The State Secretary responded that a policy reaction will follow before summer, that compliant ongoing shallowings cannot simply be stopped, and that competent authorities will be asked to consider the new findings for new initiatives.
Ongoing shallowings that meet all legal requirements cannot simply be stopped.
Lopende verondiepingen die aan alle wettelijke eisen voldoen kunnen niet zomaar worden stopgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over het toekennen van een groot bedrag aan NOW-steun aan een meermaals veroordeeld bedrijf, dat weigert dwangsommen te betalen

Two MPs asked why a company that rents out animals, has repeated court-imposed penalties and enforcement history, received about 170,000 euro in NOW wage subsidy and remains an approved training company. The ministers answered that the NOW scheme does not test animal welfare, that subsidy amounts are advances pending final settlement, and that SBB and the NVWA are monitoring the company.
Animal welfare is not part of these conditions.
Dierenwelzijn is geen onderdeel van deze voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het verspreiden van schadelijke desinformatie over de wolf

An MP asked the ministers of Nature and Nitrogen and of Justice and Security about a hound among sheep reports, wolf diet, Flemish penalties, and how to combat disinformation about wolves through criminal law, platform responsibility and awareness campaigns. The minister answered that there is no central data on livestock killed by dogs, that existing law and penalties are adequate, that disinformation is protected speech except where it leads to unlawful acts, and that a wolf plan with information will follow after summer.
Figures on farm animals killed by dogs are not available, because there is no central registration of this.
Cijfers van landbouwhuisdieren die gedood worden door honden zijn niet beschikbaar, omdat hier geen centrale registratie van plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke, Wuite, Van Raan en Wassenberg over de uitzending van Zembla 'Bedreigd Nederlands Koraal' van 17 februari 222

MPs Boucke, Wuite, Van Raan and Wassenberg asked about a Zembla broadcast on threats to Bonaire's coral reef, including a planned oil pier, BBT's sustainability mandate and the 40 million euro WEB green-energy request. The minister answers that no new pier is currently planned, that 10 million euro was invested in BBT for the energy transition, and that a transition roadmap for the Caribbean Netherlands will follow before summer.
To avoid influencing the tender for the construction, some data remain confidential.
Om de aanbesteding van de bouw niet te beïnvloeden, blijven sommige gegevens vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over het exporteren van hamsters naar Hongkong

MPs Wassenberg and Teunissen asked whether the government would share its exchanges with Hong Kong authorities after hamsters exported from the Netherlands tested positive for the Delta variant, and whether it would halt live rodent exports. The minister said the correspondence was shared with parliament via the health minister, that existing EU and OIE rules were followed without a SARS-CoV-2 requirement, and that no direct reason for a ban exists while exports stay within those rules, with a national zoonosis action plan to follow.
As long as the trade in live rodents to other member states or export to third countries takes place within the framework of this regulation, I see no direct reason to ban the trade.
Zolang de handel van levende knaagdieren naar andere lidstaten of export naar derde landen binnen de kaders van deze regelgeving plaatsvindt, zie ik geen directe aanleiding de handel te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de wanpraktijken aan boord van vissersschepen op de Noordzee

An MP asked the minister about fish being killed without stunning on Dutch fishing vessels and about enforcement of the landing obligation, including camera monitoring and inspection numbers. The minister answered that no rules govern killing fish at sea, that research on stunning methods is underway, and that inspections of around 300 per year are carried out with plans for a camera monitoring pilot.
In the RVO fisheries information bulletin of December 2021, fishers were once again reminded of the need for complete and correct registration of bycatch.

In het door de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) uitgegeven informatiebulletin Visserij van december 2021 zijn de vissers nogmaals gewezen op de noodzaak van een volledige en correcte registratie van bijvangsten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Raan over zandsuppletie bij gaswinning onder het UNESCO Werelderfgoed

MPs Wassenberg and Van Raan asked whether UNESCO has been informed that sand nourishment may compensate gas- and salt-extraction subsidence in the Wadden Sea World Heritage site, and what UNESCO's view is. The minister answers that UNESCO was informed via the 2008 nomination file, that sand nourishment is coastal maintenance rather than a mitigation measure, that IUCN will assess the Ternaard gas extraction impact, and that no delisting is currently in question.
I do not consider that necessary.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg naar aanleiding van de aflevering ‘Buitensporige dierenartsrekeningen’ van Meldpunt van 7 januari 2022

An MP asked the ministers about very high emergency veterinary costs for pets, pre-payment demands, advice to borrow money or rehome animals, VAT, market concentration and vet training numbers. The minister replied that veterinary pricing is a free market, that the ACM oversees competition, that vets must disclose prices, and that a study of the veterinary sector and labour market is underway.
The Netherlands Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) is the independent regulator for competition, a number of specific sectors and consumer protection.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) is de onafhankelijke toezichthouder voor mededinging, een aantal specifieke sectoren en de bescherming van consumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de tekortschietende steun aan dierenhulpverleners voor het weghalen van met vogelgriep besmette, in het wilde levende dieren

MP Wassenberg asks the minister about inadequate support for animal rescue volunteers who collect birds dead or sick from avian flu, including who is responsible and who pays for protective equipment. The minister answers that responsibility is shared between landowners and government, promises consultation with stakeholders on execution and financing, and says volunteer organisations should not incur costs beyond their means.
I will therefore consult with the parties involved to see how we can jointly further improve the execution of this shared responsibility in practice.
Ik zal daarom met betrokken partijen in overleg gaan om te kijken hoe we samen de uitvoering van deze gedeelde verantwoordelijkheid in de praktijk verder kunnen verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de weigering van het Erasmus Medisch Centrum om gegevens over proefdierengebruik te delen met de toezichthouder

MP Wassenberg asked whether Erasmus MC refused to supply animal experiment data to the NVWA, whether this breaches the Dierproevenregeling, and what sanctions would follow. The minister answered that Erasmus MC met its legal registration obligations, that the missing institution-level table is not legally required, that reminders were sent without reply, and that the national overview remains complete.
Erasmus Medical Centre (MC) complied with the legally required registration requirements for animal experiments and laboratory animals in 2020.
Het Erasmus Medisch Centrum (MC) heeft aan de wettelijk verplichte eisen over de registratie van uitgevoerde dierproeven en proefdieren 2020 voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de plannen van dierentuinen om gorilla’s te doden

An MP asks the minister whether EAZA plans to cull, castrate or solitarily house male gorillas and whether Dutch zoos, which are EAZA members, would do so, and asks the minister to oppose such practices. The minister says Dutch EAZA zoos have no plans to kill or isolate male gorillas, calls prolonged solitary housing unacceptable, and points to ongoing NVD research into alternatives, without committing to a new formal step.
There are seven zoos in the Netherlands that are EAZA members and keep gorillas.
Er zijn zeven dierentuinen in Nederland die lid zijn van EAZA en die gorilla’s houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over geweld tegen anti-Zwarte Piet demonstranten in Volendam

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked why the cabinet did not condemn violence against anti-Zwarte Piet demonstrators in Volendam, whether perpetrators should be prosecuted, and how the mayor and local triangle handled the unannounced demonstration. The minister condemned the violence and the attempt to block the constitutional right to demonstrate, but said prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, and that assessing the mayor's and local triangle's conduct is for the mayor, who answers to the municipal council.
Facilitating and properly managing demonstrations is the responsibility of the mayor, who is accountable to the municipal council.
Het faciliteren en in goede banen leiden van demonstraties is aan de burgemeester, die daarover verantwoording aflegt aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Wassenberg over het rapport van de Algemene Rekenkamer: ‘waar is de grutto?’

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the minister whether the Court of Audit's finding that meadow bird policy failed, with grutto numbers still declining, justifies that conclusion, and how ANLb subsidies will be kept effective. The minister acknowledged the report, rejected the 'failed policy' conclusion while accepting that results have not yet reversed the decline, and pointed to monitoring and a 2023 ecological evaluation without committing to new structural changes.
I do not share this conclusion.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de export van dolfijnen naar een pretpark in China

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the export of dolphins, walruses and sea lions from the Dolfinarium to a Chinese amusement park, covering permits, inspections, the scope of the animal-welfare check under Article 4.11, sales proceeds, resale risks and breeding. The Minister answers that the Dutch rules apply to the transfer, that the RVO assesses the information provided, that the Dolfinarium is not required to produce a separate report, that conditions in China fall outside Dutch jurisdiction, and that the Dolfinarium does not currently intend to breed.
I see no objection in advance to sharing the relevant documents with your House in due course.
Ik zie op voorhand geen bezwaar om de desbetreffende stukken te zijner tijd met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de Zembla-aflevering waaruit blijkt dat de verkoop van orka Morgan gebaseerd was op leugens

MP Wassenberg asked the minister whether the export of orca Morgan to Loro Parque, based on alleged dishonesty by the Dolfinarium, breached export conditions and welfare rules, and what would be done about it and about the planned transfer of twelve animals to a Chinese park. Minister Schouten answered that the EU certificate was lawfully issued (confirmed by the Council of State), that Morgan's welfare is regrettable but the Netherlands no longer has jurisdiction, and that any complaint about Spanish use must go to Spanish authorities; she declined to suspend the Hainan transfer, citing separate procedures.
Unfortunately, after the transfer of the orca to Loro Parque, the Netherlands no longer has jurisdiction over the animal.
Helaas heeft Nederland na de overdracht van de orka aan Loro Parque geen rechtsmacht meer ten aanzien van het dier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over disproportioneel politiegeweld, de aanhouding van een journalist en rechtsongelijkheid bij een demonstratie van Extinction Rebellion

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the arrest of a Volkskrant journalist at an Extinction Rebellion demonstration, alleged disproportionate police force, and unequal treatment compared with farmers' protests in 2019. The minister declined to judge the police conduct, which is for the prosecutor, courts, and mayor, and gave no apology or independent investigation.
It is for other authorities – where applicable the judge – to assess whether the use of force was lawful.
Het is aan andere autoriteiten – in voorkomende gevallen de rechter – om te beoordelen of het geweldsgebruik rechtmatig was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over “de aanhoudende kindermarketing en onderwijsbeïnvloeding door de fossiele industrie”

An MP asked the ministers about Shell's 'children's council' outreach to primary schools near its Pernis and Moerdijk sites, alleged ExxonMobil gifts in classrooms, climate responsibility, and how children are protected from fossil-industry marketing in schools. The minister answered that schools and teachers decide on educational materials under school autonomy, that the government is reluctant to steer material choices, that the sponsorship convenant was tightened, and that no new protective measures are planned.
The central government is therefore very restrained in encouraging or discouraging the use of certain materials in education.
De rijksoverheid is daarom zeer terughoudend in het stimuleren of juist ontmoedigen van het gebruik van bepaalde materialen in het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de bescherming van de privacy en het gebruik van een front-facing camera op de zelfscanner van de Albert Heijn

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether Albert Heijn's handheld self-scanners with a front-facing camera enable facial recognition of customers, and what the government will do to prevent supermarkets from using it. The minister replied that the camera is switched off, that the manufacturer lists facial recognition as a possible use, that GDPR allows biometric processing only with explicit consent or for overriding public interest, that a bill clarifying this in the UAVG is planned, and that the AP's guidance is considered sufficient.
The statutory text will explicitly state that the exception in Article 29 may only be applied where necessary for an overriding public interest.
In de wettekst wordt expliciet opgenomen dat de uitzonderingsgrond van artikel 29 alleen kan worden toegepast wanneer dat nodig is voor een zwaarwegend algemeen belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over het aankomende staatsbezoek in Noorwegen en het aankaarten van de Noorse walvisjacht

MPs Wassenberg and Teunissen asked whether the King knows that Norway killed 575 whales this year, whether IMF findings on whale carbon storage are known, and whether he would raise whaling with Norway during the state visit. The government confirms awareness of the figures and findings, says the climate-whaling link was not discussed but will feed into Dutch positions at the IWC, and reports that the Dutch position for a whaling ban was raised by other delegation members and by the Prime Minister by phone.
This subject was not raised by the King during the state visit, but it was raised by other members of the delegation.
Dit onderwerp is niet aangekaart door de Koning tijdens het staatsbezoek, maar wel door andere leden van de delegatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Wassenberg over de subsidieaanvraag van de Koning voor het beheer van het Kroondomein

MPs Wassenberg and Sneller asked the minister about the King's subsidy application for managing the Het Loo crown estate, including whether it could circumvent the 358-day public opening requirement and which parcels and hectares were covered. The minister answered that the application is the King's responsibility, that the opening conditions apply to nature-subsidy areas with limited exceptions, and that the application has been published on the estate's website.
It is up to the King (the estate's steward) to complete the subsidy application.
Het is aan (de rentmeester van) de Koning om de subsidieaanvraag in te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Vestering over de jachtakte van prinses Amalia voor het beheer van het Kroondomein

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether Princess Amalia obtained a hunting certificate, whether an exception to the minimum age was made, and whether this relates to management of the Crown Estate and a subsidy request. The minister answered that she obtained a hunting diploma (not a hunting licence), that no exception was made, and that there is no link between the diploma, the subsidy request and management of the Crown Estate.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over geconstateerde ernstige misstanden op de dierenbeurs in Houten

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked about serious animal welfare and public health concerns at the Houten reptile fair, including cramped housing, stress, zoonosis risk and NVWA inspections. The minister acknowledged the welfare concerns, reported NVWA findings and inspection history, and said a broader exploration of animal fairs and legal analysis is underway, without committing to a ban.
I have started an exploration into animal fairs in the Netherlands.
Ik ben een verkenning gestart over beurzen met dieren in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over de massale dolfijnslachting op de Faeröer eilanden

MPs Wassenberg and Teunissen asked the government about the mass dolphin slaughter on the Faroe Islands, including whether Denmark and the Faroese government have been pressed and whether the topic will be raised in EU forums. The minister replied that the Netherlands opposes the hunt, that the ambassador has raised it with Faroese representatives, that the Faroe Islands are responsible for their own marine resources, and that the issue will be discussed in the EU Council working group on whaling.
As an autonomous part of the Kingdom of Denmark, the Faroe Islands are themselves responsible for managing their natural resources, including the hunting of cetaceans.
Als autonoom onderdeel van het Koninkrijk Denemarken zijn de Faeröer Eilanden zelf verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van hun natuurlijke hulpbronnen, met inbegrip van de jacht op walvisachtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat twee wolven zijn ontsnapt in DierenPark Amersfoort

An MP asked the minister whether Amersfoort zoo is safe after two escapes in a short period, whether it should lose its licence, and whether zoos should be reconsidered. The minister replied that escapes are exceptional, that protocols were followed, that an independent investigation was completed and improvements implemented, and that zoos should not be abolished.
I do not have the investigation report in my possession.
Ik heb het onderzoeksrapport niet in mijn bezit.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Vestering en Wassenberg over het illegaal vangen van zwanen

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers of Agriculture and Justice about illegal capture of swans, including how many cases occur, how the ban on swan drives is enforced, and the number of reports received. The minister answered that the ministry lacks the data, that provinces and police are responsible for enforcement, and that reports to the NVWA and police are listed, while admitting a late reply on earlier questions.
The Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (LNV) does not have this data.
Het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (LNV) beschikt niet over deze gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Wassenberg over stropers

Two PvdD MPs asked the ministers of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality and of Justice and Security about a poaching network in Limburg, including the methods used, the seizures, detection rates and reports, and the number of animals killed. The minister condemned the practices but declined to share operational details, gave aggregated report and case figures, said animal totals cannot be reliably counted, and did not commit to a new national study.
I cannot share further information with your House, as I cannot go into individual cases or investigative information.
Meer informatie kan ik niet met uw Kamer delen aangezien ik niet in kan gaan op individuele gevallen of opsporingsinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de export van dolfijnen naar een pretpark in China

An MP asked the minister about the export of dolphins, walruses and sea lions from the Dolfinarium Harderwijk to a Chinese amusement park, including animal welfare, CITES permits, oversight of the receiving facility, and the zoo's conservation and educational value. The minister answered that transfer is allowed only if the receiving zoo meets Dutch welfare standards, that RVO will check this, that the Dolfinarium's commitments will be enforced through licence conditions, and that renovation deadlines run to 2024, 2026 and 2029.
If the Dolfinarium does not implement the changes or does not do so on time, I will take enforcement action.
Als het Dolfinarium de wijzigingen niet of niet tijdig doorvoert, zal ik handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Vestering over het bericht 'Tweede Duitse coach weggestuurd uit Tokio na mishandeling paard'

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether a German coach's mistreatment of a horse at the Tokyo Olympics constitutes animal abuse, and about whipping, bit use, horse trade fraud, subsidies and a national horse welfare decree. The minister condemned the conduct, said whip use as punishment is not customary and that enforcement follows existing frameworks, but declined a dedicated horse welfare law and deferred answers on several points.
I am of the view that deploying specific, additional legislation on horse welfare does not contribute to better welfare for horses or to accelerating the process.
Ik ben van mening dat het inzetten van specifieke, aanvullende wetgeving voor paardenwelzijn niet bijdraagt aan beter welzijn voor paarden of versnelling van het proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg ingezonden over de natuurbeheersubsidie van Kroondomein Het Loo

MP Wassenberg (PvdD) asked whether Kroondomein Het Loo may close during the period from 15 September 2021 despite the statutory opening requirements, whether the minister will implement the motion for year-round opening, whether the 2022 Gelderland plan excludes areas from the opening duty, whether objections can be lodged against the new subsidy application, whether the EUR 4.7 million subsidy should be reclaimed, and which hunting permits were granted. The minister answered that the temporary closure complies with current rules, that the new conditions only apply from 2022, and deferred answers to questions 2 to 6 for further consultation.
For questions 2 to 6 that is not possible, because more time is needed for consultation and investigation to answer them.
Voor de vragen 2 tot en met 6 is dat niet mogelijk, omdat voor het antwoord op die vragen meer tijd nodig is voor overleg en onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het gebruik van een verboden landbouwgif in viskwekerijen

MP Wassenberg asked the minister whether the banned pesticide imidacloprid could be used in fish farming and whether imported farmed fish with residues could reach Dutch shops, and asked about antibiotics, mortality, wastewater and inspections. The minister answered that imidacloprid is not authorised for fish in the EU, that an MRL exists for food safety while environmental risks are assessed separately, and described monitoring and the antibiotic rules, mostly without giving the specific figures requested.
No resistance data specific to national aquaculture production are known.
Er zijn geen resistentiegegevens specifiek van de nationale aquacultuurproductie bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Wassenberg over een eventuele subsidieaanvraag voor Kroondomein Het Loo

MPs Sneller and Wassenberg asked whether a new subsidy application for maintenance of Kroondomein Het Loo had been received, and when it would be shared with parliament. The minister replied that no application has been received yet, that the Chamber will be sent the subsidy framework before any application, and that applications must be submitted by 31 December 2021 for subsidy from 1 January 2022.
I will give effect to the above commitment by sending you the framework with the subsidy conditions against which any application will be assessed, before any possible application.
Ik zal invulling aan bovenstaande toezegging geven door u voorafgaande aan een eventuele aanvraag het kader met de subsidievoorwaarden te sturen, waaraan de aanvraag getoetst zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de geitenhouderij en het leed van geitenbokjes

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about animal welfare in goat farming, including early slaughter of kid goats, short-term transport, colostrum provision, registration rules, housing and a subsidy for a new goat barn. The minister answers each question, acknowledging the registration tightening and a subsidy under review, but says data are not yet conclusive and no new legal obligations on housing or colostrum are planned.
At this moment, however, it is still too early to draw conclusions about the impact of the amended I&R obligation.
Op dit moment is het echter nog te vroeg om conclusies te trekken over de impact van de gewijzigde I&R-plicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat de hobbyvisserijsector op school reclame maakt

The MP asks whether a primary school lesson filmed with Sportvisserij Nederland, VIS TV and Enzo Knol amounts to hobby-fishing promotion disguised as teaching material, breaching the sponsorship convenant, and whether parents were asked consent. The minister replies that schools have autonomy over teaching materials under the constitutional freedom of education, that content review is the school's and inspectorate's responsibility, and that no further government action is planned.
It is not for the central government to review the content of teaching materials substantively.
Het is niet aan de rijksoverheid om lesmateriaal inhoudelijk te toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over het manifest ‘Klimaat in de Klas’

MPs Wassenberg and Teunissen asked the Minister of Education about the 'Klimaat in de Klas' manifesto, including curriculum climate content, student and teacher involvement, objectivity, and corporate influence such as Shell's festival and sponsorship in schools. The Minister answered that the government is open to dialogue, is pursuing stronger sustainability content in curriculum proposals, but says schools are autonomous and the government's ability to restrict corporate materials is limited by freedom of education and expression.
It is not centrally recorded how often and by what means companies or other parties try to influence education.
Er wordt niet landelijk bijgehouden hoe vaak en waarmee bedrijven of andere partijen proberen het onderwijs te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite, Ceder, Bromet, Wassenberg en Simons over het bericht “heeft premier Jacobs een punt als zij zegt dat Nederland vals speelt”

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister about the Rijksministerraad decision of 23 April 2021 to release the fifth tranche of liquidity support to Sint Maarten and why the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations did not implement it. The Prime Minister answered that concerns about corporate governance at the airport led the State Secretary to resubmit the matter, which the council reversed on 28 May, and that no change to the council's rules of procedure is planned.
I see no reason to amend the rules of procedure of the council of ministers.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om het reglement van orde van de ministerraad te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Wassenberg over CO2-uitstoot van bodemberoerende visserij, die even hoog is als de luchtvaartindustrie

MPs Teunissen and Wassenberg asked whether CO2 released from bottom trawling is counted in national emissions, whether it can be quantified, and whether the government will protect 30% of Dutch seas. The minister replied that seabed disturbance emissions are not counted nationally because IPCC rules provide no method and the CO2 share is unknown, and that protection follows the Noordzeeakkoord targets (13.7% rising to 15% by 2030) rather than 30%.
I will explore, with the State Secretary of EZK and Dutch knowledge institutions, the options for characterising the nature and severity of seabed disturbance as a source of CO2 emissions.
Ik zal in overleg met de Staatssecretaris van EZK met Nederlandse kennisinstellingen de mogelijkheden verkennen om de aard en ernst van bodemberoering als bron van CO 2 -uitstoot te duiden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Vestering over het 'per ongeluk' kappen van een beschermd bos en het kappen van bomen in het broedseizoen

MPs Wassenberg and Vestering asked the minister about the accidental felling of a protected forest and tree-cutting during the breeding season, including killed squirrels, a badger disturbance permit, and the lack of central oversight of municipal and provincial tree-felling. The minister acknowledged the Nature Conservation Act was breached, referred enforcement to the RUD Utrecht, said central regulation is not the answer but will explore changes with provinces and VNG, and committed to raising the issues with an expert group.
The investigation by the RUD is still ongoing, so the province cannot comment on it in advance of that investigation.
Het onderzoek bij de RUD is nog lopende, waardoor de provincie vooruitlopend op dit onderzoek hier niet op in kan gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over ernstig gewonde varkens bij een exportverzamelplaats

An MP asked the minister about severely injured sows at an export collection point in Gelderland, including whether NVWA checks were carried out, why the site's approval was not suspended, and why NVWA did not enforce on the footage. The minister answered that the animals could not be identified or linked to the site, so no enforcement was possible, while confirming a visible animal should not have been transported and reporting inspection and complaint figures for 2019.
It could not be established that these animals were delivered to the collection centre, and therefore also not whether these animals were presented and inspected for export.
Er kon niet vastgesteld worden dat deze dieren zijn aangevoerd op het verzamelcentrum en dus ook niet of deze dieren zijn aangeboden en gekeurd voor export.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het verbod op verrijkte kooien voor leghennen

MP Wassenberg asks the minister to confirm the ban on enriched cages for laying hens since 1 January 2021, the number of hens and farms still in such cages, and whether the NVWA or private body COKZ enforces the ban and whether all farms have been checked. The minister confirms the ban, corrects earlier figures, says 14 farms were registered in 2019, admits checks are not yet complete and grants one farm a temporary exemption, and defends COKZ inspections as efficient.
No, checks on this will be carried out by the COKZ as soon as possible.
Nee, controle hierop wordt zo spoedig mogelijk uitgevoerd door het COKZ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de structurele mishandeling van honden in training bij leden van de Koninklijke Nederlandse Politiehonden Vereniging (KNPV)

An MP from PvdD asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about structural animal abuse in training of police dogs by KNPV members, including demands to suspend ties, halt exports, ban electric equipment, and review the dogs' use as force. The minister acknowledged the abuse reports, said a criminal investigation is ongoing, refused to suspend the relationship with the KNPV as a whole, and promised a law to ban electric training equipment.
A bill is being prepared to introduce such a ban.
Er wordt gewerkt aan een wetsvoorstel om een dergelijk verbod in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het transport van duizenden Nederlandse koeien naar landen in het Midden-Oosten

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture about thousands of Dutch cattle exported by sea to Middle Eastern countries despite the May 2020 suspension of exports requiring rest stops outside the EU, and about enforcement at non-EU ports and during sea transport. The minister confirmed the suspension applied only to exports needing EU-external rest stops, said the NVWA lacks powers and visibility outside the EU, and committed to pushing for an EU ban on long-distance live exports to non-EU countries.
It is not possible to impose EU legislation on non-EU countries and the NVWA has no powers in countries outside the EU.
Het is niet mogelijk om EU-wetgeving aan niet-EU landen op te leggen en de NVWA heeft geen bevoegdheden in landen buiten de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Raan over de Rabobank die erkent dat het landbouwsysteem failliet is, maar verandering tegenwerkt,

MPs Wassenberg and Van Raan asked the ministers about Rabobank acknowledging co-responsibility for agricultural problems while allegedly resisting change, and about financing barriers for farmers seeking sustainable transition and the use of subsidies that may flow to banks. The minister acknowledged shared responsibility of financiers, pointed to voluntary initiatives, the Omschakelprogramma and Investeringsfonds, the SER exploration, and declined to pursue additional legislation or new reporting, leaving banks' lending decisions to them.
I do not intend to work towards an additional reporting cycle at company level, but I consider it very important to have good insight into developments in this area.
Ik ben niet voornemens naar een additionele rapportagecyclus op bedrijfsniveau toe te werken, maar ik vind het wel heel belangrijk om goed inzicht te hebben in de ontwikkelingen op dit terrein.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat het BPRC apen infecteert met het vogelgriepvirus

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the government about a BPRC study infecting monkeys with H5N1 avian flu, including animal suffering, the risk to the poultry sector, and whether the government will reduce animal testing and the primate breeding colony. The minister answers that the study was reviewed and permitted by the Central Committee on Animal Experiments, defers questions on zoonosis policy to a pending expert review, and states that the 40% reduction target for primate experiments by 2025 remains unchanged.

All animal experiments in the Netherlands are independently and carefully assessed by the Central Committee on Animal Experiments (CCD), which then determines whether the animal experiment may take place from a scientific and ethical standpoint.

Alle dierproeven Nederland worden onafhankelijk en zorgvuldig beoordeeld door de Centrale Commissie Dierproeven (CCD), die vervolgens bepaalt of de dierproef vanuit wetenschappelijk en ethisch oogpunt mag plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over het gebruik van bouwpuin vervuild met plastic voor wandelpaden

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked whether building rubble contaminated with plastic, used for forest and nature paths by State Forestry Service (Staatsbosbeheer), can be guaranteed free of harmful substances, and whether its use should be banned. The State Secretary answered that no national data exist on the quantities used, that the EU and Dutch standards cap plastic contamination at 1% but are not otherwise specific, and that the government will examine whether plastic contamination can be better regulated by year-end while supporting Staatsbosbeheer's initiative to explore alternatives.
At national level there is no insight into this. There is no reporting obligation for the application of recycled granulate as a building material.
Op landelijk niveau bestaat hierin geen inzicht. Op het toepassen van recyclinggranulaat als bouwstof rust geen meldingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de subsidie aan de Koning voor het beheer van het Kroondomein

An MP asked the government about a nature-management subsidy paid to the King for the Kroondomein, including legal basis, missing application, public access closures, and whether the subsidy should be reclaimed. The minister answered that the subsidy was lawfully granted under the Kaderwet EZ-subsidies, that Parliament was informed via the budget, and that no reclaim is warranted, while declining to comment on royal security measures.
I do not comment on security measures taken to protect the King.
Over veiligheidsmaatregelen die getroffen worden ter bescherming van de Koning doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het doodrijden van een wolvin door drukte in natuurgebieden

An MP asked whether recreational pressure, low-flying military helicopters and deer culling on the Veluwe disturb wolves, and whether speed limits or bans should be imposed to protect wolves and otters. The minister answered that disturbance only arises when visitors break conduct rules, that the Veluwe helicopter flights are judged not to disturb wolves, and that speed limits are a local road-manager matter, while promising no new protective measures for the wolf habitat.
Yes, I am aware of the report.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over puppy’s die als ‘click and collect’-handelswaar kunnen worden afgehaald bij een omstreden puppyhandelaar

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a controversial puppy dealer reopening under click-and-collect rules, alleged fraud and neglect since 2015, and the NVWA having paused breeder inspections during COVID-19. The Minister confirms click-and-collect applies to puppy sales, refuses to disclose individual inspection data, states that the NVWA resumed priority-based oversight with a protocol for home inspections, and promises a study on a mandatory cooling-off period and an I&R/DNA system, but rejects an import ban as unenforceable.
The NVWA does not share data on individual companies.
De NVWA deelt geen gegevens over individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de oproep van de NVWA om te stoppen met het kopen van puppy’s omdat het probleem van malafide hondenhandel te groot is

An MP asked the Minister about the NVWA inspector's call to stop buying puppies because illegal dog trade is too large to control, and about enforcement gaps including Hungarian documents and internet sales. The Minister replied that the call targeted buyers, that the NVWA runs risk-based supervision and awareness campaigns, that a ban on imports or online sales is not practicable, and that an identification and registration system and a DNA databank are being developed.
I do not have the possibility to regularly inspect breeders in other countries.
Ik beschik niet over de mogelijkheid om fokkers in andere landen regelmatig te controleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het moeten wijken van een dassenburcht voor een nieuwbouwwijk

An MP asked the minister about the province of Limburg granting a licence to capture and relocate badgers from a sett in Roermond to make way for new housing, and whether the species' duty of care was respected. The minister confirmed the licence, stated all badgers have been captured and moved, said the province is the competent authority, and noted that the duty of care has a mainly supportive role for nationally protected species.
My officials are in close contact with the province of Limburg and are also in contact about this case.
Mijn ambtenaren staan in goed contact met de provincie Limburg, en hebben ook contact over deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de onwenselijke handel in natuurvergunningen door extern salderen

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the trade in nature permits through external netting (extern salderen), including their supposed paper value, compensation in buyout schemes, and whether permits should lapse. The minister answered that permits confer no tradeable emission rights, that buyout schemes do not compensate for permit value, and that permits are adjusted or withdrawn, while giving partial figures and declining to estimate values or the number of farms affected.
Because no emission rights exist, it is not possible to estimate the value of nitrogen space in issued nature permits.
Omdat er geen emissierechten bestaan, is het niet mogelijk om een inschatting te maken van de waarde van stikstofruimte in afgegeven natuurvergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het hoge gebruik van landbouwgif door de sierteeltsector en de slechte naleving van de betreffende wet- en regelgeving

An MP asked the minister about high pesticide use in the ornamental horticulture sector, low compliance with pesticide rules, limited inspections, illegal pesticide trade, and whether COVID aid should have required pesticide reduction. The minister replied that use per hectare fell since 2012 for most crops, compliance was 67% in a 2019 inspection, the NVWA works risk-based, aid was not conditioned on sustainability, and a Drenthe lily pilot is starting.
Of course I find it unacceptable that laws and regulations are not complied with by everyone.
Ik vind het uiteraard onacceptabel dat wet- en regelgeving niet door iedereen wordt nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de uitspraak van de Rechtbank Noord-Nederland dat technische lapmiddelen geen oplossing vormen voor de stikstofproblematiek

MP Wassenberg asked the minister about a court ruling that technical farm measures do not justify nitrogen permits, whether the ABDTopconsult studies show herd reduction is needed, and whether public money for technical measures is wasted. The minister disputed that the ruling undermines technical measures, said the package balances staying and exiting farmers, and stated the ruling has no current consequences for intern/extern salderen policy.
A substantive response to the independent explorations on the nitrogen problem is for the next cabinet, as are the choices made or not made on that basis.
Een inhoudelijke reactie op de onafhankelijke verkenningen met betrekking tot de stikstofproblematiek is aan het volgende kabinet, evenals de keuzes die al dan niet op basis daarvan worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over politiegeweld bij een demonstratie op het Malieveld

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about alleged disproportionate police violence at a COVID protest on the Malieveld, including baton strikes, police dog use and water cannon hits on journalists, and whether an independent investigation would be carried out. The minister answered that the police and the Public Prosecution Service are assessing the use of force under existing rules, that no separate investigation is planned, and that the police dog deployment criteria have been tightened in a recent amendment to the Ambtsinstructie.
Whether or not there was disproportionate use of force is not for me to judge but for the authorities that investigate and assess that use of force.
Het oordeel of er wel of niet sprake is geweest van disproportioneel geweldgebruik is niet aan mij maar aan de autoriteiten die dat geweldgebruik onderzoeken en beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de onzin van subsidieslurpende mestfabrieken

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether manure processing plants receiving SDE++ subsidy really produce renewable energy, given gas use, digestate marketing, fraud risk and emissions. The minister answered that subsidies go to renewable energy production, that fraud risks are addressed through enforcement, and declined to remove manure installations from the scheme.
No figures are kept on gas use by manure processors.
Er worden geen cijfers bijgehouden van het aardgasgebruik bij mestverwerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over financiële hulp voor wildopvangcentra en de kosten die dierenambulances en vogelopvangcentra maken als gevolg van vogelgriepuitbraken

Wassenberg (PvdD) asked whether the minister would provide structural financial support for wildlife rehabilitation centres and animal ambulances facing costs from avian influenza outbreaks, and what concrete results emerged from consultations with provinces and municipalities. The minister acknowledged the extra costs, said the ministry does not track which authorities pay, and announced a one-off subsidy covering 50% of avian-flu related costs, framed as an exceptional case.
Nevertheless, I intend to grant a one-off subsidy to cover part of the costs of caring for birds with avian flu.
Desondanks ben ik voornemens een eenmalige subsidie toe te kennen om een deel van de kosten voor de zorg voor vogels met vogelgriep te vergoeden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het Ierse plan om dit voorjaar tienduizenden kalfjes op het vliegtuig te zetten naar Nederland

MP Wassenberg (PvdD) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about an Irish plan to fly young calves to the Netherlands, and whether the minister would stop calf imports. The minister answered that the Irish plan raises welfare and climate concerns, that the concerns were passed to Irish authorities, and that calf imports over 8 hours will be phased out, with a possible EU-wide ban pursued.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de natuurvergunning van Groningen Airport Eelde

Two MPs (Van Raan and Wassenberg, PvdD) asked the minister whether the 2009 nature permit for Groningen Airport Eelde, its monitoring plans and reports, and possible additional conditions to protect nearby Natura 2000 areas were in order. The minister confirmed she is the competent authority, said monitoring was required, but explained that no further conditions were needed because flight movements fell after the permit, so the planned post-permit monitoring was never carried out.
The subsequent monitoring, which concerned the expansion, ultimately did not take place because the number of flight movements actually decreased after the permit was issued.
De opvolgende monitoring, die zag op de uitbreiding, heeft echter uiteindelijk niet plaatsgevonden omdat de hoeveelheid vliegbewegingen na afgifte van de vergunning juist is afgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Wassenberg over de ontheffing van de avondklok voor de jacht op zwijnen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether hunting wild boar spreads African swine fever, citing EFSA research, hunting-hygiene risks, hunting tourism and an inconsistent dog rule. The Minister rejects that hunting spreads the disease, defends culling as risk-reducing, and says the dog rule will be clarified in the flyer.
The NVWA will adjust the text in the flyer.
De NVWA zal de tekst in de flyer aanpassen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over lacunes in de beoordeling van Wageningen Environmental Research over het onderzoek naar landbouwgif in koeienmest bij veebedrijven in weidevogelgebieden in Gelderland

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about gaps in Wageningen Environmental Research's assessment of pesticide residues in cattle manure and whether they harm soil life and dung beetles, and about the effectiveness of weidevogel programmes. The Minister largely defended the existing assessment and its methods, said WEnR was commissioned to reason about risks from manure chemicals, and said a scoping exercise on knowledge gaps would follow.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Wassenberg over het sluiten van trimsalons voor dieren

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked why dog and cat grooming salons were closed during the lockdown, whether owners may bring animals in, why salons count as public places, and whether small salons can get state support. The minister answered that salons may fetch and return animals, that home-based groomers may take clients by appointment, and that existing support schemes are sufficient, so no further widening is planned.
At this moment I see no reason and no room to broaden this further.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding en geen ruimte om dit nog verder te verbreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over plannen voor legalisering door provincies van twee illegale megastallen van varkensindustrieel Straathof

An MP from the Partij voor de Dieren asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about provinces legalising two unlicensed pig megastables run by Straathof, whether this conflicts with buy-out schemes, and whether the state should refuse legalisation and tighten oversight. The Minister answers that permits follow the legal framework and PAS-melder rules, that the owner's foreign ban and animal welfare record are not grounds to refuse a Wnb permit, that NVWA inspections occurred with sanctions, and that no action to block the legalisation is planned.

Nor can the alleged improper conduct of the entrepreneur towards animals be taken into account in assessing the Wnb permit application, as this aspect falls outside the assessment framework for these applications.

Evenmin kan het gestelde onbehoorlijke gedrag van de ondernemer jegens dieren in de beoordeling van de aanvraag van een Wnb-vergunning worden betrokken, aangezien dit aspect niet valt binnen het toetsingskader voor de beoordeling van deze aanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht ‘De strijd tegen mestfraude’

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about manure fraud, including NVWA inspection findings, NVWA capacity, the delayed real-time manure transport registration, bank support for offending firms and the need to reduce manure production. The Minister confirms the figures with caveats, points to the enforcement strategy and sector plan, defers the rVDM decision to a successor and declines to commit to reducing livestock numbers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het mogelijk uitsterven van haaien en roggen

An MP asked the minister about the decline of sharks and rays from overfishing, bycatch and the shortfin mako shark at ICCAT, including whether the EU voted against a moratorium. The minister confirmed most facts, said the Netherlands backed scientific advice for a moratorium while other EU states opposed it, and committed to keep pushing for one.
I will continue to push firmly within ICCAT for consistently following scientific advice; in this case, therefore, for a moratorium.
Ik zal mij binnen ICCAT nadrukkelijk blijven inzetten voor het consequent volgen van het wetenschappelijk advies; in deze dus voor een moratorium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het gebruik van politiepaarden en -honden bij oproerbeheersing

MP Wassenberg (PvdD) asked the Justice Minister about police horse and dog injuries and welfare during crowd control at unlawful demonstrations in Amsterdam and Eindhoven, and whether alternatives are being investigated. Minister Grapperhaus confirmed the incidents and injuries, argued the animals' deterrent role is an acceptable risk with welfare measures in place, and said no suitable alternative exists yet while developments are monitored.
To date there is no suitable alternative to the deployment of police horses and dogs for crowd control, crowd management and riot control.
Er is tot op heden nog geen geschikt alternatief voor de inzet van politiepaarden en -honden ten aanzien van crowd control , crowd management en riot control .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het vermalen van vissen bij waterkrachtcentrales

An MP asks whether hydropower plants on the Rhine and Maas (Vattenfall at Alphen and Maurik, RWE at Linne) are exempt from the 10% fish-mortality norm, why fish mortality remains high, whether fish passes and warning systems are monitored, and whether operators will be pressed to take extra measures. The minister confirms temporary exemptions for testing new fish-protection techniques under strict monitoring, says the Council of State ruled the 10% norm cannot currently be applied, and promises to amend the legal basis and continue talks with operators.
The Council of State ruled in its judgment that the 10% norm cannot be applied under the current legal anchoring. I will therefore have the legal anchoring amended.
De Raad van State heeft in haar uitspraak geoordeeld dat de 10%-norm bij de huidige juridische verankering niet gehanteerd kan worden. Ik zal de juridische verankering daarom laten aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de onduidelijke brief over de inzet voor het bijenrichtsnoer

MP Wassenberg asked the minister to clarify what 'most conservative protection level' for honeybees means, why the Ctgb uses 12.8% rather than 7% colony loss, and whether the minister will push for 7% at the EU meeting. The minister answered that the 2013 EFSA guidance set 7% as the maximum acceptable effect, that the Ctgb chose 12.8% as most conservative given natural colony variability, and that she will urge the Commission to propose protection levels and to act on the latest science.
At the 23 February meeting I will call on the Commission to come with a proposal as soon as possible.
Tijdens de bijeenkomst van 23 februari zal ik de EC oproepen om zo snel mogelijk met een voorstel te komen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over de dreigende slacht van honderdduizenden haaien voor coronavaccins

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked whether squalene from shark livers used in some COVID-19 vaccines should be replaced by plant-based sources and whether the government would choose vaccines without protected animals. The minister confirmed shark-derived squalene is in the Sanofi/GSK vaccine, said plant-based alternatives are preferable where equivalent, and promised to ask contract partners in future agreements about protected animals in production.
I am, however, willing to ask the contracting party in the case of new agreements whether they use protected animals in the production process.
Ik ben wel bereid om in geval van nieuwe overeenkomsten aan de contractpartij te vragen of ze gebruik maken van beschermde dieren bij het productieproces
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de ontheffing van de avondklok voor de jacht op zwijnen en vossen

An MP asked the government whether hunting wild boar and foxes at night is exempt from the curfew, why night hunting is allowed, and whether local permits were centrally requested. The minister replied that hunting is not a curfew exemption, only the necessary management of wild boar (to prevent African swine fever) and handling of road-killed wildlife is treated as essential work, agreed with the provinces.
In the third week of January, before the curfew was introduced, the ministry received requests from, among others, the KNJV about being able to carry out necessary wildlife management at night.

Het ministerie heeft in de derde week van januari, voorafgaand aan de invoering van de avondklok, verzoeken ontvangen van onder andere de KNJV over het in de nacht kunnen uitvoeren van noodzakelijk wildbeheer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het uitbreiden van een Natura 2000-gebied met een voormalig defensieterrein

Wassenberg (PvdD) asks whether the former Defence terrain near Meijendel Natura 2000 area, which The Hague council wants returned to nature, will be added to the protected area, and whether Zuid-Holland can help acquire it. The minister answers that the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf is examining with the municipality, province and stakeholders whether transfer is possible, aiming for clarity by September 2021, while the province plays a facilitating role.
The aim is to have clarity on this by September 2021.
Het streven is hier in september 2021 duidelijkheid over te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de koehandel met Nieuwkoopse 'stikstofruimte'

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the minister about livestock farmers in Nieuwkoop trading nitrogen deposition rights, the Natura 2000 reduction needed, and whether this is legally permissible under the PAS ruling. The minister confirms the high deposition levels, says the farms are not the main cause, admits the PAS rulings limit using nitrogen gains for mitigation, but says external netting and leasing remain allowed under policy rules being reviewed with the provinces.
For now there is no reason to assume that private initiatives are, by their nature, measures within the meaning of Article 6(1) and (2) of the Habitats Directive that could only benefit nature.

Vooralsnog is er geen aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat particuliere initiatieven naar hun aard zijn aan te merken als maatregelen in de zin van artikel 6, lid 1 en 2 Hrl, die alleen ten goede zouden kunnen komen aan de natuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat de NVWA al maandenlang weigert controles uit te voeren bij foute fokkers

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks why the NVWA has suspended enforcement of rules on breeding companion animals since March 2020, citing COVID-19, and whether it has developed protocols for home inspections. The minister confirms the suspension, says a protocol for inspections in domestic settings is being finalised, and commits to enforcement resuming once it can be done safely, with the decision on enforcement requests postponed until mid-2021.
A protocol has in the meantime been drawn up for inspections in domestic settings.
Er is overigens inmiddels een protocol opgesteld voor inspecties in huiselijke kring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het geringe animo voor de subsidieregeling voor een wolfwerend raster

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the low uptake of the subsidy scheme for wolf-proof fencing, the number of sheep killed by people and dogs, the protection of wolves against disturbance, and whether hunting in wolf habitat is compatible with protection rules. The minister said the province of Gelderland monitors its own scheme, declined to launch a campaign or commission independent research, and argued that hunting and population management are not in conflict with protection rules.
Nationally it is not centrally recorded how many sheep are killed outside the slaughterhouse, so these numbers are not known to me.
Er wordt niet centraal geregistreerd hoeveel schapen buiten het slachthuis worden gedood. Deze aantallen zijn mij daarom niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de jacht op wilde zwijnen zonder deugdelijke schietvaardigheidstoets

An MP asks the minister why wild boar hunting proceeds without a proven shooting-skill test after the drive-hunt ban, and whether hunters can be assured animals will not suffer. The minister replies that shooting is only at standing animals from high seats, that legal duties and hunting codes apply, and that retesting is left to land managers rather than being legally required.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat ontsnapte chimpansees zijn doodgeschoten in Dierenpark Amersfoort

MP Wassenberg asked about the shooting of two escaped chimpanzees at Dierenpark Amersfoort caused by a human error, and whether this warrants reconsidering chimpanzee captivity, zoo safety rules and zoos' right to exist. The minister said the shooting was a necessary safety decision, that the park has started an independent investigation, and that no ban, new inquiry or reconsideration of zoos is planned.
Dierenpark Amersfoort takes its responsibility in this and has started an independent investigation.
Dierenpark Amersfoort neemt hierin haar verantwoordelijkheid en is een onafhankelijk onderzoek gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het slachten van paling

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about eel slaughtered without stunning, after NVWA inspections in 2019 found four of eleven farms in breach. The minister confirmed the violations, said the companies were warned and will be re-checked next year, and rejected continuous supervision as unnecessary.
The other companies have been ordered to urgently comply with the Regulation.
De andere bedrijven zijn gemaand om met spoed aan de Regeling gevolg te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht ‘misleidende kindermarketing door de vee-industrie’

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether the government will act against pig-industry marketing aimed at children, including the 'The Pig Story' lesson pack and the Agractie 'Boer in de klas' programme that receives a start-up subsidy. Minister Schouten answers that schools freely choose their materials, the government does not vet or warn against them, no oversight tightening is planned, and the subsidy conditions are described.
Beyond that, I do not foresee any additional steps.
Verder voorzie ik geen extra stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over ‘de dramatische achteruitgang van de biodiversiteit in Europa, die hoofdzakelijk veroorzaakt wordt door de industriële landbouw’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the decline of European biodiversity, the role of intensive farming, the Natura 2000 stikstof approach, pesticide-related bee mortality and the new CAP and derogation. The minister answers that EU targets were not met, defends the stikstof and CAP approach, says the bee risk-assessment is pending EFSA and rejects some demands for stricter measures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over Nederlandse schuld aan Europese automatische verlengingen van landbouwgif

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture whether the Netherlands bears responsibility for EU automatic extensions of pesticide approvals and for delays at the Dutch pesticide authority Ctgb, including whether the Ctgb is held to account and what action will be taken. The minister answers that extensions are a legally required temporary measure caused by shared delays across EU actors, that the Ctgb is autonomous but accountable to her as owner, and that she will keep pressing for improvements without announcing sanctions.
I have confidence in the Ctgb that in recent years it has already taken various measures and is making every effort to limit delays.
Ik heb vertrouwen in het Ctgb dat de laatste jaren al diverse maatregelen heeft genomen en zich tot het uiterste inspant om vertragingen te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de gevolgen van de hittegolf voor dieren in de veehouderij

MP Wassenberg asked the minister about heat stress in livestock during the 2020 heatwave, including the number of animals affected, NVWA inspection capacity, shade requirements, and enforcement. Minister Schouten answered that the 110 million figure is only an estimate of animals at risk, that existing rules cover heat stress without a fixed temperature threshold, that twelve written warnings were issued in 2020, and that no additional measures are planned.
I do not have data on this.
Hier heb ik geen gegevens over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de stikstofcrisis en het gebrekkig toezicht op en handhaving van dieraantallen en natuurvergunningen

Deputy MP Wassenberg (PvdD) asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the nitrogen crisis and weak supervision and enforcement of livestock numbers and nature permits, citing press investigations of farmers emitting more than permitted and fraud risks. Minister Schouten answers that the discrepancies can have many explanations, that the Netherlands' supervision is risk-based and provinces are primarily responsible for nature permits, and that no centralisation of permits or supervision is planned.
A centralised application procedure, central registration of nature permits and central supervision would add no value.
Een centrale aanvraagprocedure, centrale registratie van natuurvergunningen en centraal toezicht heeft geen toegevoegde waarde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de aanhoudende schade van neonicotinoïden in het milieu en voor dieren

An MP asked the minister about persistent neonicotinoid contamination of surface water from greenhouses, the enforcement of greenhouse growers, and risks to birds and insects under EU approval procedures. The minister confirmed exceedances at 9 of 54 Delfland sites, described emission routes and enforcement measures, and noted that EU approvals for thiamethoxam and clothianidine have lapsed while imidacloprid's is expected to lapse.
There are various actions to prevent or limit as far as possible discharges of plant protection products into surface water.
Er zijn verschillende acties om de lozingen van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen naar het oppervlaktewater te voorkomen of zoveel mogelijk te beperken

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Amhaouch, Wilders, Graus, Emiel van Dijk, Regterschot, Nijkerken-De Haan, Raemakers, Ploumen, Gijs van Dijk, Öztürk en Wassenberg over het advies van de Raad van Europa over a

Multiple MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether she shares the Council of Europe's view that Limburgish and other regional languages need more government attention, and what the government does to promote them. The minister answered that the government gives ample attention to regional languages, pointed to the 2019 Limburgish convenant with the province, the symposia, education and childcare provisions, and the province's leading role, without committing to new obligations such as recognising Limburgish as an official government language.
The government is not working on recognising Limburgish as an official government language.
De regering werkt niet aan het erkennen van het Limburgs als overheidstaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat landbouwgif gevonden wordt in het hart van natuurgebieden

An MP asked the minister whether pesticide residues found deep inside Drenthe nature reserves show widespread drift, whether cumulative effects are assessed in authorisation, and what measures will reduce use. The minister confirms the findings, cites RIVM and Ctgb advice that current levels pose no unacceptable risk to non-target arthropods, acknowledges gaps in cumulative assessment, and commits to an exploration of area-based approaches and to asking the European Commission to address cumulative environmental effects.
I recognise the need to gain better insight into the burden on vulnerable areas from chemical substances in order to assess whether this leads to risks.
Ik onderken de behoefte om meer zicht te krijgen in de belasting van kwetsbare gebieden door chemische stoffen om te kunnen beoordelen of dat leidt tot risico's.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg , Futselaar, Bromet, De Groot, Moorlag en Graus over de onderbouwing voor de Nederlandse inzet voor de bescherming van honingbijen, hommels en wilde bijen in het bijenrichtsnoer

MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality for the scientific basis behind the Dutch position on protecting honeybees, bumblebees and wild bees in the EU bee guidance, including the BEEHAVE model, percentile choice, EFSA test runs and consultation of independent experts. The minister answered that the chosen option keeps colony size within natural variability, that the protection goal is still to be set, that a technical meeting is expected in late October, and that documents will be made public beforehand.
I will inform your House about this in advance of the meeting.
Ik zal uw Kamer voorafgaand aan deze bijeenkomst daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over de oorzaken van droogte en de gevolgen voor natuur

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked about drought causes, including drainage for agriculture, daytime irrigation, and effects on nature and Natura 2000 areas. The minister denied that drought is simply a policy failure, acknowledged agricultural drainage as one cause among several, and committed to an inventory of groundwater abstractions and area-based approaches.
The water boards and Rijkswaterstaat cannot state how many cubic metres that was in that period.
De waterschappen en Rijkswaterstaat kunnen niet aangeven hoeveel kubieke meter dat in die periode geweest is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Graus over de malafide puppyhandel vanuit Hongarije naar Nederland

MPs Wassenberg and Graus asked the minister about NVWA enforcement against illegal puppy trade from Hungary, including complaint handling, staffing, the identification and registration system, Hungarian oversight and a Belgian vet's role. The minister answered that enforcement is risk-based with limited staff, that the I&R system is being improved, that cross-border trust rules limit verification, and declined to share data on individual companies.
Data cannot be shared about individual companies.
Er kunnen geen gegevens worden gedeeld over individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de malafide puppyhandel vanuit Hongarije naar Nederland

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the ministers about illegal puppy trafficking from Hungary, including prosecution numbers, penalties, border controls, EU registration, and enforcement against criminal networks. The minister responds that enforcement is being strengthened through a task force and a pending houding-ban bill, while stating that penalties are adequate, border checks rely on mutual trust between member states, and the bill is delayed.
The OM's registration systems therefore cannot establish how many cases related to illegal dog trade were processed by the OM in recent years or whether they led to a conviction.

Uit de registratiesystemen van het OM kan derhalve niet achterhaald worden hoeveel zaken gerelateerd aan illegale hondenhandel de afgelopen jaren door het OM zijn verwerkt en of dit tot een veroordeling heeft geleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Raan en Wassenberg over het NOW-register en controversiële steun

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether NOW wage-support should go to firms linked to controversial sectors and to firms with animal-welfare, COVID-compliance or dividend controversies, and asked for sector data and new ethical criteria. The minister said the scheme is deliberately generic to be fast and broad, that the register cannot show sector activities, and that no new criteria will be added.
To provide income protection and preserve employment, the measure must be generic.
Om inkomensbescherming en behoud van werkgelegenheid te bieden, moet er sprake zijn van een generieke maatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over biomassa uit Estland

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals ask the ministers about clear-cutting and biodiversity loss in Estonian forests supplying wood pellets to Dutch subsidised biomass plants, including Natura 2000 logging, overexploitation, corruption risks and whether subsidies should stop. Minister Wiebes answers that Dutch sustainability criteria under the SDE+ scheme apply, that the government sees no reason for independent research, and that Estonian forest regulation is primarily Estonia's responsibility.
I am not aware of how much biomass is imported annually from Estonia.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel biomassa er jaarlijks geïmporteerd wordt uit Estland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het toezicht op het slachtproces ten tijde van COVID-19 en tijdens het Offerfeest

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about NVWA supervision of unstunned slaughter during the COVID-19 period and the Feast of Sacrifice, including low inspection staffing, illegal slaughter, and meat cooling rules. The Minister answered that supervision is unchanged and risk-based, that about 10% more animals were slaughtered, that the NVWA may grant a derogation allowing covered transport of carcasses, and that the convenant follow-up was delayed by the pandemic.
The criminal investigation is still ongoing. While this investigation is in progress, no statements can be made about it.
Het strafrechtelijke onderzoek is momenteel nog gaande. Lopende dit onderzoek kunnen hierover geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het slachtproces ten tijde van COVID-19 en het Offerfeest

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether the NVWA (food safety and consumer authority) had reached a real agreement with two Harderwijk and Nijkerk slaughterhouses on stunning during the 2020 Eid festival, how inspection and sanctions would apply, and whether unstunned slaughter could respect RIVM distancing rules. The minister answered that after a court case the slaughterhouses submitted revised plans, that stunned slaughter was agreed, that vets would use masks where distancing was impossible, and that normal supervision and enforcement applied.
I have worked to send the answers to your House as quickly as possible.
Ik heb mij ingezet om de antwoorden zo snel mogelijk aan uw Kamer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het advies van de Gezondheidsraad betreffende de gezondheidsrisico’s van landbouwgif en de kabinetsreactie hierop

An MP asks the government to confirm that the Health Council advises intensifying existing pesticide sustainability plans, to explain the gap with past targets, and to adopt stricter EU approval criteria and spray-free zones. The minister responds that the Toekomstvisie 2030 implementation programme will intensify efforts with annual monitoring, that targets from Gezonde Groei remain in force, and that spray-free zones lack the required scientific basis.
This is provided for in the implementation programme accompanying the Toekomstvisie gewasbescherming 2030, which I will send to your House in September.
Hierin voorziet het uitvoeringsprogramma bij de «Toekomstvisie gewasbescherming 2030», dat ik uw Kamer in september zal doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat een slachthuis medewerkers heeft aangezet tot het afleggen van valse gezondheidsverklaringen

An MP asked ministers about reports that a slaughterhouse pressured workers to fill in false health declarations, and whether the company withheld declarations from the GGD and why oversight was not tighter. The government said it had no signals of withholding, that the Inspectie SZW found no irregularities in one site, that additional oversight measures were taken, and that the NVWA could halt slaughter work if worker safety is not assured; criminal investigation is for the Openbaar Ministerie.
If the safety of NVWA and KDS staff is not assured, the NVWA will halt its work in slaughterhouses.
Als de veiligheid van NVWA en KDS medewerkers niet geborgd is, staakt de NVWA de werkzaamheden in slachterijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat garnalenvissers veel meer mogen vissen in beschermde natuurgebieden

An MP asks the minister why shrimp fishing hours in Natura 2000 areas were increased without informing parliament, why earlier written questions went unanswered, and whether the VIBEG and VisWad convenants have been effective. The minister denies reducing enforcement, says the convenant evaluation is nearly finished and will be shared, and states that the current shrimp fishing is permissible under the Wet natuurbescherming.
Both decisions on objection can be found via the link provided.
De beide beslissingen op bezwaar zijn vindbaar via: https://puc.overheid.nl/natuurvergunningen/doc/PUC_308280_17/1/
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over regelgeving en handhaving van garnalenvisserij in Natura 2000-gebieden

An MP asked the minister whether shrimp fishers exceeded permitted fishing hours in Natura 2000 areas and why enforcement was lacking, including questions on NVWA staffing, the decision not to close areas, and release of reports. The minister admitted monitoring problems led to halted warnings, moved enforcement to Wageningen Marine Research with a margin, relied on a future black box system, and refused to close areas for lack of ecological necessity.
When the permitted number of fishing hours is exceeded, enforcement action is now taken, starting from 1 January 2020.
Bij een overschrijding van het aantal toegestane visuren wordt nu, dus ingaande vanaf 1 januari 2020, handhavend opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het afschieten van jonge zwijntjes

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether juvenile wild boar may be shot from 1 July, including nursing piglets, and why this is compatible with animal protection and the wildlife rescue efforts of a dierenambulance. The minister answers that shooting timing and methods are set in provincial exemptions based on approved management plans, that wild boar breed year-round so no closed season is realistic, and that provinces decide on management and rescue.
The date from which wild boar may be killed is stated in the exemptions issued by the provinces.
De datum vanaf wanneer wilde zwijnen gedood mogen worden, staat in de ontheffingen die door de provincies worden afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat politieagenten worden verdacht van zeer zware mishandeling van een hond

MP Wassenberg asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that police officers are suspected of severely abusing a dog (Tommy) during an arrest-team operation, including the timing of the internal investigation, suspension, possible criminal probe, and whether such force is tolerated. The Minister confirmed the investigation by VIK is ongoing, stated that force must be proportionate, said no officers are yet suspected of criminal offences, and gave limited detail citing the ongoing procedure.
Because the investigation into the use of force is still ongoing, I cannot make further statements about the nature of the use of force and the content of the force report.
Omdat het onderzoek naar de geweldsaanwending nog loopt, kan ik geen verdere uitspraken doen over de aard van de geweldsaanwending en de inhoud van de geweldsmelding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat een nertsenfokker al jaren vossen in kleine, kale en smerige draadgazen kooien houdt

An MP asked the minister about reports that a mink farmer kept foxes in small, bare, dirty wire cages, questioning NVWA oversight and enforcement. The minister answered that fox-keeping as a hobby animal is not prohibited if breeding for fur has ceased, that the NVWA inspected the farm in 2017 and in May 2020 without grounds for enforcement, and that the owner handed the foxes to a zoo.
