It is no longer possible to determine which companies kept foxes before the 2008 ban, so this question cannot be answered.
Het is niet meer te achterhalen welke bedrijven voor het verbod van 2008 vossen hebben gehouden, waardoor het niet mogelijk is om deze vraag te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het lot van geitenbokjes

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the fate of around 100,000 goat kids born in dairy goat farming, the closure of bokkenmesterijen, herd growth despite a goat stop, and high kid mortality. The minister answers that licensing is a municipal competence, that provinces have taken precautionary measures, and that I&R registration will be tightened from December 2020 with a further letter on animal welfare promised before summer.
Licensing and the control thereof is a competence of municipalities.
Vergunningverlening en de controle daarop is een bevoegdheid van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de toename van de stikstofuitstoot door de biomassacentrales in Diemen en Geertruidenberg

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether biomass plants in Diemen and Geertruidenberg, licensed on maximum historic emissions and without netting out unused headroom, would raise nitrogen emissions, and questioned the NOx standards. The minister answers that the provinces are competent authority, that permits were granted via internal netting within the rules, that actual emissions may rise under full operation, and that stricter emission standards are planned for 2022.
It should be noted first that the provinces are the competent authority for these permits. I therefore cannot intervene in their assessment of the permit.
Vooropgesteld moet worden dat de provincies bevoegd gezag zijn voor deze vergunningen. Ik kan dan ook niet treden in hun beoordeling van de vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg, Bromet, Futselaar, Moorlag en Madlener over de Nederlandse inzet voor het bijenrichtsnoer

MPs asked the minister whether the Netherlands would back a proposed bee guidance option based on natural colony variability, which the Ctgb and minister favour over the 2013 fixed 7% mortality threshold, and asked for postponement of the July 2020 SCoPAFF discussion. The minister answered that the discussion is non-binding, that she follows the Ctgb advice on the scientific basis for protection goals, and that she has pushed for rapid implementation of the bee guidance while refusing to postpone the meeting.
I consider it important that the way in which the protection goal is set is scientifically justified.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de wijze waarop het beschermdoel wordt vastgesteld wetenschappelijk verantwoord is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat de Koning ten onrechte subsidie ontvangt voor Kroondomein het Loo

An MP asked whether the Crown estate Het Loo unlawfully received a subsidy, whether the 358-day public access rule and oversight by its Raad van Beheer are adequate, and for correspondence on the estate. The minister answered that the subsidy was granted under the Kaderwet EZ-subsidies with partial analogous application of the Gelderland regulation, that no exemption was granted, that the Crown's correspondence is withheld under constitutional privacy and Crown autonomy, and that the Raad van Beheer answers to the Crown.

Correspondence between the government and the Crown estate falls, under Article 41 of the Constitution, within the Crown's freedom to arrange its household and the protection of the King's private life.
Correspondentie tussen de regering en het Kroondomein valt, gelet op artikel 41 van de Grondwet, onder de inrichtingsvrijheid en bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de Koning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de bestrijding van de eikenprocessierups, waardoor ook andere insecten gedood worden

An MP asked the minister whether biological caterpillar control agents for the oak processionary moth also kill other caterpillars and harm protected species and biodiversity, and whether natural alternatives are being pursued. The minister confirmed that these agents also affect other soft-bodied insects, explained the enforcement division among NVWA, ILT and provinces, and said the ministry participates in the Kennisplatform Processierups while natural restoration takes years.
In doing so, other insects with a soft body, such as other caterpillars, can also be affected.
Hierbij kunnen ook andere insecten met een soft body , zoals andere rupsen, worden getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat de Koning ten onrechte subsidie ontvangt voor Kroondomein het Loo

An MP asked whether the King wrongly receives subsidy for the Het Loo Kroondomein, including an exemption from public access of 7,200 hectares and whether the subsidy should be reclaimed. The minister answered that the subsidy was lawfully and carefully granted under nature-management rules, with partial closure allowed for privacy, and declined to reclaim it or change the arrangement.
Correspondence between members of the Royal House and ministers about the subsidy and opening of the Kroondomein is not known to me.
Correspondentie tussen leden van het Koninklijk Huis en ministers over de subsidie en openstelling van het Kroondomein is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over vleermuizen en vogels die slachtoffer worden van lijmbanden

An MP asks the minister about birds and bats being killed by glue traps used against the oak processionary caterpillar, and whether such use is lawful. The minister confirms glue traps are banned outside under the Nature Conservation Act without provincial exemption, that no exemptions have been granted, and that enforcement lies with provinces and environmental services, which act where needed.
Compliance with the ban on glue traps and similar outdoors is monitored by the provinces, and where necessary by the environmental services acting on their behalf.
Op het verbod tot gebruik van lijmbanden e.d. buitenhuis wordt toegezien door de provincies, en in voorkomende gevallen de Omgevingsdiensten voor hen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over injecties met giftige bestrijdingsmiddelen in eikenbomen

An MP asked the minister about a trial injecting oak trees with the insecticide Vertimec to control the oak processionary caterpillar, which could harm bees, butterflies and other insects, and whether the trial was lawful. The minister replied that the Ctgb withdrew the trial exemption, judging risks to other insects and foraging birds too great, and that the trial had been notified under the regular biocide procedure without suspensive effect.
The Ctgb ruled that the risks of this trial for other insects and for foraging birds, for example, are too great.
Het Ctgb heeft geoordeeld dat de risico's van deze proef voor andere insecten en voor bijvoorbeeld foeragerende vogels te groot zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de toelating van het landbouwgif sulfoxaflor

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the authorisation of the insecticide sulfoxaflor, its similarity to neonicotinoids, its bee risks and the EFSA 2020 reassessment, and whether it should be banned from open crops immediately. The minister confirms current Dutch authorisations and EFSA's identified risks to bees and bumblebees, but states that the Ctgb-imposed mitigation measures cover these risks and that she awaits the European Commission's proposal before acting further.
I am awaiting the Commission's proposal and the Ctgb's advice on it.
Ik wacht het voorstel van de Commissie af en het advies daarop van het Ctgb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Sjoerdsma, Sneller, Markuszower, Kuiken, Buitenweg en Wassenberg over nieuwe onthullingen in de zaak van Julio Poch

MPs asked the Justice Minister about new revelations in the Poch case, including whether the Royal House was informed, why a 2008 travel journal and a 2009 ministerial note were not sent to parliament, and on what legal basis documents are withheld during an ongoing inquiry. The minister answered that the Royal House question is part of the Machielse commission's remit, that the journal was handed to the commission, and that the 2009 note was shared confidentially with parliament, while declining to release further documents during the inquiry to protect its independence.
Given the importance of establishing the truth, however, I am reluctant to provide separate documents during the ongoing inquiry.
Gezien het belang van de waarheidsvinding ben ik echter terughoudend met het verstrekken van separate documenten tijdens het lopende onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de steeds verdere achteruitgang van de grutto

An MP asks the agriculture minister about the continuing decline of the black-tailed godwit, whether current meadow-bird management works, and whether subsidies for agri-environment management are effective and enforceable. The minister acknowledges the decline and its complex causes, defends current measures and an ongoing WUR evaluation due end of year, and explains provincial responsibility and intervention options.
I expect to be able to send the outcomes of this evaluation to the House at the end of this year.
Ik verwacht de uitkomsten van deze evaluatie eind dit jaar aan de Kamer te kunnen toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het sluiten van landgoederen met een openstellingssubsidie

An MP asked the Minister whether the growing closure of estates with an opening subsidy to the public, citing corona, is being enforced, how often estates are checked, whether subsidies are clawed back, and whether a public register and complaint route exist. The Minister replied that no closures due to corona measures were reported, that the Tax Authority checks about 100 estates specifically on openness each year, that revocation of status is rare and not separately recorded, and that complaints go via RVO.nl, with a half-yearly public list of open estates.
No reports have been received by RvO.nl that estates have actually been closed due to corona measures.
Er zijn geen meldingen ontvangen bij RvO.nl dat er daadwerkelijk landgoederen zijn gesloten vanwege coronamaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Wassenberg en Van Esch over een alomvattend aanvalsplan om het risico op toekomstige overspringende zoönotische infectieziekten drastisch te verkleinen

MPs Ouwehand, Wassenberg and Van Esch asked about zoonotic disease risks, intensive livestock farming, wildlife trade, deforestation and a comprehensive action plan to reduce spillover risk. The ministers answered that risks are recognised and managed through the Dutch zoonosis structure, but declined to commit to new bans, a dedicated action plan or additional wildlife-trade enforcement, saying existing measures are sufficient.
The cabinet will continue to work to keep the risks as small as possible or make them smaller.
Het kabinet zal zich ervoor blijven inzetten dat de risico's zo klein mogelijk zijn of kleiner worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de wildopvang, die dreigt te bezwijken door een tekort aan geld en een toename van het aantal op te vangen dieren als gevolg van de coronacrisis

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the risk that wildlife shelters collapse from a shortage of funds while animal intake rises during the coronavirus crisis, and whether talks on a uniform national compensation guideline have stalled. The minister agreed closure would be undesirable, said talks continue though slower, and promised an inventory of funding and recommendations by end of June.
I expect to be able to present recommendations to the House at the end of June.
Ik verwacht eind juni aanbevelingen aan de Kamer te kunnen aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de opvang van de Afrikaanse olifant uit circus Freiwald

An MP asked the minister about finding a suitable sanctuary in Europe for the elephant Buba from circus Freiwald before its temporary permit expires on 30 June, including commercial interests, expert involvement and periodic updates. The minister answered that welfare comes first, that three possible sanctuaries are being assessed with independent experts, and that the Chamber will be informed once a location is found, though a move before 30 June is unlikely.
I will inform the Chamber when a suitable sanctuary for the elephant has been found.
Ik informeer uw Kamer wanneer er een geschikte opvanglocatie voor de olifant gevonden is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de situatie van de vogelopvang in Naarden en de steun voor wildopvangcentra in Nederland

MP Wassenberg asked the minister whether the Naarden bird shelter still faces problems, what steps were taken after a debate commitment, and whether wildlife shelters can get workable rules and funding. Minister Schouten answered that NVWA intervened over unlicensed medicines, that talks with shelters and a plan to revise the quality rules are under way, and that she will inform parliament before summer.
The NVWA enforces in line with its intervention policy, which is public and can be found on the NVWA website.
De NVWA handhaaft conform haar interventiebeleid, dat openbaar is en terug te vinden is op de website van de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de mishandeling van honden, in training bij leden van de Koninklijke Nederlandse Politiehonden Vereniging (KNPV)

An MP asked the ministers about abuse of dogs in training by members of the KNPV police dog association, shown on television, and whether trainers would be prosecuted, banned from keeping dogs, and whether training should be brought under government control. The ministers answered that an investigation is ongoing, a standalone dog-keeping ban bill is being prepared, police buys mostly from KNPV-affiliated private schools, and they declined to make training a regulated profession or bring it fully under government.
The Public Prosecution Service and the police have started a criminal investigation.
Het OM en de politie zijn een opsporingsonderzoek gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over “manipulatie van Monsanto om de Europese toelating van glyfosaat te beïnvloeden”

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about alleged Monsanto manipulation of the EU glyphosate approval, including ghostwriting, a rewritten Kirkland study and the omitted TNO dermal absorption study. The minister answered that EFSA, ECHA and Ctgb found no reason to think industry influenced the assessment, that the TNO study was not in the dossier but newer studies were used, and that the approval process is open.
I have confidence that these studies were taken into account correctly in the latest European assessment procedure for the active substance glyphosate.
Ik heb er vertrouwen in dat deze studies op de juiste wijze zijn meegenomen in de laatste Europese beoordelingsprocedure van de werkzame stof glyfosaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over “niet vernieuwen van de toelating van het aan Parkinson-gerelateerde mancozeb"

An MP asked the Minister whether the EU would vote on not renewing approval of the fungicide mancozeb, its sales and health risks, and whether the Netherlands would support the Commission's proposal. The Minister answered that the proposal is on the May 2020 SCoPAFF agenda, that the Netherlands will support non-renewal if the final proposal matches the draft, and that it is pressing the Commission to conclude the decision quickly.
I find these worrying signals and that is why I am already urging the European Commission to conclude the decision-making quickly.
Ik vind dit verontrustende signalen en daarom dring ik er al bij de Europese Commissie op aan snel de besluitvorming af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over onderzoek met apen voor de ontwikkeling van een vaccin tegen COVID-19

An MP asks whether animal testing for COVID-19 vaccines is wasteful, whether non-animal methods should be prioritised and funded, and whether the reduction of primate use at BPRC is being undermined by Java monkey research. The minister says standards require animal tests, that alternatives are being funded through calls and programmes, and that the BPRC reduction stands, with an exception clause not needed so far.
The BPRC indicates that invoking this clause on the basis of the COVID-19 pandemic is not necessary for now.
Het BPRC geeft aan dat een beroep op deze clausule op basis van de COVID-19-pandemie vooralsnog niet nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de berichtgeving dat de Europese toelating van glyfosaat gebaseerd is op vervalste gegevens uit het Duitse horrorlaboratorium LPT

MP Wassenberg asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that the EU approval of glyphosate rested on falsified studies from the German LPT laboratory, raising fraud, animal welfare, GLP certification and the choice of testing labs. The minister answered that the BfR and Ctgb see no reason to question the glyphosate reassessment based on the LPT studies, that the German fraud investigation must be awaited, and that GLP inspection and EU quality requirements are adequate.
The BfR currently sees no reason to question the outcome of the reassessment of the active substance on the basis of the LPT studies.
Het BfR ziet op dit moment geen aanleiding om op basis van de studies van LPT de uitkomst van de herbeoordeling van de werkzame stof ter discussie te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de schadelijke effecten van SHDI-pesticiden op planten, dieren en mensen

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about evidence that SDHI pesticides harm soil organisms, bees and humans via mitochondrial effects, plus EU approval status, Dutch sales, toxicity and a scientists' call for a ban. The minister answered that the in vitro study cannot be directly translated to real exposure, that the Ctgb sees no reason to withdraw existing approvals and is awaiting further research.
The Ctgb, like the French authority Anses, sees no reason to intervene directly in existing authorisations and first awaits further research.
Het Ctgb ziet, net als de Franse toelatingsautoriteit Anses, geen aanleiding om direct in te grijpen op bestaande toelatingen en wacht eerst verder onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de inzet van vangkooien door zwijnenjagers

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the use of cage traps by wild boar hunters, covering legality, animal welfare, by-catch, slaughter methods, video evidence, COVID-19 measures and illegal releases of wild boar. The minister answered that cage traps are permitted only under provincial exemptions for damage control and population management, that welfare requirements apply, and that she sees no unnecessary suffering, while declining to share correspondence with provinces since licensing is a provincial power.
Granting exemptions for the use of cage traps is a statutory competence of the provinces.
Het verlenen van ontheffingen voor de inzet van vangkooien is een wettelijke bevoegdheid van de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht dat de provincie Drenthe toestemming heeft gegeven voor het afschieten van tientallen diersoorten op Groningen Airport Eelde

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers about reports that the province of Drenthe permitted culling dozens of animal species at Groningen Airport Eelde, and whether the permit was justified, lawful, effective and transparent. The minister replied that the province is the competent authority under the Wet natuurbescherming, that the permit was granted for aviation safety, that the government cannot intervene in provincial decisions, and that the matter can be taken to court.
It is not for me to intervene in the considerations and decisions of the provinces, nor to intervene in the course of justice.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de afwegingen en besluiten van de provincies, noch om te interveniëren in de rechtsgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat het fokken van honden met extreem platte snuiten ondanks een verbod ongestraft doorgaat

Wassenberg (PvdD) asks why breeding of extremely short-snouted dogs continues despite a ban, how many breeders and inspections exist, and whether enforcement is adequate. The minister answers that enforcement by the NVWA has started with new criteria, nine controls were held in 2019, six written warnings issued, and capacity was increased for 2020 though not yet proven effective.
In 2020 more controls, based on selection and on reports, will be carried out on breeding dogs with extreme physical characteristics.
In 2020 zullen meer controles, op basis van selectie en op basis van meldingen, worden uitgevoerd op het fokken van honden met extreme uiterlijke kenmerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de noodzaak van het uitbreiden van de lijst met vitale beroepen met dierenartsen en dierverzorgers

MP Wassenberg asked whether veterinarians and animal carers should be added to the government's list of critical occupations during COVID-19, citing staff shortages at shelters and animal care organisations. Minister Schouten replied that the list is deliberately kept narrow to limit exceptions to measures, that veterinary work for the food chain is covered, that animal carers are not listed but local solutions should be sought, and that she is monitoring the situation in consultation with sector bodies.
The list of critical occupations and vital processes has been kept limited in order to restrict the spread of COVID-19 as much as possible.
De lijst met cruciale beroepen en vitale processen is beperkt gehouden om de verspreiding van COVID-19 zo veel mogelijk te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de ongewenste en ernstige gevolgen van de coronamaatregelen voor mensen en organisaties die kwetsbare, zieke en gewonde dieren opvangen

MP Wassenberg asked whether Covid-19 quarantine rules, which keep household members home, could leave animal shelters and carers short-staffed and endanger animal care. Minister Schouten acknowledged the risk, said the rules aim primarily at the epidemic, and pointed to local solutions and case-by-case exemptions for specialist carers rather than new general exemptions.
I am willing to monitor the situation and am already doing so.
Ik ben bereid om de situatie te monitoren en doe dit ook al.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht dat Shell de Nationale Boomfeestdag van Staatsbosbeheer sponsort

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether Shell's sponsorship of the Nationale Boomfeestdag, its climate record, and related tree-planting and flight-compensation claims amount to greenwashing and misleading children's education material. The government confirmed the sponsorship, said climate responsibility lies with companies and the Klimaatakkoord, declined to assess school learning materials citing school autonomy, and promised a separate letter on the voluntary CO2 compensation market.
The cabinet regularly receives questions about the content of learning materials.
Met enige regelmaat krijgt het kabinet vragen over de inhoud van leermiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat lijmplankjes veel dierenleed veroorzaken

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the minister about the animal suffering caused by glue traps and whether their sale and use should be banned. The minister replied that glue traps are prohibited without a provincial exemption, that they are sold legally, that a sales ban is not warranted, and that IPM prevention is the preferred approach.
As I explained in my answer to question three, the use of glue traps is prohibited, but provinces can deviate from this by granting exemptions.
Zoals ik in mijn antwoord op vraag drie heb toegelicht, is het gebruik van lijmplankjes verboden, maar kunnen provincies kunnen hier van afwijken door ontheffingen te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat Defensie klimaatactivisme en werken als reservist onverenigbaar vindt

An MP asked whether Defence considers climate activism incompatible with serving as a reservist, and whether this restricts the right to demonstrate. The government answers that climate activism is not in principle incompatible with reservist service, that the right to demonstrate applies to military personnel subject to limits in the Wet ambtenaren Defensie, and that individual cases cannot be discussed publicly.
Taking action for a liveable planet is in principle not assessed by Defence as incompatible with working as a reservist.
Actie voeren voor een leefbare aarde wordt bij Defensie in beginsel niet als onverenigbaar met het werken als reservist beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het Vlaamse verbod op de jacht in het kader van de coronamaatregelen

An MP asked whether the Netherlands will, like Flanders, ban hunting and angling during the COVID-19 measures, since trips for these hobbies are no longer considered justified. The minister answered that no additional measures beyond the existing stay-at-home advice are needed, noting hunting is closed until August and population control may continue under strict RIVM rules.
There is no reason to take additional measures for hunting and angling beyond the measures the cabinet has already announced.
Er is geen aanleiding om voor het jagen en het beoefenen van de hengelsport aanvullende maatregelen te treffen, bovenop de maatregelen die het kabinet al heeft afgekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Raan over de wijze waarop een vreedzame demonstratie op Schiphol werd beëindigd en het verschil met de boerendemonstraties

MPs Wassenberg and Van Raan asked why a peaceful Greenpeace demonstration at Schiphol on 14 December 2019 was ended forcefully, with arrests and a 48-hour area ban, and why it was treated differently from farmers' protests and a KLM concert. The government answered that the mayor of Haarlemmermeer is responsible for demonstration management and emergency orders, that the matter is subject to council accountability and possible court review, and that it cannot judge the mayor's conduct.
It is not for me to intervene in that.
Het is niet aan mij om daarin te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over de dierlijke oorsprong van het nieuwe coronavirus en de falende aanpak van de handel in bedreigde diersoorten

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked whether the new coronavirus originated from wildlife sold at a Wuhan market and whether the government will tighten import checks, ban trade in protected species and push China and the EU for stronger wildlife trade rules. The minister acknowledged possible wildlife reservoirs and the zoonotic risk but declined new import controls, a CITES evaluation, a total trade ban or a call to China, arguing there was no evidence the spread stems from animal trade.
There is no reason now to tighten supervision and enforcement of imports of animal products and animals from China.
Er is geen reden om nu tot een aanscherping van toezicht en handhaving op de import van dierlijke producten en dieren uit China over te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht dat vogels kleiner worden door klimaatverandering

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked the government about reports that birds are shrinking due to climate change, including the red knot study and its implications for biodiversity and the Wadden Sea. The minister acknowledges the research, says climate change is one cause of biodiversity loss, notes the Wadden Sea's importance for migratory birds, and points to existing climate and Wadden policy without committing to new action.
This is a scientific question that I cannot assess.
Dit is een wetenschappelijk vraagstuk dat ik niet kan beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over bladblazerterreur

Two PvdD MPs asked the ministers about the health, noise and environmental harm of leaf blowers and whether they should be banned or phased out. The minister answered that a categorical ban is not possible under EU rules, that municipalities should decide on use, and that the national government will not intervene but will raise the topic with the VNG.
I do not consider it the task of the national government to intervene here, but I do want to bring this topic to the attention of the municipalities via the VNG.
Ik vind het niet de taak van de nationale overheid om hier in te treden, maar ik wil wel dit onderwerp bij de gemeenten via de VNG onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het kennelijk uitblijven van bestuurlijk overleg met de convenantpartners over het onverdoofd slachten

An MP asks why a promised consultation with convenant partners on unstunned ritual slaughter, announced in February 2018, had not taken place, and why the convenant's agreed limits on animal numbers and separate sales channels remain unimplemented. The minister says the consultation was held on 28 November 2019, that the partners will supply information in Q1 2020, and that no slaughterhouses have reduced supervision frequency.

With a view to elaborating the system referred to in article 3 of the addendum, the convenant partners will supply in the first quarter of 2020 the information needed to determine the actual demand of religious communities in the Netherlands for meat from unstunned ritually slaughtered animals.

Met het oog op de uitwerking van het stelsel, bedoeld in artikel 3 van het addendum, zullen de convenantpartners in het eerste kwartaal van 2020 de informatie aanleveren om te bepalen wat de daadwerkelijke behoefte van de in Nederland aanwezige religieuze gemeenschappen is aan vlees van onbedwelmd ritueel geslachte dieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht ‘Bomen stoken in centrales? Waanzin!’

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a critical newspaper article on burning trees in power plants, questioning the minister's claim that whole trees do not end up in Dutch wood pellets, the carbon debt of biomass, and biodiversity in production forests. The minister defended the sustainability criteria for subsidised pellets, acknowledged limited US pellet imports, and announced that small pellet stoves and biomass boilers will no longer be subsidised from 2020 while air emission norms for mid-sized plants are examined.
I do not have the specific cost breakdowns that companies use, and I could not share them because this is commercially confidential information.
Over de specifieke kostenverdelingen zoals bedrijven deze hanteren beschik ik niet en deze zou ik ook niet kunnen delen omdat dit bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie betreft.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Helvert, Diks, Kerstens, Voordewind, Belhaj, Stoffer, Van Haga, Karabulut, Rudmer Heerema, Van den Hul, Rog, Kwint, Bisschop, Bruins, Beertema, Van Meenen, Krol, Wassenberg en

Twenty MPs asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Defence whether schools could be required to give children a day off when a parent returns from a military deployment, a 'family day' as is customary for US troops. The Minister answered that headteachers can already grant up to ten days of leave under the Leerplichtwet for weighty circumstances, that a parent's return from a mission falls under this, and that a letter will be sent to all schools pointing this out.

Because I find it a understandable request, I will send all schools a letter pointing out that the situation mentioned falls under this existing possibility for which a special form of leave is permitted.

Omdat ik het een begrijpelijk verzoek vind, zal ik aan alle scholen een brief sturen waarin ik erop zal wijzen dat de genoemde situatie onder deze bestaande mogelijkheid valt waarvoor een bijzondere vorm van verlof is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat 600 miljoen euro uit het Waddenfonds is uitgegeven zonder dat de natuur erop vooruit is gegaan

MP Wassenberg asked whether the Waddenfonds spent about 600 million euro on economic projects without measurable nature gains, and asked about monitoring, evaluation and reallocating remaining funds. The ministers answered that spending is balanced roughly 50/50 between nature and economy under the 2011 agreement, that nature indicators are still negative, and rejected a separate monitoring commission and new earmarking, while noting provinces may strengthen their oversight role.
Therefore there is no question of a payout of 600 million euros to economic projects.
Er is dus geen sprake van een uitkering van € 600 miljoen aan economische projecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over ‘het bericht dat de rechter het besluit tot afschot van edelherten in de Oostvaardersplassen onrechtmatig heeft verklaard’

An MP asked whether the government would act after a court ruled that Flevoland's culling of deer in the Oostvaardersplassen was unlawful, and whether the province had neglected its duty and should be placed under supervision or forcibly replaced. The minister said the province is still considering the ruling, that it is for the province to decide next steps, that the province acted carefully, and that there is no reason for indeplaatsstelling or other intervention, while promising to examine merging or redrawing nature areas with provinces without naming specific areas.

If not, why not? Answer 4, 5 and 6: Responsibility for the welfare of the large grazers was transferred in 2016 by the then State Secretary of Economic Affairs to the Provincial Executive of Flevoland.

Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 4, 5 en 6 De verantwoordelijkheid voor het welzijn van de grote grazers is in 2016 door de toenmalige Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken overgedragen aan GS van de provincie Flevoland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over hondengevechten in Nederland

An MP asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers why authorities acted only now against dogfight organisers, whether penalties are too low, and whether lifetime breeding and keeping bans should apply. The government replied that local authorities set priorities, that current maximum penalties match the seriousness of the offences and courts decide sentences, and that a bill allowing immediate enforcement of keeping bans is planned.
The bill is expected to be sent to the Council of State for advice in spring 2020.
Het wetsvoorstel wordt naar verwachting in het voorjaar van 2020 ter advisering aan de Raad van State verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het «Special Report on the Ocean and Cryosphere in a Changing Climate  (SROCC)» van het IPCC

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked ministers about the IPCC special report on oceans and the cryosphere, covering glacier loss, marine heatwaves, ocean acidification, marine protected areas and fisheries. The government answered at length, mostly restating the IPCC findings and pointing to the forthcoming cabinet appraisal and international negotiations, with few concrete commitments.
A comprehensive cabinet appraisal of the IPCC report on oceans and the cryosphere has been sent to the House.
Een uitgebreide kabinetsappreciatie van het IPCC-rapport over oceanen en de cryosfeer is aan de kamer toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat er pal naast het safaripark Beekse Bergen een outdoor hardcore festival is gehouden

MP Wassenberg (PvdD) asked whether loud hardcore festival noise near Safaripark Beekse Bergen harmed animals and whether the Animal Welfare Act or licensing rules were breached. Minister Schouten answered that noise was mostly within licence limits, the park reported no behavioural changes, the NVWA's latest inspection predated the festival, and that municipalities and provinces hold licensing responsibility while she would not intervene.
I assume that municipalities take their responsibility in granting and enforcing permits.
Ik ga ervan uit dat gemeenten hun verantwoordelijkheid nemen bij het verstrekken en handhaven van vergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de beelden waaruit blijkt dat circus Freiwald zich opnieuw niet aan de wet houdt en een olifant daarvan de dupe is

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about footage of a circus elephant being touched by the public in breach of its exemption conditions, and about NVWA enforcement, inspection history and the basis for the temporary exemption. The minister confirms a breach, a written warning and an unannounced re-inspection, but withholds inspection reports for privacy and says a new search for an elephant shelter in Europe will be made before the exemption expires on 30 June 2020.
These reports are not actively made public. The reason is the importance of protecting the privacy of persons involved in the inspection.
Deze rapporten worden niet actief openbaar gemaakt. Reden daarvoor is het belang van het beschermen van de privacy van personen die betrokken zijn bij de inspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat de bouwers van een windmolenpark de vergunning van voormalige eendenfokkerijen misbruiken om een windmolenpark te realiseren

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether a wind park permit in Flevoland, which relied on temporarily filling duck-farming stables to use nitrogen compensation room, is lawful and should be stopped, and whether latent permit space should be scrapped. The minister answered that the province checked the permit against the rules then in force, that the stables were filled within valid permits, that the two farms' permits will be withdrawn and their intensive livestock use permanently ended, and that the government will set uniform rules by 1 December 2019 while maintaining that latent permit space does not raise emissions.
In the letter to parliament of 1 November 2019 I informed you that the cabinet and the provinces will make uniform agreements on the policy rules by 1 December 2019 at the latest.
In de Kamerbrief van 1 november 2019 (Kamerstuk 32 670, nr. 193 ) heb ik u geïnformeerd dat het kabinet en de provincies uiterlijk 1 december 2019 eenduidige afspraken maken over de beleidsregels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat straaljagers van Defensie zonder vergunning boven het Wad vliegen

MP Wassenberg asked whether Defence jets fly over the Wadden Sea without the required nature permit, why earlier promises were not met, and whether flights should be suspended. The government answered that permit applications for military flight activities are being prepared for submission in Q1 2020, that flights at standard altitudes need no further assessment, and that suspension is not necessary.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht ‘Honingcowboys bedreigen de wilde bij in de Biesbosch’

An MP asks the minister why hundreds of unregistered beehives stand just outside the Biesbosch, threatening wild bee species, and what the government will do about it. The minister replies that no registration duty exists, that regulation is a matter for provinces, municipalities and land managers, and that the government will alert those parties and rely on knowledge development and possible self-regulation rather than new national policy.
I see no reason to formulate new government policy.
Ik zie geen aanleiding tot het formuleren van nieuw overheidsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de handel in apen naar Europese proefdiercentra door een Nederlands bedrijf

An MP asked whether a Dutch company trading macaques to European animal testing labs, including a lab in Parma, was implicated in mistreatment shown in undercover footage, and asked for trade volumes, transport welfare and wild-catch safeguards. The minister said Italian authorities should act, that the company meets EU and Dutch rules enforced by the NVWA, and declined to disclose trade volumes and origins for commercial confidentiality reasons.

Although I consider it important to be as transparent as possible on animal testing, I cannot, in line with the earlier answer, provide this information because of the protection of business and manufacturing data.

Hoewel ik het belangrijk vindt om bij dierproeven zo transparant mogelijk te zijn kan ik, in lijn met de eerdere beantwoording, deze Informatie vanwege de bescherming van bedrijfs- en fabricagegegevens niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het  lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat tientallen soorten exotische dieren, waaronder apen, gewoon te koop zijn via Marktplaats en Facebook

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why exotic animals, including protected monkeys and the invasive Indian mongoose, are openly advertised on Marktplaats and Facebook, and whether enforcement is adequate and legislation is planned. The minister answered that NVWA enforces risk-based, uses a protocol and keyword list with Marktplaats, has 23 inspector fte, sees no need for extra capacity or a dedicated internet ban, and is exploring similar agreements with other platforms.
I will explore the possibilities of making such agreements with other online providers as well.
Ik ga de mogelijkheden na om dergelijke afspraken ook met andere online-aanbieders te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de stalbrand in Niawier, waarbij 42.000 kippen zijn omgekomen

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked the minister about a barn fire in Niawier that killed 42,000 chickens, including whether birds escaped, the farm's permit and capacity, fire prevention, and whether the government will act on barn fire prevention. The minister said no birds escaped, that permits are a municipal matter, and that a broader action plan with added measures is being discussed, but gave no concrete legislative commitment.
How many animals the farm was permitted for is not known to me. The issuing of environmental permits falls under the responsibility of the municipality concerned.
Voor hoeveel dieren het bedrijf een vergunning had, is mij niet bekend. De afgifte van omgevingsvergunningen valt onder de bevoegdheid van de desbetreffende gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Ouwehand over het evenement 'Zwientie Tikken' waarbij varkens worden getreiterd ter vermaak van de mens

Two MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture whether the 'Zwientie Tikken' pig-chasing event at a Dutch festival was acceptable given animal welfare and disease rules, and what would be done. The minister said the organiser is responsible for compliance, the NVWA found three violations, two of which lead to written warnings and one to a report that may lead to a fine, and that pigs were sourced from a nearby farm with privacy reasons given for not disclosing details.
The NVWA found 3 violations here, two of which will be dealt with through a written warning.
De NVWA heeft hierbij 3 overtredingen vastgesteld, twee daarvan zullen met een schriftelijke waarschuwing afgedaan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de uitverkoop van natuurgebieden

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about Staatsbosbeheer's plan to sell about 379 hectares of nature land, including 10.8 hectares inside Natura 2000 areas, to fund purchases elsewhere, and how nature protection is guaranteed. The minister answers that land-use obligations in zoning plans and provincial supervision protect the sold land, that sales create larger connected nature areas, and that no change to public ownership is needed.
Future owners commit, when purchasing nature plots, to realising or maintaining the nature.
Toekomstige eigenaren verplichten zich bij de aankoop van natuurpercelen tot realisatie dan wel behoud van de natuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat rubberkorrels op kunstgras wel degelijk een gezondheidsrisico’s voor kinderen kunnen zijn

MP Wassenberg asks whether researchers' criticism of RIVM and ECHA studies on rubber granulate in artificial turf, which they say shows possible health risks for children, is justified, and whether the government will advise parents and tighten PAH limits or ban the use. The minister replies that RIVM's assessment found a practically negligible risk, that the criticism was discussed in the expert group, that the government supports a stricter PAH limit via a REACH restriction dossier, and that it will subsidise measures to limit granulate spread but sees no reason for a ban.
RIVM states that the results of more recent scientific studies do not point in a different direction.
Het RIVM laat weten dat de resultaten van recentere wetenschappelijke onderzoeken niet in een andere richting wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht ‘Deel naar Spanje verhuisde konikpaarden is ziek’

MP Wassenberg asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports that Konik horses moved from the Oostvaardersplassen to a Spanish reserve are sick and thin, and about Staatsbosbeheer's contract, selection criteria, welfare monitoring and oversight of the receiving foundation. The minister answered all 21 questions, acknowledging about 20 horses in poor condition but stating that Staatsbosbeheer no longer bears formal responsibility, that welfare monitoring and disease handling are now the foundation's responsibility under Spanish law, and that no formal aftercare or independent veterinary supervision was agreed.
Although Staatsbosbeheer formally no longer bears responsibility for the animals after the transfer in March 2019, Staatsbosbeheer of course wants the horses to have a good life in Spain.
Hoewel Staatsbosbeheer na de overdracht in maart 2019 formeel geen verantwoordelijkheid meer heeft voor de dieren, wil Staatsbosbeheer natuurlijk wel dat de paarden een goed leven hebben in Spanje.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de gevolgen van de vernietiging van het Programma Aanpak Stikstof voor biomassacentrales

An MP from PvdD asked ministers whether the Council of State's annulment of the Programma Aanpak Stikstof (PAS) affects pending permits for biomass plants, including Nuon's plant in Diemen, and whether new nitrogen assessments are needed. Minister Schouten answered that pending permits can no longer rely on the PAS and need an appropriate assessment, that the Diemen permit did not use the PAS, and that no new nitrogen study is required.
Pending permit applications can no longer be granted under the PAS.
Lopende vergunningaanvragen kunnen niet meer via het PAS worden vergund.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het artikel van De Volkskrant van 25 mei jl. onder de titel ‘een aan alle kanten stinkende affaire’

MP Wassenberg asked whether SDE+ subsidies for manure digesters are really for renewable energy or mainly serve to dispose of manure surplus and sustain intensive livestock farming, and whether the subsidy should end. The minister defended the digesters as cost-effective renewable energy producers, said existing subsidies will not be ended, and noted co-digestion is no longer a separate SDE+ category from 2019.
No, I will not end the subsidies on existing manure (co-)digesters.
Nee, de subsidies op bestaande mest(co)vergisters zal ik niet beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over kerosineprojecten in Rotterdam en Delfzijl

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked the minister about public funding and sustainability of synthetic and bio-kerosene projects in Rotterdam and Delfzijl, including fraud risks, deforestation and aviation volume reduction. The minister answered that public funds support feasibility studies and an innovation programme, that the Delfzijl plant receives no public money, and that sustainability is assured through private auditors and advisory boards, while acknowledging limited public enforcement powers and deferring on volume reduction.
At present the ministry is in discussion with the Netherlands Emissions Authority (NEa) about various scenarios for public-law supervision and enforcement to limit fraud risks in the chain.

Op dit moment is het ministerie met de Nederlandse Emissieautoriteit (NEa) in gesprek om verschillende scenario's te bekijken voor publiekrechtelijk toezicht en handhaving om de frauderisico's in de keten te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht 'Shell wil fundamenten olieplatforms in Noordzee na gebruik laten staan'

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about Shell's plan to leave the concrete base of decommissioned North Sea platforms in place, including OSPAR rules, German objections, and the 11,000 tonnes of contaminated material remaining. The minister answered that the Netherlands has not yet taken a position, is commissioning an independent review and will submit a draft position to parliament first, while acknowledging that contaminated material would slowly enter the environment in the very long term.
I will submit this draft position to your House before adopting the final position toward the UK.
Ik zal uw Kamer dit conceptstandpunt voorleggen alvorens het definitieve standpunt richting het VK in te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de kritiek van de Algemene Rekenkamer op het plastic afvalbeleid van het kabinet

Wassenberg (PvdD) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management how the government responds to Court of Audit criticism that its plastic waste policy ignores the statutory waste hierarchy, lacks reduction targets, relies on soft instruments and overstates recycling rates. The State Secretary largely rejects the criticism, citing existing legal instruments, planned measures (SUP directive, new recycling norms, statiegeld as fallback) and noting the Dutch recycling figure is comparable under EU rules.
I will inform the House after the summer about the new recycling standards for packaging.
Ik informeer uw Kamer na de zomer over de nieuwe recyclenormen voor verpakkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het ontbreken van draagvlak voor aardgaswinning onder het Werelderfgoed de Waddenzee

MP Wassenberg (PvdD) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the lack of local support for gas extraction under the Wadden Sea World Heritage site, citing a local council letter and the Fryslân provincial opposition. The minister stated that public support is not a legal ground for refusal, defended the 'hand on the tap' monitoring principle and the independent audit committee, and refused to hold an enquiry or to refuse permits in advance.
For the gas extraction at Ternaard it has been agreed that the outcomes of the environmental process will be given a place in the final decision-making.
In het geval van de gaswinning bij Ternaard is de afspraak gemaakt dat de uitkomsten van het omgevingsproces een plek krijgen in de uiteindelijke besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de milieuschade van houtstook die vele malen hoger is dan de milieuschade door aardgas of stookolie

MP Wassenberg asked the government about a CE-Delft study showing wood heating causes far higher environmental damage than gas or oil, and asked whether pellet imports, pellet classification and ISDE subsidies for biomass should be ended. The minister acknowledged the concerns, said the ISDE subsidy will be critically evaluated and emission rules tightened, but refused to ban North American pellets (WTO rules) or to label wood pellet heating generically as not climate-friendly.

Because of the effect on air quality, the draft Climate Agreement announced that the cabinet, as part of the evaluation of the ISDE, will critically examine whether further stimulation of small-scale biomass combustion is desirable.

Vanwege het effect op de luchtkwaliteit is in het ontwerp-Klimaatakkoord aangekondigd dat het kabinet als onderdeel van de evaluatie van de ISDE kritisch zal kijken naar de wenselijkheid van verdere stimulering van kleinschalige verbranding van biomassa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de vergroening van de auto’s van de overheid

An MP asked whether the government still stands by its 2016 commitment to green its official car fleet, given cases where replacement cars were petrol-powered and only 2% of the fleet is electric. The state secretary answered that the commitment stands, admitted the 2020 target of 20-25% electric will be hard to reach, and promised to push other ministers and a joint improvement programme.
Although I realise it will be difficult to reach the stated target still in 2020, I want to commit to it, especially now that the market for electric transport offers an increasingly better range.
Hoewel ik besef dat het lastig zal worden om het gestelde doel nog in 2020 te halen, wil ik me hiervoor inzetten, zeker nu de markt voor elektrisch vervoer een steeds beter aanbod kent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Raan over de (bij)stook van biomassa in centrales

MPs Wassenberg and Van Raan asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether biomass co-firing in coal plants is truly CO2-neutral, given transport and processing emissions, forest regrowth times, and the growing role of biomass by 2020 and 2023. The minister replied that biomass is treated as CO2-neutral under international agreements, that Dutch sustainability criteria require at least 70% CO2 savings across the chain, and that the government sees biomass as necessary for the energy transition, though it did not provide a precise breakdown of chain emissions.
I cannot provide an exact breakdown of the CO2 emissions associated with the production, transport and processing of biomass.
Ik kan geen exacte uitsplitsing geven van de CO 2 -uitstoot die samenhangt met de productie, het transport en de verwerking van biomassa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Raan over de grootste, maar ongewenste, houtoven in Diemen

MPs Wassenberg and Van Raan asked whether Diemen and the province of Noord-Holland must approve the permit for the Netherlands' largest wood-burning biomass plant despite air and CO2 concerns, what legal tools exist to refuse it, whether biomass is doubly subsidised, and what SDE+ subsidy applies per kWh. The minister answered that permits can only be refused for non-compliance with law, that biomass is treated as renewable and CO2-neutral under international rules, and gave the subsidy amounts (about 0.051 euro/kWh for a pellet boiler for district heating, 0.027 euro/kWh for smaller boilers).
Yes, if all laws and regulations are complied with, in particular the requirements on air emissions and air quality, the Environmental Permitting Act (Wabo) contains no ground to refuse an activity.

Ja, als voldaan wordt aan alle wet- en regelgeving – in het bijzonder ook de vereisten op het gebied van luchtemissies en luchtkwaliteit – dan kent de Wet algemene bepalingen omgevingsrecht (Wabo) geen weigeringsgrond om een activiteit te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kooten-Arissen en Wassenberg over bomenkap in Nederland

MPs Van Kooten-Arissen and Wassenberg asked the minister about large-scale tree felling in the Netherlands, its scale compared with Brazil, its biodiversity impact, and whether felled Natura 2000 trees must be replanted. The minister confirmed high felling rates, said biomass is mostly a by-product rather than a main driver, did not claim a general biodiversity conclusion, and promised a forest strategy and further investigation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het (ontbreken van) draagvlak voor aardgaswinning onder het Werelderfgoed de Waddenzee

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether local and regional support for gas extraction under the Wadden Sea World Heritage site is lacking, whether he will investigate it, and whether he will halt the planned Ternaard extraction. The minister says support is fragile, that a stakeholder process with local residents will inform a decision this autumn, but that the project is one of national interest decided by cabinet, and declines to commit to halting it.
In addition, I am considering putting the resulting package of measures to a wider group of residents in the area.
Ik overweeg om, aanvullend daarop, het resulterende pakket aan maatregelen ook nog breder voor te leggen aan omwonenden in het gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Raan over de aanklacht tegen de EU vanwege de negatieve klimaatimpact van houtstook

MPs Wassenberg and Van Raan asked the minister about a lawsuit claiming EU energy policy wrongly treats wood burning as CO2-neutral, and whether subsidies for wood burning should stop. The minister rejects the claim that wood burning is wrongly classed as CO2-neutral, says sustainability criteria and the Klimaatakkoord address carbon debt and air quality, and declines to stop subsidies.
I do not share the view that wood burning is wrongly classified as CO2-neutral.
Ik deel het standpunt niet dat houtstook onterecht wordt aangemerkt als CO 2 -neutraal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht ‘Geen boetes voor verstoren natuur in de Waddenzee’

An MP asked whether fines for disturbing nature in the Wadden Sea have stopped, why enforcement is difficult under the Nature Conservation Act, and about capacity of the Wadden unit and closing areas to the public. The minister confirmed no disturbance fines were issued in the past year, described enforcement difficulties and ongoing consultation, and promised to inform parliament within half a year on outcomes and a decision on a Wadden management authority.
I expect to be able to inform your House within half a year about the outcomes of the consultation.
Naar verwachting zal ik uw Kamer binnen een half jaar kunnen informeren over de uitkomsten van het overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht dat Rotterdam The Hague Airport alle vogels op de luchthaven wil en mag doden

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether the province's permit allowing Rotterdam The Hague Airport to kill all wild bird species, including eggs and nests, goes beyond what is necessary, conflicts with Natura 2000 objectives, and whether the government will press the province to withdraw it and inform travellers about bird deaths. The minister replied that the province is primarily responsible for such permits, that the permit is open to objection and appeal to the administrative court, that it is not appropriate for the cabinet to judge this case, and that bird-strike control is a continuous process where killing is used only when other measures fail.
Primary responsibility for granting exemptions under the Nature Conservation Act lies with the provinces.
De primaire verantwoordelijkheid voor het verlenen van ontheffingen in het kader van de Wet natuurbescherming is bij de provincies belegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de gevolgen van Lelystad Airport voor vogels

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether the government had adequately studied bird strike risks around Lelystad Airport and why environmental NGOs' concerns had not been addressed. The minister rejected the critique, stated the bird research was thorough, and offered a further meeting with Vogelbescherming Nederland.
The Lelystad project within my ministry is willing to receive Vogelbescherming for an additional meeting.
Het project Lelystad binnen mijn ministerie is bereid om de Vogelbescherming te ontvangen voor een aanvullend gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de gevolgen van Lelystad Airport voor vogels

Two PvdD MPs asked whether the bird-impact research for Lelystad Airport was adequate, whether bird-scaring or killing measures are acceptable, and whether the airport decision should be suspended. The minister replied that the research (including a 2017-2018 baseline survey) shows no need for extra bird-scaring beyond the faunabeheerplan, that killing birds is a last resort, and that no defects justify suspending the decision.
No, I do not share that view. The bird research provides sufficient justification for a positive decision
Nee, die mening deel ik niet. Het vogelonderzoek geeft voldoende onderbouwing voor een positief besluit
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de impact van de luchtvaartplannen van de minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat op het natuurbeleid

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the agriculture and nature minister whether the aviation expansion plans of the infrastructure minister, including Lelystad Airport, affect nature policy through nitrogen deposition and bird strikes, and whether the effects on Veluwe nature have been adequately studied. The minister replied that the impacts were assessed in the MER and follow-up studies, that flight routes avoid Natura 2000 areas, and that the infrastructure minister's aviation policy falls outside her remit, so she sees no reason for further consultation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de schokkende beelden van een hondenshow in Eindhoven

Wassenberg (PvdD) asked the ministers about videos showing men touching dogs' genitals at a Eindhoven dog show, asking whether this is criminal, whether organisers must report it, and whether dog shows inherently harm welfare and should be restricted. Minister Schouten condemns the conduct as very inappropriate, notes a report has been filed with prosecution left to the Openbaar Ministerie, rejects a ban on dog shows arguing welfare can be safeguarded by supervision, and refers to earlier letters for enforcement plans.
Prosecution falls to the Public Prosecution Service.
Over de strafvervolging gaat het Openbaar Ministerie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht ‘Omstreden jacht met bijna 80 man levert op: één dood zwijn’ en over het ‘Verslag bewegingsjacht 5 januari 2019 Wildbeheereenheid Zuid-Oost Twente’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a newspaper report on a drive hunt with nearly 80 hunters in Zuid-Oost Twente, questioning whether handling a possibly infected wild boar carcass, dogs, eating and drinking, and horn-blowing complied with African swine fever hygiene rules, and whether sanctions apply. The minister answered that no African swine fever was present, the dissection and leaving remains followed the protocol, the hunt was not aimed at infected animals, no violation of hygiene or legal rules occurred, and no measures were considered.
In the drive hunt on 5 January 2019 in Zuid-Oost Twente there was no violation of hygiene or legal rules, so no measures are being considered.
Bij de bewegingsjacht op 5 januari 2019 in Zuid-Oost Twente was geen sprake van schending van hygiënische of wettelijke voorschriften, zodat geen maatregelen worden overwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de terugkeer van de wolf in Nederland

MP Wassenberg asks the minister whether the return of the wolf is positive, whether reopening wolf hunting would undo protection efforts, and about lobbying by a park director, the wolf's conservation status, wolf population estimates, and Germany's possible hunting. The minister answers that hunting wolves in the Netherlands is not allowed under EU law, the wolf's conservation status varies by country, and wolf population counts rely on genetic research.
Hunting wolves is not an issue in the Netherlands.
De jacht op de wolf is in Nederland niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de verkoop van doodgeschoten herten uit de Oostvaardersplassen

MP Wassenberg asked the minister about the sale of culled deer from the Oostvaardersplassen, the NVWA's individual inspection, the feasibility of oversight given NVWA capacity, and the skill of replacement rangers. The minister answered that each deer is inspected via an approved game-processing facility, that animal welfare during culling falls outside slaughter rules and is only spot-checked by the regional body, and that replacement staff are sufficiently experienced; no Koninklijk Jachtdepartement staff were involved.
In addition, small quantities of game for the local market may be offered directly by a qualified person to the poulterer and catering trade without involvement of a game-processing facility.
Daarnaast bestaat de mogelijkheid dat kleine hoeveelheden wild voor de lokale markt door een gekwalificeerd persoon direct worden aangeboden aan poelier en horeca zonder tussenkomst van een WBI.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het afzwakken van de ambitie om in 2025 wereldleider proefdiervrije innovatie te zijn

An MP asked whether the minister weakened the national ambition to be a world leader in animal-free innovation by 2025, and why this was not reported, financed, monitored or backed by evaluations. The minister denied weakening the ambition, reformulated it as being a forerunner, gave an explanation, and outlined networks and monitoring without concrete new targets or extra funds.
I shared the current formulation of the ambition with you both in my letter of 1 June to the House and in the annex 'Philosophy and working method of the Animal-Free Innovation Transition'.
Ik heb zowel in mijn brief d.d. 1 juni jl. aan de Kamer als in de bijlage «Filosofie en werkwijze Transitie Proefdiervrije Innovatie» de huidige formulering van de ambitie met u gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over ernstige misstanden op paardenmarkt in Hedel

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about video-documented animal welfare abuses at the Hedel horse market, whether they violated the Animal Welfare Act, and why enforcement by the NVWA and the municipality failed over many years. The Minister replied that no violations were found by the NVWA, defended self-regulation and the existing guidelines, said the municipality's role is being clarified with the VNG, and pointed to inspection trends and a tightened welfare protocol.
No violations of Animal Welfare Act article 1.3 paragraph 3 were found by the NVWA during these checks.
Hierbij zijn geen overtredingen van Wet dieren artikel 1.3 lid 3 vastgesteld door de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de gruwelijke wereld achter de handel in cavia’s

MP Wassenberg (PvdD) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about serious animal welfare abuses in the guinea pig breeding and trade shown by Kassa, including sick animals being killed, sale of ill animals and misleading advice to buyers. The minister acknowledged the abuses but stated that conclusions cannot be drawn from one trader, pointed to existing enforcement by the LID and NVWA, and declined to introduce new bans or tighter rules, while noting that a review of the Animal Act will consider killing rules.
However, no conclusions can be drawn on the basis of images from one trader.
Op basis van beelden bij één handelaar zijn echter geen conclusies te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat Japan zich terugtrekt uit de internationale walvisvaartcommissie

The MP Wassenberg asked the government whether it shares concern about Japan's withdrawal from the International Whaling Commission, what consequences it has for relations and the trade agreement's sustainability chapter, and whether the government will raise the matter with Japan, summon its ambassador, or seek EU pressure or sanctions. The government answered that it regrets the decision, raised it with Prime Minister Abe, notes the sustainability chapter allows annual dialogue, and sees no EU sanctions basis since Japan is acting within its rights.
Japan has also indicated it will only hunt in its own territorial sea and exclusive economic zone, whereby Japan does not violate international agreements.
Japan heeft tevens aangegeven enkel nog in hun eigen Territoriale Zee en Exclusieve Economische Zone te zullen jagen, waarmee Japan geen internationale afspraken schendt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Wassenberg over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

Two PvdD MPs asked 21 questions about Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, including whether the government accepts shared responsibility for climate policy, whether it will tighten its own climate measures and move toward plant-based catering. The government answered on behalf of the full cabinet, but the answer text available here is only a reference to an Aanhangsel and gives no substantive response.
The written questions from MPs Ouwehand and Wassenberg (both PvdD), question number 2018Z24285, have been answered by means of Appendix to the Handelingen, session 2018–2019, no. 1305.
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Wassenberg (beiden PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24285 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1305 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de zienswijze 'Dierproeven ten behoeve van de Veehouderij' van de Raad voor Dieraangelegenheden

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Agriculture about the Animal Affairs Council's opinion on animal experiments for livestock farming, including rejection rates, severe suffering, whether such tests should be allowed, and a phase-out plan. The Minister answers that 144 livestock project applications were reviewed since 2015 with 5 rejected, that 17 projects with potentially severe suffering were approved, that the 'no, unless' principle applies, and that a phase-out will be pursued through the Transition to Animal-Free Innovation track rather than a concrete reduction plan.
The independent administrative body Central Committee on Animal Experiments (CCD) informed me that from 2015 through April 2018, 144 project applications for livestock farming were processed.

Het Zelfstandige Bestuursorgaan Centrale Commissie Dierproeven (CCD) heeft mij geïnformeerd dat er in de periode van 2015 t/m april 2018 144 projectaanvragen ten behoeve van de veehouderij zijn behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg inzake het gevonden leeuwenwelpje in Tienhoven

An MP asked the ministers about a lion cub found in Tienhoven, the origin of the animal, the CITES protection of lions, the positive list for mammals kept as pets, and the WHO's inclusion of traditional Chinese medicine in the ICD. The minister declined to disclose origin details citing an ongoing criminal investigation, and otherwise gave largely policy-level answers, committing to consult on the positive list in 2019 and to support CITES disposal work.
This information is part of a criminal investigation.
Deze informatie is onderdeel van strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de blinde vlek van de Nederlandse overheid voor natuurvernietiging die het gevolg is van de delving van mineralen voor onze energietransitie

MP Wassenberg asked whether the government will use permits and tenders for wind and solar parks to require responsibly sourced minerals, given environmental and human rights harm from mining abroad. The minister answered that responsibility lies with companies and the government will first give an IMVO covenant for the wind sector a chance, with possible measures only if it fails, and will examine linking supply-chain due diligence reporting to permit granting.
I want to give this IMVO covenant, in which the central government also participates as a party, a chance first.
Ik wil dit IMVO-convenant, waar wij als Rijk ook als partij aan deelnemen, eerst zelf een kans geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Akerboom over de pilot omgevingsmanagement gericht op de aardgaswinning onder de Waddenzee bij Ternaard

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the minister about a pilot on local stakeholder involvement for gas extraction under the Wadden Sea near Ternaard, a UNESCO site, including why island municipalities were not involved and whether national and international interests or local support could halt the project. The minister explained the pilot aims to test participation instruments, that the municipality of Ameland declined to join, that the Hand aan de Kraan principle and the Structuurvisie Waddenzee set limits, and that local support is assessed at the end of the process without a simple yes/no veto.
Determining local support is not a simple yes or no regarding the proposed gas extraction.
Bij het vaststellen van lokaal draagvlak gaat het niet om een eenvoudig ja of nee met betrekking tot de voorgestelde gaswinning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Beckerman over het dreigende tekort aan stroom in België vanwege uitgeschakelde kernreactoren

MPs Wassenberg and Beckerman asked whether the Netherlands would supply emergency electricity to Belgium amid nuclear reactor shutdowns, raising CO2, price, reactor safety and parliamentary consultation concerns. The minister answered that Belgium seeks optimised interconnector capacity rather than extra power, that CO2 emissions cannot be excluded, that FANC is responsible for nuclear safety, and that the operational measures fall within TenneT's competence.
Question 11: Are you willing to avoid irreversible steps and submit decisions on supplying electricity to Belgium to the House?
Vraag 11 Bent u bereid om geen onomkeerbare stappen te nemen en besluiten over de levering van stroom aan België voor te leggen aan de Kamer?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over tankers die elke dag illegaal kankerverwekkend gas lozen

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about tankers that vent benzene and other carcinogenic vapours on the Waal and Rhine, including near inhabited areas, and about enforcement gaps between provinces and the state. The minister answered that venting is banned only for petrol, that a national ban on venting other dangerous substances will take effect around 2020 under a revised Rhine convention, that enforcement lies with the ILT and Rijkswateren authorities, and that no change in provincial responsibility is warranted.
Nevertheless, my aim is to ban venting of all dangerous substances while sailing as quickly as possible.
Niettemin is mijn streven gericht op het zo snel mogelijk verbieden van het varend ontgassen van alle gevaarlijke stoffen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het levend ontvinnen van een haai in Caribisch gebied

MP Wassenberg asked the minister about a video showing fishermen in Curaçao finning a live shark, whether the EU ban applies there, and what steps will be taken on the shark reserve, strategy and ICCAT. The minister answered that Curaçao is a national matter, the shark reserve and Curaçao's commitment are not yet implemented, and the national shark strategy will be sent to parliament in Q1 2019 with some commitments to pursue a global finning ban.
It is not for me to address the Curaçao government on this, as it is a matter for the country.
Het is niet aan mij om de Curaçaose regering hierop aan te spreken daar het een landsaangelegenheid betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Kooten-Arissen over het testen van zenuwgassen op proefdieren door Defensie

MPs Wassenberg and Van Kooten-Arissen asked the Defence Minister about animal testing of nerve agents on guinea pigs and rats, including ethics, the origin of animals, the number of animals used, funding for alternatives and plans to end testing. The government answered that the tests are necessary for medical countermeasures under the Animal Experiments Act, that about 100 rodents a year are used, and that testing will stop only when non-animal methods suffice, which is not expected soon.
For sound and reliable research, due to the lack of sufficient alternatives, the use of laboratory animals is still necessary.
Voor goed en betrouwbaar onderzoek is, vanwege het ontbreken van voldoende alternatieven, het gebruik van proefdieren nog steeds noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over undercoverbeelden over apenexperimenten in het BPRC

An MP asked the government about undercover footage showing sedated monkeys at the BPRC primate research centre, including animals left unattended and handlers joking near suffering animals, and whether subsidy should stop. The minister answered that the NVWA inspected, found the sedation adequate and no violations, and committed to a plan from the BPRC by 1 January 2019 to reduce primate experiments by 40 percent, with a letter to parliament in Q1 2019.
Following the undercover footage, the NVWA carried out an extra inspection at the BPRC on 10 September.
Naar aanleiding van de undercoverbeelden heeft de NVWA op 10 september jl. een extra inspectie bij het BPRC uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat methaanuitstoot door gasindustrie groter is dan gedacht

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that methane emissions from the gas industry are higher than assumed, and whether measurement rather than sector estimates should be used, plus whether a national measuring programme and offshore leak measures will follow. The Minister says the current estimate-based method, reviewed with SodM, is adequate, that a harmonised protocol was adopted, that a national measurement programme will be examined with SodM and NOGEPA, and that a TNO study on possible shallow-gas leaks at abandoned wells will report in Q1 2019.
I will consider with SodM and NOGEPA whether an additional measurement programme is needed and, if so, how it should take shape.
Ik zal met SodM en NOGEPA bezien of een aanvullend meetprogramma nodig is en zo ja hoe dit vorm moet krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over “illegale en giftige mengsels in stookolie”

MP Wassenberg asked the State Secretary about illegal and toxic waste mixed into heating oil by fuel traders, the enforcement failures that allowed it, and plans to tighten control. The State Secretary confirmed the findings, attributed past lapses to sector unawareness of REACH and to inspection priorities, and committed to more inspection capacity in the fuel sector from autumn 2018.
From autumn 2018, the ILT will make more capacity available for supervision of the fuel sector.
Vanaf najaar 2018 stelt de ILT meer capaciteit beschikbaar voor het toezicht op de brandstofbranche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over illegale praktijken rondom recycling van kunstgras

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management and the Justice Minister about illegal artificial turf recycling practices, including municipalities paying recyclers who leave pitches unprocessed, lack of enforcement, and bankruptcy used to dodge costs.
