The State Secretary answered that enforcement and permitting lie with provinces and municipalities, that the ILT issued warnings to inspected firms, and that no additional national measures are planned while monitoring the local follow-up.
It is the responsibility of provinces and municipalities to take these requirements into account when granting permits to waste companies.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van provincies en gemeenten om bij vergunningverlening aan afvalbedrijven rekening te houden met deze voorschriften.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Wassenberg en Ouwehand over de jaarlijkse milieuschade van ruim 37 miljard euro

MPs Van Raan, Wassenberg and Ouwehand asked the government about the roughly 37 billion euro annual environmental damage from Dutch firms and consumers, the CO2 minimum price, aviation emissions, livestock and imported environmental costs, and whether environmental costs are included in fiscal and policy calculations. The Minister mostly defended existing policy, said the PBL figures are uncertain and not fully comparable, pointed to planned True Pricing work and aviation measures, and declined to give some requested estimates.
The multi-year programme I have in mind should provide more insight into the cost-shifting mechanisms.
Het meerjarenprogramma dat mij voor ogen staat moet meer inzicht in de afwentelingsmechanismen opleveren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over oliebedrijf Odfjell, die de rekening van de olieramp in de Rotterdamse haven wil doorschuiven naar de Nederlandse belastingbetaler

MP Wassenberg asked whether the Odfjell shipping and owner NCC should pay for the Rotterdam oil spill cleanup and whether Odfjell should be barred from the port if it refuses. The minister answered that total damage is not yet known, liability is being pursued under the Bunkers Convention with a liability-limitation request pending before the Rotterdam court, and that barring Odfjell would be disproportionate.
At this moment it is not yet known what the total extent of the damage is.
Op dit moment is nog niet bekend wat de totale omvang van de schade is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de toegenomen populariteit van gasgestookte ketels, met name in nieuwbouw

MP Wassenberg asks whether the rising popularity of gas boilers, especially in new-build homes, undermines Dutch climate targets, the Groningen gas phase-out and the 2050 gas-free goal, and whether government policy and gas connections should be changed. The minister replies that gas-boiler demand has not risen sharply, that heat pumps are gaining share, that the gas connection obligation for new homes was abolished from 1 July 2018, and that municipalities will set neighbourhood plans and the Klimaatakkoord will support the transition.
I have asked RVO to explain these figures.
Ik heb RVO gevraagd om deze cijfers toe te lichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over afvalscheiding op NS-stations

An MP asked the state secretary about NS breaking its 2020 promise to separate three-quarters of station waste, including too few combi-containers and separated waste being recombined. The state secretary denied NS was failing its commitments, pointed to ongoing Green Deal pilots and planned combi-container tests, and said no conclusion on final realisation can yet be drawn.
I therefore do not share your conclusion that NS would not be keeping its agreements.
Ik deel daarom niet uw conclusie dat de NS haar afspraken niet zou nakomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat er meer afval naar de stortplaats verdwijnt

An MP asked the state secretary about a report that more waste is going to landfill, including permits for 130 kton more this year, and about recycling by households. The state secretary said the increase is about 30 kton, that landfilling uses existing capacity, and cited economic growth and a 57% household separation rate, promising to strengthen circular economy measures and raise landfill taxes.
It concerns landfilling at existing landfill sites and within existing capacity.
Het betreft hier storten op bestaande stortplaatsen en binnen bestaande capaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over plastic als belangrijke bron van broeikasgas

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether litter plastics are a significant greenhouse gas source and whether emissions from them are estimated or monitored in the Netherlands. The minister confirmed the research finding, said no estimates exist and that the RIVM will follow international research, and stated that litter plastics are not yet included in climate policy.

Climate policy currently does not take into account greenhouse gas emissions from litter plastics, because until now these have not been considered a relevant emission source with substantial emissions.

Er wordt in het klimaatbeleid momenteel geen rekening gehouden met de uitstoot aan broeikasgassen door zwerfplastics omdat dit tot nu toe niet beschouwd is als relevante emissiebron met een substantiële emissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat de stook van biomassa zorgt voor een flinke toename van fijnstof

An MP asked the government about reports that biomass burning raises fine particulate levels, the WHO guideline gap, climate effects, whether biomass is sustainable, and whether subsidies for wood stoves should end. The minister answered that biomass is renewable, promised attention to particulate emissions in the Clean Air Agreement, and said the ISDE subsidy scheme will be evaluated in 2019 including its effect on local air quality.
In the 2019 evaluation of the ISDE scheme I will include its effects on (local) air quality as one of the assessment criteria.
Bij de evaluatie van de ISDE-regeling in 2019 zal ik de effecten op de (lokale) luchtkwaliteit meenemen als een van de criteria bij de beoordeling van de regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het pleidooi van gemeenten voor een landelijk vuurwerkverbod

The MP asks whether the government will adopt a nationwide fireworks ban as urged by municipalities and the Safety Board, whether the VVD blocked it, and how it views local measures and the 'waterbed effect'. The ministers answer by referring to their 8 June letter explaining why they chose not to implement the Safety Board's ban now, say they are consulting the VNG on local regulation, and state that a ban on certain fireworks is not excluded if the measures prove ineffective after evaluation.
Should it turn out that these measures do not lead to the desired result, a ban on certain types of fireworks is not ruled out.
Mocht blijken dat deze maatregelen niet tot het gewenste resultaat leiden, dan is een verbod op bepaalde typen vuurwerk niet uitgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Kooten- Arissen over “de verkoop van een giftige aanslagreiniger, gevaarlijk voor mens, dier en milieu”

MPs Wassenberg and Arissen asked whether a green-mould cleaner sold by Action, containing the toxic substance DDAC, is safe and whether it should be recalled or banned for consumers. The state secretary answered that the product is authorised by the Ctgb and meets legal requirements, but a warning label on pets will be added, and no recall or sales ban is planned.
A warning sentence on the label is a proportionate measure for this problem.
Een waarschuwingszin op het etiket is voor dit probleem een proportionele maatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het artikel ‘Hout stoken in woonwijken moet aan banden worden gelegd’

An MP asks the state secretary and minister about the health, climate and environmental effects of residential wood burning, and whether national rules and subsidies for wood and pellet stoves should be restricted. The government acknowledges that wood smoke causes pollution and local nuisance, says it will work with municipalities on feasible measures, but defends biomass as renewable and keeps subsidies for pellet stoves in place.
I consider it important to give municipalities tools to address actual nuisance situations.
Ik vind ik het belangrijk om gemeenten handvatten te geven om daadwerkelijke overlastsituaties aan te kunnen pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de schadelijke effecten van de groeiende luchtvaart op de luchtkwaliteit rond Schiphol

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked the government about the air-quality effects of growing aviation around Schiphol, including RIVM projections of NO2 exceedances in 2030 and whether environmental impact assessments adequately cover health and climate effects. The minister answered that the exceedances stem from Schiphol-related traffic, pointed to planned measures and the ongoing ultrafine particle research, and defended the scope of the MERs as adequate, while committing to take the Commission's suggestion into a future aviation strategy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het aangekondigde Britse verbod op plastic rietjes, roerstaafjes en wattenstaafjes

An MP asks the government about the UK plan to ban plastic straws and stirrers, their share of marine litter, and whether the Netherlands will ban such single-use plastics. The state secretary welcomes the UK initiative, says the Netherlands does not track straw sales, and defers concrete measures to the forthcoming circular economy response.
In the cabinet response to the circular economy transition agendas I will go further into how I intend to deal with disposable products.
In de kabinetsreactie op de transitieagenda's circulaire economie zal ik nader ingaan op de wijze waarop ik met wegwerpproducten wil omgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het verzet van de Duitse deelstaat Rijnland-Palts tegen het langer openhouden van de kerncentrales in Doel en Tihange

An MP asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about the German state of Rhineland-Palatinate's opposition to extending the operating life of the Belgian nuclear plants Doel and Tihange, including joining a Greenpeace lawsuit and a regional anti-nuclear alliance conference. The State Secretary answered that Belgian nuclear decisions are Belgium's responsibility, that the Belgian regulator deems the plants safe, that the Netherlands will monitor and seek information on safety, and that the Netherlands will not join foreign court cases.
I have no reason to doubt the judgment of FANC.
Ik heb geen reden aan het oordeel van FANC te twijfelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het gelekte water uit kernreactor Doel 1 dat radioactief kan zijn

An MP asked the state secretary whether leaked water from Belgian reactor Doel 1 could be radioactive, why the Netherlands was informed late, and whether the Belgian lifetime extension should be opposed. The government answered that the water is slightly radioactive but contained with no impact on people or environment, admitted the initial communication was inadequate and will be tightened, and said Belgian lifetime extension is a Belgian competence that it will monitor closely.
The existing agreements on mutual information exchange and communication to the public will be tightened as a result.
De bestaande afspraken over onderlinge informatie-uitwisseling en communicatie naar het publiek zullen naar aanleiding hiervan worden aangescherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over berichtgeving over een lek in het nucleaire gedeelte van kernreactor Doel 1

An MP asked the state secretary about a reported leak in the nuclear part of Belgian reactor Doel 1, the risks to Dutch citizens, and whether the Netherlands would oppose life extension of Belgian reactors. The state secretary answered that the Dutch regulator was not informed in time due to an administrative error, that Belgian authorities found no safety impact (INES-0), and that life-extension decisions belong to Belgium though the Netherlands will monitor them closely.
Due to an administrative error, the ANVS was, contrary to agreements, not actively informed by the Belgian authorities about the leak at the Doel-1 nuclear plant.
Door een administratieve vergissing was de ANVS, tegen de afspraken in, niet actief door de Belgische autoriteiten geïnformeerd over het opgetreden lek in de kerncentrale Doel-1.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat er veel meer afval in de Stille Oceaan ronddrijft dan werd aangenomen en dat bijna de helft van deze vervuiling bestaat uit visnetten

An MP asked the government about a Nature study showing far more ocean plastic in the Pacific than assumed, with fishing nets making up nearly half, and whether this implies similar underestimates in the North Sea, what fishing-gear waste is found on Dutch beaches, whether the Green Deal on clean fishing is working, and what further measures are planned. The minister answered that North Sea findings cannot be translated directly, that net and rope waste is the largest category on Dutch beaches, that the Green Deal shows progress, and that new EU port reception rules and international initiatives are planned, but gave no new binding measures.
I acknowledge the need for a vigorous approach to reducing plastic litter in the marine environment.
Ik onderken de noodzaak van een voortvarende aanpak om plastic zwerfvuil in het mariene milieu terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat ziekenhuizen, universiteiten en musea kiezen voor vieze kolenstroom

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why hospitals, universities and museums still buy coal-based electricity, and what the government will do about greenwashing and municipal green procurement. The minister replied that the market works through guarantees of origin, that the Greenpeace analysis is not supported, that institutions choose their own supply, and that an inventory of municipal procurement and a PIANOo self-evaluation tool will follow with results in early 2019.
I have had an inventory made of the procurement requests of municipalities that took place on TenderNed.
Ik heb een inventarisatie laten maken van de inkoopaanvragen van gemeenten die in TenderNed hebben plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat het 'groenste' kabinet nogal vuil rijdt

An MP asked why most ministers of the Rutte III cabinet are driven in fuel-inefficient cars despite the government's commitment to lead by example on sustainability. The government replied that six ministers currently use hybrids, that a Green Deal targets 20-25% electric vehicles in the central government fleet by 2020, and that it will accelerate the fleet transition, though each ministry is responsible for its own choices.

In consultation with the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (responsible for the civil service) and the State Secretary for Defence (responsible for the civil service vehicle procurement category), I will work on accelerating the transition to zero-emission vehicles across central government.

Ik zal in overleg met de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (vanuit haar verantwoordelijkheid voor de Rijksdienst) en de Staatssecretaris van Defensie (vanuit haar verantwoordelijkheid voor de inkoopcategorie civiele dienstauto's) werken aan het versnellen van de transitie naar zero emissie voertuigen door het Rijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het gebruik van uit het wild gevangen beschermde dieren in een dierexperiment

An MP asked the minister about trapping wild protected starlings and jackdaws for animal experiments at the University of Groningen and whether the ethics review was public. The minister answered that the animals are protected but the Central Committee on Animal Experiments approved the project under a 2015 exemption, that ethics advice and non-technical summaries are published, and that she sees no reason to halt the project.
Transparency about animal experiments is my first priority.
Transparantie over dierproeven staat bij mij voorop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat de Staat meebetaalt aan de reorganisatie van NAM

MP Wassenberg asked whether the State, via EBN, co-pays NAM's reorganisation costs (EUR 48.7 million), whether the 1963 agreements are secret, and whether EBN was pressured to pay. Minister Wiebes answered that EBN pays 40% of operator costs under confidential private-law cooperation agreements, that an Ernst & Young audit found the calculation compliant, and that the advice cannot be shared.

Because this concerns the execution of a private-law agreement between EBN and an operator and the documents contain personal and commercially sensitive information, I do not have the advice or other documents from Ernst & Young.

Omdat het hier gaat om de uitvoering van een privaatrechtelijke overeenkomst tussen EBN en een operator en de stukken persoons- en bedrijfsgevoelige informatie bevatten, beschik ik niet over het advies of andere stukken van Ernst & Young.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de dramatische effecten van sleepnetten op de Noordzee

The MP Wassenberg asked whether the minister knows of research showing a 30% decline in seabed fauna in the North Sea, largely due to beam trawling, and whether beam trawling and pulse fishing should be phased out and seabed life protected with ambitious recovery goals. The minister confirmed the 30% finding, referred to earlier answers for the trawling questions, described pulse fishing as a promising less damaging alternative with ongoing long-term research, and referred again to earlier answers on protection.
The pulse gear is lighter than the traditional beam trawl, so the gear penetrates the seabed less deeply.
Het pulstuig is lichter dan de traditionele boomkor, waardoor het tuig de zeebodem minder diep penetreert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het niet vervolgen van het illegaal afschieten van 82 beschermde grauwe ganzen door Faunabeheereenheid Flevoland

An MP asked the minister whether the Flevoland wildlife management unit should be prosecuted for shooting 82 protected greylag geese without a valid permit, and why the environmental service declined a criminal investigation. The minister explained that the permit was only usable after the objection period, that the unit admitted shooting during that period, that the service dropped criminal proceedings given the low risk of repetition, and that prosecution remains legally possible but was not pursued.
The Omgevingsdienst then decided to refrain from a criminal investigation because it considers the chance of recurrence small.
De Omgevingsdienst heeft daarop besloten af te zien van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek omdat zij de kans op herhaling klein acht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het nalaten te handhaven op illegale jachthutten door de Omgevingsdiensten

An MP asked the minister why illegal hunting huts in the Biesbosch were not removed after a February 2017 enforcement request, including questions on handling by the Omgevingsdiensten and whether animals were illegally killed. The minister replied that the Omgevingsdiensten act under provincial responsibility, so she would not comment on their conduct, that huts are not an offence under the Wet natuurbescherming per se, and that the province has no evidence of illegal killings.
The Omgevingsdiensten work on behalf of and under the responsibility of the provinces. It is therefore not for me to respond to the working methods of these services.
De Omgevingsdiensten werken in opdracht van en onder verantwoordelijkheid van de provincies. Het is derhalve niet aan mij om een reactie te geven omtrent de werk- en handelwijze van de deze diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat er door visserij nauwelijks meer volgroeide vissen zijn in de oceanen

An MP asked the minister whether old-growth fish have become scarce under commercial fishing, whether the EU fisheries policy adequately protects them, and whether she will push for better protection. The minister acknowledges the age-structure effect of fishing but says evidence on the reproductive role of older fish is mixed, age structure is not an indicator in the CFP, and existing catch limits and minimum sizes are sufficient.
I consider the combination of these measures sufficient to protect fish species against overfishing.
De combinatie van deze maatregelen acht ik voldoende om vissoorten tegen overbevissing te beschermen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat Nederland de fossiele industrie met 7,6 miljard euro per jaar steunt

An MP asked whether the Netherlands subsidises the fossil fuel industry with 7.6 billion euro a year, whether the polluter-pays principle should guide climate policy, and how this squares with the energy transition and Paris goals. The government denied that fossil producers receive specific subsidies, stated it supports renewables and energy saving, and said the future of fossil phase-out is for the next cabinet to decide.
As indicated, there is no question of companies receiving specific government support for the use or production of fossil energy.
Zoals aangegeven, is er geen sprake van dat bedrijven specifieke overheidssteun ontvangen voor het gebruik of de productie van fossiele energie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het voornemen garnalenvissers het MSC-keurmerk voor duurzame visserij te geven

The MP asks whether the MSC label for North Sea shrimp fishers is credible given reported bycatch of around 60% and overfished stocks, and what the timeline is for the landing obligation. The minister answers that the certifier assessed bycatch (about 78% shrimp, 11% benthic animals, 9% fish, 2% flatfish), points to voluntary measures and a coastal fisheries agreement, argues the label is an independent private initiative that performs better on stocks, and says the landing obligation applies from 2019 with survival-exemption and pulse-fishing options still under study.
The awarding of quality marks is a private initiative.
Het toekennen van keurmerken is een privaat initiatief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het voornemen van Gedeputeerde Staten van Limburg om het doden van bevers toe te staan

An MP asked the minister whether the provincial executive of Limburg's approval of a beaver management plan permitting killing of beavers complies with the Nature Conservation Act and EU habitat rules. The minister answered that the assessment is for the provincial executive, outlined the damage and safety risks beavers can cause, noted alternative measures and the protected status under EU law, and declined to intervene through interbestuurlijk toezicht.
It is up to the provincial executive to assess whether these conditions are met.
Het is aan gedeputeerde staten om te beoordelen of aan deze voorwaarden wordt voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het weren van pers en bezorgde inwoners bij een informatiebijeenkomst over de kerncentrale in Tihange

An MP asked the government about differences in iodine tablet distribution across the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany, and about the exclusion of press and concerned residents from a Tihange information meeting. The government said harmonisation with neighbours is partial, regional authorities may act independently, Belgian nuclear safety is a national responsibility, and it has no influence over the safety-region meetings, declining to answer the questions in time for the meeting.
The meetings were organised by the safety regions in Limburg. I have no need to exert influence over that.
De bijeenkomsten zijn georganiseerd door de veiligheidsregio's in Limburg. Ik heb geen behoefte om daar invloed op uit te oefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de stijging van CO2-uitstoot in 2016

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether the 2020 CO2 reduction target (25% versus 1990), upheld by the court, is still achievable given a 1% rise in 2016 and a reduction of only 11% so far, and how the remaining 14% will be achieved year by year. The government denies the target is out of reach, says the Energy Agreement should close the remaining 4 Mton gap and that the NEV 2017 will be used to check course, with additional measures if needed.
At the NEV 2017 it will be examined whether we are still on track to implement the Urgenda judgment.
Bij de NEV 2017 zal worden bezien of we nog op koers liggen om uitvoering te geven aan het Urgenda-vonnis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de haalbaarheid van de emissiereductie van broeikasgassen van 25% in 2020

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether the CE Delft finding that the 25% greenhouse gas reduction target for 2020 (Urgenda ruling) is very likely unattainable with current policy is accepted, and how the 2017 projection handles the uncertainties (wind onshore, CCS ROAD, electricity imports) and what will be done if the analysis proves right. The Secretary of State disagrees, saying the Energy Agreement targets should close the remaining 4 Mton gap, that ROAD is no longer counted after withdrawal, and that the NEV 2017 will be reviewed with additional measures such as closing a coal plant if needed.
With the NEV 2017 it will be examined whether we are still on course to implement the Urgenda ruling.
Bij de NEV 2017 zal worden bezien of we nog op koers liggen om uitvoering te geven aan het Urgenda-vonnis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over zorgen die er bij het Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen bestaan over de veiligheid bij delfstoffenwinning en geothermie

An MP asks the minister about State Supervision of the Mines' concerns over safety in gas extraction and geothermal energy, including predictability of quakes, offshore decommissioning funding, geothermal operators lacking approved extraction plans, and clearer rules on where mining may take place. The minister acknowledges model uncertainty, promises an interim geothermal framework and tighter Mijnbouwwet rules on decommissioning finance, and says the structure vision on the subsurface is being reviewed.
If SodM finds in the meantime that an unsafe situation arises, SodM will intervene and halt the exploration or extraction.
Indien SodM in de tussentijd constateert dat er zich wel een onveilige situatie voordoet, zal SodM ingrijpen en de opsporing of winning stilleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over Nederlandse pensioenfondsen die beleggen in de kerncentrales van Tihange en Doel

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked whether Dutch pension funds, including ABP which civil servants must join, should stop investing in the Belgian nuclear plants Tihange and Doel, and about iodine tablets sent to civil servants in the south. The government replied that ABP's investment policy is for the fund's board, that employee representatives and the accountability body can influence it, and that ABP raises safety with the operator Engie as a shareholder without committing to divestment.
The ABP board is responsible for implementing the pension scheme, including investment policy.
Het ABP-bestuur gaat over de uitvoering van de pensioenregeling, inclusief het beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Arissen over lange afstandswedstrijden in de duivensport, waarbij meer dan de helft van de dieren uitvalt

MPs Wassenberg and Arissen asked about high loss rates in long-distance pigeon races, animal welfare rules, enforcement, and whether a ban is needed. The State Secretary said welfare rules apply, enforcement rests with the NVWA and the Dutch pigeon federation, and no ban is planned while the federation self-regulates.
I do not have the requested data on the organised pigeon events in the Netherlands.
Ik beschik niet over de gevraagde gegevens met betrekking tot de georganiseerde evenementen met duiven in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de voorgestelde forse daling van de subsidiebedragen voor duurzame energie productie (SDE+)

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether cutting SDE+ renewable energy subsidy amounts for 2018 undermines the 14% renewable target, the government's steering role, and environmental and landscape safeguards, including the Eemshaven cable routing. The minister defends the proposed basisbedragen as cost-driven, says consultation is still ongoing with a final advice pending, and denies that environmental concerns are neglected.
Based on the final advice, I will decide together with the Minister of Finance on opening the SDE+ 2018, and will inform your House of this in the autumn.
Op basis van het eindadvies zal ik samen met de Minister van Financiën besluiten over de openstelling van de SDE+ 2018. Hier zal ik uw Kamer in het najaar over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het doden van beschermde houtsnippen

MP Wassenberg asked about a court ruling on the killing of protected woodcocks at Duivenvoorde estate, whether a game warden with investigative powers took part, and whether such officers should be barred from hunts they supervise. The State Secretary answered that the warden's dual role is justified with strict training and supervision requirements, saw no reason for further restrictions, pointed to existing protection rules, and confirmed the public prosecutor did not appeal.
I see no reason to impose further restrictions on the game warden.
Zie ik geen reden om nadere beperkingen op te leggen aan de jachtopzichter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht ‘Groot deel Klaverbank verwoest’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that bottom trawling had devastated part of the Klaverbank Natura 2000 area and why no protective measures apply yet. The State Secretary replied that the single dive covers only a small part of the area, that protective measures will be set out in a management plan and through EU channels with neighbouring countries, and that a joint recommendation to the European Commission is expected to be launched in autumn 2017.
I am working diligently and carefully on an agreement with neighbouring countries on a joint recommendation to the European Commission for the protection of the Klaverbank.
Ik werk voortvarend en zorgvuldig aan een akkoord met de buurlanden voor een gezamenlijke aanbeveling aan de Europese Commissie voor de bescherming van de Klaverbank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het uitblijven van de vermaatschappelijking van faunabeheereenheden

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs why nature and animal protection organisations are absent from some faunabeheereenheden boards, despite a promised democratisation under the Nature Conservation Act, and whether provinces will be pressed or plans withdrawn. The State Secretary replied that provincial ordinances now meet the statutory requirements in all but one province, that Noord-Holland will amend its ordinance, that actual board composition is published by each unit, and that he sees no reason to pressure provinces.

I have established that in all provinces except one, ordinances with provisions on the boards of the faunabeheereenheden that meet the requirements of the Nature Conservation Act have been in force since 1 January 2017.

Ik heb vastgesteld dat in alle provincies – op één na – sinds 1 januari 2017 verordeningen van kracht zijn geworden met bepalingen ten aanzien van de besturen van de faunabeheereenheden die voldoen aan de vereisten van de Wet natuurbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het stoppen van Deense hulp aan jaarlijkse dolfijnslachtingen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked whether the government supports a Sea Shepherd request for an EU infringement procedure against Denmark over dolphin hunts in the Faroe Islands under the Habitats Directive. The state secretary replied that the Faroe Islands fall outside EU treaty scope, so the Habitats Directive does not apply and no infringement procedure is possible, though the government will keep raising the issue with Denmark.
Expressing support for a request to start an infringement procedure is therefore not possible.
Het uitspreken van steun aan een verzoek tot het starten van een inbreukprocedure is derhalve niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het nieuwbouw proefdiercentrum van het Erasmus MC

An MP asked the state secretary about a new 6,000 m2 animal research centre at Erasmus MC, funded by a 4.2 million euro interest-free loan, and whether this fits the government's goal of leading in animal-free research by 2025. The state secretary confirmed the project, said it consolidates existing facilities without increasing animal experiments, and that subsidy requests are assessed on economic, social, scientific and 3Vs criteria.
It does not concern an increase in the number of animal experiments but an improvement of the conditions for the research.
Het gaat daarbij niet om een uitbreiding van het aantal dierproeven maar om verbetering van de omstandigheden voor het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Wassenberg en Beckerman over het bericht 'Netherlands to get first US LNG cargot'

MPs Van Tongeren, Wassenberg and Beckerman asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that a US shale gas LNG cargo would arrive in Rotterdam, whether it is meant for the Dutch market, whether shale gas from the US is undesirable, and whether the government can block this transport. The minister answered that the buyer decides the destination, that the origin of the gas cannot be verified, that countries are sovereign over their resources, and that a blockade would be unenforceable, contrary to EU law and to diversification goals.
In doing so, I see no reason nor possibility to impose a blockade on gas from the United States or on shale gas.
Daarbij zie ik geen reden noch mogelijkheid om een blokkade op te werpen ten aanzien van gas uit de Verenigde Staten of ten aanzien van schaliegas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het doodschieten van ontsnapte antilopes bij Hunsel (Limburg)

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the shooting of two escaped eland antelopes near Hunsel, whether they could have been captured instead, the police role, and the owner's prior escapes. The State Secretary regretted the deaths, explained experts judged capture infeasible due to aggression and traffic danger, said the NVWA could not prove prior escapes came from this owner, and stated no permit is needed for eland antelope keeping.
However, it proved impossible to establish with full certainty that the animals came from the owner in question.
Het bleek echter niet mogelijk om met volledige zekerheid vast te stellen dat het dieren betrof die afkomstig waren van de betreffende eigenaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de vondst van een dood en ernstig verwaarloosd paard in Deurne (Noord-Brabant)

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a dead, severely neglected horse found on a Brabant family's land, whether the family's ongoing animal-keeping is responsible, whether animal health is monitored, whether a standalone keeping ban could help, and why the promised policy letter on it has been delayed. The minister answers that the matter is for the courts, describes the inspection bodies and their enforcement powers without disclosing visit counts, says a keeping ban could help depending on the case, and promises to inform parliament before the summer recess.
I will inform the House before the summer recess.
Ik infomeer uw Kamer voor het zomerreces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het lot van in beslag genomen wilde dieren uit de illegale handel

MP Wassenberg asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the unknown fate of wild animals seized from illegal trade, the lack of CITES reporting obligations, and what the Netherlands would do at the CITES CoP to improve reporting. The State Secretary answered that Dutch seizure figures are given (60 to 1,290 animals per year, 2011-2015), that reporting is a national matter and CITES notification is being followed up, and that a CITES resolution on disposal of confiscated specimens was adopted, promising to inform the House on the CoP outcomes.
I will inform the House shortly about the outcomes of CITES CoP 17.
Ik zal de Kamer op korte termijn informeren over de uitkomsten van de CITES CoP 17.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over dierproeven met duizenden boerderijdieren zonder noodzaak

An MP asked why data on animal experiments with farm animals only became public after a freedom-of-information request, and whether such experiments on farm animals should be phased out. The state secretary said the CCD publishes non-technical summaries and the NVWA publishes annual figures, that licences cover five years so permitted numbers differ from actual use, and that a phase-out schedule is being prepared with the NCad.
I am in favour of as much transparency as possible when it comes to animal experiments.
Ik ben voorstander van zo veel mogelijk transparantie als het gaat over dierproeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de geplande grootschalige bomenkap in de Schoorlse Duinen

MP Wassenberg asked the State Secretary whether the planned 141-hectare tree felling in the Schoorlse Duinen, a PAS measure, could free up room for intensive livestock farming and whether the issue would be considered in the PAS evaluation. The State Secretary answered that felling is primarily a measure to restore wind and water dynamics in the Natura 2000 area, that PAS does not single out specific economic activities, and that the effects of felling will be included in the PAS evaluation.

In the evaluation of the PAS, the effects of ecological restoration measures such as tree felling and experiences with granting permits based on allocated development space will be taken into account.

Bij de evaluatie van het PAS worden effecten van ecologische herstelmaatregelen zoals het kappen van bomen en ervaringen met uitgifte van vergunningen op basis van het toedelen van ontwikkelingsruimte, meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over enkele zorgwekkende berichten rondom landbouwgif

MP Wassenberg asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the EU approval of cyantraniliprole, the Netherlands' stance on neonicotinoids and systemic insecticides, the withdrawal and phase-out periods for glyphosate with tallowamine, Italy's glyphosate restrictions, and changes to maximum residue limits linked to Codex and TTIP. The government answered that EU and EFSA assessments found cyantraniliprole safe, that the Ctgb assesses authorisations under harmonised methods, that a withdrawal with a six-month sell-off period is planned, and that it will examine pre-harvest glyphosate use while maintaining the principle of the lowest attainable residue levels.
The Ctgb is now processing the submitted views and preparing the final decision.
Het Ctgb is nu bezig met het verwerken van de zienswijzen en het voorbereiden van het definitieve besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het op grote schaal illegaal couperen van paardenstaarten

Wassenberg (PvdD) asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why tail-docked horses were shown at the national draft horse exhibition despite the ban, how many official reports the NVWA drew up, how enforcement will be made more effective, and whether the sector can be pressed to voluntarily end docking. The State Secretary confirms the exhibition reports, says the NVWA is investigating via administrative enforcement rather than criminal reports, will inform parliament this autumn on enforcement effectiveness, and calls the sector's failure disappointing and says administrative enforcement was started for that reason.
The NVWA is currently investigating tail-docked horses displayed at exhibitions.
De NVWA doet momenteel onderzoek naar aanleiding van tentoongestelde, gecoupeerde paarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het voornemen van de EU om zich te verzetten tegen een totaalverbod op ivoorhandel

An MP asks the state secretary whether the EU opposing a total ivory trade ban, and the risk to African elephants, is accurate and whether the Netherlands influenced the EU position. The state secretary denies that a global ivory ban is being lifted, says the Commission proposal keeps the existing ban and that member states had no input on the first draft, and says Dutch involvement is possible but not currently considered necessary.
In the proposal that the European Commission sent to the Council, that ban remains in place.
In het voorstel dat de Europese Commissie aan de Raad gestuurd heeft, blijft dat verbod gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over ‘het dierenleed door miljoenen subsidies voor luchtwassers’

An MP asked the state secretary about animal suffering linked to subsidised air scrubbers in pig and poultry barns, including claims of EUR 38 million in public money, lower animal welfare, fewer bronmaatregelen and reduced grazing for cows. The government answered that scrubbers reduce ammonia and fine dust, that roughly EUR 3.5-4.0 million went to about 650 farms via fiscal schemes and EUR 24 million in subsidies to about 300 farms, that inspections found four shortcomings, and that it will not remove scrubbers from the Maatlat Duurzame Veehouderij.
Over the past 5 years about EUR 3.5-4.0 million has been allocated to scrubbers for about 650 farms.
De afgelopen 5 jaar is voor luchtwassers circa € 3,5 – 4,0 mln toegekend aan circa 650 bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over massale illegale vogelvangst en vogelhandel in Nederland en over het ontbreken van toezicht hierop

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports of mass illegal trapping and trade of wild birds in the Netherlands, the lack of enforcement, the Flora- and faunawet exemption for captive-bred birds, and whether bird markets should be closed. The State Secretary answered that the NVWA carries out risk-based inspections of bird markets, that police and NVWA run criminal investigations, that existing enforcement capacity is sufficient, and that closing markets would drive trade underground.
I remain of the view that within the existing capacity and scope of the NVWA sufficient attention is paid to enforcement of and supervision over nature legislation in the Netherlands.
Ik blijf van mening dat binnen de bestaande capaciteit en ruimte van de NVWA voldoende aandacht wordt besteed aan de handhaving van en het toezicht op de natuurregelgeving in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over misstanden in de Nederlandse vogelhandel

An MP asked the state secretary and the health minister about animal welfare, illegal trade and disease risks at Dutch bird markets after a broadcast, including whether bird markets should be abolished. The government acknowledged the abuses and pointed to existing rules and NVWA enforcement, but said it could not verify the trade claims, gave limited answers on enforcement, and promised to draw attention to the psittacosis reporting duty with the veterinary association and to ask the NVWA to focus on illegal trade and welfare at such events.
I regret the abuses shown in the broadcast.
Ik betreur de misstanden die worden getoond in de uitzending.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de stikstofuitstoot van de intensieve veehouderij als sluipmoordenaar voor Nederlandse natuur

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether nitrogen emissions from intensive livestock farming are endangering Dutch nature, including the Veluwe, and whether reducing livestock is needed. The State Secretary answers that nitrogen deposition is a major problem in many Natura 2000 areas, that deposition has fallen and the Programma Aanpak Stikstof (PAS) with monitoring and restoration measures is adequate, and that no decision on reducing the livestock stock is taken.
With the PAS the downward trend in nitrogen deposition is strengthened.
Met de PAS wordt de dalende trend van de stikstofdepositie versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het gebruik van een olifant als publiekstrekker voor circus Freiwald, ondanks een wettelijk verbod

The MP Wassenberg asks why circus Freiwald is allowed to keep and display elephant Buba and zebras despite the ban on wild animals in circuses and the conditions of its exemption, and why exemptions were renewed without a shelter being found. The State Secretary answers that the NVWA is investigating compliance with the exemption conditions, that the exemptions run until 15 January 2017 on condition of cooperating with an independent assessment, and that finding shelter is difficult and the ministry will mediate where needed, while noting that the animals are owned by the circuses.
Following this report and other notifications, the NVWA has launched an investigation.
Naar aanleiding van dit bericht en andere meldingen heeft de NVWA een onderzoek ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de schadelijke effecten van microplastics in kunstgras voetbalvelden

The MP Wassenberg asks whether artificial turf football pitches releasing a million kilos of microplastics yearly threaten the environment, why the RIVM study led to no further research, and whether new infill-based pitches should be banned. The State Secretary says the RIVM rates turf's contribution as limited, expects policy updates by year-end on other sources, and defers the turf question until then.
No statement can be made about the stated quantity of 1 million kilos of microplastics on the basis of the RIVM quick scan.
Over de genoemde hoeveelheid van 1 miljoen kilo microplastics kan op grond van de quick scan van het RIVM geen uitspraak worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het jaarlijks uitzetten van korhoenders op de Sallandse Heuvelrug die vervolgens een hongerdood sterven

MP Wassenberg (PvdD) asked whether the government would halt the annual release of Swedish capercaillies on the Sallandse Heuvelrug, which died of starvation due to nitrogen-depleted insect food, and how this fits the state's duty to protect nature. The State Secretary replied that nature policy is a provincial responsibility, that the releases are a last-resort bridging measure justified by Overijssel's provincial executive, and that the government will not halt them.
Policy on the capercaillie is a responsibility of the province, which I do not wish to interfere with.
Het beleid ten aanzien van het korhoen is een verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie, waar ik niet in wil treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het Franse voornemen een verbod af te kondigen op neonicotinoïden in verband met hun rol in de zorgwekkende bijensterfte

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the government about a French parliamentary move to ban neonicotinoid pesticides from 2018 and whether the Netherlands would pursue a total ban. The Secretary of State answered that the French proposal is not final and not yet notified to the EU, that the Dutch government considers the earlier motions unenforceable under EU regulation 1107/2009, and that a total ban is not appropriate given recent EFSA reassessments, while promising to inform parliament of relevant developments.
A total ban is, in my view and based on recent reassessments of the active substances in the neonicotinoid group, not an option.
Een totaalverbod is naar mijn inzicht en op basis van recente herbeoordelingen van de werkzame stoffen uit de neonicotinoïdengroep niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het visserijplan Oostzee

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the Baltic Sea fisheries plan, through FMSY ranges, allows structural overfishing and whether Dutch policy on it is sound. The government replied that the plan stays within scientific MSY advice with safeguards, denies it enables overfishing, and commits only to advocating scientifically based catch limits in future plans.
That the plan offers possibilities for structural overfishing is therefore an incorrect claim.
Dat het plan mogelijkheden biedt tot structurele overbevissing, is derhalve een onjuiste stellingname.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het illegaal couperen van staarten bij veulens

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about illegal tail docking of foals, the KVTH association's tolerance of it, and whether the government would act on it. The State Secretary said the NVWA runs no specific inspections, recorded one report and one warning in two years, regretted the KVTH's stance, and will raise the issue bilaterally in Europe without new EU legislation.
The NVWA does not carry out specific inspections on the ban on tail docking.
De NVWA voert geen specifieke inspecties uit op het verbod op het couperen van staarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het gebruik van roofvogels tegen drones

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police tests using birds of prey against drones, including injuries to the birds, the criteria for deployment, and housing and training conditions. The minister answered that no birds were injured in training, that animal welfare is one aspect in the test phase, and that the birds are housed under general animal housing rules and trained without coercion.
At present the police are examining various scenarios to counter misuse of drones.
Op dit moment bekijkt de politie verschillende scenario’s om misbruik met drones tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de reeks van incidenten bij de kerncentrale Tihange

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the minister about a series of incidents at the Belgian Tihange and Doel nuclear plants, including a leak in Tihange 2, a request for an incident overview, and whether the Netherlands would join legal action by Maastricht and Aachen. The minister said the Belgian regulator judged the leak not safety-relevant, provided an incident count, declined to join the legal steps as a Belgian national responsibility, and relied on the Belgian regulator's assessment of plant safety.
No, I am not joining the aforementioned legal steps.
Nee, ik sluit niet aan bij de genoemde juridische stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat de Vlaamse minister Ben Weyts de Nederlandse aanpak van de malafide puppyhandel te laks vindt

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about reports that Flemish minister Weyts considers Dutch enforcement against puppy trafficking too lax, including the claimed 50,000 unregistered dogs imported in 2014, possible whitelists and enforcement capacity. The government disputes the trend claim, points to existing measures and EU cooperation, and promises an evaluation of measures in spring 2016 to decide on further steps.
Your House will receive the evaluation presumably in the spring.
Uw Kamer ontvangt de evaluatie naar verwachting in het voorjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de erbarmelijke situatie van olifant Carla bij Circus Renz Berlin

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the conditions of elephant Carla at Circus Renz Berlin, citing expert concerns about housing, welfare, possible hook injuries, and the slow NVWA response, and asks for seizure and an expert-accompanied inspection. The State Secretary answers that the NVWA inspected on 14 December with a veterinarian and an external elephant expert, found no violations of the Animal Act, so there is no reason to seize the animal, rejects the claim that Carla is a needy animal, and explains that the earlier 2014 inspection was timed to the start of the tour.
During the inspection no violations of the Animal Act were found.
Tijdens de inspectie zijn geen overtredingen van de Wet Dieren vastgesteld.

m: Amendement van de leden Marijnissen en Van Nispen ter vervanging van nr. 3 over verhoging van het punttarief voor de sociale advocatuur
Raises the legal aid point rate for social lawyers from 121 to 137 euros with retroactive effect from 2023, funded from general funds, and calls for a structural increase and lower court fees.
With this proposal the point rate is raised from 121 to 137 euros.
Met dit voorstel wordt het punttarief verhoogd van 121 euro naar 137 euro.
Amendement van de leden Marijnissen en Van Nispen over verhoging van het uurtarief voor de sociale advocatuur
Raises the legal aid hourly rate from €121 to €137 and adds €68 million to access-to-justice funding.
Access to justice for everyone is an important and weighty starting point for the submitters.
De toegang tot het recht voor iedereen is een belangrijk en zwaarwegend uitgangspunt voor de indieners.
Amendement van de leden Dijk en Marijnissen over middelen voor extra plekken in verpleeghuizen
Increases the budget for long-term care by 975 million euro to fund 65,000 additional nursing home places, with funding partly from corporate tax.
With this amendment the submitter aims to structurally increase the Wlz contribution by 975 million euro
Met dit amendement beoogt de indiener de Bijdrage Wlz met € 975 miljoen structureel te verhogen
Amendement van de leden Dijk en Marijnissen over middelen voor een hoger salaris voor zorgverleners
Adds 2 billion euro to the care-sector budget so care workers' pay and working conditions can be raised structurally.
The submitter uses this amendment to create wage room to structurally raise salaries for care workers and improve their working conditions.
De indiener regelt met dit amendement dat er loonruimte ontstaat om de salarissen voor zorgverleners structureel te verhogen en hun arbeidsvoorwaarden te verbeteren.
Amendement van de leden Beckerman en Marijnissen over het bevriezen van de huren
Amendment adds 350 million euro to the housing budget to compensate housing corporations for rent revenue lost through a rent freeze, and asks the minister to agree a rent freeze.
This increase compensates housing corporations for the loss of rental income caused by the underlying amendment to freeze rents.
Deze verhoging compenseert het verlies van woningcorporaties aan huurinkomsten door onderliggend amendement om de huur te bevriezen.
Amendement van het lid Klaver c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 4 over een extra toeslag
Increases the health ministry budget by 2.35 billion euro to fund a one-off 500 euro allowance for care-allowance recipients and asks the government to design the scheme.
In article 8 Specific cost allowance, the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by 2,350,000 (x 1,000 euro).
In artikel 8 Tegemoetkoming specifieke kosten worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 2.350.000 (x € 1.000).
Amendement van de leden Marijnissen en Alkaya over het structureel verhogen van de zorgsalarissen
Adds 2 billion euro in 2021 and 2.9 billion structurally to care-sector pay, instructs the minister to renegotiate the OVA agreement, and asks for structural funding in the 2022 budget.
This amendment therefore instructs the Minister to adjust the OVA agreement with employers for this purpose.
Dit amendement geeft dan ook de Minister de opdracht om in overleg met de werkgevers de afspraken van het OVA convenant aan te passen hiervoor.
Amendement van het lid Marijnissen c.s. 35570-XVI-4 over budget voor de verhoging van de salarissen van zorgverleners
Increases the departmental health budget by 2.2 billion euros to fund structural salary increases for care workers.
the commitment amount and the expenditure amount are increased by €2,200,000 (x €1,000)
het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 2.200.000 (x € 1.000)
Motie van de leden Kooiman en Marijnissen over kleinschalige opvang in de wijk
Asks the government to inventory rules that hinder small-scale neighbourhood care homes for the elderly and propose how to remove them.
asks the government, in response to the initiative note on the Zorgbuurthuis, to inventory obstructive rules
verzoekt de regering om, in reactie op de ingediende initiatiefnota over het Zorgbuurthuis ( 34 849 ), belemmerende regels te inventariseren
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Marijnissen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het verlagen van het eigen risico met € 100 voor het jaar 2018
Lowers the mandatory health insurance deductible by 100 euro for 2018, funded by an extra state contribution to the health insurance fund.
This amendment provides for a reduction of the mandatory deductible by 100 euro.
Dit amendement regelt een verlaging van het verplicht eigen risico met 100 euro.
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Nijboer c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 15 over het loslaten van de koppeling tussen zorgkosten en de hoogte van het eigen risico
Decouples the statutory deductible (eigen risico) from healthcare costs and makes any change a ministerial regulation subject to a heavy prior parliamentary submission (zware voorhang).
that any increase or decrease of the eigen risico takes place by ministerial regulation subject to a heavy prior submission to parliament.
dat een eventuele verhoging of verlaging van het eigen risico plaatsvindt bij ministeriële regeling met zware voorhang.
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Ellemeet c.s. ter vervanging van nr.14 over het financieren van het niet verhogen van het eigen risico uit het Zorgverzekeringsfonds
Amendment having the minister pay the Zorgverzekeringsfonds a 2018 contribution to offset not raising the mandatory deductible, with insurers' lost income neutralised in equalisation payments.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Nijboer c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 11 over het loslaten van de koppeling tussen zorgkosten en de hoogte van het eigen risico
Decouples the statutory own-risk excess from healthcare costs and requires a heavy prior parliamentary review (voorhang) before any ministerial regulation changes it.
Additionally, this amendment provides that any increase or decrease of the own risk takes place by ministerial regulation with heavy prior review.
Daarnaast regelt dit amendement dat een eventuele verhoging of verlaging van het eigen risico plaatsvindt bij ministeriële regeling met zware voorhang.
Amendement van het lid Marijnissen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 6 over het regelen van dekking voor het amendement inzake de verlaging van het eigen risico

Amendment adds 1.1 billion euro to curative care budget to fund lowering the deductible (eigen risico) and compensate insurers, funded from the 2018 budget surplus; it is a budget-spending matter with no check on the executive.
In article 2 curative care, the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by € 1,100,000 (x € 1,000).
In artikel 2 curatieve zorg worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 1.100.000 (x € 1.000).
Amendement van het lid Ellemeet c.s. over de dekking van het niet verhogen van de premie
Adds a budget amount to the curative care line to fund a state contribution to the health insurance fund and compensation to insurers so the deductible and premiums need not rise.
the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by EUR 140,000
worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 140.000
Amendement van het lid Marijnissen 34775-XVI-6 over het regelen van dekking voor het amendement inzake de verlaging van het eigen risico
Amendment providing budget coverage for an increase in the state contribution to the health insurance fund to lower the own risk excess, from the 2018 budget surplus.
The coverage for 2018 is found in the 2018 budget surplus.
De dekking voor 2018 wordt gevonden in het begrotingsoverschot van 2018.
Amendement van het lid Nijboer c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 8 over het loslaten van de koppeling tussen zorgkosten en de hoogte van het eigen risico

Decouples the statutory own-risk deductible (eigen risico) from care costs and makes any change a ministerial regulation subject to a heavy advance-submission procedure (zware voorhang) to parliament.
Democratic control over the level of the own-risk deductible is thereby guaranteed.
De democratische controle op de hoogte van het eigen risico wordt hiermee gewaarborgd.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Marijnissen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 10 over het verlagen van het eigen risico met € 100 voor het jaar 2018
Lowers the mandatory health insurance deductible by 100 euro for 2018, funded by an extra state contribution to the health insurance fund.
This amendment provides for a reduction of the mandatory deductible by 100 euro.
Dit amendement regelt een verlaging van het verplicht eigen risico met 100 euro.
Amendement van het lid Nijboer c.s. over het loslaten van de koppeling tussen zorgkosten en de hoogte van het eigen risico
Decouples the statutory own-risk deductible from healthcare costs and makes any change by ministerial regulation subject to a four-week pre-submission to parliament.
The ministerial regulation to be adopted under Article 19(2) is not adopted until four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of the States General
De krachtens artikel 19, tweede lid, vast te stellen ministeriële regeling wordt niet eerder vastgesteld dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd
Amendement van het lid Ellemeet c.s. over het financieren van het niet verhogen van het eigen risico uit het Zorgverzekeringsfonds
Has the Minister grant a 2018 subsidy to the health insurance fund and the Zorginstituut compensate insurers for not raising the own risk.
This amendment provides that health insurers need not (further) raise premiums in connection with not raising the own risk, because they receive a compensation for loss from the Zorginstituut.

Dit amendement regelt dat de zorgverzekeraars de premie niet (extra) hoeven te verhogen in verband met het niet verhogen van het eigen risico omdat zij hiervoor een nadeelscompensatie ontvangen van het Zorginstituut.
Amendement van het lid Marijnissen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 6 over het verlagen van het eigen risico met € 100 voor het jaar 2018
Lowers the statutory deductible by 100 euro for 2018, funded by an extra federal grant to the health insurance fund instead of premiums.
Through an extra national government contribution of 1 billion to the health insurance fund, this reduction need not be reflected in the premium.
Via een extra Rijksbijdrage aan het Zorgverzekeringsfonds van 1 miljard, hoeft deze verlaging niet verdisconteerd te worden in de premie.
Amendement van het lid Marijnissen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 9 over het verlagen van het eigen risico met € 100 voor het jaar 2018
Amendment lowering the statutory own-risk deductible in health insurance by 100 euro for 2018, financed by an extra state contribution to the health insurance fund.
Via an extra state contribution to the health insurance fund of 1 billion, this reduction need not be priced into the premium.
Via een extra Rijksbijdrage aan het Zorgverzekeringsfonds van 1 miljard, hoeft deze verlaging niet verdisconteerd te worden in de premie.
Amendement van het lid Marijnissen over het verlagen van het eigen risico met € 100 voor het jaar 2018
Lowers the 2018 health insurance deductible by 100 euro, funded by an extra state contribution to the health insurance fund.
Through an extra state contribution to the health insurance fund of 1 billion, this reduction need not be reflected in the premium.
Via een extra Rijksbijdrage aan het Zorgverzekeringsfonds van 1 miljard, hoeft deze verlaging niet verdisconteerd te worden in de premie.
gewijzigd amendement van het lid Ellemeet c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 5 over het financieren van het niet verhogen van het eigen risico uit het Zorgverzekeringsfonds
Makes the health minister grant the health insurance fund a funding contribution for 2018 to offset not raising the mandatory deductible.
Our Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport grants the Health Insurance Fund a contribution for calendar year 2018
Onze Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport verleent over het kalenderjaar 2018 aan het Zorgverzekeringsfonds
Amendement van het lid Marijnissen waarmee alleen de verlenging van de tijdelijke wet wordt gehandhaafd
Removes the bill's changes to the extension of the temporary ambulance care law, including new profession terms and the limit to medically necessary care.
The submitter aims with this amendment to undo all changes in the extension of the Temporary Ambulance Care Act.
De indiener beoogt met dit amendement om alle wijzigingen in de verlenging van de Tijdelijke wet ambulancezorg ongedaan te maken.
Amendement van het lid Marijnissen over het schrappen van de uitzonderingen op het verbod op gunstbetoon
Amends the medical gift-giving ban to remove all exceptions, making any gifts to medical professionals from industry prohibited.
This amendment provides that the exceptions to the ban on gift-giving are removed from the legislative amendment.
Dit amendement regelt dat de uitzonderingen op het verbod op gunstbetoon uit de wetswijziging worden gehaald.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Temmink over de lobby-activiteiten van oud-bewindspersonen bij de IND

MPs Marijnissen and Temmink asked about IND lobbying meetings with former ministers Verdonk and Teeven on Indonesian nurse visas, whether procedures changed, the ministry's whistleblower cases, ministers' agenda transparency, and a lobby register. The government answered that the IND's decision was based on rules and not affected by the meetings, that no procedures were changed, and that agenda publication will be improved while a lobby register is deferred pending research.
The cabinet recognises the importance of transparent representation of interests.
Het kabinet onderkent het belang van transparante belangenvertegenwoordiging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Temmink over ‘de financiering van politieke partijen’

Opposition MPs Marijnissen and Temmink asked the Interior Minister about political party donations from BVs, whose ultimate beneficial owners were not disclosed, and whether the EUR 100,000 donation cap and transparency rules are being circumvented. The minister answered that beneficial-owner registration applies only from 2024, that the cap is checked via accountant certification and fines, and that the rules are normative and left to parties to apply, while promising to enforce registration from 2024.

Because the obligation to also record the address details of the ultimate beneficial owner(s) for a donation from a legal entity only applies from subsidy year 2024, those details did not yet have to be provided or made public in subsidy year 2023.

Omdat de verplichting om bij een bijdrage van een rechtspersoon ook de adresgegevens van de uiteindelijk belanghebbende(n) te registreren pas van toepassing is vanaf het subsidiejaar 2024 – zie het antwoord op vraag 1 – hoefden die gegevens in het subsidiejaar 2023 nog niet te worden verstrekt noch openbaar te worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Marijnissen over de staking bij VDL Nedcar

MPs Van Kent and Marijnissen asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the strike at VDL Nedcar, the government's response to the planned end of the BMW contract, and the dates and content of contacts between ministers and VDL management and between ministries. The minister acknowledged the job losses and the union dispute, but repeatedly declined to disclose the contents, dates or preparatory documents of the contacts, citing business confidentiality and an ongoing process.
For this reason the cabinet is generally reluctant to provide specific information about this.
Om die reden is het kabinet over het algemeen terughoudend met het geven van specifieke informatie hierover.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Marijnissen over het onderzoek van SOMO ‘Pharma’s Pandemic Profits’

An MP asks the health minister about a SOMO study showing pharmaceutical firms earned about $90 billion from COVID-19 vaccines despite heavy public funding, and whether government should cap prices, require transparency and claw back profits. The minister acknowledges the concerns, cites existing responsible-licensing principles and ongoing contract reviews, but declines to disclose specific prices due to confidentiality and commits only to continued engagement and new policy rather than binding new obligations.
In general, the contracts signed by the European Commission include a confidentiality clause for all parties involved, including representatives of the 27 member states.

In algemene zin geldt dat de contracten die getekend worden door de Europese Commissie voorzien in een geheimhoudingsverklaring voor alle betrokken partijen, inclusief de vertegenwoordigers van de 27 lidstaten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de aangekondigde stakingen bij de ziekenhuizen en het feit dat KPMG aangeeft dat ziekenhuizen in de rode cijfers komen als ze akkoord gaan met de cao-eisen van d

SP MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about planned hospital strikes, a KPMG finding that hospitals would run losses if they accepted union wage demands, and related pay, premium and pharma-profit questions. The minister answered that a new collective agreement had been reached, that the annual overheid bijdrage (ova) is the government's contribution to wage development, that hospitals must negotiate compensation with insurers, and that a study on care-sector pay will be sent to parliament in the autumn.
In the autumn I will inform your House of the outcomes.
In het najaar zal ik uw Kamer over de uitkomsten informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Marijnissen Grinwis, Palland, Kathmann, Teunissen, Pouw-Verweij, Stoffer, Van der Plas, Van Haga en Den Haan over duizenden gezinnen die al jarenlang leven van een inkomen onder h

MPs asked the government how couples on social assistance and single-earner households with disability benefits can end up with less net income plus allowances than a benefit couple, and what will be done after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling. The minister answered in detail, acknowledging the undesirable outcome and roughly 10,000 affected households, but offered no finished fix, only options under study and no compensation decision yet.
We want to do everything we can to find a solution to this.
We willen er alles aan doen om hier een oplossing voor te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de aanwezigheid van de Nederlandse kabinetsdelegatie op het World Economic Forum in Davos

An SP MP asked why the Dutch cabinet delegation attended the 2023 World Economic Forum in Davos, its costs, its agenda, and its views on inequality and taxation of the wealthy. The government answered that the forum is a useful platform for exchanging ideas, gave a cost table per minister, referred to programmes and livestreams, and stated that the forum involves no political decision-making.
Some sessions had a confidential character. For that reason the WEF does not share the content and participant list.
Enkele sessies hadden een vertrouwelijk karakter. Het WEF deelt de inhoud en deelnemerslijst om die reden niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Leijten over mensen die afgesloten worden van energie en het beleid om dit te voorkomen

MPs Marijnissen and Leijten asked the Minister for Climate and Energy how many households have been disconnected from gas or electricity despite the government's pledge of no winter disconnections, and what measures prevent it. The minister said data do not show total disconnections for wanbetaling, announced a tightened disconnection regulation with mandatory payment-arrangement offers until 1 April 2023, and said the ACM and dispute bodies supervise compliance.
Grid operators only have insight into the numbers of end-of-supply signals they receive from suppliers and the number of disconnections carried out by grid operators.
Netbeheerders hebben alleen inzicht in de aantallen «einde leveringssignalen» die zij vanuit leveranciers ontvangen en de aantallen afsluitingen (door netbeheerders).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Leijten over de zorgen van Netbeheerder Nederland over het rampscenario van 1 miljoen huishoudens de worden afgesloten omdat ze hun energierekening niet meer kunnen betalen

SP MPs Marijnissen and Leijten asked the Minister for Climate and Energy whether he agrees that the worst case is one million households being disconnected for unpaid energy bills, what will prevent this, and whether the climate fund can relieve energy costs. The minister answered that the cabinet is pursuing income-support measures and tightened disconnection protections, that the energy-price measures are separate from the climate fund, and that saving energy and tackling price rises are complementary.
This tightening means the supplier must make every effort to contact the customer and offer the customer an appropriate payment arrangement.
Deze verruiming houdt in dat de leverancier zich tot het uiterste moet inspannen om met de klant in contact te komen en de klant een passende betalingsregeling moet bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Marijnissen over de prijscap op energie

MPs Omtzigt and Marijnissen asked the government about the planned energy price cap, its costs, who it covers, safeguards against excess profits by energy companies, and related consultations. Minister Jetten answered that a price cap from 1 January 2023 is planned with volume limits and maximum tariffs, costs are not yet exact and will be funded partly from energy tax cuts, and the government intends to bar disconnections this winter, while many answers refer to a separate letter and some consultation details are not shared.
Given the short deadline for answering, for further explanation of this answer I refer briefly to my letter of 20 September 2022.
Gegeven de korte termijn die is gesteld voor beantwoording, verwijs ik voor verdere uitleg van dit antwoord kortheidshalve naar mijn brief van 20 september 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Leijten over het gestrande onafhankelijk onderzoek naar uithuisplaatsingen van kinderen door schuldenproblematiek en/of het toeslagenschandaal

MPs Marijnissen and Leijten asked why an independent study into child removals linked to debt problems and the childcare benefits scandal stalled, and whether the minister had intervened. The minister replied that he had no involvement, that the judiciary chose not to co-operate with Groningen because cases are still pending, that an Inspectorate study and a planned independent commission are under way, and that he sees no reason for another study now.
In addition, at the request of your House I am working on establishing an independent investigation committee.
Daarnaast werk ik op verzoek van uw Kamer aan de instelling van een onafhankelijke onderzoekscommissie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Marijnissen over kinderen die uit huis geplaatst zijn, het toeslagenschandaal en de schadevergoeding die zij krijgen uitgekeerd, terwijl ze nog uit huis geplaatst zijn

MPs Omtzigt and Marijnissen asked the government about children placed out of home in the childcare benefits scandal, compensation payments to those children, who controls the money, and whether expert analyses and rights protections are available. The minister answered that a support team has worked with 202 parents and 429 children, that a child compensation scheme exists with parents or guardians controlling minors' money under the civil code, and that contra-analyses and family-analysis instruments face waiting lists and are being piloted.
The investigation by the Inspectorate of Justice and Security and the independent inquiry committee should provide more insight into this.
Het onderzoek van de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid en van de onafhankelijke onderzoekscommissie moet hier meer inzicht in bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Leijten over ‘de rol van de premier in de Uber-files’

MPs Marijnissen and Leijten asked the Prime Minister about his and his advisers' contacts with Uber, Neelie Kroes's informal role, her appointment as StartupDelta envoy and the Uber Files revelations. The Prime Minister answered that he knew of Kroes's advisory role since 2016, described his meetings with Uber executives as functional business contacts, declined to comment on the Dutch prosecution and tax matters, and referred several questions to the European Commission, the Tax Authority and other ministries.
I have been aware of Ms Kroes's role as a member of Uber's advisory council since her appointment in May 2016.
Ik ben sinds haar aanstelling in mei 2016 op de hoogte van de rol van mevrouw Kroes als lid van de adviesraad van Uber.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over het bericht dat het ziekenhuis in Sneek een operatiekamer sluit vanwege personeelstekort

An MP asked the Health Minister about the temporary closure of one of four operating theatres at Antonius Ziekenhuis in Sneek due to staff shortages, its effect on patients, and whether understaffing reflects wider problems tied to pay and working conditions. The Minister answered that the closure is temporary, that non-urgent operations were postponed, that a reopening is expected after August, and that workplace autonomy and career prospects are the key levers, with the government pointing to its existing funding and a forthcoming labour-market programme.
The Antonius Ziekenhuis has informed me that it expects there to be enough care staff again after this month to staff all operating theatres.
Het Antonius Ziekenhuis heeft mij laten weten dat het de verwachting is dat er na deze maand weer voldoende zorgmedewerkers zijn om alle operatiekamers te bemensen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de schrijnende situatie van EU-arbeidsmigranten

MP Marijnissen asks the government about the dire situation of EU labour migrants exploited by temp agencies and landlords, citing a newspaper series, and asks about enforcement, housing standards, EU free movement and inspectorate criticism. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to pending bills on temp agency certification and Goed Verhuurderschap, a plan for vulnerable EU citizens, and says data on overcrowding are not available.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Alkaya over ongelijkheid en herverdeling via het belastingstelsel

MPs Marijnissen and Alkaya asked the Finance Minister about inequality and redistribution through the tax system, citing a CPB study showing top incomes pay relatively low tax rates and questioning the shift from direct to indirect taxes. The government answered that the tax system does reduce inequality, that the top 1% face a lower burden due to capital income treatment, that it will consider measures before Prinsjesdag, and that it stands by its planned tax measures on capital income.
In the run-up to Budget Day the cabinet will look at how the balance between burdens on wealth and on labour can be brought more into balance.
Het kabinet zal in aanloop naar Prinsjesdag kijken naar de wijze waarop de verhouding tussen lasten op vermogen en arbeid meer in balans kan worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de uitspraken tijdens de ministerraad over het toeslagenschandaal
