The SP's Marijnissen asked the Prime Minister about his statement that settling the childcare benefits scandal would take years, and about delays in appeals, Commissie Werkelijke Schade processing, Belastingdienst deadlines, and the placement of 1115 children out of home. Staatssecretaris De Vries answered that restoration will take several years, outlined the backlog measures (anonymisation capacity, mediation pilot, BAC single-member hearings) and the Ondersteuningsteam, but gave no firm deadline and did not commit to a fixed completion date.

In addition, the Bezwaarschriftenadviescommissie (BAC) has started single-member hearings (by one member) instead of three members, in cases suited to this, so that more members are freed up to handle other cases.

Daarnaast is de Bezwaarschriftenadviescommissie (BAC) gestart met het enkelvoudig horen (door één lid) in plaats van drie leden, in zaken die zich daarvoor lenen, om zodoende meer leden vrij te maken om andere zaken te behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Alkaya over het nieuwsbericht ‘Kabinet polst Kamer over afschaffen dividendbelasting na besluit Shell’

Two SP MPs asked whether the cabinet sought parliamentary support for abolishing the dividend tax after Shell's announced departure, and about the costs, jobs and the verhuurderheffing. The government replied that it informed some parliamentary groups informally, that abolition costs about EUR 2 billion a year and is not currently on the agenda, that it cannot disclose Shell's tax position under tax secrecy, and that it cannot judge the verhuurderheffing as a caretaker cabinet.
No insight can be given into the tax position of a specific company because of the statutory tax secrecy obligation.
Er kan geen inzicht worden gegeven in de belastingpositie van een specifiek bedrijf vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Leijten over de gang van zaken met de nieuwe functies van de voormalig bewindspersonen Van Veldhoven en Van Nieuwenhuizen

Two SP MPs asked the Prime Minister why the departure of former state secretary Van Veldhoven and minister Van Nieuwenhuizen was delayed after their new jobs became known, and why integrity and lobbying rules were not applied earlier. The government answered that the timing followed the dismissal process, that the handbook is not binding, that Van Nieuwenhuizen's ministerial role was adjusted and her appointment was reconsidered before she left, and that the minister is responsible for some answers.
As I also said in the debate of 8 September 2021, I would prefer ministers to stay on until a new cabinet takes office, but it remains a personal consideration.
Zoals ik ook in het debat van 8 september 2021 heb gezegd, zie ik liever dat bewindspersonen aanblijven tot het aantreden van een nieuw kabinet, maar het blijft een persoonlijke afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink over het bericht ‘Grijs goud: Europese ouderenzorg is goudmijn voor internationale investeerders’

MPs Marijnissen and Hijink asked the Minister of Health about reports that commercial and private-equity investors are profiting from elderly care, including profit extraction, tiered access, and care-cost shifting. The minister answered that profit-distribution rules do not cover extramural home-care packages, that a Wibz bill may add conditions on profit distribution, and that diversity of providers is acceptable, while leaving open possible tightening of public conditions and declining to state a preferred policy given the caretaker cabinet.
I have no information on the level of these specific results.
Over de hoogte van deze specifieke resultaten heb ik geen informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Leijten over de benoeming van nieuwe bewindslieden

Two SP MPs asked the Prime Minister about the caretaker cabinet's appointment of new ministers and state secretaries, including whether caretaker status is applied consistently, dual roles of MPs who are also ministers, the timing of announcement and swearing-in, and the severance entitlements of such appointees. The Prime Minister answered that caretaker restraint is applied consistently, that the Constitution's exception allows MPs to serve as ministers during caretaker periods, that MPs-ministers follow agreed limits on parliamentary activity, and that severance rules apply, with some appointees offering to waive their MP allowance.
The Constitution (Article 57, second paragraph) provides, among other things, that a member of the States General cannot also be a Minister or State Secretary.
In de Grondwet (artikel 57, tweede lid) staat onder meer dat een lid van de Staten-Generaal niet tevens Minister of Staatssecretaris kan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de aanschaf van beademingsapparatuur die niet bruikbaar is op de intensive care

Two SP MPs asked whether part of the first 100 ventilators from Philips, and planned Demcon machines, are unsuitable for ICU use, and asked about expert advice, serial numbers, distribution lists and disposables. The minister answered only by referring to a COVID-19 update letter, providing no substance on the questions themselves.

The written questions from MPs Hijink and Marijnissen (both SP) to the ministers of Medical Care and Economic Affairs and Climate about the purchase of ventilation equipment unusable in intensive care (2020Z06022) have been answered by way of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen (beiden SP) aan de ministers voor Medische Zorg en van Economische Zaken en Klimaat over de aanschaf van beademingsapparatuur die niet bruikbaar is op de intensive care ( 2020Z06022 ) zijn beantwoordwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de blunder van de verkenner waardoor het vertrouwen in de verkenning voor een nieuw kabinet is beschadigd

The SP asks the Prime Minister about a leaked internal note by outgoing informateur Ollongren referring to a 'position elsewhere' for MP Omtzigt during formation talks, and about trust damage. The government answers that formation is the Tweede Kamer's responsibility, not the cabinet's, and that it lacks specific information on the process.
There is no ministerial responsibility for the formation process.
Er is geen ministeriële verantwoordelijkheid voor het formatieproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink over de onderzoeken naar de werking van mondmaskers

MPs Marijnissen and Hijink asked the Minister for Medical Care about the scientific basis for claims that face masks could create false security, and about whether RIVM guidance discouraged medical mask use in care settings. The minister referred to earlier answers, said RIVM guidance is evidence-based, denied that its statements covered medical masks in care, and noted that a procurement route via ROAZ existed.
RIVM does not speak in its guidance of reluctance to use medical face masks in care.
Het RIVM spreekt in de uitgangspunten niet over terughoudendheid in het gebruik van medische mondmaskers in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de onderzoeken naar de werking van mondmaskers

Two SP MPs asked the minister to explain the basis of RIVM's claims that medical face masks could create false security, given that the RIVM said no scientific study showed this and later cited preprints. The minister answered that the remarks concerned FFP2 masks used in care, were based on expert opinion and WHO/ECDC consensus, and that the earlier reference to studies was an error, but did not provide the studies requested.
Unfortunately, confusion has arisen about Mr Van Dissel's statements on the use of face masks during the technical briefing of 22 April 2020 and the possible occurrence of false security.

Er is helaas onduidelijkheid ontstaan over de uitspraken van de heer Van Dissel over het gebruik van mondneusmaskers tijdens de technische briefing op 22 april 2020 en het mogelijk optreden van schijnveiligheid daarbij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de besprekingen op het Catshuis.

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether a memo from three ministers on economic effects of lockdown scenarios was discussed at an informal Catshuis meeting, and why the Chamber cannot receive it despite earlier motions. The government answered that Catshuis meetings are informal, non-decisional consultations and that disclosure would harm confidential deliberation, while promising ongoing general information to the Chamber.
Disclosure of any documents would undermine the confidentiality necessary for free exchange of views in which this consultation between those present takes place.
Openbaarmaking van eventuele documenten doet afbreuk aan de bescherming van de voor de vrije gedachtewisseling noodzakelijke vertrouwelijkheid waarin dit overleg tussen de aanwezigen plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de richtlijnen van het RIVM die tot onveiligheid in de ouderenzorg leidden

MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked the Minister of Health whether RIVM guidelines and the shortage of protective equipment contributed to infections and deaths in elderly care, and whether employers and inspectorates were adequately responsible. The minister answered that responsibility lies with employers and that inspectorates applied RIVM norms as a temporary starting point, while denying a conclusive link between the guidelines and harm.
Employers are responsible for a safe working environment and for good and continuous care to patients and clients.
Werkgevers zijn verantwoordelijk voor een veilige werkomgeving en voor goede en continue zorg aan patiënten en cliënten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Alkaya over het bericht  dat honderden Nederlandse economen meer investeringen aanraden in sociale gelijkheid en verduurzaming

MPs Marijnissen and Alkaya asked whether the government shares economists' call for more investment in social equality and sustainability, whether debt can safely rise, whether Groeifonds should prioritise jobs, and whether austerity is off the table. The ministers answered that existing support, investment acceleration and the Nationaal Groeifonds already address these goals, that debt must stay manageable, and that no choice is made between corporate tax and social security, while offering no new proposal.
The cabinet will submit a recovery plan for the RRF to the Commission in spring 2021.
Het kabinet zal in het voorjaar van 2021 een herstelplan voor de RRF bij de Commissie indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink over het bericht ‘VWS hielp met taaleis Duits lab van de testmarkt te weren’

Two SP MPs asked the health minister why extra conditions, including a Dutch-language requirement for an arts-microbioloog, were imposed on a German lab seeking to test for COVID-19, despite RIVM approval, and whether this breached EU law and why the lab's capacity was not used sooner. The minister replied that the conditions derive from quality-of-care law, that two German labs now offer testing with Dutch partners, that the conditions were not meant to exclude providers, and that the government will consult on reorganising the test landscape.
I want to emphasise that these requirements were not intended to keep parties out of the market, and it did not turn out that way.
Ik wil benadrukken dat deze eisen niet bedoeld was om partijen te weren van de markt, en het heeft zo ook niet uitgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over het bericht 'Lucratief beleggen in ouderen met dementie'

Two SP MPs asked the health minister how to respond to a report on investors profiting from dementia care, including promised 7% returns on care property, private nursing home growth, sale-and-lease-back structures, foreign takeovers, inspection report publication and concentration oversight. The minister answered each question, saying he cannot judge the returns, that care leaders must buy property at market rates, that he is preparing the Wibz bill allowing profit-distribution conditions, that the IGJ oversees quality, and that he sees no need for nationality-based rules.

However, I am working on the bill on integrity of care provider business operations (Wibz), in which I want to introduce the possibility of attaching additional conditions to profit distribution in sectors where there is currently no ban on profit distribution.

Ik werk echter aan het wetsvoorstel integere bedrijfsvoering zorgaanbieders (Wibz) waarin ik de mogelijkheid wil introduceren aanvullende voorwaarden te stellen aan winstuitkering voor sectoren waar nu geen verbod op winstuitkering geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Van Gerven over de financiële belangen van testlabs van medisch-microbiologen

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister whether testing capacity in the large labs was underused in early 2020, whether financial interests of medical-microbiology labs drove testing choices, and whether the OMT was steered toward them. The Minister denied that financial interests shaped advice, attributed the early restrictive testing policy to material shortages and validation constraints, and declined to comment on OMT steering because he has no seat on it.
I do not sit on the OMT and can therefore make no statements about steering within the OMT.
Ik heb geen zitting in het OMT en ik kan dan ook geen uitspraken over sturing binnen het OMT doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de werking van de Overheidsbijdrage in de Arbeidskostenontwikkeling (OVA)

Two SP MPs asked the health minister how the Overheidsbijdrage in de Arbeidskostenontwikkeling (OVA) was set up, how it is determined and reported, and what a lower OVA in 2021 due to the COVID-19 recession would mean for care wages. The minister answered that the OVA is governed by the 1999 OVA-convenant and set from CPB forecasts, that deviating requires representative employer agreement, and that the Chamber is not routinely informed to avoid a floor in collective bargaining.
That is why the OVA-convenant agrees to avoid publicity about the OVA.
Daarom is in het OVA-convenant afgesproken om publiciteit over de OVA te mijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de verspreiding van het coronavirus in verpleeghuizen

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about COVID-19 spread in nursing homes, including full ward isolation, staff protective equipment, return of residents from hospital, testing capacity and the delayed answers. The minister answered all questions, describing cohort isolation, PPE supply via the LCH, revised testing policy and procedures for returning residents, while stating that he would respond separately after a late answer.
I now answer the questions posed on 30 March 2020 after all.
Ik geef alsnog antwoord op de op 30 maart 2020 gestelde vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de situatie in de verpleeghuizen

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about the COVID-19 situation in nursing homes, including infection and death figures, scenarios, protective equipment, testing, inspection reports and a weekly update. The Minister gave detailed figures (about 8,400 confirmed infections and 2,800 deaths by 6 July), described visitor rules, a knowledge coalition and research efforts, said the LCH can meet demand for protective equipment, reported about 90 inspectorate reports, and agreed to answer in future weekly updates.
Will you answer these written questions instead of including the answers generally in your weekly update on developments of the coronavirus?
Vraag 9 Wilt u deze schriftelijke vragen beantwoorden in plaats van de antwoorden algemeen mee te nemen in uw wekelijkse update over de ontwikkelingen van het coronavirus?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over blijvende signalen van tekorten aan persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen voor zorgverleners

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about persistent shortages of personal protective equipment for care workers, including outside hospitals, and why PPE is not provided preventively. The minister reported 71 million items distributed, said PPE use is risk-based with professional discretion added from 1 May, and that preventive provision is not desirable because it could create scarcity.
Generally deploying personal protective equipment preventively is not desirable because it could in turn create scarcity.
Algemeen preventief inzetten van persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen is niet wenselijk omdat daardoor juist weer schaarste kan ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de productie van persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen in Nederland

MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked the Minister about domestic production of personal protective equipment, including which producers exist, certification capacity for masks in the Netherlands, and whether small firms are treated equally to large ones in procurement via the LCH. The Minister answered that no full registry exists, listed selected contracts and certifying bodies, said the government will not set up its own notified body, and that firms bear the risk of failed certification.
A general overview of all manufacturers of protective equipment in the Netherlands cannot be given, because this is not registered.
Een algemeen overzicht van alle fabrikanten van beschermingsmiddelen in Nederland is niet te geven, omdat dit niet wordt geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de aankoop van vijf miljoen afgekeurde mondkapjes

Two SP MPs asked the Minister why around five million government-purchased face masks were rejected as unfit for care, what their type, financial impact and recovery prospects are, and what happens to them. The Minister said the LCH procurement consortium checks quality at three stages, withholds payment on rejected goods and has no recall insurance, and that the risk to the ministry cannot yet be quantified and rejected masks are being checked for other uses.
The LCH generally pays part of the purchase price in advance, but for part of the purchases no financial obligation was entered into in advance.
Het LCH betaalt, in de regel, vooraf een gedeelte van de koopsom aan, maar voor een deel van de aankopen is vooraf geen financiële verplichting aangegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over het invoeren van een draagplicht voor niet-functionele mondmaskers in het openbaar vervoer

MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked how a mandatory face-covering rule in public transport would be enforced, and questioned why non-medical masks need no CE marking or minimum quality standards and why masks are not provided free of charge. Minister Bruins answered that enforcement runs through existing transport supervisors without checking mask type, that NEN is drafting recommendations for non-medical masks, and that people are responsible for buying their own masks, with VAT lowered to 0%.
People themselves are responsible for purchasing a face mask.
Mensen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het aanschaffen van een mondkapje.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de handelwijze van Facilicom/Axxicom in de thuiszorg

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health why Facilicom/Axxicom urged thuiszorg staff to take holiday days, whether staff can be forced to take leave, and why home-care workers lack protective equipment and testing. The minister replied that employers may request but not force leave, that protective equipment and testing are available in specified cases, and that the employer bears the risk of reduced work.
However, an employee is not obliged to do so.
Een werknemer is hiertoe echter niet verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Jasper van Dijk over het onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat verhoging van het minimumloon weinig banen kost

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about a CPB update finding that raising the minimum wage costs fewer jobs than previously thought, and whether the government would reconsider its opposition to a substantial minimum wage increase. The ministers welcomed the study, said the job losses are smaller but still substantial when the benefit link is kept, and saw no reason to change their position or raise the minimum wage now.
At this moment I see no reason to revise the response to the initiative note and raise the minimum wage.
Op dit moment zie ik geen aanleiding om de reactie op de initiatiefnota te herzien en het WML te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de briefing inzake het testbeleid en de persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen

MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked the health and medical care ministers about the procurement of personal protective equipment, the shortage claims, and the reasons no additional suppliers were added during COVID-19. Minister Van Rijn answered that the LCH buys from over fifty suppliers, that RIVM guidelines are risk-based rather than shortage-based, and that the LCH is working to expand procurement and transport, but gave no precise delivery dates.
I have instructed the LCH to procure as much protective equipment for healthcare as possible.
Ik heb het LCH opdracht gegeven om maximaal beschermingsmiddelen voor de zorg in te kopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Alkaya over mogelijke bezuinigingen

Two SP MPs asked the Finance Minister whether spending cuts would follow the coronavirus crisis, how large they would be, and whether they would hit public services, social schemes or businesses. The minister answered that cuts are not on the table during the crisis, that nothing can be excluded given uncertainty, and that the government will keep assessing fiscal sustainability.
It is still too early to assess how large the effect on public finances will be, and what is needed to reach sound public finances in the longer term.
Het is nog te vroeg om te kunnen beoordelen hoe groot het effect op de overheidsfinanciën zal zijn, en wat nodig is om te komen tot gezonde overheidsfinanciën op langere termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Van Gerven over het rapport over de financialisering van big pharma (nieuwe versie)

Two SP MPs asked the minister for Medical Care about an SOMO report on the financialisation of big pharma, including shareholder payouts, debt-financed buybacks, the role of public money in COVID-19 vaccine development, and access conditions. The minister answered that transparency on R&D costs and pricing is important, that the government negotiates hard on prices and will remain transparent on public vaccine investments, and that it will insist on broad access, but did not accept the characterisation of the business model as unacceptable or unsustainable.
I will remain transparent about the Dutch government's investment strategy and within European cooperation.
Ik zal transparant blijven over de investeringsstrategie van de Nederlandse overheid en in Europees samenwerkingsverband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink over zelftesten voor corona

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about unreliable and unlawfully marketed COVID-19 self-test kits, including imports from China, and asked what the government will do about enforcement, monitoring by the IGJ, sanctions and customs checks. The Minister's reply is a referral to a letter on the COVID-19 situation, meaning the questions were answered by reference to another document rather than on substance.
The written questions from MPs Marijnissen and Hijink (both SP) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (2020Z07032) have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink (beiden SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ( 2020Z07032 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over het beleid voor testen en beschermingsmiddelen bij mensen die werken in de huishoudelijke verzorging

SP MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked the Minister of Health whether RIVM guidelines provide testing for home care workers, whether they should be tested and protected with personal protective equipment, and why the guidance on contact with coughing patients was loosened. The Minister referred the answers to the COVID-19 update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 315) rather than answering each question in this document.
The written questions from MPs Hijink and Marijnissen (SP) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (2020Z07555) have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen (SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ( 2020Z07555 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de tekorten aan beschermende middelen bij zorginstellingen

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister twelve questions about shortages of protective equipment at care institutions, including bureaucracy and delays at the national procurement consortium LCH, untested supplies, and rejected offers. The minister's reply is a cross-reference: the questions were answered in a broader COVID-19 status letter rather than individually.
The written questions from MPs Hijink and Marijnissen (both SP) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport have been answered by way of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen (beiden SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over de berichtgeving dat het sterftecijfer door het coronavirus hoger is dan eerder gemeld

SP MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked why Dutch COVID-19 death figures may be about twice the officially reported number, whether CBS and RIVM should combine data, whether suspected cases are recorded, and whether testing of elderly care residents will be expanded. Minister De Jonge acknowledged the deaths are higher than RIVM figures, which only count confirmed cases, referred to earlier answers for the data questions, and said the government will strengthen protection of the vulnerable and point to its testing policy letter.
The total number is larger than the RIVM figures that RIVM publishes; we also explain this when publishing those figures.
Het totaal aantal is groter dan de RIVM cijfers die het RIVM publiceert, dat leggen we ook uit bij de publicatie van die cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen over het bericht 'Onrust bij thuiszorg, wijkverpleging, gehandicaptenzorg en ouderen zorg bij gebrek aan bescherming en beperkt testen personeel'

SP MPs Hijink and Marijnissen asked the ministers, following press reports, about shortages of protective equipment and limited testing for staff in home care, district nursing, disability care and elderly care, including how the ministry's purchasing collective, alternative supplies, industry contributions, domestic production, expanded testing and a passed motion would be handled. The answer is a referral: the questions were answered in the broader COVID-19 update letter to parliament rather than individually.

The written questions from members Hijink and Marijnissen (both SP) to the Ministers for Medical Care and of Health, Welfare and Sport (2020Z06304) have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Hijink en Marijnissen (beiden SP) aan de Ministers voor Medische Zorg en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ( 2020Z06304 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink over de gevolgen van het coronavirus op bewoners en medewerkers van verpleeghuizen

SP MPs Marijnissen and Hijink asked the Minister of Health about COVID-19 infections among nursing home residents and staff, testing and mortality counting, visitor restrictions and their effects on residents, protective equipment, and related staffing and visiting policy. The answer refers the MPs to the government's COVID-19 status update letter (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 200) instead of answering each question directly.
The written questions from MPs Marijnissen and Hijink (both SP) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (2020Z05791) have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 – Status update'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Hijink (beiden SP) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ( 2020Z05791 ), zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen, Beckerman en Alkaya over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis op huishoudens

Three SP MPs asked the government how it monitors the economic effects of the coronavirus on households, and whether utilities, landlords, mortgage lenders, the Waarborgfonds and the NHG should suspend evictions, disconnections and payments. The minister answered that utilities will not disconnect for arrears, evictions are postponed during the crisis by agreement with landlords, existing income and rent support measures are pointed to, and emergency support for homeless people is being arranged with municipalities.
Landlords have agreed as a common line that evictions will be postponed for the time being during the crisis period, unless there are evident reasons such as criminal activity or extreme nuisance.

Er is met de verhuurders als gezamenlijke lijn afgesproken dat huisuitzettingen voorlopig worden uitgesteld gedurende de crisisperiode, tenzij er evidente redenen zijn, zoals criminele activiteiten of extreme overlast.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink, Van Gerven en Marijnissen over het opkopen van een Duits bedrijf dat aan een coronavaccin werkt door de Amerikaanse president Trump om een vaccin uitsluitend voor Amerikanen te ver

MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care how she would respond to reports that President Trump sought to buy a German COVID-19 vaccine developer for exclusive US access, and how to ensure affordable, universal access to any Dutch-funded vaccine or therapy, including whether to block private sale, suspend patents and set price limits. The minister replied that CureVac denied any such offer, that the medical need should guide access, that the existing patent law and compulsory licensing options are sufficient for now, and that she supports international price negotiations and will oppose excessive prices.
It is also not my intention in this crisis to develop a vaccine publicly and, if successful, to have distribution to the world population handled by a public organisation.

Het is ook in deze crisis niet mijn voornemen om publiekelijk een vaccin te ontwikkelen en bij een eventueel succes de distributie vanuit een publieke organisatie naar de wereldbevolking te verzorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Karabulut over een bezoek aan het noorden van Marokko

MPs Marijnissen and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about political prisoners from the Hirak movement in northern Morocco, trials, torture allegations, detention conditions, development aid and migration. The minister said the Netherlands monitored trials, had raised concerns, and would not verify torture claims independently, and that it lacks data on many detainees and cannot take a position on the broader questions asked.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not keep track of how many detainees in Morocco are serving sentences for their participation in the Hirak movement, as they are not persons with Dutch nationality.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken houdt niet bij hoeveel gedetineerden in Marokko een straf uitzitten naar aanleiding van hun deelname aan de Hirak-beweging, daar het geen personen met de Nederlandse nationaliteit betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Futselaar over het bericht dat er een studentenstop is aan de verpleegkunde opleidingen

MPs Marijnissen and Futselaar asked about a reported student admission stop for nursing programmes amid a severe nurse shortage, the adequacy of internship places, use of trainees to fill staff gaps, and demands from nurses' organisations. Minister De Jonge answered that growth in places is managed regionally, that no hard data exist on students stopping for lack of internships, that the Stagefonds and regional action plans are being used, and that a planned action day was supported.
According to the Landelijk Overleg Opleiding Verpleegkunde, there is no hard data on students who had to stop their studies due to a shortage of internship places.
Volgens het Landelijk Overleg Opleiding Verpleegkunde zijn er geen harde gegevens over studenten die hun studie hebben moeten stoppen vanwege een tekort aan stageplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de misstanden bij Thebe

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about serious misconduct and understaffing at care organisation Thebe, raised via a staff 'Zwartboek', and asked whether the inspectorate and board should act. The minister answered that the board is responsible for safe care, that Thebe is discussing staffing with unions, that the inspectorate found generally positive care quality and sees no reason to intervene, and that he sees no grounds for further action.
I see no reason in the inspectorate's conduct to make statements about the inspectorate's competence.
Ik zie in het handelen van de inspectie geen aanleiding om uitspraken te doen over de bekwaamheid van de inspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over opnieuw honderden ontslagen in de zorg

An SP MP asked the health minister whether it is acceptable that care workers at Zorgspectrum Het Zand are being dismissed despite staff shortages, and asked for investigation of the causes and intervention with social partners. The minister declined to judge the organisation's specific decision, citing financial difficulties, and pointed to the Arbeidsmarktagenda 2023 commitments to job security and a EUR 347 million support package.
It is not for me to judge the specific circumstances of the case and the choice made by the organisation concerned.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over de specifieke omstandigheden van het geval en de keuze die daarin door de betreffende organisatie wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over fraude bij zorgaanbieder Job Lanceer

The MP Marijnissen asked the state secretary about serious care failures and suspected pgb fraud at care provider Job Lanceer, and why the Inspectorate kept approving care and did not coordinate with other bodies. The minister calls the reports serious, says the municipality of Tiel has moved clients to other providers, explains the Inspectorate's supervision history and cooperation arrangements, and sees no reason for further measures.
In view of the above answers, I currently see no reason to take measures.
Gelet op bovenstaande antwoorden zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding tot het nemen van maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over alarmerende berichten dat mensen met een beperking ’s nachts enkel in de gaten gehouden worden door camera’s

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about reports that people with disabilities are monitored only by cameras at night, questioning the safety, IGZ oversight, staffing norms, dignity and whether camera monitoring is a restrictive measure. The minister answered that camera monitoring can complement care if conditions are met, that the IGZ checks restrictive measures and proportionality, but that no binding staffing norm or new national rules are planned.
I therefore see no reason to take measures to replace camera monitoring with care workers.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om maatregelen te treffen om de inzet van cameratoezicht te vervangen door zorgverleners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over het vervolgonderzoek naar Alliade

An MP asks the Minister of Health about the status and delay of the supplementary inspection into Alliade's misuse of care funds, and about the Leijten motion on care institutions placing property in separate subsidiaries. The minister replies that the report is delayed to around the turn of the year due to new information being verified, that Alliade is not obstructing the inquiry, and that the subsidiary study has been conducted with findings feeding into the policy response.
Because the investigation is still ongoing, I can only inform you that the supplementary investigation is taking longer than expected
Omdat het onderzoek nog loopt kan ik u daarover alleen laten weten dat het aanvullende onderzoek langer duurt dan verwacht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over het bericht dat bendes het gemak ontdekt hebben van fraude met persoonsgebonden budget (pgb)

An SP MP asked the minister about press reports that criminal gangs exploit the personal budget (pgb) for care fraud, the scale of the fraud, and what is being done to reduce it, including the NZa recommendations. The minister acknowledges the problem, gives fraud figures as a lower bound, lists existing and planned measures such as the Wtza bill, a planned legal study on data sharing and a fraud warning register, and says he will inform parliament on the pending report.
I will inform your House of the results of this study.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over het aanpakken van teveelverdieners in de zorg

An SP MP asks the new Minister for Medical Care how she will credibly tackle top earners in healthcare, pointing to the minister's own earnings from UWV and NPO that exceed the Wet normering topinkomens limit. The minister replies that the premise is a misunderstanding because UWV complies with the Act, which applies to everyone, and that the CIBG supervises suspected violations in healthcare.
Where there is a (suspected) violation of the Wet normering topinkomens in healthcare, the CIBG acts as the independent supervisor.
Daar waar sprake is van een (vermoeden van een) overtreding van de Wet normering topinkomens in de zorg treedt het CIBG op als onafhankelijk toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de toegang tot de Wet langdurige zorg (Wlz)

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about waiting lists and access to the Wlz long-term care act for young adults with intellectual disabilities and psychiatric problems, including the CIZ's evidentiary requirement of onset before age 18 and the exclusion of psychiatric grounds from the Wlz. The State Secretary answers that the CIZ assesses each case individually, that other domains (Wmo, Zvw, Jeugdwet) can provide care, and that the question of opening the Wlz to psychiatric disorders is left to the incoming cabinet.
The CIZ weighs each application for access to the Wlz individually, uses various documents and applies a nationally applicable assessment framework.
Het CIZ weegt elke aanvraag voor toegang tot de Wlz individueel, maakt daarbij gebruik van verschillende documenten en hanteert een landelijk geldend afwegingskader.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Marijnissen over het bericht dat ziekenhuisfusie tussen het AMC en VUmc niet in het belang is van patiënten

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about the NZa's warning that the AMC-VUmc merger harms patients (higher prices, lower quality, 'too big to fail') and whether oversight by ACM, NZa and IGJ is adequate. The minister replied that fusion oversight is legally split between NZa and ACM, that the ACM cleared the merger on competition grounds, and that she wanted stronger fusion rules via a bill which the Tweede Kamer declared controversial.
I find it highly undesirable if mergers lead to such market power that the price of care rises and/or quality and accessibility decline.
Ik vind het zeer onwenselijk als fusies leiden tot een zodanige mate van marktmacht dat daardoor de prijs van zorg stijgt en of de kwaliteit en toegankelijkheid dalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over het bericht dat er te weinig verpleging is voor mensen die thuis willen sterven

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that patients wanting to die at home cannot get district nursing, and that hospitals and hospices had to keep patients or admit them, including a budget-cap issue raised by Buurtzorg's director. The State Secretary said he regrets the problems, pointed to available funding and the NZa's oversight of insurers' duty of care, and cited workforce measures and training expansion, without committing to a specific new measure.
Following the reports, the NZa is contacting RTL Nieuws, V&VN and Buurtzorg to investigate this signal further.
Naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving neemt de NZa contact op met RTL-nieuws, V&VN en Buurtzorg om dit signaal verder te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Marijnissen over de ontslagen bij ziekenhuis Medisch Spectrum Twente (MST) Enschede

MPs Kooiman and Marijnissen asked the Minister of Health about MST Enschede's cost-cutting plan of 30 million euros, which eliminates about 155 jobs, its effects on patient safety, regional referrals, and executive salaries and bonuses. The Minister answered that MST cites rising care demand, new building costs and the need to fund a new EPD, that the IGZ monitors risks, and that executive pay falls under the WNT and supervisory board responsibility, declining to intervene.
That is not my responsibility as Minister.
Dat is niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid als Minister.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de het bericht dat medisch specialisten definitief buiten de Wet Normering Topinkomens vallen

An SP MP asks why medical specialists are exempt from the Dutch top-salary cap (WNT), why their pay is not public, and whether excessive salaries and severance should be curbed. The minister answers that the exemption is a deliberate policy to make employment attractive, that the WNT cannot practically cap specialists' pay, and that the cabinet does not intend to change the WNT on this point.
The government deliberately chose to exclude medical specialists from the scope of the WNT.
De regering heeft er nadrukkelijk voor gekozen om medisch specialisten buiten het toepassingsbereik van de WNT te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de misstanden en de winsten in de zorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a young man who took legal action over poor care from Woonzorgnet, Woonzorgnet's profits and executive pay, whistleblower signals of abuse, and the profit ban in care. The State Secretary said the situation is undesirable, pointed to supervisory roles of the IGZ, internal supervisors, purchasers and the WNT, explained the profit-ban rules and noted one enforcement case currently under legal review.
I find that an undesirable situation. Complaints must be open for discussion and resolved as well as possible in consultation between the care provider and the client (representatives).
Ik vind dat een onwenselijke situatie. Klachten moeten bespreekbaar zijn en zo goed mogelijk in overleg tussen zorgaanbieder en cliënt(vertegenwoordigers) worden opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de problemen bij Haagse Wijk- en Woonzorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about worker protests and planned dismissals at Haagse Wijk- en Woonzorg, including the board's refusal to engage, the former board chair's severance pay, and whether the health and labour inspectorates would investigate. The State Secretary said the situation is being handled through the Arbeidsmarktagenda and mediation with FNV, that the IGZ sees no reason to intervene for now but will monitor, and that the labour inspectorate is not involved.
The Labour Inspectorate indicates it is not involved and therefore has no findings on this matter.
De Inspectie SZW geeft aan niet betrokken te zijn en heeft hierover derhalve geen bevindingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over au pairs in de zorg

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about Dutch care providers using Eastern European 'au pairs' (live-in care workers) for home care, including whether the Inspectorate monitors such providers, whether this complies with the working time and collective agreement rules, and whether these constructions should be banned. The State Secretary replies that the Inspectorate applies risk-based supervision and will visit if signals warrant it, that 24-hour on-call presence is permitted under the Working Time Act with rest rules, that he cannot judge collective agreement compliance, and that language skills and fair competition must be safeguarded without announcing a ban.
I do not have figures on the number of Eastern European 'au pairs', where 'au pair' in this case means a live-in Eastern European care worker.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over het aantal Oost-Europese «au pairs», waarbij onder «au pair» in dit geval wordt verstaan een inwonende Oost-Europese zorgverlener.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Marijnissen over de impact van de Groningse versterkingsopgave voor de zorg

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Economic Affairs how the Groningen earthquake reinforcement operation affects care institutions, including guarantees of support, who bears costs, resident relocation and compensation, and whether gas extraction should be reduced further. The government answered that a joint programme with the NCG, care providers, insurers and local authorities is being prepared, that NAM pays for safety reinforcement while costs of future-proofing fall to care providers and insurers, and that the production ceiling is reduced by 10% from October 2017 with a broader gas phase-out to be considered in transition paths.
Further details on the implementation of the reinforcement operation will follow once the steering group has completed the programme.
Verdere details over de uitvoering van de versterkingsopgave volgen als de stuurgroep het programma gereed heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Marijnissen over het bericht dat door invoering van eigen bijdrage ggz de dwangopnames zijn verdubbeld en crisisopnamen zijn toegenomen

MPs Kooiman and Marijnissen asked whether the 2012 co-payment for mental health care, which a study linked to doubled involuntary admissions and more crisis care and a net cost increase, was sensible, and what the government would do about care avoidance and unequal effects by income. Minister Schippers acknowledged the findings, said the co-payment was abolished in 2013, stressed the Wvggz bill and ambulantisation as responses, and pointed to municipal compensation measures without committing to new research.
The co-payment in secondary mental health care was abolished in 2013, so I do not consider it necessary to conduct further research into it.
De eigen bijdrage in de tweedelijns ggz is in 2013 afgeschaft, waardoor ik het niet nodig acht daar verder onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de misstanden bij zorginstelling Careyn

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Health about serious problems at care provider Careyn, covering care quality, working conditions, finances, the board's pay and the IGZ's earlier blacklisting, and whether the government intervened. The State Secretary answers that the board is responsible, that the NZa sees no short-term continuity threat, that the IGZ's judgment on quality is awaited in October, and that the IGZ issued an order and several measures were taken.
On the quality of care at Careyn, I am awaiting the IGZ's judgment, which will come with its findings in October.
Over de kwaliteit van zorg bij Careyn wacht ik het oordeel van de IGZ af die in oktober met haar bevindingen komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Marijnissen over het bericht dat melkgeitenhouders in opmars zijn

Two SP MPs asked the government about reports that goat dairy farms are expanding despite Q-fever concerns, whether expansion raises infection risk, what advice local health services gave on a specific expansion, and whether compensation for Q-fever victims will be reconsidered. The government answered that existing measures such as vaccination and milk-tank monitoring keep the risk low, that permitting is a municipal responsibility, that it does not track expansion locations, and deferred the compensation question to a separate cabinet response.
The Brabant Due Diligence Score is not public until the expansion permit is granted.
De Brabantse Zorgvuldigheidsscore is niet openbaar tot toekenning van de vergunning tot uitbreiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de misstanden bij de Thomashuizen

MP Marijnissen asks the State Secretary about reported poor care, neglect, abuse and misuse of personal budget (pgb) funds at Thomashuizen, and about the franchise model used by De Drie Notenboomen. The State Secretary answers that the inspectorate has ordered investigations, a sexual abuse report has gone to the Public Prosecution Service, two franchisees were replaced, and an action plan and inspectorate review are forthcoming, while placing primary responsibility for quality on the operators and the umbrella organisation.
Following the signals, the inspectorate, in line with standard procedure, instructed De Drie Notenboomen and these Thomashuizen to investigate the signals further and report back to the inspectorate.

Naar aanleiding van de signalen heeft de inspectie, in lijn met de standaard werkwijze, de Drie Notenboomen en deze Thomashuizen de opdracht gegeven om nader onderzoek te doen naar de signalen en hierover te rapporteren aan de inspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Kooiman over het bericht dat een zorgbestuurder de Wet Normering Topinkomens middels een riante vertrekpremie omzeilt

MPs Marijnissen and Kooiman asked the health minister whether a hospital board member's EUR 75,000 departure payment circumvents the Dutch top-income cap (WNT) and whether the law will be amended. The minister replied that the WNT caps severance at one year's salary up to EUR 75,000, does not regulate when such payments may be contracted, so the payment is not in breach, and the cabinet does not intend to amend the WNT on severance.
The WNT does not prescribe in which cases a severance payment may be included in the employment contract.
De WNT schrijft niet voor in welke gevallen een beëindigingsvergoeding in het arbeidscontract mag worden opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de gedwongen verhuizing van ouderen bij zorginstelling Aafje

An MP asked the State Secretary whether it is acceptable that Aafje forces 35 very elderly residents at Boekenrode to move, after it stops 24-hour care and a restaurant there, and what will be done to prevent this. The State Secretary answered that residents were consulted, 25 chose to move and 4 stay, that care entitlements remain, and that the IGZ has issued an instruction to Aafje, with no national registry of such closures kept.
No national list is kept of nursing home locations that close or receive another purpose, whether or not with care.
Er wordt geen landelijke lijst bijgehouden van locaties van verzorgingshuizen die sluiten of een andere bestemming krijgen, al dan niet met zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Kooiman over de decentralisatie van de Kindertelefoon, AKJ en Sensoor

MPs Marijnissen and Kooiman asked the state secretary about the VNG's decision to stop centrally financing the Kindertelefoon, AKJ and Sensoor, and how continuity and bureaucracy concerns square with earlier motions and commitments. The state secretary answered that the government will take over responsibility for these services from 2018 via a fund deduction from the municipal fund and legislation, citing insufficient guarantees and the burden of the existing arrangement.
I will regulate this by law as soon as possible.
Ik zal dit zo snel als mogelijk wettelijk regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de constructie van De Wit thuiszorgorganisatie

MPs Marijnissen and Van Kent asked about thuiszorgorganisatie De Wit employing 'zorg-au pairs' from Eastern Europe under Wlz care, inspection history, language requirements, pay and oversight. The state secretary answered that the inspectorate issued an aanwijzing after repeated non-compliance, that foreign care workers are allowed if qualified, that a WTZi reform bill is in preparation, and that topfunctionaris pay is not publicly disclosed because the organisation lacks a WTZi licence.
It is up to the institution itself whether and how it wants to be transparent about the pay of its top officials.
Het is aan de instelling zelf of en hoe zij transparant wil zijn over bezoldigingen van haar topfunctionarissen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over problemen met hygiëne in een ggz-instelling

An SP MP asked the Minister about hygiene problems at an addiction clinic reported by patients who felt unheard by management and the Inspectorate, and whether the Inspectorate has capacity to oversee hygiene. The State Secretary said the institution is responsible, patients should use complaint procedures and the Landelijk Meldpunt Zorg, the Inspectorate has a specialist hygiene team, and it has ordered the board to report on hygiene and will discuss it soon.
The inspectorate has instructed the institution's board of directors to report on how the institution ensures good hygiene throughout the entire institution and how this is safeguarded.

De inspectie heeft de raad van bestuur van de instelling de opdracht gegeven te rapporteren op welke wijze de instelling zorg draagt voor goede hygiëne binnen de gehele instelling en de manier waarop dat wordt geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Karabulut over de intimidatie van proefpersonen bij medicijntesten in ontwikkelingslanden door farmaceutische bedrijven

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about alleged intimidation of clinical trial participants in Egypt by pharmaceutical company Roche and about oversight of drug testing in developing countries. The state secretary answered that responsibility lies primarily with sponsors, that the Roche matter concerns publication rather than trial conduct, and that EMA-coordinated GCP inspections and the GCP IWG address oversight, without committing to new action.
Ultimately it remains the responsibility of the sponsor, usually a drug manufacturer, to decide where it has its clinical research carried out.
Het blijft uiteindelijk de verantwoordelijkheid van de sponsor -veelal een fabrikant van geneesmiddelen- om te bepalen waar hij zijn (klinisch) onderzoek laat uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Kooiman over de tekorten aan ambulancepersoneel

Two SP MPs asked the government about shortages of ambulance staff, reliance on temporary agency workers, pay and workload, and whether market-based regulation of ambulance care is acceptable. The state secretary answered that an advisory study of ordering variants is underway, that staffing is the responsibility of providers and insurers supervised by the NZa and Inspectie, that AZN assured sufficient staff, and that pay is a matter for CAO negotiations; the government declined to address the desirability of market mechanisms given its caretaker status.
Because the cabinet is caretaker, I will not address questions on the desirability of market mechanisms in ambulance care.
Vanwege de demissionaire status van het kabinet zal ik niet ingaan op vragen over de wenselijkheid van marktwerking in de ambulancezorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Marijnissen over de geplande sluiting van Den Bongerd in Oss

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary whether the planned closure of Den Bongerd in Oss is justified given the lack of support from staff, parents and pupils, whether co-determination should have binding consent rights, and whether the closure fits the goal of appropriate education for every child. The state secretary answered that the closure is a deliberate decision to move Den Bongerd's expertise into regular schools, that staff and parents were involved through co-determination bodies, that no statutory consent right is planned, and that he sees no reason to meet the board to prevent the closure.
As I explained earlier in the letter to parliament on the progress of the pupil decline measures of 28 October 2016, I see no reason to align the consent right when closing a school.

Zoals ik eerder heb toegelicht in de Kamerbrief over de voortgang van de uitvoering van de maatregelen leerlingendaling van 28 oktober 2016, zie ik geen aanleiding voor het gelijktrekken van het instemmingsrecht bij sluiting van een school.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over het bericht dat Siemens eigenaar is geworden van de operatiekamers van het Admiraal de Ruyter Ziekenhuis in Goes

An SP MP asked the minister about Siemens becoming owner of the operating rooms at the financially troubled ADRZ hospital in Goes, and the risks of commercial ownership for quality of care, financing trends and the competition implications of the contract. The state secretary replied that hospitals are private entities responsible for their own operations, that the hospital remains ultimately responsible for care quality under the Inspectorate's supervision, that the arrangement is a financing alternative, and that competition assessment belongs to the ACM.
Hospitals are private institutions and themselves responsible for their business operations.
Ziekenhuizen zijn private instellingen en zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun bedrijfsvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over het toestemmingsvereiste voor de verwerking van ROM gegevens

MP Marijnissen asked the minister whether ROM mental health data shared with SBG without explicit patient consent is unlawful, and what the government will do, including deleting data, halting callcenters, and a repair law. The state secretary answered that data sharing can continue on the basis of consent, that providers must still try to deliver under contract, that a legislative exploration is underway, and that the Chamber will be informed after consultation with the Dutch data protection authority.
I do not possess that data, so that is not for me.
Ik ben niet in het bezit van die gegevens, dus dat is niet aan mij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de forse kritiek van de inspectie op de ZGT ziekenhuizen in Hengelo en Almelo

The SP MP Marijnissen asked the state secretary to react to the Inspectorate's critical year-talk report on ZGT hospitals in Hengelo and Almelo, including medication, emergency staffing and high mortality, and to commit to a plan restoring both hospitals to full service. The state secretary answered that the report is standard transparency, that the Inspectorate sees improvement points but no grounds for formal measures, and that it sees no link between the concentration of specialisms and quality problems, so no plan is announced.
It is the task of the IGZ to supervise healthcare institutions and, where necessary, to require improvement measures.
Het is de taak van de IGZ om toezicht te houden op zorginstellingen en waar nodig verbetermaatregelen te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over het bericht dat mensen met een beperking niet terecht kunnen in een zorginstelling

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health why young people with intellectual disabilities and severe behavioural problems cannot find care places, how care insurers' duty of care fits with waiting lists of up to 143 people, and whether the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) should have intervened earlier. The State Secretary called the situation undesirable, said care insurers are working on a contact and mediation action plan with results reported in May, acknowledged a rough estimate of about 500 hard-to-place youths without fully verifying it, and promised to inform parliament soon.
I will inform the House this spring about the results, as well as about the structural improvement measures.
Ik informeer uw Kamer nog dit voorjaar over de resultaten, evenals over de structurele verbetermaatregelen.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Hammelburg c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het verhogen van het ODA-budget
Raises spending on the three ODA policy articles by a total of 40 million euro through a cash shift funded by lowering the ODA buffers in 2027 and 2028.
Coverage is found in a cash shift between years by lowering the ODA buffer in 2027 by 20 million and lowering the ODA buffer in 2028 by 20 million.
Dekking wordt gevonden in een kasschuif tussen jaren door middel van het verlagen van de OS-buffer in 2027 met 20 miljoen en het verlagen van de OS-buffer in 2028 met 20 miljoen.
Amendement van het lid Hammelburg c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 7 over het verhogen van het ODA-budget met ongeveer 120 miljoen
Amendment raises the ODA budget by about 120 million euro through a cash shift between years, funded by lowering the ODA buffers in 2027 and 2028.
With this amendment the submitters aim to raise the ODA budget by about 120 million.
Met dit amendement beogen de indieners het ODA-budget met ongeveer 120 miljoen te verhogen.
Amendement van het lid Hammelburg c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 6 over het verhogen van het ODA-budget met ongeveer 120 miljoen
Increases the ODA development aid budget by about 120 million euros through a cash shift between years, funded by lowering the ODA buffers in 2027 and 2028.
With this amendment the submitters aim to increase the ODA budget by about 120 million
Met dit amendement beogen de indieners het ODA-budget met ongeveer 120 miljoen te verhogen
Motie van het lid Inge van Dijk c.s. over ook het uurbedrag van de vrijwilligersvergoeding indexeren met de tabelcorrectiefactor
Asks the government to index the hourly volunteer allowance with the table correction factor from 2024, funded by an offset from another amendment.
requests the government to also index the hourly amount with the table correction factor from 2024
verzoekt daarom de regering om vanaf 2024 ook het uurbedrag te indexeren met de tabelcorrectiefactor;
Gewijzigd amendement van het Inge van Dijk c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 82 over een regeling voor fiscaal bovenmatige pensioenregelingen

Amends the Wet op de loonbelasting so that a fiscal over-maximum pension rule does not apply to young workers in franchiseless schemes, time-limited to 1 January 2026, and asks the cabinet to inform the House about its application.
Submitters request the cabinet to inform the House in time about how this amendment is applied in practice
Indieners verzoeken het kabinet tijdig de Kamer te informeren over hoe dit amendement in de praktijk wordt toegepast
Motie van het lid Van Weyenberg c.s. over de invoering van een verbruiksbelasting op e-sigaretten
Asks the government to submit a bill introducing an excise duty on e-cigarettes before summer recess 2024, ahead of the EU excise directive revision.
requests the government, anticipating the revision of the European Excise Directive, to submit a bill before summer recess 2024
verzoekt de regering, vooruitlopend op de herziening van de Europese Accijnsrichtlijn, voor het zomerreces 2024 een wetsvoorstel in te dienen
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Paternotte c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 49 over het verhogen van de belasting op leidingwater en de BTW op sierteelt ter dekking van de 0%-rente op studieleningen
Funds a permanent 0% interest rate on student loans by abolishing the tap-water tax cap for large users and the reduced VAT rate on ornamental horticulture.
This proposal is financed through measures taken in the tax plan
Dit voorstel wordt gedekt via maatregelen die genomen worden in het belastingplan
Amendement van het lid Inge van Dijk c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 62 over een regeling voor fiscaal bovenmatige pensioenregelingen
Amendment adds a rule to the tax act on pension schemes so that young hairdressers' franchise-free pension plans are not treated as fiscally excessive.
With this amendment a regulation is made for this specific situation.
Met dit amendement wordt een regeling getroffen voor deze specifieke situatie.
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over ook in Caribisch Nederland een systematiek implementeren waardoor een wml-stijging niet fiscaal wordt afgeroomd
Asks the government to implement in the Caribbean Netherlands a system so that minimum wage increases are not taxed away, for example by linking the minimum wage to the tax-free allowance.
requests the government to also implement in the Caribbean Netherlands a system whereby a minimum wage increase is not fiscally clawed back
verzoekt de regering ook in Caribisch Nederland een systematiek te implementeren waardoor een wml-stijging niet fiscaal wordt afgeroomd
Amendement van de leden Grinwis en Van Weyenberg over regelen dat de belastingvrije som op de BES niet lager is dan het minimumloon
Amendment setting the tax-free allowance on the BES islands at no less than the minimum wage, with retroactive effect from 2023.
This amendment ensures that the tax-free allowance on the BES islands is no longer lower than the minimum wage.
Dit amendement regelt dat de belastingvrije som op de BES niet langer lager is dan het minimumloon.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Grinwis en Van Weyenberg ter vervanging van nr. 8 over regelen dat de belastingvrije som op de BES niet lager is dan het minimumloon
Amends the BES income tax law so the tax-free sum there is not lower than the minimum wage, with retroactive effect and a waiver for early 2024.
This amendment ensures that the tax-free sum in the BES is no longer lower than the minimum wage.
Dit amendement regelt dat de belastingvrije som op de BES niet langer lager is dan het minimumloon.
Amendement van het lid Van der Lee c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 7 over middelen voor een verhoging van het minimumloon en van de kinderopvangtoeslag
Budget amendment raising the minimum wage and the maximum hourly rate for childcare allowance, funded by a tax amendment.
This amendment has two aims: on the one hand raising the minimum wage and on the other raising the childcare allowance.
Dit amendement heeft twee doelen; enerzijds het verhogen van het minimumloon en anderzijds het verhogen van de kinderopvangtoeslag.
Amendement van het lid Paternotte c.s. over het verhogen van de belasting op leidingwater en de BTW op sierteelt ter dekking van de 0%-rente op studieleningen
Removes the 300 cubic metre cap on the water tax and the reduced VAT rate on ornamental horticulture to fund a 0% interest rate on student loans.
This amendment provides that the 300 cubic metre cap in the water tax expires from 2025.
Dit amendement regelt dat het heffingsplafond van 300 kubieke meter per 2025 vervalt in de belasting op leidingwater.
Amendement van de leden Van Weyenberg en Hammelburg over een verhoging van het tarief energiebelasting voor bedrijven en belastingvermindering voor huishoudens

Raises the energy tax rates for large gas consumers (fourth and fifth brackets) and uses the revenue to increase the household electricity connection tax reduction, with later annual adjustments to 2033.
The revenue from this rate increase is used to spare households in the energy tax.
De opbrengst van deze tariefsverhoging wordt ingezet om huishoudens te ontzien in de energiebelasting.
Amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. over het niet doorgaan van de afschaffing van de giftenaftrek in de vennootschapsbelasting voor giften onder de € 100.000
Amends the Belastingplan so the abolition of the corporate tax gift deduction for gifts under €100,000 does not proceed, funded by lowering the excessive-lending maximum from €700,000 to €500,000.
This amendment provides that the abolition of the corporate tax gift deduction for gifts under €100,000 does not go ahead.
Dit amendement regelt dat de afschaffing van de giftenaftrek in de vennootschapsbelasting voor giften onder de € 100.000 niet doorgaat.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het stapsgewijs afbouwen van de IACK en het uitstellen van de afschaffing tot 2027
Phases out the income-dependent combination tax credit (IACK) in steps from 2027 by lowering the amounts in article 8.14a, and abolishes it from 2035.
The second amount mentioned in article 8.14a, second paragraph, is reduced by €134.
Het in artikel 8.14a, tweede lid, als tweede vermelde bedrag wordt verlaagd met € 134.
Amendement van de leden Inge van Dijk en Van Weyenberg over een regeling voor fiscaal bovenmatige pensioenregelingen
Adds a tax-law exemption for young hairdressers' pension schemes without a franchise so they are not deemed fiscally excessive, a rule for private pension schemes.
With this amendment an arrangement is made for this specific situation.
Met dit amendement wordt een regeling getroffen voor deze specifieke situatie.
Amendement van het lid Inge van Dijk over het verlagen van vergoedingen inzake Wahv-zaken
Reduces the cost reimbursement for professional legal aid paid by third parties in appeals against traffic fines under the Wahv, limiting citizens' effective access to appeal.
Amendement van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over een regeling voor auto's die tussen de 15 en 25 jaar geleden in gebruik zijn genomen
Amends the youngtimer car benefit rules: raises the forfeit percentage and extends the valuation rule to cars 15 to 25 years old, with later changes in 2026 and 2030.
Amendement van het lid Hammelburg c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 4 over het verhogen van het ODA-budget met ongeveer 120 miljoen
Amendment shifting ODA spending up by about 120 million euros across three policy articles, funded by lowering the OS-buffer in 2027 and 2028, to offset the asylum cost overrun.
Coverage is found in a cash shift between years by lowering the OS buffer in 2027 by 60 million and in 2028 by 60 million.
Dekking wordt gevonden in een kasschuif tussen jaren door middel van het verlagen van de OS-buffer in 2027 met 60 miljoen en het verlagen van de OS-buffer in 2028 met 60 miljoen.
Amendement van het lid Van Weyenberg c.s. over middelen voor SER Diversiteit in Bedrijf
Adds €1 million to the labour market budget to fund SER Diversiteit in Bedrijf, offset from general subsidies.
The submitter therefore provides funding of €1 million by amendment
Daarom voorziet de indiener met amendement in financiering van € 1 miljoen
Amendement van het lid Van Weyenberg c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 20 over middelen voor de re-integratie van mensen met postinfectieuze aandoeningen
Amendment shifting two million euro within the Arbeidsmarkt budget to fund re-integration support for people with post-infectious illnesses.
Therefore the submitters reserve two million for promoting the re-integration of people with post-infectious illnesses.
Daarom reserveren indieners twee ton ter bevordering van de re-integratie van mensen met postinfectieuze aandoeningen.
Amendement van het lid Van Weyenberg over middelen voor de re-integratie van mensen met postinfectieuze aandoeningen
Shifts 2 million euros within the labour market budget from one subsidy line to fund reintegration support for people with post-infectious conditions.
Therefore D66 reserves two million for promoting the reintegration of people with post-infectious conditions.
Daarom reserveert D66 twee ton ter bevordering van de re-integratie van mensen met postinfectieuze aandoeningen.
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over overgaan tot de uitvoering van het beleid om verschraling van regionaal ov te voorkomen en prijsstijgingen tegen te gaan
Asks the government to proceed with policy to prevent cuts to regional public transport and fare rises before the budget law takes effect, invoking article 2.25 of the Comptabiliteitswet.
requests the government, invoking the second paragraph of article 2.25 of the Comptabiliteitswet, to proceed with implementing the policy
verzoekt de regering met een beroep op het tweede lid van artikel 2.25 van de Comptabiliteitswet over te gaan tot de uitvoering van het beleid
Motie van de leden Van Weyenberg en Grinwis over de Eurocommissaris van Klimaat aansporen om intensiever aandacht te besteden aan het uitfaseren van fossiele subsidies op Europees niveau
Asks the government to urge the new EU climate commissioner to prioritise phasing out fossil fuel subsidies at EU level.
requests the government to urge the new EU Climate Commissioner to give more attention to phasing out fossil fuel subsidies at EU level
verzoekt de regering om de nieuwe Eurocommissaris van Klimaat aan te sporen intensiever aandacht te besteden aan het uitfaseren van fossiele subsidies op Europees niveau
Amendement van het lid Van der Lee c.s. over middelen voor een verhoging van het minimumloon en van de kinderopvangtoeslag
Adds funding to raise the minimum wage and the childcare allowance maximum hourly rate, while noting parliament's limited budget power and inability to amend AMvB regulations.
With this the submitters want to improve purchasing power for low and middle incomes.
Daarmee willen de indieners de koopkracht verbeteren voor lage- en middeninkomens.
Amendement van het lid Van der Lee c.s. over verhoging van de tarieven van box 2 en 3 met twee procentpunt en een verhoging van de bankenbelasting met 150 miljoen euro
Raises box 2 top rate and box 3 rate by two points, raises the bank tax and abolishes the dividend-tax buyback facility to fund minimum wage and childcare measures.
Amendement van het lid Hammelburg c.s. over het verhogen van het ODA-budget met ongeveer 120 miljoen
Amends the 2024 budget to raise ODA spending by about 120 million euros through a cash shift from the OS-buffer, partly to offset asylum cost overruns.
With this amendment the submitters aim to raise the ODA budget by about 120 million.
Met dit amendement beogen de indieners het ODA-budget met ongeveer 120 miljoen te verhogen.
Amendement van de leden Van Weyenberg en Hammelburg over een substantiële verhoging van het tarief energiebelasting voor bedrijven en belastingvermindering voor huishoudens
Amendment raises energy tax rates for large gas users and increases the electricity connection tax reduction for households.
With this amendment it is arranged that large consumers contribute a fairer share for their gas use.
Met dit amendement wordt geregeld dat grootverbruikers een eerlijker steentje bij gaan dragen voor hun gasverbruik.
Motie van de leden Paulusma en Van Weyenberg over het actualiseren van Zorgkeuzes in Kaart en hierin de resultaten van de technische werkgroep macrobeheersing zorguitgaven meenemen
Motion asking the government to update Zorgkeuzes in Kaart and include results of a working group on macro-control of healthcare spending.
requests the government to update Zorgkeuzes in Kaart for these measures
verzoekt de regering om Zorgkeuzes in Kaart voor deze maatregelen te actualiseren
Motie van de leden Romke de Jong en Van Weyenberg over het onderzoeken van het vormgeven van een miljonairsbelasting in het licht van uitvoerbaarheid en fiscaal-juridische houdbaarheid
Asks the government to study how a wealth tax of 1% on box 3 assets above 1 million could be designed, in terms of feasibility and legal soundness.
requests the government to investigate how a millionaires' tax, for example a 1% wealth tax on box 3 assets above 1 million, could be designed
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken hoe een miljonairsbelasting, bijvoorbeeld door een vermogensbelasting van 1% op box 3-vermogen boven de 1 miljoen, vormgegeven kan worden
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 10 over een extra schijf voor gas in de energiebelasting
Amendment introducing a new first band in the energy tax for natural gas up to 1,200 cubic metres, with a lower rate, and adjusting the other bands and related rates.

vervalt in artikel 105, derde lid: krachtens een bestuursbesluit, waarbij ten minste één vierde van de bestuurders zich daarvoor heeft uitgesproken,

Amendement van de leden Van Weyenberg en Madlener ter vervanging van nr. 24 dat ertoe strekt het wetsvoorstel voor wat betreft het advies-en beroepsrecht van (een minderheid van) de deelnemers- en pen

Amendment gives the participants' and pensioners' council of a pension fund advisory rights over key decisions and a right of appeal to the Amsterdam Enterprise Chamber for a minority of that council.
can appeal to the Enterprise Chamber of the Amsterdam Court of Appeal against a decision
kan bij de ondernemingskamer van het gerechtshof te Amsterdam beroep instellen tegen een besluit
Amendement van het lid Van Weyenberg over onder andere een adviesrecht voor de deelnemers- en pensioengerechtigdenraad
Gives the participants and pensioners council an advisory right on many fund decisions and a right to appeal, in a pension bill.
To this end the participants and pensioners council should receive an advisory right over all important decisions.
Daartoe dient de deelnemers- en pensioengerechtigdenraad over alle belangrijke besluiten een adviesrecht te krijgen.

Amendement van het lid Van Weyenberg dat ertoe strekt het wetsvoorstel in overeenstemming te brengen met het onlangs tot wet verheven initiatiefwetsvoorstel van de leden Koşer Kaya en Blok (wet van 23
Amendment removes the cap on pensioner representatives' board seats in pension fund boards, aligning the bill with a recently enacted law.
In this law the cap on the number of seats for pensioners has been removed from legislation.
In deze wet is de maximering van het aantal zetels voor de pensioengerechtigden uit de wetgeving geschrapt.
Amendement van het lid Van Weyenberg over het voorhangen van de AMvB aangaande het quotum
Amends the bill so that the general administrative order setting a quota on work permits must be submitted to both Houses for four weeks before it is adopted.
The proposal for a general administrative order to be established under the first paragraph is not submitted until four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both Houses of the States General.

De voordracht voor een krachtens het eerste lid vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Amendement van het lid Van Weyenberg over het laten vervallen van het quotum t.a.v. tewerkstellingsvergunningen
Amendment deletes the power to impose sector-wide quotas on work permits for third-country workers, which could be set by general administrative order with limited parliamentary control.
A quota capping work permits per sector, possibly even at zero, is too drastic an instrument in this light.
Een quotum – waarbij het aantal tewerkstellingsvergunningen voor een sector wordt gemaximeerd, mogelijk zelfs op nul – is in dit licht een te ingrijpend instrument.
Amendement van de leden Heerma en Van Weyenberg over het uitzonderen van de ouderparticipatiecreche aan opleidingsvereisten
Exempts parent-run participation childcare centres from the training requirements in the Childcare Act, so parents need not meet them.
on the understanding that the parents do not have to meet training requirements
met dien verstande dat de ouders niet hoeven te voldoen aan opleidingseisen
Motie van de leden Van Weyenberg en Heerma over eisen aan ouderparticipatiecrèches
