Asks the government to make proposals ensuring that parent-participation daycare centres are not subject to requirements they cannot meet by their nature.
requests the government to make proposals to ensure no requirements are imposed on parent-participation daycare centres
verzoekt de regering, voorstellen te doen om te borgen dat aan ouderparticipatiecrèches geen eisen worden gesteld
Amendement van de leden Van Weyenberg en Pia Dijkstra over het flexibel inzetten van het bevallingsverlof
Lets mothers ask the employer to split the post-birth leave after day 42 and take the remainder flexibly over 30 weeks, with employer consent unless a serious business interest opposes it.
This amendment provides that the remaining days of maternity leave, after the 42nd day following the birth, can be used flexibly.
Dit amendement regelt dat de resterende dagen van het bevallingsverlof, na de 42e dag na de bevalling, flexibel kan worden ingezet.
Amendement van het lid Van Weyenberg over het wegnemen van de drempel voor werknemers die zich verkiesbaar willen stellen voor de ondernemingsraad
Removes the requirement for works council candidates to gather 30 signatures, letting individual employees stand for election without a union or signatures.
This amendment aims to remove a barrier for employees who wish to stand for election to the works council.
Dit amendement beoogt een drempel weg te nemen voor werknemers die zich verkiesbaar willen stellen voor de ondernemingsraad.
Motie van het lid Karabulut c.s. over inzichtelijk maken van de cumulatie van maatregelen
Asks the government to make the cumulative effect of its coalition-agreement measures visible for specific vulnerable groups such as pensioners, tenants, students and single parents on benefits.
requests the government to make the cumulation of measures transparent for specific groups in society
verzoekt de regering, de cumulatie van maatregelen inzichtelijk te maken voor specifieke groepen in de samenleving
Motie van de leden Heerma en Van Weyenberg over een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar extreme kooopkrachteffecten
Motion asks for an independent investigation into extreme purchasing-power effects of January 2013 measures and proposals to repair them.
to have an independent investigation carried out into extreme effects on purchasing power as of 1 January 2013
een onafhankelijk onderzoek te laten doen naar extreme effecten per 1 januari 2013 in de koopkracht
Motie van de leden Van Weyenberg en Omtzigt over een pensioenvergelijker
Asks the government to legislate for inflation-corrected pension communication by 2014 and to study a pension comparison tool with a quality label.
requests the government to come up with legislation by 1 January 2014 to correct pension communication
verzoekt de regering om, voor 1 januari 2014 met wetgeving te komen om de communicatie over pensioenaanspraken
Motie van de leden Van Weyenberg en Heerma over een sociale agenda
Asks the government to pursue extra jobs and ensure a social agenda does not reduce structural employment effects below those in the coalition agreement.
requests the government to pursue extra jobs
verzoekt de regering, in te zetten op extra banen
Motie van de leden Van Weyenberg en Krol over leeftijdsbewust personeelsbeleid
Asks the government to pursue ambitious age-conscious personnel policy in the social agreement and to break up age-based pay and leave arrangements in collective agreements.
requests the government to pursue ambitious agreements on age-conscious personnel policy
verzoekt de regering, daarbij in te zetten op ambitieuze afspraken over leeftijdsbewust personeelsbeleid
Motie van het lid Voortman c.s. over scholingsmogelijkheden voor flexwerkers
Asks the government to propose giving temporary (flex) workers the same access to training as permanent staff.
requests the government to come with proposals to give flexible workers the same access to training as permanent staff
verzoekt de regering, met voorstellen te komen om flexwerkers dezelfde toegang tot scholing te geven als medewerkers in vaste dienst
Motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over een redelijke beloningscode voor de pensioensector
Asks the government to negotiate with the pension sector on a reasonable remuneration code, also covering implementing organisations, and report to the House.
requests the government to consult the pension sector and persuade it to come up with a reasonable remuneration code
verzoekt de regering, in overleg te treden met de pensioensector en hen te bewegen om met een redelijke beloningscode te komen
Motie van de leden Van Weyenberg en Schouten over het garanderen van een minimaal aantal WSW-plekken
Motion asks the government to guarantee at least 30,000 sheltered employment (WSW) places when designing the Participation Act.
requests the government, when designing the Participation Act, to build in guarantees that at least 30,000 WSW places structurally remain
verzoekt de regering om, bij de vormgeving van de Participatiewet waarborgen in te bouwen dat er structureel minimaal 30 000 WSW-plekken overblijven
Motie van de leden Heerma en Van Weyenberg over monitoring van cumulatie-effecten
Asks the government to update monitoring of cumulative income and participation effects and inform parliament before the Voorjaarsnota.
to update this monitoring, with specific attention to middle incomes, and to inform the House about it before the Spring Memorandum
deze monitoring te actualiseren, met specifieke aandacht voor de middeninkomens en de Kamer hierover voor de Voorjaarsnota te informeren
Motie van het lid Van Weyenberg over wettelijk verplichte communicatie van pensioenfondsen
Asks the government to examine whether the AFM can adequately supervise legally required pension communication and whether norms from the Wft can apply.
to examine whether alignment with the correct and non-misleading norms from the Financial Supervision Act is possible for the legally required information elements
te onderzoeken of aansluiting bij de normen correct en niet-misleidend uit de Wet financieel toezicht mogelijk is voor de wettelijk verplichte informatie-elementen
Amendement van het lid Van Weyenberg over opnemen van de strekking van het wetsvoorstel van het lid Koser Kaya (Kamerstuk 31 045) in dit wetsvoorstel
Adds up to two weeks of additional adoption leave for employees in cases of intercountry adoption, with a matching benefit under the Wet arbeid en zorg.
If there is an intercountry adoption, the employee is entitled during the period referred to in the first sentence to additional leave of up to two weeks.
Indien sprake is van een interlandelijke adoptie heeft de werknemer gedurende het tijdvak, bedoeld in de eerste volzin, recht op aanvullend verlof van ten hoogste twee weken.
Motie van de leden van Weyenberg en Heerma over langdurige ziekte tijdens deel aan de startersregeling
Asks the government to ensure that participation in the starters scheme is paused during long-term illness so it does not use up the six-month limit, because UWV's discretion is not always used.
UWV therefore has a discretionary power not to let long-term illness count against the six-month term
het UWV derhalve een discretionaire bevoegdheid heeft om langdurige ziekte niet ten koste te laten gaan van de termijn van zes maanden
qa: Antwoord op de leden Inge van Dijk, Vedder en Welzijn over het bericht ‘Erfpacht oneerlijk, CDA-Raadslid wil ACM dwingen naar systeem te kijken’

MPs asked whether municipalities should inform residents better about erfpacht (leasehold) formulas, whether general erfpacht conditions favour municipalities, and whether the guidance should be binding and supervised by the AFM. The minister replied that the existing guidance is voluntary and sufficient, that the ACM rightly declined an enforcement request, that erfpacht is a private-law matter, and that the AFM is not the appropriate supervisor.

Intervening in the local trade-offs, the local autonomy and contractual freedom of municipalities (within the general principles of good governance) are very far-reaching measures and I see no need for them at this time.

Ingrijpen in de lokaal te maken afwegingen, de lokale autonomie en contractvrijheid van gemeenten (uiteraard binnen de algemene beginselen van behoorlijk bestuur) zijn zeer vergaande maatregelen en ik zie daar op dit moment niet de noodzaak toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oostenbruggen over het aantal toegenomen schijnzelfstandigen bij het Ministerie van Financiën

An MP asked the Finance and Social Affairs ministers about the rise in suspected false self-employed (schijnzelfstandigen) working at the Ministry of Finance and its services, after an Algemene Rekenkamer finding and a taskforce meant to reduce them. The government answered that about 1,000 potential false self-employed are hired via intermediaries, mainly at Toeslagen/UHT for the childcare benefits recovery operation, that the taskforce aims to phase them out by 1 January 2025, and that no central overview exists across other departments.
There is currently, however, no central overview of the specific numbers of potential false self-employed at the departments.
Er is momenteel echter geen centraal overzicht van specifiek de aantallen potentiële schijnzelfstandigen bij de departementen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Thijssen en Kröger over de toename van fossiele financieringen door banken

MPs Van der Lee, Thijssen and Kröger asked whether banks' rising fossil financing conflicts with Paris goals, how the climate commitment measures CO2 (relative versus absolute), and why finance does not invest more in Dutch sustainability. The government answered that the IEA sees no room for new oil and gas fields, that the climate commitment guidance will be revised to include absolute and sectoral targets, and that a review of further measures is underway, though it could not answer all questions in time.
The revised version of the guidance will be published after the summer.
De herziene versie van de leidraad wordt na de zomer gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Vedder over de uitzending van Radar van 1 april jl. en artikelen inzake speculatieve grondhandel

MPs Inge van Dijk and Vedder (CDA) asked ministers about speculative land trade in farmland shown on Radar, including misleading sales practices, the AFM and ACM supervisory roles, notary duties and the number of victims. The minister acknowledged the problem, cited a Kadaster study of about 7,000 owners and 2,000 hectares split into investment plots, and said a working group is examining options such as a splitting ban, AFM supervision and notary obligations, with results due in autumn.
You will be informed about this in the autumn.
Hierover zult u in het najaar worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Ceder over de noodzaak tot verplichte leeftijdscontrole bij BNPL-diensten

MPs Mohandis and Ceder asked the government about minors using Buy Now, Pay Later services, the lack of mandatory age verification, the effect of the revised Consumer Credit Directive, fees, and sanctions. The minister acknowledged the risks, reported that BNPL providers committed from 1 June to verify all users' age, and said the government is still working out how to make age verification legally mandatory and will report after the summer.
The cabinet is currently working out how age verification can be made mandatory.
Het kabinet werkt op dit moment uit hoe leeftijdscontrole verplicht gesteld kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht dat landen van de Europese Unie (EU) 33 miljoen euro per uur mislopen door de fiscale behandeling van superrijken

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister and State Secretary about reports that EU states lose 33 million euro per hour to the tax treatment of super-rich individuals, including wealth distribution, effective tax burdens, revenue losses and wealth registers. The government answered that it upholds that the strongest shoulders bear the heaviest burden, cited Dutch wealth concentration data, said tax avoidance cannot be precisely measured, and committed to exploring a stepwise EU/OECD approach and improved wealth statistics without committing to a wealth register.
It is therefore currently not possible to estimate how much tax revenue is missed due to a lower tax burden than intended, or to break down which combination of schemes causes this.

Het is daarom nu niet mogelijk een schatting te maken van hoeveel belastinginkomsten er gemist worden door een lagere belastingdruk dan is beoogd en een decompositie te maken door welke (combinatie van) regelingen dit veroorzaakt wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet for the current status of its 2030 targets, including halving road deaths. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management answers only the road-casualty sub-question: the target is likely too ambitious, the cabinet keeps existing measures and will examine an extra step, with results expected mid-2024.
For question 2, under e, you will receive a separate answer from me shortly.
Voor vraag 2, onder e, zult u op korte termijn een separaat antwoord van mij ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Tony van Dijck over het verlagen van de NHG-premie

MPs Madlener and Tony van Dijck asked whether the NHG mortgage guarantee premium should be lowered, whether NHG's guarantee capital is larger than needed, and whether NHG should use its capital for wider social goals. The minister answered that the premium must stay low but sufficient to protect the state as backstop, that a large fund remains necessary, that a revised premium methodology will be applied for 2025, and that NHG will study a broader role in sustainability while protecting its core purpose.
After this elaboration, I want to arrive at an improved premium methodology that can be applied when calculating the premium for 2025.
Na deze uitwerking wil ik komen tot een verbeterde provisiemethodiek die kan worden toegepast bij de berekening van de premie voor 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Kahraman de fraudezaak betreffende het Europees coronaherstelfonds

MPs Van Hijum and Kahraman asked about a suspected large-scale fraud case involving the EU Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF) in Italy, the number of fraud cases, EU and Dutch anti-fraud measures, and consequences for future payments. The minister answered that the investigation is ongoing, no consequences for Italian payments have been decided yet, and existing EU control systems and the Dutch audit framework are considered sufficiently robust, while noting the Commission's annual reports will provide further insight.
At this moment there are no consequences for future payments to Italy as a result of the suspected fraud case.
Op dit moment zijn er geen gevolgen voor toekomstige uitbetalingen aan Italië als gevolg van het vermoede fraudegeval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het nieuws dat werknemers op Schiphol worden blootgesteld aan kankerverwekkende stoffen

The SP MP Van Kent asked ministers about reports that Schiphol platform workers are exposed to carcinogenic aircraft engine emissions, and what measures, health monitoring and compensation exist. The minister answered that the Arbeidsinspectie's demands require Schiphol and employers to do more, cited phased measures such as APU limits and a green zone by 2027, said the Gezondheidsraad is reviewing classification of kerosene engine emissions, and declined to commit to immediate mandatory electrification or a site visit.
I have asked the Health Council to determine whether kerosene engine emissions as a whole should be classified as carcinogenic.
Ik heb de Gezondheidsraad gevraagd te bepalen of kerosinemotoremissie als geheel als kankerverwekkend moet worden geclassificeerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het onderzoek van de Groene Amsterdammer naar de illegale export van Nederlandse microchips naar Iran

An MP asked the government about a Groene Amsterdammer investigation into illegal export of Dutch microchips to Iran, including customs controls on Iranian trucks and parcels, company identity checks, export figures, and penalties. The minister replied that customs checks are risk-based, sanctions evasion is already punishable, the government will not raise maximum penalties now, and sanctions law modernisation will add administrative fines.
Sanctions evasion is unfortunately a well-known problem.
Sanctieomzeiling is helaas een bekend probleem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Hoe Ajax en PSV in zee gingen met dubieuze Aziatische gokbedrijven'

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked whether Ajax and PSV's sponsorship deals with Asian gambling firms were adequately vetted for money-laundering risks, and about the legal framework, supervision, the planned gambling sponsorship ban and Curaçao's gambling reform. The government answered that football clubs are not gatekeepers under the Wwft, that supervisors' investigations are confidential, that the sponsorship ban applies from 1 July 2025 with no acceleration, and that the Curaçao law is delayed but being monitored.
Whether supervisors are investigating particular cases or entities is supervisory-confidential information.
Of toezichthouders onderzoek doen naar bepaalde casussen of entiteiten is toezichtsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the election result, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government answered that such discussions took place only within existing regular meetings, that no separate meetings are planned, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
This is not possible; no overviews are kept of how many and which employees attended which meetings.
Dit is niet mogelijk, er worden geen overzichten bijgehouden van hoeveel en welke medewerkers er bij welke overleggen aanwezig zijn geweest
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het WEF en de belasting voor miljonairs en miljardairs

An SP MP asked the government whether it endorses the WEF participation and why taxpayers fund it, what the costs are, whether ministers account for outcomes, and what has been done about taxing millionaires and billionaires after motions on that topic. The minister replied that attendance offers networking and Dutch interests, listed accommodation costs of about 6,000 euros in total and that the government is transparent about its delegation, and referred to earlier studies (Bouwstenen 2020 and 2022, a 2023 letter and an IBO fiche on wealth tax) as the follow-up to the millionaire tax motions.
Besides six cabinet members, ten civil servants from the Netherlands travelled to Davos.
Naast zes kabinetsleden, zijn tien ambtenaren uit Nederland afgereisd naar Davos.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Kat en Van der Laan over influencers die jongeren in de armen van oplichters lokken

D66 MPs asked how young people can be protected from influencers who lure them into scams around match-fixing sports betting, including crypto flows, gambling-addiction protection, advertising oversight and cross-border enforcement. The minister answered that prevention campaigns, platform obligations and existing regulators (Ksa, ACM, AFM, Commissariaat voor de Media) cover the issue, and promised a campaign, a ministry review of labelling edited ads and a werkagenda by year-end.
As previously promised, the House will receive the work agenda by the end of this year, setting out ongoing and future activities on addiction prevention.
Zoals eerder toegezegd ontvangt de Kamer eind dit jaar de werkagenda waarin lopende en toekomstige activiteiten op het gebied van verslavingspreventie een plek krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat, Sneller en Van Weyenberg over het piramidespel van IM Academy en Finfluencers

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers of Justice, Finance and Economic Affairs about the IM Academy pyramid scheme, its recruitment of young people, and the regulation of finfluencers. The government said the supervisors (Ksa, ACM, AFM) are responsible, explained existing rules and enforcement tools, and said it sees no need for major new rules beyond pressing for stronger European investor protection.
The supervisory authorities are independent in their supervision and make no statements about ongoing or possible future investigations.
De toezichthouders zijn onafhankelijk in hun toezicht en doen geen mededelingen over lopende of eventueel te starten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Van Weyenberg over het verbod op FATCA-doorgiftes op basis van de General Data Protection Legislation (GDPR) in België

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Belgian data protection authority's ban on passing tax data of Belgian accidental Americans to the US under the GDPR, and whether the Dutch FATCA arrangement complies with the GDPR and what the Dutch privacy authority has assessed. The State Secretary answered that the Belgian ruling does not affect the bilateral and EU efforts, that the Dutch privacy authority's earlier advice found no GDPR-conflict and that pending individual procedures will be awaited rather than reopening the advice, and that the Belgian ruling has no direct consequences for Dutch data exchange.
I think it is important that the AP is given time to form its judgment and I do not want to interfere with ongoing procedures.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de AP de tijd krijgt voor oordeelsvorming en ik wil lopende procedures niet doorkruisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de registratie van fraudeurs door verzekeraars naar aanleiding van het bericht 'Nederlandse verzekeraars spelen voor aanklager en rechter tegelijk'

An MP asks the Finance and Interior ministers about insurers registering suspected fraudsters in a shared warning system without court review, including limits on listing duration, notification, objections, and age/occupation-based refusals. The ministers defend the PIFI protocol as approved by the Dutch data protection authority, describe objection and complaint routes, and say they see no need for new regulation on uninsurability or refusals.
So I do not share your view that fraudsters should only be placed on a list after a judge or another independent body has examined the evidence.
Ik deel dus niet met u dat fraudeurs pas op een lijst moeten kunnen komen nadat de rechter of een andere onafhankelijke instantie naar het bewijs heeft gekeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Van Weyenberg over het niet kunnen openen van een betaalrekening door kwetsbare mensen

MPs Kat and Van Weyenberg asked whether vulnerable people, including young victims of money mules, can open a payment account and why banks demand debt counselling or guardianship first. The Minister of Finance explains the Basic Bank Account Convenant and the EU directive, says the requirements are for banks to judge case by case, and promises to discuss improved communication and tailored treatment with banks.
Yes, I will discuss this with banks and will inform the House of Representatives about it.
Ja, ik zal hierover met banken in gesprek gaan en zal uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Romke de Jong over het bericht 'Financieel gepuzzel toch weer terug bij Belastingdienst door verstoringen'

MPs Van Weyenberg and Romke de Jong asked why the automatic income-distribution calculator between fiscal partners was removed from the 2022 tax return despite an earlier promise, and when it would return. The State Secretary explained it was disabled due to incorrect values, that the 2021 promise could not be met due to other priorities, and that it will return in the next campaign after fixing existing returns.
The Tax Administration aims to correct the return based on the optimal distribution, without requiring citizens to submit a new return.
De Belastingdienst streeft ernaar de aangifte te herstellen op basis van de optimale verdeling, zonder dat de burger gevraagd wordt om een nieuwe aangifte in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Boulakjar en Kat over het bericht 'BKR wil hypotheken registreren en gegevens delen met belwinkels en postorderbedrijven'

MPs from D66 asked the Finance Minister, on behalf of other ministers, about BKR's plan to register mortgages and share data with phone-shop and mail-order firms, including its legal basis, public oversight, proportionality and privacy. The minister answered that no positive mortgage registration is planned for now, that a bill will be consulted on in early 2023 to give credit registration a statutory basis and ministerial powers, and that the government is in talks with BKR.
In the bill, credit registration becomes a statutory task, with corresponding powers for the Minister of Finance.
In het wetsvoorstel wordt kredietregistratie een wettelijke taak, met overeenkomstige bevoegdheden voor de Minister van Financiën.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden vragen van de leden Sneller, Van Weyenberg en Romke de Jong over de aanbesteding van fotografieopdrachten

D66 MPs asked how the government's new framework contract for photography procurement affects photographers' administrative burden, costs, rates and market power, and whether the photographers were consulted. The government answered that a single agency will manage a pool of photographers with lower admin burdens for them, a hourly rate of 109 euros, a likely rise in costs for the state, and that the photographers were contacted in an earlier round.
The aim of this procurement is to contract a single agency that, in consultation with clients, selects a pool of photographers to carry out assignments under the framework agreement.
Het doel van deze aanbesteding is om één bureau te contracteren dat, in samenspraak met opdrachtgevers, een poule van fotografen selecteert om opdrachten binnen de raamovereenkomst uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bevriezen van tegoeden in Nederland van Russen op de sanctielijst

An MP asked the Finance Minister why far more Russian sanctioned assets are frozen in Belgium than in the Netherlands, how assets are categorised, who can freeze them, and what the government will do to speed up freezing. The minister replied that Dutch frozen assets total 640.8 million euro in the financial sector, that differences reflect specific circumstances in each state, that obliged entities must freeze and report, and that a broader reporting duty and a policy letter on strengthening the sanctions regime are being prepared.
Reports from Belgium indicate that this concerns 2.7 billion euro in frozen assets of persons or entities on sanctions lists.
Uit de berichtgeving uit België blijkt dat het om 2,7 miljard euro gaat aan bevroren tegoeden van personen of entiteiten op sanctielijsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Van Weyenberg over problemen bij het inschrijven van vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne in Nederland

MPs Podt and Van Weyenberg asked about problems registering Ukrainian refugees in the Netherlands, including slow municipal registration, identity documents, financial access, and bank accounts. The government answered that it is working with municipalities, banks and the Ukrainian embassy, describes temporary flexibilities and a planned Hryvnia exchange scheme, but gives little detail on definitive fixes.
It is good that we also gain insight into this group.
Het is goed dat we ook zicht krijgen op deze groep.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Weyenberg over het faillissement van RCCS, waardoor coffeeshophouders problemen ervaren om hun kasgelden te verwerken en hun reguliere bedrijfsvoering daardoor niet kunnen v

MPs Sneller and Van Weyenberg asked about the RCCS cash-transport bankruptcy and banks' de-risking of coffeeshops, which struggle to deposit and withdraw cash. The Minister of Finance answered that banks must apply risk-based customer due diligence under the Wwft, that a Convenant Contant Geld and case law set limits on refusing cash access, and that the sector is being consulted, while declining to change the Wwft guidance and giving only partial information on the RCCS takeover.
I encourage banks and coffeeshop operators to make mutual agreements on their cash needs and expect banks to take the court's considerations into account when making agreements.

Ik stimuleer dat banken en coffeeshophouders onderling afspraken maken over de contantgeldbehoeft en ga ervanuit dat banken bij het maken van afspraken rekening houden met de overwegingen van de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad over beleggingsverzekeringen

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Finance about a Supreme Court ruling on information duties for investment insurance policies (woekerpolissen), compensation adequacy, collective claims, insurers' activation duties, financial stability risks, implications for other financial products, and when sector rules will be revised. The minister answered that the case is still before the Court of Appeal, declined to judge the adequacy of compensation or what insurers should do, pointed to existing activation duties and ongoing review of cost transparency, and saw no direct financial-stability risk.
It is now up to the Court of Appeal in The Hague, the trial court, to assess whether such additional information duties exist and, if so, what they are.
Het is nu aan het Gerechtshof Den Haag, de feitenrechter, om te beoordelen of dergelijke aanvullende informatieverplichtingen bestaan, en zo ja, welke dat dan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over de Zembla uitzending over de uitstoot van giftige stoffen op Schiphol

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked the government about the Zembla broadcast on toxic emissions at Schiphol and the health risks for platform workers, including accountability, Arbowet compliance, and liability. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to sector-wide steps and ongoing Labour Inspectorate investigation, but largely placed responsibility on employers and stated that data on life expectancy and some emission assessments are unavailable or pending.

It is up to the employer and the client to ensure this. The Netherlands Labour Inspectorate started an investigation at the end of 2021 into compliance with working conditions legislation at Schiphol.

Het is aan de werkgever en de opdrachtgever om daar zorg voor te dragen. De Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie is eind 2021 onderzoek gestart naar de naleving van de arbeidsomstandighedenwet- en regelgeving op Schiphol.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Peter de Groot over de uitspraak 201908401/1/R1 van de Raad van State over het verstrekken van omgevingsvergunningen door de gemeente Zutphen aan IJsselwind bv en het waterschap

Two VVD MPs asked the government about the Council of State ruling that annulled the zoning plan and permits for the IJsselwind wind park and the consequences of the related Delfzijl Zuid ruling for general wind turbine rules, municipal and provincial powers, and RES planning. The minister answered that local authorities may set their own environmental norms pending a new plan-MER, that wind projects may be delayed but the 2030 target is expected to be met, and that regional dialogue will address legitimacy and cross-border effects.
The State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management has set in motion the process for carrying out a plan environmental impact assessment for the general environmental rules.
De Staatssecretaris van IenW heeft het proces om een plan-milieueffectrapportage uit te voeren voor de algemene milieuregels in gang gezet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens, Peter de Groot en Leijten over de invloed van de windlobby op de rapporten van het Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu (RIVM) over de gezondheidseffecten van windturbines

MPs Erkens, Peter de Groot and Leijten asked whether RIVM omitted the wind-lobby influence on its reports on health effects of wind turbines, and how independent future research can be ensured. The minister said the RIVM's authority is not in question, that funding source alone should not exclude studies, and that RIVM is exploring additional health research and a study on setback distances.
I do not think it is for me or the cabinet to respond to this discussion, which belongs in the scientific domain.
Ik vind het niet aan mij of het kabinet om te reageren op deze discussie, die in het wetenschappelijk domein thuishoort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Bromet over het bericht 'Treinverkeer in Nederland heeft last van slappe bodem'

MPs Bouchallikh and Bromet asked the government about rail track stability on soft peat soils and whether it can keep up with frequency and climate ambitions. The state secretary replied that ProRail is studying baanstabiliteit and climate adaptation, with results expected in 2022, but gave no commitment to new funding.
Maintenance of the railway is of great importance.
Het onderhoud van het spoor is van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over bedrijven die nauwelijks gecontroleerd worden op milieudelicten

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked whether companies are hardly inspected or fined for environmental offences, how often omgevingsdiensten should visit polluting firms, and about ammonia emissions by cacao factory Cargill Aurora in Zaandam that were not reported to the RIVM for 2010-2018. The State Secretary answered that inspection frequency is risk-based, that the Landelijke Handhavingsstrategie and the VTH reform are being used, that Cargill's unreported emissions were discovered in 2019 and are being addressed through a planned last onder dwangsom, and that the omission does not create new nitrogen effects.

I find this a worrying conclusion, and it was partly the reason for my predecessor to inform you, in the letter on strengthening the VTH system, about the actions planned to follow up the recommendations of the Van Aartsen committee.

Dit vind ik een zorgwekkende conclusie en het is voor mijn voorganger mede aanleiding geweest om u met de Kamerbrief versterking VTH-stelsel 5 te informeren over de acties die worden voorzien om de aanbevelingen van de commissie Van Aartsen op te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over ammoniakuitstoot van het bedrijf Aurora (onderdeel van Cargill) in Zaandam

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister whether a Cargill subsidiary's undisclosed ammonia emissions in Zaandam were a sign of gaps in emission reporting and enforcement, and what consequences and actions followed. The answers say the regional environmental service knew of the emissions, that a possible emission-norm breach for one sub-process is under a pending enforcement order, and that the reporting system relies on self-reporting with sampling checks plus a correction mechanism, with improvements planned.

As previously stated in the answer to question 5 from the D66 faction, the Noordzeekanaalgebied environmental service was aware of the ammonia emissions by Cargill Aurora and these are also permitted under certain conditions.

Zoals eerder bij het antwoord op vraag 5 van de D66-fractie aangeven was de omgevingsdienst Noordzeekanaalgebied op de hoogte van de uitstoot van ammoniak door Cargill Aurora en is deze ook toegestaan onder bepaalde voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over ammoniakuitstoot van het bedrijf Aurora (onderdeel van Cargill) in Zaandam

An MP asked how the cocoa industry's ammonia emissions are regulated, whether it is included in the structural nitrogen approach, and whether underestimated industrial ammonia emissions could explain the RIVM model correction. The state secretary answered that a 30 mg/Nm3 emission limit applies via the Activiteitenbesluit, that a tightening to 5 mg/Nm3 is expected in 2026 under the new BAL, and that industry's contribution is too small to explain the model correction.

The RIVM does not expect that industrial ammonia emissions are a possible underlying cause of the correction to the nitrogen calculation models related to the spatial calibration based on measurement data.

Het RIVM verwacht niet dat de industriële ammoniakuitstoot een mogelijke onderliggende oorzaak is van de correctie van de stikstofrekenmodellen in verband met de ruimtelijke kalibratie op basis van meetgegevens.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Peters, Lodders, Edgar Mulder, Van Weyenberg, Snels, Nijboer, Bruins, Van Raan, Azarkan, Van Haga, Van Otterloo, Leijten, Stoffer en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat de Bel

MPs from many parties asked whether the Tax Authority fails to apply the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) when offsetting benefit overpayments against current allowances, and whether this breaches the law. The State Secretary admits that offsets under the standard payment arrangement were made without applying the protected minimum, that this is a mistaken assumption, and promises a repayment operation and a solution, but declines to meet the requested three-week deadline.
I conclude that this approach, given the purpose and intent of the Wet vBVV, offers citizens insufficient protection.
Ik concludeer dat deze werkwijze, gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vBVV, onvoldoende bescherming aan burgers biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Van Weyenberg over het bericht 'Hoe juist werken tot armoede leidt: ‘Het probleem is dat toeslagen, loon en uitkering niet op elkaar zijn afgestemd’'

D66 MPs Kat and Van Weyenberg asked about a newspaper report that mismatched payment cycles (four-weekly wages versus monthly benefits and allowances) cause hardship, asking how common this is, how payroll and benefit rules work, and whether uniform payment rules or holiday-pay changes would help. The minister answers that the problem is recognised, explains the rules and offsetting practices in detail, says data on liquidity problems are unavailable, and notes that the answers will feed into a follow-up study of the UWV report.
It is not known how many people experience liquidity problems in connection with receiving wages every four weeks.
Niet bekend is hoeveel personen in verband met de ontvangst van salaris per vier weken liquiditeitsproblemen ondervinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Romke de Jong en Kat over de Tozo

MPs from D66 asked why the Tozo loan carries 2% interest while the Bbz credit carries 8%, and whether the gap is defensible for entrepreneurs. The minister answered that the Tozo is a temporary crisis scheme pegged to Qredits' rate, the Bbz is a structural last-resort scheme with market-rate interest, and he is not willing to lower the Bbz rate because a lower non-market rate would constitute state aid.
I attach importance to a market-conform interest rate being applied to interest-bearing loans under the regular Bbz.
Ik hecht eraan dat er in het kader van het reguliere Bbz een marktconforme rente wordt gehanteerd voor rentedragende leningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Van Kent over het bericht 'Betere bescherming arbeidsmigranten kan niet wachten op nieuw kabinet'

MPs from D66 and SP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of migrant workers found in degrading conditions on a farm in Limburg, including inspection roles, sanctions, the welfare of the workers and the registration of migrant workers. The minister answered that inspections were carried out by the Inspectorate SZW, police and municipality, that investigations are ongoing, that the workers were traced to Belgium, and that the implementation of the Roemer taskforce recommendations is being pursued with some measures awaiting a new cabinet.
The investigation into this incident has not yet been completed and I cannot therefore assess it at this time.
Het onderzoek naar dit voorval is op dit moment nog niet afgerond en ik kan dit derhalve nog niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de fiscale verschillen tussen werknemers en zelfstandigen

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Finance about tax differences between employees and self-employed workers, including assumptions behind tax-burden figures, the threshold profit at which self-employment is cheaper, the effect of old-age reserve limits and insurance, and comparisons by occupation. The State Secretary answered with detailed tables and assumptions, but declined to model the additional differences the MP asked about, citing methodological reasons.
Although in principle it is possible to calculate all kinds of cases, I consider it methodologically incorrect to take other differences into account in comparing the tax treatment by contract type.

Hoewel het in beginsel mogelijk is allerlei casussen door te rekenen, acht ik het methodologisch niet correct om in de vergelijking van de fiscale behandeling naar contractvorm rekening te houden met andere verschillen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Hij heeft me gewoon opgelicht’

An MP asked the ministers about reports of exploitation of Asian chefs brought to the Netherlands under a residence-and-work permit scheme, including IND permits during closures, recruitment via intermediaries, job ads with harsh conditions, wage deductions and bonds. The government answered at length, stating that employers are responsible and that the Inspectorate and UWV can act, and announced it will end the scheme for non-EU chefs at first application while the scheme is reviewed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Ginneken over het bericht ‘'Gluurapparatuur' in trek door thuiswerken, vakbonden bezorgd’

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Ginneken asked the Minister of Social Affairs about employers using monitoring equipment on home workers and the protections for workers' privacy. The minister answered that the same strict rules on monitoring apply whether work is done at home or in the office, and pointed to the works council's consent rights, the AVG, and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and Inspectie SZW roles.
It does not matter whether work takes place at home or at the workplace. The rules for monitoring employees are the same in both cases.
Het maakt niet uit of het werk thuis of op de werkplek plaatsvindt. De regels voor controle van werknemers zijn in beide gevallen gelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Romke de Jong over de TONK

MPs Van Weyenberg and Romke de Jong (D66) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the TONK emergency living-cost support, including its scope relative to the TOZO, uneven municipal implementation, low payouts and strict conditions, and requested a comparison table of municipal rules. The minister replied that TONK covers necessary costs after income loss, that municipalities are being urged to apply it generously and are loosening rules with the extra budget, and that a comparison table is attached as a snapshot.
I have held constructive discussions with municipalities on several occasions about the objectives of TONK and the wish of the House of Representatives and the cabinet to apply TONK generously.
Ik heb op meerdere momenten constructieve gesprekken met gemeenten gevoerd over de doelstellingen van TONK en de wens van Tweede Kamer en kabinet om ruimhartig met de TONK om te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Boulakjar over het bericht 'Zembla: spoorwerkers worden al ruim 10 jaar blootgesteld aan gevaarlijk kwartsstof'

D66 MPs asked the government about reports that railway workers were exposed to carcinogenic quartz dust for over a decade, whether ProRail ignored advice to change ballast stone, whether ProRail should have reported its studies to the Labour Inspectorate, and related questions on enforcement and ProRail's status. The ministers said ProRail has commissioned studies, is following TNO advice to exclude three stone types temporarily, shared the studies with the inspectorate, and that the inspectorate enforces violations without size distinction.
The Ministry of IenW has received ProRail's research reports.
Het Ministerie van IenW heeft de onderzoeksrapporten van ProRail ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat een op de vier belastingbetalers meer betaalt dan nodig is

The MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about reports that one in four taxpayers pays more than necessary, including how income splitting between fiscal partners works, why the split cannot be changed after six weeks, and the reasons for not optimising it. The State Secretary says the Tax Administration does not hold data on non-optimal splits, explains the six-week irrevocability rule and the five-year correction limit, and admits answers could not be given before the filing deadline.
It is not possible for the Tax Administration to investigate in which individual situations an optimal allocation is present.
Het is voor de Belastingdienst niet mogelijk om te onderzoeken in welke individuele situaties sprake is van een optimale toedeling
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het artikel 'Hoe je door de TOZO-regeling als ZZP’er in de schulden belandt'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about self-employed people who had to repay TOZO support despite initially qualifying, asking for leniency, access to TONK, and a longer repayment term without interest. The minister acknowledged confusion over alimony and student finance rules, urged municipalities to apply leniency, pointed to TONK as a local option, and said the cabinet is still considering the loan terms.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘TONK steun veel minder aangevraagd dan verwacht’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that few people applied for the TONK support, whether municipalities apply a means test contrary to a motion, and how the scheme is monitored. The minister answered that municipalities have discretion within special assistance law, urged generous implementation, promised monitoring and continued consultation, and said it is too early to draw conclusions.
In a letter to municipalities I conveyed the wish of the House and the cabinet to apply this generously.
In een brief aan gemeenten heb ik de wens van de Kamer en het kabinet om hier ruimhartig mee om te gaan overgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst weer op zijn kop werd gezet

The MP asks why the Minister of Finance decided to split the Belastingdienst into separate Douane, Toeslagen and Belastingdienst organisations, on what advice, how workers were involved, and whether the promised feasibility test will be sent to parliament. The government answers that the split improves focus and span of control, relies on earlier reports, involves staff in working groups, and promises feasibility tests in Q2 2021, while stating that ministerial responsibility for the Belastingdienst is shared with the state secretaries.
Once the feasibility tests have been carried out, we will inform your House of the results and send the tests to the House.
Wanneer de haalbaarheidstoetsen zijn uitgevoerd zullen wij uw Kamer over de resultaten van deze toetsen informeren en de toetsen aan de Kamer toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten en het lid Van Weyenberg over ongevraagde voorlopige aanslagen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about unsolicited provisional tax assessments sent to about 1.3 million taxpayers in January 2021, and their burden and timing. The State Secretary confirmed the figures, explained the rationale for provisional assessments, acknowledged payment difficulties, and pointed to instalment and payment-arrangement options while promising to improve communication.
I want to look at how the communication about the provisional assessment can be further improved.
Ik wil kijken hoe de communicatie rond de voorlopige aanslag verder verbeterd kan worden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sienot over de postcoderoosregeling

Two D66 MPs asked whether the conversion of the postcoderoos tax scheme into a subsidy scheme was meant to cut back support, and why the transitional arrangement does not let new members join and avoids cooperative bankruptcies when members leave. The State Secretary denies that a cutback was intended, admits the transitional rule may not achieve its aim, and says the government is studying an additional transitional rule in the next tax package.
That is why we are examining whether it is possible to introduce additional transitional arrangements in the upcoming Tax Plan package.
Daarom laten wij uitzoeken of het mogelijk is om aanvullend overgangsrecht te introduceren in het komende Belastingplanpakket.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de versoepeling van het urencriterium in 2020 als fiscale steunmaatregel

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why the hours criterion for entrepreneurs' tax facilities was relaxed in 2020 as a Covid measure, why the relaxation ended in October 2020 and was reinstated for the first half of 2021, and whether it should be extended retroactively to the last quarter of 2020. The State Secretary explained the relaxation as a temporary, non-retroactive measure to avoid losing entrepreneurs' facilities during the crisis, acknowledged that lockdowns affect entrepreneurs' ability to work, and declined to extend it retroactively.
There is no insight into how many entrepreneurs who would normally have met the hours criterion in 2020 would have benefited from an extension of the relaxation to the last quarter of 2020.

Er is geen inzicht in hoeveel ondernemers, die onder normale omstandigheden in 2020 aan het urencriterium zouden voldoen, van een uitbreiding van een versoepeling naar het laatste kwartaal van 2020 zouden hebben geprofiteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Weyenberg over het ondersteunen van start-ups en innovatieve scale-ups met een diversiteitsoogmerk

MPs Bergkamp and Van Weyenberg asked what the government has done to promote gender diversity among government-backed start-up and scale-up investment, including at Invest-NL and the Dutch Future Fund, and whether lack of experience unfairly excludes new groups. The Secretary of State replied that female representation on EZK advisory committees rose to 41.9%, that several diversity initiatives are underway, that Invest-NL and the EIF do not treat lack of experience as a decisive rejection criterion, and that diversity is monitored but not a formal DFF selection criterion.
Invest-NL has so far rejected 58 applications that met the intake criteria for financing.
Invest-NL heeft tot heden 58 aanvragen die voldeden aan de intake criteria, afgewezen voor financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over werkzaamheden onder Europese aanbestedingsregels bij Schiphol

D66 MP Van Weyenberg asked ministers whether Schiphol's security tendering under EU rules, with contracts of at least four years and a change of providers in December 2020, shifts the collapse in passenger-related demand onto security firms who cannot claim the NOW wage subsidy, and whether Schiphol as a state-owned company should take responsibility. The ministers answered that Schiphol handled the tender and rebalancing under EU rules, that the NOW wage subsidy does not cover staff not on the payroll and the firms' eligibility rules apply, and that Schiphol says security remains adequately guaranteed and works with the firms to manage capacity risks.
Schiphol tenders the work under the European procurement rules and thereby takes responsibility for properly tendering the security work at Schiphol, as may be expected of a state-owned company.

Schiphol besteedt de werkzaamheden aan via de Europese aanbestedingsregels en neemt daarmee de verantwoordelijkheid voor het juist aanbesteden van de beveiligingswerkzaamheden op Schiphol zoals van een staatsdeelneming mag worden verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Van Weyenberg over de onbelaste vaste reiskostenvergoeding

MPs Palland and Van Weyenberg asked whether the tax-free fixed travel allowance measure expires on 1 April 2021, what considerations underlie extending it, how employers view it, and when clarity will be given. The government answered that the measure is extended to 1 July 2021, explained the trade-offs, said it is studying a supplementary scheme for home-working costs, and said the Tax Administration cannot see how many employers kept unchanged allowances.
The Tax Administration therefore has no information on how many employers have not adjusted the travel allowance despite no actual travel costs being incurred.
De Belastingdienst beschikt daardoor niet over informatie hoeveel werkgevers de reiskostenvergoeding niet hebben aangepast ondanks dat er geen daadwerkelijk gemaakte reiskosten tegenover staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de TOZO

An MP asks whether municipalities can grant discretionary exceptions (maatwerk) under the TOZO self-employed support scheme and whether the 17 March 2020 Chamber of Commerce registration cut-off should be a hard criterion, including for backdated registrations. The minister answers that municipalities may use the Participatiewet 'zeer dringende redenen' route, that the cut-off is deliberately fixed to limit fraud and administrative problems, and that no change is planned beyond pointing to the earlier answer.
Setting the registration date as a hard criterion for granting the Tozo is consistent with the intended application of the Tozo.
Het stellen van de datum van inschrijving als hard criterium voor toekenning van de Tozo is in overeenstemming met de bedoelde toepassing van de Tozo.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Van Weyenberg over instroom in de WIA van mensen met ME/CVS

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Van Weyenberg asked whether people with ME/CVS who cannot work are not classed as fully incapacitated, whether WIA reassessments rely on outdated assessments, and about appeals, regional inflow and the Raemakers motion. Minister Koolmees answered that UWV assesses earning capacity case by case, that a fresh WIA claim assessment is always done by an occupational physician, that the Raemakers motion is being implemented, and gave appeal and regional inflow figures.
An insured person with ME/CVS may be eligible for a reassessment if the occupational physician found at the previous assessment that the insured person had not done enough to recover.

Een verzekerde met ME/CVS komt mogelijk in aanmerking voor een herbeoordeling indien de verzekeringsarts bij de vorige beoordeling heeft vastgesteld dat de verzekerde niet voldoende gedaan had aan zijn herstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Palland over de Tozo voor grensondernemers

MPs Van Weyenberg and Palland asked about cross-border entrepreneurs living in Germany or Belgium who run businesses in the Netherlands and are excluded from the Tozo, and whether support could be extended. The minister answered that Tozo and TONK are social assistance not exportable abroad for equality and practical reasons, pointed to other Dutch support schemes, said EU talks are ongoing, and committed to a quarterly monitoring report.
The Tozo is social assistance provided only to persons residing in the Netherlands.
De Tozo betreft immers sociale bijstand die alleen wordt verstrekt aan personen die in Nederland woonachtig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Weyenberg over kinderopvang voor alleenstaande ouders tijdens de lockdown

MPs Van Meenen and Van Weyenberg asked whether childcare and schools during the lockdown are open only for parents in critical jobs or vulnerable children, whether single parents, including self-employed ones, were considered, and whether they could access emergency care. The minister confirmed the restriction, said single parents were considered but that expanding emergency care would risk overcrowding, and stated that childcare providers and schools decide with parents, with maatwerk possible in exceptional cases.
That is why I do not wish to change the starting points for emergency childcare so that single parents can also rely on it.
Daarom wil ik de uitgangspunten voor de noodopvang niet aanpassen zodat alleenstaande ouders hier ook een beroep op kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het pensioenakkoord

An MP asked the minister whether the transition framework of the pension agreement would give existing contribution schemes with age-rising premiums a longer phase-out, and whether that transitional arrangement would also extend to directly insured defined-benefit schemes. The minister confirmed a longer phase-out because compensation for switching to flat premiums could not be made cost-neutral, and agreed to extend the transitional rule to directly insured defined-benefit schemes, with the option to keep progressive premiums until 2026.
The Hoofdlijnennotitie on elaborating the Pensioenakkoord therefore chose a longer phase-out over time.
In de Hoofdlijnennotitie uitwerking Pensioenakkoord is daarom gekozen voor een langere uitfasering in de tijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Van Weyenberg over incorrecte cijfers van ziekenhuisopnames

MPs Diertens and Van Weyenberg (D66) asked the Minister of Health why hospital admission figures on the coronavirus dashboard were wrong, when the ministry knew, whether Parliament was informed, and whether meeting records and advice of the BAO and OMT could be shared. The minister explained that the discrepancy came mainly from broader testing rather than delayed reporting, that the dashboard switched to NICE data on 13 October, and refused to release OMT and BAO minutes citing confidentiality and Article 68 of the Constitution while sharing some advice.
I do not have OMT minutes available and they are not public.
OMT-verslagen heb ik niet beschikbaar en zijn niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Weyenberg over het bericht “Ophef over lokale quota voor huisvesting arbeidsmigranten”

Two MPs asked the Social Affairs minister whether municipal quotas limiting housing for migrant workers conflict with EU free-movement law and what the government will do. The minister agreed such quotas conflict with EU law, said the ministries will contact the VNG, and pointed to regional housing agreements and funding instead.
Limiting the housing of migrant workers through quotas specifically aimed at this group is at odds with the free movement of Union citizens, which permits no distinction by nationality.

De huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten beperken door middel van het instellen van quota die specifiek op deze groep gericht zijn, staat op gespannen voet met het vrij verkeer van Unieburgers dat geen onderscheid naar nationaliteit toestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Van Weyenberg over het voldoen aan artikel 68 van de Grondwet

Two MPs from D66 asked the health minister whether the government complies with article 68 of the Constitution, which requires ministers to give parliament requested information unless state interests oppose it, concerning withheld OMT and BAO meeting records and the early handling of personal protective equipment in January and February 2020. The minister refused to release OMT minutes and BAO records, citing the confidentiality needed for expert advice and the constitutional limits of article 68, while giving a detailed chronology of PPE procurement and inventory steps.
The relevant OMT minutes are not provided for the reasons stated in the answer to question 4.
De desbetreffende OMT-notulen worden niet verstrekt om redenen vermeld in het antwoord op vraag 4.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Omtzigt, van Weyenberg en Bruins over het bericht ‘Storing Belastingdienst: ondernemers krijgen week extra voor btw-aangifte’

MPs asked whether the Tax Authority's portal outage on 31 July 2020 justified a general extension and no fines for late VAT returns and payments. The state secretary confirmed the outage and the extension to 7 August, with fines waived under existing policy and the Covid emergency measures.
That is correct; between 30 July 23:35 and 31 July 14:15 it was not possible to submit VAT returns online because the MijnBelastingdienst/Zakelijk portal was unavailable.
Dat klopt, tussen 30 juli 23:35 uur en 31 juli 14:15 uur was het niet mogelijk btw-aangiften in te dienen via internet omdat het betreffende portaal MijnBelastingdienst/Zakelijk onbereikbaar was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch, Van der Molen, Van Helvert en Van Weyenberg over het bericht "Nederland moet ondernemers in het buitenland mogelijk toch TOZO-uitkering geven"

MPs from CDA and D66 asked the State Secretary whether the European Commission's view that the Tozo is a special non-contributory benefit requires exporting it to cross-border entrepreneurs, and whether Tozo 2's partner test should be treated differently. The State Secretary answered that the Tozo is a social assistance benefit outside the scope of the coordination regulation, so it cannot be exported, and that cross-border entrepreneurs can use other support measures instead.
The Tozo is a social assistance benefit and cannot be regarded as a special non-contributory benefit.
De Tozo is een bijstandsuitkering en kan niet gezien worden als een bijzondere non-contributieve uitkering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Weyenberg over het bericht 'Angstcultuur in vleessector: slachterijwerkers zwijgen opgelegd'

D66 MPs asked the ministers about reports of a fear culture in the meat sector, where migrant slaughterhouse workers feel threatened with dismissal if they report sick, and about hygiene, COVID-19 testing, and abusive temp agencies. The government acknowledges the dependency problem, points to existing inspection and reporting channels, and commits to advisory follow-up and a national cooperation platform, but gives mostly general answers and declines to reconsider the sampling-based testing approach.
The cooperation platform will be fully operational from 1 September.
Het samenwerkingsplatform is vanaf 1 september volledig operationeel.
De gedeeltelijke AOW-opbouw van in Nederland wonende mensen met een Surinaamse achtergrond.

MPs Van Weyenberg and Slootweg asked whether courts have only tested the legality of residence-based distinctions in AOW pension accrual, whether existing schemes target Surinamese and Antillean residents, whether the SVB informed Surinamese migrants about buying back AOW years, and whether the government will examine legal options to repair partial AOW accrual for 1957-1975. The minister answers that courts have found objective justification for residence-based distinctions, that a repair would create precedent and unequal treatment of other groups, that the only specific scheme is the civil-servant pension supplement, that the SVB ran buy-back campaigns with low uptake, and that the government has examined the issue at length and sent a letter to the House.

The question is whether there is an objective justification for treating Surinamese Dutch people as residents of the Netherlands while they lived in Suriname, and not treating other citizens who were not residents for a period under comparable circumstances the same way.

Het is immers de vraag of er een objectieve rechtvaardiging is om Surinaamse Nederlanders wel te behandelen alsof ze ingezetene waren in Nederland, terwijl ze in Suriname woonden, en andere burgers die een bepaalde periode onder vergelijkbare omstandigheden geen ingezetene waren, niet zo te behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Groothuizen en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Geef kennismigranten en internationaal talent meer zekerheid tijdens de coronacrisis’

Three D66 MPs asked whether knowledge migrants and international students in the Netherlands should get more legal certainty during the COVID-19 crisis, including relaxed study-progress rules, extended job-search periods, and deadlines. The government answered that it will not impose consequences on temporary salary-criterion breaches under the Wtv scheme, offers flexibility on study progress and language tests, and is only exploring a broader interpretation of job-search rules, with no firm extension of the search period.

When insufficient study progress is caused by the coronavirus crisis, institutions can treat this as an excusable reason for the study delay, and this has no consequences for the student's residence permit.

Wanneer onvoldoende studievoortgang is veroorzaakt door de coronacrisis, kunnen instellingen dit aanmerken als een verschoonbare reden voor de studievertraging en heeft dit geen gevolgen voor de verblijfsvergunning van de student.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Beukering-Huijbregts over “snelle toegang van zzp’ers tot het Besluit bijstandverlening zelfstandigen (Bbz)”

MPs from D66 asked the State Secretary how quickly self-employed people without staff can obtain Bbz benefits during the coronavirus crisis, including eligibility conditions, processing times, capacity, and tax deferral information. The State Secretary answered that eligibility conditions apply, that municipalities are responsible for processing and speed, and pointed to the temporary Tozo scheme as the faster route.
There is no data known about the actual average decision time by municipalities.
Er zijn geen gegevens bekend over de feitelijke, gemiddelde beslisduur door gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over “zelfstandigen die net buiten de Tijdelijke overbruggingsregeling zelfstandig ondernemers (Tozo) dreigen te vallen”

An MP asked whether self-employed people with a VAT number but no Chamber of Commerce registration on 17 March 2020 are excluded from the Tozo, and how municipalities should handle hardship cases and advances that must be repaid. The state secretary confirmed that registration in the trade register is a cumulative legal requirement, that VAT status does not substitute for it, that deviation is only possible under strict 'very urgent reasons' rules, and that the criteria were not changed from the earlier published framework.
The number of self-employed persons registered with the Chamber of Commerce but without a VAT number can only be small.
Het aantal zelfstandigen dat beschikt over een inschrijving bij de Kamer van Koophandel, maar niet over een btw-nummer, kan niet anders dan gering zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Van Weyenberg over het heropenen van de sekswerksector

Two MPs from D66 asked whether the Dutch sex work sector could reopen under a hygiene protocol like Belgium's, and why not if not. The minister answered that the sector may reopen from 1 July under sector-drafted protocols that follow RIVM guidance, with EZK giving further advice on the protocols.
The sex work sector may reopen from 1 July.
De sekswerksector mag per 1 juli weer open.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp en Van Weyenberg over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor vrouwen

MPs Bergkamp and Van Weyenberg asked the ministers of Education, Culture and Science and Social Affairs about the economic and care impacts of the coronavirus crisis on women, including gender-impact checks on support measures. The minister answered that the evidence is mixed, that no specific gender-targeted policy is currently needed, and that the government will monitor and evaluate labour-market measures with attention to gender differences.
The cabinet will monitor and evaluate the effects of labour market measures and inform the House about them.
Het kabinet zal de effecten van arbeidsmarktmaatregelen monitoren en evalueren en de Kamer hierover informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Van Weyenberg over de berichten: 'Coronaslachters Groenlo mogelijk aan het werk in plaats van in quarantaine' en 'Varkensstallen dreigen vol te raken door sluiting slachthuizen

Two D66 MPs asked the government about reports of Groenlo slaughterhouse workers possibly working while in quarantine, overcrowded pig stables due to slaughterhouse closures, and related labour, enforcement and animal welfare concerns. The government answered that the regional safety authorities and the NVWA/Inspectie SZW are responsible for enforcement, that a breeding ban is disproportionate, that borders cannot be closed to EU live animals, and that sectors will develop short-term scenarios.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Van Weyenberg over “de steunmaatregelen voor sekswerkers”

D66 MPs Bouali and Van Weyenberg asked whether sex workers, including opting-in workers without employee premiums, can access COVID-19 support schemes (Tozo, WW, NOW), how many are affected, and why sex work may only resume on 1 September. Minister Koolmees answered that lawfully resident persons may claim Tozo, WW or general assistance if they meet criteria, that opting-in workers cannot claim WW or NOW, that sex work reopening on 1 September follows the cabinet route map and expert advice, and that he sees no way to reopen earlier.
It is not known how many sex workers there are in the Netherlands.
Niet bekend is hoeveel sekswerkers er in Nederland zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Tielen over de toepassing van de NOW bij payrollbedrijven

MPs Van Weyenberg and Tielen asked the Minister of Social Affairs how the NOW wage subsidy applies to payroll and temp agencies whose workers cannot work because of COVID-19 closures, including dismissal procedures, invoicing of closed-sector clients, and possible contract dissolution. The minister confirmed payroll firms can apply for NOW as employers with 20% or more turnover loss, explained UWV assesses dismissal requests based on conditions at the client, and largely left invoicing and contract issues to the parties themselves, calling on them to talk.
Due to the sector classification used in the wage declaration, it is not possible to determine how many payroll companies have applied for a NOW subsidy.
Door de sectorindeling die in de loonaangifte geldt is het niet mogelijk om na te gaan hoeveel payrollbedrijven een NOW-subsidie hebben aangevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sneller over het bericht ‘Verzekeringsreus Aon vraagt personeel om loonoffer van 20% vanwege corona’

MPs Van Weyenberg and Sneller asked whether the government finds it acceptable that insurer Aon requests a 20% pay cut from staff due to COVID-19 while still paying dividends, and what role works councils and unions play. The minister declined to judge individual companies, explained that employees can refuse such requests and that works councils have only advisory or consent rights in limited cases, and noted that pay levels affect NOW subsidies and unemployment benefits.
I do not think it appropriate to go into individual cases.
Ik vind het niet passend om in te gaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het feit dat de (maximale) huurtoeslag daalt wanneer een alleenstaande een kind krijgt

The MP asks whether the maximum housing allowance (huurtoeslag) for single parents is lower than for single persons without children, whether this is desirable, and what options exist to reduce the difference. The minister confirms the difference (about EUR 47 per month at minimum income and rent at the threshold), explains it reflects the 1997 rationale for singles, points to the single-parent supplement in the child-related budget as compensation, and says a harmonisation option was studied in the IBO and that the IBO part 2 was sent to parliament.
It is correct that there is a difference in the maximum possible housing allowance for single persons and for multi-person households, which also include single-parent families.
Het klopt dat er een verschil is in de maximaal mogelijke huurtoeslag voor alleenstaanden en voor meerpersoonshuishoudens, waar ook eenoudergezinnen onder vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van Weyenberg, Özütok en Snels over de opschorting van het Wob-verzoek van Pieter Klein

MPs from D66, GroenLinks asked the Health Minister why he suspended a Wob freedom-of-information request from journalist Pieter Klein on coronavirus matters and whether this undermines oversight and press freedom. The minister answered that the request was suspended for force majeure due to crisis work, that only coronavirus-related Wob requests are paused with a plan to resume by 1 June, and that alternative channels and appeal routes remain open.
Only in a very exceptional situation can an administrative body invoke force majeure to suspend the decision period for Wob requests.
Uitsluitend in geval van een zeer uitzonderlijke situatie kan een bestuursorgaan met een beroep op overmacht de beslistermijn voor Wob-verzoeken opschorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de gevolgen van de Wet arbeidsmarkt in balans (WAB) voor werknemers die gevraagd worden om als zzp’er verder te werken

MP Van Weyenberg asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Finance about reports that workers were asked to continue their work as self-employed contractors after the WAB took effect, and about enforcement via the Belastingdienst and where affected workers can report it. The minister answered that no trend data exists yet, a quick scan is underway, that employers may generally structure relationships within law but cannot force self-employment against an employee's will, and pointed to inspection and reporting channels, with a half-yearly enforcement report promised.
I expect to be able to inform your House about this in May or June.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer hierover in mei of juni te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Werkgever beboet voor discrimineren zwangere: Velen gaan de fout in’

An MP asks the Secretary of State about pregnancy discrimination at work, including the burden of proof, fixed-term contracts, the temporary-agency clause and the new recruitment-discrimination law. The government acknowledges the problem, points to existing legal protection and to the College voor de Rechten van de Mens, and declines to change the law for now while the courts decide pending cases.
I will bring this possibility more firmly to attention in communication about the rights of pregnant women and women who have just given birth.
Ik zal in de communicatie over de rechten van zwangere vrouwen en vrouwen die net bevallen zijn deze mogelijkheid steviger onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor het urencriterium, de zelfstandigenaftrek en de startersaftrek

An MP asked whether the government could relax the 1,225-hour test for the self-employed deduction and starter deduction given COVID-19 lockdown effects, and whether it would use crisis-year leniency as in 2009-2010. The Secretary of State answered that the government will relax the test by treating entrepreneurs as having worked 24 hours per week from 1 March to 31 May 2020, and that the questions were answered late due to ongoing studies.

The cabinet has however preferred a variant under which an entrepreneur in the period from 1 March 2020 to 31 May 2020 is deemed to have spent at least 24 hours per week on his business, even if he did not actually spend those hours.

Het kabinet heeft echter de voorkeur gegeven aan een variant waarbij een ondernemer in de periode van 1 maart 2020 tot en met 31 mei 2020 geacht wordt ten minste 24 uren per week aan zijn onderneming te hebben besteed, ook als hij die uren niet daadwerkelijk heeft besteed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Groothuizen over de positie van arbeidsmigranten tijdens de coronacrisis

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the position of migrant workers during the COVID-19 crisis, covering worker testing, complaint routes, dismissals, housing, travel and harvest labour shortages. The minister answered substantively on most points, stating that employers must follow RIVM rules and that complaints can go to the Inspectie SZW, while stating that no unified figures exist on evicted or travelling migrant workers.

Although these developments have our continuous attention, there are currently no unambiguous figures on the number of migrant workers who have travelled home or lost their housing as a result of the corona crisis.

Hoewel deze ontwikkelingen onze continue aandacht hebben, zijn er op dit moment geen eenduidige cijfers over het aantal arbeidsmigranten die naar huis zijn gereisd of die als gevolg van de coronacrisis hun huisvesting kwijt zijn geraakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Schaf de zorgtoeslag af, zonder inkomenseffecten’

D66 MPs asked the government about a proposal to abolish the healthcare allowance (zorgtoeslag) and lower the nominal premium, covering income effects, costs, state-aid risk and premium competition. The minister answered at length, noting that roughly 3 million households would lose out without compensation, that the proposal is unclear on compensation and feasibility for the tax authority, and that a lower premium would require EU state-aid notification, while promising alternatives will be explored in the response to the IBO-toeslagen.
Regarding cost-awareness and the level of the nominal premium, two aspects play a role.
Met betrekking tot kostenbewustzijn en de hoogte van de nominale premie spelen twee aspecten

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Weyenberg en Lodders over banken die op grond van de FATCA-wetgeving financiële dienstverlening weigeren aan Nederlanders met (ook) de Amerikaanse nationaliteit

Three MPs asked whether banks may block or close accounts of Dutch citizens who also hold US nationality (Accidental Americans) for lacking a US TIN under FATCA, and what the government will do. The Secretary of State answers that closure is not required by FATCA or the IGA, that supervisors DNB and AFM apply case-by-case rules, that no closures had yet occurred, and that the government keeps pressing the US for solutions while declining to restrict data exchange unilaterally.
I am aware of what my predecessor wrote to the House.
Ik ben bekend met hetgeen mijn ambtsvoorganger aan uw Kamer heeft geschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Weyenberg over een overzicht van aftrekposten, grondslagversmallers en belastingregelingen in de vennootschapsbelasting

MPs Leijten and Van Weyenberg asked why the liquidation loss scheme is not listed among tax arrangements and whether the Chamber will get a full list of provisions that reduce the corporate tax base. The state secretary provided a 2017 corporate tax base overview, explaining that the Miljoenennota list covers only non-primary-structure items, and committed to consider regular updates.
The overview omits banks and the gas sector because publishing their tax base figures could lead to identifiable information.
