In het overzicht zijn de banken en de gassector weggelaten omdat publicatie van de grondslagbedragen bij deze specifieke sectoren kan leiden tot herleidbare informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over box 2 als klusbox

An MP asks the Finance Minister about box 2 of the Dutch tax system, focusing on directors' profit retention, tax planning, borrowing from their own company, and macro-economic and fairness effects. The minister acknowledges the DNB analysis, says fiscally driven profit retention is a possible problem to be examined in the building-blocks study, notes the planned excessive-lending bill, and gives partial figures while declining to break down loan uses.
Alongside the elaboration of this measure, the building-blocks study will further examine the desirability of the possibility to borrow from one's own company.
Naast de uitwerking van deze maatregel wordt in het bouwstenenonderzoek de wenselijkheid van de mogelijkheid tot lenen van de eigen vennootschap nader onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de gevolgen van de Wet arbeidsmarkt in balans (WAB) voor payroll en detacheringscontracten

The MP asks whether workers moved from secondment to temporary-agency contracts under the WAB are a choice by employers, how payroll and agency contracts differ, where workers can complain, and whether the minister will talk to the sector federations. The minister says payroll-qualifying secondments cannot simply be converted to agency contracts, lists cost differences, points workers to the kantonrechter and Inspectie SZW, and says he will discuss with ABU and NBBU if concrete signals arise.
An employer cannot simply unilaterally change a contract.
Een werkgever kan niet zomaar eenzijdig een contract wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht 'Concurrentiebeding wordt vaak oneigenlijk gebruikt'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that non-compete clauses are often misused, including their prevalence, how often employers invoke them, and whether compensation should be required. The minister answered that data on prevalence and enforcement are limited, that courts weigh justified business interests case by case, and that a review of conditions including mandatory compensation will be undertaken per a motion.
As indicated in the answer to question 4, it is not known how often employers invoke the non-compete clause
Zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op vraag 4 is het niet bekend hoe vaak werkgevers zich beroepen op het concurrentiebeding
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de mogelijkheid van pensioenoverdracht uit het buitenland

An MP asked whether people with foreign pensions can transfer them under Dutch law, and on the criteria, the obligations of Dutch pension providers, and the options when a new Dutch employer's provider refuses. The minister answered that transfers are possible under the 2015 policy decision and Article 91/92 Pensioenwet, that Dutch providers are obliged to cooperate only for transfers from EU or EEA-based insurers meeting listed conditions, and that transfers to a provider other than the new employer's are not possible.
A transfer to a pension provider other than that of the new employer is not possible.
Een waardeoverdracht naar een andere pensioenuitvoerder dan die van de nieuwe werkgever is niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht 'Loonkloof tussen man en vrouw verder gegroeid: gat van 175 euro in het bedrijfsleven'

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about press reports that the gender pay gap widened in the private sector, including the causes of the gap, overtime, international examples and possible legislation. The State Secretary answered that the unexplained (corrected) gap is not closing, pointed to the CBS monitor and the forthcoming part-time review, described existing measures, and deferred a position on the proposed pay equality bill until it is tabled.
I am awaiting the submission of the bill and will then determine a position.
Ik wacht indiening van het wetsvoorstel af, en zal vervolgens een standpunt bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Meer meldingen rond arbeidsmigranten: Cowboybedrijven omzeilen de wet’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about rising reports of Wav violations (illegal foreign workers), whether the posting notification duty and Inspectorate capacity will curb abuse, EU priority-labour-market tests, Polish work permits, and Dutch firms recruiting in Poland. The minister answered that reports rose from 1,182 in 2015 to 1,817 in 2018, that the Inspectorate is being expanded by over 400 FTE, and that EU law limits national conditions on posted workers, with supervision mainly the responsibility of the country where work is performed.
The number of complaints and signals increased from 1,182 in 2015 to 1,307 in 2016, 1,382 in 2017 and 1,817 in 2018.
Het aantal klachten en signalen is toegenomen van 1.182 in 2015 naar 1.307 in 2016, 1.382 in 2017 en 1.817 in 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Leijten over “ambtenaren die deelnemen aan belastingcommissies van lobbyclubs van buitenlandse bedrijven”

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether civil servants should sit on tax committees of foreign business lobby groups such as AmCham, and whether NFIA staff participation creates conflict of interest and loss of role clarity. The minister answered that participation as a listening observer (toehoorder) is justified for signal-gathering and network building, that the NFIA has no membership except a French chamber corporate membership, and declined to publish meeting records or systematic participation data.
It is not for me to make the points raised in such consultations public.
Het is niet aan mij om ingebrachte punten uit dergelijke overleggen naar buiten te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Van Weyenberg en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Een ongeluk waar je niets van leert’

Three D66 MPs asked the Defence and Infrastructure ministers about a 2018 helicopter training accident involving the Coast Guard's SAR contractor, the unreported incident, and unclear inspection and safety responsibilities across ILT, Inspectie SZW and contractors. The government answered that the accident was reported by the worker, that an inspection into the employer's failure to report will be started, and that responsibilities are divided among several inspectorates, while rejecting claims of unacceptable shortcomings.
ISZW will launch an investigation into this.
Er wordt door ISZW een onderzoek hiernaar ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht "Arbeidsmigranten Westland luiden noodklok: Ik mocht niet naar huis toen ik ziek was”

An MP asked the government about reports that migrant workers in Westland were refused permission to go home when sick, including a pregnant worker, and about pregnancy leave, inspections, rights information and the integrated approach to abuses. The minister condemned such treatment as contrary to good employership, explained leave and dismissal rules for temporary agency workers, stated inspections are unannounced, and said an integrated approach would be sent to parliament by year end.
The Labour Inspectorate does not comment on whether investigations are or are being conducted at companies.
De Inspectie SZW laat zich niet uit over de vraag of bij bedrijven onderzoek is of wordt gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de mogelijkheden van zzp’ers om deel te nemen aan UWV Marktplaats

Two MPs (Van Weyenberg, D66) asked whether freelancers (zzp'ers) can only join UWV Marktplaats if their KvK registration meets the Waadi registration duty, and how this fits with UWV's website and EU procurement rules. The minister answers that this is a misunderstanding: a sole trader acting as a natural person is not subject to the Waadi, the wording on the UWV website was wrongly aimed at suppliers and has been corrected, and freelancers can participate and have a fair chance under EU rules.
No, this is not correct. When a freelancer participates in UWV Marktplaats as a natural person, the Waadi does not apply to them.
Nee, dit klopt niet. Wanneer een zzp'er als natuurlijk persoon deelneemt aan UWV Marktplaats is de Waadi op hem of haar niet van toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Weyenberg over het artikel “Recalcitrant accountholders in de IGA”

MPs Lodders and Van Weyenberg asked the State Secretary of Finance about a legal article on FATCA's intergovernmental agreement, including how banks must handle US persons without a TIN and whether the IRS can judge banks significantly non-compliant. The State Secretary largely rejected the article's interpretation, said the Netherlands is pressing the US for clarity and a simpler SSN procedure, but admitted US positions remain unclear and no concrete US measures have been announced.
I do not agree with this interpretation of Article 4, second paragraph, of the IGA.
Ik ben het niet eens met deze uitleg van artikel 4, tweede lid, van de IGA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over Nederlandse burgers die de dupe zijn van Amerikaanse regelgeving

D66 MPs Van Weyenberg and Sjoerdsma asked whether the government would press the US for a solution for Dutch citizens who are also US citizens ('Accidental Americans') harmed by FATCA, including whether banks may refuse basic payment accounts when no US SSN is held, and whether a coordinated European approach would be pursued. State Secretary Snel answered that the issue is high on the government's agenda, that a missing US TIN/SSN is not a valid ground to refuse a basic payment account, and that Netherlands is seeking a coordinated European action, with a follow-up letter promised after the summer.
The cabinet will continue to work on behalf of this group of people.
Het kabinet zal zich blijven inzetten voor deze groep mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Lodders over de heffingskorting van Nederlanders in het buitenland

MPs Van Weyenberg and Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance about the loss of tax credits (heffingskortingen) for Dutch pensioners abroad since 2019, including the number affected, budget estimates, AOW export rules, and how they were informed. The State Secretary confirmed the change follows from Belastingplan 2018 and 2019, gave estimates of about 350,000 and 130,000 affected persons and a 3 million euro revenue estimate, and described Belastingdienst and SVB communication, while not providing a precise count of AOW recipients affected.
The concrete share of these persons in the numbers is not known.
Het concrete aandeel van deze personen in de aantallen is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Fiscaal verdrag drijft Amerikanen in Nederland tot wanhoop’

MPs Lodders and Van Weyenberg asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the US FATCA tax treaty is driving Americans living in the Netherlands to despair, including missing US TIN/SSN numbers and possible bank account closures. The State Secretary answered that he raised the issue with US authorities, that no extension of the transition period is expected, that significant non-compliance sanctions are a last resort, and that he is coordinating with France and other EU partners.
The size of this group as of 1 June 2019 is not known to me.
De omvang van deze groep op 1 juni 2019 is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht 'Oude vervuilende zakelijke auto veel goedkoper dan schone Tesla'

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the youngtimer scheme, which applies a lower company-car benefit to cars older than fifteen years, and whether it encourages older, more polluting cars. The State Secretary answers that the rule is a forfaitaire differentiation rather than a tax advantage, gives usage figures and emissions comparisons, and says the review of the scheme will be sent to parliament before the summer recess.
I aim to send the outcomes of the study into the possibility of adjusting the youngtimer scheme to your House before the summer recess.
Ik streef er naar de uitkomsten van het onderzoek naar de mogelijkheid om de youngtimerregeling aan te passen voor het zomerreces aan uw Kamer te sturen.
Àntwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers, Van Eijs en Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘800.000 Nederlanders kregen kanker, na ‘genezing’ houden zij problemen’

Three D66 MPs asked the health, finance and social affairs ministers about reports that many cancer survivors face lasting problems, including ongoing fatigue, lack of aftercare and advice, difficulties returning to work, and problems obtaining mortgages and insurance. The ministers answered that care providers should be doing more, that existing initiatives such as a no-risk insurance pilot and a Taskforce Cancer Survivorship are underway, and that the government sees little need for its own intervention, while promising to review mortgage and insurance issues with the sector.

In preparation for the next Platform meeting in 2020, I will ask how lenders handle the life insurance requirement and whether parties experience other bottlenecks in mortgage provision to (ex-)cancer patients.

Ik zal in voorbereiding op de volgende Platform bijeenkomst in 2020 uitvragen hoe kredietverstrekkers omgaan met de overlijdensrisicoverzekering en of partijen andere knelpunten ervaren op het gebied van hypotheekverstrekking aan (ex)kankerpatiënten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat een niet-bewezen effectieve therapie bij ADHD wel door zorgverzekeraars vergoed wordt

MPs Raemakers and Van Weyenberg asked the ministers whether insurers, municipalities and UWV fund horse therapy for ADHD and other treatments not proven effective. The minister replied that such therapy is outside the basic package, that insurers set their own supplementary coverage, that UWV buys horse-coaching as Werk-Fit activation with success monitoring, and that the Jeugdwet and PGB rules apply to municipalities without a full list of funded treatments.
We therefore do not have a (complete) overview of which treatments or therapies are reimbursed from the supplementary package.
Wij beschikken dan ook niet over een (totaal)overzicht van welke behandelingen of therapieën uit het aanvullende pakket vergoed worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Onderzoek: deelnemers bereid in te leveren voor duurzaam beleggen’

MP Van Weyenberg asked the minister of Social Affairs about survey results showing that pension fund members want sustainable investing and influence over it, and about the Eerlijk Pensioenlabel ratings and standardisation of sustainability measurement. The minister responded that the fund boards remain responsible for investment policy, pointed to existing transparency rules and the IMVB convenant, and said the government would send an overview of EU developments before summer.
The investment policy of pension funds remains primarily the responsibility of the pension fund board.
Het beleggingsbeleid van pensioenfondsen blijft in de eerste plaats een verantwoordelijkheid van het pensioenfondsbestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Sjoerdsma en Van Weyenberg over vrouwelijke ondernemers

D66 MPs asked why so few start-ups led by women receive investment, whether women face harder access to credit, and what government will do about it. The ministers answered that the gap is a real underuse of talent, that causes include bias and stereotypes, that no data yet exist on credit applications by women, and that they will commission research, host a roundtable follow-up and seek SER advice on diversity.
We will consider how and within what timeframe such research will take place.
We zullen bezien op welke wijze en welke termijn een dergelijk onderzoek plaats zal vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Van Weyenberg en Slootweg over de uitwerking FATCA voor Nederlandse burgers en signalen dat bankrekeningen geblokkeerd gaan worden

MPs from VVD, D66 and CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance about FATCA's effects on Dutch citizens with US ties, including banks threatening to block accounts without a US TIN/SSN. The State Secretary answered that banks may refuse or end services but must still offer basic payment accounts, that the number of affected people cannot be confirmed, and that the government is engaging US authorities on the SSN procedure and extending the transitional arrangement.
I assume the "white list" refers to banks that qualify as Participating FIs under FATCA.
Ik ga ervan uit dat met de «witte lijst» de banken worden bedoeld die kwalificeren als deelnemende bank (Participating FI) op grond van FATCA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over ondersteuning bij werk in de Wet werk en inkomen naar arbeidsvermogen (WIA)

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether re-integration support under the WIA is available to people with WGA 80-99 or IVA benefits, and whether terminally ill people who want to work are supported. The minister answered that WGA recipients with current work options get active re-integration help, while IVA recipients have no re-integration obligation or right, though they can request reassessment or work facilities, and that no change to income offsetting for prognosis is planned.
For people who fall under the IVA, re-integration is in principle not an issue.
Voor mensen die onder de IVA vallen, is re-integratie in beginsel niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over “de werking van de WW”

An MP asked whether jobseekers with a signed contract or a small top-up WW benefit must keep searching, whether UWV can exempt them, and how scholarship and retraining rules work. The minister confirmed the job-search duty continues until two weeks before the new job starts, that UWV can exempt in special cases but does not record how often, and described the income-offset and training budget rules.
The precise circumstances in which this happens and how often UWV does so are not specifically recorded in the implementation administration.
De precieze omstandigheden waarin dit gebeurt en hoe vaak het UWV dat doet, worden niet specifiek bijgehouden in de uitvoeringsadministratie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Van Weyenberg over zzp’ers zonder schuldhulp

MPs Raemakers and Van Weyenberg (D66) asked why many large municipalities deny debt assistance to self-employed people, why partners' income can block access, and what the government will do. The State Secretary acknowledges the problem, says municipalities cannot exclude self-employed groups, and promises a change to the Wgs, guidance and knowledge sharing, though some data requests are answered only partially.
Self-employed people may not be excluded as a group from debt assistance.
Zelfstandigen mogen niet als groep worden uitgesloten van schuldhulpverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Pieter Heerma over het bericht 'Werkgevers pompen Polen rond om kosten te besparen'

MPs Van Weyenberg and Heerma asked whether temp agencies send workers onto unemployment benefit (WW) to cut costs and whether this is structural. The minister says UWV, the Inspectorate and the sector bodies do not recognise the pattern, but finds such constructions undesirable, will examine revolving-door practices in a planned evaluation of the temp-work regime in 2020, and says the cost differences for temp workers are modest and that data analysis on WW fraud is forthcoming.
In the evaluation of the temporary employment regime in the Netherlands that I am going to start, I will therefore include revolving-door constructions in the temp sector.
In de evaluatie van het uitzendregime in Nederland die ik ga opstarten, zal ik draaideurconstructies in de uitzendsector dan ook meenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Weyenberg over toepassing van het verlaagde btw-tarief op e-publicaties

MPs Sneller and Van Weyenberg asked whether the government will lower VAT on e-publications following the October 2018 EU political agreement, and what preparations, timeline and consultation with the sector are planned. The state secretary confirmed the agreement and earlier commitments, said preparations are underway including a draft bill for internet consultation in the first half of 2019, and targeted entry into force on 1 January 2020.
Furthermore, I intend to consult broadly on a draft bill in the first half of 2019 via an internet consultation, so that all stakeholders have the opportunity to respond.

Verder ben ik voornemens om een conceptwetsvoorstel in de eerste helft van 2019 breed te consulteren via een internetconsultatie, zodat alle belanghebbenden in de gelegenheid worden gesteld te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de behandeling van postnatale depressie (postpartum depressie) door UWV

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV failing to recognise postnatal depression as pregnancy-related, the role of treating physicians, notification deadlines, the three-month benchmark and whether the sickness-benefit rules should be changed. The minister answered that UWV assesses causality case by case under the guideline, that treating physicians' diagnoses are weighed but do not decide, that the three-month mark is not a fixed rule, and that no change to the guideline or the rules is planned.
It is up to the insurance physician to assess in the individual case whether a causal link exists between the pregnancy or childbirth and a depression occurring during or after it.
Het is aan de verzekeringsarts om in het individuele geval te beoordelen of er een causaal verband bestaat tussen de zwangerschap of bevalling en een daarbij of daarna optredende depressie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over "het bericht ‘856.000 Nederlanders in loondienst bouwen geen pensioen op"

An MP from D66 asks the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that 856,000 employees build no pension, and about the causes (flex contracts, expats, uitzend sector waiting periods, administrative lag, the waiting period rule). The minister answers that the CBS figures reflect a new methodology, explains the composition of the white spot and the administrative processes in the temp sector, and says social partners are researching the waiting period and will report back.
I am in contact with the parties involved about progress and will inform the House of the outcomes.
Ik onderhoud contact met de betrokken partijen over de voortgang en zal uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht 'Zelfstandigen bouwen wel degelijk pensioen op, maar benutten belastingvoordeel te weinig'

An MP asked whether self-employed workers build pension savings but underuse the tax advantages, and whether they know about the tax-facilitated options. The minister answered that self-employed people do build old-age savings but often not in a tax-favoured form, that the tax rules are explained, and that awareness-raising and reforms such as abolishing the doorsneesystematiek are being considered.
I consider it important that all workers in the Netherlands build up an adequate old-age provision.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat alle werkenden in Nederland een toereikende oudedagsvoorziening opbouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de manier waarop pensioenfondsen de CO2-voetafdruk van hun beleggingsportefeuille berekenen en hierover intern en extern rapporteren

An MP from D66 asked how pension funds, notably ABP, calculate the CO2 footprint of their investments, in particular whether excluding scope-3 emissions gives a distorted picture and why ABP has not included them despite its participants' requests. The minister answered that scope 1 and 2 give a good picture for individual companies, that a distorted picture is never desirable but no serious distortion is currently evident, that scope 3 may be added later, and that the ABP board has primacy over investment policy within its governance structure.
The ABP board has primacy over the implementation of the pension scheme, including investment policy.
Het ABP-bestuur heeft het primaat van de uitvoering van de pensioenregeling, inclusief het beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Pieter Heerma over het bericht 'Heya! Kilo’s knallen!'

MPs Van Weyenberg and Heerma asked the Minister of Social Affairs about working conditions, agency staffing, pension and WW-benefit practices, hygiene training and inspection in the meat processing sector, following a press report. The Minister responded that the picture from the article is not reflected in complaints to the Inspectorate, pointed to existing collective agreements, complaint routes and prevention projects, and did not commit to new action.
The picture in the article regarding the working conditions of migrant workers is not something I recognise in the complaints and reports submitted to the Inspectorate SZW.
Het beeld dat naar voren komt in het artikel waarbij het gaat om de arbeidsomstandigheden van arbeidsmigranten zie ik niet terug in klachten en meldingen die worden ingediend bij de Inspectie SZW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Bergkamp en Sneller over het bericht dat de Nederlandse cultuur rond vrouwemancipatie en deeltijdwerken achterhaald is

MPs from D66 asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Education and Finance about a report that Dutch culture on women's emancipation and part-time work is outdated, covering women's access to extra hours, sector shortages, McKinsey's estimate of GDP gains, parental role models, pay gaps and childcare flexibility. The minister answered that the government is studying part-time work through an interdepartmental policy review, cites measures such as tax changes and parental leave, and says concrete outcomes depend on individual employers and employees.
The cabinet has commissioned an interdepartmental policy review on part-time work (IBO Deeltijdwerk).
Het kabinet heeft opdracht gegeven tot een interdepartementaal beleidsonderzoek deeltijdwerk (IBO Deeltijdwerk).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Arbeidsdeelname mannen 25 tot 45 lager dan voor crisis’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the falling labour participation of men aged 25 to 45 compared with before the crisis, including causes, whether it is structural, and whether it is also seen in other countries. The minister answered that the decline is partly cyclical and partly structural (lower-educated men, more schooling, more illness-related inactivity), that CPB research is underway, and that the decline is also visible across OECD countries.
The CPB is currently conducting research at the request of the Ministry of SZW into the development of labour supply in the Netherlands.
Het CPB doet momenteel op verzoek van het Ministerie van SZW onderzoek naar de ontwikkeling van het arbeidsaanbod in Nederland
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Raemakers over het bericht ‘Honderdduizenden senioren lopen risico geld te laten liggen’

MPs Van Weyenberg and Raemakers asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Social Affairs about research showing many 55-plus households may miss out on healthcare and rent allowances, and about outreach to eligible seniors and Wajong beneficiaries. The government answered that non-take-up is known (about 17% for rent and healthcare allowance in earlier studies), that outreach exists, and that the issue will be examined in an upcoming IBO study with conclusions to inform further action.
Regarding the group of older migrants and single elderly, which you refer to in your question, no data are available in the aforementioned studies.
Over de groep oudere migranten en alleenstaande ouderen, waar u in uw vraag aan refereert, zijn in voornoemde onderzoeken geen gegevens voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Echtpaar gooit tuinhuis op Airbnb. Hoe worden de huurinkomsten belast?’

MPs Van Eijs and Van Weyenberg asked the State Secretary of Finance how short-term rental income from a home (e.g. Airbnb, garden house) is taxed, and whether partial room rentals should be taxed. The State Secretary explained the existing rules under the Wet IB 2001 (article 3.113, room rental exemption, box 3 and VAT treatment), estimated about 8,000 households declared such income, and said no new measures were currently planned while a court case is on appeal.
The Tax Administration's records do not show how large the group is that should declare income from temporary rental of their own home in the income tax return.
Uit de administratie van de Belastingdienst is niet af te leiden hoe groot de groep is die inkomsten uit tijdelijke verhuur van de eigen woning moet aangeven in de aangifte inkomstenbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Gijs van Dijk over reclame door verplichtgestelde pensioenfondsen

MPs Van Weyenberg and Gijs van Dijk asked whether a mandatory pension fund's national TV advertising campaign (EUR 1.3 million in 2018) is appropriate, how it is supervised and reported, and whether targeted letters would be cheaper. The minister confirmed no specific advertising rules exist beyond AFM supervision of information duties, said communication costs are not separately reported, and left the choice of media to the fund's board and works council.
In PFZW's annual report, communication costs are not listed separately.
In het jaarverslag van PFZW worden de communicatiekosten niet apart vermeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Nijboer, Snels, Van Weyenberg, Omtzigt, Lodders en Leijten over een nieuw datalek bij Mossack Fonseca

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a new Mossack Fonseca data leak, how the Tax Authority will use the data, the yield and cost of Panama Papers work, the promised business case on strengthening its information position, and staffing outflow. The State Secretary confirmed awareness, said analysis will start once the data is public, and stated that costs and yields cannot be separately tracked or directly linked, promising a broader assessment and information to parliament on Prinsjesdag 2018.

I will inform the House on Prinsjesdag 2018 to what extent additional investment in strengthening the Tax Authority's information position and enforcement capacity could benefit tax revenues and its enforcement strategy.

Ik informeer uw Kamer op Prinsjesdag 2018 in hoeverre een extra investering op het terrein van de versterking van de informatiepositie en de opsporingscapaciteit van de Belastingdienst de belastingopbrengsten en ook de handhavingstrategie van de Belastingdienst ten goede kan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins, Van Weyenberg en Lodders over rulings over de dividendbelasting

MPs Omtzigt, Bruins, Van Weyenberg and Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance about the full dividend-tax ruling policy of the past fifteen years, whether companies can pay dividends to zero-dividend-tax jurisdictions, how many dividend-tax rulings exist, whether they comply with law, and whether the commission examined pre-2015 rulings. The State Secretary answered that no separate ruling policy exists beyond the Verzamelbesluit, that counts of rulings were not systematically kept, that rulings are checked on procedure, and that the independent commission examined a random sample of 2017 APA/ATR rulings including some dividend-tax ones.
The number of cases in which advance certainty was given on the application of the Dividend Tax Act 1965 has not been systematically recorded over the past 15 years.
Het aantal gevallen waarin zekerheid vooraf is gegeven over de toepassing van de Wet op de dividendbelasting 1965 is niet systematisch bijgehouden in de afgelopen 15 jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Raemakers over het niet toekennen van het loonkostenvoordeel na stage

MPs Van Weyenberg and Raemakers asked why employers lose the wage-cost advantage (loonkostenvoordeel) when a paid internship is not followed by timely registration of a target-group declaration, and whether this can be corrected. Minister Koolmees explained the three-month registration rule, said UWV will inform employers, and that he is examining a one-off 2018 exception for workers hired directly after a paid internship.
To ensure the target-group declaration is requested in time, UWV will actively inform employers, possibly via the education institutions involved.
Om ervoor te zorgen dat de doelgroepverklaring tijdig wordt aangevraagd, zal het UWV de werkgevers, al dan niet via de betrokken onderwijsinstellingen, actief gaan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over grenswerkers die klem zitten tussen de Nederlandse en Duitse Belastingdienst

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary of Finance about cross-border workers and self-employed people caught between Dutch and German tax authorities, including whether problems are increasing, how Team GWO handles questions, and how information is provided. The State Secretary answered that no data show a rise in such cases, described the existing information structure (Team GWO, border info points, outreach), and said cooperation with other tax authorities is generally good.
However, there are no figures available on all cases where problems arise from different interpretation of those tax rules in relation to Germany.
Er zijn echter geen cijfers beschikbaar van alle gevallen waar zich problemen voordoen door verschillende interpretatie van die (belasting)regels in relatie tot Duitsland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over een financieel nadeel voor docenten die in België wonen en in Nederland hun beroep uitoefenen

Two MPs from D66 asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Education whether teachers living in Belgium but working in the Netherlands face a financial disadvantage from double tax-premium coordination, and whether the teacher clause in the Dutch-Belgian tax treaty should be changed. The government confirmed the mismatch under the treaty's two-year residence-state taxation rule, said the Netherlands no longer aims for such clauses, and stated that the issue is being raised in ongoing treaty negotiations with Belgium.
The Netherlands has already raised the issue of the professor clause with the aim of resolving the problem.
Nederland heeft de problematiek met betrekking tot de hooglerarenbepaling al aan de orde gesteld met als doel de genoemde problematiek op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over claims door pensioenfondsen met terugwerkende kracht

An MP asked whether pension funds pursue employers retroactively for unpaid premiums and whether this is proportionate given employers' finances and dual-pension situations. The minister confirmed the practice, stated that funds must treat all covered employers equally regardless of finances while allowing payment arrangements, and explained exemption options for past periods but offered no new commitments.
I have no insight into the exemption and collection policy of individual industry-wide pension funds.
Ik heb geen zicht op het vrijstellings- en incassobeleid van individuele bedrijfstakpensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Groothuizen over het verplichtgestelde pensioenfonds voor notarissen

MPs Van Weyenberg and Groothuizen asked whether there is sufficient support among notaries for the statutory obligation to join the notarial pension fund, given a survey showing the 60% representativeness norm is not met. The government answered that mandatory participation for notaries rests on the Wna itself, that the desirability of compulsory membership is a matter for the profession, and declined to comment on the survey figures.

Given this responsibility of the notaries themselves, I am of the view that the figures from the support survey, their interpretation and any conclusions drawn from them are a matter for the notaries themselves.

Gezien deze verantwoordelijkheid van de beroepsgenoten in het notariaat zelf, ben ik van mening dat de cijfers die uit het draagvlakonderzoek naar voren komen, de interpretatie daarvan alsmede eventuele conclusies naar aanleiding daarvan een zaak van de beroepsgenoten in het notariaat onderling is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over ontslag uit het verantwoordingsorgaan

An MP asked the minister whether pension fund Atos's amended articles allowing its board to dismiss supervisory council (verantwoordingsorgaan) members are acceptable, and what legal protection such members have. The minister answered that the conditions were added under pension law and the Code Pensioenfondsen, that members are elected by beneficiaries so the board cannot choose them alone, and that a governance evaluation is forthcoming.
These concern conditions on integrity and fulfilment of the required tasks and responsibilities.
Dit betreffen voorwaarden omtrent integriteit en vervulling van de vereiste taken en verantwoordelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weyenberg en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Rijken mijden fiscus langs nieuwe route’

Members Weyenberg and Paternotte (D66) asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that wealthy individuals use open funds for joint account (fonds voor gemene rekening) to avoid tax, and whether these funds sit outside the UBO register and enable access to allowances. The State Secretary answered that the tax saving depends on actual returns, that UBO registration for such funds is under study with the UBO register planned for summer 2018, that registrations rose to about 550 by mid-August 2017 with over 25% rejected, and that no legislative measures were taken for now given the caretaker cabinet.
At present it is being examined whether the obligation to register UBO information should also apply to funds for joint account.
Op dit moment wordt onderzocht of de verplichting tot het registreren van UBO-informatie ook moet gaan gelden voor fondsen voor gemene rekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat artsen via hun pensioenfonds verplicht in tabak beleggen

An MP asked whether the government, as employer, can influence ABP's investment policy on tobacco and how participants can have more say over it. The state secretary replied that ABP's board and accountability body govern investments, that employer and employee representatives are involved, and that the government does not directly steer the policy.
The central government is one of the many public and education employers affiliated with ABP.
De rijksoverheid is één van de vele overheids- en onderwijswerkgevers die is aangesloten bij het ABP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat bedrijven het convenant Werk en Kanker ondertekenen

An MP asked whether the government will sign the Werk en Kanker covenant, what it will do about stigma and discrimination against former cancer patients, and about D66's proposals. The minister said the covenant is a private initiative, the government as employer already ensures equal treatment, and the minister will wait for the results of the no-risk policy experiment and the AFM review of insurers' claim assessment.
I want to await the outcomes of this.
Ik wil de uitkomsten hiervan afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over uitstel van de beslistermijn Pensioen Eigen Beheer

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the consequences of directors-major shareholders not stopping PEB accrual by 1 July 2017, how they were informed, and why the deadline should not be extended. The State Secretary answered that accrual must stop by 1 July 2017 due to tax rules, that the Tax Administration informed affected parties extensively, and that further extension is undesirable.
Further postponement is undesirable from a policy perspective and illogical because pension would then continue to accrue for even longer, which would then have to be phased out again.
Verder uitstel is beleidsmatig onwenselijk en niet logisch omdat dan nóg langer pensioen wordt opgebouwd dat vervolgens weer moet worden uitgefaseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over uitstel beslistermijn Pensioen in Eigen Beheer

MP Van Weyenberg asked about the deadline for ending pension-in-own-business (PEB) accrual, a survey showing many directors unaware of the phase-out, and information provided by the government. The Secretary of State answered that the only requirement by 1 July 2017 is to stop accrual, that decisions can be made until end 2019, that outreach has been extensive, and that no extension of the grace period is needed.
In my view, the Tax Authority has therefore done everything to provide the necessary information, and affected parties or their service providers should therefore be informed.

Naar mijn mening is er dus vanuit de Belastingdienst alles aan gedaan om de noodzakelijke informatie te verstrekken en zouden belanghebbenden dan wel hun dienstverleners dan ook op de hoogte moeten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de Wet arbeid vreemdelingen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Dutch foreign workers act (Wav), specifically who counts as an 'other employer' liable for checking identity documents, including private individuals who hire cleaning firms and whether sanctions apply. The minister confirmed that clients including private persons must verify identity and keep copies, that the Inspectorate SZW does not enforce this against private households, and gave fine statistics for 2014-2016.
No copy of the identity document needs to be provided if the foreign national is a national of a country party to the European Economic Area, of the European Union, or of Switzerland.

Er hoeft geen kopie van het identiteitsbewijs te worden verstrekt als de vreemdeling onderdaan is van een land dat partij is bij de Europese Economische Ruimte, onderdaan is van de Europese Unie of van Zwitserland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over uiteenlopende eisen aan het recht op nabestaandenpensioen

MP Van Weyenberg (D66) asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about differing partner definitions for survivors' pensions and what was done with the Stichting van de Arbeid recommendation on unmarried cohabitants. The State Secretary answered that most pension funds already include unmarried cohabitants, that most fund rules no longer require marriage or registered partnership, and that the situation may be reconsidered after the small pensions transfer bill takes effect.
If it becomes clear in time whether the small pensions value transfer bill has an effect on this point (as indicated in answer 2), it can be considered whether further measures are needed.
Als op termijn duidelijk is of het wetsvoorstel waardeoverdracht klein pensioen effect heeft op dit punt (zoals aangegeven in antwoord 2), kan worden bezien of nadere maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Ronnes, Omtzigt, Jetten en Van Weyenberg over het bericht in de Trouw van 4 mei 2017 “Staatsbedrijf NS ontwijkt fiscus weer”

MPs from CDA and D66 asked the government about reports that state-owned NS avoids Dutch tax via an Irish leasing subsidiary, including whether the 2015 agreements were honoured and how much tax is lost. The minister defended the arrangement as consistent with a 'level playing field' for foreign concessions, and refused to give tax figures citing secrecy rules and business confidentiality while promising phase-out of the Irish route on Dutch lines.

A more detailed specification of amounts I cannot give because under article 67 of the AWR I cannot make statements about the taxes of individual taxpayers, as business confidentiality precludes this.

Een nadere specificatie van bedragen kan ik niet geven omdat ik op grond van artikel 67 van de AWR geen uitspraken kan doen over de belastingen van individuele belastingplichtigen omdat bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid zich hiertegen verzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Van Weyenberg over korting van het pensioenfonds Caribisch Nederland

MPs Diertens and Van Weyenberg asked why the new financial assessment framework (nFTK) was not applied to the Caribbean Netherlands pension fund PCN, what the effects of its introduction would be, and about pension cuts, the court case with the State, income effects and flanking policy. The government answered that the nFTK cannot be transplanted directly, that it would not improve PCN's financial position, that a 3.5% cut has been applied with income effects of up to 1.4%, that no compensation is planned, and that talks with employers and PCN are ongoing.
In short, adapting the supervisory framework for the Caribbean Netherlands requires a separate assessment and separate legislation.
Kortom, een aanpassing van het toetsingskader voor Caribisch Nederland vraagt om een eigenstandige afweging en aparte wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht 'Aantal ZZP’ers dat opdrachten misloopt verdrievoudigd, ondanks uitstel handhaving DBA'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why opdrachtgevers still avoid giving work to zzp'ers despite the suspension of DBA enforcement, and what research is underway on the criteria. The State Secretary acknowledged remaining concerns, stated that model contracts are optional, said the research on 'vrije vervanging' and 'gezagsverhouding' will be sent to the informateur and then to parliament, and aimed to clarify the timeline before the summer recess.
The results of this research will be presented to the informateur in the short term so that it
De resultaten van dit onderzoek zullen op korte termijn aan de informateur worden aangeboden opdat het
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over antwoorden op eerdere vragen over het korten van nabestaandenpensioen op de IOW-uitkering

MP Van Weyenberg asks why partner income is not offset against the IOW benefit while a survivor's pension is, and whether this is consistent for a minimum-needs scheme. The minister confirms partner income is not counted, explains the IOW's hybrid character as an individual benefit tied to the 2006 WW duration limit, and acknowledges that offsetting survivor's pensions is consistent with other minimum schemes like the Participatiewet.
The income of a partner of an IOW beneficiary is indeed not taken into account when determining the amount of the IOW benefit.
Het inkomen van een partner van een IOW-gerechtigde wordt inderdaad niet meegerekend bij het bepalen van de hoogte van de IOW-uitkering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenbergover de vaststelling van het dagloon voor een WIA-uitkering

An MP asked why WW benefits paid after the reference year are excluded from the WIA daily wage calculation, and whether the resulting timing effect (up to about €15.77 lower daily wage in the example given) is an unintended consequence. The minister explained the UWV's loon-in payroll system, said the effect is deliberate under the Dagloonbesluit, and rejected changing the system because it would raise employer administrative burdens.
The Dagloonbesluit werknemersverzekeringen deliberately allows the UWV to use the wages or benefits recorded in the policy administration.
In het Dagloonbesluit werknemersverzekeringen is er bewust voor gekozen dat het UWV gebruik kan maken van het loon dat of de uitkering die in de polisadministratie is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het korten van nabestaandenpensioen op de IOW-uitkering

An MP asked why a survivor's pension is deducted in full from an IOW unemployment benefit when the partner's income is not counted in that benefit's calculation, and how many recipients are affected. The minister confirmed the deduction as overig inkomen under the Algemeen inkomensbesluit, justified it by the IOW's minimum-needs character, and said the number affected is not available from the system.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht “Onrealistische AOW-leeftijd op pensioenoverzicht” van radar.avrotros.nl

An MP asked whether the Stichting Pensioenregister's pension overview site would show the expected AOW (state pension) age, and when. The Secretary of State replied that an impact analysis concluded showing amounts at the expected AOW age was too uncertain, so only the expected AOW age would be shown, with a link to an SVB calculator and a planned integration review.
The board has informed me that it will, in the short term, point more clearly where possible to the rise in the AOW age.
Het bestuur heeft mij laten weten op korte termijn waar mogelijk nog beter te wijzen op de stijging van de AOW-leeftijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Schouten over dubbele kinderbijslag voor ouders met kinderen met autisme

MPs Van Weyenberg and Schouten asked the minister about double child benefit for parents of children with autism, including diagnosis mix, how parents demonstrate intensive care needs, the CIZ assessment framework and evaluation, and handling of parental letters. The minister answered that most approved children have only an autism diagnosis, explained the assessment criteria and procedure, reported a parent meeting, and announced process improvements and a policy review.
Exact numbers cannot be given because the information cannot be retrieved directly from the automated systems.
Exacte aantallen zijn niet te geven omdat de informatie niet rechtreeks uit de geautomatiseerde systemen is te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over de wijziging van het zetelverdrag van het Joegoslaviëtribunaal

Two MPs asked whether amendments to the host-state agreement of the Yugoslavia Tribunal extend AOW pension coverage to family members of its staff retroactively to 2009 and why not to 1994 as the UN requested. The minister confirms the 2009 retroactive date, explains it was a goodwill choice rather than a legal obligation, and declines to extend it to 1994 because family members were explicitly excluded in the 1994 agreement.
The decision on retroactive effect is not based on an (international) legal obligation but was chosen as an accommodation for the MICT.
Het besluit met betrekking tot de terugwerkende kracht is niet gebaseerd op een (internationaal) juridische verplichting, maar is gekozen als tegemoetkoming voor het MICT
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Weyenberg over jonge vrouwen die vaak in deeltijd werken

MPs Dijkstra and Van Weyenberg asked about young women working part-time more often than men, its causes, its long-term effects on economic independence, and whether the government will act. The minister answers that causes are not yet clear and are being studied in a joint OCW/SCP project, and points to existing awareness and budgeting initiatives and general part-time work rules, without committing to new legislation.
The causes are not yet clear now; that is precisely the subject of the research.
De oorzaken zijn nu nog niet duidelijk, dat is juist onderwerp van het onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het afschaffen van de Tegemoetkoming Ouders Gehandicapte kinderen (TOG) en problemen met het recht op dubbele kinderbijslag bij ouders met kinderen met autisme

An MP asked whether abolishing the TOG allowance for parents of disabled children and the new intensive-care criteria for double child benefit unfairly exclude parents of children with autism, and how assessments and appeals work. The minister defended the new assessment framework, said autism cases are not refused more often, noted that appeals are possible, and said he sees no reason to revise the criteria now.
Based on the foregoing, I currently see no reason to revise the current assessment framework.
Op basis van voorgaande beantwoording zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding om het huidige beoordelingskader te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het na toestemming toegankelijk maken van pensioenregistergegevens voor ontwikkelaars

Rep. Van Weyenberg asked whether pension fund and independent adviser access to personal pension register data, with participant consent, is blocked and whether the register foundation could enable it. The Secretary of State answered that only participants can access the register, that downloads to third parties are technically possible but unused, and that she will raise the issue with the register board without committing to a timeline.
Yes, insofar as it concerns the possibility outlined in answer 5, I am willing to do so.
Ja, voor zover het gaat over de mogelijkheid geschetst bij antwoord 5 ben ik hiertoe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de inzet van uitzendkrachten bij de Belastingdienst Toeslagen

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary of Finance about dissatisfaction among temporary agency workers at the Belastingdienst Toeslagen, their grading, qualifications, working conditions compared with permanent staff, and the structural use of temp workers. The State Secretary answered that temp workers are paid under the agency CAO and inlenersbeloning, that the Belastingdienst intends to introduce the Functiegebouw Rijk, and that temp use for structural work is justified by peaks and expected reductions, though he did not commit to changing the practice.
The Belastingdienst complies with the frameworks set for equal treatment of temporary agency workers compared with employees appointed at the Belastingdienst.
De Belastingdienst voldoet aan de kaders die gesteld zijn betreffende de gelijke behandeling van uitzendkrachten ten opzichte van medewerkers aangesteld bij de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Weyenberg over de voortdurende totale onzekerheid over het uitstel van handhaving van de wet deregulering beoordeling arbeidsrelaties

MPs Omtzigt and Van Weyenberg asked why the Belastingdienst website gave a broader definition of 'kwaadwillend' (bad-faith) in its enforcement-suspension notice than the state secretary's own definition on the Wet DBA, and who approved it. The state secretary answered that the website text was a communication error, withdrawn after three days, and that the official definition in the Handboek Loonheffingen applies, with roughly ten bad-faith cases expected.
On Friday 2 December the deviating text was replaced by a text that does match the texts exchanged with your House.
Op vrijdag 2 december jl. is die afwijkende tekst vervangen door een tekst die wel aansluit bij de met uw Kamer gewisselde teksten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het al dan niet algemeen verbindend verklaren van de cao besloten busvervoer

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether the new collective agreement for private bus transport should be declared generally binding, given shifting union and employer representation and an early start date. The Minister answers that no request for general binding declaration has been received yet, that representativeness rules and the consultation procedure will be applied if one is filed, and that declining representativeness after adoption does not affect the decision.
Only when a concluded collective agreement is registered with the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment is the government formally informed which parties have contracted.
Pas door aanmelding van een eenmaal afgesloten cao bij het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid wordt de overheid formeel op de hoogte gesteld welke partijen gecontracteerd hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Omtzigt over het VVD-filmpje over de Wet Deregulering Beoordeling Arbeidsrelaties

MPs Van Weyenberg and Omtzigt asked about a VVD video implying the DBA law was postponed, the legal status of enforcement suspension, and plans to change labour law and communicate with clients. Staatssecretaris Wiebes answered that enforcement was postponed (not the law itself), that a separate policy decision is not issued, that a labour-law review is underway with a timeline, and that enforcement will focus on about ten malicious cases.
What has been postponed is, of course, the enforcement.
Wat is uitgesteld is natuurlijk de handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Weyenberg over het door de fiscus meetellen van een PGB-restant voor de vermogenstoets voor toeslagen

Two D66 MPs asked whether a leftover personal budget (pgb) owed back to a care office can count as debt under the box 3 wealth test and whether this wrongly makes some recipients lose housing benefit. The government confirmed the pgb remainder can be declared as debt above the 3,000 euro threshold, but agreed to a hardship arrangement via the Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen for affected cases and to a ministerial regulation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de toetsing van pensioenfondsbestuurders door De Nederlandsche Bank

An MP asked the State Secretary about DNB suitability tests of pension fund board members, including the 24% of reappointed members who did not receive a positive verdict and the 30 members appointed before 2000 who were never tested. The government answered that the 22 members concerned had already passed earlier tests for board membership, that DNB can re-test on reasonable grounds, and that the test framework and figures for 2012-2016 were set out.
There is therefore no question of a pension fund having been governed by board members who turned out to be unsuitable afterwards.
Er is derhalve geen sprake van dat een pensioenfonds bestuurd werd door bestuurders die achteraf ongeschikt bleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht “Nieuwe regels voor aparte indexatiedepots voor Pensioenfondsen” van Rijksoverheid.nl.

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary about new rules allowing separate indexation buffers for pension funds, including whether funding them reduces fund assets for other members and whether DNB advised on them. The State Secretary answered that these buffers are limited to three special situations, are financed under strict conditions without draining assets from other members, and that DNB gave informal input rather than formal advice.
It is not possible to finance an indexation depot by drawing off fund assets to the detriment of the other participants in the fund.
Het is niet mogelijk om een indexatiedepot te financieren door vermogen in het fonds af te romen ten nadele van de overige deelnemers in het fonds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de toetsing van pensioenfondsbestuurders door De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB)

An MP asked whether sitting pension fund board members escape DNB suitability checks, how often reappointed or re-tested board members are assessed, and whether performance is linked to suitability. The Secretary of State confirmed that sitting board members appointed before 30 December 2000 are not tested until reappointment, gave re-test and reappointment figures, and said no specific study links fund performance to board suitability.
I have not considered having sitting pension fund board members also undergo a one-time test.
Ik heb niet overwogen om ook zittende pensioenfondsbestuurders eenmalig een toets te laten afleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Fiscus weert publiek in rechtszaal’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why the public was excluded from a tax court hearing on the savings tax case, and how this fits government transparency goals. The State Secretary answered that tax hearings are closed by default for privacy and business-data reasons, that the Tax Authority opposed the journalist's presence, and that it will instruct inspectors to agree to public hearings in mass objection procedures while publication of anonymised judgments continues.
Hearings in tax procedures take place in principle behind closed doors.
Zittingen in belastingprocedures vinden in beginsel achter gesloten deuren plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat de verkoop van elektrische en hybride auto’s fors is afgenomen

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about reports that sales of electric and hybrid cars fell, whether the 2016 rise in the company car tax (bijtelling) explains it, and how this fits with climate, air quality and energy goals and earlier motions to stimulate electric driving. The minister answered that electric car sales keep growing steadily, that the PHEV decline is partly due to the tax change, that EU-level emission standards are the preferred instrument, and that he will inform parliament further in the autumn on the Groot motion.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat Japanners vanaf 1 oktober 2016 een tewerkstellingsvergunning moeten aanvragen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about an interpretive declaration to the Dutch-Swiss treaty that would require Japanese nationals to obtain work permits, and why Parliament was not informed earlier. The minister answered that the declaration restores the original intent of both states, that a transition period extends the work-permit requirement to 1 January 2017, and that Parliament was not informed because effects were expected to be limited.
I have answered the questions as quickly as possible.
Ik heb de vragen zo snel als mogelijk beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Opdrachtgevers haken af door afschaffing VAR’

MP Van Weyenberg (D66) asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that clients were withdrawing from freelancer hiring after the VAR was abolished, and about how the Tax Authority supervises model agreements under the DBA Act. The State Secretary replied that the DBA Act does not change the legal test for employment, outlined guidance and case statistics, and explained the enforcement approach, burden of proof and transitional arrangements.
After the summer recess I will therefore send you a letter giving you insight into what the Tax Authority has achieved with partners in various sectors
Na het zomerreces stuur ik u daarom een brief waarin ik u inzicht geef over hetgeen door de Belastingdienst met de partners in verschillende sectoren is bereikt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht “Staatssecretaris Wiebes en zijn eigen Belastingdienst hanteren verschillende criteria rond (schijn)zelfstandigheid”

MP Van Weyenberg (D66) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Tax Authority treats a freelancer doing the same work as an employee, such as a temporary replacement, as an employment relationship, and why clients cannot hire self-employed people as replacements. The State Secretary answered that clients may hire freelancers for temporary replacement, that such an arrangement is judged on its own fiscal merits, and that it becomes an employment relationship only if the replacement works in the same way and under the same conditions as the employee replaced.
A working relationship, including a temporary one replacing someone employed, is assessed on its own fiscal merits.
Een arbeidsrelatie, ook een tijdelijke ter vervanging van iemand die in loondienst is, wordt op zijn eigen fiscale merites beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij, Pieter Heerma en Van Weyenberg over schoonmakers in de hotelbranche die zwaar onderbetaald worden door middel van stukloon

MPs asked whether the government knew of and would act on reports that hotel cleaners are underpaid through piece-rate pay, and whether the Inspectorate had checked the hotel sector and whether government contracts with implicated hotel chains would end. The minister said the Inspectorate checked hotel cleaning in 2015 (94 cases opened, 16 violations found in closed cases), that government contracts run through intermediaries under generic social conditions with possible stricter clauses in future, and that cleaning in hotels remains under the Inspectorate's focus.
In 2015 the Inspectorate SZW carried out inspections of cleaning in the hotel sector.
In 2015 heeft de Inspectie SZW controles uitgevoerd naar schoonmaak in de hotelbranche.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Verhoeven over minimumtarieven voor zelfstandigen zonder personeel in collectieve arbeidsovereenkomsten

MPs Van Weyenberg and Verhoeven asked whether cao rate agreements for self-employed workers without staff (zzp'ers) in the architects' cao breach the Dutch cartel prohibition, and whether such rules should be declared generally binding. The minister answered that competition enforcement belongs to the ACM, that the avv-procedure is still ongoing, that the cao rules are not generally binding for now due to competition risk, and that no further guidelines on bogus self-employment are needed.
It is therefore only up to the ACM to make statements in individual cases.
Het is dan ook slechts aan de ACM om uitspraken te doen in individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat de Belastingtelefoon wederom een onvoldoende heeft gekregen

The MP asks why the Tax Authority's helpline (Belastingtelefoon) again received a poor rating from the Consumentenbond, why service has not improved since 2014, and what concrete measures will be taken. The State Secretary replies that the consumer test covers highly specialised questions, that the Tax Authority's own IPSOS research shows 89% of questions answered correctly, and that complex questions will be redirected to the website library or tax advisers, with no commitment to a specific rating target.

The Tax Authority is working towards a new way of interaction with a sharper distinction between status and general substantive questions on the one hand, and more complex, case-specific questions on the other.

De Belastingdienst werkt toe naar een nieuwe manier van interactie met een scherper onderscheid tussen status- en meer algemeen-inhoudelijke vragen enerzijds, en complexere, casusspecifieke vragen anderzijds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat het bedrijf Raet de bovenwettelijke aanvullingen op de WW gaat uitvoeren

MP Van Weyenberg asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that private firm Raet would administer supplementary unemployment benefits, including the data sharing with UWV, privacy safeguards and costs. The minister answered that ssocial partners are responsible for the scheme's design, premiums and data arrangements, that no UWV-Raet agreement yet exists, and that privacy and cost questions will be clarified later.
I am not aware of how exactly social partners intend to shape the supplementary WW benefits.
Het is mij niet bekend op welke wijze sociale partners de bovenwettelijke WW-aanvullingen exact willen vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Pieter Heerma over het bericht ‘Een nieuwe baan en tóch het UWV op je dak: ‘Het lijkt verdorie wel Kafka’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs why WW unemployment benefit recipients who have already found a new job still face job-search obligations, and whether this discourages keeping small benefits and risks losing accrued employment history. The minister replied that job-search duties attach to benefit receipt, that the Wwz gives a three-month exemption for same-hours work, that the mismatch with employment history is likely a misunderstanding because prior work counts again in a new WW claim, and that the effectiveness of these duties for employed recipients has not been studied.
Even before the Wwz took effect, WW recipients who received a benefit alongside a job were subject to a job-search obligation.
Ook voor de inwerkingtreding van de Wwz was sprake van een sollicitatieplicht voor de WW-gerechtigde die een uitkering ontving naast een baan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst startende ondernemers laat wachten

MP Van Weyenberg (D66) asked whether the Tax Authority's delays in issuing VAT numbers to start-up entrepreneurs, a recurring January peak, were foreseen and what will prevent repetition. State Secretary Wiebes answered that extra capacity was deployed but proved insufficient this year, that processing times have fallen to seven working days, and that the Tax Authority knows of no hardship and has received no complaints.
Measures have now been taken to clear the backlog.
Inmiddels zijn maatregelen getroffen om de achterstand weg te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over naheffingen voor zzp’ers in de zorg

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary of Finance how many self-employed care workers had their VAR-wuo converted into a VAR-loon, how large the resulting back-tax assessments were, and whether these could be undone given the changed Tax Authority assessment practice from October 2013. The State Secretary answered that 257 care workers were converted in 2013, 104 in 2015, that the average correction was EUR 14,000, and that no change in assessment practice occurred, so legal remedies via objection and appeal remain the route.
It is procedurally incorrect to assume that a VAR-wuo can be requested.
Het is procedureel niet juist om te veronderstellen dat een VAR-wuo kan worden aangevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Veldhoven over het beleid om op basis van de typegoedkeuringswaarde CO2 gedifferentieerde belastingen vast te stellen

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Veldhoven asked whether the Finance Ministry knew of the growing gap between type-approval and real-world CO2 figures used for car taxes, and why no alternative basis was studied, plus the Volkswagen tax impact and planned action. The state secretary answered that the ministry was aware through TNO and Court of Audit work, that alternatives were judged impractical pending the WLTP test, that Volkswagen-related revenue losses are expected to be very limited and clarity is expected in early 2016, and that Autobrief II measures address the plug-in hybrid gap.
The cabinet is aware of the gap between standard and real-world consumption and has informed the House on several occasions.
Het kabinet is bekend met de afwijking tussen norm- en praktijkverbruik en heeft daar uw Kamer bij verschillende gelegenheden over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Van Weyenberg over DigiD in het buitenland

Two D66 MPs asked whether a German resident of Belgium with a former Dutch business cannot obtain a DigiD, and so cannot access his pension and health insurance data online, and how this squares with EU free movement. Minister Plasterk confirmed that DigiD requires Dutch nationality for non-residents, justified as identity-fraud prevention, and said this may change once the EU eIDAS regulation takes effect, while stating that EU free movement rights do not include a right to digital communication with foreign authorities.
That will probably become possible in the near future.
Dat zal in de nabije toekomst wel tot de mogelijkheden kunnen gaan behoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Verhoeven over minimumtarieven voor zzp'ers in cao’s

MPs Van Weyenberg and Verhoeven asked whether collective agreements may set minimum fee rates for self-employed workers without staff, and how this relates to bogus self-employment, competition law and tax treatment. Minister Asscher answered that such clauses likely fall under the cartel prohibition unless the workers are bogus self-employed, that the ACM decides on bogus self-employment, and that the agreement has no effect on tax deductions or the Belastingdienst's assessment.
Whether or not there are bogus self-employed workers does not appear from this collective agreement provision.
Of al dan niet sprake is van schijnzelfstandigen blijkt niet uit deze cao-afspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Voortman over de uitzending van Radar ‘Kinderopvangtoeslag’

MPs Van Weyenberg and Voortman asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether it is fair that families with a fully disabled parent receive no childcare allowance when the other parent works, and whether a hardship clause or other flexibility should be introduced. The minister answered that the Sociaal Medische Indicatie (SMI) lets municipalities compensate such families, that municipalities are best placed to judge individual cases, that no new statutory route for the Belastingdienst is foreseen, and that the matter is for municipalities under their duty of care.
It is up to the municipal council to monitor the mayor and aldermen on the implementation of SMI.
Het is aan de gemeenteraad om het college van burgemeester en wethouders te controleren inzake de uitvoering van SMI.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over het vergoeden van een doventolk door het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Meenen asked why people over 30 are denied a sign-language interpreter for study, and how that fits with policy easing study for older adults. The government explains the 30-year limit for education funding, notes that UWV can fund interpreters for work-related training under conditions, and says a study has been started.
The outcome of the consultation is that a study will be started on behalf of the Ministries of Education, Culture and Science, Health, Welfare and Sport, and Social Affairs and Employment.

Uitkomst van het overleg is dat er in opdracht van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (OCW), het Ministerie van VWS en het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (SZW) een onderzoek wordt gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het moment van openbaarmaking van het rapport ‘Nederlandse Moslimjongeren en de Arabische herfst’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why the Motivaction report on Dutch Muslim youth was published without the additional research Motivaction reportedly advised, and whether the earlier answers still hold. The minister states that the answers remain current, that the matter was discussed with FORUM and Motivaction, that no party objected to publication before further research, and that he announced follow-up research in January 2015.
No signals were given by either party indicating that they were opposed to publication before first conducting additional in-depth research.
Er zijn geen signalen afgegeven door beide partijen waaruit is gebleken dat zij tegen openbaarmaking waren alvorens eerst aanvullend verdiepend onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de uitvoering van de motie-Van Weyenberg om de aanmeldtermijn voor de vrijwillige verzekering te verlengen

MP Van Weyenberg asked the minister why he has not announced implementation of the adopted motion to extend the enrolment period for voluntary disability insurance to at least 26 weeks, despite his earlier objections. The minister acknowledges the motion and its adoption but declines to give an implementation date, saying the cabinet will address it in its response to the interdepartmental policy study on self-employed workers after the summer.
Despite the fact that the motion was adopted by a large majority of the House, I cannot yet inform you about the implementation of the motion.
Ondanks het feit dat de motie is aangenomen door een ruime meerderheid van de Kamer, kan ik u nu nog niet informeren over de uitvoering van de motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht “Arbeidswet bedreigt Nederlandse speelfilms”

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Social Affairs about planned changes to the rules exempting children from the child labour ban for film, television, musical and ballet work, including a cut from 24 to 18 performance days and limits on two shows per day, and how these compare with other countries and sports schools. The Minister answered that practice has outgrown the rules, that the aim is clarity and a child-first approach, that the proposal counts days rather than performances, that consultation responses are still being assessed, and that no negative experiences are known.
I am currently studying the input and intend, insofar as relevant, to invite parties to further explain their input.
Ik bestudeer thans de inbreng en heb het voornemen, voor zover relevant, partijen uit te nodigen voor een nadere toelichting op hun inbreng.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat het Bedrijfstakpensioenfonds voor de Zeevisserij haar nieuwe regeling onderbrengt bij het Pensioenfonds Grafisch Bedrijf

Parliamentarian Van Weyenberg (D66) asked the State Secretary whether the Bedrijfstakpensioenfonds voor de Zeevisserij could move its new scheme into the Pensioenfonds Grafisch Bedrijf without expanding that fund's statutory scope, and whether this conflicts with the earlier call for restraint in such expansions. The State Secretary answered that extending the compulsory scheme to another sector is permitted under current law, that the issue of limiting such moves raises principled questions to be addressed within the future pension system, and that PGB plans to offer premium schemes from 2016.
That is permitted under current legislation.
Dat is toegestaan binnen de huidige wetgeving.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Weyenberg over welke mensen verplicht moeten deelnemen aan het pensioenfonds voor de uitzendbranche, StiPP, nu de ontslagregeling een andere definitie heeft van uitzendwerkg

MPs Omtzigt and Van Weyenberg asked whether payroll and secondment workers must remain covered by the StiPP pension fund, given that the 2015 dismissal rules define employment agencies differently by requiring an allocation function. The State Secretary answered that the dismissal definitions apply only to that regulation, that the StiPP scope is set by its parties (with a pending Supreme Court case), and promised a bill on equal pension treatment for payroll workers after the summer.
The relevant bill will be submitted to your House after the summer.
Het betreffende wetsvoorstel zal na de zomer bij uw Kamer worden ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over uiteenlopende eisen aan het recht op nabestaandenpensioen

An MP asked why pension funds differ in whether survivor's pension requires marriage or registered partnership, and whether this is fair. The government said most funds cover cohabitants, the legal definition of partner imposes no extra conditions on the relationship, and it will raise the issue with social partners rather than act directly.
Contacts with the Pensioenfederatie and the Stichting van de Arbeid have shown willingness to bring this matter to the attention of decentralised parties involved in collective bargaining.
Uit contacten met de Pensioenfederatie en de Stichting van de Arbeid is gebleken dat er bereidheid bestaat om deze zaak onder de aandacht te brengen van decentrale partijen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over discriminatie door de Inspectie SZW

An MP asked the minister about discrimination by the Inspectie SZW after the Raad van State annulled an inspection decision because identity checks were triggered by dark hair and skin tone, and whether such practices are standard.
