The minister condemned the remark, said it is not an inspection method or risk indicator, and announced training, a written instruction and the start of a discrimination inspection team.
This case gives rise to the following measures.
Deze zaak geeft aanleiding om de volgende maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het algemeen verbindend verklaren van de cao Besloten Busvervoer

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Social Affairs why article 48 of the Besloten Busvervoer collective agreement was declared generally binding without clarifying that it does not apply to self-employed contractors, as a Tilburg court ruled, and how enforcement distinguishes sham self-employed from genuine ones. The minister answered that the generally binding declaration includes the explanatory interpretation in the decree, that the court ruling and CJEU case law guide its scope, and that the FSO enforces the agreement, with no change to the text required.
Article 48 of the Besloten Busvervoer collective agreement was declared generally binding with due regard to the considerations made about that article in the general-binding decree.
Artikel 48 van de cao Besloten Busvervoer is algemeen verbindend verklaard met inachtneming van de overwegingen die ten aanzien van dat artikel in het avv-besluit zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Weekcontracten: de nieuwe schijnconstructie van uitzendbureaus’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that staffing agencies use rolling weekly contracts to get around the chain-contract rule, which ends in a permanent contract after a set period. The minister answered that no law or collective agreement is broken, explained how the 26-week period and the Wwz changes work, and said structural work should preferably be done under a direct permanent or fixed-term contract rather than through agency contracts.
I cannot infer from this that the law or the collective agreement has been violated.
Ik kan hieruit niet opmaken dat in strijd met de wet of de cao is gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over het bericht ‘Leerwerkplekken in de knel door ontslagregels’

D66 MPs asked whether apprenticeship (BBL) contracts are exempt from the chain-employment rule and the transition payment, and how the transition payment affects training places. The minister answered that BBL contracts are exempt from the new chain rule, that they are not exempt from the transition payment but employers may deduct training costs under a new decree, and that the effect on training places will be monitored.
This has partly led the cabinet to decide, by general administrative order, that training costs may be deducted from the transition payment.
Dat heeft er mede toe geleid dat het kabinet heeft besloten om bij amvb te bepalen dat kosten van de opleiding in mindering kunnen worden gebracht op de transitievergoeding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over het bericht ‘Leerling naar huis door invallerlimiet’

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Meenen asked why school boards still resist replacing teachers despite the Wwz flexibility options, and whether the Wwz's entry into force in primary education should be delayed if the PO-Raad and unions fail to agree by 1 July 2015. The minister answers that board reactions stem from unfamiliarity with Wwz options, that the current CO primary education cao continues until 1 July 2016 under transitional law, and that boards may keep existing temporary-contract and min/max arrangements until then.
Reports from the PO-Raad and the unions of 1 May show that the parties have agreed not to conclude a new primary education collective agreement at this time.
Uit de berichtgeving van de PO-Raad en de bonden van 1 mei jl. blijkt dat partijen hebben afgesproken om op dit moment geen nieuwe cao voor het primair onderwijs af te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Weyenberg inzake de vastgelopen cao-onderhandelingen in het voortgezet onderwijs

MPs Van Meenen and Van Weyenberg asked the State Secretary for Education about stalled collective bargaining in secondary education, including the wage adjustment budget, whether lower ABP pension premiums created room for scholarships, and whether employers should pass the premium cut on to employees. The State Secretary answered that collective bargaining is decentralised, that employers decide how the cabinet contribution is used, and that he is not a party to the negotiations, declining to press employers and only promising to monitor developments.
That means it is up to the employers to decide how the cabinet contribution is used for the terms of employment.
Dat betekent dat het aan de werkgevers is om te bepalen op welke wijze de kabinetsbijdrage wordt ingezet voor de arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Berndsen-Jansen, Van Weyenberg en Koolmees over het bericht dat een farmaceutisch bedrijf dat zich onlangs in Nederland heeft gevestigd, doodstraf-medicatie levert aan de Amerik

MPs from D66 asked whether Dutch-based pharmaceutical company Mylan supplies the muscle relaxant rocuronium bromide for US executions, whether this conflicts with the EU export ban and Dutch policy against the death penalty, whether pension funds should keep investing, whether tax rulings were involved, and whether Mylan will stop. The government neither confirmed nor denied the supply, said the EU export regulation does not cover the drug, pledged to propose adding it to the list and to raise the matter with Mylan, and declined to disclose tax ruling details citing confidentiality law.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act does not permit disclosing information about the tax position of an individual taxpayer, such as Mylan in this case.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen staat niet toe informatie bekend te maken over de belastingpositie van een individuele belastingplichtige, zoals in het onderhavige geval Mylan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het artikel ‘‘Onafhankelijke’ voorzitter beleidsonderzoek zzp krijgt topfunctie bij Financiën”

An MP asked whether appointing the chair of the IBO Zzp study to a directorate-general post at Finance undermines the study's independence and the support for its policy options. The minister replied that the IBO is technical and the chair qualifies for both roles, and that the chair agreed to finish the study as planned, with the report to parliament before summer.
The report will be submitted to the House of Representatives before summer, as previously announced.
Antwoord 6, 7 Het rapport zal – zoals eerder gemeld 2 – voor de zomer aan de Tweede Kamer worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over het effect van de Wet Werk en Zekerheid op invalkrachten in het primair onderwijs

D66 MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the Wwz labour law reform leaves primary schools without enough flexibility to cover sick-leave substitutes, and what guidance schools received. The minister said schools were informed via newsletters, listed available flexibility instruments (substitute pools, zero-hours and min/max contracts, CAO derogations), and stated pool membership and sizing figures while acknowledging it is not exactly determinable how large pools should be.
To let the transition around the amendment of the chain provision proceed smoothly, I have therefore also committed to providing information to education
Om de overgang rondom de wijziging van de ketenbepaling vloeiend te laten verlopen heb ik daarom ook toegezegd om voorlichting te geven aan het onderwijs
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bevallingsverlof dat per dit jaar flexibel kan worden ingezet

An MP asked the minister whether most workers were unaware of the new flexible leave rules in force since 1 January 2015 and what information campaign was planned. The minister replied that information was already distributed via websites, press releases and intermediaries, and that a broader campaign would start in May 2015.
In May an information campaign starts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Jaarcontract niet verlengen bij ziekteverlof’

An MP asked whether insurers may condition sickness-absence insurance on not renewing fixed-term contracts of sick employees, and whether the minister will engage insurers. The minister replied that contract renewal is for employer and employee, that insurers may set coverage conditions which reportedly lapse after 28 days of full work, and declined to talk to insurers, noting they usually negotiate with employers.
Insurers should not interfere in that.
Verzekeraars dienen daar niet tussen te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het verbeteren van de mogelijkheden voor zzp'ers om zich te verzekeren tegen arbeidsongeschiktheid

An MP asked why self-employed workers without staff (zzp'ers) have low uptake of voluntary sickness and disability insurance through UWV, why access is limited to former employees, and why the 13-week enrolment deadline exists. The minister said UWV has improved information without planned additional measures, explained the restriction as continuation of prior coverage and the risk of adverse selection if the deadline were extended or access widened, and said the cabinet's IBO on zzp'ers will address the issue and be sent to parliament before summer.
The cabinet expects to present the IBO to the House of Representatives before the summer.
Het kabinet zal het IBO naar verwachting voor de zomer aanbieden aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Veldhoven over de veiligheid van wegwerkers

D66 MPs asked the ministers about the safety of road workers, including fatal accidents over ten years, whether the union's concerns are shared, trade-offs with traffic, and links to maintenance budgets. The ministers answered that safety follows CROW guidelines, a covenant and inspections are in place, and no link to budgets exists.
At the end of 2014 I concluded a covenant with the construction and infrastructure sector to work more safely.
Eind 2014 heb ik een convenant afgesloten om met de bouw- en infrabranche te komen tot veiliger werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over een AOW-korting voor niet-werkende gezinsleden van Nederlandse werknemers bij diverse internationale organisaties in Nederland

Two D66 MPs asked whether Dutch family members without their own income of staff at various international organisations in the Netherlands build no AOW pension rights because of host-state agreements, and whether this is fair. The Secretary of State answered that these exclusions follow from the seat agreements, that the organisation's wishes are decisive, that recent agreements no longer exclude resident family members, that fewer than 20 persons are affected, and that courts found the exclusion justified.

As indicated above, the exclusion from the Dutch social security system follows from the correct application of applicable seat agreements that the Netherlands has concluded with international organisations established in our country.

Zoals hierboven aangegeven vloeit de uitsluiting van het stelsel van Nederlandse sociale zekerheid voort uit de correcte toepassing van geldende zetelverdragen die Nederland heeft gesloten met in ons land gevestigde volkenrechtelijke organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Bergkamp over het artikel ‘culturele topinstellingen worstelen met regels bij aantrekken van talent van buiten EU’

Two D66 MPs asked why cultural institutions such as the Rijksmuseum, Concertgebouworkest and Nationaal Ballet struggle to hire non-EU talent under work-permit rules, and whether the rules should be relaxed. The minister defended the EU-first principle but acknowledged that the arts need international talent, pointed to existing lower salary thresholds for performing arts, said he would consult the museum sector, and offered talks with the orchestra and ballet, reporting back to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het door het UWV herkeuren van (uitbehandelde) kankerpatiënten

An MP asked the minister about UWV re-assessments of terminally or long-term cancer patients receiving disability benefits, including appeal rates, alleged targets, and guidelines. The minister said no outcome targets exist, appeal data show cancer patients appeal less often but win more often without indicating mistreatment, and a working group on the issue will report in spring 2015.
No requirements or targets are set regarding a desired or undesired outcome in re-assessments concerning the degree of work incapacity.
Er worden geen eisen c.q. targets gesteld ten aanzien van een al dan niet gewenste uitkomst bij herbeoordelingen met betrekking tot de mate van arbeidsongeschiktheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over het sectorplan primair onderwijs

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Meenen asked why the Jong en Oud subsidy in the primary education sector plan excludes young teachers who had a regular paid job in the previous six months, and whether this conflicts with teacher shortage goals. The minister answered that the condition is intended to target labour-market-vulnerable youth, that uptake so far is lagging (25.3 fte applications), and that changing the rules retroactively is undesirable.

An amendment of the Regulation as proposed is not desirable to me, because the measures for hiring vulnerable workers are specifically intended to offer opportunities to people at a distance from the labour market.

Een aanpassing van de Regeling zoals voorgesteld acht ik niet gewenst omdat de maatregelen voor indienstneming van kwetsbare werknemers, bij uitstek zijn bedoeld om personen met een afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt kansen te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Zzp’ers komen langs zijlijn te staan’

Mr Van Weyenberg (D66) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the new rules would push self-employed teachers into employment relationships and whether the enforcement practice in education should change before parliament is informed of the outcome of consultations with the education sector. The State Secretary denied that new rules create a stronger employment relationship, stated that enforcement in education has not changed, and said the outcome of the consultations is expected in Q4 2014, depending on testing a draft convenant.
The Tax Authority expects to have completed the consultations with the education sector in the fourth quarter of 2014.
De Belastingdienst verwacht in het vierde kwartaal 2014 de overleggen met de onderwijssector te hebben afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de hoogte van de AOW-uitkering in het buitenland

An MP asked how many Dutch AOW pensioners live abroad, with which countries treaties exist for checking the cohabitation criterion, how the SVB verifies survival in non-treaty countries, and whether treaties should be pursued more widely. The State Secretary answered that treaty-based enforcement is the policy basis, that few new treaties are feasible, that 21 countries are under negotiation, and that the provisional application of the Costa Rica treaty was ended in 2012.
It has been the aim of the Dutch government, after adoption of the Export Restriction of Benefits bill, to conclude such enforcement treaties with as many countries as possible.
Het is de inzet geweest van de Nederlandse regering om na aanvaarding van het wetsvoorstel Beperking Export Uitkeringen (BEU) met zoveel mogelijk landen een dergelijk handhavingsverdrag te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Schouw over het bericht ‘Sociale Zaken overtrad mogelijk de privacywetgeving’

MPs Van Weyenberg and Schouw (D66) asked Minister Asscher whether SZW linked and analysed databases without a legal basis in its 'Black Box' fraud-detection programme, whether unlawfully obtained evidence was used, and how the CBP supervised it. The minister answered that the linking rested on the Wbp, WWB and SUWI, that the Black Box had been adjusted after CBP findings, and that individuals are not personally informed about the processing.
The number of fraud cases detected with this is not available in aggregated form.
Het aantal fraudegevallen dat hiermee is opgespoord is niet in geaggregeerde vorm beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Rekenfout kost 1,3 miljoen’

An MP asks why six municipalities must repay Wsw sheltered-employment budget for 2011, and whether they can be exempted if they show the money went to jobs. The state secretary answers that the repayments follow from documented under-realisation under the Sisa system, that the municipalities' audited accounts were accepted by their councils, and that she cannot deviate from the statutory rules, though two municipalities have appealed to the court.
Municipalities have an explicit responsibility of their own in this regard.
Gemeenten hebben hierin uitdrukkelijk een eigen verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Van Weyenberg over het hoge ziekteverzuim bij de Rijksoverheid

MPs Schouw and Van Weyenberg asked why sick leave in the central government (5.2% in 2013) is above the national average and the highest of all sectors, whether a target exists, what it costs, and how re-integration and wage sanctions by the UWV can be improved. Minister Blok confirmed the figures, argued that the comparison with the national average is misleading because of age and job-type differences, declined a separate study, set no single sector target, and promised further re-integration measures and a review of sick-pay agreements.
In 2013, a wage sanction was imposed in 23% of WIA applications submitted by employees in the central government, police and judiciary sector.
Bij 23% van de WIA-aanvragen die zijn ingediend door werknemers in de sector «rijksoverheid, politie en rechterlijke macht», is in 2013 een loonsanctie opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Werkgevers vernietigend over ziektewet tijdelijk personeel’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about employers' criticism of the sickness benefit rules for temporary staff and about risk-avoidance and selection under the Wet BeZaVa, and when it will be evaluated. The minister defends the activation measures, says the survey findings on employer behaviour are not yet proven, and promises a monitor and survey by end 2015 and an effect study by late 2016.
I think it is too early to make a statement now about the effects of the Wet BeZaVa, precisely because I expect this law to lead to behavioural changes.
Ik vind het te vroeg om nu al een uitspraak te kunnen doen over de effecten van de Wet BeZaVa, juist omdat ik verwacht dat deze wet zal leiden tot gedragsveranderingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Schouw over het bericht dat haatimams moeten worden aangepakt

Two D66 MPs asked how the government intends to stop hate preachers (haatimams), whether criminal law or a conversation with mayors is the right tool, how often such cases occurred and whether visas or residence permits were refused, and why the focus is on imams rather than other radicalising channels. The ministers answered that visa refusal, administrative measures and criminal law (art. 137d) apply, that no imam-related residence permits were refused on national security grounds in 2012-2014, and that a broader multi-year programme with mosques and local government on radicalisation is planned.
Criminal law applies (article 137d of the Criminal Code) to public statements that incite hatred against people because of their race, religion or belief.
Het strafrecht is van toepassing (artikel 137d Wetboek van Strafrecht) op openbare uitspraken die aanzetten tot haat tegen mensen wegens hun ras, godsdienst of levensovertuiging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Anne Mulder over de rechterlijke uitspraak dat de FNV vakbondsleden voortrekt.

MPs Van Weyenberg and Anne Mulder asked whether a court ruling that FNV unfairly gave union members higher severance under a social plan breaches good employer conduct, whether the Postcodeloterij comparison is apt, what legal framework allows union-member benefits, whether courts or the Inspectie SZW should review such agreements, how the government acted on a motion against disadvantaging non-members, and what measures it would take. The minister answered that contractual freedom permits distinctions only within limits of good employer conduct and equal pay, that courts rather than the government review such clauses, that social partners say existing law suffices, and that no measures are planned.
A ruling on the legal validity of a collective agreement provision such as in the above-mentioned lawsuit is reserved for the civil court.
Een oordeel over de rechtsgeldigheid van een cao-bepaling zoals bedoeld in de bovengenoemde rechtszaak, is voorbehouden aan de burgerlijke rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over leerlingen in het vmbo en praktijkonderwijs die geen stage mogen lopen

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Meenen asked why students without a permanent residence permit can only do compulsory internships in BOL vocational courses and not in vmbo, praktijkonderwijs or hbo. The minister acknowledged the exemption was an omission, said he would extend the exemption to praktijkonderwijs, vmbo maatwerk routes and similar tracks, but not to hbo.
This is an omission. Besides mbo, there are other secondary education routes specifically aimed at acquiring work-placement experience, so that an internship is an essential part of the course.

Dit is een omissie. Naast het mbo zijn er andere onderwijsroutes in het voortgezet onderwijs die specifiek gericht zijn op het opdoen van beroepspraktijkvorming waardoor stage een essentieel onderdeel van de opleiding vormt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat ambtenaren gegevens van bekende Nederlanders bekijken

MPs Ulenbelt and Van Weyenberg asked about reports that municipal staff looked up records of well-known Dutch people in the Suwinet system without need, and what measures had been taken since November 2013. The state secretary called such access unacceptable, outlined VNG and CBP measures, a planned escalation protocol to cut off access from early 2015, and further technical measures, but gave few new firm commitments.
I find it unacceptable that employees of municipalities and social services consult data of well-known Dutch people without any necessity.
Ik vind het niet acceptabel dat medewerkers van gemeenten en sociale diensten zonder enige noodzaak gegevens van bekende Nederlanders raadplegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weyenberg over “het feit dat het UWV vrijwilligerswerk onmogelijk maakt”

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs why the UWV's rules on volunteering while receiving unemployment benefit (WW) led to a local bus line in Zaanstreek being at risk, and whether a neighbourhood bus driver counts as volunteer work and whether displacement of paid jobs is at stake. The Minister says each case is assessed by the UWV under existing rules, displacement of paid work must be avoided, and he will propose loosening the rules before the summer recess.
I am therefore examining how the current rules can be loosened and will inform the House before the summer recess of the outcome.
Ik bekijk daarom hoe de huidige regels verruimd kunnen worden en informeer uw Kamer voor het zomerreces over de uitkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Bergkamp en Koolmees over Verklaring arbeidsrelatie (VAR) voor zzp’ers

MPs from D66 asked the government how the Tax Authority can grant and then withdraw VAR-WUO declarations for care freelancers working through agencies, and how many were reviewed and reclassified. The minister explained that VARs are assessed on submitted facts, that roughly 900 of about 1,500 reviewed cases were reclassified as employment, and that the pilot was extended to address the problem.
The cabinet will shortly start an interdepartmental policy study on freelancers to examine whether laws and regulations for freelancers and employees are sufficiently in balance.

Het kabinet zal op korte termijn een Interdepartementaal Beleidsonderzoek (IBO) starten met betrekking tot zzp'ers om te bezien of wet- en regelgeving voor zzp'ers en werknemers voldoende in balans zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over de informatie voor grensarbeiders over het doolhof aan regelgeving

MPs Van Weyenberg and Sjoerdsma asked about complex cross-border rules for frontier workers, the shift from personal to electronic service at the Bureaus Belgische/Duitse Zaken, and funding for a central back office. The state secretary said digital information is adequate, that personal services are a regional responsibility, and that a back office at the SVB will be funded through 2018 at EUR 700,000 per year.
We will therefore ensure that a back office run by the SVB through the Bureaus is possible until the end of 2018.
Wij zullen er daarom voor zorg dragen dat uitvoering van een back office door de SVB via de Bureaus tot eind 2018 mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Bergkamp en Koolmees over VAR-verklaringen voor zzp’ers

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers about the Belastingdienst's handling of VAR declarations for self-employed workers (zzp'ers), including reports of fewer VAR-WUO grants in healthcare and revocations for 250 people tied to care intermediaries. The government replied that the criteria have not changed, that enforcement against false self-employment has increased, and that a planned joint-liability rule for clients and an online VAR module are under development.
The statutory confidentiality obligation means that no statements can be made about individual cases.
De in de wet verankerde geheimhoudingsverplichting maakt dat over individuele gevallen geen mededelingen kunnen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het AOW-gat voor studenten van de BES-eilanden

MP Van Weyenberg asked whether students from the Caribbean Netherlands lose AOW/AOV pension accrual when studying in the European Netherlands, whether voluntary AOW insurance is impossible abroad, and whether the government will seek a solution with the islands. The state secretary explained when AOV coverage ends and when students remain insured, confirmed no voluntary AOV option exists, and committed to discussing a solution with the island governments in June.
I am willing to jointly seek an appropriate solution with the administrative boards of the Caribbean Netherlands for the issue at hand.
Ik ben bereid gezamenlijk met de bestuurscolleges van Caribisch Nederland naar een passende oplossing te zoeken voor de onderhavige problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Hachchi over de ongelijke behandeling van Defensie medewerkers die geen vakbondslid zijn bij het kandideren voor de Ondernemingsraad

Two D66 MPs asked why Defence staff who are not union members face a 30-signature requirement and a one-year employment threshold for works council candidacy, and whether this unequal treatment will be changed. The minister answered that the Defence co-determination decree mirrors the former WOR rules, that the minister will review the decree with unions after the WOR was amended, and that the SER will consider the one-year threshold.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over het artikel ‘Asscher ziet wel iets in boud plan Cameron’

Two D66 MPs asked the Social Affairs and foreign ministers about Cameron's plan to delay free movement for new EU members until they reach a certain economic level, and whether Minister Asscher's reported openness to it conflicts with EU free movement. The government calls the idea a potentially interesting contribution to building support for free movement, citing exploitation of lower-income workers, and says reciprocity depends on future accession negotiations while transitional restrictions are compatible with free movement.
Whether the possibility of reciprocity will also be included in the accession treaties with new members depends on negotiations with those countries, which is not yet on the agenda.

Of de mogelijkheid tot wederkerigheid ook in de toetredingsverdragen met nieuwe toetreders wordt opgenomen, hangt af van de onderhandelingen met deze landen, hetgeen voorlopig nog niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat het aantal laaggeletterden snel stijgt

Two D66 MPs asked the education minister about reports that functional illiteracy is rising quickly, including labour-market shortages, the role of women, and measures for 45-65 year olds. The minister replied that the Action Plan on Functional Illiteracy, municipal adult-education funding, pilots and a motion-backed €5 million annually address the issue, with no sign of executive power or oversight being at stake.
Women are unfortunately overrepresented among functionally illiterate people.
Vrouwen zijn helaas oververtegenwoordigd onder laaggeletterden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Weyenberg over het bericht “Mishandeling Marokkaanse kinderen onderschat”

MPs Bergkamp and Van Weyenberg asked about a news report claiming child abuse among Moroccan-Dutch families is underestimated, based on a PhD study by Lahlah. The state secretary replied that the study adds knowledge to existing findings, pointed to existing prevention programmes and municipal responsibilities, and said the government will continue its approach to child abuse and juvenile crime.
The research by Ms Lahlah underlines that specific attention to intercultural differences is still needed.
Het onderzoek van mevrouw Lahlah onderstreept dat specifieke aandacht voor interculturele verschillen nog steeds nodig is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Van Weyenberg over het achterhalen van vaders van niet-erkende kinderen

D66 MPs asked whether municipalities may pursue biological fathers of non-recognised children for benefit recovery, how paternity is established, how this relates to privacy, and whether mothers can lose benefits for refusing cooperation. The state secretary explained the municipal procedure, the court route under the Civil Code, the mother's duty to cooperate with possible suspension of benefits, and that sperm donors are generally not liable for maintenance.
Those who carry out work under the WWB are subject to a duty of confidentiality (article 65 WWB), which adequately safeguards the privacy of those involved in municipal benefit recovery.

Voor degenen die werkzaamheden verrichten in het kader van de uitvoering van de WWB geldt een geheimhoudingsplicht (artikel 65 WWB) waarmee de privacy van de betrokkenen bij gemeentelijk bijstandsverhaal afdoende is gewaarborgd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het artikel ‘Samsom staat op nivelleren’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the employment effects of the coalition agreement's levelling measures, the marginal tax burden for low and middle incomes, and the reported Samsom remarks on job losses. The minister answered that the agreement is a coherent whole, that CPB calculations show a 0.6% structural rise in employment, that no separate figures for individual measures are known, and that the rise in marginal burden for higher incomes is a defensible trade-off for restoring public finances.
The coalition agreement consists of many different measures, but forms a coherent and inseparable whole.
Het regeerakkoord bestaat uit veel verschillende maatregelen, maar vormt een samenhangend en onlosmakelijk geheel.
Antwoord vragen Van Weyenberg en het lid Pieter Heerma over "een miljoenenstrop voor werkgevers door gebruik van onjuiste UWV-gegevens voor de nieuwe ziektewet "

MPs Van Weyenberg and Heerma asked the minister about press reports that over a third of UWV data used to set Ziektewet premiums is wrong, and whether employers could face large unjustified costs. The minister does not recognise the percentage, says employers should check the data and object annually, and points to UWV's data quality efforts and the 2014 flex-worker financing reform without committing to new measures.
No, I do not recognise the percentage that is mentioned.
Nee, het percentage dat wordt genoemd herken ik niet.
Antwoord vragen Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Bijzondere bijstand op aan onkosten’

An MP asked the state secretary about rising numbers of people placed under protective administration (beschermingsbewind), whether it is granted beyond physical or mental incapacity, the quality and oversight of administrators, and the relation to debt rescheduling and municipal responsibility. The government answered that cases have tripled since 2004, that debt problems are a common ground, that a pending bill would formalise debt-related grounds and require quality standards, and that municipalities should use integrated debt assistance and can request such measures.
In the collective letter to municipalities, municipalities will be pointed to this ruling of the Central Appeals Tribunal and to the options outlined above, in line with my commitment to your House.

In de Verzamelbrief aan de gemeenten zullen gemeenten worden gewezen op deze uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep en op de hierboven geschetste mogelijkheden, conform mijn toezegging aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Wachtlijsten op de voorschool groeien’

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary and minister about reports that waiting lists for pre-school education for children at risk of language delay are growing, and about how many such children are affected and what will be done. The government calls the growing waiting lists worrying, says it cannot determine how many target-group children are waiting, estimates about 45,000 target children, and places the duty to provide places on municipalities, with the Inspectorate of Education supervising, promising a joint letter before summer.
It is up to the municipalities to organise this; they also hold the instruments to resolve this at local level.
Het is aan de gemeenten om dit te organiseren; zij hebben ook de instrumenten in handen om dit op lokaal niveau op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over ‘het verbod in de cao Besloten Busvervoer om zzp’ers in dienst te nemen’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the clause in the collective agreement for private bus transport that bars carriers from using drivers not employed under an employment contract, and similar CAO clauses excluding self-employed workers, are undesirable, incompatible with the Competition Act and the general-binding-declaration test, and whether action will follow. The minister replied that such clauses are permitted under the Collective Agreements Act and competition law, do not bar self-employed workers from working or founding their own companies, are not contrary to the public interest, and that no action is warranted.
There is no ground to refrain from declaring this provision generally binding.
Er is geen grond om deze bepaling niet algemeen verbindend te verklaren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Kerstens over "beëindiging uitkering van kankerpatiënte omdat vriend te vaak langskwam"

MPs Van Weyenberg and Kerstens asked the state secretary whether it is undesirable that a cancer patient's benefit was stopped because her partner visited too often, and how far law or case law requires this. The state secretary declined to judge the individual case, explained that the WWB is decentralised to municipalities and that cohabitation is assessed case by case, and said she has confidence in municipalities, councils and the courts.
The WWB is decentralised and implemented by the municipalities.
De WWB is gedecentraliseerd en wordt uitgevoerd door de gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de toetreding van Kroatië

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about the planned postponement of free movement of workers for Croatia, the consistency with the Foreign Minister's remarks, Croatian qualifications, and the effects of posted-worker constructions and bogus constructions. The minister defended the postponement by pointing to rising unemployment and the need to activate domestic labour potential, and provided tables on permits and notifications for Bulgarian and Romanian workers while promising an action plan against bogus constructions.
I am not aware of how many Croatians have completed a technical degree.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel Kroaten een technische studie hebben gevolgd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over "minder vrije dagen voor niet-vakbondsleden"

An MP from D66 asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether collective agreements that give union members an extra study day and training budget over non-members are compatible with equal treatment, and whether the union dues and extension of collective agreements should be abolished. The Minister answers that such differentiation is a matter for private parties and ultimately for the courts, that agreements distinguishing members from non-members cannot be declared generally binding, and that he has asked the SER to consider the issue.
How much scope there is to make agreements that apply only to union members is a matter for the judgment of the court.
Hoe groot de ruimte is om afspraken te maken die alleen gelden voor vakbondsleden is aan het oordeel van de rechter.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over berichten dat ABP 50 miljard euro meer vermogen zou hebben gehad als het haar renterisico had afgedekt

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary whether ABP pension fund could have had about 50 billion euros more capital had it hedged its interest rate risk, and asked about sector-wide hedging, DNB supervision, and communication to members. The state secretary declined to judge individual funds, explained that hedging is a board responsibility under prudent-person rules with DNB supervision, gave sector hedging figures of about 45%, and said the government will talk with stakeholders about wider questions.
The confidentiality provisions of the Pensions Act do not allow information that individual pension funds have provided to the supervisor to be made public.
De geheimhoudingsbepalingen uit de Pensioenwet staan niet toe dat informatie die individuele pensioenfondsen aan de toezichthouder hebben verstrekt, openbaar wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat de AFM meer pensioenrechten voor jongeren wil

An MP asked the state secretary how the government views AFM board member Korte's call for more open pension communication, the example of a fund's mismatched brochures, and the status of the study on the cross-subsidy premium. The state secretary answered that the communication rules are being revised, the AFM lacks powers over non-mandatory communication, the study concludes in early May, and the Witteveen scheme bill will be submitted this spring.
There are no statutory powers for the AFM to intervene in non-mandatory forms of communication.
Er zijn geen wettelijke bevoegdheden voor AFM om in te grijpen in niet verplichte vormen van communicatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat pensioenfondsen weigeren premies te verlagen

MP Van Weyenberg (D66) asked the government about reports that pension funds refuse to lower premiums when the accrual cap is cut, and whether lower accrual should translate into lower premiums and what the budgetary and generational effects are. The state secretary answered that funds must set premiums at least covering costs but have discretion over how freed-up room is used, that the government expects no one-sided burden on workers, that DNB supervises balanced interest representation, and that premium developments will be monitored, while declining to legally guarantee premium cuts.
The cabinet intends to closely monitor the premiums applied by pension funds.
Het kabinet is voornemens de door pensioenfondsen gehanteerde premies nauwlettend te monitoren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over "het onderzoek van DNB en AFM waaruit blijkt dat de helft van de herstelplannen van pensioenfondsen van onvoldoende of slechte kwaliteit is "

Van Weyenberg (D66) asked the minister about a DNB/AFM study finding that half of pension funds' recovery plans are of insufficient or poor quality, and about the rules and enforcement for such plans. The state secretary replied that the study concerns financial crisis plans rather than recovery plans, described the statutory requirements for recovery plans and annual DNB review, noted a planned tightening of information duties in 2014, and did not give concrete targets or enforcement commitments beyond existing supervision.
Contrary to what the questioner assumes, the study does not concern recovery plans but so-called financial crisis plans.
In tegenstelling tot hetgeen de vragensteller veronderstelt, heeft het onderzoek geen betrekking op herstelplannen, maar op zogenoemde financiële crisisplannen.
qn: Antwoord op vragen die het lid Dijk over het advies van NLFI over de toekomstopties voor de Volksbank

An MP asks the Finance Minister how the government responds to NLFI's advice to privatise the Volksbank, and about its effects on banking stability, its public values, market concentration, SME financing, branch access and whether it can stay in public hands. The minister responds that the Volksbank is a commercial bank, that privatisation would not affect stability, that a separate analysis already showed a state bank is not required to secure public interests, and points to other existing instruments and the ongoing accessibility programme.
Neither NLFI nor the state can require the Volksbank to act as an investment bank for SMEs, a regional development bank, or to maintain branches.
NLFI, noch de staat, kunnen van de Volksbank vragen zich op te stellen als investeringsbank voor het mkb, ontwikkelingsbank in de regio of loketten te behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het rapport ACM naar aanleiding van de lage spaarrentes bij banken

A D66 MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the ACM report finding that Dutch bank savings rates lag due to insufficient competition and tacit coordination among large banks. The minister acknowledged the findings, promised follow-up steps such as studies on mandatory standalone savings accounts, transparency requirements, and exploring number portability, while noting limits on enforcement and that IBAN portability is technically complex and costly.
I will commission research into the impact of an obligation for banks to offer a standalone full savings account to customers who do not have a payment account with them.
Ik ga onderzoek laten doen naar de impact van een verplichting voor banken om een zelfstandige volwaardige spaarrekening aan te bieden aan klanten die bij hen geen betaalrekening hebben.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid Vermeer over de mislukte verkoop van TenneT Duitsland

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the failed sale of TenneT Germany, including how TenneT's short-term financing need should be met, the government obligations behind its investments, deadlines, whether German grid tariffs could cover the gap, and whether booking the sale proceeds was premature. The ministers answered that a bridging loan to TenneT is planned, explained the statutory investment obligations and planning cycles, stated that tariffs are set by regulators, and defended the budgeting as the most realistic estimate at the time.
In the short term we intend to grant TenneT an additional bridging loan to ensure TenneT can continue to invest.
Voor de korte termijn geldt dat wij voornemens zijn TenneT een aanvullende overbruggingslening te verlenen om er zorg voor te dragen dat TenneT kan blijven investeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over rekeninggluren over “rekeninggluren door medewerkers van de Bunq-bank” naar aanleiding van het krantenbericht van de NRC van 26 juni 2024

An MP asked the Finance Minister about bank employees at Bunq secretly viewing customer account data, whether this is a privacy breach, whether the bank and supervisors are responsible, and what measures will prevent recurrence and identify other banks with the problem. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, pointed to the existing legal framework, DNB and Data Protection Authority supervision, and the disciplinary body, and said no additional measures were currently deemed necessary.
It is up to the independent supervisor to assess whether a bank meets its legal obligations and, if not, to enforce against it.
Het is aan de onafhankelijke toezichthouder om te beoordelen of een bank aan haar wettelijke verplichtingen voldoet, en als dat niet zo is, om daar op te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het artikel 'Kolonisten in Palestijns gebied krijgen hun helmen en drones van orthodox-christelijk Nederland'

An MP asks the ministers whether tax-deductible donations from the Dutch charity Christenen voor Israël fund protective gear and drones for settlers in occupied territory, and whether that conflicts with Dutch policy. The government says it was unaware of the donations, considers settlements contrary to international law and undesirable to fund, but states that under neutral ANBI rules protective helmets and vests can count as generally beneficial and the charity status is not withdrawn, while pledging continued EU sanctions efforts against violent settlers.
Because the tax authority is bound by the confidentiality duty of article 67 of the General Tax Act, no further information can be provided about individual institutions.

Omdat de belastingdienst is gehouden aan de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan geen nadere informatie worden verstrekt over individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over financiering van de vee-industrie door de Rabobank

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Finance Minister about Rabobank's financing of intensive livestock farming, its links to JBS and the National Pork Producers Council, and the role of banks in the transition to animal-welfare-compliant farming. The minister acknowledges shared responsibility, expects banks to apply OECD and UNGP standards and to weigh such relationships in financing decisions, but leaves the concrete choices on the JBS relationship to Rabobank itself.
It is up to Rabobank itself to weigh maintaining a customer relationship with JBS in this light.
Het is aan Rabobank zelf om het onderhouden van een klantrelatie met JBS in dit licht te wegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het bericht dat de schade van weerextremen in 2023 in Europa 13,4 miljard euro bedroeg

An MP asked the Finance Minister about Copernicus/WMO estimates that weather-related damage in Europe in 2023 reached 13.4 billion euro, and whether funding for weather-extreme damage and climate adaptation is sufficient. The government agrees that investing in climate and nature is preferable to repairing damage, points to ad hoc, unbudgeted schemes (Wts, financial hardship policy for 2021 floods) under evaluation, and says additional climate policy is for the next cabinet.
Additional climate policy is currently a matter for the next cabinet.
Aanvullend klimaatbeleid is op dit moment aan het volgende kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Sneller en Tjeerd de Groot over de verplichtingen voor financiële instellingen om financiering aan ontbossing te voorkomen

Two D66 MPs asked the Finance Minister about obligations for financial institutions to prevent financing deforestation, citing a Greenpeace and Milieudefensie report and asking about the EU Forest Law, CSRD transparency, climate-risk reporting, a green bank tax and the WRR. The minister acknowledged the sector's responsibility under OECD and UN guidelines, said mandatory due diligence for financial institutions was not secured in the CSDDD, and pointed to pending EU effect assessments and a climate-measures exploration with a letter promised around summer.
I intend to inform the House around the summer on the main outlines of the outcomes of the exploration.
Ik ben voornemens om de Kamer rond de zomer te informeren op hoofdlijnen over de uitkomsten van de verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Vree over het bericht 'Alarm om nieuwe criminele truc met deepfake: 'Hackers kopiëren je gezicht en plunderen je bankrekening''

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether he knows of a reported deepfake facial-recognition bank fraud and how he ensures account holders are protected against AI-enabled hackers. The minister answered yes, noted the incident did not occur in Europe or at a Dutch bank, said banks apply technical safeguards, and that the Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer monitors new fraud forms with stakeholders.
To prevent misuse of identification methods by hackers, banks take various (technical) security measures, including for facial recognition.
Om misbruik van identificatiemethoden door hackers te voorkomen nemen banken verschillende (technische) veiligheidsmaatregelen, zo ook bij gezichtsherkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Mkb’ers verliezen bankrekening door strikte anti-witwasregels: ‘Onacceptabele toestanden’'

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Finance whether strict anti-money-laundering rules are unduly burdening small businesses that struggle to get bank accounts and credit, and whether the government will act on proposals such as a basic business payment account. The Minister acknowledges the problems, argues that DNB supervision is not the main cause and that banks must apply the risk-based approach better, and promises to inform parliament around the summer about options including a basic business payment account.
I aim to inform the House about this further around the summer.
Ik streef ernaar om uw Kamer rond de zomer hierover nader te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Onderzoek banken: criminele geldstromen blijven te vaak onopgemerkt'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about an industry threat assessment on bank-based money laundering detection, its claimed shortcomings, the role of gatekeepers beyond banks, crypto and underground banking, trade finance, and whether the gatekeeper role should be reorganised. The minister replied that the confidential assessment is not shared beyond banks and authorities, that the FATF rated the Dutch anti-money-laundering approach as robust, that a wider crypto regulation is coming, and that the group could not answer in time for the debate.
I respect the decision not to share these findings beyond these parties, as they are the gatekeepers, investigative bodies and FIU that must act on these risks.
Ik respecteer de keuze om deze bevindingen niet verder te delen buiten deze partijen, het zijn immers de poortwachters, opsporingsinstanties en FIU die moeten acteren op deze risico’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mooiman en Emiel van Dijk over het opgeven van soevereiniteit voor de interne markt

PVV MPs Mooiman and Emiel van Dijk asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch sovereignty would be surrendered to complete the EU capital markets union and how this would affect autonomy, alternatives, and protection against liability for other member states. The minister answered that the goals can be pursued within existing EU powers via harmonisation and stronger ESA supervision, that any new EU powers require Dutch consent, and that parliament will be involved through BNC fiches, while giving only general answers and no concrete commitment to new scrutiny steps.

The cabinet will involve your House, in line with the regular arrangements, in the Dutch assessment of and position on new white or green papers, communications (action plans) and/or legislative proposals from the European Commission.

Het kabinet zal uw Kamer conform de reguliere afspraken betrekken bij de Nederlandse appreciatie van en inzet bij nieuwe wit-of groenboeken, mededelingen (actieplannen) en/of wetgevende voorstellen van de Europese Commissie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over de berichten 'Fraud-busters swoop on Greek contracts involving € 2.5B of EUrecovery funds' en 'Lamborghini and Rolexes seized in massive EU policeraid over € 600M Covid fraud'

MP Heinen asked the Finance Minister about reports of fraud involving EU Recovery and Resilience Facility funds in Greece and Italy, and about the adequacy of EU oversight. The government, answering on behalf of the Finance Minister, said it cannot yet judge fraud levels relative to other EU funds, pointed to ECA and Commission reports, said defrauded funds should be recovered under the RRF regulation, and promised to raise fraud prevention in the Ecofinraad and in the Commission's annual report.
The cabinet cannot currently establish how the amount of fraud and the effectiveness of fraud control at the RRF compare with those of other EU funds.

Op basis van deze informatie kan het kabinet op dit moment niet vaststellen hoe de hoeveelheid fraude en de effectiviteit van de fraudebestrijding bij het HVF zich verhoudt tot die bij andere EU-fondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de ramingen en realisaties van het EMU-saldo

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the gap between forecast and realised EMU balance (deficit) over 15 years, including whether forecasts are systematically too pessimistic and how underspending affects forecasts. The minister answered that realisations have on average been more favourable than forecasts, explained underspending and the in=uit taakstelling mechanisms, and said forecasts are realistic and being made more accurate, without committing to new oversight measures.
The starting point for the forecasts of the EMU balance is realistic forecasting, which means there is in advance no forecast deviation.
Het uitgangspunt voor de ramingen van het EMU-saldo is realistisch ramen, wat inhoudt dat er op voorhand geen sprake is van een ramingsafwijking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Pleidooi voor strengere regels na eerste rechtszaak tegen financieel influencer'

An MP asked the Minister of Finance whether the spread of unlicensed brokers promoted by finfluencers, the AFM's slow enforcement and the expected EU rules justify stricter measures. The Minister replied that existing rules are sufficient for now, pointed to ongoing AFM supervision and a planned influencer certificate, and committed to pushing the EU to ban promotion of unlicensed financial firms.
The AFM cannot give insight into all measures taken because of its statutory duty of confidentiality and does not normally comment on ongoing investigations.
De AFM kan geen inzicht geven in alle genomen maatregelen vanwege de wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht en doet normaliter ook geen uitspraken over lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het niet nemen van juridische vervolgstappen tegen KLM vanwege gebrekkige naleving van steunvoorwaarden

An MP asked the Finance Minister why the state is not taking legal action against KLM for failing to comply with state aid conditions, including tax-avoidance facilitation by pilots and the structural cost-reduction requirement. The minister answered that legal analyses found no real prospect of success and no state damage, that the aid conditions were not decisive for EU approval, and that an independent evaluation by EY and an external committee is underway.
The legal analyses show that the State has not suffered damage to its assets as defined in the Civil Code.
Uit de juridische analyses komt naar voren dat de Staat geen vermogensschade heeft geleden zoals gedefinieerd in het Burgerlijk Wetboek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens  over gebrekkig inzicht in juridische duurzaamheidsrisico’s

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the Finance Minister about gaps in oversight of legal sustainability risks (climate litigation) by DNB, pension funds and financial institutions, and about how CSDDD article 15 and possible climate rules for the financial sector would apply. The government answered that legal sustainability risks are already part of supervision, that the existing framework leaves room for supervisors, that CSDDD transition plans are an effort obligation, and that decisions on financial-sector climate legislation will be informed to the House around summer.
The supervisory framework and the current legal framework leave sufficient room for supervisors to give content to this.
Het toezichtkader en het huidige juridische kader bieden voldoende ruimte voor toezichthouders om daar invulling aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de besluitvorming rond het AML-pakket

An MP asks the Finance Minister how the EU AML package changed during trilogue so that data-sharing moved from an optional clause to a harmonised obligation, and how it relates to the national Plan van Aanpak Witwassen bill, including KYC data-sharing, processing of sensitive data, cash limits and reporting of unusual versus suspicious transactions. The minister answers all 13 questions on substance, explaining the EU negotiation outcome, saying national safeguards will be examined during implementation, and defending Dutch reporting practice.
During the implementation process of the AML package it will be examined whether additional national safeguards are necessary.
Tijdens het implementatietraject van het AML-pakket zal worden bezien of aanvullende nationale waarborgen noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op het lid Van Kent over ‘misgelopen lijfrentepolis of pensioen in Radar-uitzending’

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about slow transfers of pension and annuity capital between banks and insurers, which cost consumers money, and asked who supervises this, whether the transfer period should be extended, and whether a secure online process is possible. The minister said DNB, AFM and Kifid received few complaints, the voluntary PSK protocol is sufficient for now, no supervisor has a legal basis to enforce it, the period should not be lengthened, and industry will be urged to go digital while the minister monitors compliance.
I will contact these parties to monitor the extent to which follow-up is given to this.
Ik zal in contact treden met deze partijen om te monitoren in hoeverre hier opvolging aan wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de over de uitwerking van het Europese begrotingsraamwerk

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the effects of the revised EU fiscal rules on the Dutch structural primary balance and spending growth, including the gap with the Studiegroep Begrotingsruimte and the required adjustment. The minister answered that updated preliminary Commission calculations imply a target of 0.3% of GDP in 2028 instead of 0.7%, that the Commission's forecasts are not yet final, and gave indicative ranges for the adjustment needed.
It is currently difficult to say which structural primary balance the Commission will forecast for 2028, as this will depend on the latest economic developments and macroeconomic assumptions.

Het is op dit moment moeilijk om te zeggen welk structureel primair saldo de Commissie voor 2028 zal ramen, omdat dit zal afhangen van de laatste economische ontwikkelingen en macro-economische aannames.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en De Hoop over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof over steun aan KLM

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister how the government will respond to the General Court ruling annulling the Commission's approval of state aid to KLM, including whether the aid remains compatible if the holding and Air France are also beneficiaries, and what financial consequences may follow. The minister replied that talks with the Commission and France are ongoing, that the Commission is expected to appeal, that no direct financial obligations follow from the ruling yet, and declined to give the uncertain consequences or the tax-deferral figures, citing confidentiality of individual firms.
As previously promised in my letter to your House, I will inform the House if there are concrete new developments.
Zoals eerder toegezegd in mijn brief aan uw Kamer zal ik de Tweede Kamer informeren als er concrete nieuwe ontwikkelingen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ''Bank vraagt klantgegevens aan ondernemers bij contante betaling''

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Finance about reports that banks demand customer information and impose restrictions on entrepreneurs during anti-money-laundering checks, including for cash payments, and whether banks may restrict accounts when information is withheld. The minister acknowledges the concerns, says such measures are proportionate only in specific high-risk circumstances, and commits to asking DNB to review its guidance and to banking-sector discussions on communication with customers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tseggai en Maatoug over het bericht ‘Hoe Netflix zijn recordwinst laat belasten: in vele ‘winstjes’ hier en daar’

MPs Tseggai and Maatoug asked whether Netflix's Dutch-based profits are shifted abroad, whether this undermines the investment obligation for streaming services, and about openness over Netflix's tax rulings. The State Secretary answered that profit allocation follows the arm's-length principle and BEPS rules, that the investment obligation is tied to Dutch revenue rather than profit, that he has no insight into Netflix's investments, and that individual tax files cannot be discussed under tax secrecy.
Due to the fiscal confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR), I cannot discuss individual tax files.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over boodschappen die weer duurder worden

MP Dijk (SP) asks the Finance Minister whether grocery prices are rising again, why inflation cannot be curbed, whether profiteering (greedflation) should be tackled, and whether price regulation like in France or Spain should be used. The minister replies that food inflation has peaked, that price setting is up to firms with the competition authority ACM acting on cartels or abuse of market power, that a review of ACM's instruments is underway with a letter due in Q2 2024, and that no further grocery price regulation is intended.
It is now being examined whether the ACM's instruments are still adequate in the current time.
Er wordt nu onderzocht of het instrumentarium van de ACM nog toereikend is in deze huidige tijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Mohandis over het bericht ‘Opera Zuid luidt noodklok: ‘Reële kans dat we verdwijnen’’

MPs Westerveld and Mohandis asked whether the state secretary will ensure Opera Zuid's survival given rising wage costs and its limited subsidy share. The state secretary declines extra funding, says the three opera functions and subsidy ceilings are set, and defers the assessment to the Raad voor Cultuur.
I see no room to provide additional support to one or more institutions.
Ik zie geen ruimte om een of meer instellingen extra te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Geurts over de export van vervuilende brandstoffen naar Afrika

CDA MPs asked the state secretary about the export of high-sulphur, polluting fuels from the Netherlands to West Africa, the ILT's voluntary talks with refineries, whether the approach reduces emissions, and the legal basis for enforcement. The government answered that the ILT is enforcing the environmental duty of care on Dutch fuel exporters, pursuing international fuel standards via UNEP and ECOWAS, and considering regulatory changes, while rejecting a separate external study.
The ILT is authorised under article 18.2b of the Environmental Management Act and holds these companies to their statutory duty of care.
De ILT is hiertoe bevoegd op basis van artikel 18.2b uit de Wet milieubeheer en spreekt deze bedrijven aan op het naleven van hun wettelijke zorgplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht “Limburgse grensgemeente verrast door volstorten recreatieplas”

MPs Hagen and Tjeerd de Groot asked about reports that a Flemish Maas lake near the Dutch border was designated for dumping excavated soil from Antwerp, possibly polluted like the Westerschelde, and about risks to Dutch municipalities, boaters, agriculture and drinking water. The State Secretary answered that no soil is currently being applied, the Flemish authority is responsible, the permit excludes heavily polluted soil, no monitoring report or MER exists yet, and that the Netherlands will be closely involved in monitoring approval.
It is not possible to send you a report regarding ecological or environmental requirements.
Het is niet mogelijk om u een rapportage met betrekking tot ecologische of milieueisen toe te zenden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Boulakjar over de berichten '3000 lege vliegtuigen in België de lucht in om landingsrechten te behouden' en 'Knotsgekke drempels in Europese lidstaten bemoeilijken treinreis

Two D66 MPs asked about reports of empty flights run to preserve airport slot rights during the pandemic and about rail cross-border obstacles, and asked how many empty flights were operated, whether the slot waiver would be extended, and what was being done on international rail. The minister replied that no empty flights were needed at Dutch slot-coordinated airports, that the EU slot relief rules are expected to continue for summer 2022 with a request for clarity beyond, and outlined ongoing EU and national rail initiatives without committing to a new legal change.
The ministry has no access to load factors per airline or per flight movement.
Het ministerie heeft geen inzage in de bezettingsgraden per luchtvaartmaatschappij en of per vliegtuigbeweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Bontenbal over het fragment ’80 miljoen zonnepanelen in 2024 zijn een tikkende milieutijdbom’

MPs Hagen and Bontenbal asked the state secretary about reports that financing for recycling solar panels is not secured, including the 13 cent per panel fee and how it compares with Belgium's system. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, said the current fee covers only present costs, and pointed to producer organisation OPEN as primarily responsible while it develops a financing roadmap and a possible removal fund.
The financing of high-quality processing of future discarded solar panels is not in order.
De financiering van een hoogwaardige verwerking van vrijkomende afgedankte zonnepanelen in de toekomst is niet op orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Peter de Groot over de haalbaarheidsstudie ‘klimaatneutrale paden TSN IJmuiden’ van Roland Berger

Two VVD MPs asked the cabinet about the Roland Berger feasibility study on climate-neutral routes for Tata Steel IJmuiden, including state financial support, the size of the subsidy need, infrastructure, permit acceleration and inter-government coordination. The minister said the study is an important next step, that financial needs and support options are not yet known and depend on Tata Steel's own business case, that no funds are yet reserved, and that a new cabinet would decide, while permit speed-up and coordination are being explored without an interdepartmental taskforce.
That also cannot be expected at this stage of the process.
Dat kan in deze fase van het proces ook nog niet verwacht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Zeer nauwe verbintenis Roland Berger en Tata

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about press reports of close ties between consultancy Roland Berger and Tata Steel, questioning the independence of a study on green steel production. The minister answered that the past Tata/Roland Berger alliance concerned Indian advisory work, ended around 2012, was not linked to Tata Steel Netherlands, and that the scenarios studied have been published.
Both FNV and the group Zeester (former Tata Steel directors) have designated Roland Berger as a competent organisation to investigate the sustainability options for Tata Steel.
Zowel FNV, alsook de groep Zeester (oud-directeuren van Tata Steel) hebben Roland Berger aangewezen als een competente organisatie om de verduurzamingsmogelijkheden voor Tata Steel te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden De Hoop en Nijboer over het traject Delfzijl – Groningen n.a.v. het bericht ‘Boosheid over 'puinhoop' op spoor tussen Delfzijl en Groningen’ van de NOS

MPs Nijboer and De Hoop asked the state secretary about recurring train disruptions and overcrowding on the Delfzijl–Groningen line, including whether longer trains should be deployed during the pandemic and whether operator Arriva would be called to account. The state secretary said that regional transport responsibility lies with the province of Groningen, which regards the incidents as isolated, and that the province accepts the operator's explanation of force majeure.
Responsibility for regional public transport services lies primarily with the regional transport authorities and the operators.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het regionale OV-aanbod ligt primair bij de regionale OV-autoriteiten en de vervoerders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Erkens over cumulatie van uitstoot en overlast in Zuid-Limburg

MPs Peter de Groot and Erkens asked about cumulative emissions and nuisance in cross-border South Limburg, including the planned Lixhe biomass plant in Belgium, and whether Dutch municipalities and the province can be stakeholders in the Belgian permit process. The State Secretary answered that Dutch bodies were not yet formally recognised as stakeholders, that the matter is for the bordering authorities to resolve, and that the government will raise concerns diplomatically and with Dutch local authorities.

I believe the province of Limburg and the Dutch municipalities concerned should be able to formally raise these objections in the procedure and that they should be weighed in assessing the application.

Ik vind dat de provincie Limburg en de betrokken Nederlandse gemeenten deze bezwaren formeel moeten kunnen inbrengen in de procedure en dat deze ook meegewogen moeten worden bij de beoordeling van de aanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en De Kort over het bericht 'Slecht ter been? Zorg dan maar dat je niet op dit station terecht komt'

MPs Minhas and De Kort asked the state secretary about the prolonged closure of all lifts at Rotterdam Lombardijen station near Maasstad Hospital, including temporary lifts, taxi alternatives, and station accessibility nationwide. The secretary answered that the works are delayed but managed by ProRail and NS, that temporary lifts are technically impossible, that taxis are offered as an alternative, and referred to a national accessibility report.
ProRail states that it closely steers the planning with the contractors involved and eliminates possible risks of overrun as far as possible.
ProRail geeft aan samen met de betrokken aannemers strak te sturen op de planning en mogelijke risico's op uitloop zoveel mogelijk te elimineren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas en Rudmer Heerema over de extra reistijd op het traject Alkmaar-Den Haag van NS

MPs Minhas and Rudmer Heerema asked the State Secretary about longer rail travel times between Alkmaar and Den Haag under NS's 2022 timetable, and whether this conflicts with the goal of more frequent trains. The State Secretary replied that NS manages the timetable, that the net benefit for most travellers outweighs the losses for a few tens of passengers, and that he sees no reason to intervene.
I see no reason at this time to intervene as concession grantor in this process.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om als concessieverlener in dit proces te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikh over het bericht 'Supermarkten verkopen massaal flessen frisdrank zonder statiegeld, onderzoek inspectie'

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that supermarkets sell plastic soft-drink bottles without deposit (statiegeld) and whether the rules should exempt juice and dairy. The state secretary said the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport is investigating, needs at least eight weeks, cannot guarantee when violations will end, and that the exemption for juice and dairy will be reviewed in the 2024 evaluation.
The ILT has indicated it needs at least 8 weeks to conduct an initial investigation and determine whether enforcement action is required.
De ILT heeft aangegeven minimaal 8 weken nodig te hebben om een eerste onderzoek te doen en te bepalen of tot handhaving moet worden overgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht ‘Met de rolstoel de trein in? In Cuijk en Boxmeer heb je dan een probleem’

An MP asks the state secretary whether it is acceptable that wheelchair users cannot board trains at some stations, and whether travellers in wheelchairs should travel independently across the country. The state secretary acknowledges the problem, points to the ongoing ProRail station accessibility programme to 2030, and announces a forthcoming Bestuursakkoord on expanding assisted travel and talks with Arriva and the province.
I agree that wheelchair users should be able to travel by train independently as far as possible.
Ik ben het ermee eens dat rolstoelgebruikers zoveel mogelijk zelfstandig met de trein moeten kunnen reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Westerveld van de ontoegankelijkheid van het openbaar vervoer voor mensen met een beperking.

MPs Bouchallikh and Westerveld asked about inaccessible public transport for people with disabilities, including broken lifts at small stations, assistance by train staff, rolling-stock seating and the involvement of disability experts. The State Secretary answered that stations are being made accessible by 2030, that platforms on the Maaslijn will follow by 2024, and that staff assistance at all times is not feasible, while promising a transport accessibility agreement and monitoring of lifts.
I share the view that public transport in principle must be accessible to all people with disabilities.
Ik deel de mening dat het OV in beginsel toegankelijk moet zijn voor alle mensen met een beperking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over de NS en het mogelijke verlies van een fors deel van de Duitse treindiensten

An MP from PVV asked the Minister about NS possibly losing much of its German rail services, why NS remains involved abroad, the cost to taxpayers, staff layoffs, further claims, and who is responsible. The Minister confirmed the loss, explained the rationale for foreign activities, estimated potential Abellio losses of 30-50 million euros per year, stated no Dutch staff are dismissed, and described restructuring and the Nordrhein-Westfalen outcome, while financial details remain pending.
I will inform the House about the financial implications once the restructuring has been completed.
Ik zal de Kamer informeren over de financiële implicaties zodra de herstructurering is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Nijboer over de activiteiten van NS-dochter Abellio in Noordrijn-Westfalen (NRW)

MPs De Hoop and Nijboer asked the government about NS subsidiary Abellio's losses and insolvency procedure in Germany, particularly the North Rhine-Westphalia contracts, and whether Dutch travellers and taxpayers would bear the costs. The minister explains the losses stem from external factors, that NS-backed restructuring keeps risk within the agreed framework, and that Abellio's NRW concessions will end on 31 January 2022 with emergency tenders.
With this solution NS stays within the risk framework ('Capital at Risk') that I agreed with your House for NS's foreign activities.
NS blijft met deze oplossing binnen het risicokader («Capital at Risk») dat ik met uw Kamer heb afgesproken voor de buitenlandse activiteiten van NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over de toename van incidenten met asielzoekers in de Nederlandse treinen

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretaries whether train staff will be protected against incidents with asylum seekers, whether asylum seekers causing nuisance can be sent back, and whether borders will be closed. The government answered that all nuisance is unacceptable and is handled through reporting, extra staff and a harder zero-tolerance approach, but that closing borders is not realistic and that nuisance alone is not legal grounds for rejecting an asylum application.

As stated in the answers to earlier questions from your House, causing nuisance on public transport legally provides insufficient grounds to reject an asylum application and to proceed to direct removal.

Zoals vermeld in de beantwoording van eerdere vragen van uw Kamer, biedt het veroorzaken van overlast in het openbaar vervoer wettelijk gezien onvoldoende grond om over te gaan tot afwijzing van een asielaanvraag en tot directe uitzetting.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Peter de Groot en Erkens over het bericht 'Nederlands initiatief in Glasgow: nieuwe vrachtauto's uitstootvrij in 2040'

MPs Peter de Groot and Erkens asked the State Secretary about a news report on the Glasgow zero-emission truck initiative, questioning why a 2040 target was not previously shared, its consistency with the Klimaatakkoord, competitiveness and leakage, and the instruments needed. The State Secretary answered that the MoU is not a new target but supports existing 2050 mobility goals, listed signatories, and described subsidies, charging infrastructure and toll-revenue funding under consideration.
The Global MoU does not involve legally binding agreements that countries must comply with.
Het Global MoU betreft geen juridisch bindende afspraken waaraan landen moeten voldoen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen en Sneller over de berichten ‘Dwangsom asfaltfabriek Eindhoven als te hoge uitstoot kankerverwekkende stof benzeen niet stopt, ‘half miljard naar milieucontrole bedrijven, maar wat g

Two D66 MPs asked about benzene emissions from an Eindhoven asphalt plant exceeding limits, weak enforcement of environmental rules, the lack of data on sanctions and about 570 million euro spent by local environmental services, and continued ship degassing in Flevoland lakes. The state secretary answered that enforcement is the competence of local authorities and environmental services, denied any tolerance policy on degassing, and promised a status overview and a leading policy note by year end.
I do not have figures on how often companies are ultimately (partially) closed down.
Ik heb geen cijfers voorhanden hoe vaak bedrijven uiteindelijk (gedeeltelijk) worden gesloten.
