Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en De Hoop over het inzetten van minder treinen door tekort aan verkeersleiding personeel bij ProRail

MPs Bouchallikh and De Hoop asked the state secretary about train cancellations caused by a shortage of rail traffic controllers at ProRail, including recruitment, ageing staff and a temporary compensation allowance. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, described ProRail's short- and long-term measures and an external review to be shared with parliament, and said financial issues had not been reported to him.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat spitstreinen niet rijden vanwege het tekort aan verkeersleiders

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management why peak-hour trains were cancelled on 2 November 2021 due to a shortage of train traffic controllers, why no replacement buses were arranged, whether crowding on diversion routes was safe, and what is being done to retain staff and prevent overcrowding during tighter COVID measures. The State Secretary answered that NS could not organise adequate replacement buses at short notice, described ProRail's notification schedule and staff recruitment, retention and pay measures, and said shareholder discussions on personnel policy took place without committing to new binding steps.
I will inform your House about the outcomes of the shareholder meeting in a separate letter.
Over de uitkomsten van de aandeelhoudersvergadering informeer ik uw Kamer via een separate brief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over het bericht 'Treinen vallen uit door personeelstekort bij ProRail'

An MP asked the state secretary about train cancellations caused by staff shortages at ProRail, the timing of solutions, whether such cancellations count as force majeure in concessions, and why replacement buses were not deployed on 2 November 2021. The state secretary acknowledged the shortages, outlined recruitment and training measures expected to last until 2023, said cancellations count in performance evaluations, and explained NS's operational limits on replacement buses while promising ongoing talks with NS.
Train cancellations count, regardless of cause, in various performance indicators, such as passenger punctuality and number of high-impact disruptions.
Treinuitval telt, ongeacht de oorzaak, mee in diverse prestatie-indicatoren, zoals reizigerspunctualiteit en aantal impactvolle verstoringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over werksfeer en problemen bij de verkeersleiding van ProRail

Madlener (PVV) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about low morale, staffing shortages and train cancellations among ProRail traffic controllers, including pay, timing of recovery and why cancellations concentrate in the east. The State Secretary answered that ProRail is aware of unrest, has introduced a temporary allowance and recruitment and retention measures, and that shortages will persist until about mid-2023 while ProRail is the responsible party.
In my role as shareholder I generally ask for attention to strategic personnel policy.
Vanuit mijn rol als aandeelhouder vraag ik in het algemeen aandacht voor het strategische personeelsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikh over varend ontgassen in Flevoland

An MP asks the minister why the ban on onboard gas release (varend ontgassen) in Flevoland waters has not yet taken effect, despite a Chamber motion, and questions the health risks and enforcement gaps. The minister explains the international treaty ratification delay, notes ILT enforces existing rules, and agrees with provinces to pursue earlier emission reductions.

Meanwhile we are not standing still: within the Taskforce 'Varend Ontgassen' the central government works with the provinces, petrochemical, inland shipping and port industry associations on preparing the introduction of onboard gas release ban.

Ondertussen zitten we niet stil: binnen de Taskforce «Varend Ontgassen» werkt het Rijk samen met de provincies, brancheorganisaties uit de petrochemie, de binnenvaart en de havens aan de voorbereidingen van de invoering van het varend ontgassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het bericht ‘De Westereen 'bezorgd, misschien wel boos' over schrappen bushalte bij station’

The MP De Hoop asks the State Secretary about the removal of a bus stop in De Westereen, its importance for pupils, refugees and commuters, the broader cutting of bus services during COVID-19, and when the PBL/CBS study on transport poverty will be published. The State Secretary answers that regional authorities are responsible for such decisions, that the stop is minor (ranked 325th, not 15th), that the province keeps the measure until 2025, that OV-autoriteiten monitor service levels nationally, and that the transport-poverty study is delayed to 2022.
The considerations per concession, or even per bus line, are the responsibility of the decentralised government.
De afwegingen per concessie, of zelfs per buslijn, zijn de verantwoordelijkheid van de decentrale overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Baarle over het bericht dat volgens de rechter Uber chauffeurs in dienst moet nemen

An MP asked the government how it views the court ruling that Uber must employ its drivers, including whether it constitutes modern employer authority, whether specific regulation against false self-employment on platforms is needed, whether the ruling is immediately enforceable, and the status of the taxi sector review and COVID support. The government answered that it cannot judge court rulings, that clarification of employment relationships is needed and is a task for a new cabinet, that it is studying a legal presumption of employer status for platform work, that the ruling is enforceable pending appeal, and that the taxi sector evaluation and a study on drivers' finances will report in 2022.
The cabinet is therefore examining, for a future cabinet, whether and how a legal presumption for platform work could strengthen the position of platform workers in practice.
Het kabinet onderzoekt daarom, ten behoeve van een toekomstig kabinet, of en hoe een rechtsvermoeden bij platformwerk, de positie van platformwerkers in de praktijk kan versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over mogelijke ontwijking van het statiegeldsysteem

An MP asked whether producers are evading the deposit (statiegeld) system by shifting drinks to cartons without deposit, and what the government will do. The state secretary says the government will monitor litter data and market sales in 2022, has raised the issue with industry, introduced a recycling target for cartons, and will consider a deposit or ban on cartons for water and soft drinks if the shift grows.
In doing so, I will at least explore the possibilities of making deposits mandatory on drinks cartons and banning the use of drinks cartons for packaging water and soft drinks.
Daarbij verken ik in ieder geval de mogelijkheden van het verplichten van statiegeld op drankenkartons en het verbieden van het gebruik van drankenkartons voor het verpakken van water en frisdrank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het bericht ‘Oostenrijk lanceert ‘Klimaticket’: voor 3 euro per dag onbeperkt met het ov door het land’

The MP Boulakjar (D66) asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about Austria's 'Klimaticket' for unlimited public transport at 3 euro per day, and whether a similar system, family tickets, cross-operator annual passes and a pilot could work in the Netherlands. The secretary answered that a comparable national scheme would cost roughly 4,000 euro per person, that earlier experiments showed no measurable effect on congestion, and that an analysis of price instruments will be delivered to parliament in the second half of 2022.

As I indicated during the budget debate of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management on 4 November, in response to the motion by MPs Boulakjar and De Hoop, I will commission an analysis of which price instruments can be used to further expand the mobility shift.

Zoals ik tijdens de begrotingsbehandeling van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat op 4 november jl. heb aangegeven, in reactie op de motie van de leden Boulakjar en De Hoop, zal ik een analyse laten maken van welke (prijs)instrumenten ingezet kunnen worden om de mobiliteitsshift verder uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de uitvoering van het onderzoek naar de mogelijke risico’s van biobrandstoffen voor scheepsmotoren in de binnenvaart

MPs Alkaya asked about criticism from the shipping association ASV of the NEN study on biofuel risks for inland shipping engines, and about the study's scope, schipper involvement, and reliance on desk research. The Staatssecretaris answered that the study covers practical experience via the Meldpunt Binnenvaart and a survey, that schippers were involved via their representative bodies, that time pressure limited data collection, and that the government will keep discussing findings with the sector.
NEN will state in its report which research questions remain open in order to reach safe application of biofuel in ship engines.
NEN zal aangeven in haar rapport welke onderzoeksvragen nog openstaan om tot veilige toepassing van biobrandstof in scheepsmotoren te komen.

Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Hagen over de berichten ‘Meerderheid Nijmeegse politiek: vervuilende asfaltcentrale moet vertrekken ’ en ‘Protest tegen asfaltfabriek zwelt aan; ook andere wijken én politiek in verzet’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that an asphalt plant in Nijmegen may emit far more PAHs than allowed, and about how the competent authority can enforce, monitor and sanction. The state secretary acknowledged the exceedance, said enforcement tools and the 'recognised measure' rule are under review with a decision expected by year-end, and explained the monitoring, certification and fine-setting arrangements, while stating that the burden of proof stays with the authority.
Signals that the regulations on monitoring PAHs at asphalt plants are experienced as an obstacle, I take seriously and am investigating.
Signalen dat de regelgeving ten aanzien van monitoring van PAK's bij asfaltcentrales daarbij als belemmerend wordt ervaren neem ik serieus en onderzoek ik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het nieuws dat NS-medewerkers staken om de sluiting van servicestations te voorkomen

An SP MP asks the State Secretary about NS plans to close 15 of 36 staffed ticket service counters and shorten service hours, and the resulting strike, including effects on safety, assistance for people with reduced mobility, calamity support, and jobs. The State Secretary answers that the decision is NS's operational responsibility, that safety is monitored via the concession with NS, that assistance disruptions are being covered by extra staff, and that he will not intervene as concession grantor.
The plan to adjust service at stations is an operational responsibility of NS.
Het voornemen voor het aanpassen van de dienstverlening op stations betreft een operationele verantwoordelijkheid van NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over de geluidsoverlast van motoren

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about noise nuisance from motorcycles, including health effects, EU-level and national noise norms, roadside acoustic cameras, municipal road closures and the regulation of non-certified exhausts. The minister replied that noise policy is being developed in an integrated response expected after a new cabinet, that municipalities may close roads case by case, and that EU and national rules on exhausts and inspections are being reviewed or enforced.
For this reason an integrated policy response is expected to be drafted and sent to the House after a new cabinet takes office.
Om die reden zal een integrale beleidsreactie naar verwachting na aantreden van een nieuw kabinet kunnen worden opgesteld en naar de Kamer worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Hagen over investeringszekerheid en annex IX, A biobrandstoffen

MPs Bontenbal and Hagen asked the state secretary about soy-based biofuels under E10, the treatment of biomethanol from the gas grid, blending rules, and whether the opt-in for Annex IX-A biofuels in shipping would continue to give investment certainty. The state secretary answered that no soy oil was used, that grid-based methanol will qualify for HBEs under conditions from 2022, that blending of fossil and renewable fuels remains restricted, and that the opt-in for shipping will run until 2025 before moving to sector-specific policy.
I intend to continue this as manageably as possible until 1 January 2025 in the Energy Decree that is before your House.
Ik ben voornemens dit tot 1 januari 2025 zo beheersbaar mogelijk voort te zetten in het Besluit energie dat bij uw Kamer voorligt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hagen over de berichten ‘Primark wil af van vervuilende wegwerpmode’ en ‘Een betere wereld? Primark maakt er geen haast mee’

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about reports that Primark wants to move away from polluting fast fashion and that it plans to pay living wages in its supply chain only by 2030. The government welcomed Primark's steps, noted that concrete interim targets and transparent monitoring are still lacking, and described Dutch measures on living wages and the circular textile programme, including the planned extended producer responsibility for textiles.
I welcome that the company is taking steps to move closer to a circular textile chain.
Ik juich het toe dat het bedrijf stappen zet om dichter bij een circulaire textielketen te komen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de berichten dat ophoping van plastics en chemicaliën gerust mag worden beschouwd als de derde planetaire crisis en dat de schade door plastic bijna tien keer hoger ligt dan d

An MP asked the Minister whether plastic and chemical accumulation should be treated as a third planetary crisis and what the government will do about plastic's hidden costs. The State Secretary acknowledged the environmental problem, pointed to existing and planned measures (single-use plastics bans, deposit schemes, extended producer responsibility, a possible plastic levy left to the next cabinet) and said a global approach is needed.
I will shortly announce further measures to reduce the use of plastic cups and meal packaging.
Ik zal op korte termijn nadere maatregelen bekendmaken om het gebruik van plastic bekers en maaltijdverpakkingen terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het statiegeldsysteem voor kunststof flessen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the state secretary why small PET bottles cannot be returned for deposit at petrol stations, NS stations, cinemas and other venues, and whether the system is adequate. The state secretary answers that producers organise collection, that the system is satisfactory and will be evaluated in 2024, and that she sees no need to change responsibility for returns.
As promised, I will closely monitor shifts in the market and take additional policy measures if necessary.
Ik zal, zoals toegezegd, de verschuivingen in de markt nauwlettend volgen en indien nodig aanvullende beleidsmaatregelen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Aukje de Vries en Grinwis over het bericht op NOS.nl getiteld ‘Spoorbrug over Van Harinxmakanaal bij Leeuwarden nog wekenlang defect’

MPs Heerema, De Vries and Grinwis asked the minister about a defect that left the Leeuwarden railway bridge over the Van Harinxmakanaal unable to open for shipping for weeks, its causes, repair timeline, communication, inspection frequency, and whether a replacement study is needed. The minister and state secretary answered that the bridge was repaired and reopened in early October, that ProRail sees no need for early replacement or a quickscan, and that inspections and repair costs were addressed.
ProRail did its utmost to restore the functioning of the railway bridge as quickly as possible and was in constant contact with the ministry, the province and the municipality.
ProRail heeft haar uiterste best gedaan de werking van de spoorbrug zo spoedig mogelijk te herstellen en heeft daarbij voortdurend in contact gestaan met het ministerie, de provincie en de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar over het bericht «Grote treinstoring kwam door kapotte backup-server» en het bericht «ProRail onderzoekt oorzaak telefoniestoring»

MPs Boulakjar asked the state secretary how the 16 September 2021 nationwide rail outage relates to his earlier statement that the 31 May incident was a one-off, why the backup failed, and what has been done to make the telephony system robust. The state secretary answered that both outages had different causes but similar effects, that ProRail and the provider are investigating and will report in the annual impact report, that fixes were implemented after 31 May, and that backup checks and switchover times are being reviewed.
I have asked ProRail to report on this in the annual report on high-impact disruptions, which is part of the regular annual accountability reports that I always send to your House in spring.

Ik heb ProRail gevraagd hierover te rapporteren in de jaarlijkse rapportage impactvolle verstoringen, die onderdeel is van de reguliere jaarverantwoordingen, die ik uw Kamer altijd in het voorjaar doe toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Dubieuze investeringen van Nederlandse pensioenuitvoerders in Myanmar’

Two D66 MPs asked whether Dutch pension funds investing in companies linked to Myanmar's military should be curbed and whether participants should have more say over investments. The minister said the government advises firms and pension funds not to deal with military-controlled entities, relies on the IMVB covenant and engagement, and points to existing participant voice through boards and accountability bodies.
The cabinet is willing to specifically point pension funds, within this framework, to the lasting importance of the cited cabinet advice and its elaboration.
Het kabinet is bereid om de pensioenfondsen binnen dit verband ook specifiek te wijzen op het blijvende belang van het genoemde kabinetsadvies en de uitwerking er van.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over mogelijke bezuinigingen op het openbaar vervoer

An MP from DENK asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about planned public transport cuts affecting frequencies, safety, stops and fares, and whether operators should be fully compensated for lost passengers. The State Secretary answered that the earlier scenarios were provisional, that operators are updating 2022 plans under the existing financial framework, that the RET's security cuts are a local decision, and that full compensation is not planned since the subsidy covers 93–95% of costs.
I will inform you about this in the autumn.
Ik zal u hier dit najaar over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het toelaten van elektrische steps

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why electric scooters (e-steps) and similar light electric vehicles remain unlicensed in the Netherlands, asking about rental platforms, enforcement, fines, and timelines for legalisation. The minister answered that a national licensing framework is planned for 2023, that enforcement is by police with fines of 280 euro, and that a study on hoverboards and similar devices is expected in spring 2022.
The police do not keep a separate record of enforcement against e-steps.
De politie houdt geen aparte registratie bij van de handhaving op e-steps.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Sneller, Wuite, Romke de Jong en Van Weyenberg over de aanbesteding van fotografieopdrachten

D66 MPs asked whether the Ministry of General Affairs' tender for photography services, which bundles assignments with a large image bank, would exclude freelancers and SMEs and create a monopsony. The Prime Minister's answer says the tender is in preparation, that a pool of photographers will be selected via a single agency, that the image-bank and commissioned photography will be split into separate tenders, and that the approach honours the 2017 Vos/Mulder motion.
The Ministry of General Affairs has decided, after further consideration, that the commissioned photography and image-bank photography, initially bundled, will be decoupled in this tender.
Het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken heeft op basis van nadere afwegingen besloten dat de van aanvang gebundeld ingezette opdracht- en beeldbankfotografie in deze aanbesteding worden losgekoppeld.

m: Motie van het lid Van den Nieuwenhuijzen c.s. over subsidiëring van maatschappelijke organisaties beoordelen op de kwaliteit van hun programma's
Asks that subsidies to civil society organisations be assessed on programme quality, never on how far they support government policy, protecting critical independent civil society.
the subsidisation of civil society organisations must be assessed on the quality of their programmes and never on the degree of support for cabinet policy
de subsidiëring van maatschappelijke organisaties moet worden beoordeeld op de kwaliteit van hun programma's en nooit op de mate van ondersteuning van het kabinetsbeleid
Motie van het lid Voordewind c.s. over een inspanning van de regering om twee keer 50 vluchtelingen uit Griekenland op te nemen
Asks the government to make every effort to take in 50 unaccompanied minors and 50 vulnerable family members from Greece before Christmas.
to make every effort to realise this
zich tot het uiterste in te spannen om dit te realiseren
Motie van het lid Van Ojik c.s. over afspraken met burgemeesters over de opvang van vluchtelingen uit de kampen op de Griekse eilanden
Motion asking the government to meet mayors of five cities before year end to agree concrete arrangements for receiving refugees from Greek island camps.
requests the government to enter into talks with these mayors before the end of the year
verzoekt de regering, voor het einde van het jaar het gesprek aan te gaan met deze burgemeesters
Motie van het lid Van Ojik over de samenwerking met de Libische kustwacht heroverwegen
Asks the government to press in the EU for closing Libyan detention camps and to reconsider cooperation with the Libyan coast guard while they remain open.
requests the government to press within the EU for renewed efforts to close those camps and to reconsider further cooperation with the Libyan coast guard
verzoekt de regering, binnen de EU aan te dringen op een hernieuwde inspanning voor het sluiten van die kampen en de verdere samenwerking met de Libische kustwacht te heroverwegen
Motie van het lid Van Ojik c.s. over de achterstanden bij de IND voor 1 juni 2021 wegwerken

Amendement van het lid Van Ojik dat regelt dat een voorwaarde voor toepassing van het voorgestelde verlaagde energiebelastingtarief voor lokaal duurzaam opgewekte elektriciteit wordt aangepast
Allows a cooperative to qualify for the reduced energy tax rate when its generation installation is owned indirectly through a fully owned subsidiary company.
Motie van het lid Van Ojik over openbaarmaken van de jaarrekening
Asks the government to inform the Chamber on when companies must file annual accounts, how many wrongly failed to do so, and how supervision will improve.
requests the government to inform the Chamber by 2013 when a company must publish its annual accounts within thirteen months, and how many companies failed to comply

verzoekt de regering, de Kamer uiterlijk in 2013 te informeren (1) in welk geval een bedrijf de verplichting heeft om uiterlijk dertien maanden na afloop van het boekjaar de jaarrekening openbaar te maken
Amendement van het lid Van Ojik over het bieden van lange termijn investeringszekerheid aan de leden van een coöperatie
Amendment extending the tax-reduction protection for cooperative members' electricity supply to ten years when the reduction is lowered or ends.
With this amendment the aim is to offer cooperative members long-term investment security.
Met amendement wordt beoogd de leden van coöperatie lange termijn investeringzekerheid te bieden.
Motie van de leden Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over versterking van de rol van vrouwen in conflictsituaties als voorwaarde
Asks the government to make use of the International Security budget conditional on strengthening women's role in conflict situations.
requests the government to attach to the use of the International Security Budget the condition that it contributes to strengthening the role of women in conflict situations
verzoekt de regering, aan de inzet van het Budget voor Internationale Veiligheid de voorwaarde te stellen dat het bijdraagt aan versterking van de rol van vrouwen in conflictsituaties
Motie van de leden Voordewind en Van Ojik over bescherming van burgers verankeren in het uitzendtoetsingskader
Asks the government to address civilian protection compliance in its article 100 letters to parliament and to anchor this in the deployment assessment framework.
requests the government to explicitly address, in article 100 letters, how obligations regarding civilian protection are observed before and during missions

verzoekt de regering om, in artikel 100-brieven, conform het advies van de Evaluatiecommissie van de Nederlandse deelneming aan ISAF in Uruzgan, «expliciet aandacht te besteden aan de wijze waarop voorafgaande aan en tijdens missies verplichtingen met betrekking tot de bescherming van burgers worden nageleefd
Motie van het lid Servaes c.s. over waar mogelijk ondersteunen van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek
Asks the government to support the criminal investigation into the attack on a Dutch diplomat in Moscow and keep the House continuously informed.
requests the Dutch government to support the criminal investigation where possible and to keep the House continuously informed about it
verzoekt de Nederlandse regering, het strafrechtelijk onderzoek waar mogelijk te ondersteunen en de Kamer hierover voortdurend te informeren
Motie Omtzigt c.s. over onderzoek naar het geweld van de Turkse autoriteiten tegen demonstranten
Asks the government to press Turkish authorities for an independent investigation into violence against demonstrators and to report back to parliament.
requests the government, and the foreign minister in particular, to personally urge a member of the Turkish government for a swift and independent investigation
verzoekt de regering, en in het bijzonder de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken, woensdag persoonlijk bij een lid van de Turkse regering te pleiten voor een snel en onafhankelijk onderzoek
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 27 over het inzetten van 2,5 miljoen euro via de maatschappelijke organisaties in Rwanda
Shifts 2.5 million euro from sectoral budget support to Rwanda into civil society organisations in Rwanda, a foreign aid allocation without bearing on executive checks.
This amendment aims to deploy 2.5 million euro via civil society organisations in Rwanda (art 2.5).
Dit amendement beoogt € 2,5 miljoen in te zetten via maatschappelijke organisaties in Rwanda (art 2.5).
Motie van het lid Van Ojik over uitbreiding van de diplomatieke inzet aangaande Syrië
Asks the government to expand diplomacy on Syria by appointing a traveling ambassador and adding staff at the embassy in Turkey.
requests the government to expand diplomatic efforts on Syria by appointing a traveling ambassador and increasing staffing at the embassy in Turkey
verzoekt de regering, de diplomatieke inzet aangaande Syrië uit te breiden door middel van het benoemen van een reizende ambassadeur en verhoging van de personele inzet op de ambassade in Turkije
Motie van de leden Van Bommel en Van Ojik over onderhandelingen over de afstoting van de Nederlandse kerntaak
Asks the government to negotiate directly with the US government on phasing out the Dutch nuclear task, which is a defence and foreign policy matter rather than a check on the executive.
requests the government to enter into negotiations directly with the American government on phasing out the Dutch nuclear task
verzoekt de regering, rechtstreeks met de Amerikaanse regering de onderhandeling aan te gaan over afstoting van de Nederlandse kerntaak
Motie van de leden Van Ojik en Bonis over richtlijnen voor het Uitzendtoetsingskader
Asks the government to anchor civilian-protection obligations in guidelines and the Uitzendtoetsingskader for military deployments.
requests the government to anchor this in the Uitzendtoetsingskader
verzoekt de regering, dit te verankeren in het «Uitzendtoetsingskader»
Motie van het lid Van der Staaij c.s. over het stimuleren van geefgedrag
Motion asking the government to explore how companies and private individuals can be encouraged to give, to reduce aid organisations' dependence on subsidy.
requests the government to map how companies and individuals can be further stimulated to give.
verzoekt de regering, in kaart te brengen op welke wijze bedrijven en particulieren extra gestimuleerd kunnen worden tot geefgedrag
Motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over de verwijdering van Europese tactische kernwapens
Asks the government to make removal of European tactical nuclear weapons a hard goal and to put it on the agenda of the Oslo conference, reporting to the House beforehand.
requests the government to formulate the removal of European tactical nuclear weapons as a hard objective
verzoekt de regering, de verwijdering van Europese tactische kernwapens als harde doelstelling te formuleren
Motie van het lid Van Ojik over uitbreiding van het Shelter City-programma
Asks the government to explore expanding the Shelter City programme for human rights defenders and to inform the House with the upcoming Human Rights Note.
requests the government to investigate how useful expansion of the Shelter City programme can be realised
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken hoe nuttige uitbreiding van het Shelter City-programma kan worden gerealiseerd
Motie Van Ojik over een Human Rights due dilligence-proces
Asks the government to supervise that companies receiving export or state support carry out human rights due diligence and follow OECD guidelines.
requests the government to supervise that companies benefiting from state support carry out a human rights due diligence process
verzoekt de regering, er toezicht op te houden dat bedrijven die profiteren van economische diplomatieke dienstverlening of andere overheidssteun, een «human rights due diligence»-proces uitvoeren
Amendement van het lid Maij c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 23 over het verhogen van de beschikbare middelen voor FLOW met € 10 miljoen in 2013
Shifts €10 million within the development budget from Mali budget support to the FLOW fund for women and girls in developing countries in 2013.
Coverage is provided by a reduction of article 4.2 Effective poverty policy of developing countries.
Dekking wordt geboden door een verlaging van artikel 4.2 Effectief armoede beleid van ontwikkelingslanden.
Motie Van Ojik c.s. over de bezuinigingen van het vorige kabinet-Rutte
Asks the government to study the effects of the previous Rutte cabinet's aid cuts on developing countries and report to the House before the Spring Memorandum.
requests the government to conduct a study into the effects on developing countries and programmes of the cuts by the previous Rutte cabinet
verzoekt de regering, een onderzoek in te stellen naar de gevolgen voor ontwikkelingslanden en -programma's van de bezuinigingen van het vorige kabinet-Rutte
Motie Voordewind en Van Ojik over gebonden hulp
Asks the government not to provide tied aid, since it benefits developing countries only marginally.
requests the government not to give tied aid
verzoekt de regering, geen gebonden hulp te geven
Motie Sjoerdsma c.s. over inzicht in de besteding van de ontwikkelingsgelden
Asks the government to give the best possible insight into how development aid funds are spent and their results, through digital publication.
requests the government to give the best possible insight into the spending of development funds and their results
verzoekt de regering, een zo goed mogelijk inzicht te geven in de besteding van de ontwikkelingsgelden en de resultaten daarvan
Amendement van het lid Maij c.s. over het verhogen van de beschikbare middelen voor FLOW met € 10 miljoen in 2013
Amendment moving 10 million euros to the FLOW fund for women in developing countries in 2013, financed by cutting budget support for Mali.
Funding is provided by a reduction of article 4.2 Effective poverty policy of developing countries.
Dekking wordt geboden door een verlaging van artikel 4.2 Effectief armoede beleid van ontwikkelingslanden.
Amendement van het lid Maij c.s. over het in 2013 eenmalig verhogen van de beschikbare middelen voor UN-Women met € 2 miljoen
Increases funding for UN Women by 2 million euros in 2013 by reducing budget support for Mali.
Funding is provided by reducing article 4.2 Effective poverty policy of developing countries.
Dekking wordt geboden via een verlaging van artikel 4.2 Effectief armoede beleid van ontwikkelingslanden.
Motie Van Ojik en Jasper van Dijk over de komende Voorjaarsnota
Asks the government to review all existing tax treaties with third countries for negative effects on developing countries and to inform the House before the Spring Memorandum.

Asks the government to inform the House in spring 2013 on how climate funds can avoid reducing development programmes without a climate goal, including scenarios for private financing.
to inform the House in spring 2013 on how climate funds can be spent so that they come as little as possible at the expense of development programmes without a climate goal
de Kamer in het voorjaar van 2013 te informeren over de wijze waarop de klimaatgelden zo min mogelijk ten koste van ontwikkelingsprogramma's zonder klimaatdoel gaan
Amendement van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. over het inzetten van € 1,5 miljoen via maatschappelijke organisaties in Rwanda
Proposes moving €1.5 million within the foreign aid budget to civil society organisations in Rwanda and stopping sectoral budget support to Rwanda.
sectoral budget support should now be stopped
zou sectorale begrotingssteun nu moeten worden stopgezet
Asks the government to apply the FIETS sustainability criteria to the planned revolving development fund of 750 million euro.
requests the government to also declare these sustainability criteria applicable to the revolving fund yet to be established
verzoekt de regering, deze duurzaamheidscriteria ook van toepassing te verklaren voor het nog op te richten revolverende fonds
Motie van het lid Klaver c.s. over een onafhankelijke evaluatie van missies
Asks the government to set up a system of independent evaluation of military missions by the Ministry of Defence and inform the House about it.
requests the government to set up a system of independent evaluation of missions by the Ministry of Defence and to inform the House about it
verzoekt de regering, een systeem van onafhankelijke evaluatie van missies op te zetten door het ministerie van Defensie en de Kamer hierover te informeren
Motie van het lid Klaver c.s. over bescherming van burgers in de nieuwe visie op de krijgsmacht
Asks the government to give attention to civilian protection when developing the new vision on the armed forces, to help translate theory into practice.
requests the government, when developing the new vision on the armed forces, also to give attention to protection of civilians
verzoekt de regering, bij het ontwikkelen van de nieuwe visie op de krijgsmacht ook bescherming van burgers aandacht te geven
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Van Ojik en Leijten over het bericht ‘Statement of the Members of the European Council’

MPs Kuiken, Van Ojik and Leijten asked the Prime Minister whether the European Council's March 2021 statement to start work on modernising the EU-Turkey customs union squared with the minister's earlier remarks, and why it should not be paused given Turkey's withdrawal from the Istanbul Convention and moves against the HDP. The government replied that the customs union has not been decided, that discussion only starts under the positive agenda conditional on de-escalation, and that human rights and the rule of law must remain part of the EU-Turkey dialogue, with the minister having raised these concerns directly with Turkey.
The cabinet will reiterate this in relevant new discussions with colleagues.
Het kabinet zal dit bij relevante nieuwe discussies met collega’s opnieuw benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld van de leden Van den Hul, Van Ojik en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over de stelselmatige verkrachting van Oeigoerse vrouwen in Chinese kampen

MPs Van den Hul, Van Ojik and Van den Nieuwenhuijzen asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about reported systematic rape and torture of Uyghur women in Chinese camps, what action the government would take, whether it would press China on human rights and sanctions, and what it was doing about Dutch companies profiting from Uyghur forced labour. The ministers answered that they condemn these abuses, raised them with the Chinese ambassador and in joint EU and UN statements, supported independent UN investigation and EU sanctions, held talks with business and organised a sector session on due diligence, while stating the government has no overview of companies linked to Xinjiang supply chains.
The cabinet has no overview of companies that are linked to the situation in Xinjiang through their supply chain.
Het kabinet heeft geen overzicht van bedrijven die via hun toeleveringsketen zijn gelinkt aan de situatie in Xinjiang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Bouali over het verdwijnen van Vietnamese alleenstaande kinderen uit de COA-opvang

MPs Van Ojik and Bouali asked about Vietnamese unaccompanied minors disappearing from COA shelter, including police handling of two boys later found in the Essex case, trafficking criteria, and new work procedures. The state secretary answered that police monitored the boys across the border without a concrete suspicion, that no 'doorlaten' occurred, that Vietnamese minors are placed in protected shelter, and described existing cooperation with the UK and EU.
In the Netherlands this case will be reflected upon and it will be examined which possible lessons can be drawn from it.
In Nederland zal gereflecteerd worden op deze zaak en zal worden bezien welke mogelijke lessen hier uit getrokken kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van den Hul en Van Ojik over de sloop van een Palestijns dorp

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government reacts to Israel's repeated demolition of the Palestinian village Humsah al-Fawqa, which left over seventy people homeless, and whether the government will push for firm EU measures against continued demolitions. The minister says the Netherlands and the EU are very concerned, have called on Israel to stop demolitions, visited the village with other European representatives, and will pursue a joint European response such as demarches and diplomatic visits, without committing to sanctions.
The Netherlands is actively working toward a joint European response to the demolition of Palestinian buildings.
Nederland zet zich actief in voor een gezamenlijke Europese reactie ten aanzien van sloop van Palestijnse gebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Groothuizen, Van Ojik en Jasper van Dijk over pushbacks van vluchtelingen door de Kroatische grensbewaking

MPs asked the State Secretary whether she knew of Danish Refugee Council and EenVandaag reports of pushbacks and violence by Croatian border guards, and whether she would raise them at EU Justice and Home Affairs Council, press the Commission, reconsider mutual trust in Croatia and address the damage to EU asylum policy. The State Secretary said the allegations are serious and must be investigated, that the subject was discussed at the January 2021 JHA Council and under Croatia's Schengen action plan, that the Commission is in dialogue with Croatia and is setting up an independent monitoring mechanism, and that mutual trust applies unless a court rules otherwise.
No court rulings have been made regarding Croatia that would mean the principle of mutual trust can no longer be assumed.
Over Kroatië zijn in dezen geen rechterlijke uitspraken gedaan die tot gevolg hebben dat niet langer kan worden uitgegaan van het interstatelijk vertrouwensbeginsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de toegang van journalisten tot China

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why journalists with Chinese residence permits are still barred from re-entering China after travel abroad, and how many Dutch and European correspondents are affected. The minister said the cabinet regrets the restrictions, has repeatedly asked Chinese authorities to lift them, and that the Dutch correspondent has now been allowed back, while exact numbers are unknown and further efforts will continue.
Exact numbers are not known to me.
Exacte aantallen zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het landgebonden asielbeleid voor China

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the Dutch asylum policy for Chinese nationals, which allows examining Turkey as a first country of asylum or safe third country for Uyghurs, should change given a reported China-Turkey extradition treaty, and asked about Uyghur asylum numbers, ratification timing, and whether Chinese journalists and bloggers should be treated as a risk group. The State Secretary answered that the policy will not change for now because the treaty is unratified and safety is assessed individually, that Chinese asylum seekers numbered 56 in 2020 with no Chinese nationals returned to Turkey, and that journalists and bloggers cannot be treated as a risk group as a whole in China.
I will closely monitor developments and where necessary gather information on this.
Ik zal de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend in de gaten houden en waar nodig informatie hierover inwinnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Ojik over zorg en begeleiding voor ex-AMV'ers vanaf 18 jaar

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about extended care and support for unaccompanied minor asylum seekers (AMV'ers) after they turn 18, including whether a uniform scheme and extra funding should be found. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for adult status holders, that Nidos extension is already possible at municipal cost, and that no structural or incidental funds are available in 2021, while promising ambtelijk contact but no timeline.
Should a new cabinet wish to regulate the support of the group you mean structurally and nationally, a civil-servant proposal will be requested for that purpose.
Mocht een nieuw kabinet de begeleiding van de door u bedoelde groep structureel en landelijk willen regelen, dan zal gevraagd worden om een ambtelijk voorstel daartoe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse regering stelt dat de Chinese regering zich schuldig maakt aan genocide op de Oeigoeren

MPs Van Ojik and Van den Nieuwenhuijzen asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares the US claim that China commits genocide against the Uyghurs and whether the Netherlands will launch an official investigation, grant access to Xinjiang, or act jointly with the US. The minister answered that the Netherlands is concerned about abuses but, following the government's recognition criteria (international court rulings, consistent scientific findings, UN determinations), does not currently find genocide established, and will raise the matter in EU context while requesting access for observers.

Leading for the Dutch government in recognizing genocides are rulings of international courts or tribunals, unambiguous conclusions from scientific research, and determinations by the UN, as set out in the coalition agreement.

Leidend voor de Nederlandse regering bij de erkenning van genocides zijn uitspraken van internationale gerechts- of strafhoven, eenduidige conclusies volgend uit wetenschappelijk onderzoek en vaststellingen door de VN leidend

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik, Van den Hul, Sjoerdsma en Karabulut over het ter dood veroordeelde Pakistaanse echtpaar Shafqat Emmanuel en Shagufta Kausar

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the death sentence for blasphemy imposed on the Pakistani couple Shafqat Emmanuel and Shagufta Kausar, the repeated postponements of their appeal, and what the government would do through diplomacy, EU channels and asylum support. The minister condemned the death sentence, said the Netherlands and the EU raised concerns with Pakistani authorities without intervening in the court process, and declined to commit to attending the trial or to pre-judging any asylum request.
The Netherlands and the EU do not intervene in the legal proceedings in other countries.
Nederland en de EU interveniëren niet in de rechtsgang in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van der Lee over het bericht dat het Noorse verzekeringsbedrijf ‘DNV GL’ de certificatie voor Nord Stream 2 intrekt

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about DNV GL withdrawing certifications for Nord Stream 2, the consequences for completion, the status of the court and arbitration cases, and enforcement of the EU gas directive. The government answered that alternative routes are unknown, that it opposes US sanctions but will not anticipate their effects, that the cases are pending and the gas directive is currently applied strictly, and that it will not comment on matters before courts.
It is not appropriate for the cabinet to respond to matters that are before the courts.
Het past het kabinet niet om te reageren op zaken die onder de rechter zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Kuiken, Markuszower en Voordewind over de poging van het Koninklijk Huis om een strafzaak te beïnvloeden

MPs from six parties asked the Prime Minister and Justice Minister about alleged attempts by circles around the Royal House to influence the Poch criminal case, leaks from the investigation, and withheld Argentine legal-aid documents. The minister answered that the Commission Poch found no confirmation of the alleged influence, that a leak prosecution is likely time-barred, and that the archive documents will be assessed for release under Article 68 of the Constitution after the Commission is dissolved.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Jasper van Dijk en Kuiken over de bureaucratie waarmee Ranov-vergunninghouders worden tegengewerkt bij het verkrijgen van het Nederlanderschap

MPs Van Ojik, Van Dijk and Kuiken asked why Ranov permit holders who have lived in the Netherlands for decades must meet a strict document requirement to naturalise, and whether the requirement should be dropped or Ranov permits converted to asylum permits. The State Secretary answers that individual exceptions are possible, that Ranov holders were found not to need protection and can be expected to obtain documents from their country of origin, and that a new WODC study will examine problems Ranov holders experience.

The policy ensures that, in the naturalisation procedure, the personal details and current possession of a foreign nationality are as far as possible known and demonstrated for foreigners with a regular right of residence.

Het beleid borgt dat in de naturalisatieprocedure zo goed als mogelijk de persoonsgegevens en het actueel bezit van de vreemde nationaliteit bekend en aangetoond zijn van vreemdelingen met een regulier verblijfrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het statement van de EU dat meer dan 800 Palestijnen het risico lopen gedwongen te worden uitgezet in Oost-Jeruzalem

MP Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister whether he knows of the EU statement that over 800 Palestinians risk forced eviction in East Jerusalem, whether this violates international humanitarian and human rights law, and what steps the government will take to protect these families and press Israel. The minister confirmed awareness, stated that forced transfer is prohibited under occupation law, and said the Netherlands and EU repeatedly urge Israel to refrain, including through diplomatic visits and funding legal aid, without committing to new concrete steps.
The cabinet calls on Israel to strictly comply with these obligations.
Het kabinet roept Israël op tot strikte naleving van deze verplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Karabulut, Ploumen, Van Raan, Van Ojik, Van Helvert en Van der Staaij over de mensenrechtensituatie in West-Papua

MPs from seven parties asked the Foreign Minister about arms exports to Indonesia, the Community Policing Programme, human rights in West Papua, journalist access, the murder of Yeremia Zanambani, and environmental damage by companies. The minister answered that arms licences are assessed case by case including the Papua situation, the Dutch programme ended in 2019 with local continuation, and human rights concerns are raised bilaterally, though no full overview of documented violations or environmental damage is held.
However, I do not have a complete overview of all documented damage to the environment, living environment and climate in Papua.
Ik beschik echter niet over een totaaloverzicht van alle gedocumenteerde schade aan milieu, leefomgeving en klimaat in Papua.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Graaf, Bosman, Bouali, Leijten, Asscher en Van Ojik over het juridische advies van de commissie over de Brexit-deal.

Six MPs and a Green MP asked the ministers whether the Council's Legal Service had put its advice on the Brexit deal in writing, and requested all internal and external legal advice on the deal, plus options for a smooth transition if the deal is mixed. The minister replied that the Legal Service confirmed its view only orally, that the conclusions will be written into the Council decision and a Commission statement, that the EU-only route is a political choice not binding on future deals, and that interim application of mixed parts is not possible, while the legal analysis and a confidential annex were shared with the Chamber.
There are no written opinions from the Council's Legal Service (JDR) on these questions; the JDR confirmed both points orally.
Er zijn over deze vraagstukken geen schriftelijke adviezen van de Juridische Dienst van de Raad (JDR) verschenen; de JDR heeft beide punten mondeling bevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Ploumen en Karabulut over het bericht 'Egypt arrested its leaders, but a leading human rights group remains defiant'

Four MPs asked the foreign minister about the arrest of three senior staff of the Egyptian Initiative for Personal Rights, shortly after Western ambassadors including the Dutch one had visited the group, and about whether the Netherlands would raise concerns. The minister confirmed the arrests and their charges, said the three were released on 3 December while charges remain, and stated that the Netherlands has raised concerns with Egyptian authorities through diplomatic channels.
Both in Cairo and in The Hague, the Netherlands has engaged with the Egyptian authorities at various levels to convey our concerns and ask for clarification.
Zowel in Cairo en in Den Haag is Nederland op verschillende niveaus in gesprek gegaan met de Egyptische autoriteiten om onze zorgen over te brengen en opheldering te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen, Van Ojik en Bromet over het verzwakken van Europese standaarden voor landbouwgif onder Canadese druk via CETA

MPs from GroenLinks asked the trade and development minister whether CETA weakens EU pesticide safety standards, including reports of a shift to case-by-case risk assessment and Canadian pressure via CETA committees. The minister denied any abandonment of the precautionary principle, said the Netherlands opposed refusing import tolerances, and stated that CETA committees cannot change EU law and no concessions were made.
CETA does not affect the precautionary principle, which is anchored in EU law.
CETA tast het voorzorgsprincipe, dat is verankerd in EU-recht, niet aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ploumen en Van Ojik over het Nederlandse kernwapenbeleid

Three MPs asked the foreign and defence ministers about NATO's decision to publicise the nuclear dimension of exercise Steadfast Noon, transparency on Dutch nuclear policy, the Secretary-General's visit to Volkel, and whether nuclear sharing breaches the Non-Proliferation Treaty. The ministers answered that transparency is being increased within alliance limits, that exercise details and US nuclear locations remain classified, and that nuclear sharing arrangements predate and are consistent with the NPT.
As your House is aware, no statements can be made on the numbers and locations of American nuclear weapons present in Europe, due to alliance and legally binding agreements.

Zoals uw Kamer bekend, kunnen over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de uitspraak van Merkel dat "een compromis van alle kanten nodig is" over het rechtsstaatmechanisme ter bescherming van de rechtsstaat in de EU-begroting

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would resist any weakening of the agreed EU rule-of-law budget mechanism after Merkel called for compromise. The minister replied that the agreed outcome with the European Parliament is the Dutch lower limit, that the Netherlands will keep pressing this, and that it is for the German presidency, not the Netherlands, to set options.
The cabinet will continue to work at all levels to preserve the negotiated outcome and to ensure that no harm is done to the conclusions of the European Council of 17-21 July.

Het kabinet zal zich op alle niveaus blijven inzetten voor behoud van het bereikte onderhandelingsresultaat en er op blijven toezien dat geen afbreuk wordt gedaan aan de conclusies van de Europese Raad van 17-21 juli jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over de bijeenkomst van de G20 georganiseerd door Saoedi-Arabië

MPs asked whether the Dutch UN envoy would attend the G20 meeting hosted by Saudi Arabia, and about the detention of Saudi women's rights activists and what the government has done about it. The minister answered that the Netherlands did not attend the G20 summit or side events, raised the activists' detention through several channels, and expressed concern about their treatment without committing to new concrete action.
The Netherlands did not take part in the G20 summit held virtually on 21 and 22 November.
Nederland nam niet deel aan de G20-top die op 21 en 22 november jl. virtueel plaatsvond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de voortgang van de evacuatie van asielzoekers van het Griekse eiland Lesbos

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the evacuation of asylum seekers from Lesbos, including conditions at the Kara Tepe camp, sanitation, healthcare, lead contamination, and the relocation of unaccompanied minors to the Netherlands. The government answered that conditions are improving under Greek and EU management, that Pikpa is empty and Kara Tepe is to close by year end, and that the Netherlands offered to relocate 100 people but sees no reason to increase that offer.
I have already committed to informing your House about this in more detail.
Ik heb uw Kamer reeds toegezegd hier nader over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over het landgebonden asielbeleid ten aanzien van Armenië en Azerbeidzjan

MPs Van Ojik, Voordewind and Jasper van Dijk asked whether escalating fighting in Nagorno-Karabach and neighbouring Armenian-Azerbaijani border areas warrants revising asylum return policy and the Armenia safe-country designation, and whether a return moratorium is needed. The State Secretary replied that the policy stands for now, citing the 10 November ceasefire and monitoring of the situation, with individual asylum assessments continuing and a possible new thematic country report if developments warrant it.
Depending on developments, a new (thematic) country report may be requested, which will address the security situation in Azerbaijan.
Afhankelijk van de ontwikkelingen kan een nieuw (thematisch) ambtsbericht worden opgevraagd, waarbij dan wordt ingegaan op de veiligheidssituatie in Azerbeidzjan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Kuiken, Van Ojik, De Roon, Karabulut en Voordewind over het Nederlandse meisje Insiya, dat ontvoerd is naar India en de pogingen die de Nederlandse regering onderneem

Six MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice why the Dutch child Insiya, abducted to India by her father, has not been returned, what steps have been taken, and whether ministers will personally intervene. The government answered that Dutch court rulings are not automatically binding in India, that it keeps raising the case bilaterally and at high level, and that it has contact persons for the mother, but that return depends on Indian legal procedures and it will not detail enforcement steps against the father.
The Netherlands will keep drawing India's attention to the rulings of the Dutch court and will closely follow the proceedings in India.
Nederland zal de uitspraken van de Nederlandse rechter bij India onder de aandacht blijven brengen en zal uitspraak in de procedures in India nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Ojik over de coronamaatregelen in de asielketen

MP Van Ojik asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about COVID-19 infections, testing, hygiene supplies and distancing in COA asylum reception centres and immigration detention. The State Secretary answered that infections are reported per location, that protocols and quarantine arrangements exist, that residents must largely provide their own masks and hygiene products, and that complaints at Rotterdam detention centre are pending before a court.
I cannot respond on matters that are still before the court.
Over zaken die nog onder de rechter zijn, kan ik geen reactie geven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Asscher, Van Otterloo, Van Ojik en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht dat het Verenigd Koninkrijk met nieuwe wetgeving afspraken uit het uittredingsakkoord niet na dreigt te komen

Five MPs asked the government about the UK's planned Internal Market Bill, which would breach parts of the Withdrawal Agreement, and its risks for citizens' rights and Dutch nationals in the UK. The State Secretary answered that the government shares concerns, monitors citizens' rights implementation with the Commission, sees no current signs of further UK legislation undermining citizens' rights, and will consider information measures for Dutch nationals in the UK.

The government therefore monitors, together with the European Commission and in several ways, whether these rights are being honoured, including via the Joint Committee and the Dutch embassy in the UK.
Het kabinet monitort daarom samen met de Europese Commissie op verschillende manieren of deze rechten worden nagekomen, onder meer via het Gemengd Comité en via de Nederlandse ambassade in het VK.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘VS zet hoofdaanklager Internationaal Strafhof op zwarte lijst’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about US sanctions placing the ICC chief prosecutor and Court staff on a blacklist, and what the Netherlands has done bilaterally and in the EU to prevent or respond to them. The minister answered that the government repeatedly urged the US not to escalate, is pursuing EU options such as the Anti-Boycott Regulation, and is working with banks to limit the impact on the Court, while stressing the Court must keep functioning.
Over recent months close contact has been maintained with the Court, various banks and our European partners.
Afgelopen maanden is nauw contact onderhouden met het Strafhof, verschillende banken en onze Europese partners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de optie om via UNHCR-hervestiging de noodsituatie op de Griekse eilanden te verlichten

An MP asked the State Secretary about conditions in the Greek island camps (Moria) and whether UNHCR resettlement, including of unaccompanied minors, should be expanded to relieve them. The government acknowledges the poor conditions and local hostility, notes Greek efforts and transfers, and declines to reassign unaccompanied minors but agrees to take 50 minors and 50 family migrants via the existing quota.
In response, the cabinet has decided, as a rare exception, to offer Greece to take in 50 unaccompanied minors and 50 migrants in family units with minor children.
In reactie daarop, heeft het kabinet besloten, om bij hoge uitzondering, Griekenland aan te bieden 50 amv en 50 migranten in gezinsverband met minderjarige kinderen op te vangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de chaos bij de IND-taskforce die de achterstallige asielzaken moet afdoen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports of chaos at the IND task force clearing backlogged asylum cases, including incomplete files, unanswered calls, lawyers unable to assist clients, and cases pushed into the extended procedure. The State Secretary referred to a 7 September letter, acknowledged start-up problems now being addressed, reported over 4,000 cases cleared by 1 September, and committed to clearing all task-force cases by year end.
The start-up problems have been and are now being addressed.
De opstartproblemen zijn en worden inmiddels aangepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik, Karabulut, Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van der Staaij en Van Raan over de beveiliging van Nobelprijswinnaar dr. Denis Mukwege

MPs asked whether MONUSCO protection of Nobel laureate Denis Mukwege and the Panzi hospital is sufficient, whether Nederland will play a role in his security, and whether he should be protected. The minister answered that Nederland pressed the UN for adequate protection, MONUSCO assigned Nepalese troops to the compound and committed to continued protection, and Nederland is exploring a new contribution to security without a formal request from Mukwege.
For this reason, the Netherlands has in recent weeks pressed the UN for adequate protection for Dr. Mukwege.
Nederland heeft daarom de afgelopen weken bij de VN aangedrongen op adequate bescherming voor dr. Mukwege.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over de impact van coronabeperkingen op visumverlening aan buitenlandse geliefden van Nederlanders

MPs asked the government about the impact of COVID-19 restrictions on visa processing for foreign partners of Dutch nationals, including closed embassies, cancelled civic integration exams abroad, and whether alternative routes such as online exams or post-arrival testing are possible. The minister answered that most posts now offer the basic integration exam, that online testing is ruled out to prevent fraud, that post-arrival testing is incompatible with the MVV process, and that the government will keep working with posts and EU partners but cannot quantify affected families.
There is no insight into figures on the number of Dutch nationals currently forced to live apart because their partner cannot take the basic civic integration exam abroad.
Er is geen inzicht in cijfers van het aantal Nederlandse staatsburgers dat op dit moment gescheiden moet leven vanwege het niet kunnen afleggen van een basisexamen inburgering buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Bouali, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Israël martelde verdachte Palestijnen van een NGO gesteund door Nederland'

MPs asked whether the Israeli detention and alleged torture of two former staff of the Palestinian NGO UAWC, which the Netherlands supports, breaches international law, and about military trial, access to counsel and administrative detention. The ministers say the Netherlands is concerned, has raised torture and fair-trial rights with Israel and the EU, notes an Israeli Justice Ministry inquiry without published results, and will keep monitoring the case.
The Netherlands will continue to follow the progress.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de verlening van vergunningen voor wapenexport naar landen die een VN-wapenembargo schenden

An MP asked the minister why an arms export licence was granted to Egypt for €114 million of naval radar and C3 systems despite Egypt's alleged breaches of the UN Libya arms embargo, Egypt's human rights record, and its role in Yemen, and whether the Chamber could be informed before such licences are issued. The minister answered that Egypt is not under an arms embargo, that no clear diversion or misuse risk was identified under the EU criteria, and refused to revoke the licence or pre-inform parliament, while stating ongoing monitoring of the situation.
No. For the sake of legal certainty for companies, it is important that the assessment framework is fixed when the licence is applied for and that it is applied objectively.

Nee. Omwille van de rechtszekerheid voor bedrijven is het van belang dat het toetsingskader vast staat op het moment dat de vergunning wordt aangevraagd en dat dit toetsingskader objectief wordt toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, De Roon, Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Van Helvert en Van Ojik over de bombardementen van Turkije in de Iraakse regio Sinjar

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish bombings in the Sinjar region of Iraq, including alleged strikes on a refugee camp, a hospital and Yezidi areas, and whether the Netherlands would seek clarification or condemn them. The minister confirmed awareness, said the camp and hospital were reportedly not directly hit according to local sources, cited PKK presence as the reason for Turkish strikes, and said the Netherlands raised the bombings with EU partners and urges restraint and respect for international humanitarian law.
I have also recently raised the Turkish bombings with my European colleagues at the Foreign Affairs Council on 13 July.
Ook heb ik de Turkse bombardementen recentelijk opgebracht bij mijn Europese collega's tijdens de Raad Buitenlandse zaken op 13 juli jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over de situatie in Noord-Mozambique

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about the insurgency in Cabo Delgado, Mozambique, including casualties, displacement, funding sources, Mozambican government conduct, press access and the case of a missing journalist. The minister answered that the situation is serious, that Dutch embassy and EU channels have raised concerns about army abuses and press freedom, and that Nederland supports development programmes and a multi-stakeholder platform, without committing to a new concrete step beyond existing diplomacy.
It is unclear whether he was actually taken away by the army.
Het is onduidelijk of hij daadwerkelijk door het leger is meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Karabulut en Van den Hul over de doorvoer van ruim 10 miljoen kogelpatronen naar Turkije

Opposition MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a transit of over 10 million cartridges from Czechia through Rotterdam to Turkey despite Dutch restrictions, and about prior assurances on Czech export checks. The minister confirmed the transit without transhipment, said no Dutch licence was required, explained that end-use details are confidential and not held in the Netherlands, and said the government would not require standard customs checks on Czech consignments.

Since the goods require a licence in Czechia rather than in the Netherlands, and given the confidential nature of the information, the cabinet cannot provide additional information on the end use of the goods.

Aangezien de goederen niet in Nederland maar in Tsjechië vergunningplichtig zijn, en gelet op de vertrouwelijke aard van de informatie kan het kabinet geen aanvullende informatie verstrekken aangaande het eindgebruik van de goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Zwangere Afrikaanse asielzoeksters verdwijnen uit opvang'

MPs Van der Graaf and Van Ojik asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about reports that pregnant African asylum seekers disappeared from reception centres, including whether this resembles the Koolvis trafficking case, and what protection and follow-up is planned. The State Secretary said trafficking is not yet established, that COA and EMM have acted on signals, that a phenomenon study will be undertaken and reported after the summer recess, and that the answers to some questions were delayed.
Unfortunately it has not been possible to answer the questions within the requested time limit.
Het is helaas niet gelukt om de vragen binnen de gevraagde termijn te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Voordewind, Groothuizen, Kuiken en Van Ojik over het bericht dat Griekenland asielzoekers stiekem terugstuurt naar Turkije

MPs from five parties asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how the Netherlands views reports that Greece secretly returns asylum seekers to Turkey, whether this breaches the ECHR, and whether the government will press for independent investigation in EU and Council of Europe settings. The government says it has no independent information to confirm or refute the reports, that Greece denies them and temporarily suspended asylum applications from March to April 2020, and that it expects Greece and the EU to comply with the ECHR, leaving investigation to the Commission and to complaints by those affected.
The Netherlands does not have independent information to confirm or refute the precise circumstances of the findings described in the article.
Nederland beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie om de precieze toedracht van de in het artikel geschetste bevindingen te bevestigen of te ontkrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van Ojik en Ploumen over de Nederlandse kernwapentaak en de Duitse kernwapendiscussie

MPs Karabulut, Van Ojik and Ploumen asked the government about Dutch nuclear weapons tasks, past nuclear exercises and consultations, US nuclear weapons in Europe, and German debate on nuclear deterrence. The ministers largely declined to give details on nuclear decision-making, exercises and US weapons arrangements, citing binding alliance agreements and security, while pointing to NATO unanimity and committing to arms-control and de-escalation work.
Regarding agreements and procedures for nuclear decision-making and execution of the nuclear weapons task, no statements can be made on the basis of alliance and legally binding agreements.

Over afspraken en procedures voor nucleaire besluitvorming en uitvoering van de kernwapentaak kunnen, op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken, geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over de dood van George Floyd als gevolg van racistisch politiegeweld

MPs Ploumen, Karabulut and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister about George Floyd's death, press arrests and force against protesters in the US, and whether he raised concerns with his US counterpart. The minister condemned the killing, said the Netherlands expressed concern in a videoconference with Secretary Pompeo, and largely deferred to US institutions to investigate and prosecute.
The cabinet trusts that the American democratic rule of law will investigate the death of George Floyd and that justice will be done.
Het kabinet vertrouwt erop dat de Amerikaanse democratische rechtstaat de dood van George Floyd zal onderzoeken en dat recht zal worden gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Van den Hul, Westerveld, Van Ojik, Groothuizen en Van Meenen over onderwijs in asielzoekerscentra

Six MPs asked about schooling in asylum reception centres (azc's) during COVID-19, including poor wifi and lack of laptops for online lessons. The State Secretary answered that wifi capacity was expanded at all COA locations, EUR 6.3 million was allocated for devices, and schools must offer distance learning.
It is undesirable that online education is not possible due to limitations in network connections or the availability of tablets, laptops or computers.
Het is onwenselijk dat online onderwijs niet mogelijk is door beperkingen in netwerkverbindingen of de beschikbaarheid van tablets, laptops of computers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Ploumen over het optreden van China

MPs Van Ojik and Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about alleged Chinese pressure on an EU COVID-19 disinformation report, Chinese attempts to influence officials, the Hong Kong national security law, and Chinese control of the Paracel and Spratly islands. The minister answered that the EU's High Representative denied any watering down, that the government promotes independent analysis and information-sharing, that it condemns the Hong Kong measures together with the EU and will keep monitoring, and that an EU-wide response to the island control is unlikely to succeed, though it will raise maritime security in the EU.
The cabinet considers it of great importance that all parties refrain from actions that undermine the rule of law and the autonomy of Hong Kong within the People's Republic of China.
Het kabinet acht het van groot belang dat alle partijen zich onthouden van acties die de rechtsstaat en de autonomie van Hongkong binnen de Volksrepubliek China ondermijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het uitblijven van een wet inzake de vaststelling van staatloosheid

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why the promised bill on establishing statelessness has not been submitted, and about a stateless doctor who cannot work, the discretionary power for such cases, and volunteering by undocumented people. The State Secretary said the bill is delayed and will be communicated soon, declined to discuss individual cases, stated the discretionary power was abolished in May 2019 and now applies only in exceptional hardship cases, and confirmed undocumented persons may not volunteer.
I informed your House on 19 July 2019 that work has been underway for some time on a bill concerning statelessness.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 19 juli 2019 geïnformeerd dat al enige tijd wordt gewerkt aan de totstandkoming van een wetsvoorstel over staatloosheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van den Berge over het voornemen de aangenomen motie over Afghaanse misbruikslachtoffers niet uit te voeren

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why the State Secretary will not implement an adopted motion granting protection to Afghan bacha bazi abuse victims, and why the response took nearly four months. The State Secretary replies that literal implementation conflicts with the EU Qualification Directive, that existing asylum assessment already protects such victims where needed, and that she is nonetheless willing to designate them as a risk group in the Vreemdelingencirculaire.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van der Lee over een mogelijke uitzondering voor Nord Stream 2 op de Gasrichtlijn

MPs Van Ojik and Van der Lee asked the ministers whether Nord Stream 2 could obtain an exemption from the EU Gas Directive, what input the Netherlands gave the German regulator, and how energy dependence and security are being addressed. The minister answered that the Netherlands considers it the German regulator's decision, that Nord Stream 2 may appeal and has pursued other legal routes, and that the government sees no immediate need for extra measures on energy dependence.

In my response to the Bundesnetzagentur, I indicated on behalf of the Minister of Foreign Affairs as well that it is not up to the Netherlands to assess whether EU regulations provide a sufficient basis for granting the derogation Nord Stream 2 requested.

In mijn reactie aan Bundesnetzagentur heb ik mede namens de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken aangegeven dat het niet aan Nederland is om te beoordelen of de EU-regelgeving voldoende basis biedt voor het verlenen van de door Nord Stream 2 gevraagde afwijking.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Ojik, Kuiken, Groothuizen, Voordewind en Van Toorenburg over het voorstel om migranten op de Griekse eilanden vanwege corona over te brengen naar stilliggende cruisesc

MPs from six parties asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the Netherlands would press the EU to evacuate migrants from overcrowded Greek island camps, such as Moria, to idle cruise ships to prevent a COVID-19 outbreak, and why Dutch relocation promises were not being kept. The government answered that the Greek authorities are primarily responsible, that transfers to the mainland are already ongoing, that the Netherlands is backing a Greek-Dutch programme for unaccompanied minors, and that cruise-ship accommodation was judged unnecessary and costly by Greece.
In principle it is for the Greek authorities to take adequate measures to address the COVID-19 situation.
Het is in beginsel aan de Griekse autoriteiten om adequate maatregelen te treffen om de COVID-19 situatie het hoofd te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht 'Protesten in HongKong laaien weer op na ‘coronastop’: zeker 230 arrestaties'

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about police violence against protesters and journalists in Hong Kong, Chinese interference in Hong Kong's autonomy, and whether the government would act at EU and bilateral level, including support for universal suffrage and an independent inquiry into police conduct. The minister answered that the government is concerned, shares the EU's statement on national security legislation, has raised concerns with Beijing and Hong Kong authorities, and supports universal suffrage and an independent inquiry in EU settings.

The government has repeatedly conveyed its concerns over the past year to both the central government in Beijing and the local government in Hong Kong, and will continue to do so as long as there is reason to.

Het kabinet heeft het afgelopen jaar herhaaldelijk zorgen overgebracht aan zowel de centrale overheid in Peking als de lokale overheid in Hongkong, en zal dat blijven doen zolang daar aanleiding toe is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht 'China: Free Covid-19 Activists, ‘Citizen Journalists’

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Chinese COVID-19 citizen journalists had disappeared, and about censorship's effect on China's official information.
