The minister affirmed the importance of independent journalism, said he would raise the issue in the EU-China human rights dialogue, and noted the EU had already called for the release of detained citizen journalists.
No, but the cabinet is willing to raise this issue in the human rights dialogues with China of the Netherlands and the EU.
Nee, maar het kabinet is bereid aandacht te vragen voor deze kwestie in het kader van de mensenrechtendialogen met China van Nederland en de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over het terug laten keren van Nederlanders uit Marokko

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Ojik asked how many Dutch nationals remain stranded in Morocco, how many have returned, at what level the government is negotiating with Morocco, why Morocco is not allowing them to return, and whether the King should contact the Moroccan King. The minister answered that over 1000 remain registered, about 1300 have returned via four repatriation flights, and that contacts with Moroccan authorities continue at a level chosen for effectiveness, without addressing the reasons Morocco gives or the royal contact proposal.
The Dutch aim is to organise all necessary repatriation flights in the short term.
Inzet van Nederland is om op korte termijn alle benodigde repatriëringsvluchten te organiseren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Karabulut en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlanders in Marokko in het licht van de pandemie

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how many Dutch citizens remain stranded in Morocco, why Morocco is refusing repatriation, what pressure the government applies, and what the EU and other member states are doing. The minister answered that over 1000 are registered, four special repatriation flights and some ambulance flights have taken place, Morocco cooperates on urgent cases, and the government continues to press for repatriation within EU coordination.
The aim of the Netherlands is to organise all necessary repatriation flights in the short term.
Inzet van Nederland is om op korte termijn alle benodigde repatriëringsvluchten te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘China wil de ‘klus’ in Hongkong afmaken’

MPs Ploumen, Karabulut and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the April 2020 arrests of fifteen pro-democracy figures in Hong Kong, whether it will coordinate with EU partners and contact Beijing, and how it reads the Liaison Office's claim that the Basic Law's Article 22 does not bind it. Minister Blok answered that the government and the EU will closely monitor the cases, will seek clarification if needed, and restated that Hong Kong's autonomy under One Country, Two Systems must be respected, while leaving the Liaison Office interpretation to Hong Kong's own legal debate.
The cabinet, together with the EU, will closely follow the further course of their cases.
Het kabinet zal, mede in EU-verband, het verdere verloop van hun zaken nauwgezet volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Krol en Van Raan over de zaak van dhr. Singh

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers about the case of Mr Singh (J.S.), a Dutch prisoner in the United States, including whether a transfer request was received, whether Nederland can start a transfer procedure, whether a clemency request was made without his knowledge, and what efforts are made on humanitarian grounds. The government answered that no formal transfer request has been received, that the US was told he does not meet the binding criteria, that it expressed humanitarian support diplomatically, and that the initiative lies primarily with Mr J.S.
As far as the question concerns the specific circumstances of detainee J.S., I must inform you that no statements can be made about this for privacy reasons.
Voor zover de vraag ziet op de specifieke omstandigheden van gedetineerde J.S. moet ik u mededelen dat er in het kader van de privacy hierover geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Van Ojik , Van der Lee, Özütok, Van den Berge, Buitenweg en Westerveld over de coronacrisis

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about COVID-19 measures, including drug shortages, ventilator procurement, religious gatherings, Hungary's emergency law and EU funds, tourism in the Wadden area, sex workers' access to support, and charity funding. The government answered most questions substantively, declining to ban religious gatherings in non-public places for lack of legal basis and deferring some matters to EU or regional bodies.
The cabinet emphasises that there is currently no reason to ban religious gatherings of fewer than thirty people.
Het kabinet stelt voorop dat er thans geen aanleiding is voor een verbod op religieuze bijeenkomsten van minder dan dertig personen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, De Roon, Van Ojik, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Raan, Krol, Van der Staaij, Kuzu, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlander

MPs asked how many Dutch nationals remain stranded abroad, why repatriation costs are charged, and whether a 300-euro rate should extend to more countries and hardship cases. The minister replied that about 8,000 registered Dutch nationals still wished assistance, that the registration closed on 8 April, that costs are charged after the fact, that Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories will be considered favourably, and that a coulance regime is not appropriate given personal responsibility and budget impact.
I am willing to look favourably at the request to add Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories to the list for which the 300-euro rate applies.
Ik ben bereid welwillend te kijken naar het verzoek om Jordanië, Israël, Libanon en de Palestijnse Gebieden toe te voegen aan de lijst waarvoor het tarief van 300 euro geldt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Wijngaarden, Ploumen, Van Ojik, van der Graaf, Van der Staaij, van Nispen over het onderzoek van Levada Centrum onder de Russische bevolking naar de publieke opinie over Ned

MPs asked the government about a Levada Centre survey of Russian public opinion on the Netherlands and MH17, including willingness to pay compensation, access to facts, and whether Russians could follow the trial in Russian. The government said it was aware of the survey, that trial information is available online in English and via the Dutch embassy, and that the judiciary chose to livestream the trial in English; a Russian-language livestream of the first session was made by Current Time and the government is looking into Russian summaries.

Within the limits of the law, the judiciary, partly because of the broad and diverse international involvement, decided to set up a livestream so the MH17 trial can be followed worldwide and in English as well as Dutch.

Binnen de mogelijkheden van de wet heeft de Rechtspraak, mede vanwege de brede en diverse internationale betrokkenheid, besloten om een livestream in te richten waardoor het MH17-proces wereldwijd en naast het Nederlands, ook in het Engels te volgen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut  en Van Ojik over het staatsbezoek aan Indonesië

MPs Karabulut and Van Ojik asked for the programme of the state visit to Indonesia, whether apologies for the colonial past were on it, and why broad apologies had not been given. The minister answered that the programme was adjusted after a boat accident, listed past apologies and spijtbetuigingen by Dutch officials, and stated the King expressed regret and apologies on 10 March 2020.

On 10 March 2020, during the state visit to Indonesia, the King, following earlier statements by Dutch ministers and ambassadors, expressed regret and apologies for acts of violence by Dutch forces in the years after the proclamation.

Op 10 maart 2020 heeft de Koning tijdens het staatsbezoek aan Indonesië, in navolging van eerdere uitspraken door Nederlandse bewindspersonen en ambassadeurs, spijt en excuses uitgesproken over geweldsontsporingen van Nederlandse zijde in de jaren na de proclamatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht dat voormalige IS-strijders mogelijk zullen worden overgebracht naar een (te bouwen) instelling in de Ninevé vlakte

MPs Ploumen, Karabulut and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware of and had responded to reports that former IS fighters might be transferred to a planned facility in the Nineveh Plain, and what role the Netherlands would take. The minister answered that the transfer concerns Iraqi nationals, is primarily Iraq's responsibility, that the Netherlands remains in dialogue with Iraq and partners, and that no official transfer decision appears to have been taken.
The transfer to Iraq referred to in the article concerns only people with Iraqi nationality.
De in het artikel aangehaalde overplaatsing naar Irak betreft alleen mensen met de Iraakse nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Koopmans, Karabulut, Voordwind en Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘In Saudi Arabia, contacting the EU is a crime,

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government reacts to reports that contacting an EU or Dutch embassy is treated as a crime in Saudi Arabia, and whether EU diplomats may attend trials of women's rights activists. The minister answered that the government regards such contacts as legitimate, has raised the matter repeatedly with Saudi authorities, and that EU diplomats have so far been refused access to hearings despite continued efforts.
It is correct that EU diplomats, including Dutch diplomats, have not been granted access to court hearings since autumn 2018.
Het klopt dat EU-diplomaten, waaronder Nederlandse diplomaten, sinds het najaar van 2018 geen toegang hebben gekregen tot hoorzittingen van rechtszaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Diks, Bouali en Sjoerdsma over het VN-rapport waarin wordt geconstateerd dat diverse landen het VN-wapenembargo tegen Libië schenden

MPs from GroenLinks and D66 asked the government about a UN Panel of Experts report finding that several states violated the Libya arms embargo, including the possible Dutch role of Van der Kamp Shipsales in a warship sale. The minister said the Netherlands raised enforcement at EU level, is investigating the company without yet deciding on measures, and sees no need for additional rules, while noting the limits of post-export controls.
Further investigation is currently ongoing, so the cabinet cannot now say whether there is cause to take measures against the company.
Nader onderzoek loopt op dit moment, daarom kan het kabinet nu geen uitspraak doen over de vraag of er aanleiding bestaat om maatregelen tegen het bedrijf te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het zogeheten 'Istanboel 10'-proces

MPs Ploumen, Karabulut and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister about the 'Istanbul 10' trial of eleven human rights defenders arrested in 2017, including concerns about fair trial and the use of Turkish anti-terror law. The minister answered that the Netherlands cannot judge individual prosecutions, monitors the hearings with EU partners, has raised the rule of law and fair trial with Turkey including in EU and UN settings, and continues to support civil society.
The Netherlands may and cannot, however, interfere in the legal proceedings in another state.
Nederland mag en kan zich echter niet mengen in de rechtsgang in een andere staat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ploumen, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het intrekken van perskaarten in Turkije

MPs from SP, PvdA, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkey revoked press cards of journalists from the paper Evrensel, whether this fits a pattern of state repression, and whether the Netherlands will press Turkey on press freedom. The minister answered that the Evrensel revocations were reversed, that Turkey has revoked nearly 3,804 press cards since 2015, and that the Netherlands raises press freedom concerns with Turkey at all levels, including with the Turkish foreign minister and within the EU and Council of Europe.
The Netherlands therefore continuously raises concerns about the lack of press freedom in Turkey with Turkey at all levels.
Nederland brengt daarom in contacten met Turkije voortdurend en op alle niveaus de zorgen over het gebrek aan persvrijheid in Turkije op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de onderdrukking van Oeigoeren door de Chinese overheid

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister about Chinese state repression of Uyghurs, including intimidation of the Uyghur diaspora in the Netherlands, complaints, intelligence monitoring, detention of relatives in Xinjiang, the China Cables, US-style legislation and sanctions. The minister confirmed rising reports of pressure from China, said the government raises the issue bilaterally and in the EU and UN, declined to confirm individual complaints or intelligence methods, and said Dutch visa sanctions and Chinese-company sanctions are not currently feasible at EU level, while an EU thematic human-rights sanctions regime is being prepared.
The cabinet cannot make statements about the working methods of the intelligence services.
Het kabinet kan geen uitspraken doen over de werkwijze van de inlichtingendiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over de Zembla-uitzending ‘Doelwit Volkel’

Three MPs asked whether the Netherlands has a veto over US nuclear weapons at Volkel, whether the Dutch pilots must follow a US order, and whether the government will confirm the presence of nuclear weapons. The ministers answered that NATO decisions require unanimity and Dutch consent, but that numbers, locations and procedures cannot be disclosed for security and binding alliance reasons, and that efforts to increase transparency have gained no support.

On the numbers and locations of US nuclear weapons present in Europe, as well as the precise procedures for nuclear decision-making and execution of the nuclear task, no information can be provided, on the basis of alliance and legally binding agreements.

Over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens, alsmede de precieze procedures voor nucleaire besluitvorming en uitvoering van de kernwapentaak kunnen, op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken, geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht dat de Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid niet welkom is in Marokko om te praten over het terugsturen van uitgeprocedeerde Marokkanen

An MP asked whether the State Secretary for Justice and Security was refused a meeting in Morocco on returning rejected Moroccan asylum seekers, and what reasons Morocco gave. The government denied any refusal, said talks continue at several levels, and that a visit is being planned.
The State Secretary for Justice and Security already stated during the second round of the Justice and Security budget debate on 21 November that she was not refused by Morocco.
De Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid heeft tijdens de tweede termijn van de begrotingsbehandeling Justitie en Veiligheid op 21 november reeds gemeld dat zij niet door Marokko is geweigerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Diks en Van Ojik over de investeringen van Nederlandse pensioenfondsen in controversiële wapenhandel

MPs Smeulders, Diks and Van Ojik asked the government about a PAX report showing Dutch pension funds invest over 1 billion euros in arms companies supplying Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Egypt, and what the government can do about it. The minister answered that pension investment policy is for funds and supervisors (AFM, DNB), that arms export rules were tightened for Saudi Arabia and the UAE, and that compliance with the IMVB pension covenant is voluntary but monitored.
It is not my task to supervise the investment policy of pension funds. That is for the supervisors, the Authority for the Financial Markets (AFM) and De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).
Het is niet mijn taak om toezicht te houden op het beleggingsbeleid van pensioenfondsen. Dat is aan de toezichthouders Autoriteit Financiële Markt (AFM) en De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over een recent vermoorde boswachter in Roemenië

Green-left MP Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister about the murder of a forest ranger in Romania, the second in two months, and about illegal logging, EU law compliance and the ranger's protection. The minister condemned the killings, said the Romanian prosecutor is investigating, noted Romanian forest reforms, and said the EU forest strategy and the Bucharest embassy's NGO cooperation would address the issue.
The Romanian public prosecutor is currently investigating the case.
Het Roemeense OM onderzoekt momenteel de zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van Ojik over Nederlanders die meevechten in de burgeroorlog in Oekraïne

MPs Ploumen and Van Ojik asked the minister about reports that eight Dutch nationals were fighting in the Ukraine conflict on both sides, and about monitoring, return, and measures. The minister answered that the figures could not be confirmed, that the source report gave no substantiation, and that no further details were known, while referring to the integrated approach to extremism and terrorism for radicalised individuals.
Figures on Dutch nationals who would take or would have taken part in the fighting in Ukraine, however, cannot be confirmed.
Cijfers over Nederlanders die deel zouden nemen of deel zouden hebben genomen aan de strijd in Oekraïne, kunnen echter niet worden bevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Karabulut, Van Oijk en Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Israëlisch hooggerechtshof keurt uitzetting HRW-directeur goed'

MPs from PvdA, SP, GroenLinks and D66 asked how the government responds to the Israeli Supreme Court's approval of the expulsion of Human Rights Watch director Omar Shakir, and whether it fears this chills civil society and human rights defenders. The minister says the government raised concerns with the Israeli ambassador and at senior official level, its embassy monitored the hearings, and the EU urged Israel to reverse the decision.

Because of the government's and the EU's concern about increasing pressure on human rights organisations and defenders in Israel, and specifically this case, the Minister of Foreign Affairs emphatically raised concerns about this threatened expulsion with the Israeli ambassador on 7 November.

Vanwege de bezorgdheid van het kabinet en de EU over de toenemende druk op mensenrechtenorganisaties en -verdedigers in Israël, en specifiek deze zaak, heeft de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken tijdens een kennismakingsgesprek met de Israëlische ambassadeur op 7 november jl. de zorgen over deze dreigende uitzetting nadrukkelijk opgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Diks over het bericht dat de minister van Defensie niet aanwezig was bij de bijeenkomst van NAVO-ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken op 20 november 2019

MPs Van Ojik and Diks asked why the Defence Minister did not attend the NATO foreign ministers' meeting on 20 November 2019, as reported by Trouw. The government answered that the Defence Minister stayed in The Hague to prepare for a possible parliamentary debate on transparency about civilian casualties, and that Netherlands' permanent NATO representative attended instead.

Yes, the Minister of Defence took into account a possible wish of your House to hold a debate in the short term on transparency about civilian casualties, and therefore decided not to travel to Brussels.

Ja, de Minister van Defensie hield rekening met een mogelijke wens van uw Kamer om op korte termijn een debat te voeren over de transparantie over burgerslachtoffers en heeft daarom besloten om niet naar Brussel af te reizen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over de situatie in Chili

Three MPs asked the Dutch Foreign Minister about the protests in Chile, including excessive police force, deaths and mass arrests, and whether the government had condemned the violence and raised concerns with the Chilean counterpart. The minister condemned violence on all sides, said the government shares UN concerns and awaits the OHCHR investigation and the national human rights institute's review before considering further steps.
The cabinet is awaiting the outcome of the OHCHR investigation before considering possible steps.
Het kabinet wacht de uitkomst van het OHCHR-onderzoek af, alvorens mogelijke stappen te overwegen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Nederlandse hulp aan gevangenen in buitenland berust op willekeur’

Six MPs from CDA, SP, GroenLinks, D66, SGP and ChristenUnie asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about Dutch assistance to Dutch prisoners abroad (the Singh case), including the five-year binding criterion, a WOTS transfer request and the handling of the case. The government answered that it cannot comment on individual cases, that existing criteria apply, that no official US transfer request was ever made, and that it promises no concrete new step.
I cannot make statements about ongoing cases and individual cases.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over lopende zaken en individuele gevallen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kuiken, Jasper van Dijk, Van Toorenburg, Groothuizen en Bisschop over het bericht dat een medewerker bij de IND door zijn leidinggevende onder druk werd gezet om zijn eigen dossi

MPs asked whether internal IND emails showing a supervisor discussing 'constructions' around asylum decisions contradict the De Leeuw commission's finding of no directed instructions to break rules, and whether further investigation, contact with ministry officials, and a meeting with the whistleblower are warranted. The State Secretary replied that the emails were included in the commission's research, found no reason for further investigation or doubt about the report's reliability or independence, declined to discuss individual personnel matters citing privacy, and saw no reason to meet the whistleblower.
I therefore see no reason for additional investigation.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding voor een aanvullend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Helvert en Van Ojik over bloedvergieten op Papoea

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about deadly violence in Wamena, Papua, on 23 September 2019, the Indonesian demonstration ban, the end of the Dutch contribution to the Community Policing Programme, and Dutch diplomatic efforts. The minister answered that the causes and casualty breakdown remain unclear, described the programme's results, and said Dutch diplomacy on Papua continues at ministerial and senior official level.
The cabinet closely follows developments in Papua and gives priority to raising these developments as a standing item with the Indonesian authorities.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen in Papua nauwgezet, en geeft er prioriteit aan deze ontwikkelingen als vast onderdeel bij de Indonesische autoriteiten aan te kaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Van Helvert, Voordewind en Ploumen over de Nieuwsuur-uitzending 'Nederlandse regering heeft morele verplichting West-Papoea te helpen'

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister about a Nieuwsuur broadcast on a Dutch moral obligation toward West Papua, reports of deaths in Papua unrest, and whether the Netherlands would press Indonesia on human rights. The minister answered that at least 32 died in Wamena with casualties on several sides, that the Netherlands raises Papua in dialogue with Indonesia while fully respecting its territorial integrity, and that it sees no reason to revise its earlier position on the Drooglever report.
I see no reason to revise the position set out in the letters to parliament of 22 November 2005 and 29 April 2016.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de lijn in de Kamerbrieven van 22 november 2005, stuk 30 300V, en van 29 april 2016, stuk 2420, te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Ojik, Voordewind en Kuiken over het artikel ‘De uit zee opgepikte migranten moeten wel ergens van boord kunnen, waarschuwen Nederlandse reders’

MPs asked the government about shipowners' difficulties finding safe ports for rescued migrants in the Mediterranean, the suspension of EU naval mission Sophia, disembarkation platforms in North Africa, and Libya returns. The government agreed safe ports are needed, said a causal link to Sophia cannot be established, noted some North African ports have accepted rescued migrants, and pointed to ongoing EU negotiations and an informal JHA Council without a concrete mechanism.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Sneller, Ploumen, Voordewind, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘Jaar na dood Khashoggi: zaken doen met de kroonprins kan weer’

Six MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Saudi Arabia's incomplete accountability for the killing of Jamal Khashoggi, the crown prince's responsibility, pressure for openness, trade missions, sanctions and attending the G20. The minister answered that the Saudi account remains incomplete, that the Netherlands keeps pressing bilaterally and in UN and EU fora, that no government-led trade missions are planned, and that sanctions lack international consensus while an EU human rights sanctions regime is being pursued.
The cabinet will continue to press for this in bilateral and multilateral contexts.
Het kabinet zal hier in bilateraal en multilateraal verband op blijven aandringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van Ojik over garantstelling sprekers De Balie

GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether the IND's demand for a financial guarantee for Turkish and Sri Lankan guest speakers at De Balie hinders free public debate, and whether such demands could be dropped for debate-centre invitees. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, said EU Schengen visa rules allow a guarantee as one way to show sufficient means, and argued the motion on event security does not override those rules.
I cannot, however, go into the individual case, also for reasons of protecting personal data.
Ik kan evenwel niet op de individuele casus ingaan, ook om redenen van bescherming van persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de hoogte van leges voor een Kinderpardon-aanvraag

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the €164 fee for a Kinderpardon (Afsluitingsregeling) application is proportionate and whether affordability for less wealthy applicants should matter or be investigated. The State Secretary answered that the fee was set at a reduced level, tied to the 2013 regulation and indexed, that the IND offered case-by-case flexibility for those unable to pay, and that affordability was a factor, but no further investigation into the fee's effect on applicants would be undertaken.
I do not intend to conduct further research into the affordability of the fees.
Ik ben niet voornemens verder onderzoek in te stellen naar de betaalbaarheid van de leges.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik, Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, en Van Raan over een aanval op de democratie in Turkije

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's removal of elected HDP and CHP mayors and appointment of state supervisors, and whether the Netherlands and EU would condemn it and what consequences would follow. The minister answered that the government shares EU and Council of Europe concerns, supports the EU's public statements, raises the issue bilaterally, and backed halting accession talks, though that proposal lacked support and talks have stalled.
The government does not have precise figures.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over precieze aantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kuiken, Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over de humanitaire noodsituatie waarin vluchtelingen in Libië verkeren

MPs asked the government about the humanitarian crisis facing migrants in Libyan detention centres near the conflict zone, including reports of an airstrike on the Tajoura centre, forced labour, and whether the Netherlands would evacuate migrants or offer asylum. The minister answered that the centres are unsafe, that Libya's GNA government agreed to close three centres including Tajoura, that Nederland supports IOM/UNHCR evacuations and ETM resettlement from Niger, but that the Netherlands has no humanitarian admission route like Italy's and direct evacuation to the Netherlands is not possible.
The Netherlands has no admission on humanitarian grounds, unlike Italy. Direct evacuation from Libya to the Netherlands is therefore not among the possibilities.
Nederland kent geen toegang op humanitaire gronden, zoals Italië. Directe evacuatie vanuit Libië naar Nederland behoort dan ook niet tot de mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Diks en Van Ojik over Venezolaans conflictgoud dat via Curaçao en Aruba wordt verhandeld

Three GroenLinks MPs asked the government about Venezuelan conflict gold being traded via Curaçao and Aruba, and how this fits with Dutch recognition of Guaidó and the gold covenant. The State Secretary answered that Curaçao and Aruba have banned Venezuelan gold trade, that no Venezuelan gold import was declared in Caribbean Netherlands in five years, and that the EU conflict minerals regulation applies from 2021, with the gold covenant and due diligence as the main tools.
Regarding the nature and scale of gold trade on Sint Maarten, despite inquiries with the Sint Maarten government, I currently have no figures available.
Van de aard en omvang van de handel in goud op Sint Maarten zijn mij, ondanks navraag bij de regering van Sint Maarten, op dit moment geen cijfers bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Diks over de export van cybersurveillance technologie

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked whether Dutch firms should supply emotion-recognition and surveillance technology used by China's Ministry of Public Security, and what controls apply to cybersurveillance exports. The minister says such use is unacceptable, firms must exercise due diligence, export licences are refused where human-rights concerns exist, and the Netherlands keeps pushing for EU-level controls while declining to pre-empt the stalled dual-use regulation revision.
The Netherlands will continue to work to keep the subject on the agenda.
Nederland zal zich ervoor blijven inzetten dat het onderwerp op de agenda blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oijk en Snels over de ‘Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank’

Two MPs asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers how Netherlands has used its shareholding in the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank to push human rights and environmental standards, complaints mechanisms, transparency and oversight. The minister answered that the Netherlands has pushed for these standards and transparency within the bank's board, that the complaints and disclosure rules have gaps the government will raise in the upcoming framework review, and promised to report annually to parliament.

I propose to share a report with the House of Representatives annually after the meeting of the bank's highest governing body, the Board of Governors, to inform the House of the most important developments at the AIIB.
Ik stel voor om jaarlijks na de bijeenkomst van het hoogste bestuursorgaan, de Board of Governors , van de AIIB een verslag met de Tweede Kamer te delen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ojik over het bericht "Deportaties in Turkije: 'Ze hebben hem naar Syrië gestuurd'"

MP Van Ojik asked the government about reports that Turkey deports Syrian refugees to unsafe areas, whether the EU-Turkey deal is still in force and whether EU funds should be conditioned on stopping such deportations. The State Secretary replied that the government has no indication of a structural deportation policy, that non-refoulement binds Turkey, that the deal still operates, that EUR 5.6 billion has been committed with EUR 3.45 billion contracted, and that Nederland raises the issue bilaterally without committing to conditioning funds.

As reported in the answer to the questions from MP Groothuizen (D66) on 'Deportations in Turkey: They sent him to Syria', there is currently no reason to assume a structural policy of deporting Syrian refugees from Turkey.

Zoals gemeld in de beantwoording van de vragen van het lid Groothuizen (D66) over «Deportaties in Turkije: «Ze hebben hem naar Syrië gestuurd»», is er op dit moment geen aanleiding om aan te nemen dat er sprake is van een structureel beleid om Syrische vluchtelingen uit Turkije uit te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het landgebonden asielbeleid

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about asylum policy for Sudan, Iran, Afghanistan and Russia, including LHBTI risks, child-related conditions and alternatives to protection. The State Secretary answered that a new Sudan report is expected in October 2019, reclassified gay men from Iran as a risk group, rejected the demand that gay people hide their orientation, and explained that children are not a designated risk group but are assessed individually.
With my letter of 1 July 2019 I sent you my response to the latest general country report on Afghanistan.
Met mijn brief van 1 juli 2019 heb ik u mijn reactie toegestuurd op het laatste algemene ambtsbericht over Afghanistan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht dat kinderen van Oeigoerse afkomst door de Chinese overheid van hun ouders worden gescheiden en naar internaten worden gestuurd

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister whether reports that Chinese authorities separate Uyghur children from their families and place them in boarding schools are credible, whether this violates the Convention on the Rights of the Child, and whether sanctions or other measures will follow. The minister said the government has no reason to doubt the reports but cannot verify them independently, called forced separation unacceptable, promised to raise it in a bilateral human rights dialogue, and declined sanctions for now while stressing companies' due diligence responsibilities.
Due to the strict security and control in Xinjiang, independent verification of the reports is not feasible in practice.
Vanwege de strikte beveiliging en controle in Xinjiang is onafhankelijke toetsing van de berichtgeving in de praktijk niet haalbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘Madagascar: Take decisive steps to end torture and killings by security forces’

MPs Ploumen and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister about Amnesty International's call on Madagascar to end impunity for torture and killings by security forces and to address prison conditions. The minister answered that Netherlands supports the call, will raise it via EU political dialogue and the UN Universal Periodic Review, but has no embassy in Madagascar and cannot verify prison conditions or the number of detained minors.
The Netherlands has no embassy or career consulate in Madagascar and therefore cannot draw on its own observations.
Nederland heeft geen ambassade of beroepsconsulaat in Madagaskar en kan derhalve niet uit eigen waarnemingen putten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ploumen, Karabulut, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik en Van der  Staaij over het Nederlandse kind Duncan en de Spaanse kinderbescherming

MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the case of a Dutch child with Down syndrome held under Spanish child protection and whether he should be reunited with his mother quickly. The minister said the matter falls to the competent Spanish authority, that the ministry is following the case and has mediated contact, and withheld case details citing data protection.
For reasons of personal data protection, I cannot give your House any details about the individual case.
Omwille van persoonsgegevensbescherming kan ik uw Kamer geen details geven over de individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het uitblijven van een wetsvoorstel rond het vaststellen van staatloosheid

An MP asked why the planned bill on establishing statelessness, promised for spring 2018 and scheduled for Q1 2019, had still not been submitted, and asked about the estimated number of stateless persons and support for municipalities. The State Secretary said the bill is still in preparation and will be reported on after the summer, disputed the 8,000 estimate as not based on established data, and offered to discuss municipal problems with VNG.
Contrary to what was hoped, the submission date previously communicated to your House was not met.
Anders dan gehoopt is het eerder aan uw Kamer gecommuniceerde moment van indiening niet gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over de oprichting van een tribunaal om IS-strijders te vervolgen

MPs asked whether the government had discussed an international tribunal for IS fighters with Sweden, whether it will pursue genocide prosecutions and join a Swedish-invited conference, and whether a prosecutor is assigned. The government confirmed talks with Sweden and UN partners, said it is seeking expert advice on an international tribunal due 8 July 2019, and said the Public Prosecution Service will report on a dedicated prosecutor before the recess.
The Public Prosecution Service is expected to inform the cabinet before the recess whether a special prosecutor specifically for prosecuting ISIS fighters for genocide would add value.

Het OM zal het kabinet naar verwachting voor het reces nog informeren of daarnaast een speciale officier van justitie specifiek voor de vervolging van ISIS-strijders voor genocide van toegevoegde waarde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het uitzetten van Yezidi’s

MP Van Ojik (GroenLinks) asked whether the state secretary intends to deport Yezidis to Kurdish refugee camps in Iraq, citing UNHCR concerns about capacity and the group's vulnerable status. The state secretary replied that asylum claims are assessed individually, that the Kurdish Autonomous Region is no longer treated as the normal residence for Yezidis arriving from other parts of Iraq, and that the vulnerable-minority policy applies to them.
I have exceptionally asked the Repatriation and Departure Service to manually review the files of Iraqi nationals in immigration detention.
Ik heb bij uitzondering de Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek gevraagd om handmatig de dossiers van Irakese staatburgers die in vreemdelingenbewaring zitten door te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘Western firms get tangled in China’s Uighur crackdown’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether forced labour in Xinjiang re-education camps and a surge in yarn production is linked to garments sold in the Netherlands, and what the government will do about supply chains and the textile covenant. The government condemns forced labour, says it cannot confirm or deny that Xinjiang yarn ends up in Dutch clothing, and promises to raise the issue within the covenant and with China, without committing to talks with individual brands.
The government therefore can neither confirm nor deny that yarn from Xinjiang, produced with forced labour, has been processed into clothing sold in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet kan daarom bevestigen noch ontkennen dat garen uit Xinjiang, geproduceerd met gedwongen arbeid, is verwerkt in kleding die in Nederland wordt verkocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Amerikaanse kerncentrales in Saoedi-Arabië, en Urenco?'

MPs Van der Lee and Van Ojik asked whether the US would sell nuclear technology to Saudi Arabia despite the Khashoggi case and Saudi nuclear weapons ambitions, and whether Urenco would supply enriched uranium to Saudi Arabia under the Almelo Treaty. The ministers answered that the US has not confirmed any export, that civil nuclear use is permitted under the NPT, that Urenco supply oversight lies with the Joint Committee whose deliberations are confidential, and that no supply to Saudi Arabia is foreseen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht dat natuurorganisaties en inheemse volken Jair Bolsonaro een grote bedreiging vinden voor het Amazoneregenwoud

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister about reports of rising Amazon deforestation under President Bolsonaro, whether Dutch support for land-rights and environmental defenders exists, and whether Dutch companies are involved. The minister acknowledged the concern, said the government raises deforestation with Brazil bilaterally and multilaterally, noted funding channels, and said no Dutch company involvement is known.
Should this be the case, dialogue on this will be sought.
Mocht dit zo zijn, dan zal daarover de dialoog gezocht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg, Diks en Van Ojik over het bericht 'AIVD en MI5 gestopt met samenwerking met Oostenrijkse diensten'

MPs Buitenweg, Diks and Van Ojik asked the government about reports that the AIVD and MI5 stopped cooperating with Austrian intelligence services, including effects on the Club van Bern, CTG, PESCO and the Burum satellite station. The minister declined to comment publicly on the specifics of intelligence cooperation, citing legal risk-weighing procedures, and otherwise answered that bilateral and EU relations with Austria remain good.
The AIVD and MIVD make no public statements about the precise nature of cooperation with intelligence or security services.
De AIVD en MIVD doen in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de precieze invulling van de samenwerking met inlichtingen- of veiligheidsdiensten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Van Ojik en Diks over het bericht dat Brunei extreme straffen invoert, onder meer de doodstraf voor homoseksuele handelingen

Three GroenLinks MPs asked the foreign and education ministers about Brunei's introduction of harsh Sharia penalties, including the death penalty for same-sex acts, and whether the Netherlands would cut arms trade, summon the ambassador, or take other action. The minister answered that the government strongly opposes the measures, has publicly and diplomatically objected via the EU, the Equal Rights Coalition and the Foreign Affairs Council, and that arms exports are screened for human-rights risk, with no export moratorium deemed necessary at present.
For this reason, the cabinet currently does not consider it necessary to announce a moratorium on the export of strategic goods to Brunei.
Om die reden acht het kabinet het op dit moment niet noodzakelijk om een moratorium af te kondigen op de export van strategische goederen naar Brunei.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Van Ojik en Karabulut over vervolging van de Palestijnse mensenrechtenverdediger Issa Amro

MPs Van den Hul, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the government about prosecutions of Palestinian human rights defender Issa Amro by Palestinian and Israeli authorities, including criticism of Amnesty and Front Line Defenders reports and whether the EU and the Netherlands support him. The minister answered that the Netherlands shares concern over shrinking civic space, urges both authorities to respect free expression and drop charges covered by that right, and that the EU and member states have attended hearings, with the next hearing set for 22 May.
The EU and the Netherlands both follow the two legal cases against Amro closely, including by attending hearings.
De EU en Nederland volgen beide rechtszaken tegen Amro nauwgezet, onder andere door het bijwonen van hoorzittingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Saoedi-Arabië executeert 37 gevangenen om terrorisme’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government responded to Saudi Arabia's execution of 37 prisoners convicted of terrorism, including the use of the 2014 counterterrorism law against activists and critics, and whether sanctions were considered. The minister condemned the executions, said Nederland opposes the death penalty and raised concerns in EU and UN settings, but stated that sanctions lack the required international political consensus and gave no concrete new measures.
Imposing sanctions requires broad international political agreement.
Voor het instellen van sancties is internationaal brede politieke overeenstemming nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Amerikaanse immigratiedienst bouwde database van journalisten'

The MPs asked whether the Dutch government cooperates with a US immigration agency's reported database of journalists and activists critical of US immigration policy, and whether Dutch and foreign journalists are in it. The minister answered that the Netherlands did not cooperate, no Dutch journalists are known to be on the list, and the government will not intervene in a US internal matter unless press freedom there is at stake.
No cooperation with the Dutch government took place in this.
Hierbij is niet samengewerkt met de Nederlandse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ojik over oplichters die in het bezit zijn van gegevens van Kinderpardonaanvragers

An MP asked whether the state secretary knows of reports that Kinderpardon applicants are called by fraudsters demanding fees, and how such people could know who applied. The state secretary confirmed the reports, said it is unknown how fraudsters obtain applicant names, described the IND's website warning and internal investigation, and said the Bureau Integriteit is looking into the reported call.
The IND's Bureau Integriteit is, however, investigating this report with further information from VWN.
Wel verricht het Bureau Integriteit van de IND met nadere informatie van VWN onderzoek naar deze melding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de visumaanvraag van Nigeriaanse weduwen om de rechtszaak tegen Shell bij te wonen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why Nigerian widows suing Shell were refused Schengen visas to attend the Dutch hearing, whether Dutch visa policy had been fully outsourced to France and Belgium, and whether the government would support future applications. The minister said the French consulate refused the files as incomplete (missing documents and a financial guarantee), that the Dutch embassy tried to find a solution, and that he would support a complete future application if the widows are summoned again.
The French consulate-general indicated that the file was incomplete.
Het Frans consulaat-generaal heeft aangegeven dat het dossier incompleet was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ploumen en Van Ojik over de mogelijke invoering van twee wetten in Guatemala

MPs Karabulut, Ploumen and Van Ojik asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs whether he shares concerns about Guatemalan bills 5377 (amnesty for wartime crimes 1990-1996) and 5257 (stricter rules for NGOs), and what their status is. The minister shares the concerns, reports that the Netherlands raised them bilaterally, in an EU High Representative statement and with donors, and says the bills are pending a third reading with uncertain timing.
Yes, I am aware of the concerns of human rights organisations and UN experts about laws no. 5377 and no. 5257. I indeed share these concerns.
Ja, ik ben bekend met de zorgen van mensenrechtenorganisaties en VN-experts over de wetten nr. 5377 en nr. 5257. Ik deel deze zorgen inderdaad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Sea-Watch 3 op last van Nederland aan ketting gelegd'

MPs Kröger and Van Ojik asked why the Dutch government requested Italy to detain the Sea-Watch 3 rescue ship, whether this conflicted with earlier assurances to NGOs, and about rescue capacity in the Mediterranean. The minister answered that the ILT inspection followed Italian port-state findings, that safety comes first, that the inspection was not caused by foreign pressure, and that the ship is not chained, while largely refusing to explain policy-change timing and deferring to the letter for detailed conclusions.
The Netherlands asked Italy not to grant the ship permission to sail while the investigation was ongoing.
Nederland heeft Italië verzocht het schip geen toestemming te verlenen om uit te varen zolang het onderzoek liep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht 'It Wasn’t Just Khashoggi: A Saudi Prince’s Brutal Drive to Crush Dissent'

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister how he views reports of a Saudi intervention team allegedly surveilling, detaining and torturing dissidents, whether he has information on secret detention sites, and what concerns he has about pre-trial detention. The minister said the reports cannot be confirmed, that Netherlands shares concern about the human rights situation and has raised it bilaterally and in the UN Human Rights Council, and that the Netherlands has no independent information on secret detention sites.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs cannot confirm the reporting about the existence of the said intervention team.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken kan de berichtgeving over het bestaan van het genoemde interventieteam niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Diks over niet gemelde gebreken bij de F-35

MPs Van Ojik and Diks asked the State Secretary for Defence about unreported defects in the F-35A, including gun accuracy, the ALIS maintenance system, reliability metrics, maintenance cost estimates and why critical US oversight findings were not in the progress reports. The government answered that the annual report reflects agreed committee arrangements, that identified issues are being addressed by the programme office without operational impact, and that it will report cost updates and test results in the annual report later.
Once there is clarity about any differences, this will be reported in the annual report on the F-35 acquisition project.
Zodra er duidelijkheid is over eventuele verschillen zal dit worden gerapporteerd in de jaarrapportage over het project Verwerving F-35.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Ploumen, Karabulut, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over de krimpende bewegingsruimte, democratische vrijheden en veiligheid van mensenrechtenorganisaties en -verdedigers in Israël

MPs from several parties asked the ministers about threats to human rights organisations and defenders in Israel, including an Israeli UN envoy's insult to B'Tselem, a law affecting Breaking the Silence, and the deportation order against Human Rights Watch's Omar Shakir. The government answered that it shares concern about intimidation and shrinking civic space, has protested at the UN and bilaterally, and will keep raising the issues with Israeli and Palestinian authorities together with the EU.

The government, together with the EU, is concerned about the increasing pressure on human rights organisations and defenders in Israel, partly caused by bills that restrict the space of civil society organisations.

Het kabinet is, samen met de EU, bezorgd over de toenemende druk op mensenrechtenorganisaties en -verdedigers in Israël, mede veroorzaakt door wetsvoorstellen die de ruimte van maatschappelijke organisaties beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht dat een door Nederland uitgezette asielzoeker uit Bahrein zonder eerlijk proces is veroordeeld tot levenslang

An MP asked whether the Dutch government would acknowledge that the deportation of a Bahraini asylum seeker, later sentenced to life imprisonment without a fair trial, breached non-refoulement, and what it would do about his case. The state secretary refused to discuss individual case details citing privacy, rejected the non-refoulement claim as not established on the information available at the time, and said it would raise concerns with Bahraini authorities and follow the appeal.
Out of respect for personal privacy, I am not free to make individual facts and circumstances from an asylum file public.
Met het oog op de eerbiediging van de persoonlijke levenssfeer, ben ik niet vrij individuele feiten en omstandigheden uit een asieldossier in de openbaarheid te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Ojik over een hongerstaking in Turkije

MPs Karabulut and Van Ojik asked about a hunger strike in Turkey by MP Leyla Güven and others, the demands of the strikers, and the number of political prisoners and Dutch efforts for their release. The minister said the situation is critical according to contacts, that the government takes no position on the demands, that it lacks reliable figures on political prisoners, and that it raises rule-of-law and fair-trial concerns with Turkey.
The cabinet does not have reliable figures on the number of political prisoners in Turkey.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over betrouwbare cijfers wat betreft het aantal politieke gevangen in Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Koopmans, De Roon, Karabulut, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de uitzetting van Nederlandse journalist Boersma

MPs from nine parties asked the Foreign and Justice ministers whether Turkey expelled Dutch journalist Ans Boersma on the basis of information Dutch authorities shared, and what Dutch government steps followed. The ministers confirm the expulsion, say an information request was made in a Dutch criminal investigation via operational channels without foreign ministry involvement, and decline to give further details citing the ongoing investigation.
Regarding the content of that information request, no further statements can be made because the criminal investigation is still ongoing.
Over de inhoud van dat informatieverzoek kunnen, vanwege het nog lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek, geen nadere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het vertrek van VN-gezant Patrick Cammaert uit Jemen

Three MPs asked the ministers about the early departure of UN envoy Patrick Cammaert from Yemen, the stalled Hodeidah ceasefire and redeployment talks, humanitarian effects and Houthi refusal to negotiate. The ministers confirmed the short mandate was known, reported that the ceasefire largely holds despite delays, outlined humanitarian funding and ongoing contacts with the UN and EU, and gave limited detail on the Crisis Group report and Houthi motives.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het (mogelijke) gebruik van chemische middelen tijdens militaire operatie in West Papoea door het door het Indonesische leger

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about reports of possible chemical weapons use by the Indonesian military in West Papua and whether the Netherlands would seek an independent fact-finding mission. The minister answered that Indonesia denies the reports, that neither local sources nor the OPCW can confirm them, and that he sees no reason yet for an independent investigation, while Nederland continues to press for free access for NGOs and journalists.
In view of the above answer, I currently see no reason to call for an international independent investigation.
Gezien het bovenstaande antwoord zie ik vooralsnog geen aanleiding voor een oproep tot het instellen van een internationaal onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het uitzetten van gewortelde kinderen in afwachting van een Kinderpardon

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether deportations of rooted children who have lived in the Netherlands over five years while awaiting their residence procedure would be suspended, and whether their cases would be reassessed under discretionary power. The State Secretary referred to his letter of 29 January 2019 on the coalition's new agreements, including ending the DRLVK regulation and reassessing applications of those refused on the cooperation criterion, with transitional measures.
Among other things, I have taken the measure to end the Definitive Regulation for Long-Term Resident Children (DRLVK) as of 29 January 2019.
Ik heb onder andere de maatregel genomen om de Definitieve Regeling Langdurig Verblijvende Kinderen (DRLVK) per 29 januari 2019 te beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht dat drie passagiers zijn opgepakt in vliegtuig na protest tegen de uitzetting van vluchteling

An MP asked whether marechaussee officers threatened passengers with arrest and deleted footage, and whether force used to remove a protesting woman was proportionate. The government denied the threat and deletion claims, saying passengers were asked by the crew to stop filming and one deleted footage voluntarily, and described the force used as light and proportionate.
I do not recognise the picture painted in the article.
Ik herken mij in het beeld dat wordt geschetst in het artikel niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht dat een asielzoeker uit Bahrein na zijn uitzetting direct is gearresteerd

An MP asked whether an asylum seeker deported to Bahrain was arrested and tortured on arrival, whether the IND assessed non-refoulement correctly, and whether a Bahrain-specific moratorium or new assessment is warranted. The State Secretary declined to comment on the individual case citing privacy, said Bahrain has no country-specific asylum policy, acknowledged worsened human rights, and refused a moratorium or new assessment while promising no concrete action.
As your House is aware, for reasons of privacy of the person concerned I cannot make statements about individual cases and possible deportations.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend kan ik in verband met de privacy van de betrokken persoon geen uitspraken doen over individuele zaken en eventuele uitzettingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind en Sjoerdsma over de repressie tegen Nicaraguaanse ngo’s

MPs from five parties asked the Dutch foreign and development ministers about Nicaragua's dissolution of NGOs including CENIDH, police raids on NGOs and the Confidencial newsroom, seizure of Dutch-funded assets, and the anti-terror law 977 used against civil society. The ministers confirmed the raids and seizures, said Nederland raised the issue with the Nicaraguan ambassador and within the EU, and shared the concern that civil society is under pressure.
The Netherlands will continue to closely monitor the situation and, where possible, including within the EU, continue to speak out against repression in Nicaragua.
Nederland zal de situatie nauwlettend blijven volgen en waar mogelijk zich, onder meer in EU-verband, blijven uitspreken tegen onderdrukking in Nicaragua.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ploumen en Van Ojik over het bericht dat de visa van 11 onderzoekers van CICIG door Guatemala zijn ingetrokken

MPs Karabulut, Ploumen and Van Ojik asked the minister about Guatemala expelling 11 CICIG investigators and revoking their visas and immunity, and whether the Netherlands would condemn this and support CICIG's mandate. The minister condemned Guatemala's termination of the UN agreement, said the Netherlands backs CICIG and a renewed mandate, and reported EU and G13 statements and diplomatic contacts, while declining to commit to a specific new step beyond existing advocacy.
The international community has sharply condemned the Guatemalan government's termination of the CICIG agreement.
De internationale gemeenschap heeft het opzeggen van het CICIG-akkoord door de Guatemalteekse regering scherp veroordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van Ojik en Ploumen over de detentie van anti-slavernij activisten in Mauritanië

MPs Karabulut, Van Ojik and Ploumen asked about the detention of anti-slavery activist Biram Dah Abeid in Mauritania, the conditions and fairness of his trial, and whether the minister would press Mauritania to stop repressing anti-slavery activists. The minister answered that Abeid was arrested in August 2018, released on 31 December 2018, that the Netherlands and the EU have raised concerns with Mauritanian authorities, and that Dutch support for local human rights NGOs continues.
Information on the exact conditions in detention and the course of the trial was limited.
Informatie over de exacte omstandigheden in detentie en verloop van het proces was beperkt beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Toorenburg, Groothuizen en Van Ojik over het rapport ‘Extra beschermd of extra beschadigd?’

MPs asked the State Secretary about a report finding that disabled and seriously ill children in asylum procedures and reception centres are not protected under UN child and disability treaties, and how the IND's medical assessments differ from treating doctors' views. The State Secretary responded that COA adapts housing and care case by case, that medical permits follow a separate IND/BMA assessment with discretionary power, and that individual cases are not addressed.
From that standpoint I cannot answer your question.
Ik kan uw vraag vanuit dat oogpunt dus niet beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Karabulut, Ploumen, Van Helvert, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over arrestaties tijdens mensenrechtendemonstraties in West-Papoea

Eight MPs asked the Foreign Minister about mass arrests of protesters at Human Rights Day demonstrations in West Papua, the fairness of their trials, progress on human rights in Indonesia, the Dutch Community Policing Programme, and whether the Netherlands will keep pressing Indonesia on press freedom and violence against Papuans. The minister answered that roughly 132-137 people were detained and released without charge in a context of tension, that all were freed and will not be prosecuted, that human rights concerns remain despite socio-economic progress, and that the Netherlands raises these points bilaterally and within the EU.
All persons arrested have since been released. They will not be prosecuted.
Alle opgepakte personen zijn inmiddels weer vrijgelaten. Zij zullen niet vervolgd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Verhoeven over de artikel 7-procedure

Two MPs (Van Ojik and Verhoeven) asked the Foreign Minister whether member states are stalling the Article 7 procedure against Hungary, whether a Council hearing with Hungary should be held, which states block it, and what deadlines and consequences apply. The minister answered that the Council must follow up the EP resolution with hearings, that no fixed deadline exists, that the Netherlands is pushing with like-minded states for an early hearing, and that the Council's deliberations are confidential.
Because the Council's deliberations are confidential, the cabinet cannot publicly provide further explanation of the positions of other member states on the Article 7 procedure against Hungary.

Het kabinet kan vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van de beraadslagingen in de Raad publiekelijk geen verdere toelichting verschaffen over de positionering van de overige lidstaten ten aanzien van de artikel 7-procedure jegens Hongarije.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Verhoeven, Van der Graaf, Leijten, Van Ojik, Maeijer, Asscher, Van Rooijen, Van Raan, Bisschop, Azarkan en Baudet over de rechtsstatelijke aspecten van de machtigingsbepaling van

MPs from many parties asked the Foreign Affairs and Justice ministers whether article X of the Brexit omnibus bill, which lets ministers issue temporary general rules that can depart from existing law, undermines legislative primacy and rule-of-law safeguards, and whether they would add safeguards by amendment. The ministers reject the criticism, argue the power is a narrow, one-year transitional measure justified by Brexit's unprecedented nature and that the Council of State endorsed it, and say they will consider an amendment based on Chamber feedback.
We will, based on the views of the Chamber and further reactions from society, benevolently consider whether an amendment note is appropriate.
Wij zullen op basis van de zienswijze van de Kamer en verdere reacties uit de samenleving welwillend bezien of een nota van wijziging aangewezen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht Saudi Arabia Allegedly Tortured Women’s Rights Activists Before Khashoggi Murder

MPs Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked whether the government knows of reports that Saudi Arabia detained eight women's rights activists for exercising free expression and allegedly tortured them, and what it will do, bilaterally, in the EU and with partners, to condemn this and seek release. The minister replied that the Netherlands raised concerns with the Saudi ambassador, in multilateral fora and through EU channels, promoted a formal EU-Saudi human rights dialogue, and works with the embassy to gather information, while weighing public versus quiet diplomacy case by case.
The Netherlands, together with partners, weighs case by case what degree of public attention is most effective, with the wishes of the persons concerned or their families being decisive.
Nederland maakt samen met partners per geval de afweging welke mate van publieke aandacht het meest effectief is, waarbij de wensen van de betrokkenen zelf, of hun families, leidend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over doorvoer van militaire goederen via Schiphol en anderen Nederlandse havens

The MP asks whether the government expects companies exporting or transiting dual-use and military goods to apply due diligence and to inform authorities of human rights risks. The minister answers that export licences check for military end use and human rights violations, that companies with global licences need an approved compliance programme, and that there is no general duty to report human rights risks to authorities.
A general obligation to inform authorities about possible human rights violations does not as such exist.
Een algemene verplichting om autoriteiten over mogelijke mensenrechtenschendingen te informeren bestaat als zodanig niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over de The Hague Youth Declaration on Human Rights in Action van 20 oktober 2018

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Foreign Minister about the Hague Youth Declaration on Human Rights in Action adopted at the One Young World Summit, including its relevance to human rights promotion and how the government will publicise it among young people. The minister answered that the government sponsored youth participation, supports youth voice initiatives in the Netherlands, and will promote the declaration in line with existing human rights policy, without committing to a new concrete step.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Voordewind over het bericht dat Nederland bewust geen vluchtelingen met medische problemen selecteert voor hervestiging

MPs Van Ojik and Voordewind asked whether the Netherlands caps medical refugee resettlement at 30 people including family, and whether this burden-based reasoning is justified. The State Secretary denied any binding cap, explained the medical sub-quota as a maximum within the total quota, and stated that medical cases are accepted outside it, citing Lebanon figures.
It is not correct that the Netherlands has set a maximum on the number of refugees with a medical indication who can be selected and resettled to the Netherlands.
Het klopt niet dat Nederland een maximum heeft gesteld aan het aantal vluchtelingen met een medische indicatie dat kan worden geselecteerd en hervestigd naar Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Berispte ambtenaar blijft actief in vrouwenrechten'

MPs Özütok and Van Ojik asked whether a Foreign Ministry official coordinating a women's rights project, whose complaints of sexual intimidation, financial abuse and bullying were upheld, was moved to an equivalent post still touching women's rights and contact with NGOs. Minister Blok confirmed six complaints were upheld, a disciplinary measure was imposed, the official was moved immediately, and he may continue in ministry work with NGO contact that will be avoided, while outlining reforms to reporting and transparency.
Six of the complaints have been upheld.
Zes van de klachten zijn gegrond verklaard.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht ‘Escalatie President Guatemala weert corruptie-aanklager VN’

MPs asked the ministers about Guatemala's refusal to renew the UN anti-corruption commission CICIG and about the government's response, protection of human rights defenders, and intimidation of NGOs. The ministers said they regret the non-renewal, cite Dutch funding, EU statements and the Shelter City programme, and promised continued monitoring and raising of the issue with Guatemalan authorities.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs will continue to closely monitor the situation and keep raising it with the Guatemalan government.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken zal de situatie nauwlettend blijven volgen en blijven aankaarten bij de Guatemalteekse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van Rooijen, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Kuzu over de uitvoering van de motie inzake Magnitsky-sancties

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he had formally proposed an EU human rights sanctions regime, how other member states reacted, and why he doubts a national Magnitsky-style regime would be effective, as well as whether he will implement the Omtzigt motion. The minister answered that he proposed an EU global human rights sanctions regime at the Gymnich meeting, that some states were positive and none openly negative, that a formal proposal is deferred until support exists, that a national regime would be ineffective given Schengen, and that he will pursue the EU route and report after a November meeting.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is organising a senior-official meeting in November for EU member states and like-minded countries to further develop the concept of a human rights sanctions regime.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken organiseert in november een hoogambtelijke bijeenkomst voor EU-lidstaten en enkele gelijkgezinde landen om het concept van een mensenrechtensanctieregime verder te ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van Ojik over het ‘Verdrag tussen de Regering van het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden en de Regering van Australië inzake olievoorraadovereenkomsten’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether the Netherlands-Australia oil stockholding treaty is efficient given Australian stocks stored in the Netherlands, whether it mainly benefits Dutch oil companies, and what value it has for citizens. The minister answered that stock location does not matter in IEA collective actions, that Australia has long failed its stockholding obligation, and that the treaty lets Australia buy oil tickets from Dutch firms, a usual commercial activity.
The treaty makes it possible for Australia to purchase oil tickets from oil companies established in the Netherlands.
Het verdrag maakt het voor Australië mogelijk om olie-tickets aan te kopen bij in Nederland gevestigde oliebedrijven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Kuiken, Van Ojik en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de staatssecretaris in hoger beroep is gegaan in de zaak van Lili en Howick en daarmee het advies van de Raad voor kind

MPs asked why the State Secretary appealed the Lili and Howick ruling and disregarded Raad voor de Kinderbescherming conditions, and whether removal of supervised children without achieved goals is responsible. The State Secretary answered that asylum law under the CJEU M'Bodj judgment excludes these socio-economic circumstances from Article 3 ECHR, that the Raad van State ruled in his favour, that the children may now stay after events of 8 September 2018, and that the RvdK, IND and DT&V cooperate while each applies its own context.

The circumstances invoked in this case, namely that the goals formulated by the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming have not yet been achieved, cannot and may not, according to this case law of the Court of Justice, lead to asylum status.

De aangevoerde omstandigheden in deze zaak, erin gelegen dat de door de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming geformuleerde doelen nog niet zijn bereikt, kunnen en mogen volgens deze jurisprudentie van het Hof van Justitie niet leiden tot een asielstatus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Van Ojik en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Waarom help Nederland zijn meisjes niet’

MPs Özütok, Van Ojik and Buitenweg asked the Foreign Affairs and Legal Protection ministers why the Netherlands helps so few women and girls who are victims of forced marriage or abandonment abroad, why the ticket fund is little used, and how Norway compares. The minister's answer describes 38 reports in 2017, the handling of cases, the limited use of the ticket fund, and commits to reporting results of the forced marriage unit soon.
There is no national registration of victims of forced marriage and abandonment.
Er is geen landelijke registratie van slachtoffers van huwelijksdwang en achterlating.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ploumen en Van Ojik over de hongerstaking van gedetineerde Rif-activisten in Marokko

MPs Karabulut, Ploumen and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister about the hunger strike of detained Rif activists in Morocco, including Nasser Zefzafi's health, contacts with Moroccan authorities, review of the verdicts and calls for release. The minister confirmed the hunger strike ended after most demands were met, said the embassy is in contact with lawyers but not detainees, and declined to request release or better treatment, citing that verdicts and appeal are still pending.
Regarding the treatment of Mr Zefzafi and other political prisoners, I do not have information that would support a request for better treatment.
Wat betreft de behandeling van de heer Zefzafi en andere politieke gevangenen, beschik ik niet over informatie die een verzoek om betere behandeling zou kunnen ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van den Hul, Ploumen, Van Ojik en Van Raan over het bericht dat de VS alle hulp aan UNRWA stopt

MPs asked the government how it views the US decision to halt all funding to UNRWA, and whether it will press Washington, increase its own contribution, and address the wider political consequences. The government regrets the US decision, says it opposes politicising humanitarian aid, pledges to raise the issue with the US and other donors, and keeps its existing 13 million euro annual contribution while deferring any extra funding to year-end review.
As usual, at the end of the year the cabinet will assess, within existing humanitarian aid agreements, which additional Dutch contributions based on the humanitarian imperative are desirable.

Zoals gebruikelijk beoordeelt het kabinet aan het einde van het jaar binnen de bestaande afspraken over humanitaire hulp welke aanvullende Nederlandse bijdragen op basis van het humanitair imperatief wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kuiken, Voordewind en Jasper van Dijk over uitzettingen naar Afghanistan

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA, ChristenUnie and SP asked the State Secretary about deportations of Afghan families with minor children, the compatibility with children's rights, recognition rates across EU states, and the number of families in return procedures. The State Secretary rejected the claim that the deportation endangered the family, defended the policy change and the Afghan recognition rate, and said unaccompanied minors are not returned where no family or adequate care is available.
I do not share this conclusion.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Ojik, Agnes Mulder, Sjoerdsma en Van der Staaij over de berichten dat tegen vijf Soedische mensenrechtenactivistes de doodstraf is geëist

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that prosecutors sought the death penalty against five Saudi human rights activists, including one woman, and whether the trial is fair and what pressure the Netherlands can exert. The minister answered that the government is deeply concerned, opposes the death penalty, raises concerns with Saudi authorities and through EU channels including a joint demarche, and will raise the issue at the November UPR, but gave limited information on the trial itself.
The cabinet is following developments, including the trial of the female activist mentioned in the reports, closely.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen, waaronder het proces van de in de berichtgeving genoemde vrouwelijke activist, op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kuiken en Jasper van Dijk over de negatieve gevolgen van uitzetting naar Armenië voor de PTSS-klachten van Howick en Lili

MPs Van Ojik, Kuiken and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the IND adequately investigated the PTSD complaints of children Howick and Lili and their deportation to Armenia, and whether deportation should be halted pending new investigation. The Staatssecretaris declined to address individual medical circumstances, citing privacy of special personal data, and confirmed no irreversible steps had yet been taken.
As your House is aware, I do not go into individual and personal aspects in public answers to parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is ga ik in openbare beantwoording van Kamervragen niet in op individuele en persoonlijke aspecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het ‘Report on the Situation of Human Rights in Kashmir’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister about the 2018 OHCHR report on human rights in Kashmir, including whether the Netherlands or the EU had responded, whether an international inquiry should be set up, and whether India and Pakistan should grant access. The minister said the report was regrettable given the lack of access, noted that neither the Netherlands nor the EU took a position on it in the Human Rights Council, and said all parties should cooperate with independent investigations, leaving any heavier inquiry to future findings.
Neither the Netherlands, nor the European Union, nor any of the other EU member states has taken a position on the report.
Nederland, noch de Europese Unie of een van de andere EU-lidstaten, heeft zich uitgesproken over het rapport

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Ojik, Ploumen en Karabulut over de inning Eritrese diasporabelasting nadat de Tijdelijk Zaakgelastigde persona non grata is verklaard

Seven MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the dwangmatige inning of Eritrean diaspora tax has changed since the Eritrean chargé was declared persona non grata, whether reports and prosecutions have increased, and whether a central reporting point should be created.
