The minister answered that no new chargé has been appointed, that there are no indications of change in reports, that a study on banning diaspora tax is underway, and that a special reporting point is not considered necessary.
The cabinet is currently examining the possibilities for a ban on diaspora tax in the Netherlands, in line with the motion by MPs Karabulut and Van Ojik.
Het kabinet onderzoekt momenteel de mogelijkheden met betrekking tot een verbod op diasporabelasting in Nederland, conform de motie van de leden Karabulut en van Ojik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht 'Waarom het KhAD-WAD ambtsbericht van 29 februari 2000 onjuist en onbetrouwbaar is'

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice about a critique of the 2000 KhAD-WAD country report, which relied on anonymous sources and claimed all Afghan intelligence officers were involved in human rights abuses via rotation, and about the resulting exclusion of asylum seekers under Article 1F. The ministers defended the sources as confidential but credible, said the 2008 UNHCR critique did not refute the report, and rejected calls for a new assessment.
The sources consulted are not anonymous but confidential.
De geraadpleegde bronnen zijn niet anoniem maar vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Baudet, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Becker, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over de sluiting van kerken door de Algerijnse overheid

Eight MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Algeria is closing Protestant churches under its law on non-Islamic religions and whether this breaches religious freedom. The minister confirmed that some churches cannot hold services without the required permits, said freedom of religion is not generally violated, and said he raised the issue with the Algerian foreign minister, who replied that churches have nothing to fear.
Needless to say, I will continue to closely monitor developments in this regard and, if necessary, voice my concerns bilaterally and within the EU.
Het spreekt voor zich dat ik de ontwikkelingen hieromtrent nauwgezet blijf volgen en indien nodig hierover, bilateraal en in EU-verband, mijn zorgen zal uiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Ploumen, Van Ojik en Van Helvert over het bericht dat Syrië komende maand voorzitter is van de VN-Conferentie over Ontwapening

Six MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Syria's rotating presidency of the UN Conference on Disarmament, given the regime's use of chemical weapons, undermines UN credibility and whether the Netherlands would raise objections with the UN Secretary-General. The minister agreed Syria lacks moral authority, said the Netherlands has reduced its representation and will leave sessions if Syria misuses the chair, but declined to raise the matter with the Secretary-General because the Conference is autonomous.
The Netherlands will immediately leave the meetings when Syria uses its chairmanship position politically.
Nederland zal de vergaderingen terstond verlaten wanneer Syrië in voorzitterscapaciteit zijn positie politiek aanwendt

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over de uitspraak 201700522/1/A3 van de Raad van State en het bericht ‘Gevolgen van vernietiging IS door Nederlandse bommen blijven geheim’

MPs Ploumen, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the Defence Minister whether the Netherlands' air strikes against IS can be traced in the weekly Defence overview alongside CENTCOM reports, whether more detail will be published, and whether the Dutch weapon deployments reported to the Public Prosecution Service will be shared with parliament. The minister replied that coalition strikes cannot be attributed to individual countries, that the Dutch weekly overview has been expanded in detail, and that parliament has been informed confidentially and openly, while assessment of investigations is for the prosecutor.
Attacks cannot be traced back to countries from this reporting.
Aanvallen zijn hieruit niet te herleiden naar landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Özütok en Van den Hul over de verkiezingsprocedure voor leden van het United Nations Committee on the Elimination of Discrimination against Women (CEDAW)

Three MPs asked why the Netherlands did not nominate a candidate for the UN CEDAW committee and whether it would do so in future. The minister replied that suitable candidates were unavailable or did not meet the independence and expertise requirements, and that the government will reconsider a nomination in a future round.
On the basis of the criteria mentioned earlier, the cabinet will again consider nominating a candidate in a next round.
Op basis van eerdergenoemde criteria zal het kabinet een volgende ronde opnieuw overwegen een kandidaat te nomineren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Voordewind, Becker, Diks, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij, Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Prominente Saudische vrouwenrechtenactivisten opgepakt’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the arrests of Saudi women's rights activists were only for campaigning for women's right to drive, and whether the government would raise the matter bilaterally and in the EU and call for their release. The minister said the detainees are suspected of conspiracy with foreign powers and financing hostile actors, that Nederland raised concerns with the Saudi foreign minister and is consulting partners including in the EU, and that it remains concerned about repression of dissent.
The Netherlands will continue to ask for attention to the detention of the activists and press for proper treatment.
Nederland zal aandacht blijven vragen voor de aanhoudingen van de activisten en aandringen op goede behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht dat het aantal migranten dat wordt opgesloten in onmenselijke Libische detentiecentra sterk is toegenomen

Green Left MP Van Ojik asked the ministers about reports that the number of migrants detained in Libyan detention centres rose sharply, and whether Dutch support for the Libyan coastguard and alleged Italian direction amounted to unlawful pushbacks. The government replied that Libyan coastguard tasks are lawful, denied Italian direction beyond coordination, and described its efforts to improve conditions and close the centres, noting progress remains slow.
As previously shared with your House, the cabinet is working with the AU, EU and UN to improve the situation in the centres, including promoting access to medical care and food supplies.

Zoals eerder met uw Kamer gedeeld 6 , zet het kabinet zich in om samen met de AU, EU en VN de situatie in de centra te verbeteren, waaronder het bevorderen van de toegang tot medische zorg en voedselvoorziening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Groothuizen, Jasper van Dijk, Van Ojik en Kuiken over het rapport van Amnesty over de situatie van migranten in Libië

MPs from five parties asked the government about Amnesty's report on abuses against migrants in Libya, including how to close detention centres, EU/Dutch support to Libyan authorities, UNHCR access, IOM return programmes, and the Libyan coast guard. The government answered that it presses Libya for better conditions and closure of centres, notes four centres closed, defends continued support to stabilise Libya, and says it has urged monitoring improvements while lacking evidence of transponder non-compliance.
The ultimate goal is to close these detention centres and move to alternative reception and transit centres.
Het uiteindelijke doel is deze detentiecentra te sluiten en te komen tot alternatieve ontvangst- en transitcentra.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van Ojik en Ploumen over kernwapenbeleid

MPs Karabulut, Van Ojik and Ploumen asked the Dutch government about US nuclear modernisation (B61 bombs, the F-35 nuclear role, transport and accident safety) and whether the Netherlands should refuse nuclear weapons. The minister declined to give locations, numbers and transport details on alliance grounds, said the F-35 will take over the nuclear-capable role from the F-16 in line with prior policy, and pointed to a forthcoming AIV advisory report.
As the House is aware, under alliance arrangements no information can be provided on the numbers and locations of US nuclear weapons present in Europe.
Zoals de Kamer bekend kunnen op basis van bondgenootschappelijke afspraken geen mededelingen worden gedaan over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over veiligheid over verhoogde leges voor RANOV-vergunninghouders

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why RANOV permit holders must now pay 401 euro in fees to extend their residence permits, questioning the burden on low-income families and why naturalisation is still difficult. The State Secretary replied that after ten years of residence the exemption no longer applies, that alternative permits cost 161 euro, and that the IND gave advance notice, while declining to change the naturalisation document requirements.
After at least 10 years of residence in the Netherlands on the basis of a RANOV permit, there is no longer any ground to exempt this group from fee charges.
Na minimaal 10 jaar verblijf in Nederland op grond van een RANOV-vergunning is er geen grond meer om deze groep vrij te stellen van legesheffing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘Rol Belgie in geheime operatie tegen IS’

MPs Ploumen and Van Ojik asked the Defence Minister whether Dutch intelligence supports the US-led operation Gallant Phoenix against IS, including Dutch involvement in searching a database in Jordan, and whether they had contacted their Belgian counterpart. The minister said there was no contact with the Belgian minister, that Nederland shares intelligence within the anti-ISIS coalition, and that for operational security she does not comment on specific intelligence activities.
For reasons of operational security, the cabinet makes no statements about specific activities in the intelligence domain.
In het kader van de operationele veiligheid doet het kabinet geen uitspraken over specifieke werkzaamheden in het inlichtingendomein.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de vervolging van milieuactivisten in Iran

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest on espionage charges and death in custody of Iranian environmental activists, and whether the Netherlands would press Iran for explanation, attend trials and investigate. The minister said he had no further information, that Iran had issued no official explanation, that Canada leads on the case and the EU raises detainee rights, and that the Netherlands supports human rights defenders through its fund.
Iran does not allow foreign diplomats to attend trials of Iranian citizens, even when they are dual nationals.
Iran staat niet toe dat buitenlandse diplomaten rechtszaken van Iraanse staatsburgers bijwonen, ook niet als het om bipatriden gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Ten Broeke, Karabulut en De Roon over de onderdrukking van Papoea’s in Indonesië

MPs asked the minister about the expulsion of a BBC journalist from Papua, press freedom, deteriorating human rights, and Dutch police training in Indonesia. The minister confirmed the expulsion, said foreign journalists need permits, described Dutch support for press freedom and the Community Policing Programme, and said human rights including Papua are raised in bilateral and EU/UN dialogue.
Enquiries showed that the BBC journalist indeed had to leave the province.
Bij navraag is gebleken dat de BBC-journaliste inderdaad de provincie moest verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Oijk en Karabulut over het bericht 'De onderkoning van Congo'

MPs Ploumen, Van Oijk and Karabulut asked about press reports on Dan Gertler, his listing on the US Magnitsky sanctions list, whether Dutch authorities investigated Fleurette Group, whether EU or Dutch sanctions are possible, and what Dutch measures exist against foreign corruption. The minister says the cabinet is concerned, is closely informed about the US investigation and sanctions, notes the EU has no Magnitsky-type regime, and describes the Dutch integrated anti-corruption approach with enforcement left to the OM and FIOD.
This matter now has the full attention of the Dutch enforcement authorities.
Deze kwestie heeft inmiddels de volledige aandacht van de Nederlandse handhavingsinstanties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Van Ojik over bedreigde mensenrechtenactivisten in Guatemala

Two GroenLinks MPs asked about threatened indigenous human rights activist Aura Lolita Chávez in Guatemala, her return risk, and Dutch efforts against corruption and attacks on activists. The ministers said the embassy supports her through a working group and funds anti-impunity and protection programmes, and that no Dutch palm oil or logging firms had contacted the embassies, though this could not be fully excluded.
Protection of human rights is a cornerstone of Dutch foreign policy.
Bescherming van mensenrechten is een hoeksteen van het Nederlands buitenlands beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het niet verlenen van asiel aan LHBTI’s afkomstig uit Cuba

The MP asks why the government introduced a transit visa requirement for Cubans that may block LGBTI asylum seekers, and why it does not reassess Cuba asylum policy given reported discrimination. The State Secretary answers that the transit visa aims to check travel documents and intentions, that the IND assesses each asylum claim individually, and that there is no general reason to assume LGBTI people need protection from return to Cuba.
I cannot judge on the basis of that article whether and to what extent these stories are truthful.
Ik kan op grond van dat artikel niet beoordelen of en in hoeverre deze verhalen waarheidsgetrouw zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het uitzetten van uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers naar Soedan

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the government would reconsider returns to Sudan after Belgium reportedly saw a deported Sudanese man tortured on return, and whether it would investigate or impose a moratorium. The State Secretary answered that the Dutch situation differs from the Belgian one, that no concrete signal of serious irregularities after Dutch returns had been received, and that no monitoring after return is part of the policy, so no investigation or policy change is planned.
Furthermore, only a concrete and substantiated signal of serious irregularities after a removal from the Netherlands can give cause to start an investigation in an individual case.
Verder kan slechts een concreet en onderbouwd signaal van ernstige onregelmatigheden na een uitzetting vanuit Nederland aanleiding vormen om in een individueel geval onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht dat Ethiopië toch niet politieke gevangenen vrijlaat

MP Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Ethiopia would release all political prisoners, later contradicted by a spokesperson, and about Dutch efforts on human rights in Ethiopia. The minister attributed the discrepancy to a translation error, noted that 528 detainees were released in federal prisons with more releases possible, and described Dutch human rights dialogue and capacity-building efforts, without committing to further action.
Ethiopia has begun releasing jailed politicians (or 'political prisoners').
Ethiopië is begonnen met het vrijlaten van gevangen politici (of «politieke gevangenen»).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Arissen, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het bericht dat moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers in Europa in voorbere

MPs from ten parties asked the government whether it knew of reports that assassinations of Turkish citizens in Europe were being planned, how it assessed these claims, and whether it would investigate and take extra security measures. The minister said the government is alert and monitors tensions and safety in the Turkish-Dutch community, cannot confirm the existence of such plans, and urged anyone threatened to report it.
I cannot confirm the existence of plans for assassinations of Turkish citizens.
Het bestaan van plannen voor moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers kan ik niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van Tongeren over het artikel 'Nuclear accident sends 'harmless' radioactive cloud over Europe'

MPs Van Ojik and Van Tongeren asked whether the government knows who was responsible for a radioactive ruthenium-106 release over Europe, whether Russia or Kazakhstan violated early-notification duties, and what risks follow. The minister says the source is not known with certainty but likely the southern Urals, that the Netherlands raised the matter at the IAEA board, and that the national radiation monitoring network can detect such releases.
The Netherlands, together with several other European countries, asked the other IAEA member states for clarification at the recent IAEA board meeting.

Nederland heeft, tezamen met een aantal andere Europese landen, tijdens de afgelopen bestuursraad van de Internationaal Atoomenergieagentschap (IAEA) opheldering gevraagd aan de andere IAEA-lidstaten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Thieme, Baudet, Kuzu, Van de Hul en Knops over het bericht dat de Nederlandse overheid grote steken heeft laten vallen in het verle

MPs from many parties asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the Dutch government failed to assist Mr Singh, a Dutch national imprisoned in the US for 33 years, including over consular visits, a transfer request and the handling of his case. The government rejects the picture of failure, says it cannot intervene in foreign justice, explains that transfer was refused on legal grounds and pledges continued support for parole and review requests.
The ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice and Security do not recognise that picture.
De ministeries van Buitenlandse Zaken en Justitie en Veiligheid herkennen zich niet in dat beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Karabulut, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Thieme over het referendum over onafhankelijkheid voor Iraaks Koerdistan

Six MPs asked whether the independent international law adviser should assess whether Iraqi Kurdistan meets the Montevideo criteria for statehood in light of its independence referendum, and how the government interprets such advice. The answer states that the questions were answered in a separate letter ('Situatie Koerdische regio') to parliament, so no substantive reply is given in this document.

The written questions from MPs Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Karabulut, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij and Thieme, question number 2017Z12850, have been answered by means of the letter 'Situation in the Kurdish region'.

Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma (D66), Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Karabulut (SP), Van Ojik (GroenLinks), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD), vraagnummer 2017Z12850 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Situatie Koerdische regio» (Kamerstuk 32 623, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oijk en Diks over de inbeslagname door Israël van een door Nederland gesubsidieerd zonne-energieproject in het Palestijnse dorp Jubbet adh Dhib

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether Israel would return seized Dutch-subsidised solar panels in Jubbet adh Dhib, compensate the damage, and how the Israeli permit regime relates to humanitarian obligations and EU responses. The government reported that the panels were returned to COMET-ME as a temporary solution pending a zoning plan decision, gave permit statistics showing very few Palestinian approvals in Area C, and described EU efforts to press Israel on demolitions while declining to answer some questions on Israel's intentions.
It is not for the cabinet to answer this question about the intentions of the Israeli government.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om deze vraag naar voornemens van de Israëlische regering te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over geweld en intimidatie tegen Israëlische mensenrechtenorganisaties

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about an arson-intimidation plot against Breaking the Silence, alleged government-linked smear campaigns against Israeli human rights NGOs, steps under the Sjoerdsma motion, and a vote-manipulation campaign against Gisha in the Human Rights Tulip. The minister acknowledged the trend and concern, referred to earlier reporting on the motion, said the government raises human rights in EU dialogue without committing to a formal demand, and explained the vote analysis and fraud filters.
The cabinet devotes intensive attention to human rights issues in its dialogue with the Israeli authorities, where possible within the EU.
Het kabinet besteedt – waar mogelijk in EU-verband – intensieve aandacht aan mensenrechtenonderwerpen in de dialoog met de Israëlische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over beknotting van de vrijheid van meningsuiting door de Palestijnse Autoriteit

An MP asked the foreign minister about the arrest of human rights defender Issa Amro by Palestinian Authority security forces, the Electronic Crimes Law, and Dutch support to Palestinian security institutions. The government expressed concern, said it raises freedom of expression with the PA and supports Amro diplomatically, and committed to monitoring the cases and to linking support to human rights respect without specifying new concrete measures.

The Netherlands and the EU will continue to closely follow the cases against Amro and continue to stress to the Palestinian Authority the importance of human rights defenders and organisations for a free and pluralistic society.

Nederland en de EU zullen de zaken tegen Amro nauwgezet blijven volgen en bij de Palestijnse Autoriteit het belang van mensenrechtenverdedigers en -organisaties voor een vrije en pluriforme samenleving blijven benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Ten Broeke, Knops, Van Ojik, Sjoerdsma en Voordewind over de arrestatie van een Turkse Nederlander in Turkije

MPs from six parties asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest in Turkey of Dutch-Turkish national Volkan Çalışkan over a banner, whether consular assistance was given, and about the travel bans on eleven Dutch citizens and wider rule-of-law concerns. The minister confirmed the arrest, said the Netherlands requested consular access and will ask the Turkish authorities for attention to the cases, and described diplomatic efforts on Turkey's rule of law.
The Netherlands will continue to request extra attention for these cases so that those involved can return to the Netherlands as soon as possible.
Nederland zal extra aandacht voor deze gevallen blijven vragen opdat betrokkenen zo spoedig mogelijk naar Nederland kunnen terugkeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Diks over het bezoek van de Mozambikaanse president aan Nederland

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why President Nyusi of Mozambique was received in the Netherlands before the hidden-debt fraud investigation concluded, and about his role and the government's response. The ministers answered that the topic was raised in talks, that the independent audit and criminal investigation are ongoing, and that aid resumption depends on concrete action.
In that context, the need for concrete follow-up with possible criminal prosecution was central.
Daarin is de noodzaak tot concrete opvolging met eventuele strafrechtelijke vervolging centraal gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Ojik over een hongerstaking van Palestijnen in Israëlische detentie

MPs Karabulut and Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares the UN rapporteur's view that Israel violates international law through mass administrative detention and transfer of Palestinian detainees, whether he will press Israel on treatment of prisoners, and whether he shares concerns about solitary confinement and denial of lawyers to hunger strikers. The minister answered that the government shares concerns about administrative detention, will raise prisoner conditions in regular human rights dialogue, and that the EU raised the issue with Israeli authorities and issued a local statement calling for full respect of prisoners' human rights.
The government shares concerns about the scale and duration of administrative detention.
Het kabinet deelt zorgen over de schaal en duur van administratieve detentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Azmani, Jasper van Dijk, Sjoerdsma, Kuiken, Knops en Voordewind over het bericht “Onrust op ministeries over komst Eritrese partijfunctionaris”

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about a planned Eritrean youth congress in the Netherlands, the planned speech by regime official Yemane Gebreab, and possible measures against regime-linked persons and the diaspora tax. The minister answered that the congress was banned by the Veldhoven mayor, that voluntariness of contacts with Eritrean authorities must remain the principle, that visa decisions are individual, that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service, and that a diaspora tax study is ongoing and will be reported in Q2 2017.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has commissioned an independent bureau to research the nature and extent of the Eritrean regime's diaspora tax.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft een onafhankelijk bureau opdracht gegeven om onderzoek te doen naar de aard en omvang van de diasporabelasting van het Eritrese regime.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Van Haersma Buma, Slob, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Roemer over het bed, bad, brood compromis

MPs from several parties asked the government to explain its reliance on the Council of Europe's Committee of Ministers resolution rejecting the ECSR findings on basic provision for irregular migrants, the conditional 'bed, bath, bread' shelter scheme tied to return cooperation, the funding and sanction mechanism for municipalities, and the buitenschuld permit system. The government answered that the ECSR findings have no basis in the treaty, that Article 3 ECHR sets the floor, that shelter in pre-VBL locations will be time-limited and tied to return efforts, and that details will be settled with the VNG.
It is not for the ECSR to pronounce on the rights of persons residing illegally in our country.
Het is dan ook niet aan het ECSR om zich uit te spreken over de rechten van illegaal in ons land verblijvende personen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de beslissing van het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) om een uitkeringsgerechtigde vrijwilligerswerk als chauffeur op de buurtbus te verbieden, terwijl een

An MP asked the minister why UWV barred an unemployment-benefit recipient from volunteering as a bus driver while a social-assistance recipient may do similar volunteer work, and whether this inconsistency is undesirable. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, explained the criteria for volunteering with retained WW benefit (non-commercial organisation, allowance below the tax-office cap of 150 euro per month), and said that municipalities and UWV are responsible for supervising these rules.
It is not for me to go into individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij om in te gaan op casuïstiek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt, Bontes, Van Bommel, De Roon, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het vermeende ongemak van politie en Openbaar Ministerie over de rol van de AIVD bij het onderzoek naar de ramp

MPs asked whether the AIVD is obstructing the MH17 investigation by withholding information from police and prosecutors, and whether ministers have signals of friction and will meet the organisations. The ministers reject the claim, say cooperation is good, report frequent ministerial and ministerial-commission contact, and decline further talks as unnecessary.
In response to the report "AIVD frustrates MH17 investigation", the cabinet strongly denies that the AIVD is withholding information in the investigation into the MH17 air disaster.
In reactie op het bericht «AIVD frustreert MH17-onderzoek» weerspreekt het kabinet met klem dat in het onderzoek naar de vliegramp met de MH17 door de AIVD informatie wordt achtergehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de economische missie naar Abu Dhabi

An MP asked the Defence and Trade ministers whether the February 2015 economic mission to Abu Dhabi and the IDEX defence fair aimed at arms exports, and how the government would manage the risk of arms exports fuelling instability and rights abuses in the MENA region. The government answered that the mission supports the defence and security industry under the Defence Industry Strategy, that export licences are assessed against the EU Common Position criteria, and that it will not reconsider attendance.
If this assessment against the EUGS criteria is negative, the export licence is refused.
Indien deze toets aan de EUGS-criteria negatief uitvalt, wordt de exportvergunning afgewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het opnemen van het investeringsgeschillenbeslechtingsmechanisme (ISDS) in het Vrijhandelsakkoord van de EU met Canada (CETA)

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Foreign Trade whether she would take up the EU public consultation's criticism of investor-state dispute settlement (ISDS) in CETA and TTIP, including the Franco-German call to revisit CETA. The minister answered that the consultation results feed a broader EU debate on an improved ISDS standard, that Netherlands will join the debate, and that it will consult stakeholders on the Dutch position.
I am of the view that conducting a focused debate to arrive at an EU approach to ISDS will strengthen the EU's negotiating position against the US.
Ik ben van mening dat het voeren van een gefocust debat om tot een EU-benadering van ISDS te komen, de onderhandelingspositie van de EU tegenover de VS zal versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over zijn uitspraken ten aanzien van een Europese zetel in de VN Veiligheidsraad

Dutch MP Van Ojik asked the Foreign Minister about his statements on reforming the UN Security Council and a permanent EU seat, including EU support, the veto, and the 2017 campaign. The minister answered that the Netherlands actively pushes Security Council reform, supports a French initiative to limit veto use in mass atrocities, deems an EU seat feasible, and will include reform in its 2017 campaign.
The cabinet is not in favour of new veto rights.
Het kabinet is geen voorstander van nieuwe vetorechten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Roemer, Van Haersma Buma, Wilders, Pechtold, Slob, Van Ojik en Van der Staaij naar aanleiding van zijn uitspraken tijdens het debat op 14 januari jl. over de aanslagen in Parijs

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister whether his remark that the AIVD, with current staffing and funding, can do its job was meant regarding jihadism, how many staff track returnees, whether budget cuts reduced coverage and staff quality, and how police, mayors and national government coordinate. The government replied that all eleven questions were already answered in an earlier letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 29 754, nr. 288), without giving substance in this document.
The written questions ... have been answered by letter 'extra measures counterterrorism and following the debate of 14 January 2015 on the Paris attacks' (Kamerstuk 29 754, no. 288).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «extra maatregelen terrorismebestrijding en n.a.v. debat op 14 januari 2015 over de aanslagen in Parijs» (Kamerstuk 29 754, nr. 288 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, Bontes, De Roon, Thieme en Van Ojik over de tussenrapportages van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV) onderzoeken

MPs asked whether the Safety Board (OVV) runs three MH17 investigations, whether interim reports were published, and under which ICAO Annex 13 reporting obligations. The minister confirmed three investigations, that only the cause investigation has a published preliminary report, and that the other two have no interim reports.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over Conflict-Free Tin Initiative

An MP asked the minister whether an evaluation of the Conflict-Free Tin Initiative pilot in Congo had been ordered, whether it would assess stability and socio-economic effects, and how the minister responded to expert criticism and the EU conflict minerals regulation. The minister replied that no evaluation was commissioned, but a mid-term evaluation is planned for late 2016, and defended the initiative as compatible with the EU's voluntary certification approach.
No assignment has been given for carrying out an evaluation.
Er is geen opdracht gegeven voor het uitvoeren van een evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Bontes over Satellietbeelden/MH17

Five MPs asked the government about reports that the Netherlands holds satellite images showing who is responsible for the MH17 downing, including whether intelligence from the US and Germany has been verified and what political conclusion the cabinet draws. The government answered that it does not comment publicly on verification of foreign intelligence and will not give a political verdict on the cause while the Dutch-led investigations are ongoing, to protect their independence.
The Cabinet cannot draw conclusions without undermining the independence of these official investigations.
Het Kabinet kan geen conclusies trekken zonder de onafhankelijkheid van deze officiële onderzoeken aan te tasten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Gesthuizen, Van Ojik over Textiel/Bangladesh, Compensatie Rana Plaza slachtoffers

MPs asked the minister what results followed their call for companies to compensate Rana Plaza victims, how to fill the half-empty fund, whether Dutch firms must sign the Bangladesh safety accord, and about supply-chain transparency and safety nets for workers. The minister reported an extra 2 million USD raising the fund to 19.4 million of the needed 40 million, said companies bear responsibility, and noted voluntary contributions and ongoing IMVO covenant talks.
I will continue to raise this issue with my colleagues and the government of Bangladesh.
Ik blijf dit onderwerp bij mijn collega’s en de overheid in Bangladesh agenderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kerstens en Karabulut over overtredingen van de TNO-normen voor statijden bij de luchthavenbeveiliging op Schiphol

MPs asked the minister whether maximum standing times for airport security staff at Schiphol, based on TNO norms, are an adequate protection against health risks and whether the state as shareholder should press Schiphol after FNV found an average overrun of 81 minutes per worker per day. The minister said responsibility lies primarily with security firms as employers, that TNO norms are useful, and that he is exploring ways to encourage clients to consider safe work, promising further discussion with parliament.
I am exploring options to encourage clients to take healthy and safe working by contractors into account.
Ik ben bezig met een verkenning van mogelijkheden om opdrachtgevers te stimuleren om rekening te houden met gezond een veilig werken bij de opdrachtnemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Gesthuizen over de zelfmoord van een 17-jarige Afghaanse jongen op de campus voor alleenstaande minderjarigen in Oude Pekela

MPs asked the State Secretary about the suicide of a 17-year-old Afghan boy at the Oude Pekela campus for unaccompanied minors, including his psychological care, his residence permit, the delay in finding him, communication with relatives, and prevention measures. The State Secretary declined to address individual aspects of the case, said suicide is not always preventable, and reported that the Inspectorate for Youth Care received notification and decided not to start a further investigation.
As your House is aware, I do not consider it desirable to address individual aspects of a case when answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, acht ik het niet wenselijk om bij de beantwoording van Kamervragen in te gaan op individuele aspecten van een zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Van Ojik over teveel uitgekeerde kinderopvangtoeslag

MPs Siderius and Van Ojik asked how parents facing childcare allowance recovery over missing child address data or administrative errors can reverse it, and whether an independent body should review such cases. The State Secretary replied that recovery only occurs when legal conditions are unmet, that parents can object or provide documents, that the Auditdienst Rijk and objection and appeal routes already exist so extra review is unnecessary, and refused to suspend recovery before the 24 September debate.
Given the safeguards mentioned above, I am of the view that additional investigation is not necessary.
Ik ben gezien de hiervoor genoemde waarborgen van mening dat aanvullend onderzoek niet nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Voordewind, Schouw en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Discussie illegalen op scherp’

Four MPs asked the state secretary whether he would immediately ensure that rejected asylum seekers have access to bed, bath and bread after two such people died or were seriously injured in Amsterdam. The state secretary expressed regret but rejected any link to national policy, arguing that the reception system covers vulnerable groups and that those who fulfil their departure obligation need not be without shelter.
Providing shelter to people without prospect or conditions, without requiring work towards departure, would not only undermine the credibility and sustainability of the Dutch migration system.

Het zonder perspectief of voorwaarden bieden van onderdak aan personen zonder te verlangen dat wordt gewerkt aan vertrek, zou niet enkel afbreuk doen aan de geloofwaardigheid en houdbaarheid van het Nederlandse migratiestelsel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Ojik en Schouw over de gevolgen van de definitieve beslissing van het Europees Comité van de Sociale Rechten (ECSR) inzake de opvang van vreemdelingen

MPs from SP, ChristenUnie, GroenLinks and D66 asked whether the government has responded to the European Committee of Social Rights' final decision on a complaint about shelter for undocumented and rejected asylum seekers, and asked for the findings to be shared and for prompt measures and clarity for municipalities. The Staatssecretaris answered that the findings were sent confidentially to the Committee of Ministers and the parties, cannot be shared until the Committee of Ministers adopts a position or four months pass, and that the government is not obliged to act within four months, promising to inform the House once the Committee of Ministers has spoken.

The findings of the ECSR only become public once the Committee of Ministers has adopted a position, or four months after their transmission if the Committee of Ministers has not yet adopted a position by then.

De bevindingen van het ECSR worden pas openbaar als het Comité van Ministers een standpunt heeft ingenomen, dan wel vier maanden na toezending van de bevindingen in het geval het Comité van Ministers op dat moment nog geen standpunt heeft ingenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Van Ojik over "het bericht dat een gezin de dupe is geworden van een bedrag aan teveel ontvangen kinderopvangtoeslag dat terugbetaald dient te worden”

MPs Van Ojik and Ulenbelt asked about a family forced to repay childcare allowance after an administrative error, and whether repayment is applied for mere paperwork gaps. The government answered that missing address data alone does not trigger repayment, that parents can supplement data before repayment, and that individual cases cannot be discussed due to confidentiality.
Due to the duty of confidentiality, I, the State Secretary of Finance, cannot address the situation of the people from the Hart van Nederland report.
Vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht kan ik, de staatssecretaris van Financiën, hier niet ingaan op de situatie van de mensen uit de reportage van Hart van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Servaes, Van Ojik over de Egyptische strafeis tegen een Nederlandse journaliste

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government responded to Egypt seeking maximum prison terms against about 20 journalists, including Dutch journalist Rena Netjes, and whether Egypt kept its promise of a fair trial. The minister answered that the Netjes sentence of ten years in absentia is not a fair process, that the Netherlands raised concerns bilaterally and in the EU, and referred to a separate letter for further measures.
The Netherlands informed the Egyptian authorities that it deeply regrets that, due to the course of events in Egypt, Ms. Netjes is denied the possibility of returning safely and doing her work there.
Nederland heeft de Egyptische autoriteiten geïnformeerd dat het zeer betreurt dat mw. Netjes door de gang van zaken in Egypte de mogelijkheid wordt ontzegd om veilig te kunnen terugkeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Bommel, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Sjoerdsma over seksueel geweld tegen (Dalit) vrouwen in India

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he would raise caste discrimination and impunity for sexual violence against Dalit women in India and Bangladesh at UN forums, co-sponsor a side event, and raise the issue bilaterally. The minister confirmed awareness and past discussions, noted India's announced zero-tolerance policy and Dutch UN resolution work, but declined to co-sponsor the side event and could not answer before the deadline.
To increase the effectiveness of this event it is important that not only European countries co-sponsor it, but especially countries from other parts of the world.
Om de effectiviteit van dit evenement te vergroten is het van belang dat niet alleen Europese landen dit evenement co-sponsoren», maar juist ook landen uit andere delen van de wereld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de stijgende werkloosheid en de mogelijke komst van een banenplan

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Prime Minister and Minister Asscher about rising unemployment at 8.7%, the withdrawal of young people from the labour market, and reported talks on a jobs plan with social partners. The government answered that unemployment is the top priority, attributed the levelling-off to discouragement effects, outlined existing measures, and said proposals from social partners would be considered in budget discussions.
The cabinet is willing to discuss any proposals from social partners with them and will then seriously consider them in the context of the budget discussions for the coming year.
Het kabinet is bereid om eventuele voorstellen van sociale partners met hen te bespreken en zal ze dan serieus bezien in het kader van de begrotingsbesprekingen voor het komende jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oijk over investeringsverdragen

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Indonesia's termination of its bilateral investment treaty with the Netherlands, the risk of investor claims against public-interest legislation, and modernisation of Dutch investment treaties. The minister answered that Indonesia is terminating all such treaties, that Dutch treaties already protect public interests and are being modernised via UNCITRAL transparency rules and OECD guidelines, and that a study of their effects is underway.
A study into the effects of Dutch investment treaties is underway. Its conclusions will be taken into account when revision and modernisation of Dutch investment treaties is on the agenda.

Er loopt een onderzoek naar de effecten van Nederlandse IBO's. Met de conclusies van dit onderzoek zal rekening worden gehouden wanneer herziening en modernisering van Nederlandse IBO's aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de Leden Van Ojik en Klaver en Omtzigt over Oekraïense vermogens die in Nederland gestald worden en de rol die de Nederlandse ambassade hierin speelt

MPs Van Ojik, Klaver and Omtzigt asked whether the Dutch embassy in Kiev actively invited companies to a November 2013 seminar on investing in the Netherlands, whether attendees were linked to EU-sanctioned persons, and how trust offices and FIU reports relate to Ukrainian assets. The minister answered that the embassy did not actively approach companies, that the attendee list is not shared for privacy reasons, that no sanctioned person attended, and that embassy promotion events and trust office presentations are not centrally registered.
These reports of unusual transactions are then assessed by FIU, and based on the information available to FIU, FIU may decide to report the unusual transactions as suspicious to law enforcement.

Deze meldingen van ongebruikelijke transacties worden vervolgens door FIU beoordeeld en op basis van de bij FIU beschikbare informatie kan FIU besluiten de ongebruikelijke transacties als verdacht door te melden aan de opsporing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Klaver en Omtzigt over Oekraïense vermogens die in Nederland gestald worden en de rol die de Nederlandse ambassade hierin speelt

MPs Van Ojik, Klaver and Omtzigt asked about trust offices and the Dutch embassy in Kiev hosting a November seminar on the Dutch fiscal climate, including whether the presentations fit OECD substance rules, whether they would be shared, the guest list, and the number of anti-money-laundering reports on Ukrainian funds. The minister answered that the seminar was a public event within embassy tasks, that none of the 18 EU-sanctioned persons attended, that FIU-Nederland received 1475 linked transactions and two unusual trust-office reports, and that gatekeepers self-police under DNB supervision, while leaving several questions (presentations, guest list) unanswered.
The Cabinet is of the view that facilitating this meeting falls within the standing mandate of the embassies.
Het Kabinet is van mening dat het faciliteren van deze bijeenkomst past binnen de staande taakopdracht van de ambassades.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Hachchi over brandende vaten zwavelijzer bij de ISLA-raffinaderij

Two MPs asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about a fire involving drums of iron sulphide at the ISLA refinery on Curaçao, the resulting sulphur dioxide peak, health risks, how the drums ended up on a waste heap, and whether the refinery should be closed. The minister confirmed the fire, said the SO2 peak was higher than earlier hourly averages, described health effects, and said the refinery and any investigation are the autonomous responsibility of the Curaçao government.
The ISLA refinery is an autonomous responsibility of the government of Curaçao.
De Isla raffinaderij is een autonome verantwoordelijkheid van de regering van Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk, De Caluwé, Van Ojik, Omtzigt en Servaes over het bericht dat President Museveni de omstreden anti-homowet heeft ondertekend

MPs from several parties asked the government how it would respond to President Museveni signing Uganda's anti-homosexuality law and what measures it would take. The minister answered that the Netherlands suspended justice-sector aid and human-rights-conditioned support, pressed Uganda diplomatically, and would push the EU to condemn the law and withhold budget support, while promising to review support for LGBT groups.
Immediately after the law was signed, the cabinet suspended aid to the Ugandan government in the justice sector.
Meteen na het ondertekenen van de wet heeft het kabinet de hulp aan de Ugandese overheid in de justitiële sector opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Klaver over het artikel “ook zoon Janoekovitsj sluisde vermogen weg via Nederlandse belastingroute”

GreenLeft MPs Van Ojik and Klaver asked whether Dutch tax structures (Mako Holding, Artvin Holding) were used to channel money from Ukraine's Janukovych family, and whether the Netherlands would support a public beneficial-ownership register and freeze assets. The government answered that tax secrecy prevents details on individual taxpayers, described existing anti-money-laundering and beneficial-ownership rules and a planned restricted central shareholder register, and said EU sanctions on Ukrainian officials were being prepared.
Based on the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act, no information can be given about individual taxpayers.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsverplichting van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan geen informatie worden gegeven over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Hamer en Ojik over verslechterde arbeidsomstandigheden van schoonmakers bij de Belastingdienst

MPs asked whether the government would intervene after cleaners at several Belastingdienst sites complained of worsened working conditions, including higher workload, refused sick notices, and alleged intimidation, and whether the Inspectie SZW would investigate. The State Secretary answered that a yearly workload monitor and talks with contractors and cleaners will address the complaints, that Apeldoorn capacity was increased, and that no Inspectie SZW investigation is warranted.
Given the aforementioned measures, I see no reason to ask the Minister of SZW to involve the Inspectie SZW.
Ik zie, gezien de voornoemde maatregelen, geen aanleiding om de Minister van SZW te vragen de Inspectie SZW in te schakelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Van Ojik over het onderbreken van een project voor jonge werkzoekenden bij de politie Assen

MPs Van Tongeren and Van Ojik asked why a Assen police project offering work experience to young jobseekers was halted and whether a national rollout would be pursued. The minister answers that the original training project ended this year, a national working group is examining options, and 5 to 10 placements will be set up at two police units with an ambition of 100.
Last January, in implementation of the Marcouch motion, I indicated that I would research national possibilities for the national police to offer work experience places to unemployed young people.

Afgelopen januari heb ik ter uitvoering van de motie Marcouch aangegeven onderzoek te gaan doen naar landelijke mogelijkheden voor de nationale politie om werkervaringsplaatsen aan te bieden aan werkloze jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Jan Vos, Gesthuizen, Agnes Mulder, Thieme, Baay-Timmerman en Van Ojik over kinderarbeid bij de katoenproductie in Turkije

Seven MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about child labour in Turkish cotton production, the follow-up to a Dutch-funded study, pressure on Turkish authorities and the ILO, the textile sector's responsibility, traceability of Turkish cotton, the MVO risk analysis, ILO child labour figures and child labour raised on trade missions. The minister answered that projects, workshops and a sector action plan are underway, that no EU action plan is needed given ILO efforts, that traceability is not feasible, and that the sector selection will be presented in summer 2014.
The Turkish government is primarily responsible for eliminating child labour.
De Turkse overheid is primair verantwoordelijk voor de uitbanning van kinderarbeid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van Tongeren over de richtlijn bekendmaking niet-financiële informatie

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government would oppose Lithuanian Council presidency compromise text narrowing non-financial reporting duties to risks material to the company itself and allowing firms to withhold information harmful to them. The minister answered that the government supports the directive in principle, will treat its BNC-fiche position as the starting point, and cannot discuss specific confidential compromise proposals.
Because of the confidentiality of the compromise proposals, I cannot go into specific proposals that may be made therein.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van de compromisvoorstellen kan ik niet ingaan op specifieke voorstellen die daarin mogelijk worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Servaes, van Bommel en van Ojik over Nederlandse steun voor bedrijven in nederzettingen

MPs from D66, PvdA, SP and GroenLinks asked whether Dutch support for Israeli companies in settlements, including a planned Dutch-Israeli business forum, conflicts with the Netherlands' discouragement policy and whether the forum's reach would extend to occupied territories. The government answered that the discouragement policy applies to the forum, that Israeli settlement firms are not invited and are monitored, that the Palestinian Authority and Israel were informed of the policy, and that a fully watertight system is not possible.
It is technically not feasible to set up a filter that excludes Israeli companies located in settlements.
Het is technisch niet haalbaar een filter in te stellen die Israëlische bedrijven gevestigd in nederzettingen uitsluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak, Pechtold en Van Ojik over de zaak De Roy van Zuydewijn

MPs Van Raak, Pechtold and Van Ojik asked the Prime Minister about a 2003 confidential DKDB report on a security investigation into Mr De Roy van Zuydewijn, a partner of a royal relative, and about who ordered and knew of it. The Prime Minister answered that the report was released under freedom-of-information rules in 2003, that DKDB acted on its statutory task with Prince Bernhard as protected person, found no security risks, and declined to publish the report to protect private life.
No. The report contains data on the private life of Mr De Roy van Zuydewijn, his former spouse and various other persons.
Nee. Het rapport bevat gegevens met betrekking tot de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de heer De Roy van Zuydewijn, zijn voormalige echtgenote en verschillende andere personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over Conflict Vrij Tin Initiatief

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the Conflict-Free Tin Initiative, concerns over its progress, whether controls will be intensified, and whether EU legislation with supply chain due diligence is supported. The minister defended the pilot's internal controls, said the government is pushing the issue in EU and OECD fora while preferring context-specific measures over generic EU legislation for now.
When it comes up, I will test such a proposal for proportionality and effectiveness.
Ik zal -wanneer aan de orde- zo’n voorstel toetsen op proportionaliteit en op effectiviteit
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma, Thieme, Van Ojik en Omtzigt over het autorijverbod voor vrouwen in Saoedi-Arabië

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about arrests and fines of women defying Saudi Arabia's driving ban and the detention of a journalist supporting women's right to drive, and whether the government would press Saudi counterparts. The minister confirmed short detentions that could not be independently verified, said the journalist was briefly held and has been released, described the situation as concerning while noting some reforms, and stated the issue is raised in EU and UPR dialogue.
However, it is not possible to independently confirm the number of women detained, nor whether they were fined.
Het is echter niet mogelijk om het aantal vrouwen dat is vastgezet onafhankelijk bevestigd te krijgen, noch of zij zijn beboet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Ojik over het weren van lesbiënnes, homo’s en bi’s in de Golfstaten

Two Green Left MPs asked whether they condemn a reported Kuwaiti proposal for Gulf states to subject visa applicants to sex testing that would target transgender people, and whether they would raise it diplomatically. The minister said the proposal conflicts with equal treatment and the government's values, that the ministry is monitoring the situation and will act jointly with partners if appropriate.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is closely monitoring the situation, is in contact with EU partners, and will take appropriate action jointly with international partners if opportune.

Het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken volgt de situatie op de voet, staat in contact met EU-partners en zal indien het opportuun mocht zijn gepaste actie ondernemen gezamenlijk met internationale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Klaver over het bericht “Meer dan 3.500 postbusfirma's in Nederland overtreden de wet”

MPs Van Ojik and Klaver asked whether the government was aware that many postbox firms and foreign cooperatives fail to file annual accounts on time, and what sanctions and oversight are in place. The minister answers that enforcement is multilayered (Chamber of Commerce monitoring, creditor claims, criminal fines, Tax Authority investigation), that sanctions need no tightening, and that a central shareholder register is planned.
I therefore see no reason to tighten the sanctions.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding de sancties aan te scherpen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Oijk over de betrokkenheid van Royal HaskoningDHV bij een illegaal Israëlisch project in Oost-Jeruzalem

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Royal HaskoningDHV's involvement in an Israeli wastewater project in East Jerusalem and Israel's obstruction of Palestinian water authorities, asking whether the government would press Israel on water rights. The minister welcomed the company's withdrawal in principle, said the government had raised the issue with the firm and with Israel, and noted that bilateral water cooperation would be discussed at upcoming consultations, while stating it lacked exact information on the Joint Water Committee.
The government does not have exact information on what is discussed in the Joint Water Committee.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over exacte informatie over hetgeen in de JWC wordt besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Van Ojik over de dreigementen van de Russische kustwacht aan het adres van het Greenpeace-schip Artic Sunrise

MPs Van Tongeren and Van Ojik asked the government about Russian coast guard threats to fire on the Greenpeace ship Arctic Sunrise, the denial of access to the Kara Sea, and Russian oil exploration in the Arctic. The minister condemned the threats, invoked UNCLOS coastal-state rules on the Northern Sea Route, reported summoning the Russian ambassador, and referred to earlier policy on Arctic oil exploration.
On 27 August the Russian embassy was summoned to obtain clarification about the inspection of the Arctic Sunrise carried out by Russia.
Op 27 augustus jl. is de Russische ambassade ontboden teneinde opheldering te verkrijgen over de door Rusland uitgevoerde inspectie van de Artic Sunrise.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Klaver over het artikel ‘Alleen losers betalen belasting’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about tax avoidance by multinationals using Dutch letterbox companies, and whether such companies comply with the OECD Guidelines and can be subject to NCP complaints. The minister acknowledges the problem, says compliance is for the National Contact Points to judge, notes no complaint has ever been filed against a Dutch letterbox company, and promises to ask the OECD for clarification while deferring the answer on access to information.

To support the NCPs in forming their judgment, I will ask the OECD whether the Working Party for Responsible Business Conduct, in consultation with the Committee on Fiscal Affairs, can clarify the OECD Guidelines in cases of tax optimisation by multinationals.

Teneinde de oordeelsvorming door de Nationale Contact Punten te ondersteunen zal ik aan de OESO vragen of de Working Party for Responsible Business Conduct in overleg met het Committee on Fiscal Affairs een nadere duiding kan geven van de OESO-richtlijnen in het geval van fiscale optimalisatie door multinationale ondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de ISLA-raffinaderij

An MP asks why two reports on the future of the ISLA refinery in Curaçao have not been published, whether SMOC's request for access can be accelerated, and whether the Dutch government will press Curaçao to prevent emissions and activate the guarantee function. The minister replies that health and environmental policy are Curaçao's responsibility, that the reports belong to the Curaçao government, that some reports have been made available to the Staten, and that the Netherlands stands ready to assist on concrete request but will not raise the matter in the Rijksministerraad.
However, it is the responsibility of Curaçao to shape the policy regarding the refinery.
Het is echter de verantwoordelijkheid van Curaçao om het beleid aangaande de raffinaderij vorm te geven.
Antwoord vragen Ten Broeke en Van Ojik over de arrestatie van vier Nederlandse documentairemakers in Moermansk op verdenking van 'homopropaganda'

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about the arrest in Murmansk of four Dutch documentary makers on suspicion of 'homopropaganda', and whether they could leave Russia and what the government would do about the law's effect on journalists. The minister answered that the group left Russia after paying small fines for a visa violation, the propaganda charge was dismissed on procedural grounds, and the government raised the matter with Russian authorities and the EU's High Representative, and will raise LGBT rights again at the next Foreign Affairs Council.
At the next discussion of developments in Russia in the Council, the Netherlands will again raise attention to LGBT rights in that country, partly in response to this matter.
Nederland zal bij de eerstvolgende bespreking van ontwikkelingen in Rusland in de Raad opnieuw aandacht vragen voor LHBT-rechten in dat land, mede naar aanleiding van deze kwestie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon, Van Ojik, Omtzigt en Van Bommel over de nieuwe NGO-wet in Egypte

Six MPs asked the foreign minister whether Egypt's draft NGO law, despite amendments, still violates freedoms of expression and assembly, threatens human rights work and civil society, and whether the Netherlands has raised objections. The minister agreed the draft appears to conflict with Egypt's international obligations, said the Netherlands and the EU have raised concerns bilaterally and in multilateral fora, and noted the law is not yet adopted, with the EU to raise it if adopted.
Should a restrictive proposal nonetheless become law, I will raise it as soon as possible within the EU framework.
Mocht een restrictief voorstel toch wet worden dan zal ik dat zo spoedig mogelijk in EU-verband aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ojik en Klaver over Investeringen vanuit Nederland in Afrika

MPs Van Ojik and Klaver asked why around 62 percent of Dutch-channelled investment in Africa comes from foreign multinationals using Dutch holdings, and whether treaty shopping under Dutch tax treaties with African countries costs developing countries revenue and will be curbed. The minister answers that Dutch treaties reduce withholding taxes, that the tax law does not distinguish 'real Dutch' companies from foreign multinationals, that revenue losses are hard to estimate, and that anti-abuse clauses and OECD BEPS work will be used.
Where desired, the Netherlands includes anti-abuse clauses in new treaties and is also willing to extend existing treaties with anti-abuse clauses where unintended use of the treaty is found.

Nederland neemt in nieuwe verdragen desgewenst anti-misbruik clausules op en is ook bereid bestaande verdragen bij gebleken onbedoeld gebruik van het verdrag uit te breiden met anti-misbruik clausules.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Bonis, Van Bommel, Voordewind, Van Ojik over het rapport "Detainee Treatment"

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister about the 2013 Constitution Project report on US detainee treatment at Guantanamo, including torture allegations, indefinite detention without trial, and medical personnel involvement. The minister called the allegations worrying, said the US must determine whether torture occurred, and reiterated that Guantanamo should close, without committing to a new concrete step beyond continued diplomatic contacts.

It is now up to the American authorities to determine, in light of the Constitution Project report, whether torture and inhuman treatment within the meaning of the aforementioned conventions has indeed occurred.

Antwoord 3 Het is nu aan de Amerikaanse autoriteiten om, gezien het rapport van het Constitution Project , vast te stellen of inderdaad sprake is van foltering en onmenselijke behandeling in de zin van bovengenoemde verdragen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis en Ten Broeke over de detentie van Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi-Arabië

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister whether the four-month detention of human rights activist Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi Arabia was justified, whether the government agrees with Amnesty International that he is a prisoner of conscience, and whether it will urge Saudi Arabia to release him. The minister answered that the EU is investigating the background of the arrest with Saudi bodies, that EU action will depend on the outcome, and that the Netherlands generally raises human rights defender issues with Saudi authorities.
Depending on the outcome of the investigation, the EU will consider whether, and if so what, action is effective and desirable.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek zal in EU-verband worden bezien of, en zo ja welke, actie effectief en wenselijk is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de Pride-evenementen in Moldavië en Oekraïne

MP Van Ojik asked the foreign minister whether he knows of Pride events in Moldova and Ukraine, whether a safe Pride is a benchmark for anti-discrimination, when visa facilitation will be decided and whether the government will signal to those governments, and what further action it will take to support Pride. The minister confirmed the events and said visa liberalisation depends on anti-discrimination laws and minority protection in the action plans, that the EU has raised concerns and the embassies actively support Pride activities.
The Netherlands will work to ensure the EU continues to press both countries on the importance of protecting and respecting the rights of (sexual) minorities.
Nederland zal zich ervoor inzetten dat de EU beide landen blijft aanspreken op het belang van de bescherming en naleving van de rechten van (seksuele) minderheden.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Bonis, Omtzigt, Ten Broeke, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Van der Staaij en Van Ojik over de ontvoering van twee Syrische bisschoppen

MPs from eight parties asked the foreign minister whether the government knew of the abduction of two Syrian bishops, whether their driver was killed, and whether the Netherlands would seek mediation with the parties to the conflict. The minister confirmed awareness, declined to give details on the circumstances or the bishops' status, and said the Netherlands is working with EU partners and the Syrian opposition to secure their release and promised to inform the House.

Regarding the precise circumstances of the abduction of Bishop Boulos Yazigi and Bishop Yohanna Ibrahim and the specific question of whether their driver was killed, it is not possible to provide further information.

Over de precieze omstandigheden van de ontvoering van bisschop Boulos Yazigi en bisschop Yohanna Ibrahim en de concrete vraag of hun chauffeur hierbij is gedood is het niet mogelijk nadere inlichtingen te verschaffen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Klaver over mogelijke belastingontwijking door leden van het Koninklijk Huis

MPs Van Ojik and Klaver asked the Prime Minister and State Secretary of Finance about possible tax avoidance by members of the Royal House, including how their structure compares to Princess Christina's, and whether they should be taxed like ordinary citizens. The government answered that royals are subject to the same legal privacy protections in tax matters as other taxpayers, that no change is needed, and that press reports do not alter this.
With regard to the legal protection of personal privacy connected to taxation, members of the Royal House do not differ from other taxpayers.
Ten aanzien van de met belastingheffing verbonden wettelijke bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer verschillen leden van het koninklijk huis niet van andere belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de introductie van separate buslijnen voor joodse Israeli's en Palestijnen

An MP asked the foreign minister about Israel's introduction of separate bus lines for Palestinians and Jewish Israelis in the occupied territories, including incidents at checkpoints and whether this violates equal treatment and mobility rights. The minister said the government will hold Israel to its commitment that existing lines remain open to Palestinians, will monitor the situation critically, and will press bilaterally and in the EU for changes if unequal treatment or restricted mobility is confirmed.

Should it turn out that the new bus lines, contrary to Israel's commitment, lead to unequal treatment or restriction of the Palestinian population's freedom of movement, the Netherlands will argue bilaterally and within the EU that this system be adjusted.

Mocht blijken dat de nieuwe buslijnen – in strijd met de toezegging door Israël – leiden tot ongelijke behandeling, dan wel inperking van de bewegingsvrijheid van de Palestijnse bevolking, dan zal Nederland bilateraal en in EU-verband ervoor pleiten dat dit systeem wordt aangepast.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bonis, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over Palestijnse gevangenen in Israëlische detentie

MPs Bonis, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma and Van Ojik asked the foreign minister about Palestinian detainees Samer Issawi and Ayman Sharawneh in Israeli custody, including administrative detention, alleged mistreatment and the death of Arafat Jaradat. The minister replied that there is no administrative detention in these cases, that the Netherlands and the EU monitor the situation and raised it with Israel, and that an independent inquiry into Jaradat's death should follow with findings made public.
There is no question of administrative detention.
Er is geen sprake van administratieve detentie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haersma Buma, Pechtold, Slob, Van Ojik en Van der Staaij over de gevolgen van het akkoord voor de ontwikkeling van het (structurele) EMU-saldo en de staatsschuld in de periode 2014-201

MPs from CDA, D66, ChristenUnie, GroenLinks and SGP asked the government how the social accord affects the structural EMU balance, debt, the 3% deficit target, and the WW premium changes. The minister replied that the accord causes a shortfall of 119 million structurally and up to 543 million in 2017, that the government abandons the 4.3 billion supplementary package but will take further measures if the CPB forecast requires it, and that a CPB analysis of structural effects will come with the June forecast.
The cabinet will take additional measures if the CPB's MEV forecast, given the 2014 balance target, gives reason to do so.
Het kabinet zal aanvullende maatregelen nemen indien de MEV-raming van het CPB gegeven het saldodoel 2014 daartoe aanleiding geeft.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik en Krol over dodelijke aanvallen op Hazara’s in Pakistan

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister about deadly attacks on Hazara Shia communities in Pakistan, including whether perpetrators have been prosecuted and whether Pakistan should investigate independently. The minister confirmed the attacks, attributed most to Lashkar-e-Jhangvi, said Pakistan pledges to pursue perpetrators while noting recent arrests, and said the Netherlands and EU raise the issue of minorities bilaterally and multilaterally.
The Netherlands regularly raises the issue of the position of (religious) minorities in Pakistan in bilateral and multilateral contacts.
Nederland stelt de kwestie rondom de positie van (religieuze) minderheden in Pakistan geregeld in bilaterale en multilaterale contacten aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Bonis over persvrijheid in Israël en ‘Palestina’

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about press freedom in Israel and the Palestinian territories after Reporters without Borders ranked them low, and about the causes and any Dutch response. The minister acknowledged the concern, cited arrests and military actions against journalists, said human rights are raised bilaterally and in the EU, and that the government has no contacts with Hamas but raises press freedom with journalists in Gaza.
The way in which the deepening of bilateral relations is to take shape is currently being studied. The House will be informed about this later.
Op dit moment wordt bestudeerd hoe de verdieping van de bilaterale relaties gestalte moet krijgen. Daarover wordt de Kamer later geïnformeerd.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Bonis, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en Agnes Mulder over seksueel geweld tegen vrouwen in India en beperkingen voor mensenrechtenorganisaties

Seven MPs asked the foreign minister about sexual violence against women and Dalit women in India and Indian restrictions on NGOs, including a Dutch human rights prize winner's trial and blacklisting of NGOs and donors. The minister said the Netherlands supports the European Parliament resolution, funds Indian women's NGOs, respects the Indian legal process while staying in contact with the prize winner, and that the Indian NGO rules are being monitored through EU channels.
I will keep you informed of relevant developments.
Ik zal u op de hoogte houden van relevante ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Maij en Jan Vos over de Nederlandse inzet aangaande financiële transparantie in de grondstoffensector

MPs Van Ojik, Maij and Jan Vos asked the minister whether Dutch policy supports EU rules on financial transparency in the extractive sector, including whether a carve-out for countries with secrecy laws should be allowed. The minister answered that the Dutch government supports the EU transparency directive, opposes any carve-out, and notes that no such exception exists in US Dodd-Frank rules.
The cabinet considers an exception clause undesirable, partly because regimes could otherwise use a reporting ban or confidentiality obligations to evade European transparency provisions.

Het kabinet acht een uitzonderingsclausule niet wenselijk, mede met het oog op de mogelijkheid voor regimes om met een verbod op rapportage of met geheimhoudingsverplichtingen te ontkomen aan Europese transparantiebepalingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Arib over de voorgenomen uitzetting van een Oeigoerse asielzoeker naar China

MPs Van Ojik and Arib asked whether a planned deportation of a Uyghur asylum seeker to China, halted by the Council of State, would be cancelled, whether his risks were re-examined, and whether Dutch policy on deporting Uyghurs to China would be reviewed in light of NGO warnings. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case for privacy reasons, said the country report on China is under review and that the government will inform parliament shortly.
Given the privacy interest of the foreign national concerned and the fact that his case is before the court, I will not go further into this individual case.
Met het oog op het belang van de privacy van de betrokken vreemdeling en gezien het feit dat zijn zaak onder de rechter is, ga ik niet verder in op deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Ojik en Gesthuizen over kinderarbeid in de katoensector in Turkije

MPs Voordewind, Van Ojik and Gesthuizen asked the ministers about child labour in Turkey's cotton sector, including unconditioned state price-support subsidies and Dutch clothing retailers selling products made with child labour. Minister Ploumen answered that Turkey is primarily responsible, that she raised ILO cooperation with Turkish authorities, and that she will support a textile-sector action plan on supply-chain transparency and ending child labour, expected mid-2013.
I am willing to play an active role in supporting the textile sector in fulfilling its supply-chain responsibility.
Ik ben bereid een actieve rol te spelen om de textielsector te ondersteunen bij het invullen van hun ketenverantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw c.s. over de zaak Van Rey - Weekers

Opposition and coalition MPs ask the State Secretary for Finance about the Van Rey–Weekers affair: a billboard donation, the sale of a tax office and a tax request involving real estate. They press on the nature and financing of the donation, contacts about closing tax offices, and handling of a personal tax request. The item is a bundle of written questions; the answers are not included in the text provided.
Have you verified that the donation was indeed made only by Mr Van Rey and, as agreed, processed via the regional campaign fund? Can you make the accounts public?

Heeft u zich ervan vergewist dat de donatie inderdaad alleen door de heer Van Rey is gedaan en, zoals afgesproken, via de regionale campagnekas is afgehandeld? Kunt u de rekeningen hiervan openbaar maken?
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Thieme, Gesthuizen, Krol, Maij, Mulder en Van Ojik over kinderarbeid bij de productie van schoenen door grote ketens

MPs asked the government whether shoe companies using child labour in their supply chains should be held to account, excluded from state support and trade missions, and whether embassies and public procurement could be used to address it. The minister answered that due diligence duties under the OECD guidelines apply, that no shoe companies receive state support or joined trade missions, and that embassies raise labour standards where possible, while procurement social conditions already apply.
No, there are no shoe companies currently receiving government support or having previously joined trade missions.
Nee, er zijn geen schoenenbedrijven die momenteel overheidssteun ontvangen of in het verleden mee zijn geweest met handelsmissies.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van Tongeren over Eritrese praktijken

MPs Van Ojik and Van Tongeren asked about Eritrean consulate practices of taxing diaspora Dutch nationals with threats of withheld services, and whether international law and UN Security Council resolution 1907 were breached.
