The minister says extraterritorial taxation is not itself contrary to the Vienna Conventions, extortion is unacceptable and existing law suffices, that no further investigation of the arms embargo question is needed now, and that complaints depend on victims filing reports, with anonymity only conditionally possible.
Once a report has been filed, the police under the direction of the Public Prosecution Service will investigate it.
Zodra er aangifte is gedaan zal de politie onder leiding van het OM daar onderzoek naar doen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Dam, Van Ojik, Schouw, Gesthuizen en Thieme over vrijheidsbeperking

Six MPs asked the minister for Immigration, Integration and Asylum whether a Hague court ruling requiring individual proportionality for restricting the liberty of rejected asylum-seeking families with children should lead to halting transfers to family locations and to a rethink of shelter provided under liberty restrictions after a Supreme Court ruling on children's rights. The minister replied that the ruling concerns one case with a lack of reasoning and draws no general conclusions, that transfers are handled with care pending government formation, and that the Supreme Court ruling does not conflict with the liberty-restriction measure, which serves public order and availability for departure.
In this individual case the court concluded that insufficient reasons were given for imposing a liberty-restricting measure.
In deze individuele zaak is door de rechter geconcludeerd dat onvoldoende was gemotiveerd waarom een vrijheidsbeperkende maatregel is opgelegd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Voordewind, Van Dam, Van Ojik, en Schouw over het uitzetten van vreemdelingen naar Guinee

MPs asked the Minister for Immigration whether deportations of rejected asylum seekers to Guinea rely on corrupt authorities, how travel-document delegations and payments work, and whether a specific mother and children case and related investigations will be addressed. The minister answered that cooperation is necessary but structured via MoUs and delegations from Guinean ministries, that payments follow standard return practice, and that deportations will not be suspended, with the family case to be reported by end 2012.
Your House will be informed further about the family concerned before the end of 2012.
Uw Kamer wordt over het betreffende gezin voor het eind van 2012 nader geïnformeerd.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Smeulders ter vervanging van nr. 52 over toetsing door de huurcommissie bij geliberaliseerde huurovereenkomsten
Extends the low-threshold dispute resolution of the Huurcommissie to tenants in liberalised rental contracts by removing the difference with the regulated segment.
Therefore this amendment provides that the difference in dispute resolution between the regulated and liberalised segments is abolished.
Daarom wordt met dit amendement geregeld dat het verschil tussen geschillenbeslechting tussen het gereguleerde en geliberaliseerde segment wordt opgeheven.
Motie van de leden Dik-Faber en Smeulders over een energieloket in elke gemeente
Asks the government to give every municipality an energy desk for insulation questions and to implement the earlier Segers/Klaver insulation programme with funding.
requests the government to ensure every municipality gets an energy desk
verzoekt de regering, om ervoor zorg te dragen dat elke gemeente een energieloket krijgt
Motie van de leden Smeulders en Van Eijs over een nationaal plan voor de transformatie van bedrijfsruimten naar woningen
Motion asks the government to draw up a national plan for converting vacant office, shop and business premises into housing and to inform the House soon.
requests the government to draw up a national transformation plan
verzoekt de regering, een nationaal transformatieplan op te stellen
Amendement van het lid Smeulders over toetsing door de huurcommissie bij geliberaliseerde huurovereenkomsten
Extends rent tribunal (huurcommissie) dispute resolution to liberalised rental contracts by removing the distinction for those contracts.
Therefore this amendment provides that the difference in dispute resolution between the regulated and liberalised segments is removed.
Daarom wordt met dit amendement geregeld dat het verschil tussen geschillenbeslechting tussen het gereguleerde en geliberaliseerde segment wordt opgeheven.
Amendement van het lid Smeulders over het niet automatisch aflopen van tijdelijke huurcontracten
Ends the automatic expiry of fixed-term rental contracts for regular housing by restoring the old rule in the Civil Code.
a fixed-term rental agreement that does not expire automatically, as applied before the Wet doorstroming huurmarkt 2015 took effect
een huurovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd die niet automatisch afloopt zoals gold voor inwerkingtreding van de Wet doorstroming huurmarkt 2015 wordt aangegaan
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Smeulders ter vervanging van nr. 30 over het verhogen van de vrije toewijzingsruimte
Amendment setting the free allocation room for social housing allocation at a fixed 85 percent instead of a variable percentage.
the first paragraph's 92.5 percent or the lower agreed percentage not below 85 is replaced by 85 percent
wordt in het eerste lid «92,5% dan wel het in de afspraken, bedoeld in artikel 44, eerste lid, overeengekomen lagere percentage, dat niet lager is dan 85,» vervangen door «85%».
Amendement van het lid Nijboer c.s. over het afschaffen van de verhuurderheffing en de BIK
Amendment abolishes the rental levy on social landlords from 2022 and repeals the employment-related investment discount, funding the change by cutting the BIK and freezing rents.
This amendment aims to abolish the rental levy from 2022
Dit amendement beoogt de verhuurderheffing met ingang van 2022 af te schaffen
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Smeulders ter vervanging van nr. 31 over het afschaffen van de indicatieve bestedingsruimte
Abolishes the indicative spending room for housing associations from the Housing Act.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Smeulders ter vervanging van nr. 24 over verduurzaming als wettelijke kerntaak
Makes sustainability of social housing, including renewable energy generation, a statutory core task of housing associations alongside the existing one.
The submitter is of the view that making the housing stock sustainable is a core task of housing associations
Indiener is van mening dat het verduurzamen van de woningvoorraad een kerntaak van toegelaten instellingen is
Amendement van het lid Smeulders over het verlengen van de termijn voor uitspraak huurcommissie
Extends from six months to one year the period tenants have to ask the rent commission to review rent in liberalised housing.
Amendement van het lid Smeulders over het afschaffen van de indicatieve bestedingsruimte
Abolishes the indicative spending room for housing corporations, which the amendment says wrongly keeps them from subsidies.
With this amendment the submitter wishes to abolish the indicative spending room of housing corporations
Met dit amendement wil indiener de indicatieve bestedingsruimte woningcorporaties afschaffen.
Amendement van het lid Smeulders over het verhogen van de vrije toewijzingsruimte
Changes the free allocation share of social housing allocations from 90% to 85%, which the explanation describes as raising the free allocation space.
In article I, part BB, under 1, in the first paragraph '90%' is replaced by '85%'.
In artikel I, onderdeel BB, onder 1, wordt in het eerste lid «90%» vervangen door «85%».
Amendement van het lid Smeulders over het verhuren van middenhuurwoningen als wettelijke kerntaak
Amends the housing act to make renting middle-income homes by housing associations a statutory core task.
To safeguard the importance of the role of approved institutions the submitter proposes making this a statutory core task.
Om het belang van de rol van toegelaten instellingen te borgen stelt indiener voor hiervan een wettelijke kerntaak te maken.
Amendement van het lid Smeulders over verduurzaming als wettelijke kerntaak
Makes improving the energy performance of rental housing, including renewable generation, a legal core task of housing associations.
The submitter believes that making the housing stock sustainable is a core task of housing associations.
Indiener is van mening dat het verduurzamen van de woningvoorraad een kerntaak van toegelaten instellingen is
Motie van het lid Beckerman c.s. over een zelfbewoningsplicht voor bestaande koopwoningen
Asks the government to allow municipalities to introduce a self-occupancy obligation for existing owner-occupied homes.
requests the government to give municipalities the possibility to introduce a self-occupancy obligation for existing owner-occupied homes
verzoekt de regering, om gemeenten de mogelijkheid te geven om een zelfbewoningsplicht in te voeren voor bestaande koopwoningen
Motie van het lid Beckerman c.s. over de huurprijzen in de sociale sector bevriezen
Asks the government to freeze rents in the social rental sector for this year after a 2.7% rise for housing corporation tenants.
to freeze rents in the social rental sector this year
om de huurprijzen in de sociale huursector dit jaar te bevriezen
Motie van het lid Kuiken c.s. over de flexibilisering van de huurcontracten een halt toeroepen
Asks the cabinet to halt the flexibilisation of rental contracts, limiting temporary leases to groups such as students and temporary migrant workers.
requests the cabinet to halt the flexibilisation of rental contracts
verzoekt het kabinet, de flexibilisering van de huurcontracten een halt toe te roepen
Motie van het lid Smeulders c.s. over huurprijsbescherming in de vrije huursector via het woningwaarderingsstelsel
Asks the government to prepare allowing rent-price protection under the points-based rent system in part of the free rental sector.
requests the government to prepare a decision to make rent price protection via the points system possible in the free rental sector
verzoekt de regering, om voorbereidingen te treffen voor een besluit om de huurprijsbescherming via het woningwaarderingsstelsel in de vrije huursector mogelijk te maken
Motie van de leden Van Weyenberg en Smeulders over steun voor initiatieven om vitaal thuis te werken
Asks the government to support and fund, with 5 million euro and in consultation with social partners, initiatives to help workers work from home in a vital way.
requests the government to stimulate and support initiatives for vital home working in consultation with social partners, and to make 5 million available for this
verzoekt de regering, initiatieven om vitaal thuis te werken in overleg met sociale partners te stimuleren en te ondersteunen, en hiervoor 5 miljoen vrij te maken
Motie van de leden Smeulders en Aartsen over huurverlaging voor bedrijven die zijn gesloten vanwege coronamaatregelen
Asks the government to strengthen tenants' legal position so rents can be lowered for businesses closed by COVID measures, and to broker a rent-reduction agreement with landlords and banks.
requests the government to come quickly with proposals to strengthen the legal position of tenants
verzoekt de regering, om op korte termijn met voorstellen te komen om de juridische positie van huurders te versterken
Motie van de leden Smeulders en Van Weyenberg over een coronaverlofregeling voor werkende ouders

Asks the government to inform the Chamber about explored options for a corona leave scheme for working parents and, if school closures extend, to make a final attempt with social partners to create one.
requests the government to inform the Chamber about options already explored regarding corona leave
verzoekt de regering, de Kamer te informeren over reeds verkende opties met betrekking tot coronaverlof
Motie van het lid Van Kent c.s. over sectorspecifieke voorstellen om ondernemers te compenseren
Asks the government to map gaps in the support package and quickly send sector-specific compensation proposals for entrepreneurs such as travel agencies and driving instructors.
requests the government to map the gaps in the current support package and urgently send sector-specific proposals to the House
verzoekt de regering, om de hiaten binnen het huidige steunpakket in kaart te brengen en met spoed sectorspecifieke voorstellen aan de Kamer te zenden
Motie van het lid Smeulders over een mentaal steunpakket
Asks the government to set up a mental support package alongside the economic package, including low-threshold access to coaching.
requests the government, alongside the economic support package, together with social partners also to set up a mental support package
verzoekt de regering, om, naast het economisch steunpakket, in samenwerking met sociale partners ook een mentaal steunpakket op te zetten
Motie van het lid Van Kent c.s. over de partnertoets bij de Tozo-regeling laten vervallen
Asks the government to drop the partner means test in the Tozo income support scheme.
requests the government to drop the partner test in the Tozo scheme
verzoekt de regering, de partnertoets bij de Tozo-regeling te laten vervallen
Motie van het lid Van Kent c.s. over vastgestelde termijnen voor re-integratietrajecten waar nodig verlengen
Asks the government to review ongoing re-integration trajectories with agreed deadlines and extend them where necessary because of the lockdown.
to review all ongoing trajectories with an agreed deadline and extend them where necessary
alle lopende trajecten waarbij een vastgestelde termijn is afgesproken tegen het licht te houden en waar nodig te verlengen
Motie van het lid Van Weyenberg c.s. over de TONK breed onder de aandacht brengen bij ondernemers
Asks the government to promote the TONK income support widely among entrepreneurs, avoid a means test in the municipal guidance, monitor implementation and inform the House regularly.
requests the government to closely monitor the implementation of the TONK and to inform the House regularly about it
verzoekt de regering, voorts de uitvoering van de TONK nauwgezet te monitoren, en de Kamer hierover regelmatig te informeren
Amendement van het lid Smeulders over het volledig doorbetalen van ouderschapsverlof
Amends the parental leave bill so that parents are paid full daily wage instead of 50 percent during parental leave.
In the seventh paragraph, '50%' is replaced by '100%'.
In het zevende lid wordt «50%» vervangen door «100%».
Motie van de leden Smeulders en Beckerman over een zelfbewoningsplicht
Asks the government to develop an owner-occupancy obligation to counter vacant housing.
requests the government to develop an owner-occupation obligation

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Smeulders over de onderbetaling van medewerkers bij de Coronacallcenters

MPs Smeulders and Kröger asked why the government again contracted Teleperformance for the corona callcenters, whether working conditions and pension accrual were tender criteria, and whether the government would intervene on underpayment and pensions. The minister replied that GGD GHOR chose Teleperformance because no other party could deliver in time, that the contract required compliance with labour law and any applicable CAO, and that the government is not the formal employer so it will not intervene or meet Teleperformance.
As far as I am aware, there are no signals that Teleperformance does not comply with the applicable laws and regulations or fails to apply any applicable CAO.
Voor zover mij bekend zijn er geen signalen dat Teleperformance niet voldoet aan de geldende wet-en regelgeving en een eventueel geldende cao niet toepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het IMVB-convenant Pensioenfondsen

An MP asked the ministers about the slow implementation of the IMVB pension fund covenant, including the monitoring commission's findings, passive investments and accountability. The minister acknowledged the shortfall, attributed it partly to the late toolkit, promised an action plan and enhanced support, and said the covenant has no legal consequences.
Failing to meet the agreed commitments has no legal consequences.
Het niet halen van vastgelegde afspraken heeft geen juridische consequenties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Bromet over het stopzetten van huurtoeslag wegens geboorte kind

MPs Smeulders and Bromet asked the ministers why a Belastingdienst benefit (huurtoeslag) was stopped because a newborn lacked legal residence status, and sought details on frequency, legal basis, and planned changes. The government answered that a birth alone is not grounds to stop the allowance, that stoppage occurs only after four months without a residence application, that the case was resolved, and that it is exploring rule changes such as raising the age threshold to 18.
I cannot go into the specific circumstances of an individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de specifieke omstandigheden van een individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het bericht ‘Particuliere woningverhuur groeit ondanks alles gestaag door’

MP Smeulders (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Interior about a report that private rental housing keeps growing, including investor purchases, by-to-let mortgages, the transfer tax increase for investors, and possible bans or municipal self-occupancy requirements. The minister answered in detail with Kadaster data, but declined to give a full count of by-to-let mortgages and argued a ban would likely fail EU law tests, while pointing to the transfer tax differentiation and an evaluation planned for 2024-2025.
I have no insight into how often rental mortgages are granted.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoe vaak verhuurhypotheken verstrekt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Tielen over NL Leert Door

MPs Smeulders and Tielen asked why the NL Leert Door development-advice scheme filled almost 50,000 applications within a day of reopening, what criteria and follow-up data exist, and how to avoid a gap in provision. Minister Koolmees answered that demand is high, an effect evaluation starts in 2021, budget covers 77,000 trajectories, and alternative routes (SLIM, sectoral schemes, a structural scheme from 2022) will fill gaps.
During 2021 an effect evaluation will be started to determine the effects, efficiency and effectiveness of the various measures in the NL Leert Door package.

In de loop van 2021 zal er een effectevaluatie worden gestart om in beeld te brengen wat de effecten, doelmatigheid en doeltreffendheid van de verschillende maatregelen uit het pakket NL leert door zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Smeulders en Buitenweg over Coronatestlijn

MPs from GroenLinks asked the ministers about reports that staff of the coronavirus testing helpline could access personal data beyond what their tasks required, about WhatsApp data sharing, training, outsourcing to Teleperformance, unpaid hours and working conditions. The government answered that access is necessary for the job, that logging and confidentiality agreements safeguard privacy, that GGD-GHOR is responsible, and that labour conditions are for employers and social partners, with the Inspectie SZW available for complaints.
Care in handling personal data is of course of great importance.
Zorgvuldigheid is bij het omgaan met persoonsgegevens uiteraard van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen vande leden Smeulders en Bromet over het bericht ‘Coronaregels overtreden maar Van Rooi Meat krijgt geen straf: gemeenteraad wil opheldering’

MPs Smeulders and Bromet asked why the safety region did not sanction Van Rooi Meat for exceeding COVID-19 staffing limits, whether the Labour Inspectorate was involved, and whether slaughterhouses are treated leniently. The minister answered that the company received a warning rather than a sanction because it had not reported the actual number of workers, that the Labour Inspectorate made an unannounced visit and found no irregularities in Helmond, and that a national cooperation platform was set up in September 2020.

The chair of the safety region weighed the matter and decided to give the company a warning and impose no sanction for failing to report in advance the actual number of persons present at the inspection.

De voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio heeft een afweging gemaakt en besloten het bedrijf een waarschuwing te geven en geen sanctie op te leggen voor het feit dat er vooraf geen melding is gemaakt van het daadwerkelijk bij de controle aanwezige aantal personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Smeulders en Nijboer over huisuitzettingen in de tweede coronagolf

MPs Beckerman, Smeulders and Nijboer asked the Minister of Interior about evictions of antikraak residents during the second COVID wave, a possible ban on evictions, a rehousing guarantee, and renewed agreements with landlords. The Minister said a general eviction ban is not desirable, that courts should weigh individual cases, that a case was resolved by alternative housing, and that the earlier agreements remain in force with some landlord associations and municipalities.
A general ban on evictions is not considered desirable by the cabinet.
Een algeheel verbod op huisuitzettingen acht het kabinet niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over het bericht ‘Verontwaardiging over voorkeur minister Ollongren voor windmolens op zee’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether her reported preference for offshore rather than onshore wind and solar was at odds with the Climate Agreement, which requires at least 35 TWh of onshore renewables. The minister denied contradicting the Climate Agreement, affirmed onshore wind and solar are needed, and stressed regional RES planning and public support.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het bericht dat het maximum aantal ontwikkeladviezen is bereikt

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why the maximum of 22,000 development advice trajectories under NL leert door was reached so quickly, whether the budget will be increased and the portal reopened, and what the capacity problems are. The minister explains the demand was underestimated, announces extra funding for 2021 (about 50,000 advice trajectories, EUR 37 million) and reopening of the portal on 1 December, while stating the agency UVB lacks capacity to process more applications now.
That is why the cabinet has decided to make additional funds available for development advice in 2021.
Daarom heeft het kabinet besloten om voor 2021 extra middelen beschikbaar te stellen voor ontwikkeladviezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Bromet over de berichten 'Coronabesmettingen bij VION in Boxtel nog altijd aan de orde van de dag'

MPs Smeulders and Bromet asked whether the ongoing COVID-19 infections at the Vion slaughterhouse in Boxtel, and the company's claim that its workplace is safe, warrant closure in light of a parliamentary motion. The Staatssecretaris replied that closure decisions lie with the regional safety board chair on GGD advice, that the plant resumed production on 2 June with extensive measures, and that a national coordination platform is being set up, while stating no signals currently show the measures are ineffective.
The chairs of the safety regions are, under the Public Health Act, the Safety Regions Act and emergency ordinances, the competent authority to take measures at regional level.

De voorzitters van de veiligheidsregio's zijn op basis van de Wet publieke gezondheid, de Wet op de Veiligheidsregio's en Noodverordeningen het bevoegd gezag in deze om op regionaal niveau maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Smeulders over veilig werken in tijden van corona

MPs Renkema and Smeulders asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about unsafe working conditions during the coronavirus pandemic, including workers' numbers, the Inspectorate's enforcement, the legal basis for enforcing corona rules, and the status of sector protocols. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate receives many complaints and resumed on-site inspections under conditions, that enforcement of emergency ordinances lies mainly with safety regions, and that legislation to strengthen the Inspectorate's powers is being prepared.
However, I can report that up to and including 29 May, 1,586 corona-related reports were made to the Inspectorate SZW.
Wel kan ik melden dat tot en met 29 mei jl. 1.586 corona gerelateerde meldingen bij de Inspectie SZW zijn gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Smeulders en Beckerman over het tijdelijk bevriezen van huurprijzen

MPs Nijboer, Smeulders and Beckerman asked how the minister will implement the Senate motion to temporarily freeze rents in both the free and social sectors, and whether housing corporations should be compensated for lost rent. The minister answered that a general freeze is not proportionate or timely, relies on case-by-case maatwerk, a complaints desk at the Huurcommissie, monitoring, and a decision in August, and will table a separate bill on temporary rent reductions.
Capping or generally postponing the rent increases customarily applied on 1 July does not reflect proper governance, for two reasons.
Het nu maximeren of generiek uitstellen van de huurverhogingen die gebruikelijk plaats vindt op 1 juli getuigt niet van behoorlijk bestuur, vanwege twee redenen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het niet (tijdig) huur kunnen betalen door de coronacrisis

MPs Smeulders (GroenLinks) asked the Minister for Environment and Housing about tenants unable to pay rent during the COVID-19 crisis, including a ban on evictions and automatic extension of temporary leases. The minister answered that evictions are postponed by agreement and courts treat them as non-urgent, a legal ban is not possible or desirable under current law, and a bill allowing temporary leases to be extended on request has been submitted.
Under current legislation it is legally not possible to prohibit this at this moment.
Op basis van de huidige wetgeving is het juridisch niet mogelijk om dit op dit moment te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema, Smeulders, Westerveld en Özütok over het coronavirus (COVID-19)

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about its whole-of-government approach to COVID-19, equipment and ICU capacity, school decisions, Caribbean Netherlands coordination, economic measures like part-time unemployment benefit, accessibility of public communication, and intensified publicity. The minister answered that broad measures are in place, outlined capacity expansions and procurement steps, and committed to letters on decision-making and a school decision framework.
During the debate of Thursday 5 March I committed to inform you about this by letter.
Ik heb tijdens het debat van donderdag 5 maart toegezegd u hierover per brief te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Snels over de bedreiging van de publieke taak van woningcorporaties

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the housing minister whether falling net cash flow at housing associations threatens their public task, citing unrealised property value gains, weak new building, the ATAD1 tax effects and the call to move dead capital to social housing. The minister confirmed most premises, said the lower cash flow is substantial but financial ratios remain sufficient, blamed the cause only partly on factors outside associations' control, and pointed to pending studies and a stronger binding nature for local performance agreements.
I will consult with VNG and Aedes on how this starting point can concretely take shape.
Ik ga in overleg met VNG en Aedes bezien hoe dit uitgangspunt concreet vorm kan krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het artikel 'Hoe Airbnb toch weer aan het langste eind trekt'

An MP asked the Minister for Environment and Housing about a newspaper report on Airbnb's influence over the bill regulating short-term rental platforms, including ministry contacts with platforms, the bill's aims and expected effects, and whether platforms can be held liable as in Paris and via EU law. The minister replied that platforms were consulted alongside municipalities, that a registration obligation and national registry were adopted after platform input, that municipalities gain sanction and information-enforcement powers, and that EU-level liability options will be explored, with the bill to be evaluated within five years.
In addition, the platforms have undertaken to prevent as far as possible that advertisements (offers) without a registration number are published on their websites.
Daarnaast hebben de platforms toegezegd zo veel mogelijk uit te sluiten dat er op hun websites advertenties (aanbiedingen) zonder registratienummer worden gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het bericht dat AirBnB moet worden gezien als informatieplatform

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Environment and Housing whether a CJEU ruling treating Airbnb as an information society service affects the Dutch short-term rental bill and municipalities' ability to regulate holiday rentals. The minister answered that the ruling does not affect the bill, which targets hosts rather than platforms, that municipalities can use registration duties, scraping and an obligation on platforms to cooperate, and that the government is pursuing EU-level measures.
Parallel to the process surrounding the bill, the cabinet is pursuing additional measures at European level.
Parallel aan het traject rond het wetsvoorstel zet het kabinet er in Europees verband op in om tot aanvullende maatregelen te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Diks en Van Ojik over de investeringen van Nederlandse pensioenfondsen in controversiële wapenhandel

MPs Smeulders, Diks and Van Ojik asked the government about a PAX report showing Dutch pension funds invest over 1 billion euros in arms companies supplying Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Egypt, and what the government can do about it. The minister answered that pension investment policy is for funds and supervisors (AFM, DNB), that arms export rules were tightened for Saudi Arabia and the UAE, and that compliance with the IMVB pension covenant is voluntary but monitored.
It is not my task to supervise the investment policy of pension funds. That is for the supervisors, the Authority for the Financial Markets (AFM) and De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).
Het is niet mijn taak om toezicht te houden op het beleggingsbeleid van pensioenfondsen. Dat is aan de toezichthouders Autoriteit Financiële Markt (AFM) en De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Diks en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Geheime diensten morren over nieuwe toezichthouder’

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the intelligence services are unhappy with the Toetsingscommissie Inzet Bevoegdheden (TIB), which authorises their special powers, over alleged assertive, detailed review and disputes about its scope and appeal rights. The minister acknowledges some disagreement on the scope of the TIB's legality review, says it is not a marginal review, and defers any change such as an appeal option to the evaluation of the Wiv 2017 starting in 2020.
As confirmed during the parliamentary treatment of the Wiv 2017, the TIB's review is not a marginal review.
Zoals tijdens de parlementaire behandeling van de Wiv 2017 is bevestigd, is de toets van de TIB géén marginale toets.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over de primaire energiefactor (PEF) voor elektriciteit

MPs Van der Lee and Smeulders asked whether a primary energy factor (PEF) of 1.45 for electricity is still realistic, given 2018 renewable shares of 7.4% and the need to align with the KEV forecast, and whether a low PEF misleads home buyers. The minister maintains 1.45 is realistic because renewable growth and coal reduction will bring the outcome in line, rejects revising the PEF to the KEV because it would delay near-zero-energy buildings, and says the PEF change was requested by the heat pump sector and the NEN committee.
No, that is not my intention.
Nee, dat is niet mijn voornemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de het lid Smeulders over het bericht ‘Perverse verhuurder stopt met hoogste bieder methode’

An MP asks whether the government considers the bidding-based rental of homes (highest bidder method) by a landlord in The Hague undesirable, whether it is legal, whether it will be banned, and whether similar cases occur. The minister answers that the method is not prohibited under freedom of contract but is undesirable as poor landlordship, notes both landlords have stopped, and says malicious landlords' excessive rents will be addressed with municipal instruments.
The method chosen here to have tenants bid against each other is not prohibited.
De methode die hier gekozen is om huurders tegen elkaar op te laten bieden is niet verboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Bromet over de rol van pensioenfondsen bij dierenwelzijn

MPs Smeulders and Bromet asked whether pension funds such as ABP, which invests in food companies allegedly failing animal welfare standards, should change their investment policy and how the government would respond. The minister replied that ABP invests about 1.7 billion euro in 17 such companies, found no known law violations, and that the government relies on the voluntary but monitored IMVB covenant and exploring greater member control over investments.
The IMVB covenant focuses on embedding the OECD guidelines and UN Guiding Principles in pension funds' policy.
Het IMVB-convenant richt zich op de inbedding van de OESO-richtlijnen en United Nations Guiding Principles (UNGP's) in het beleid van pensioenfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Özütok over het bericht ‘Wildgroei flexmakelaars baart zzp'ers zorgen’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that flex intermediaries are multiplying and may be used to shift risk and cut rates, and about the central government's own use of such intermediaries. The minister acknowledges misuse risks, says procurement emphasises quality over price, and says the government does not track how many people work via intermediaries, while promising further research into triangular relationships.
How many people per year work via flex intermediaries at the ministries cannot therefore be derived from these figures.
Hoeveel mensen per jaar via flexbemiddelaars bij de ministeries werken is derhalve niet uit deze cijfers af te leiden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over “het probleem dat in België wonende grensarbeiders die in Nederland werken, maar werkloos worden, tussen hun 65e levensjaar en hun AOW-leeftijd noch recht op WW-uitkering uit

Parliamentary questions by MP Smeulders ask whether cross-border workers living in Belgium who become unemployed in the Netherlands between age 65 and the AOW age receive neither Belgian unemployment benefit nor Dutch AOW, and whether the Netherlands must act under EU loyalty and free-movement case law. The minister acknowledges the gap caused by differing pension ages, says EU coordination leaves national systems in place, argues the Leyman-type case law does not directly apply, and will contact Belgium about the 15-year condition in its new rule.
My ministry will contact the relevant Belgian ministry to discuss this subject and the measure taken by the Belgian government.
Mijn ministerie zal contact zoeken met het betrokken Belgische ministerie om dit onderwerp en de door de Belgische regering getroffen maatregel te bespreken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Westerveld over het bericht 'Vijf stenen door de ramen bij journalist Willem Groeneveld van stadsblog Sikkom'

MPs Smeulders and Westerveld asked about the stone-throwing attack on journalist Willem Groeneveld, whether a landlord could be barred from the housing market if linked to it, what is being done to protect journalists, and how malicious landlords are targeted. The minister condemned threats against journalists, deferred on the landlord question until police and prosecutors finish, listed press-freedom and journalist-protection measures, and described pilots and ongoing work against bad landlords without committing to a keurmerk or mystery-guest checks.
Once the investigation is complete, I will consider whether further action on my part is desirable.
Na afronding van het onderzoek zal ik bekijken of verdere actie van mijn kant gewenst is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het bericht ‘Groot onderzoek naar Poolse WW-fraude in Helmond: ‘Voor zeker tonnen aan onterechte uitkeringen betaald’’

An MP asked the minister about a reported criminal investigation into Polish unemployment-benefit fraud in Helmond, including what was found in raided homes, recovery of benefits, the employers and agencies involved, and cross-border cooperation. The minister answered that the criminal investigation is ongoing, so details on findings, amounts and other cases cannot be disclosed, while explaining the detection process, that UWV will recover benefits after the investigation, and the European investigation order channels used to cooperate with Poland.
Regarding exactly what was found in the premises during the searches, I cannot make statements since it concerns an ongoing criminal investigation.
Over hetgeen tijdens doorzoekingen exact in de panden is aangetroffen, kan ik geen uitspraken doen aangezien het een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over zorgverlof voor ouders van kinderen met kanker

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether leave arrangements for parents of children with cancer should be expanded, given reports that many such parents call in sick because they cannot manage care leave. The minister acknowledged the difficulty but declined to widen statutory leave, pointing to existing options and promising a handbook for employers and engagement with social partners.
I understand the call for longer-lasting leave, but I am not considering an expansion of the leave possibilities.
Ik begrijp de oproep voor langer durend verlof, maar een uitbreiding van de verlofmogelijkheden heb ik niet in overweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het bericht ‘Vestia verkoopt 10.000 huizen in onder meer Westland en Pijnacker-Nootdorp’

An MP asks the Minister whether the planned sale of about 10,000 Vestia social rental homes in six municipalities should go only to other housing associations or sitting tenants, and whether approval can be withheld to protect rental stock. The Minister replies that the sale is planned to other housing associations under an approved sanation plan, that no buyer or approval request exists yet, that the Aw as supervisor would review any future sale, and provides 2017 sales figures by region.
Should this case change in the future, it will be assessed under the sales rules of the BTIV by the Aw, as independent supervisor.
Mocht deze casus in de toekomst wijzigen, dan zal deze conform de verkoopregels uit het BTIV worden beoordeeld door de Aw, als onafhankelijk toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Smeulders over de eerlijke betaling van kunstdocenten

MPs Ellemeet and Smeulders asked about fair pay, social security and working conditions for arts teachers, many of whom now work as self-employed freelancers, and about the state's role in arts education. The government answered that it facilitates the sector's labour market agenda and Fair Practice Code, points to planned statutory measures for self-employed workers, gives partial data on freelancers and insurance coverage, and says it will inform parliament about progress in the autumn.
I am aware that workers, and in particular self-employed workers, in the cultural sector often work under unfavourable conditions.
Ik ben me ervan bewust dat werkenden, en met name zelfstandigen, in de culturele sector vaak werken onder ongunstige voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Smeulders over "het bericht 'Rouwbegeleiding op het werk vaak onvoldoende'”

MPs Stoffer and Smeulders asked the government about reports that bereavement support at work is often inadequate, sick leave among the bereaved is higher than necessary, and there is no statutory right to bereavement leave. The minister answered that bereavement is individual and that a guidance handbook for employers will be developed, while arguing that a statutory right to bereavement leave is not appropriate and that the evidence cited is not representative.
A statutory right to bereavement leave is currently not on the agenda.
Een wettelijk recht op rouwverlof is nu niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Smeulders over gevolgen van de saneringsopdracht van corporatie Vestia voor huurders in Bergeijk

Two MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about negative effects of Vestia's remediation plan on tenants in Bergeijk, including maintenance backlogs, poor communication, reduction of social rental stock, and the Autoriteit Woningcorporaties' approval of commercial-branch separation. The Minister answered that operational maintenance is the corporation's responsibility with complaints to the Huurcommissie, that monitoring by WSW and the Aw finds no large-scale backlog, that sale of Vestia homes must be at market value, that a bestuurlijk regisseur has been appointed with advice expected mid-2019, and that financial recovery is weighed alongside housing interests.
The operational activities of a housing corporation fall under the responsibility of the corporation itself.
De operationele activiteiten van een corporatie vallen onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de corporatie zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het bericht ‘Tijdelijk huurcontract zit steeds meer huurder dwars’

An MP asks whether temporary rental contracts leave tenants vulnerable to landlords who avoid converting them to open-ended contracts, and whether rent regulation or more tenant protection is warranted. The minister defends the temporary-lease option for specific groups, says she doubts rent regulation would help, and promises a monitoring report on the use of temporary contracts before summer.
I will inform you before the summer, on the basis of this, about the use of these temporary rental agreements by landlords.
Ik zal u op basis hiervan vóór de zomer informeren over het gebruik van deze tijdelijke huurovereenkomsten door verhuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Nijboer en Ronnes over de huurcommissie

MPs Smeulders, Nijboer and Ronnes asked the Minister of the Interior about the Huurcommissie's backlog, including its budget, causes of longer processing times, regional complaint volumes, staffing, and when the backlog will be cleared. The minister answered that about EUR 4 million is reserved for 2019 and staffing is being expanded by about 10 FTE, that the 7,500-case target for 2019 carries risks, and that the backlog is expected to be cleared only in the course of 2021.
The Huurcommissie and I consider it important to clear the increased workload as quickly as possible and to normalise processing times.
De Huurcommissie en ik vinden het belangrijk om de toegenomen werkvoorraad zo snel mogelijk in te halen en de doorlooptijden te normaliseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het bericht ‘Bedrijfshal in een weiland is voor belegger bijna net zo mooi als een kantoor in Londen’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about the proliferation of large logistics warehouses in open landscape, requesting building statistics, zoning data, a possible open-space levy, and government action to concentrate development. The minister answered that spatial planning is decentralised, pointed to the ladder for sustainable urbanisation, the NOVI framework and a forthcoming landscape policy letter, and said data on warehouse construction is not currently monitored and a levy is under study.
Spatial planning of business parks is a decentralised task.
Ruimtelijke planning van bedrijventerreinen is een decentrale taak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Snels over het Eerlijk Pensioenlabel

MPs Smeulders and Snels asked ministers about the Eerlijk Pensioenlabel ranking of Dutch pension funds' sustainability policies, including the methodology, the poor grades, lagging disclosure, follow-up under the IMVB convenant, and whether climate reporting should be mandatory. The government defended the pension funds' own responsibility, pointed to the IMVB convenant and existing reporting duties, declined to assess the study's methodology, and said the sector would be given time to improve before any further regulation.
It is not for the government to assess the methodology of the research, nor to assess the outcomes of the research or come up with alternative grades.
Het is niet aan de overheid om de methodologie van het onderzoek te beoordelen, noch om de uitkomsten van het onderzoek te beoordelen of met alternatieve rapportcijfers te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Van Eijs over de Nationale Landschap Enquête van Natuurmonumenten

MPs Smeulders and Van Eijs asked the minister about Natuurmonumenten's National Landscape Survey, its concerns over landscape protection amid spatial pressures, biodiversity loss, and the role of government as landscape steward. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to provinces as primarily responsible, referred to the NOVI principles and the LNV vision, and committed to informing the House on the motion about quantifying soft values.
Yes, I will inform the House about this in writing.
Ja, ik zal de Kamer hierover schriftelijk informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Van Eijs en Ronnes over antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake het tracé van buizen voor ondergronds transport van gevaarlijke stoffen

MPs Smeulders, Van Eijs and Ronnes asked for the current status of the indicative pipeline route Laarbeek-Echt/Susteren, why it remains in the Structuurvisie Buisleidingen, and whether it should be removed or subjected to a cost-benefit analysis. Minister Ollongren answered that the definitive route procedure is being stopped because insufficient information exists, that the indicative route will stay in the structure vision, that no MKBA will be made, and that the Chamber will be informed through the upcoming Nationaal Programma Energiesysteem.
An indicative route cannot be established as a definitive route without consultation with the Chamber about it.
Een indicatief tracé kan niet als definitief tracé worden vastgesteld zonder overleg daarover met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Ronnes en Smeulders over het bericht 'Huurcommissie kan stroom aan klachten niet aan'

MPs asked why complaints to the Huurcommissie (rent tribunal) surged to about 10,000 in 2018, how long cases take, and what the effect of the modernisation bill and long waits is. The minister attributes the rise to no single cause, says durations range from two months to a year, and says she cannot say how many disputes moved to the courts.
The Huurcommissie does not receive data on court proceedings before the judge.
De Huurcommissie ontvangt geen gegevens over gerechtelijke procedures bij de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over een Arrest van het Gerecht

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the income ceiling for social housing eligibility can be changed independently, given a General Court ruling and the European Commission's role. The minister answered that the ceiling was part of an approved EC decision that Nigeria... the government is bound to implement, that the EC had to approve it, and that a review of the ceiling and household-size differentiation will be reported at the Woningwet evaluation.
I will inform you about this at the evaluation of the revised Housing Act.
Ik zal u hierover informeren bij de evaluatie van de herziene Woningwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het artikel ‘Sturen op economische groei’ van secretaris-generaal Camps van het ministerie van Economische zaken en klimaat

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Interior about a New Year article by the Secretary-General of the Ministry of Economic Affairs on cyclicality in the housing market, including the procyclical effects of the landlord levy, a possible construction fund, phasing out mortgage interest deduction, and ring-fencing land profits. The minister acknowledges the cyclicality, notes existing and planned measures (Woondeals, Omgevingswet, middle-rent bill, landlord levy evaluation in 2020), and says the ideas need further analysis, with CPB research commissioned.
I agree that the Dutch housing market is a cyclical market in which both house prices and housing construction fluctuate.
Ik onderschrijf dat de Nederlandse woningmarkt een cyclische markt is waar zowel de huizenprijzen als de woningbouwproductie fluctueert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent, Smeulders, Renkema en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat de distributiecentra van Picnic niet veilig zijn

MPs from SP, GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports of high workload, unsafe equipment and poor pay at online supermarket Picnic, including whether the Inspectorate SZW would investigate, whether its risk assessment was in order, and whether it should fall under the supermarket collective agreement. The Minister answered that employers are responsible for safe work and workload, that the Inspectorate acts on complaints and risk-based priorities without commenting on specific investigations, that no company collective agreement is registered for Picnic and interpreting the scope of sector agreements is for the social partners, and that the government is taking measures against competition on labour conditions.
No statements are made about whether the Inspectorate SZW is conducting an investigation or not.
Er worden geen uitlatingen gedaan of de Inspectie SZW al dan niet onderzoek doet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Smeulders over het bericht dat jonge gehandicapten geregeld geen uitkering krijgen terwijl ze er wel recht op hebben

MPs Renkema and Smeulders asked about a report that young disabled people are often denied a Wajong benefit they are entitled to, and about a UWV internal study finding wrong conclusions in 21% of files. The State Secretary answered that the study could not confirm incorrect outcomes with certainty, that UWV introduced retraining and quality controls, that the 2018 risk fell to 7%, and that the internal report was not shared with the ministry.
The internal study report in question was not provided to me for information at the time.
Het bewuste interne onderzoeksrapport is destijds niet ter informatie aan mij aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over het bericht 'Experts boos over soepeler BENG-eisen'

GroenLinks MPs Van der Lee and Smeulders asked why the proposed BENG energy performance requirements for nearly zero-energy buildings were softened, who lobbied for it, and what it means for the energy transition and household bills. The minister replied that the higher numerical value reflects a new calculation method rather than a weakening, listed the consulted parties and denied any lobbying, and said the figures are not comparable and that a tighter renewable-energy requirement could hurt cost-optimality.

That the numerical value is higher than in the previously proposed requirements does not mean that the BENG requirements about to be submitted for consultation are much more lenient than the previously proposed requirements.
Dat de getalswaarde hoger is dan in de eerder voorgenomen eisen betekent niet dat de BENG-eisen die binnenkort voor consultatie worden voorgelegd veel soepeler zijn dan de eerder voorgenomen eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over de primaire energiefactor (PEF) voor elektriciteit

MPs Van der Lee and Smeulders question the government's change of the primary energy factor (PEF) for electricity to 1.45, based on the NEV 2017 forecast for 2020 rather than realised performance, arguing it implies an unrealistic 69% generation efficiency and could encourage low-efficiency electric systems. Minister Wiebes defends the change as aligning the standard with the BENG requirements from 2020, rejects the claim that low-efficiency systems will be favoured, and says the PBL uses the same data in its climate agreement calculations.
The revised PEF of 1.45 has been set on the basis of realistic expectations regarding the share of renewable electricity in 2020.
De herziene PEF van 1,45 is vastgesteld op basis van realistische verwachtingen ten aanzien van het aandeel hernieuwbare elektriciteit in 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over de uitzending ‘Kwetsbare werknemers als verdienmodel?’ van de Monitor

A member of the Green Left party asked the minister whether contract takeovers of redundant public-sector workers, used as a revenue model by placement agencies, should be curbed and whether the arrangement invites benefit fraud. The government answered that such arrangements are undesirable where they shift unemployment costs to the market-sector unemployment fund, that public employers must scrutinise agencies, and that it will act against fraud with UWV, while noting existing safeguards in the national government's contract with POSG.
Constructions or arrangements whereby unemployment costs are deliberately shifted by public employers onto the market-sector unemployment funds are, in the cabinet's view, not desired.
Constructies of afspraken waarbij werkloosheidslasten door overheidswerkgevers doelbewust worden afgewenteld op de WW-fondsen in de marktsector, zijn wat het kabinet betreft niet gewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over het bericht 'Woningwet blokkeert subsidie voor zonnepanelen voor woningcorporaties'

MPs Van der Lee and Smeulders asked whether the Woningwet blocks housing corporations from claiming SDE+ subsidy for solar panels because the electricity flows to an energy company, and whether they should amend article 45(2)(c). The minister answered that the Woningwet does not exclude SDE+ subsidy, that corporations may generate electricity only when it is directly linked to housing, and that the Woningwet evaluation including the Autoriteit woningcorporaties will examine possible obstacles by year end.
The evaluation of the revised Woningwet is currently being completed. I expect to send it to your House before the end of this year.
De evaluatie van de herziene Woningwet wordt op dit moment afgerond. Ik verwacht deze voor het eind van dit jaar naar uw Kamer te versturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Nijboer over het definitieve energielabel voor woningen

MPs Smeulders and Nijboer asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about the reliability of home energy labels, the oversight of certified assessors, liability for incorrect labels, and the energy-label system's performance. The minister answered that the government registers rather than issues labels, cited inspection results and fines, acknowledged the need for better communication and a review of the simplified label, and promised further steps.
The Inspectorate for the Living Environment and Transport carries out random checks on the files handled by certified experts.
De Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport voert steekproefsgewijs controles uit op de dossiers die door de erkend deskundigen zijn behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Nijboer over gesjoemel met energielabels en energie-indexen

MPs Smeulders and Nijboer asked the Minister of the Interior about alleged manipulation of energy indices in Groningen rental housing, how tenants can recover overpayments, how certifiers are checked and sanctioned, and whether action will be taken. The minister acknowledged the article, explained the rent-points effect (often limited in practice), said only suspected cases by one certificate holder are known, pointed tenants to the Huurcommissie and courts, outlined a suspension and withdrawal process for certificate holders, and saw no need for further measures.
Given the options tenants have with the Rent Tribunal and the courts in cases of fraud and manipulation, I currently see insufficient reason for additional measures.
Gezien de mogelijkheden van huurders bij de Huurcommissie en de rechter in gevallen van fraude en sjoemelen, zie ik op dit moment onvoldoende aanleiding voor aanvullende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Smeulders over het bericht ‘Digitalisering van stroomnet loopt gevaar’

MPs Van der Lee and Smeulders asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Social Affairs about reports that a shortage of technical staff endangers digitalisation of the power grid and the energy transition, and what measures, cooperation with municipalities and UWV, and use of refugee status holders are planned. The minister answers that the government is continuing the Techniekpact, the Klimaatakkoord task group on labour market and training, a labour-market programme (VIA) and a heat-pump training Green Deal, while acknowledging that no specific grid-digitalisation initiative has been launched.
Yes, I recognise the signals from the grid operators.
Ja, ik herken de signalen van de netbeheerders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het bericht ‘Met sociale koopwoningen gaat veel mis’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of the Interior whether the social-purchase housing rules (sociale koop) can be easily misused, whether municipalities have the legal expertise to make watertight agreements, and how many social-purchase homes were added or lost over five years. The Minister pointed to municipal instruments such as zoning categories and housing vision agreements, said no data exist on social-purchase stock changes, referred to the Expertteam Woningbouw for support, and committed to informing parliament next year on a commissioned Platform 31 study.
I do not have data showing how many social-purchase homes based on the zoning category were added or disappeared over the past five years.
Ik beschik niet over data waaruit blijkt hoeveel sociale koopwoningen er op basis van de bestemmingscategorie de afgelopen vijf jaar zijn bijgekomen en verdwenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het artikel 'De keerzijde van 100.000 zzp’ers in de bouw: ‘Meer dan tien procent is fake, arm en kwetsbaar’'

An MP asked the minister about a press article claiming 10,000 of the 50,000 construction freelancers are fake, poor and vulnerable, and about a firm that set up 530 sole proprietorships for Polish horticulture workers. The minister said the figures are unknown to them, cited prior estimates of 2-17% disguised self-employment, said the Tax Authority cannot act against individuals due to confidentiality, and pointed to Inspectie SZW enforcement and forthcoming measures on low-rate contracts.
The Tax Authority cannot address individual taxpayers due to its statutory confidentiality duty under article 67 AWR.
Op individuele belastingplichtigen kan de Belastingdienst op grond van zijn geheimhoudingsplicht van art. 67 AWR niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het tracé van buizen voor ondergronds transport van gevaarlijke stoffen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the route of a pipeline for hazardous substances running under or near a residential area in Helmond, including its history, legal basis, public participation and alternatives. The minister confirmed awareness of concerns, explained the indicative status of the route and that a new public consultation will follow in the first half of 2019, but gave only partial answers, withheld the environmental study until it is final, and committed to involving Helmond and affected parties.
The route of the Laarbeek-Echt-Susteren pipeline strip has a provisional character in the current Structuurvisie, as the still-to-follow objection procedure may lead to adjustments of the route.

Het tracé van de buisleidingenstrook Laarbeek-Echt-Susteren heeft in de vigerende Structuurvisie een voorlopig karakter aangezien de nog te volgen zienswijzeprocedure kan leiden tot aanpassingen van het tracé van de strook.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Smeulders en Van Kent over onderbetaling journalisten door payrolling

MPs Van Dijk, Smeulders and Van Kent asked the ministers about public broadcasting journalists being underpaid through payrolling, including questions on pensions, the regeringsakkoord, zzp collective bargaining and flex allowances. The ministers answered that the Wab bill will extend equal pay and adequate pensions to payroll workers, that broadcasters must set their own budgets and wage terms under the cao, and declined to research the effects on journalistic quality.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over de situatie van de gesloten parkeergarage in Almere

MPs Smeulders asked the Minister of Interior about the closed parking garage in Almere: investigation status, whether its concrete matches other buildings, the inventory of unsafe concrete floors promised last year, municipal inspection capacity, the privatisation of building inspection under the Wkb, and liability. The minister answered that the Almere investigation is not finished, pointed to her May 2018 letter, said municipalities are responsible for inspection and that no national register is kept, and noted private quality guarantors would still be supervised by a public accreditation body with municipalities retaining enforcement powers.
I have made inquiries with the municipality of Almere. It has informed me that the investigation has not yet been completed.
Ik heb hierover navraag gedaan bij de gemeente Almere. Deze heeft mij laten weten dat het onderzoek nog niet is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Özdil over het bericht ‘Gemiddelde prijs studentenkamer voor het eerst boven de 400 euro’

GroenLinks MPs asked ministers about rising student rents, the causes of the housing shortage, and whether the woningwaarderingsstelsel should be mandatory for student housing. The government said it lacks exact shortage figures per city, pointed to the Landelijke monitor and a new action plan, and considered existing rent-control and Huurcommissie routes sufficient consumer protection.

As I indicated earlier in answers to parliamentary questions from MPs Van Meenen and Van Eijs (D66) and MPs Voortman and Özdil (GroenLinks), no exact figures per city can be given on student housing demand and supply.

Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven in antwoorden de Kamervragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Eijs (D66) (kenmerk 2017Z12177 ) en de leden Voortman en Özdil (GroenLinks) (kenmerk 2017Z15653 ) zijn er geen exacte standen per stad te geven als het gaat om de vraag naar en het aanbod van studentenhuisvesting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over de website www.investingindutchhousing.nl

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior why a government website encourages foreign investors to invest in Dutch housing, how it is funded, and how buy-to-let excesses, tenant conflicts, social housing sales and rising rents are addressed. The Minister answered that the website informs about the housing market, costs about 12,500 euro in editorial work, that foreign investors are a small share and must follow Dutch rules, and that municipalities and the Huurcommissie provide tools for tenant protection, while promising to update the website on social housing sales.
The website will be updated on this point.
De website zal op dit punt geactualiseerd worden.

m: Motie van het lid Deen over per direct de dienstauto met chauffeur voor de Griffier schrappen
Asks the presidium to immediately abolish the chauffeur-driven service car for the chief clerk of parliament.
considering that the Clerk does not need a chauffeur-driven service car to carry out his duties
overwegende dat de Griffier geen dienstauto met chauffeur nodig heeft om zijn taken uit te voeren
Amendement van het lid Deen over een termijn van vier jaar waarbinnen de adviesverplichting en het lobby- en draaideurverbod geldt
Amendment extending from two to four years the cooling-off period during which the advisory obligation and lobby/revolving-door ban apply to former ministers and officials.
The proposed two-year period during which the advisory obligation and the lobby and revolving-door ban apply may not provide enough distance to prevent conflicts of interest effectively.

De voorgestelde termijn van twee jaar waarbinnen de adviesverplichting en het lobby- en draaideurverbod geldt, biedt mogelijk onvoldoende afstand om (de schijn van) belangenverstrengeling effectief te voorkomen.
Motie van de leden Van Haasen en Deen over onderzoeken welke uitvoeringsmogelijkheden en kosten reëel zijn
Asks the cabinet to investigate which implementation options and costs are realistic for the disability and chronic illness equal treatment law in the Caribbean Netherlands and inform the House.
requests the cabinet to investigate which implementation options and costs are realistic and to inform the House about them
verzoekt het kabinet te onderzoeken welke uitvoeringsmogelijkheden en kosten reëel zijn, en hierover de Kamer te informeren
Amendement van de leden Deen en Wilders over de A-component van het inkomen van de Koning op het niveau van 2024 houden
Freezes the A-component of the King's income for 2025 at its 2024 level, overriding the Financial Statute for that year and reducing the budget accordingly.
For the year 2025, deviating from article 1 of the Financial Statute of the Royal House, the part of the King's allowance
Voor het jaar 2025 bedraagt, in afwijking van artikel 1 van de Wet financieel statuut van het Koninklijk Huis, het gedeelte van de uitkering van de Koning
Motie van de leden Deen en Wilders over de koning vragen om af te zien van zijn salarisverhoging per 2024
Asks the Prime Minister to request that the King waive a planned salary increase for 2024.
requests the Prime Minister to ask the King to waive his salary increase of €55,000 from 2024
verzoekt de Minister-President de Koning te vragen af te zien van zijn salarisverhoging van € 55.000 per 2024
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valize en Deen over de berichtgeving omtrent de grote datalekken bij de ministeries van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, Economische Zaken en Klimaat en Groene Groei

Two PVV MPs asked the State Secretary of Interior Affairs about media reports of large data leaks at several ministries, when the leak was discovered, whether it is a privacy problem and why the Dutch Data Protection Authority was not contacted directly, what information was exposed, what measures were taken, and whether a state actor was involved. The State Secretary confirmed the leak was known from 10 April, said it exposes civil servants' personal data in document metadata and that a joint notification was made to the Data Protection Authority, listed containment measures including a central crisis team and an investigation, and stated no state actor appears to be involved.
All affected ministries have made a preliminary notification to the Dutch Data Protection Authority.
Er is door alle getroffen ministeries een voorlopige melding gedaan bij de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Deen en Wilders over het bericht ‘Kamer-bobo laat zich door beveiligers rondrijden in opgeëiste dienstauto: chique bolide heeft pikant verleden’

PVV MPs Deen and Wilders asked the Minister of Interior whether the House Clerk (Griffier) obtained a chauffeured service car driven by Chamber security staff, and whether this should end. The Minister replied that she had no role in the decision, which falls under the House's own budget and personnel responsibility (Presidium), and therefore would not go into the reports.
For the above reasons, I will not go into the reported news any further.
Vanwege bovenstaande redenen zal ik niet nader ingaan op de genoemde berichtgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon en Deen over een protest op 19 juni 2024 buiten de Tweede Kamer

PVV MPs Boon and Deen asked the ministers whether they knew of a 19 June 2024 protest outside the Tweede Kamer where chants allegedly called for violence against Jewish people, and whether demonstrators dressed as Al-Qassam Brigades members amounted to glorification of terrorism. The minister confirmed awareness, said prosecution of such expressions is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts to assess case by case, and noted the cabinet plans to make glorification of terrorism a separate criminal offence.
Whether publicly uttering certain wording qualifies as a criminal offence ... is for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the court to assess.
Of het in het openbaar uiten van bepaalde bewoordingen te kwalificeren valt als strafbaar feit ... is aan het Openbaar Ministerie en in laatste instantie aan de rechter om te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Faber- Van de Klashorst en Deen over de berichtgeving ‘Aboutaleb wil minder communicatie over geweldsexplosie Rotterdam'

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the Rotterdam mayor, by reducing active communication about violent incidents, endangers citizens' safety and fails in his duty, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister replied that communication is a matter for local authorities and the municipal council, that the minister will not interfere in local decision-making, but that the topic is discussed regularly with partners and action will be taken if warranted.
The Rotterdam municipal council is therefore the appropriate place for the debate on communication about incidents involving explosives.
De gemeenteraad van Rotterdam is derhalve de aangewezen plek voor het debat over communicatie over incidenten met explosieven.

m: Motie van het lid El Fassed over een voorafgaande rechterlijke toets
Motion asks the government to push in EU negotiations for prior judicial review of intrusive investigative measures under the European Investigation Order and to withhold consent otherwise.
in the negotiations on the European Investigation Order directive, to press for prior judicial review
zich bij de onderhandelingen over de totstandkoming van de Richtlijn Europees Onderzoeksbevel in te zetten voor een voorafgaande rechterlijke toets
Motie van het lid El Fassed over grensoverschrijdende criminaliteit
Asks the government to work EU-wide to strengthen legal safeguards and fairness in cross-border criminal law cooperation and to report to the Chamber.
requests the government to take initiatives to strengthen EU-wide the lawfulness and fairness of cross-border crime combating
verzoekt de regering, initiatieven te ontplooien om EU-breed de rechtmatigheid en de rechtvaardigheid te versterken
Motie El Fassed over de marktmacht van boeren
Asks the government for an overview of all its activities since March 2011 in the CAP negotiations aimed at strengthening farmers' market power, to be updated periodically.
requests the government to provide an overview of all activities the government has undertaken since March 2011
verzoekt de regering een overzicht te geven van alle activiteiten die de regering sinds maart 2011 heeft ondernomen
Motie El Fassed en Koopmans over decentrale energieopwekking door boeren
Asks the government, together with civil society, to reach a green deal that helps farmers improve income through decentralised energy generation.
requests the government, together with civil society such as LTO and nature and environmental organisations, to reach a green deal
verzoekt de regering samen met het maatschappelijk middenveld, zoals LTO en natuur- en milieuorganisaties, te komen tot een green deal
Motie El Fassed over de THT-datum
Asks the government to agree with supply-chain parties on best-before date rules for non-perishable goods and to examine abolishing those dates, to reduce food waste.
requests the government to make agreements with supply-chain parties on best-before periods for non-perishable and very long-lasting products
verzoekt de regering met ketenpartijen afspraken te maken over de THT-termijnen voor niet-bederfelijke producten en zeer lang houdbare producten
Amendement van het lid El Fassed dat o.a. beoogt geld vrij te maken voor natuur om te kunnen voldoen aan internationale doelen en verplichtingen op het gebied van natuur
Adds 150 million euro to the nature and region budget to meet international nature obligations and fund access, landscape and recreation after decentralisation.
In article 18 Nature and region, the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by 150,000 thousand euro.
In artikel 18 Natuur en regio worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 150 000 (x € 1 000).
Motie Lucas c.s. over de onderhandelingen over de EU-begroting
Asks the government to resist cuts to cohesion, agriculture and structural funds in the EU budget 2014-2020 and protect education and research investment.
requests the government, during negotiations on the proposed EU budget 2014-2020, to argue for cuts to cohesion, agricultural and structural funds
verzoekt de regering om tijdens de onderhandelingen over de voorgestelde EU-begroting 2014–2020 te pleiten voor verlagingen van de cohesie-, landbouw- en structuurfondsen
Motie Eijsink c.s. over vrijstelling van de Turkse dienstplicht
Asks the government to request Turkey to recognise Dutch military service as grounds for exemption from Turkish conscription and to seek full exemption for Dutch-Turkish men.
requests the Dutch government to submit a request to the Turkish government to have active service in the Dutch armed forces count as grounds for exemption
verzoekt de Nederlandse regering een verzoek in te dienen bij de Turkse regering om vervulling van actieve dienst in de Nederlandse krijgsmacht te laten gelden als grond voor ontheffing
Motie El Fassed/Hachchi over samenwerking bij cyber defence
Motion asking the government to join the lead group in European cyber defence cooperation, such as the Scandinavian-Baltic initiative, if it yields knowledge and cost benefits.
calls on the government to belong to the lead group in European cooperation on cyber defence.
roept de regering op tot de kopgroep te behoren in het kader van Europese samenwerking op cyber defence
Motie Hachchi c.s. over doorstroom van Defensiepersoneel
Asks the government to investigate and report on structural transfers of defence personnel to other central government ministries after budget cuts.
requests the government to examine the possibilities for structural transfer of defence personnel within central government and to report to the House
verzoekt de regering de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om structurele doorstroom van Defensiepersoneel binnen de rijksoverheid te bewerkstelligen en hierover te rapporteren aan de Kamer
Motie Eijsink c.s. over uitbreiding van de inspectiefunctie IGK
Asks the government to expand the Defence inspectorate (IGK) with tasks and powers to become a full independent inspection function covering all defence policy.
to supplement the current inspection function of the IGK with the necessary tasks and powers so that the IGK can grow into a full independent inspection function
de huidige inspectiefunctie van de IGK aan te vullen met de benodigde taken en bevoegdheden waardoor de rol van de IGK kan uitgroeien tot een volwaardige onafhankelijke inspectiefunctie
Motie van het lid El Fassed over verminderen van het aantal aan te schaffen JSF's
Asks the government to consider reducing the number of JSF fighter aircraft to be purchased if further budget cuts are made.
requests the government, in case of new cuts, also to consider further reducing the number of fighter aircraft to be purchased
verzoekt de regering bij nieuwe bezuinigingen ook het nog verder verminderen van het aantal aan te schaffen jachtvliegtuigen te overwegen
Motie El Fassed c.s. over niet leveren van tanks aan Indonesië
Asks the government not to deliver decommissioned Leopard 2A6 tanks to Indonesia because of human rights violations.
requests the government not to deliver these tanks to Indonesia
verzoekt de regering deze tanks niet te leveren aan Indonesië
Motie Pechtold c.s. over adequate juridisch bijstand
Asks the government to create a regulation fixing a minimum standard of legal aid for Dutch nationals abroad who face possible capital charges, as a safety net.
Requests the government to introduce a regulation that lays down this responsibility.
verzoekt de regering een regeling in te voeren die deze verantwoordelijkheid vastlegt
Motie El Fassed over consulaire bijstand

Asks the government to investigate starting International Court of Justice proceedings against Iran for denying consular assistance to detained Dutch dual nationals, and to report within three months.
Motie Voordewind c.s. over vroegtijdige juridische bijstand
Asks the government to provide legal aid to Dutch citizens facing a real risk of the death penalty abroad who lack funds, before any sentence is passed.
requests the government to immediately provide legal aid to Dutch citizens facing a real risk of death sentence in Iran without sufficient funds

verzoekt de regering om Nederlandse staatsburgers die in Iran een reële kans lopen ter dood te worden veroordeeld en niet over voldoende financiële middelen beschikken, per direct juridische bijstand te verlenen
Asks the government to work toward extending the EU human rights defenders handbook with guidance on new media, technologies and the internet.
requests the government to work to extend the EU handbook for human rights defenders with specific guidance on new media
verzoekt de regering zich in te zetten het EU-handboek voor mensenrechtenverdedigers uit te breiden met specifieke richtlijnen en informatie over nieuwe media
Asks the government to deliver by 1 March 2011 a plan to restructure the diplomatic post network along the lines of an earlier motion.
requests the government to come up with an elaboration as requested in that motion
verzoekt de regering met een uitwerking te komen zoals verzocht in die motie
Motie-El Fassed over aandacht voor mensenrechten
Asks the government to give more and special attention to human rights and human rights defenders in priority energy countries within the Human Rights Fund.
requests the government to give more and special attention within the Human Rights Fund to human rights and human rights defenders in priority energy countries
verzoekt de regering binnen het Mensenrechtenfonds meer en bijzondere aandacht te geven aan mensenrechten en mensenrechtenverdedigers in prioritaire energielanden
Motie-Thieme c.s. over de ecologische voetafdruk
Asks the government to continuously pursue reducing the Netherlands' ecological footprint abroad in its foreign policy.
requests the government to continuously strive, in its foreign policy, to reduce the Netherlands' ecological footprint abroad
verzoekt de regering bij haar buitenlandbeleid voortdurend te streven naar verkleining van de ecologische voetafdruk van Nederland in het buitenland
Asks the government to push the EU to play a more active role in resolving bilateral border disputes between member states and accession candidates.
requests the government to advocate within the Council that the European Union play a more active role in resolving bilateral (border) disputes
