verzoekt de regering binnen de Raad ervoor te pleiten dat de Europese Unie een actievere rol gaat spelen bij de oplossing van bilaterale (grens)geschillen
Motie-Van der Staaij c.s. over de situatie in Papoea
Asks the government to seek open dialogue with Indonesia in international fora to stop human rights violations in Papua and report back.
requests the government to take initiatives in international fora leading to open and constructive dialogue with Indonesia on the situation in Papua
verzoekt de regering in internationaal verband initiatieven te ondernemen die moeten leiden tot een open en constructief overleg met Indonesië over de situatie in Papoea
Amendement van het lid El Fassed over het terugdraaien van de bezuinigingen op MATRA
Restores a 2 million euro MATRA budget cut by reallocating funds from large events and consular services within the foreign affairs budget.
This amendment reverses the 2 million euro cuts to MATRA.
Met dit amendement worden de bezuinigingen van 2 miljoen Euro op MATRA teruggedraaid
Motie van het lid Nicolaï c.s. over beveiliging diplomatiek verkeer
Asks the government to review the technical security and classification of Dutch diplomatic communications and inform the House before summer 2011.
requests the government to consider the technical security and classification of Dutch diplomatic communications and to inform the House about it before summer 2011
verzoekt de regering zich te beraden op de technische beveiliging en classificatie van het Nederlandse diplomatieke verkeer en daarover de Kamer voor de zomer van 2011 te informeren
Motie-El Fassed c.s. over het Shelter City Initiative
Asks the government to join the Shelter City Initiative and introduce emergency visa procedures for human rights defenders at risk.
requests the government to join the Shelter City Initiative and introduce related emergency visa procedures
verzoekt de regering aan te sluiten bij het Shelter City Initiative en bijbehorende procedures voor noodvisa in te voeren
Motie-El Fassed/Braakhuis over druk op Servië
Asks the government to press the EU to apply maximum pressure on Serbia to cooperate with war crimes investigations, offering operational support funded from existing enlargement funds.
requests the government to advocate within the Council that the EU exert maximum pressure on Serbia
verzoekt de regering om binnen de Raad te bepleiten dat de EU maximale druk op Servië gaat uitoefenen
Asks the government to work in the UN on research into monitoring and compliance mechanisms for freedom of expression and news gathering online.
requests the government to work within the UN to research review and compliance mechanisms for the right to freedom of expression and news gathering
verzoekt de regering zich in te zetten om in VN-verband onderzoek te doen naar toetsings- en nalevingsmechanismen voor het recht op vrije meningsuiting en nieuwsgaring
Asks the government to base any further cuts to MFS II subsidies to civil society organisations on application quality.
asks the government to let application quality guide allocation of these or possibly other cuts
verzoekt de regering bij de toewijzing van deze of mogelijk andere kortingen de kwaliteit van de aanvragen leidend te laten zijn
Amendement van het lid El Fassed over het ongedaan maken van bezuinigingen op het mensenrechtenbeleid
Restores a €5 million human rights budget for foreign policy by cutting the culture article by the same amount.
This amendment aims to reverse the €5 million cuts to Dutch human rights policy.
Dit amendement beoogt de bezuinigingen van € 5 miljoen op het Nederlandse mensenrechtenbeleid ongedaan te maken.
Amendement van de leden El Fassed en Hachchi ter dekking van amendement 32500 V nr. 62
Covers an expenditure increase in another budget item by cutting the contribution to IDA within the state budget.
Cover is found by cutting the contribution to IDA through a cash shift
Dekking wordt gevonden in het middels een kasschuif korten van de bijdrage aan IDA
Amendement van de leden El Fassed en Hachchi over het deels ongedaan maken van de extra korting op het MFS subsidiekader
Amendment restoring EUR 40 million to the civil society subsidy framework by shifting funds from the IDA 15 contribution, reversing part of an extra cut.
This amendment aims to partially reverse the extra 12.5% cut to the MFS subsidy framework.
Dit amendement beoogt de extra korting van 12,5% op het MFS subsidiekader deels ongedaan te maken.
Motie Hachchi c.s. over een Europees actieplan om resolutie 1325 te concretiseren
Asks the government to call for national action plans on UN Resolution 1325 and to push in the EU for a European action plan on it.
requests the government to work in the EU for a European action plan to give concrete form to UNSCR 1325 in policy at European level
verzoekt de regering zich in de EU in te zetten voor een Europees actieplan om op Europees niveau VNVR 1325 in beleid te concretiseren
Motie El Fassed en Hachchi over een tender gericht op vrouwen en hun rechten
Asks the government to hold a 2011 subsidy tender within the standard subsidy framework focused on women and their rights, especially in post-conflict and conflict countries.
requests the government to launch in 2011 a tender within the standard subsidy framework focused on women and their rights
verzoekt de regering in 2011 een tender uit te schrijven binnen het standaardsubsidiekader die zich richt op vrouwen en hun rechten
Motie El Fassed en Dijkhoff over ontsluiten van data van het directoraat-generaal Internationale Samenwerking

Asks the government to start opening up data held by the directorate-general for International Cooperation and the evaluation inspectorate, in response to the Rekenkamer's finding of limited transparency.
requests the government to start in 2011 making available data accessible
verzoekt de regering in 2011 een start te maken met het ontsluiten van beschikbare data
Motie El Fassed c.s. over maatregelen tegen de invoer van illegaal gewonnen grondstoffen
Asks the government to investigate obstacles Netherlands or the EU could create against imports of illegally extracted raw materials.
requests the government to investigate obstacles that the Netherlands or the EU could create against imports of raw materials that were illegally extracted
verzoekt de regering onderzoek te doen naar obstakels die Nederland of de EU in het leven kunnen roepen tegen de invoer van grondstoffen die illegaal gewonnen zijn
Amendement van de leden Hachchi en El Fassed over het deels ongedaan maken van de bezuinigingen op het Nederlandse genderbeleid in ontwikkelingslanden
Amendment shifts 5 million euro from the emergency aid budget to the women's and girls' rights objective in the development budget.
Coverage for this amendment is found in operational objective 2.6. The emergency aid budget is reduced by 5 million euro.
Dekking voor dit amendement wordt gevonden op operationele doelstelling 2.6. Het noodhulpbudget wordt verlaagd met 5 miljoen euro.
Amendement van het lid Van Veldhoven c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 14 over het oormerken van gelden voor de kwetsbare natuurwaarde van de BES-eilanden
Shifts a sum of 600 thousand euro within the budget from the nominal and unforeseen reserve to earmark it for nature protection on the BES islands.
This amendment explicitly aims to establish that these funds benefit the drafting and implementation, in consultation with local nature organisations, of an integrated management plan
Dit amendement beoogt expliciet vast te leggen dat deze middelen ten goede komen aan het in overleg met lokale natuurorganisaties opstellen en uitvoeren van een integraal beheerplan
Amendement van het lid Van Veldhoven C.S. ter vervanging van nr. 11 over het oormerken van gelden voor de kwetsbare natuurwaarde van de BES-eilanden
Earmarks existing funds in the nominal and unforeseen budget item for an integrated nature management plan for the BES islands.
This amendment explicitly aims to establish that these funds benefit the drafting and implementation, in consultation with local nature organisations, of an integrated management plan
Dit amendement beoogt expliciet vast te leggen dat deze middelen ten goede komen aan het in overleg met lokale natuurorganisaties opstellen en uitvoeren van een integraal beheerplan
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van Veldhoven en El Fassed ter vervanging van nr. 12 over robuste verbindingen
Shifts EUR 10 million from general departmental funds to nature policy, financed by cutting external ICT hiring at DICTU, to repair nature-network cuts.
In article 23 Nature, the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by EUR 10,000 (x EUR 1,000).
In artikel 23 Natuur worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 10 000 (x € 1 000).
Motie- El Fassed over stoppen met de doorvoer van clustermunitie door Nederland
Asks the government to inform the Chamber on how transit of cluster munitions through the Netherlands can be stopped.
requests the government to inform the Chamber promptly how the transit of cluster munitions through the Netherlands can be stopped
verzoekt de regering de Kamer op korte termijn te informeren hoe de doorvoer van clustermunitie via Nederland een halt kan worden toegeroepen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Fassed over mogelijke Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij 'rendition' naar Libië

MP El Fassed (GroenLinks) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Security and Justice and Immigration about alleged Dutch involvement in unlawful rendition of detainees to Libya, including the handling of asylum claimant Abu Farsan, and whether independent investigation would be conducted. Minister Leers answers on behalf of the ministers, but the text provided is cut off before the substantive answers appear, so the responsiveness and commitments cannot be confirmed.
I hereby provide you confidentially with the answers, on behalf of the Minister of Foreign Affairs and the Minister of Security and Justice, to the written questions
Hierbij bied ik u vertrouwelijk de antwoorden*), mede namens de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie, aan op de schriftelijke vragen
Antwoord vragen El Fassed en Dibi over schending door Eritrea van het VN wapenembargo

MPs El Fassed and Dibi asked the government about Eritrea's reported 2% diaspora tax funding its military in apparent breach of the UN arms embargo, and whether such practices occur in the Netherlands. The minister said the tax is not judged to breach the embargo, that police and prosecutors depend on victim complaints, that the Eritrean chargé was summoned, and that the issue is raised in EU fora.
While an investigation is ongoing, no statements are made about it.
Lopende een onderzoek worden geen mededelingen daarover gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden El Fassed en Braakhuis, Voordewind en Gesthuizen over ketentransparantie, kinderarbeid en uitbuiting in de kledingindustrie

MPs from GroenLinks, ChristenUnie and SP asked the government about implementing a motion on full supply-chain transparency and ending child labour in the garment sector, including IMVO policy, EU action and India/Bangladesh cases. The government answered that talks with textile industry associations continue, that a national action plan on business and human rights will come around the new year, and that it is primarily up to the industry to set feasible transparency commitments.
The cabinet expects internationally active companies to comply with the OECD Guidelines.
Het kabinet verwacht van bedrijven die internationaal actief zijn dat zij de OESO Richtlijnen naleven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden El Fassed en Dibi over de opvang van Syrische vluchtelingen

GroenLinks MPs El Fassed and Dibi asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands should admit Syrian refugees given the strain on Turkey and neighbouring countries, and whether he would press EU partners on this. The minister replied that refugee relief should remain in the region, that the Netherlands has offered extra support to host countries, and that the refugee issue was raised at the Gymnich meeting, without committing to admitting refugees.
Refugee reception should take place in the region.
Opvang van vluchtelingen dient in de regio te gebeuren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over het behoud van e-mailadressen

MP El Fassed asks the minister to address forced email address changes by ISPs (Wanadoo/Orange/Online), including keeping old addresses, forwarding mail after switching providers, and not reissuing addresses for ten years. The minister agrees that changes are inconvenient and will consult the sector on temporary free forwarding, but rejects a legal portability regime and sees no evidence that reissue limits reduce identity fraud.
I will therefore consult with the sector to see whether the sector is willing to make agreements on temporarily forwarding email messages free of charge.
Ik zal dan ook met de sector in overleg treden om te kijken of de sector bereid is afspraken te maken over het (tijdelijk) kosteloos doorsturen van e-mailberichten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over netneutraliteit en de EU-inzet voor de World Conference on International Telecommunications

An MP asked the minister whether Commissioner Kroes effectively supports the ETNO proposal for paid prioritisation ('tolweg') on the internet and whether the EU position for the WCIT undermines net neutrality. The minister said the EU position has not yet been decided, that he had previously criticised the ETNO proposal, and that he will not support proposals that undermine net neutrality in the WCIT.
On behalf of the Netherlands, I will in any case not allow room for proposals that undermine net neutrality, as recently enshrined in law here.
Namens Nederland zal ik in ieder geval geen ruimte bieden aan voorstellen die de netneutraliteit, zoals hier onlangs wettelijk vastgelegd, aantasten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over de Gay Pride in Belgrado

MP El Fassed asked the Foreign Minister whether the Belgrade Gay Pride, banned at short notice in 2011 over security concerns, would be protected in 2012, whether the Dutch government would press Serbia, and whether Serbia's decision should affect EU accession talks. The minister replied that the ambassador has conveyed the message to Serbian authorities, that the government has raised it with Serbian ministers, and that Serbia's treatment of minorities is part of the EU Copenhagen criteria, with the Commission's progress report addressing the LGBT situation.
The Dutch ambassador in Belgrade has conveyed this message to the Serbian authorities in recent weeks.
De Nederlandse ambassadeur in Belgrado heeft deze boodschap in de afgelopen weken overgebracht aan de Servische autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over Nederlandse investeringen in leveranciers aan het Syrische regime

An MP asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers whether Dutch financial institutions investing in firms supplying monitoring technology to the Syrian regime breach EU sanctions and what the government will do. The government answered that there is no indication of violation by the named firms, so no concrete measures are planned, while describing existing enforcement and supervision of sanctions.
There are no indications that the institutions named in the Profundo research have violated this regulation; there is therefore no direct reason for concrete government measures.

Er zijn geen aanwijzingen om te veronderstellen dat de in het onderzoek van Profundo genoemde instellingen deze verordening hebben overtreden; er is daarom geen directe aanleiding voor concrete maatregelen door de overheid.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over de inzet van private beveiligers door Nederlandse reders

An MP asked the Defence Minister about reports that Dutch shipowners deploy armed private security despite a legal ban, and whether this breaches the law and undermines the government's VPD arrangements. The government answered that it cannot accept law-breaking, will raise compliance in the working group with shipowners, the prosecutor is assessing whether to act, and it reaffirmed its anti-piracy strategy.
Of course I cannot accept a situation in which the law would be broken.
Uiteraard kan ik mij niet verenigen met een situatie waarin de wet zou worden overtreden.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over Nederlandse hulp bij tankdeal met Saoedi-Arabië

An MP asked whether the government granted an export licence for a Leopard 2 tank used in Saudi Arabian trials, whether it was a lease, whether parliament was informed, and whether arms-export criteria were applied. The Defence Minister answered that the tank remains Defence property on loan to KMW, that no sale or export occurred so no licence or criteria test was needed, and that parliament was not separately informed.
There is no agreement with Saudi Arabia that would have to be tested in any way.
Er is geen sprake van een overeenkomst met Saoedi-Arabië die op enigerlei wijze zou moeten worden getoetst.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Pechtold, Timmermans en El Fassed over ‘tegenstrijdige kabinetsuitlatingen’

MPs Pechtold, Timmermans and El Fassed asked the Prime Minister to reconcile minister Leers' claim that PVV rhetoric made Dutch intentions suspect in the EU with earlier government statements about the PVV's influence on European policy and the 'no misunderstanding' remark. The government answered that the statements concerned different matters (migration versus European dossiers generally), that it depends on other parties for most European files, and that it sees no contradiction, though it agrees such inconsistency would be undesirable.
Yes, but there is no question of contradiction.
Ja, maar van tegenstrijdigheid is geen sprake.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over berichten dat Indonesië mogelijk van Duitsland Leopard-tanks wil kopen

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reports that Indonesia may buy surplus German Leopard tanks, and why negotiations were not halted after a parliamentary motion, and whether a parliamentary rejection counts as a denial notification to EU states. The government answered that it considers the sale possible within export policy, that it ended negotiations after a parliamentary majority opposed the deal, and that a parliamentary rejection is not itself a denial notification since only negative licence decisions under the EU criteria are notified.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over de asielverlening van de heer Assange

An MP asked the foreign and justice ministers about Ecuador's asylum grant to Julian Assange, UK threats to enter the embassy, and whether the Netherlands would press the UK to let him leave. The minister confirmed the facts, noted UK extradition obligations to Sweden and that the matter is between the UK and Ecuador, and declined to take further steps.
This concerns a matter between the United Kingdom and Ecuador.
Dit betreft een zaak tussen het Verenigd Koninkrijk en Ecuador.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over politieke gevangenen in Sudan

MP El Fassed asked the Foreign Minister about political detainees in Sudan, including Green Party chair Fathi Albeheri, arrested after peaceful protests, and alleged torture, asking for pressure on Sudan and EU action. The minister answered that several protesters, including Albeheri, were released on 17 August 2012, that the Netherlands is concerned and has urged Sudan to respect human rights bilaterally and multilaterally, and that the EU High Representative has already acted.
The Netherlands, together with international partners, closely follows developments in Sudan and urges the Sudanese authorities to respect human rights in the country.
Nederland volgt samen met internationale partners de ontwikkelingen in Sudan nauwlettend en dringt er bij de Sudanese autoriteiten op aan de mensenrechten in het land te respecteren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden El Fassed en Dibi over inperking van vrijheid van meningsuiting door verschillende landen

MPs El Fassed and Dibi asked the Foreign Minister about restrictions on freedom of expression abroad, including the arrests in Belarus and Morocco and the Pussy Riot trial in Russia. The minister listed Dutch efforts on internet freedom and religious freedom, condemned the Belarus detentions, and said the EU and Dutch officials had raised concerns with Russia and Morocco.
I strongly condemn the intimidation, arrest and detention of journalists, human rights activists and other Belarusian citizens who exercise their universal rights, including Anton Suryapin.

Ik veroordeel de intimidatie, arrestatie en detentie van journalisten, mensenrechtenactivisten en andere Wit-Russische burgers die gebruik maken van hun universele rechten, waaronder Anton Suryapin, ten stelligste.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over het gebruik van Yammer door Nederlandse overheidsinstanties en de onbeperkte toegang van Amerikaanse autoriteiten tot die gegevens

MP El Fassed asked whether US authorities have unrestricted access to Dutch government data via Yammer, why it is used, whether risks were assessed, and what measures will close the alleged leak. Minister Spies replied that there is no unrestricted access, that interdepartmental guidelines apply, that confidential information may not be shared, and that no leak is seen so no additional measures are planned.
There is no unrestricted and uncontrolled access for the American authorities.
Er is geen sprake van een onbeperkte en ongecontroleerde toegang voor de Amerikaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El-Fassed over het aftreden van VN gezant Kofi Annan en de situatie in Syrië

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister about Kofi Annan's resignation as UN envoy for Syria, the Security Council deadlock, the legal classification of the Syrian conflict and whether Switzerland should convene the Geneva Convention parties. The minister answered that Netherlands prioritises ending the violence and respect for humanitarian law, agrees the conflict is non-international, and reported that Switzerland declined to convene a meeting of the parties.
The Netherlands sounded out Switzerland, the depositary of the Geneva Conventions and Additional Protocols, on whether it was willing to convene a meeting of the states parties.
Nederland heeft bij Zwitserland, de depositaris van de Geneefse Conventies en Aanvullende Protocollen, gepolst of er bereidheid bestaat om een vergadering van verdragspartijen bijeen te brengen.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over 'de door Nederland en de EU gefinancierde projecten die het Israëlische leger heeft vernietigd of beschadigd'

El Fassed (GroenLinks) asked whether Israeli forces destroyed EU- and Dutch-funded Palestinian projects, including a figure of 49.2 million euro in damage and a request for compensation. The minister answered that damaged projects were confirmed (a Dutch-funded Land Development Programme, about 65,000 euro), that damage is raised with Israeli authorities, and that compensation will be pursued through the EU framework rather than promised directly.
Damage to ongoing Dutch activities is in all cases raised with the Israeli authorities.
Schade aan Nederlandse lopende activiteiten wordt in alle gevallen opgenomen met de Israëlische autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over online privacy

An MP asked the ministers whether withholding requested data on online privacy under the 'state interest' clause (art. 68 Grondwet) was justified, and whether police phone-tapping and social media data requests are subject to equal controls. The state secretary declined to disclose cabinet deliberations, maintained that investigation interests justify withholding the requested figures, and said the Limburg-Zuid police should not have released social media request data.
As is well known, deliberations in the Council of Ministers are confidential and no statements are made about them.
Zoals bekend zijn de beraadslagingen in de Ministerraad vertrouwelijk en worden hierover geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Timmermans, De Roon, Ormel, Voordewind en El Fassed over het zwijgen van het Westen over de strafkampen in Noord-Korea

Six MPs asked the foreign minister why the West is silent about North Korea's prison camps, citing the HRNK report and asking about international action and China's refoulement of refugees. The minister acknowledged the report, described UN and bilateral efforts (UN resolutions, UPR, raising the issue at the UNGA, funding a Korean NGO) and said North Korea denies the camps, making dialogue difficult.
The Netherlands will again call on North Korea at the 2012 UN General Assembly to improve the human rights situation in the country, referring to the HRNK report.
Dit zal Nederland niet weerhouden tijdens de AVVN 2012 Noord-Korea opnieuw op te roepen de mensenrechtensituatie in het land te verbeteren met verwijzing naar het rapport van HNRK.
Antwoord vragen van de leden El Fassed en Dibi over de communicatiemogelijkheden van gedetineerde vreemdelingen

MPs El Fassed and Dibi asked about the limited internet access, and the lack of email and social media access, for foreign nationals in immigration detention, and whether the UK and Australia are models. The state secretary answered that a pilot in two detention centres allowed restricted access to a whitelist of approved sites, that the pilot was positively evaluated, and that internet facilities will be further developed with a decision on continuation to follow.
Following the positive outcomes of the pilot evaluation, the internet facility for detainees will be further developed, after which a decision on continuation will be taken.

Naar aanleiding van de positieve uitkomsten van de evaluatie van de pilot zal de internetfaciliteit voor ingeslotenen verder ontwikkeld worden, waarna besluitvorming over voortzetting plaats zal vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Fassed over het voorstel van Europese telecombedrijven om online dienstverleners mee te laten betalen aan de kosten voor internetverkeer

An MP asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether an ETNO proposal to make online service providers pay for internet traffic would undermine net neutrality and enable blocking, and whether the government would push for legal net neutrality protection at EU level. The minister answered that the proposal conflicts with Dutch net neutrality law, that it could reduce competition and innovation, and that the Netherlands intends to distance itself from the proposal and has raised net neutrality with the Commissioner and at the Telecom Council.
Based on my current understanding of what the ETNO proposal entails, the Dutch position is to distance itself from the proposal.
Op basis van mijn huidig beeld wat het voorstel van ETNO inhoudt, is de Nederlandse inzet om afstand te nemen van het voorstel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over Export van censuur technologie

MP El Fassed asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers whether Western firms still export censorship technology to countries that violate human rights, whether a list of such firms exists, and what the government is doing on free news gathering, a list of repressive states, and arms trade treaty regulation of dual-use items. Minister Rosenthal replied that it cannot be established whether such exports occur, no company list exists or is desirable, the EU dual-use regulation proposal is expected late 2012, and Dutch efforts to include such goods in the arms trade treaty have found no support.
It is not possible to establish whether companies from European countries and the United States export censorship technology to countries where human rights are violated.
Het is niet mogelijk vast te stellen of bedrijven uit Europese landen en de Verenigde Staten censuurtechnologie exporteren naar landen waar mensenrechten worden geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Fassed en Dibi over de onrechtmatige huiszoeken tegen Megaupload

MPs El Fassed and Dibi asked whether Dutch police and justice cooperated with a US request in the Megaupload case after a New Zealand court ruled the search warrants unlawful for lack of specificity, and whether an independent judicial review will be arranged. The minister answered that the Netherlands has no role in US-to-New Zealand requests, that the incoming request was tested against treaty and Dutch law and carried out under an investigating judge, and that all incoming requests are checked before execution with the same safeguards as domestic investigations.
The Netherlands has no role in legal assistance requests that the American authorities address to the New Zealand authorities.
Nederland heeft geen tussenkomst bij rechtshulpverzoeken die de Amerikaanse autoriteiten richten tot de Nieuw-Zeelandse autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over wapenhandel naar ontwikkelingslanden

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister about arms trade to developing countries, including whether the Oxfam-reported aid and military spending trends are accurate and why a development criterion is absent from the ATT preparation letter. The minister answered that the OECD-DAC could not confirm the Oxfam calculations, that the Netherlands applies a socio-economic development criterion to relevant export licences and supports one in a future treaty, and that it advocates such a criterion in EU and UN settings.
The Netherlands works within the EU for uniform application of criterion 8 of the EU Common Position.
Nederland spant zich in EU-verband in voor uniforme toepassing van criterium 8 van het EU Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over houtkap en landroof in Tanzania voor biobrandstoffen

An MP from GroenLinks asks the state secretary of Foreign Affairs about deforestation and land grabbing in Tanzania for biofuels, including European and Dutch company complicity, compensation for affected farmers, and social sustainability criteria for biofuels. The government answers that it has no concrete evidence of Dutch companies causing land grabbing, points to OECD guidelines and FAO voluntary guidelines, notes the Corbey commission is studying social effects, and defers judgement on EU social impacts until the Commission's late-2012 report.
The commission will soon issue advice on the basis of which the Netherlands will indicate how social criteria can best be incorporated into European regulation.
Binnenkort brengt deze commissie advies uit op basis waarvan Nederland aan zal geven hoe de sociale criteria het beste in de Europese regelgeving ingepast kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over homofobie in Oekraïne

An MP asked the foreign minister about the cancelled Kyiv Pride parade, police protection, alleged gag orders and assaults on participants, and whether EU visa-liberalisation commitments on anti-discrimination are breached by Ukrainian draft laws. The minister answered that Ukrainian authorities did not adequately guarantee a peaceful march, that Dutch and EU partners raised the draft laws with Ukraine, and that adopting comprehensive anti-discrimination legislation is a necessary condition for visa liberalisation.
I consider the actions of the Ukrainian authorities inadequate to guarantee a peaceful course of the demonstration.
Ik acht het handelen van de Oekraïense autoriteiten ontoereikend om een vreedzaam verloop van de manifestatie te garanderen.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over het bericht ‘Helft ontwikkelingskredieten gaat naar Westerse bedrijven’

The MP asks the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about a report claiming that development bank credits mostly flow to Western and listed companies, often in tax havens, and how Dutch support to such banks is assessed. The State Secretary answers that development banks need to finance larger firms, that strict tax-transparency rules apply, that the EIB is bound by EU rules, and that Dutch oversight of multilateral and FMO support is via scorecards and policy consultations, without committing to new measures.
I am not aware of any cases of improper use of money flows by financial intermediaries, and at this moment I see no reason to amend the guidelines.
Mij zijn geen zaken bekend van onjuist gebruik van geldstromen door financiële intermediairs, ik zie dan op dit moment ook geen aanleiding om de richtlijnen aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Peters en El Fassed over de uitspraak van de Turkse premier Erdogan dat abortus moord is

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the foreign minister how the government reacted to Turkish Prime Minister Erdogan's remarks calling abortion murder, and whether the minister would raise this during the royal visit to Turkey. The minister replied that Dutch law permits abortion under conditions reflecting a fundamentally different view, and that women's rights are regularly raised with Turkey, including in EU conclusions, without committing to a specific statement on the visit.
The importance of women's rights is regularly a point of attention in discussions with the Turkish government, including within the framework of the European Commission's progress reports.
Het belang van vrouwenrechten is regelmatig punt van aandacht in gesprekken met de Turkse regering, ook in het kader van de voortgangsrapportages van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Fassed over de Eurowob en open data

An MP asked the state secretary about the stalled EU document-access (Eurowob) negotiations, the narrow definition of documents, protection of legal advice, and open data. The state secretary said no quick agreement is expected, the Netherlands opposes both the draft and the new mandate as a step back in transparency, and legal advice should be assessed case by case.
The Netherlands could not agree to this mandate because the text, like the earlier negotiating mandate, would lead to less transparency and be a step back from the current Eurowob.

Nederland kon niet instemmen met dit mandaat omdat de tekst, net als het eerdere onderhandelingsmandaat, zou leiden tot minder transparantie en een stap terug zou betekenen ten opzichte van de huidige Eurowob.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over Wapentransport naar Syrië

MP El Fassed asked the foreign minister about reports of a Russian arms shipment to Syria, UN arms embargo enforcement, and the role of carriers and sanctions law. The minister could not confirm the shipment, said EU and UN embargoes are generally well observed, described EU measures and Dutch sanctions law covering Dutch nationals and firms abroad, and referred to a separate letter.

In EU matters the Netherlands asks for attention to the role of carriers and transporters in complying with arms embargoes, and has called on EU partners to stress this in their contacts with carriers.

Nederland vraagt in EU-verband aandacht voor de rol van transporteurs en vervoerders in de naleving van wapenembargo's en EU partners opgeroepen om in hun contacten met vervoerders dit te benadrukken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Peters en El Fassed over het opnemen van verzekeringen voor wapentransporten in de sancties tegen Syrië

MPs Peters and El Fassed asked whether insurance for arms shipments to Syria is covered by EU sanctions, whether this should be tightened like the Iran oil-insurance ban, how enforcement works, and whether financial sectors are aware of the rules. The minister answered that EU sanctions ban insuring arms cargo bound for Syria, that Dutch customs (POSS) enforces this and will remind businesses, that at least one ship apparently turned back after insurance was withdrawn, but that many insurers still cover arms cargo and enforcement by insurers is limited.
Given the importance of this matter, these services will again actively bring the information on the sanctions against Syria to the attention of Dutch business.
Gezien het belang van deze materie zullen genoemde diensten de informatie over de sancties tegen Syrië nogmaals actief onder de aandacht van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven brengen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden El Fassed en Van Gent over het bericht dat de RET gesprekken in trams afluistert

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister whether the Rotterdam transport company RET secretly eavesdrops on passengers via cameras with audio in trams and buses, and whether this is lawful and proportionate. The state secretary confirmed some cameras record sound, retrievable only afterwards and not zoomed in on individual conversations, said the data protection authority sees no reason for further investigation, and declined to investigate other transport companies, leaving that to the regulator.
The assessment of the legitimacy and proportionality of recordings such as these is not for me to make but for the CBP.
Het oordeel over de legitimiteit en proportionaliteit van registraties zoals de onderhavige komt niet aan mij toe maar aan het CBP.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over het aannemen door de lidstaten van de Voedsel- en landbouworganisatie FAO van de internationale richtlijnen voor landrechten

MP El Fassed asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs how the Netherlands will adopt and apply the FAO's new Voluntary Guidelines on land tenure, including whether they apply to companies and Dutch banks. The State Secretary welcomed the guidelines, promised to promote them domestically and internationally, and declined further investigation of Dutch bank involvement in land deals, citing no evidence of it.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over online privacy

MP El Fassed asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about online privacy, including whether police monitoring of social media should face the same controls as wiretapping and whether the government will disclose how far social media are monitored. The State Secretary says disclosing monitoring would harm investigations, that wiretap statistics are published annually, and that disclosure of social media monitoring would conflict with the state interest under Article 68 of the Constitution.
In my judgement this is the case here.
Hiervan is naar mijn oordeel in dit geval sprake.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ferrier, Van der Staaij, El Fassed, De Lange, Ouwehand, Hachchi en Irrgang over het bericht dat ruim 18 miljoen mensen in de Sahel worden bedreigd door een humanitaire ramp

MPs asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about the Sahel food crisis affecting 18 million people, its urgency, past prevention efforts, Dutch funding levels, disaster risk reduction, and support for smallholders. The State Secretary answered that the situation is very serious, outlined past Dutch development projects, reported modest extra Dutch emergency contributions and planned bilateral and multilateral efforts, but gave no specific DRR funding breakdown and declined to pledge larger increases.
At present so-called aid tracking of DRR activities, labelling the DRR dimension of development cooperation activities, is not yet possible.
Op dit moment is het zogenoemde «aid tracking» van DRR activiteiten, het labellen van de DRR-dimensie van OS activiteiten, nog niet mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen Braakhuis en El Fassed over het bericht dat Apple belasting ontwijkt via Nederland

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a New York Times report that Apple avoids taxes via the Netherlands, including whether the 'Double Irish with a Dutch sandwich' route is used by hundreds of firms and whether Dutch profits pass tax-free. The State Secretary answered that the term has no legal definition, that Dutch entities mainly earn and pay royalties subject to Dutch corporate tax, that the number of firms using such structures is not relevant, and that he sees no reason to change the Dutch reputation or substance research approach beyond the ongoing substance study.

I note that the margin between royalties received and paid in the Netherlands is fully subject to corporate income tax, and that the size of that margin must be in line with the activities performed in the Netherlands.

Ik merk hierbij op dat de marge tussen in Nederland ontvangen en betaalde royalty gewoon met vennootschapsbelasting belast is en dat de hoogte van die marge in overeenstemming moet zijn met de in Nederland verrichte werkzaamheden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over digitale onveiligheid van de site meermetminder.nl

An MP asked ministers whether the Meer Met Minder subsidy website collects sensitive data such as citizen service numbers and bank details, and what security protects them against identity fraud. The minister confirmed the data collection, described the security architecture (single sign-on, separate database, encrypted transfer to Agentschap NL), reported no unauthorised access so far, and referred to the Wabb and Wbp privacy rules.
The bank account number is needed to transfer the lawful subsidy amount.
Het bankrekeningnummer is nodig om het rechtmatige subsidiebedrag over te maken.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over wapentransport naar Egypte met een Nederlands schip

MP El Fassed asked the ministers whether a Dutch-flagged ship was carrying a military cargo from the US to Egypt, and about Egypt's human rights record, arms export risks, and whether the carrier can be held to account. The government answered that the cargo's destination was not confirmed and not Egypt, that transporting military goods requires no licence, that no action against the shipowner is planned, and that the Wet Strategische Diensten deliberately excludes mere transport services.
No steps against the owner of the chartered ship are being considered because the facts give no cause for them and there is no legal basis on which steps could be taken.

Antwoord 6 Er worden geen stappen tegen de eigenaar van het gecharterde schip overwogen omdat de feiten hier geen aanleiding toe geven (zie antwoord op vraag 2) en omdat er geen juridische grond is op basis waarvan stappen gezet kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over open data en ontwikkelingssamenwerking

An MP asked the state secretary about open data and IATI publication standards for development aid, including progress by Denmark, Germany, Spain and the UK and whether Dutch ministers would press laggard donors. The state secretary confirmed that publishing aid data supports partner-country planning, gave implementation timelines, and said the ministry encourages but does not impose further steps.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over online privacy

MP El Fassed asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about law-enforcement requests for social media user data, including counts of requests, whether Google's publication of request numbers harms investigations, and compliance with the notification duty under article 126bb Sv. The State Secretary declined to publish the counts, said notification compliance is not centrally tracked, and pointed to new guidance for the prosecution offices.
It is not in the interest of investigation to provide this insight, among other things because there is a risk that persons will adjust their behaviour to this information.
Het is niet in het belang van de opsporing om dit inzicht te verschaffen, ondermeer omdat het risico bestaat dat personen hun gedrag op deze informatie gaan afstemmen.

Antwoord vragen Peters en El Fassed over de gebrekkige medewerking van de NAVO bij het onderzoek van de rapporteur van de Parlementaire Assemblee van de Raad van Europa naar de omgekomen bootvluchtelingen uit Libië

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the foreign and defence ministers why NATO failed to cooperate fully with the Council of Europe rapporteur investigating the deaths of 63 boat migrants from Libya, and why no rescue was offered after a distress alert. The ministers replied that NATO cooperated to the extent possible, that some information lies with member states, that NATO did not command the sea area, and that the alert was a search request rather than a distress call, so NATO bore no rescue obligation.
Part of the requested information can only be provided by member states. It concerns a national competence.
Een deel van de gevraagde informatie kan alleen door lidstaten worden aangeleverd. Het betreft een nationale bevoegdheid.
Antwoord vragen Voortman en El Fassed over het bericht dat het UMC St. Radboud patiënten door middel van DigiD toegang geeft tot het patiëntendossier

MPs Voortman and El Fassed asked whether the Radboud UMC may give patients access to their medical records via DigiD, and what oversight prevents misuse and privacy breaches. The minister replied that DigiD level Midden plus a face-to-face identification at the hospital is used, that the hospital is bound by the Wbp under CBP oversight, and that DigiD only authenticates users and does not govern what data they may see.
The UMC St. Radboud is bound by the Personal Data Protection Act (WBP). The College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) supervises this.
Het UMC St. Radboud is gehouden aan de Wet Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (WBP). Het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) houdt hier toezicht op.

Antwoord vragen Voortman en El Fassed over een EU-pilot voor een Europees elektronisch patiëntendossier en de uitspraken van Zorgverzekeraars Nederland inzake het verplicht stellen van aansluiting bij het Landelijk Schak

MPs Voortman and El Fassed asked about privacy safeguards in the EU-pilot EPSOS for a European electronic patient record and about insurers' plans to make connection to the national switchpoint (LSP) a contracting requirement. The minister said EPSOS pilots run only between other countries, that data stays at source with explicit patient consent, and that connection requirements are for the care providers' profession to set, with insurers not yet imposing one.
At this moment there is not yet any requirement to connect to the LSP.
Op dit moment is er nog geen sprake van een eis tot aansluiting op het LSP.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed en Klaver over het gebrek aan open standaarden in het voortgezet onderwijs

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the education minister about the lack of open standards in secondary education, including use of NL-LOM and e-portfolio standards, Magister software access problems and whether accreditation covers digital accessibility. The minister answered that schools bear responsibility under a 'high trust' pas-toe-of-leg-uit principle, cited NOiV activities and Kennisnet/EduStandaard support, and declined further dedicated studies, while promising a round-table discussion on Magister.
National government policy on open standards is based on a 'high trust' principle.
Het rijksbrede beleid ten aanzien van open standaarden is gebaseerd op een «high trust»-principe.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over de situatie van Bradley Manning

El Fassed (GroenLinks) asked the foreign minister whether she knew of UN torture rapporteur Méndez's findings that Bradley Manning was cruelly and inhumanly treated, whether this violates the Convention against Torture, and whether she would raise concerns with the US. Minister Rosenthal said the rapporteur did not conclude torture in Manning's case, that pretrial detention should not be punitive, and that she sees no reason for bilateral action since US compliance is reviewed within the UN framework.
I therefore see no reason in this specific case for bilateral action by the Netherlands towards the US.
Ik zie daarom in dit specifieke geval geen aanleiding voor bilaterale actie van Nederland richting de VS.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over economische schade door opstelling Nederland ten aanzien van Roemenië

MP El Fassed asked the State Secretary whether the Dutch veto against Romania's Schengen accession threatens a Rotterdam–Constanza port cooperation deal and what the economic damage and job losses could be. The government replied that talks are ongoing, the Rotterdam port is vital (3.7% of GDP), the Romanian government is disappointed but relations remain good, and it declined to speculate on economic consequences.
I do not want to speculate about the economic consequences of that.
Ik wil niet speculeren over de economische gevolgen daarvan.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed De aanstelling van een export-admiraal

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether a special export admiral had been appointed, what his remit was, and how it fits with supporting industry amid defence cuts. The minister confirmed the temporary appointment of vice-admiral Nagtegaal as part of a reorganisation pool, with export support to Dutch defence industry in coordination with other departments, and said arms-export licensing advice does not fall under this role.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation is responsible for issuing licences for arms exports.
Het ministerie van EL&I is verantwoordelijk voor het verstrekken van vergunningen voor wapenexport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Fassed over de organisatie Palestinian Media Watch

MPs El Fassed asked the foreign minister about Palestinian Media Watch, its director's past ties to Central Fund of Israel, alleged funding by a foundation linked to a wanted person, and whether the government has an accurate picture of incitement in Israel and the Palestinian territories. The minister confirmed awareness of the outsourcing report, said the director was active there until 2010, gave limited information on the funding and Cherney matter, and stated the cabinet relies on its own observation and diplomatic reporting.
I have no further information about the relationship between Cherney and Palestinian Media Watch.
Ik heb geen nadere informatie over de relatie tussen Cherney en Palestinian Media Watch.
Antwoord vragen De Lange en El Fassed over het dumpen van kippenvlees in Afrika

MPs De Lange and El Fassed asked whether EU and Dutch chicken meat dumping in Africa harms local farmers and undermines food security policy, and whether such export subsidies persist. The government answered that developing countries should use existing WTO trade tools themselves, that the EU's export restitutions will be phased out by 2013, and that effects on food security cannot be generalised.
The Netherlands is of the view that the EU should phase out all export restitutions by 2013 at the latest, regardless of the outcome of the Doha round.
Nederland is daarover overigens van mening dat de EU alle exportrestituties uiterlijk in 2013 uit moet faseren, los van de uitkomst van de Doha-ronde.
Antwoord vragen Eijsink, Hachchi, Jasper van Dijk en El Fassed over het bericht ‘JSF duurder door uitstel aankopen VS’

MPs asked the Defence Minister whether and how the government was informed of the US Pentagon's decision to delay 179 F-35 deliveries over five years, and how information flow through the JSF Program Office had improved. The minister answered that the US notified the Netherlands in January 2012, that the JPO was not responsible for the US order schedule, that he had raised timely information with the JPO director, and that financial effects would be reported to the Chamber by 1 June 2012.

The Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO) is responsible for the development and future further development of the F-35, contract signing, ongoing production of the F-35 aircraft and preparation of maintenance.

Het Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO) is verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling en toekomstige doorontwikkeling van de F-35, de contractsluiting, de lopende productie van de F-35 toestellen en de voorbereiding van de instandhouding.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed en Dibi over de Amerikaanse actie tegen Megaupload en de arrestatie van een Nederlander

MPs El Fassed and Dibi (GroenLinks) asked about the US shutdown of Megaupload, the arrest of a Dutch national, Dutch cooperation via mutual legal assistance requests, and the seizure of Dutch servers. The minister said Dutch cooperation rested on existing treaties, that the servers were seized at US request under a pending foreign investigation, and declined to disclose further details.
I cannot provide further information on the background of the seizure or the content of the servers, because this concerns an ongoing foreign investigation.
Over de achtergronden van de inbeslagname en over de inhoud van de servers kan ik verder geen mededelingen doen omdat het hier een lopend (buitenlands) onderzoek betreft.
Antwoord vragen  El Fassed over Amerikaanse belemmeringen op internetvrijheid

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the US pressured European countries, including the Netherlands, into passing online piracy laws such as SOPA, and how the government assessed SOPA. The minister answered that the Netherlands was not approached, that pressure on other EU states is a bilateral matter, and that the SOPA assessment was given in a separate letter from the economics minister.
The Netherlands has not been approached or pressured by the US to pass legislation.
Nederland is niet benaderd of onder druk gezet door de VS om wetgeving door te voeren.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over gebrek aan openheid over mogelijke tankdeal met Indonesië

MP El Fassed asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reports that Indonesia was kept in the dark about a possible Dutch Leopard tank sale, how the government would implement the parliamentary motion on arms sales to Indonesia, and whether Indonesian parliamentarians had visited the Netherlands. The government answered that confidential talks with interested countries are ongoing, that any agreement would be reported to parliament, that Indonesia was informed of the motion, and that no catalogue or export-country list exists, with overview information provided in the annual MPO.
Should an agreement be reached with one of those countries, it will of course be reported to the House in accordance with the Van den Doel et al. motion.
Mocht het met een van die landen tot een overeenkomst komen, dan zal die uiteraard in overeenstemming met de motie-Van den Doel c.s.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over het rapport “Kosovo and Serbia: A Little Goodwill Could Go a Long Way”

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about the ICG report on Kosovo and Serbia, including whether Serbia's EU candidacy should be conditioned on Kosovo participating in regional meetings without UN chaperoning, on border agreement implementation and on clearing roads to Kosovo. The minister says no additional conditions have been set beyond the December 2011 European Council conclusions, that Serbia's candidacy was not discussed at the PSC, that the Netherlands can support candidate status once those conclusions are met, and that comments on recommendations addressed to third parties are not for the government.
No additional conditions have been set for Serbia to obtain candidate membership.
Er zijn geen aanvullende voorwaarden aan Servië gesteld om het kandidaat-lidmaatschap te verkrijgen.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over Europese wapenexport naar ontwikkelingslanden

An MP asked about incomplete EU arms export reporting for 2010, late submission by some member states, and whether licence refusals under criteria 2, 3 and 8 are adequately documented. The minister answered that several states do not register or pass on actual export values, the deadline was exceeded by some states, the common position sets no reporting deadline, and the Netherlands favours greater transparency in the EU.
The government cannot verify whether the value of actual exports to the Middle East and North Africa in 2010 was greater or smaller than 8.3 billion euro.
De regering kan niet nagaan of de waarde van de daadwerkelijke export naar het Midden-Oosten en Noord-Afrika in 2010 groter of kleiner dan 8,3 miljard euro was.

Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de Resolutie van de Interparlementaire Unie inzake mevrouw Jonsdottir (ingezonden 16 december 2011).

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about an Inter-Parliamentary Union resolution criticising US access to social media data of Icelandic MP Birgitta Jonsdottir without an independent judicial review, and whether the Netherlands would act to protect social media users' rights. The minister replied that Dutch legal safeguards are sufficient, that he cannot comment on the US investigation, and that the Netherlands founded a 15-country Freedom Online coalition to promote internet freedom internationally.
I therefore see no reason in the resolution to take further measures at national level.
Ik zie in de resolutie dan ook geen aanleiding om op nationaal niveau nadere maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over de uitstapmogelijkheden van het JSF-programma

MP El Fassed asked the ministers of Defence and Economic Affairs whether Dutch industry contracts depend on actually buying JSF aircraft, what exit costs and withdrawal conditions apply, and when the government shared these with parliament. Minister Hillen answered that industry has received orders from the development phase, that order allocation depends on US prime contractors and best-value principles, that partial information has been shared confidentially over time, and that Nederland can exit subject to MoU terms with exit costs to be detailed in the 2011 annual report.
It is contained in the Lockheed Martin Letter of Intent that was sent confidentially to the House on 10 October 2006.
Het is opgenomen in de Letter of Intent van Lockheed Martin die op 10 oktober 2006 vertrouwelijk aan de Kamer is gezonden
Antwoord vragen El Fassed, Verhoeven, Voordewind, Eijsink, Jasper van Dijk en Koppejan over het schip de Chariot dat naar verluidt munitie vervoerde met bestemming Syrië

MPs from six parties asked the foreign minister whether Cyprus, Russia and EU partners would be pressed over the ship Chariot, reportedly carrying munitions to Syria in breach of the EU arms embargo, and whether prosecution or Europol/Interpol involvement was possible. The minister confirmed the transit violates the embargo, said Nederland raised it with Cyprus in the EU, would press Russia through the EU, and said primary responsibility for action lies with the flag state and Cyprus.
Primarily it is up to the flag state (Saint Vincent and the Grenadines) or the port state (Cyprus) to take action where possible.
Het is primair aan de vlaggenstaat (Saint Vincent and the Grenadines) of de havenstaat (Cyprus) om waar mogelijk actie te ondernemen.
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (Groenlinks) aan de minister van Defensie over nieuwe problemen met de JSF (ingezonden 16 december 2011).

The MP asks the Defence Minister about a leaked US review of the F-35 programme listing thirteen new technical flaws, and whether these reflect a 'rijden en sleutelen' problem, plus stealth, cost, extended use of older aircraft and reporting. The minister answers that the flaws are known and being fixed through the US test programme, that the Dutch-relevant issues were already reported to parliament, declines to discuss classified stealth details, and commits to evaluating the F-16 replacement project after completion.
I cannot go into classified information.
Ik kan niet ingaan op gerubriceerde informatie.

Vragen van het lid El Fassed (Groenlinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de toegankelijkheid van overheidsdata en buienradar (ingezo

An MP asks whether Buienradar's new owner restricted free weather data for app developers and how the government views companies limiting access to public data. The state secretary replies that developers may still use the data with Buienradar's permission, that the underlying KNMI data remains publicly available, and that open-data policy aims at free or low-cost access.
A restriction of access to government data is not at issue because they remain available from the government.
Een beperking van de toegankelijkheid van overheidsdata is niet aan de orde want ze blijven beschikbaar bij de overheid.
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de export van internetfilters en aftaptechnologie (ingezonden 17 oktober 2011).

An MP asks whether Dutch ICT firms (Fox-IT, Group2000, Digivox, NetScout) have taken concrete steps under international codes of conduct for exporting surveillance and filtering technology, and whether the government will act. The state secretary replies that CSR is primarily the firms' own responsibility, reports each firm's statements, and says the government is pushing at EU level to extend the dual-use regulation to allow ad-hoc licence requirements where human rights abuses are likely.
I am working at European level, together with the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to extend Article 4 of the dual-use regulation.
Ik zet mij er in Europees verband samen met de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken voor in om artikel 4 van de dual-useverordening uit te breiden.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over de grondwetswijziging in Hongarije

An MP asked the government whether it shares concerns that Hungary's Orbán government laws (media, electoral system, judiciary, constitution) breach democratic principles and fundamental rights, and whether it will raise this at EU level or start an Article 7 procedure. The government answered that it shares concerns, that the Commission is investigating, and that it sees no reason yet for an Article 7 procedure.
Like the European Commission and many of our European colleagues, we are concerned about various legislative changes the Orbán government has initiated over the past year.
Wij zijn, net als de Europese Commissie en veel van onze Europese collega’s, bezorgd over verschillende wetswijzigingen die de regering-Órban het afgelopen jaar heeft geïnitieerd.
Vragen van de leden El Fassed en Peters (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over het Palestijns lidmaatschap van UNESCO (ingezonden 4 november 2011).

MPs El Fassed and Peters asked the foreign minister about Palestinian UNESCO membership, Israeli retaliatory measures, the cultural heritage protection and the resumption of peace talks. The minister answered that Dutch opposition rested on the need for a negotiated state first, that Israel's reaction was unhelpful, that no evidence of Hague Convention breaches was found, and that talks had resumed in principle.
These questions have been answered as quickly as possible.
Deze vragen zijn zo snel mogelijk beantwoord.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP) en El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over Google en het ongevraagd gebruik maken van gebruikersdata voo

MPs Gesthuizen (SP) and El Fassed (GroenLinks) asked whether Google, Apple and others collect Wi-Fi location data from consumers' phones without consent and whether a ban is needed. The State Secretary answered that the Data Protection Act gives the regulator enough room to impose a ban if needed, and that consent is the basis for collecting movement data while Wi-Fi router data may be collected under legitimate interest with safeguards.
Such a specific ban is not necessary.
Een dergelijk specifiek verbod is niet nodig.

Vragen van het lid El Fassed (Groenlinks) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de vervolging van wapenhandelaars en extraterritoriale wetgeving (ingezonden 7 november 2011).

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Security and Justice about the Viktor Bout arms trial, Curaçao police involvement, Dutch prosecution of extraterritorial arms brokering, and lessons for an arms trade treaty. The government answered that it lacked knowledge of US/Curaçao investigative methods, that Dutch law allows prosecution of Dutch nationals abroad for arms trade offences, and that it supports a robust UN arms trade treaty.
The Public Prosecution Service informed me that, as far as could be checked in the Netherlands, no investigative acts took place in the Netherlands in support of the American investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij meegedeeld dat voor zover kon worden nagegaan in Nederland geen opsporingshandelingen hebben plaatsgevonden ten behoeve van het Amerikaanse onderzoek.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP) en El Fassed (Groenlinks) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gebruik van spionagesoftware door de Nederlandse overhei

The SP and GroenLinks MPs asked whether Dutch government services bought the German spyware 'Bundestrojaner', on what suspicion it is deployed, how often, and whether its use stays within the law. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, referred to earlier answers on costs and which bodies may use it, said deployment requires a serious offence with pre-trial detention possible, and stated the software should only be used for serious crimes, pointing to earlier answers for safeguards.
I share the view that such software should only be deployed when investigating serious offences.
Ik deel de mening dat dergelijke software enkel dient te worden ingezet bij het onderzoeken van ernstige misdrijven.
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (Groenlinks) aan de minister van Defensie over de risico’s van JSF testtoestellen (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

MP El Fassed asked the Defence Minister about risks of starting F-35 pilot training with low test hours, following a US DOT&E memo recommending delay, and whether Dutch pilots and the Dutch test aircraft delivery schedule are affected. The minister answered that the dispute is between US bodies, that Dutch training is expected to start in late 2012 after the problems are resolved, that no specific test-hour threshold can be given, that delivery dates remain August 2012 and March 2013, and that he trusts the US airworthiness procedure.
The Dutch Ministry of Defence is not involved in this matter.
Het Nederlandse ministerie van Defensie is niet betrokken bij deze kwestie.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Eijsink (beiden PvdA), Jasper van Dijk (SP), Hachchi (D66) en El Fassed (Groenlinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Nederlandse inzet tijdens de Review Conferentie van de

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister how the Netherlands will act at the CCW Review Conference on cluster munitions, including whether a draft Protocol VI with a weaker standard than the CCM should be supported. The minister replied that the Netherlands will push for a protocol with the broadest scope, citing a total ban as the end goal, will promote universalisation of the CCM, and will consider a political declaration if no consensus is reached.
The Netherlands wants a Protocol VI with the broadest possible scope, explicitly including a total ban on cluster munitions as the final goal.
Nederland wil een Protocol VI met zo groot mogelijke reikwijdte, waarin een totaalverbod van clustermunitie expliciet als einddoel wordt opgenomen.

Vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, El Fassed en Peters (allen GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Shell oil paid Nigerian military to put d

MPs from GroenLinks asked whether Shell paid the Nigerian military to suppress protests, and whether the government would press for independent investigation of human rights abuses and require Shell to clean up and compensate in Ogoniland. The ministers answered that the events concern the 1990s, that the UNEP report calls for joint action by all parties, that the Nigerian government must decide on independent inquiry, and that Shell's subsidiary SPDC has engaged on remediation without committing to a specific government-led action.
It is up to the Nigerian government to decide whether independent research should be carried out in addition to the UNEP report.
Het is aan de Nigeriaanse overheid om te bepalen of er in aanvulling op het UNEP-rapport onafhankelijk onderzoek moet komen.

Vragen van het leden Eijsink (PvdA), Hachchi (D66), El Fassed (GL) en Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het massa-ontslag bij BAE systems als gevolg v

MPs asked the ministers about BAE Systems mass layoffs linked to delays and cost overruns in the JSF (F-35) programme and their effects on the Dutch aerospace industry. The government answered that production is ongoing, delays lower near-term output, and the business case will not be re-tendered until accounting checkpoints in 2020 and 2030, while promising no new information beyond existing reports.
I do not have information about the relationship mentioned in question 3, and I cannot make a comparison between the situation in the United Kingdom and that in the Netherlands.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over de in vraag 3 genoemde relatie en ik kan geen vergelijking maken van de situatie in het Verenigd Koninkrijk met die in Nederland.

Vragen van de leden El Fassed en Klaver (beiden GroenLinks) aan minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het gebrek aan open standaarden in het voortgezet onderwijs (ingezonden 5 oktober 2011).

GroenLinks MPs asked the education minister about the lack of open standards in secondary education, including the Magister system and whether it forces Windows purchases, and about whether open standards should be mandatory. The minister answered that open standards are encouraged through the NOiV action plan and existing comply-or-explain rules, but that schools' autonomy means a binding obligation would not be appropriate.
An obligation would therefore not be appropriate.
Een verplichting zou dus niet gepast zijn.
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (Groenlinks) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het gebruik van sociale media door gemeenten (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether municipalities are underusing social media, citing a study showing about half of municipalities use it and 86 percent want to but lack know-how. The minister disputes the underuse framing, says 47 percent use social media, 86 percent intend to develop policy, and points to a guidance publication for municipalities.
I therefore expect that municipalities will further develop their use of social media in the coming period.
Ik verwacht dan ook dat gemeenten hun gebruik van sociale media verder zullen ontwikkelen in de komende periode.
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (Groenlinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «KHRC wants inquiry reports implemented» (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

MP El Fassed asks the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about reports that millions of euros disappeared from Kenya through the Anglo-leasing scandal, some possibly ending up in EU countries, and whether investigations are being pursued. The government answers that the Dutch Rijksrecherche inquiry stalled because Kenyan authorities never responded to its legal assistance request, that investigations are ongoing in several countries, and that it will monitor developments with European partners.
Due to the operational nature of the ongoing investigations, no substantive information is provided on this.
Vanwege het operationele karakter van de nog lopende onderzoeken wordt hierover geen inhoudelijke informatie verstrekt.
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Buitenlandse Zaken over internetcertificaten (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the ministers about the DigiNotar certificate breach, which let Iran intercept Google traffic, covering oversight of the certificate provider, consequences, responsibility and whether private firms should issue government certificates. The government answered that audits and OPTA supervision existed but did not cover the affected certificates, that it is investigating the whole PKI-Overheid system and the hacking, and that it will inform parliament later.
The Cabinet takes the structural significance of the events into account.
Het Kabinet neemt de structurele betekenis van de gebeurtenissen in ogenschouw.
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over de export van clustermunitie en het gebruik in Libië (ingezonden 29 juni 2011).

An MP asks the foreign and defence ministers whether Spain exported MAT-120 cluster munitions to Libya, whether other countries did, and whether NATO allies using such munitions in Operation Unified Protector can be excluded. The minister answers that he has no information on other exporters, that Spain's government found no evidence of a denial by Instalanza, and that NATO reports it does not use cluster munitions.
I have no information on this.

Vragen van de leden Peters en El Fassed (beiden GroenLinks), Pechtold en Hachchi (beiden D66) en Timmermans (PvdA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de mediasituatie in Arabische landen, en

MPs from GroenLinks, D66 and PvdA asked the government about internet and media restrictions in Yemen and Bahrain during protests, including whether the Netherlands would condemn these as strongly as Libya, and what it would do to secure internet access. The government answered that it condemns the restrictions wherever they occur, has raised concerns bilaterally and through the EU, supports media projects, and declined to answer the questions before the scheduled debate.
This has unfortunately not proved possible.
Dit is helaas niet mogelijk gebleken.
Vragen van de leden El Fassed en Braakhuis (beiden GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de huisbankier RBS en clustermunitie (ingezonden 27 mei 2011).

MPs El Fassed and Braakhuis asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about state bank RBS's alleged investments in cluster munitions producers, RBS's assurances, state-supported institutions' services, and the selection criteria for the state's bank. The minister said RBS disputes the report's claims, that the government is reviewing how to respond to a Senate motion on banning such investments, and that it will inform the Senate in writing.
We cannot confirm the claim in the press release, because we are not in a position to establish the accuracy of the press release and the report.
Wij kunnen de stelling in het persbericht niet bevestigen, omdat wij niet in de gelegenheid zijn de juistheid van het bericht en het rapport vast te stellen.
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (Groenlinks) aan de minister van Defensie over het Selected Acquisition Report (SAR) (ingezonden 17 mei 2011).

MP El Fassed asked the Defence Minister whether the 2010 Selected Acquisition Report on the F-35 is publicly available, why the minister said the Pentagon had not released it, and how the minister assesses its cost and schedule data. Minister Hillen answered that the report is online but not released by the Pentagon, that it was sent to Congress in April and not offered to partner countries because it predates recertification and newer cost estimates, and that Defence will inform the House once updated information and the Pentagon's decisions are available.
For the Dutch F-16 replacement project, Defence needs detailed information on the operating costs of the CTOL version in order to update the estimate.
Defensie heeft ten behoeve van het Nederlandse project Vervanging F-16 gedetailleerde informatie nodig over de exploitatiekosten van de CTOL-versie om de raming te kunnen actualiseren.

Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over tegengaan van het gebruik van dual use-goederen voor censuur en aftappen (ingezonden

MP El Fassed asks whether the government will support European Parliament amendments barring dual-use telecom and surveillance exports linked to human rights abuses, and whether pre-export controls and human rights criteria will be applied. The government supports the amendments in substance, says the EU regime relies on exporter responsibility with ex post customs checks, and commits to pursue a human rights basis for individual licence requirements and pre-registration of exporters at EU level.

Because I consider it important for the protection of human rights that companies, alongside self-restraint, also have a framework for deciding on exports of their products, I will work at European level to add this possibility to Article 4 of the dual-use regulation.

Omdat ik er ter bescherming van mensenrechten echter belang aan hecht dat bedrijven naast zelfrestrictie ook een kader hebben om besluiten te nemen over export van hun producten zal ik mij er in Europees verband voor inzetten om deze mogelijkheid toe te voegen aan artikel 4 van de dual-userverordening.
Vragen van de leden Peters en El Fassed (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over de arrestatie van bloggers in de Verenigde Arabische Emiraten (ingezonden 15 april 2011).

MPs Peters and El Fassed asked the foreign minister about the arrest of bloggers Ahmad Mansoor, Fahad Salem al-Shehhi and Nasser bin Ghaith in the UAE, and whether the government would raise their detention, seek their release and voice concern over restrictions on expression and association. The minister confirmed awareness of press reports, said their whereabouts were unknown and that no signs of torture were known, and said the Dutch missions were told to stay alert and the issue would be raised at EU level.
I have therefore told the Dutch missions in the UAE to remain alert on this matter and I will raise the issue within the EU.
Ik heb de Nederlandse vertegenwoordigingen in de VAE daarom gezegd terzake alert te blijven en ik zal de kwestie in EU-verband aan de orde stellen.

Vragen lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het rapport naar aanleiding van het artikel «Order fregatten achter bezoek Beatrix aan Oman»

An MP asked ministers about a possible Dutch frigate/corvette sale to Oman, its anti-piracy role, and whether it was assessed against the arms export criteria on human rights and regional tensions. The government replied that no formal export licence has been requested, only a positive exploratory inquiry (sondage) in 2010, and promised to inform parliament if a formal application is filed.
If an application for an export licence for these corvettes is submitted, the government is, as usual, willing to explain the decision to parliament.
Indien een aanvraag voor een exportvergunning voor deze korvetten wordt ingediend, is de regering, zoals gebruikelijk, bereid om het besluit daarover toe te lichten in de Kamer.

Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over vergunningen voor wapenexport, wapendoorvoer en de export van comp

An MP asked the foreign minister about arms export licences to Saudi Arabia, the human rights situation there, and whether Thales components for Abrams tanks were licensed, given unrest and a risk of use against protesters. The minister said the human rights situation is concerning but has seen cautious improvements, that the 2007 licence was assessed under EU criteria, and that such a request would not now be approved, though the answer to the timing question was not met.
For that reason, such a licence application would not be approved at this time.
Daarom zou op dit moment een dergelijke vergunningsaanvraag niet worden goedgekeurd.
