Vragen van het lid El-Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de deelname van Europese bedrijven aan een conferentie in Dubai over aftappen en filteren van telecommunicatie (

An MP asked the minister whether European firms, including Dutch ones, marketed internet and telephone interception and filtering technology at a Dubai conference to security services in repressive states, and what the government would do about it. The minister replied that such trade is not formally banned but must be corporately responsible, that he will invite the firms to warn them of misuse and asks them to stop cooperating if misuse is threatened, and that he has no overview of existing contracts.
I will shortly invite the relevant companies to the ministry to point out the possible misuse of filtering technology for anti-democratic and repressive purposes.
Ik zal op korte termijn de desbetreffende bedrijven op het ministerie uitnodigen om hen te wijzen op mogelijk misbruik van filtertechnologie voor anti-democratische en repressieve doeleinden.

Vragen van de leden El Fassed en Dibi (beiden GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Veiligheid en Justitie over een mogelijke Amerikaanse strafvervolging van Rop Gonggrijp wegens zijn vermeende betro

MPs El Fassed and Dibi asked whether the Netherlands would cooperate with a possible US prosecution of Rop Gonggrijp over alleged Wikileaks involvement, and about treatment of detainees such as Bradley Manning. The government answered that the US investigation is ongoing with no formal charge known, that any Dutch cooperation would be assessed on a formal request, and that human rights concerns would be raised in the UPR process.
As long as there is no formal summons or charge, the US authorities make no statements about it.
Zolang er geen sprake is van een formele oproep of aanklacht, doen de Amerikaanse autoriteiten daarover geen mededelingen.

Vragen van de leden Dibi en El Fassed (beiden GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Veiligheid en Justitie over een verkenning om strafvervolging van buitenlandse politici in Nederland tegen te gaan

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government is examining how to prevent prosecution in the Netherlands of foreign politicians for human rights violations, and whether this undermines international justice. The minister replied that the study concerns only how the state should handle threatened legal action against foreign officials under international law, that immunity is procedural and not impunity, and that no change of policy is intended.

What I am having examined is how the State should deal with situations in which legal action threatens against foreign government officials who are resident in the Netherlands or intend to come to the Netherlands.

Wat ik laat onderzoeken is hoe de Staat zou moeten omgaan met situaties waarin juridische acties dreigen tegen buitenlandse overheidsfunctionarissen die in Nederland verblijven of voornemens zijn naar Nederland te komen
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Nederlandse wapenexport naar Bahrein (ingezonden 21 februari 2011).

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands exported 35 M-113 and 25 YPR armoured vehicles to Bahrain in 1994-1997, whether such exports were deemed responsible, what guarantees exist against human rights abuses, and whether arms export policy to North Africa and the Middle East should be revised given recent unrest. The minister confirmed the exports as surplus equipment assessed against the EU criteria, said no guarantee against human rights abuses can be given, and said new licence applications to the region will be reassessed, often leading to refusal.

For new licence applications for military equipment to countries in North Africa and the Middle East, it will be examined in light of current developments whether there is a risk that the equipment will be used for human rights violations or domestic repression.

Bij nieuwe vergunningaanvragen voor uitvoer van militair materieel naar landen in Noord-Afrika en het Midden-Oosten, zal in het licht van de huidige ontwikkelingen worden gekeken of er een risico bestaat dat het uit te voeren materieel gebruikt zal worden voor mensenrechtenschendingen of binnenlandse onderdrukking.
Vragen lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris voor Buitenlandse Zaken over het openstellen van data (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about the UK DFID's release of aid data under the IATI standard, whether the Netherlands would implement it, and whether it could publish its data before the Busan forum. The State Secretary welcomed the standard, said implementation would start after mapping technical and organisational consequences, and promised to publish aid data as far as possible before Busan.
Transparency benefits the effectiveness and quality of our efforts.
Transparantie komt de effectiviteit en kwaliteit van onze inspanningen ten goede.

Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over Europese wapenexport naar Noord-Afrika (ingezonden 14 februari 201

An MP asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers about the sharp rise in European arms exports to North Africa, the human rights risk of such exports, EU coordination and suspensions, and support for an Arms Trade Treaty. The minister answered that the increase is driven by large contracts and modernisation (not the 2011 unrest), that each licence is assessed individually against EU criteria, that Germany, Austria, the UK and France put some exports to Egypt on hold, and that Nederland is engaging regional states on the treaty.
I trust that this also applies to other EU member states.
Ik vertrouw erop dat dit ook geldt voor andere lidstaten van de EU.
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het Open Government Initiative (ingezonden 10 februari 2011).

MP El Fassed asked the Interior Minister why the Netherlands was absent from a Washington meeting on the Open Government Initiative, and about the economic value, Dutch vision and follow-up of open government data. Minister Donner answered that the Netherlands was not invited to an informal White House meeting, that the economic value is unproven and no Dutch analysis exists, and that a policy letter on open data would follow before the May recess.
As I promised you during the committee meeting on large ICT projects on 17 February, I will send you a policy letter on reuse of government information and open data before the May recess.

Zoals ik u heb toegezegd tijdens het AO «grote ICT projecten» van donderdag 17 februari jl. zal ik u nog voor het meireces een beleidsbrief over hergebruik van overheidsinformatie en open data toesturen.

Vragen van de leden El Fassed en Dibi (beiden GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de dagvaarding van het bedrijf Twitter door Amerikaanse autoriteiten

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice and the Foreign Minister about a US subpoena to Twitter for user data of Dutch and European citizens, and whether such data is adequately protected abroad. The government answered that the request is a US internal matter, that it concerns non-content user and traffic data, that EU data protection depends on adequacy findings, and that Twitter Inc. is not evidently covered by Safe Harbor.
The request concerns an internal American matter that must therefore be assessed by the American authorities.
Het verzoek betreft een interne Amerikaanse aangelegenheid die dan ook door de Amerikaanse autoriteiten moet worden beoordeeld.

Vragen van de leden El Fassed en Van den Berge (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het rapport «Vrij Verkeer: Nederlandse wapendoorvoer onder de Algemene Douanewet» (inge

Two MPs asked the minister about a report claiming Dutch arms transit under the Customs Act is largely unchecked, including a 2008 Czech arms shipment to Sri Lanka and the treatment of transit to Suriname and Ecuador. The government answered that transit to allies is checked via licence or notification rules, that over 90% of transit runs under an ally's export licence and is not re-tested by the Netherlands, and that no ad hoc licence requirement was imposed in the period.
In practice, the vast majority of transit transactions take place under an export licence from an ally, so more than 90% of military goods transit is not subject to a separate Dutch review.

Wel is het zo dat in de praktijk de overgrote meerderheid van de doorvoertransacties onder een uitvoervergunning van een bondgenoot plaatsvindt en dat dus meer dan 90% van de doorvoer van militaire goederen niet aan een eigen Nederlandse toetsing wordt onderworpen.

Vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en El Fassed (beiden GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een Ivoriaanse exportban op cacao (ingezonden 27 januari 2011

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers whether the government supports President Ouattara's call for a cocoa export ban in Ivory Coast to cut off funds to Gbagbo's regime, and how the Netherlands and Amsterdam port would be involved. The minister answered that the Netherlands respects Ouattara's choice, supports EU sanctions aimed at Gbagbo's funds while sparing the population, and will consider effects on the cocoa trade and Amsterdam port.
The Netherlands has recently supported various sanctions measures within the EU aimed at blocking the money flows of Mr Gbagbo and his supporters.
Nederland heeft recent in EU-verband diverse sanctiemaatregelen ondersteund die gericht zijn op het blokkeren van de geldstromen van de heer Gbagbo en zijn aanhangers.

Vragen van de leden Grashoff en El Fassed (beiden GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over een fonds voor de opbouw van het Afghaanse leger. (Ingezonden 16 december 2010)

GreenLeft MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether reports that Germany questioned US spending of Afghan army trust fund money were accurate, whether the Netherlands had been kept informed of spending from its contributions, and how the government supervises spending and administrative costs. The minister replied that the Dutch contributions to the ANA Trust Fund are managed by NATO, which reports on spending and provides an audit statement, with administrative costs of 4% within the 7.5% limit, and that Dutch money may only go to non-lethal equipment.
The Dutch contribution is managed by NATO. NATO reports on the expenditures made.
De Nederlandse bijdrage wordt door de NAVO beheerd. Over de gedane bestedingen wordt door de NAVO gerapporteerd.
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het massaproces tegen Turks-Koerdische politici (ingezonden 7 januari 2011).

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the government is aware of the upcoming mass trial of Turkish-Kurdish politicians, how it views the proceedings, and whether it will follow the case actively and attend the trial itself or at EU level. The minister answered that the Netherlands closely follows such cases with EU partners and the Commission to assess fair trial standards, and that the Dutch embassy attended the first day of the trial.
To be able to assess whether there is a fair and independent judicial process, the Netherlands follows these cases closely.
Om te kunnen beoordelen of sprake is van een eerlijke en onafhankelijke rechtsgang, volgt Nederland deze zaken op de voet.
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over wapenexport (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

An MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Foreign Affairs about arms export licences to Venezuela and Sri Lanka, including whether reports misreported destinations and values and whether a Czech-to-Sri Lanka transit was exempt from licensing. The state secretary answered that the Venezuela policy and criterion 4 basis are unchanged, that a 2007 value error was corrected, that transit exemption applies to EU member states, and that Sri Lanka exports are restricted and assessed case by case.
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de blokkade van Gaza (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether Israel had failed to honour its commitments to ease the Gaza blockade, citing reduced construction material imports and the closure of exports, and whether the government would call for an end to the blockade. The minister acknowledged that access remains insufficient for reconstruction, said the government and EU encourage further easing and have pressed Israel bilaterally, but did not commit to calling for an end to the blockade.
The Dutch government and the EU encourage the Israeli authorities to further ease the movement of goods and persons.
De Nederlandse regering en de EU moedigen de Israëlische autoriteiten aan om de beweging van goederen en personen verder te versoepelen.

Vragen van de leden Van Bommel (SP), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en Defensie over ontvoering van dorpelingen in Rawagedeh op 9 december 1947 (ingezonden 17

MPs Van Bommel, Voordewind and El Fassed asked whether Dutch troops abducted five men and boys during the 9 December 1947 Rawagedeh operation, and whether the government would investigate and inform parliament. Minister Rosenthal replied that no information on abductions is available in the sources, saw no value in further research, and agreed to inform parliament before the budget debate.
I do not have information about the possible abduction of five persons during the actions of the Dutch armed forces in Rawagedeh on 9 December 1947.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over de mogelijke ontvoering van vijf personen tijdens de acties van de Nederlandse krijgsmacht in Rawagedeh op 9 december 1947.

Vragen van de leden Klaver en El Fassed (beiden GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het programma «Sport en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking» (ing

GroenLinks MPs asked which projects and organisations receive funding from the Sport and Development budget, whether any 2011 recipients are known, and whether the budget finances the Dutch-Belgian World Cup bid. The state secretary listed the countries, ministries and organisations involved, said most projects run through 2011, and stated that no development aid goes to the World Cup bid.
No, no development aid funding is made available for the World Cup football bid.
Nee, er wordt geen OS-geld beschikbaar gesteld voor de kandidatuur van het WK-voetbal.
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over kernwapens op Vliegbasis Volkel tijdens de Cubacrisis (ingezonden 21 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that nuclear bombs were available at Volkel air base during the 1962 Cuban crisis, whether a pilot had agreed not to speak publicly about Volkel, and the status of a motion on withdrawing US nuclear weapons from Europe. The government declined to give numbers or locations of US nuclear weapons citing alliance agreements, denied knowledge of any agreement with the pilot, and pointed to earlier letters and NATO Strategic Concept work on the motion.
Regarding the numbers and locations of American nuclear weapons present in Europe, no statements can be made on the basis of alliance agreements.
Over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens kunnen op grond van bondgenootschappelijke afspraken geen mededelingen worden gedaan.

Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de gevangenneming van de Rwandese oppositieleidster Victoire Ingabire Umuhoza (ingezonden 1 november 2010).

El Fassed (GroenLinks) asked the Foreign Minister how the government assesses freedom of expression and the independence of the judiciary in Rwanda, the detention conditions of suspects, and what the Dutch embassy has done to ensure a fair trial of opposition leader Victoire Ingabire Umuhoza. The minister answered that the government is concerned about restrictions on expression and that the judiciary has made progress and is largely independent, that embassy staff attend the trial and raised it in EU dialogue, and that the answer to the one-week question could not be given in time.
The criminal trial against Ms Umuhoza Ingabire was also raised with the Rwandan government during the EU's political article 8 dialogue on 2 November.
Het strafproces tegen mevrouw Umuhoza Ingabire werd daarnaast tijdens de politieke artikel 8 dialoog van de EU op 2 november jl. aan de orde gesteld bij de Rwandese regering.
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over Q-koorts (ingezonden 1 oktober 2010).

MP El Fassed asked the ministers of Agriculture and Health about reports that government responded hesitantly to Q-fever, whether the national government saw it as a regional problem, whether ministries cooperated well and whether goat culling was necessary. The state secretary largely deferred the cooperation and culling questions to a pending evaluation commission report and restated the government's position against collective compensation for patients.
This report will, with a policy response from the minister of VWS and me, be submitted to the House of Representatives.
Dit rapport zal, voorzien van een beleidsreactie van de minister van VWS en mij, worden aangeboden aan de Tweede Kamer

Vragen van de leden El Fassed en Peters (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de werkzaamheden van Midden-Oosten Kwartetvertegenwoordiger Tony Blair (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

MPs El Fassed and Peters asked the foreign minister about Quartet envoy Tony Blair's work on the Wataniya telecom deal, his JP Morgan links, Dutch support, and his office's funding and accommodation. The minister answered that Blair acts within his Quartet mandate, that the Netherlands is not a donor to his office and sees no conflict of interest or need to investigate, and declined to press Blair on his finances or housing.
The Netherlands is not a donor and also sees no need to look into the financial position of the Quartet Representative himself.
Nederland is geen donor en ziet ook geen noodzaak zich te verdiepen in de financiële positie van de Kwartetvertegenwoordiger zelf.

Vragen van de leden Peters en El Fassed (beiden GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over het boek «Missie in Al Muthanna» van het Nederlands Instituut voor Militaire Historie (NIMH) (ingez

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether Dutch troops in Al Muthanna, Iraq, exceeded their mandate and became part of the occupying force, contrary to government statements, and whether Parliament was properly informed. The minister answered that Resolution 1483 placed the Netherlands among the non-occupying 'other countries', that the mandate boundaries were reached in practice but not exceeded, and that Parliament was regularly informed.
Information on the conduct of Dutch military personnel within SFIR was shared extensively with the House, including through periodic information provision and the final evaluation of the mission.

Informatie over het optreden van de Nederlandse militairen in het kader van SFIR is uitgebreid met de Kamer gedeeld, onder andere in de periodieke informatieverstrekking aan de Kamer en de eindevaluatie van de missie
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het optreden van de Verenigde Naties in Congo (ingezonden 16 september 2010).

MP El Fassed asked the foreign minister how the Congolese government is held to account for protecting civilians, whether MONUSCO's mandate and the ISSSS strategy are adequate, how Dutch oversight works, and what security-sector reform criteria apply. The minister answered that Nederland raises protection issues bilaterally and multilaterally, that MONUSCO's mandate is robust but not fully used, and that Nederland monitors the ISSSS through its own staff and an independent evaluation.
The Netherlands regularly discusses these issues in bilateral contacts with the Congolese authorities.
Nederland bespreekt deze kwesties regelmatig in de bilaterale contacten met de Congolese autoriteiten
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over hulp bij de ramp in Pakistan (ingezonden 19 augustus 2010).

MP El Fassed asked the foreign minister about the use of the UN Central Emergency Response Fund for flood victims in Pakistan, including whether NGOs can access it directly. The minister answered that the fund is legally limited to UN agencies and IOM, that NGOs are involved indirectly through them, and that procedures and evaluation have been strengthened.
The resolution (46/182 of 19 December 1991) establishing the CERF only allows funding of UN organisations and entities (read IOM).
De resolutie (46/182 d.d. 19 december 1991) waarmee het CERF werd opgericht staat alleen financiering van VN-organisaties en entiteiten (lees IOM) toe.
Vragen van het lid El Fassed (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over gekloond vlees (ingezonden 6 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether meat from offspring of cloned cattle could reach the Dutch market, whether cloned-animal meat is safe, whether rules should be tightened, and whether the ethical debate on animal cloning is sufficient. The minister said such meat could theoretically have reached the market, cited FDA and EFSA findings of no food-safety difference, and declined to commit to new rules or a position on the ethical debate pending future policy.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Besselaar, Van Klaveren en Wilders over "het ‘ramadan-proof’ maken van cao’s"

PVV MPs asked whether collective labour agreements should accommodate Ramadan, asked about economic costs of Ramadan fasting, and whether Muslims should work in Islamic countries. The minister answered that employers and employees may agree facilitation of religious activities, that direct discrimination on religion is prohibited under equal treatment law, that costs are unknown, and that such arrangements are the employee's own responsibility.
It is the employee's own responsibility to make good arrangements with the employer when he or she wishes to take time off work to take part in such activities in private life.

Het is de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de werknemer om goede afspraken met zijn werkgever te maken wanneer hij of zij vrij wil nemen van het werk voor deelname aan dergelijke activiteiten in de privésfeer.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van den Besselaar en Wilders over de tweede kwartaalcijfers van de vier grootste pensioenfondsen

PVV MPs asked the minister why pension fund coverage ratios fell after record-low interest rates, whether the valuation method is to blame, and what concrete short-term measures will be taken, including returning to a fixed 4% discount rate and spreading recovery deadlines. The minister attributed the decline mainly to market and life-expectancy developments, rejected returning to the fixed rate, and only promised a package of measures in September.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Beertema, Van den Besselaar en Fritsma over het bericht dat Amsterdam illegale buitenlandse jeugd stages aanbiedt

PVV MPs asked whether Amsterdam offering internships to students without residence permits is acceptable and whether fines should apply per case. The minister referred to a letter of 25 June 2012 announcing an appeal against a court ruling, and to earlier answers, without substantively answering the questions.
For answering your question I refer to the letter sent to your House on 25 June 2012, in which the cabinet announces it will appeal a ruling of the Hague District Court.

Voor de beantwoording van uw vraag verwijs ik naar de brief die wij uw Kamer op 25 juni 2012 (Kamerstukken II 2011/12, 32 144, nr. 16 ) hebben toegezonden, waarin het kabinet aankondigt in hoger beroep te zullen gaan tegen een uitspraak van de rechtbank Den Haag.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Van den Besselaar en Helder over de Midden- en Oost-Europese misdaadgolf die over ons land trekt

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Immigration and of Security and Justice about a Central and Eastern European crime wave, including whether the open borders policy was naive, whether a dedicated police chief should be appointed, and whether expulsion and entry bans are the most effective response. The minister replied that free movement brings economic benefits alongside crime risks, that measures on mobile gangs have been taken, that a separate police chief is unnecessary, and that expulsions and unwelcome declarations are used alongside preventive and European cooperation measures.
The cabinet has therefore taken measures to combat and prevent crime committed by mobile gangs from Central and Eastern Europe.
Het kabinet heeft daarom maatregelen genomen om criminaliteit die gepleegd wordt door mobiele bendes uit Midden- en Oost Europa te bestrijden en te voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen Van den Besselaar en Wilders over het bericht van De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) over mogelijke korting van pensioenen

PVV MPs Van den Besselaar and Wilders asked the minister whether DNB should limit its public communication about possible 2013 pension cuts to pension funds, and whether cuts should be suspended while the European crisis lasts. The minister replied that the cuts were foreseeable, that funds bear primary responsibility for informing members, and that he will not agree to a suspension of cuts.
This does not alter the fact that it is primarily the task of pension funds to inform their participants about fund-specific matters.
Dit laat onverlet dat het primair de taak van pensioenfondsen is om hun deelnemers over fondsspecifieke aangelegenheden te informeren.

Two PVV MPs asked the minister whether giving free bicycles to unemployed people in Rotterdam rewards them and who controls such handouts, and whether re-integration funds are being misused. The state secretary replied that the bicycles were given by a re-integration firm from its own funds only to people who had accepted a job, that the alderman considers such extra rewards undesirable and has agreed to consult the firm in advance, and that no re-integration budget is involved.
As the alderman informed the Rotterdam municipal council, the re-integration firm only provided a bicycle to people who had accepted a job.
Zoals de wethouder aan de gemeenteraad van Rotterdam heeft laten weten, heeft het betreffende re-integratiebedrijf alleen een fiets verstrekt aan mensen die een baan hebben aanvaard.

PVV MPs asked why UWV and Amsterdam hold different addresses for many benefit recipients, whether bulk data matching and benefit suspension for persons registered as untraceable are planned, and whether GBA address controls are sufficient. The minister said UWV may use correspondence addresses in limited cases, committed to legislation allowing benefit suspension and sharing of divergent addresses with municipalities, and to annual municipal address checks.
I consider it desirable that addresses can be shared between governments because citizens must never make themselves untraceable to the government, whether deliberately or not.
Ik vind het wenselijk dat adressen door overheden aan elkaar kunnen worden doorgegeven omdat burgers zich nooit – opzettelijk of onopzettelijk – onvindbaar mogen maken voor de overheid.

The minister said the fee passage in the court ruling contained a typo, that supervisors alone may request such information and are bound by confidentiality, that members can raise concerns with the accountability body and as a last resort the Ondernemingskamer, and that a cost-reporting guideline is due in November 2011.
The Pension Act provides that only the supervisors, DNB and AFM, have the authority to request information from pension funds.
In de Pensioenwet is bepaald dat alleen de toezichthouders, DNB en AFM, de bevoegdheid hebben om informatie op te vragen bij pensioenfondsen.

An MP asks the minister about the SVB's control action against alleged 'ghost AOW' pensioners abroad, questioning its 0.36% fraud estimate, the low recovery amount, and the cost-effectiveness of home visits in other countries. The minister answers that 0.36% is a modelled residual misuse risk rather than measured fraud, that enforcement spending covers all benefits and yields more than it costs, and that foreign checks are risk-based and deter misuse.
The 0.36% figure is not a 'fraud percentage' but the maximum residual misuse risk estimated by the SVB on the basis of a theoretical model.
Het bedoelde percentage van 0,36% betreft niet een «fraudepercentage» maar het door de SVB op basis van een theoretisch model geschatte maximaal resterend misbruikrisico.
Vragen van het lid Van den Besselaar (PVV) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht «Verboden arbeid soms gewoon toegestaan» (ingezonden 12 april 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether a Raad van State ruling allowing Turkish workers without a work permit to avoid fines under the Wet arbeid vreemdelingen would lead to more abuse and what measures would close the gap, including denouncing the 1973 protocol. The minister said he sees no need to amend the law, expects the ruling not to void fines, and will seek a preliminary reference to the EU Court of Justice if the issue returns, without initiating termination of the association agreement.

Should this issue come before the Council of State again in the future, I will promote that the Council of State submits it to the Court of Justice of the European Union in the form of preliminary questions.

Mocht deze kwestie in de toekomst nog eens bij de Raad van State aan de orde komen, dan zal ik bevorderen dat deze door de Raad van State in de vorm van prejudiciële vragen aan het Hof van Justitie van de Europese Unie zal worden voorgelegd.

Zie antwoord 6 op vragen van de leden Van Hijum (CDA) en Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over uitkeringen in Turkije

I can both request an assurance statement from an accountant and, if necessary, have further investigation carried out.
Ik kan zowel vragen om een assuranceverklaring van een accountant als – indien nodig – nader onderzoek uit laten voeren.

The state secretary says UWV acted on early suspicions, the Public Prosecution Service is examining how medical confidentiality hampers criminal investigations, and the government will decide next steps after that review.
On that basis, together with the Minister of Security and Justice, we will consider which follow-up steps are necessary.
Op basis daarvan zullen wij samen met de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie bezien welke vervolgstappen noodzakelijk zijn.

In de Hoofdlijnenbrief Emancipatie, die naar verwachting in april 2011 naar de Kamer gaat, zal het kabinet nader ingaan op het bevorderen van de maatschappelijke participatie
Antwoord vragen van de leden Rog en Heerma over een tekort aan stageplaatsen in het middelbaar beroepsonderwijs (mbo)

Het kabinet houdt de ontwikkeling van de jeugdwerkloosheid nauwgezet in de gaten en treedt in gesprek met sociale partners om te bezien of aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn.

Inzicht in derivatenposities van decentrale overheden is op Rijksniveau niet voorhanden.

De Inspectie SZW heeft een boeterapport opgemaakt.

Antwoord vragen Verhoeven over het gebruik van cookies op de websites van de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep

Nee, ik vind dat de NPO zich aan de wet moet houden en de gebruikers goed moet informeren over het gebruik van cookies.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Ham inzake het bericht dat basisscholen meer zullen moeten snijden

MP Van der Ham asked whether a Deloitte study showing primary schools cutting staff while still facing shortfalls, and claims that cuts stem from overstaffing rather than funding cuts, justify the pressure on schools and quality. The state secretary answered that staff fell 5% against a 1% drop in pupils, that quality is reported as rising, that funding is protected but declines with pupil numbers, and that the Audit Office study and an interdepartmental policy study on demographic decline have been commissioned.
Following the Linthorst motion, I have asked the Algemene Rekenkamer to investigate the adequacy of the funding.
Ik heb naar aanleiding van de motie Linthorst c.s. de Algemene Rekenkamer verzocht onderzoek te doen naar de toereikendheid van de bekostiging
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mohandis inzake het schrikbewind dat conciërges, onderwijsassistenten en administratief personeel op school zouden ervaren

An MP asked the education minister how she assesses a CNV Onderwijs study reporting a 'reign of terror' by pupils against school support staff, and whether schools should have safety policies. The state secretary acknowledged the incidents, pointed to the government's safety monitor and existing school safety obligations, and said she would convene employer and union organisations to address aggression in education.
I have invited the employers' organisations and trade unions to enter into consultation soon to arrive at a joint approach to aggression in education.
Ik heb de werkgeversorganisaties en vakbonden uitgenodigd om op korte termijn met elkaar het overleg aan te gaan om tot een gezamenlijke aanpak van agressie in het onderwijs te komen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rog inzake het bericht “Conciërges vogelvrij”

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education about a CNV union study reporting widespread verbal and physical aggression against school support staff, comparing it with government safety figures, and asked for registration of incidents and an action plan. The State Secretary answered that the government's own monitor shows 7% of staff feel unsafe, that a joint approach with sector bodies and unions is planned, and that sentencing data for aggression against public-service workers is being tracked.
Together with the sector organisations and unions I will soon sit down to reach agreements on a joint approach to aggression and violence in education for the coming period.

Samen met de sectororganisaties en de vakbonden zal ik binnenkort om de tafel gaan om tot afspraken over een gezamenlijke aanpak tegen agressie en geweld in het onderwijs te komen voor de komende periode.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Beertema inzake het tekort bij basisscholen in Amsterdam Oost.

An MP asks the minister about a reported 10.8 million euro deficit at Amsterdam Oost primary schools, including whether the STAIJ board and supervisory body failed and whether the district council acting as supervisor is appropriate. The answers state that school boards are responsible for their finances, that the district council is the supervisor under the statutes, and that the municipality plans to revise supervision.
The municipality of Amsterdam intends to revise the supervisory role over public education, currently vested in the district councils.
De gemeente Amsterdam is voornemens om de toezichthoudende rol op het openbaar onderwijs- nu belegd bij de stadsdelen- te herzien.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mohandis over een nieuwe, eenvoudige Cito-toets voor leerlingen met taal- een rekenproblemen

An MP asked whether an easier Cito end-of-primary test for pupils with language and arithmetic difficulties, and its possible effects on advice and stigma, was justified. The state secretary answered that Cito designs the Eindtoets Niveau, that it is scored on the same scale as the regular test so advice stays the same, and that schools already manage two-level tests without extra instruction.
The answer to the previous question also applies to possible over-advising: taking the Eindtoets Niveau leads to the same advice as taking the Eindtoets Basis.
Het antwoord op de voorgaande vraagt geldt eveneens voor mogelijke overadvisering: deelname aan de Eindtoets Niveau leidt tot hetzelfde advies als deelname aan de Eindtoets Basis.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voordewind inzake het bericht dat de werkloosheid in het onderwijs stijgt

An MP asked the education minister about the rise in unemployment benefit claims among education workers, its regional distribution, and whether the government will retain young teachers and address temporary contracts. The minister attributed the rise to pupil decline, anticipated budget cuts and staffing adjustments, said retention is primarily the employers' task, and stated the government has no data on temporary contracts ending before summer.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Smits over een groot tekort aan stages in de zorg

MPs Leijten and Smits asked the state secretary for Health about reports of a large shortage of internship places in care, why internship-fund-financed places are cut, whether students are being removed from training, and what will be done. The state secretary answered that nationally there is no general shortage, that the internship fund has increased realised placements, that no places were cut in the region concerned, and that no additional measures are needed for now.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het gebrek aan voortgang van de ambitie om meer vrouwen in topfuncties te benoemen

An MP asked the government why the share of women in top public-sector posts has stagnated and what role government should play in reaching the 30% target. The minister reports a small rise in women among senior civil servants (20% in 2008 to 25.9% in 2012), attributes slow progress largely to cuts, and defers the question of a government role to the incoming cabinet.
Whether and to what extent the government should have an exemplary role in the coming years is a matter for the new cabinet.
Of en in hoeverre de overheid de komende jaren een voorbeeldfunctie moet hebben is een zaak voor het nieuwe kabinet.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over het doden van kikkers voor consumptie

An MP asks the ministers whether a broadcast promoting frog's legs for consumption is acceptable for public broadcasting, whether a ban on importing and selling frog legs should be introduced, and whether research into how frogs are caught and killed in Europe will be done. The minister says the broadcaster is responsible for its own content, the state secretary sees no need for a national import ban, and no research is planned.
The State Secretary for EL&I does not intend to carry out research into the scale and methods by which frogs are caught and killed in Europe for human consumption.
De Staatssecretaris van EL&I is niet voornemens onderzoek te doen naar de schaal en de wijzen waarop kikkers in Europa worden gevangen en gedood ten behoeve van de humane consumptie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem en Jadnanansing van uw Kamer inzake de huur van een skybox door Consent

Two PvdA MPs asked the education minister about reports that school board Consent rented a FC Twente skybox using education funds, asked staff to volunteer there, and closed a deficit by enlarging classes. The minister confirmed the rental, said the Inspectorate monitors lawful use of public funds and has questioned the board, and declined to pre-empt the Inspectorate's findings on the board's quality.
However, I do not want to anticipate the findings of the Inspectorate.
Ik wil echter niet vooruitlopen op de bevindingen van de Inspectie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosma over een intensieve mediacampagne via de Stichting Ether Reclame (STER) gericht tegen Nederlanders die kritisch staan tegenover de massa-immigratie en de islam

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether a SIRE tolerance advertising campaign on STER airtime, which portrayed critics of mass immigration and Islam as intolerant, is consistent with the public broadcasting pluralism duty and whether STER should be pressed to give both sides airtime. The minister answered that STER must accept third-party ads that meet the Reclame Code Commissie rules, that anyone may offer an ad without government stimulus, and that as minister she will not comment on media content given constitutional and statutory programmatic autonomy.
As minister responsible for the media, I consider it neither credible nor advisable to express myself on media content.
Als minister die verantwoordelijk is voor de media, acht ik het geloofwaardig noch raadzaam om mijzelf uit te spreken over media-inhoud
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ypma over de betrokkenheid van ouders bij passend onderwijs

An MP asked the education minister how parents would be involved in individual support plans, the governance of special-needs collaboration bodies, the availability of education advisers, and teacher training on parental partnership. The minister answered that development plans will be agreed with parents, that parents can appeal to the national dispute committee, that the inspectorate will check parental consent in support plans, and that education advisers will be retained with extra funding.
If parents nevertheless disagree with the established development perspective, they can request a judgment from the national dispute committee for inclusive education.
Zijn ouders het desondanks niet eens met het vastgestelde ontwikkelingsperspectief, dan kunnen zij hierover een oordeel vragen aan de landelijke geschillencommissie passend onderwijs.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rog inzake pestgedrag op basisscholen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education about bullying in primary schools, including teacher training, citizenship education and the Vreedzame School programme. The minister answered that teacher training already covers bullying under the competence requirements, that respectful behaviour is a school task to be addressed later by the next cabinet, and that schools may choose from available programmes.
I therefore assume that teacher training programmes devote sufficient attention to recognising bullying and learning to change a negative group dynamic.
Ik ga er dan ook van uit dat lerarenopleidingen voldoende aandacht besteden aan het herkennen van pestgedrag en het leren veranderen van een negatieve groepsdynamiek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jasper Van Dijk over de verplaatsing van het televisieprogramma Tegenlicht

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the VPRO's Tegenlicht would be moved to late evening because of ratings, and whether ratings were being given too much weight at the public broadcaster. The minister replied that talks with the VPRO were ongoing, that quality and reach also count in programming, and that schedules are set by the NPO board together with the broadcasters.
Naturally, alongside ratings, quality and reach of programmes play a major role in programming.
Vanzelfsprekend spelen, naast kijkcijfers, juist ook de kwaliteit en het bereik van programma's een grote rol in de programmering.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mohandis over het gebruik van een schoollokaal voor flexwerkers

An MP asked the education minister whether a Arnhem Jenaplan primary school renting a vacant classroom to flexworkers was a model for other schools, and whether legal barriers exist. The minister called it a creative experiment to be evaluated in six months, said school boards decide community links, and explained the statutory rules on letting classrooms under article 108 WPO.
An evaluation will take place in half a year. I am curious about its outcomes.
Over een half jaar vindt er een evaluatie plaats. Ik ben benieuwd naar de uitkomsten daarvan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem en Van Dekken over de uitwerking van de fusietoets in krimpgebieden

Two PvdA MPs asked the education minister how the merger test (fusietoets) affects schools in shrinking regions that want to merge to safeguard quality. The minister said the test's justification grounds already allow such mergers, declined to soften the test for now pending an interdepartmental study due in spring 2013, and pointed to existing financial compensation for merging primary schools.
This year it will still be considered whether these signals should lead to an adjustment of the policy rule.
Nog dit jaar zal worden bezien of deze signalen zouden moeten leiden tot aanpassing van de beleidsregel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Meenen inzake het bericht dat studenten worden geremd in hun ambitie

An MP asked the minister about a student facing 60,000 euro in institutional tuition for a second medical degree, whether such cases stack up, whether the rule change was fair, whether it is a flaw for biomedical graduates, and whether it deters ambitious students in health and teaching. The state secretary answered that the exception for second studies in health and education is for labour market shortages, that institutions set institutional tuition with works-council advice, that the rules date from 2010 with a planned evaluation, and that the policy aims to encourage students in these sectors.
It is up to each institution to determine, with reasons, which institutional tuition it charges students.
Het is aan elke instelling om gemotiveerd te bepalen welk instellingscollegegeld zij studenten in rekening brengt.
Antwoord vragen Dijsselbloem over de consequenties van uitspraken van de rechtbanken Den Haag en Haarlem over absoluut schoolverzuim bij gebrek aan passend onderwijs en schuld zonder strafoplegging

Dijsselbloem (PvdA) asked the education minister what consequences follow from district court acquittals of parents of a child with dyspraxia who had been out of school for over a year, and whether 'guilty without punishment' was a satisfactory outcome. The minister declined to judge the case on the summary information available, affirmed that every child must be offered suitable education, and pointed to education consultants and the new care duty as tools, while stating she has no legal means to force a school placement.
I do not have legal means to get a student placed at a school.
Ik beschik niet over wettelijke middelen om een leerling op een school geplaatst te krijgen.
Antwoord vragen Dijsselbloem over de rol van de medezeggenschapsraden bij het oprichten van samenwerkingsverbanden ten aanzien van passend onderwijs

An MP asked whether school participation councils have advisory rights over the formation of passend onderwijs collaboration bodies and what the government will do to ensure parents, pupils and teachers are not faced with a fait accompli. The minister replied that no signals of exclusion were received, that the inspectorate does not supervise council participation in formation, that formation is legally regulated so councils lack advisory rights there, and that the support plan council retains consent rights and a support centre is being set up.
The participation of the support plan council in the support plan cannot be limited by what is laid down in the statutes of the collaboration body.
De inspraak van de ondersteuningsplanraad op het ondersteuningsplan kan niet beperkt worden door wat in statuten van het samenwerkingsverband wordt vastgelegd.
Antwoord vragen Segers over mogelijke invloed van de Turkse overheid op uitzendingen van de Stichting Zendtijd Moslims

An MP asked whether the Turkish government influences the Stichting Zendtijd Moslims through the chairman's links to the Islamic Stichting Nederland, and whether this breaches the Commissariaat's criteria. The minister answered that the Commissariaat must assess any state influence, that public broadcasters must be free of government influence under the Mediawet 2008, and that the Commissariaat can refuse designation if it is likely the law will not be followed.
Whether there is ultimately state interference in the broadcaster must be assessed by the Commissariaat.
Of er uiteindelijk sprake is van overheidsinmenging in de omroep moet het Commissariaat beoordelen.
Antwoord vragen Heerma over de mogelijke toekenning van zendtijd aan de Stichting Zendtijd Moslims

An MP asked the education and culture minister about a pending broadcasting time application by the Stichting Zendtijd Moslims, possible ties to Turkey's Diyanet, and whether a ban on government ties should be added to the Mediawet. The minister said the Commissariaat voor de Media is still assessing the application, that the law already requires independence from government influence, and that a specific statutory ban is not currently warranted.
Whether there are ties and which consequences should follow for the allocation of broadcasting time is for the Commissariaat to assess.
Of en zo ja welke banden er zijn en welke gevolgen daaraan verbonden moeten worden voor de zendtijdtoewijzing moet het Commissariaat beoordelen.
Antwoord vragen Krol over de stopzetting van de uitzendingen van Wereldomroep op de Antillen

An MP from 50PLUS asked the education and culture minister whether the stop of Wereldomroep broadcasts to the Antilles was known, whether BES residents need a Dutch public broadcaster to take over its role, and whether a new regional broadcaster could be promoted on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba. The minister confirmed the stop, said the concerns are unfounded because the national public broadcaster will provide Caribbean media services, and said no regional broadcaster is planned, though local initiatives remain possible.
There are no plans for a regional broadcaster for the Caribbean islands.
Er bestaan geen plannen voor een regionale omroep voor de Caribische eilanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hennis-Plasschaert en Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over de mishandeling van een Oegandese Gaypride bezoeker

MPs Hennis-Plasschaert and Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga asked whether suspects in the assault of an Ugandan Gay Pride visitor had been arrested, whether they belonged to a Ugandan party, their nationality, whether a doubled prosecution demand applies for discriminatory assault, and what measures will be taken against homophobia imported from other countries. The minister answered that an investigation is ongoing so no details can be shared, that the Discrimination Directive would apply with a 50% or 100% increase in the demand if the case is prosecuted, and that discriminatory expression and violence are punishable regardless of the convictions behind them.
This investigation is still ongoing, which is why I make no further statements about it.
Dit onderzoek loopt nog, reden waarom ik daar verder geen mededelingen over doe.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Beertema inzake mbo-instellingen en derivaten

An MP from the PVV asked the minister of Education, Culture and Science whether vocational colleges (mbo) should avoid flexible-rate loans hedged with swaps, whether boards and supervisory boards failed, and how many schools used derivatives. The minister said banks now offer fixed-rate long-term loans less readily, that swaps are permitted under the Beleggen en Belenen rules, that the Inspectie van het Onderwijs is investigating the sector's financial position including derivatives, and that consequences will be considered if irresponsible risks are found.
I have asked the Inspectorate of Education to investigate the financial position of all publicly funded institutions in vocational education.
Ik heb de Inspectie van het Onderwijs gevraagd om onderzoek te doen naar de financiële positie van alle publiek bekostigde instellingen in het mbo.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Plasterk inzake mbo-instellingen en derivaten

MPs Jadnanansing and Plasterk asked whether vocational (mbo) institutions that traded interest rate derivatives, now costing them money, stayed within their tasks, and how such risky products could be prevented. The minister answered that institutions must follow the Beleggen en Belenen rules, that the Inspectorate is investigating derivative use with results expected in autumn, and that action will be considered if unacceptable risks are found.
I have asked the Inspectorate of Education to investigate the financial position of all publicly funded vocational education institutions.
Ik heb aan de Inspectie van het Onderwijs gevraagd om onderzoek te doen naar het financiële cijferbeeld van alle publiek bekostigde instellingen in het mbo.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Van Dijk inzake het bericht ‘MBO’s gokken met derivaten’

SP MPs asked the Education Minister whether MBO colleges speculated with housing funds through risky derivatives, whether this was responsible, whether the sector must pay for buy-outs, and whether governance and inspection oversight should be tightened. The minister said derivatives must be used risk-averse, that the Inspectorate is reviewing the financial picture and will report in autumn, and that action depends on those findings.
I have asked the Inspectorate of Education to critically assess the financial picture of all publicly funded MBO institutions.
Ik heb de Inspectie van het Onderwijs gevraagd om het financiële cijferbeeld van alle publiek bekostigde mbo-instellingen kritisch te beoordelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over de bedreiging van Turkse homo’s

An MP asked the Justice and Education ministers about threats against Turkish gay pride boat participants, including whether complaints led to prosecution and whether victims were supported. The minister reported five police reports, no formal complaints filed, no ex officio prosecution for now, and that contact and emancipation support continue.
Discrimination offences such as articles 137c and 137d of the Criminal Code can be prosecuted ex officio, but the Public Prosecution Service currently sees no reason to do so in this case.

Discriminatiedelicten zoals artikel 137c en 137d van het Wetboek van Strafrecht kunnen wel ambtshalve worden vervolgd, maar het Openbaar Ministerie ziet hiervoor in dit geval vooralsnog geen aanleiding.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Elias en Lucas over de dreigende sluiting Vaktechnisch Opleidingscentrum VTOC Fokker

Two VVD MPs asked the education minister about the threatened closure of the VTOC Fokker aircraft maintenance training centre, its lack of standalone funding, and whether graduates are disadvantaged. The minister confirmed awareness, said the current law offers no funding route for private training, denied that only VTOC and one other centre place graduates, and promised a review with stakeholders by year-end.
It was agreed with those involved to examine how aircraft maintenance education can be offered in an accessible, high-quality and efficient way.
Met de betrokkenen is afgesproken te bezien op welke wijze het vliegtuigonderwijs op toegankelijke, kwalitatief goede en doelmatige wijze aangeboden kan worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijsselbloem over problemen met de financiering van vakopleidingen vliegtuigtechniek

An MP asked the education minister about funding problems for EASA-approved aircraft mechanic training, after one institute had to send 100 students home, and whether such niche programmes deserve protection and how other financing models could be developed. The minister confirmed the funding difficulties (linked to KLM-group cutbacks and loss of an Air Force contract), said the programme is valued but is a private, non-regulated-funding course, reported no comparable cases elsewhere, and promised a consultation outcome by year end.
With those involved it was agreed to examine how aircraft maintenance education can be offered in an accessible, high-quality and efficient way.
Met de betrokkenen is afgesproken te bezien op welke wijze het vliegtuigonderwijs op toegankelijke, kwalitatief goede en doelmatige wijze aangeboden kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smits over een tekort aan stageplaatsen in het middelbaar beroepsonderwijs (mbo)

MP Smits asked the minister about reports that 100,000 mbo students could not find an internship place, and about measures to increase internship places and match programmes to labour-market prospects. The minister disputes the figure, says the sector outlook is still manageable with a fuller picture due in October, and lists measures such as an information brochure, inspection of labour-market duty of care, and SBB advice on programme portfolios.
This is incorrect and not based on the available facts from the SBB.
Dit is onjuist en niet gebaseerd op de beschikbare feiten van de SBB.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Smits over het bericht dat gemeenten massaal snijden in het budget voor leerlingenvervoer

MP Smits asked the education minister how she responds to reports that municipalities are cutting school transport budgets, how many pupils with disabilities will be left without transport, and whether she will sanction or talk to municipalities. The minister mostly referred to earlier answers, but stated that municipalities must provide legally required transport and that courts decide compliance, and explained the legal rules on parental contributions.
If a municipality, whether or not due to cuts, offers no or unsuitable school transport to such pupils, it acts in breach of the law. Whether that is the case is assessed by the court.

Als een gemeente, al dan niet door bezuinigingen, voor dergelijke leerlingen geen of niet passend leerlingenvervoer aanbiedt, handelt zij in strijd met de wet. Of dat het geval is, wordt getoetst door de rechter.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn over gemeentelijke bezuinigingen op leerlingenvervoer

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the education minister whether municipalities are cutting pupil transport budgets, leaving children with disabilities at home and charging parents fees for special-needs transport. The minister replied that the central government is not cutting this transport, that only one municipality (affecting seventeen pupils) is reviewing its decisions, and that enforcement of the transport rules rests with the courts rather than with the minister.
I am not authorised to act against municipalities that might not comply with the law.
Ik ben niet bevoegd op te treden tegen gemeenten die zich eventueel niet aan de wet zouden handelen.
Antwoord vragen Gesthuizen, Van Bommel en Jasper van Dijk over het stopzetten van de behandeling van alle verblijfsaanvragen door Iraanse vreemdelingen

MPs asked whether the IND had stopped processing residence applications from Iranian students and nationals, and whether this amounted to discrimination. The minister answered that applications are decided, but students in restricted fields need a ministry exemption under UN resolution 1737 and EU regulation 267/2012, and that some applications for work were temporarily held before resuming processing.
It is a misunderstanding that the IND does not process applications from Iranian students.
Het is een misverstand dat de IND geen aanvragen van Iraanse studenten in behandeling neemt.
Antwoord vragen Elias en Azmani over werkloze jongeren die op reis gaan naar Schotland

MPs Elias and Azmani (VVD) asked why unemployed youths are sent on a work placement to Scotland under an EU Leonardo da Vinci subsidy, questioning its value compared with domestic options and whether the subsidy should be reclaimed. The state secretary defended the project as eligible under EU criteria, said municipalities are responsible for tailored reintegration, and said the EU funds cannot be reclaimed while the project is still running.
These are EU funds, managed by the National Agency Lifelong Learning and awarded under European subsidy conditions.
Het betreft EU-middelen, die door het Nationaal Agentschap Leven Lang Leren worden beheerd en op grond van Europese subsidievoorwaarden zijn toegekend.
Antwoord vragen Beertema over het plan van de PvdA om scholen te ‘adopteren’

An MP asked the education minister whether a PvdA plan to 'adopt' schools and offer a structural two-year programme by party politicians crosses a line, and whether parties should stay at arm's length from school content. The minister replied that the plan no longer goes ahead, that adopting a school depends on what a party means by it, and that schools decide for themselves whether to accept guest lessons.
Moreover, the plan will no longer go ahead.
Overigens vindt het plan geen doorgang meer.
Antwoord vragen Dijsselbloem, Hamer en Jadnanansing inzake ‘gebrek aan steun voor scholen bij het opzetten van burgerschapslessen’

Three Labour MPs asked the Minister of Education whether she would act on the Education Council's finding that schools lack clarity and support for citizenship lessons, and whether she would produce a plan to improve support and materials. The Minister acknowledged the advice, said citizenship is a shared school and parental task rather than a subject, and deferred a full policy response to the next cabinet.
I will leave a comprehensive policy response to this advice to the next cabinet.
laat ik een uitgebreide beleidsreactie op dit advies aan het volgende kabinet
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de aansluiting van mbo-opleidingen op de arbeidsmarkt

The MP Jadnanansing asked the Minister of Education about a newspaper report that vocational (mbo) programmes train students for jobs that do not exist, and whether the government would act to better align them with the labour market and to improve honest advice to students. The minister replied that labour market prospects are largely reasonable to good (economics being an exception), that graduate unemployment is low, rejected the characterisation of a passive approach, and pointed to an information brochure and a LOB programme for student guidance.
It is indeed important that participants are informed in good time about the career prospects of the programmes they are (considering) choosing.
Het is inderdaad van belang dat deelnemers tijdig worden voorgelicht over de loopbaanperspectieven van de opleidingen waar zij voor (overwegen te) kiezen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het recht op onderwijs voor asielzoekers van achttien jaar en ouder

An MP asked the ministers whether adult asylum seekers aged 18 and over, who have little access to education, can be denied meaningful schooling, and whether the Robin Hood College initiatives and ISK classes could be expanded. The government answered that asylum seekers have the same formal rights as residents, that compulsory education ends at 18, that it sees no discrimination, and that it will examine practical barriers and report to parliament later.
We intend to investigate the scale of the problem and consider which solution can be found.
Wij zijn voornemens te onderzoeken wat de omvang van het probleem is en te bezien welke oplossing kan worden gevonden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Biskop over het bericht dat Nederlandse schoolexamens op Curaçao op een marineschip afgenomen kunnen worden

An MP asked whether Dutch state exams could be taken on a navy ship in Curaçao, and about costs and procedures. The minister answered that a navy ship is not Dutch territory in international-law terms, that Dutch education law does not apply on Curaçao, and gave cost figures for the Bonaire exams while noting that no ship-based option is feasible.
No, on board a navy ship the jurisdiction of the flag state applies, but that does not yet make it the 'territory' of a state in the sense of international law.
Neen, aan boord van een marineschip geldt de rechtsmacht van de vlaggenstaat maar daarmee is er nog geen sprake van «grondgebied» van een staat in volkenrechtelijke zin
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Biskop inzake schoolkosten mbo

The CDA MP Biskop asked the Minister of Education whether MBO institutions still send students bills for non-mandatory costs despite the ban on such charges, and whether she will intervene immediately. The minister replied that schools must follow the law as explained in her May 2012 guidance, that the Inspectorate will tighten supervision and re-inspect the twelve schools on the Zwartboek list this autumn with possible sanctions, and that she will not report separately to the House.
The Inspectorate will publish the individual assessment reports of the examined programmes in the usual way and report the outcomes of the institutional analysis in the annual Education Report.

De inspectie zal op de gebruikelijke wijze de afzonderlijke rapporten met beoordelingen van de onderzochte opleidingen openbaar maken alsook in het jaarlijkse Onderwijsverslag rapporteren over de uitkomsten van de instellingsanalyse.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Çelik over het uitblijven van 'exitgesprekken' met voortijdig schoolverlaters

Two PvdA MPs asked whether the absence of exit interviews with early school leavers, who face higher unemployment and crime risk, is acceptable and whether such interviews should be mandatory, and whether the halving target should be adopted. The minister agreed interviews are sensible and promotes them through schools and parent involvement, but declined to make them mandatory, said the 2016 target of 25,000 is ambitious and that an even sharper target is not feasible, and linked youth unemployment to temporary contracts and lack of qualifications.
It is up to the educational institution to make conducting exit interviews a regular part of the deregistration procedure.
Het is aan de onderwijsinstelling om het voeren van exitgesprekken een regulier onderdeel te maken van de uitschrijfprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dijk over de verkoop van voetbalrechten aan Rupert Murdoch

An SP MP asked the education, culture and science minister whether Murdoch's entry into Eredivisie rights would reduce open-channel match highlights and whether Studio Sport could disappear, and questioned the NOS's ability to pay higher prices. The minister said prices are set by the market, that the Mediawet and evenementenlijst already require highlights on the open channel with minimum durations and start times, and that an evaluation of the list is underway with results promised this autumn.
This autumn I will inform your House about this.
Dit najaar zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dijk en Smits inzake ‘gebrek aan burgerschap bij jongeren’

MPs Van Dijk and Smits asked the Minister of Education about a media report that Dutch pupils ranked low on civic knowledge and held extreme views on equal rights for migrants, and what would be done. The minister replied that the media analysis was selective, that Dutch pupils ranked 24th of 38 countries on civic knowledge, and that the Education Council's advice on civic education would be awaited, with the response left to the next cabinet.

In 2011 I asked the Education Council, partly in response to the Inspectorate's finding that citizenship in education needs more attention, to advise me on how schools can be supported in developing citizenship education.

In 2011 heb ik, mede naar aanleiding van de constatering van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs dat burgerschap in het onderwijs nadere aandacht behoeft, de Onderwijsraad gevraagd mij te adviseren over de vraag hoe scholen ondersteund kunnen worden
Antwoord vragen van de leden Biskop en Uitslag over de werkinstructie indicatiestelling voor jeugd -GGZ 2012

Two CDA MPs asked why the 2012 youth mental health (jeugd-GGZ) assessment guideline was changed so that AWBZ care is only possible with full school exemption, and whether children living at home lose the combination of school and care. The state secretary answered that the guideline was corrected to 'full' exemption to match the CIZ indicator, that children can still receive personal care, nursing and individual support during school hours, and that exact numbers affected are not registered.
No, neither the CIZ nor youth care records which children use AWBZ or youth care during school hours, and in what way.
Nee, noch het CIZ, noch jeugdzorg registreren welke kinderen op welke wijze gebruikmaken van AWBZ- of jeugdzorg tijdens dagdelen onderwijs.
Vragen van de leden Smits en Van Bommel (beiden SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het onveranderd hoge aantal laaggeletterden (ingezonden 17 juli 2012).

SP MPs Smits and Van Bommel asked the education minister why the number of functionally illiterate people remains about 1.5 million despite action plans, and questioned the spending and expertise of Stichting Lezen & Schrijven. The minister denied policy failure, defended subsidised activities and the foundation's expertise, and said the ministry, not the foundation, holds the lead role.
The ministry of OCW has the lead on reducing the number of functionally illiterate people, not Stichting L&S.
Het ministerie van OCW heeft de regie over het terugdringen van het aantal laaggeletterden en niet Stichting L&S.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn over het bericht dat scholen massaal de klassen vergroten

An MP asked the education minister about reports that schools are enlarging classes after budget cuts, and about trends in class size, cost and funding, and the effect on policy. The minister rejects the claim that cuts cause larger classes, says the student-teacher ratio has fallen over time and funding per pupil has risen, and says class size is for schools to decide, with the financial management evaluation to follow in autumn.
I do not recognise the picture that emerges from the research.
Ik herken het beeld dat uit het onderzoek naar voren komt niet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het vonnis van de rechtbank Rotterdam inzake het Early Birdprogramma

An MP from the SGP asks the education minister how the Rotterdam court ruling on the Early Bird programme, which allows Dutch primary schools to teach partly in English without a formal experiment permit, fits with the Experiments Act and the inspectorate's oversight. The minister replies that the court limits the programme to 15% of teaching time in English, that the inspectorate will take the ruling into account, and that she sees no reason for further research but will send a plan on English in primary education later.
The Inspectorate of Education will take the ruling into account in its supervision.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs zal het vonnis betrekken in haar toezicht.
Antwoord vragen Biskop over het artikel ‘slechte economie kost mbo’ers stage’

An MP asked the education minister about a report that the number of vocational (mbo) students starting internships fell 23% in early 2012, and about sectors where internship places are declining. The minister acknowledged the concern, attributed the drop to the economic downturn and government spending cuts, and called on employers and social partners to keep offering internships without committing to a concrete government measure.
I share this view. That is why in the mentioned article I call on the business community to continue offering internships.
Ik deel deze mening. Vandaar dat ik in het genoemde artikel een oproep doe aan het bedrijfsleven om stages te blijven aanbieden.
Antwoord vragen Ortega-Martijn inzake het probleem van pesten op school

An MP asked the education minister about a 16-month absence from school of a pupil bullied in Eindhoven, the reported 850 truant pupils, the extent of school bullying, and whether anti-bullying duties are in inspection frameworks and teacher training. The minister answered that the Eindhoven case is resolved, that bullying is one of several causes of truancy with no separate count, that the social safety monitor and inspection frameworks cover bullying, and that existing teacher competence rules already cover it.
I therefore have no figures on the number of pupils staying at home because they are victims of bullying.
Ik heb dan ook geen cijfers over het aantal leerlingen dat thuiszit omdat ze slachtoffer zijn van pesterijen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over foto’s over executies in Indonesië

An SP MP asked whether photos showing Dutch soldiers near executed Indonesians implicate Dutch forces, and whether archives and a new research programme on the 1945-1949 Indonesian war should be commissioned. The minister answered that the photos do not establish responsibility, that the institutes hold similar images already in the public domain, and that independent research is for the institutes, not the cabinet.
On the basis of the photographs it cannot be concluded that these soldiers are responsible for the deaths of the victims shown.
Op basis van de foto's kan niet worden geconcludeerd dat deze militairen verantwoordelijk zijn voor de dood van de slachtoffers op de foto.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans en Jadnanansing over de onderwijsachterstand in Zuid-Limburg

MPs Timmermans and Jadnanansing asked the Education Minister whether educational disadvantage in South Limburg is comparable to the Randstad, whether it stems from mine closures and deprived pupil populations, and whether a joint regional approach will be initiated. The minister answered that there is no indication the problems are comparable, that no research links them to mine closures, and that existing provincial and national programmes and a convenant already cover the regional approach.
I do not have any indication that the problems are comparable to those in the Randstad.
Ik beschik niet over een indicatie dat de problemen vergelijkbaar zijn met die in de Randstad.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans en Hilkens over steenkolenmijnen op de UNESCO-werelderfgoedlijst

MPs Timmermans and Hilkens asked whether the government would consult Limburg authorities to nominate remaining Limburg coal-mining heritage for the UNESCO World Heritage List, after three Walloon mines were listed. The state secretary replied that the independent commission's advice, adopted in 2011, did not include Limburg mining heritage, so no consultation was planned.
I therefore see no reason to now enter into discussions with authorities in Limburg about a World Heritage nomination of parts of the mining region.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding nu in gesprek te gaan met overheden in Limburg over een werelderfgoednominatie van delen van de mijnstreek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klijnsma over cultuureducatie op basisscholen

An MP from the PvdA asked the state secretary about arts education in primary schools, including the Raad voor Cultuur advice, support for schools via the Cultuurkaart and Jeugdcultuurfonds, and keeping the Cultuurkaart going as requested by a motion. The state secretary promised a policy response this autumn and a letter before Prinsjesdag, while noting the existing programme Cultuureducatie met Kwaliteit.
I aim to send your House a policy response to the advice of the Education Council and the Council for Culture this autumn.
Ik streef ernaar om dit najaar een beleidsreactie op het advies van de Onderwijsraad en de Raad voor Cultuur naar uw Kamer te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra, Van Gent en Marcouch over het niet uitvoeren van de motie die verzoekt bloeddonatie voor homoseksuelen mogelijk te maken

MPs Dijkstra, Van Gent and Marcouch asked why the minister did not implement a motion to allow blood donation by gay men and whether she would reconsider using new scientific evidence and foreign practice. The minister replied that she relies on Sanquin's advice and current epidemiological data, will not yet reconsider, and will inform parliament after consultations with other experts by early September.
I aim to send your House a letter on this subject in the short term, by early September at the latest.
Ik streef ernaar om uw Kamer op korte termijn, uiterlijk begin september, een brief over dit onderwerp te sturen.
Antwoord vragen Haverkamp over de interpretatie van de wettelijke zorgplicht van provincies voor regionale omroepen

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about provinces cutting regional broadcasters' statutory funding despite the duty under the Mediawet 2008, the court rulings annulling some cuts, and why the Commissariaat voor de Media declined to enforce. The minister gave a province-by-province overview of disputed cuts, said enforcement is for the courts and, as a last resort, the Interior Minister, and stated the Commissariat lacks sanction powers.
It is then for the administrative court to determine whether a province complies with its statutory obligations.
Het is dan aan de bestuursrechter om vast te stellen of een provincie zijn wettelijke verplichtingen nakomt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders en Beertema over het ontslag van docent maatschappijleer/Leids raadslid naar aanleiding van tweets

PVV MPs Wilders and Beertema asked the education minister whether a Leiden teacher and councillor dismissed over anti-Islam tweets was rightly suspended, why a VU employee's tweet about shooting PVV members had no employment consequences, and whether the minister would press the school to reverse the contract termination. The minister answered that the ministry is not a party, that the school's competent authority and ultimately the cantonal judge decide such matters, and that she cannot intervene in an individual employment relationship.
The ministry of OCW is not a party in this matter.
Het ministerie van OCW is in deze geen partij.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Ham over de handdruk van de directeur van de Wereldomroep

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the general director of the Wereldomroep would receive over 1 million euro upon departure and whether such amounts should be avoided in future. The minister answered that departure is uncertain, that the Supervisory Board sets pay and severance and was urged to apply the kantonrechter formula, and that the director is willing to discuss a lower amount.
The Supervisory Board (RvT) is responsible for employment conditions, including a possible severance payment, and will therefore determine what amount the general director is offered.
De Raad van Toezicht (hierna: RvT) gaat over de arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder mogelijke ontslagvergoeding en zal dan ook bepalen welk bedrag de algemeen directeur aangeboden krijgt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ten Broeke over het bericht “Directeur Wereldomroep krijgt miljoen euro bij vertrek”

An MP asked ministers about reports that the Wereldomroep director would receive about one million euro in severance on departure, and whether such payments are permissible in the public sector. The ministers answered that the Raad van Toezicht sets the severance under the Wereldomroep's contractual and sector frameworks, that the director's pay would be assessed critically using the kantonrechter formula, and that the WNT caps severance at 75,000 euro once in force.
I have urged the RvT to critically assess the severance payment once it becomes relevant.
Ik heb er bij de RvT op aangedrongen om de ontslagvergoeding kritisch te beoordelen zodra deze aan de orde is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Biskop over het artikel 'Leraren Frans klagen over examens'
