An MP asked the education minister about reports that French exam teachers complained that correct student answers were not in the marking model, and whether teachers risk their jobs for approving such answers. The minister said the College voor Examens handles such complaints, corrects errors where needed, found no error in the French exam, and that teachers must follow the marking rules.
I agree that it must not be possible for final exam candidates to be disadvantaged by giving the correct answer.
Ik deel de mening dat het niet mogelijk moet zijn dat eindexamenkandidaten gedupeerd worden door het geven van het juiste antwoord.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Beertema en Van Klaveren over de uitspraak dat salafistische ouders thuisonderwijs mogen geven

Two PVV MPs asked the minister of Education whether a court ruling allowing Salafist parents to homeschool is absurd, whether she recognises the dangers of Salafist messages, and what measures she will take to make this form of homeschooling impossible. The minister said courts decide whether religious objections justify exemption from compulsory schooling, that she will not judge a court ruling, that inciting violence is inappropriate, and that she is preparing a bill to attach conditions to religious exemptions from school attendance.
I am preparing a bill aimed at attaching a number of conditions to exemption from compulsory schooling on grounds of religion or belief.

146 ) al aangekondigd dat ik bezig ben met de voorbereiding van een wetsvoorstel met het doel de vrijstelling van de leerplicht op grond van godsdienst of levensbeschouwing aan een aantal voorwaarden te verbinden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Beertema, Van den Besselaar en Fritsma over het bericht dat Amsterdam illegale buitenlandse jeugd stages aanbiedt

PVV MPs asked whether Amsterdam offering internships to students without residence permits is acceptable and whether fines should apply per case. The minister referred to a letter of 25 June 2012 announcing an appeal against a court ruling, and to earlier answers, without substantively answering the questions.
For answering your question I refer to the letter sent to your House on 25 June 2012, in which the cabinet announces it will appeal a ruling of the Hague District Court.

Voor de beantwoording van uw vraag verwijs ik naar de brief die wij uw Kamer op 25 juni 2012 (Kamerstukken II 2011/12, 32 144, nr. 16 ) hebben toegezonden, waarin het kabinet aankondigt in hoger beroep te zullen gaan tegen een uitspraak van de rechtbank Den Haag.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Biskop over het bericht dat gebruik van de rekenkaart voor leerlingen met een rekenstoornis niet is toegestaan bij de eindexamens

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Biskop asked why the rekenkaart (calculation aid) is banned in exams for pupils with dyscalculia, whether a one-year postponement was possible, why the ERWD protocol arrives late, and whether schools must be exempted under equal-treatment law. The minister refused postponement, said pupils had ample notice via the College voor Examens, noted the protocol supports schools, and argued that allowing the aid would lower exam requirements.
Postponing the tightening of the exam requirements is not an option.
Uitstel van de aanscherping van de exameneisen is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bericht dat tien presentatoren bij de Publieke Omroep een salaris boven de Balkenende-norm ontvangen

An MP asked the minister about reports that ten Public Broadcasting presenters still earn above the Balkenende norm, and why the number has not been reduced, and asked for pressure on broadcasters to pay the excess from membership funds. The minister answered that the NPO reports exceptions fell to ten in 2011, that remaining older contracts explain the excess and will be phased out toward eight by 2013, and that excess pay is already paid from association funds, so no further action is needed.
That is not necessary, see the answer to question 4.
Dat is niet nodig, zie het antwoord op vraag 4.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over het bericht over zelfdoding onder Hindostaanse meisjes

MP Arib asks the health and education ministers about reports of high suicide among Hindustani girls, whether prior answers on attention to the issue hold up, whether schools and professionals are equipped, and whether recent national figures exist. Minister Schippers answers that suicide prevention has received more investment, that schools will be pointed to available information via the VO-raad without a mandatory approach, and that no recent national figures on migrant young women are available, while promising a forthcoming clinical guideline.
No recent national figures are available on the number of suicide attempts among certain groups of migrant young women.
Er zijn geen recente landelijke cijfers beschikbaar van het aantal suïcidepogingen onder bepaalde groepen migranten jonge vrouwen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch, Van Dekken en Timmermans over homorechten in Oekraïne

MPs Marcouch, Van Dekken and Timmermans asked about the cancelled Kyiv gay pride, a Ukrainian bill criminalising public expression of homosexuality, and whether this should affect Dutch attendance at Euro 2012 matches and the final's location. The government condemned the violence and bill, said Dutch ministers would attend a match with a human rights programme, but rejected moving the final to Poland as impractical.
On 21 May I expressed to the media my disappointment at the cancellation of the Kyiv Pride Parade.
Ik heb op 21 mei jl. tegenover de media mijn teleurstelling uitgesproken over de afgelasting van de Kyiv Pride Parade.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Çelik over de inzet van de functiemixmiddelen bij ROC Flevoland

MP Çelik asked whether the ROC Flevoland board is diverting functiemix (salary mix) funds meant for teaching staff into a separate cost centre, creating a shortfall used to justify reorganisation. The state secretary answered that inspection oversight cannot confirm this, that the plan of action commits all funds to structural promotions with any remainder for teacher training, and that a phone check confirmed this, so no reason is seen to act.
On the basis of inspection oversight I cannot make any statements about this.
Op basis van het inspectietoezicht kan ik hierover geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Ham over berichtgeving excellente leerlingen

The MP asks how the minister responds to reports that a quarter of excellent pupils fail to obtain their VWO diploma within six years, and how this relates to PISA results and the Actieplan Beter Presteren. The minister answers that the signal supports continuing the existing gifted-pupil policy, describes roles for parents, higher education and business, and cites 30 million euros per year and the School aan Zet programme.
This signal underlines the need to continue my policy for gifted and excellent pupils.
Dit signaal onderstreept de noodzaak om mijn beleid voor hoogbegaafde en excellente leerlingen voort te zetten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Biskop over het bericht dat gebruik van de rekenkaart voor leerlingen met een rekenstoornis niet is toegestaan bij de eindexamens

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Biskop asked why a student with dyscalculia may not use a formula card in the final exams, despite a Commissie Gelijke Behandeling ruling against the school, and whether exam rules should be changed. The minister declined to follow the ruling, citing exam requirements known in advance, risk of inequality and timing, while promising a possibly adapted formula card and further guidance and research.
I have decided not to give the school room to deviate from the applicable rules for the central exam.
Ik heb besloten de school geen ruimte te geven om van de geldende regels voor het centraal examen af te wijken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dam over de ontvangst van radio in delen van Noord-Holland

An MP asked how the power increase of the Lopik transmitter would be verified and whether alternative measures such as relay transmitters in Noord-Holland would be used. The minister answered that transmitter power was restored to pre-fire levels on 11 April 2012, that a further increase for Radio 4 is blocked by Belgian objections, and that no adequate alternatives exist yet.
The power of all transmitters at Lopik was increased on 11 April 2012 to the level before the fire.
Het vermogen van alle zenders op Lopik is per 11 april 2012 verhoogd tot het vermogen van voor de brand.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Ham over mogelijke discriminatie van een school en de regels van het ministerie omtrent examens

An MP asked the education minister how he views a school's alleged discrimination against a dyscalculic pupil denied a formula card at exams, and why the ministry refused exceptions despite the Commission for Equal Treatment's view. The minister refused exceptions citing the value of the diploma and exam requirements, said no conflict with equal treatment law exists, and pointed to a protocol and a research project in progress.
I already made clear immediately that there would be no exceptions because the central exam was about to begin.
Ik heb al meteen laten weten dat er geen uitzonderingen zullen komen omdat het centraal examen op het punt stond te beginnen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Driessen over kenniscentrum E-Quality en de afscheidsreceptie van zijn directeur

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about subsidies to knowledge centre E-Quality, the costs of a farewell reception for its director, and whether future subsidies should be stopped. The minister listed the subsidy amounts from 2007 to 2012 and said the reception costs were not yet known, and declined to end subsidies, citing the emancipation subsidy scheme.
The costs of the event are not known at this moment; what costs were involved will become clear in the accountability report.
De kosten van de bijeenkomst zijn op dit moment niet bekend; welke kosten hiermee gemoeid waren zal blijken bij de verantwoording.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht “NMa heeft andere prioriteiten dan muziekauteurs”

MP Peters asked ministers whether the NMa's refusal, on priority grounds, to investigate a complaint by Stichting Platform Makers about NPO conduct was acceptable, whether the minister would talk with the NMa, whether competition law is applied evenhandedly in culture, and when a copyright contracts bill would be submitted. The minister answered that the NMa is an independent body setting its own priorities, that appeal remedies exist, that competition law applies to creators, and that the bill would be submitted shortly.
It is therefore up to the NMa to set its own priorities.
Het is dan ook aan de NMa om haar prioriteiten vast te stellen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Çelik over het bericht “Nederlandse scholieren blijven vaker zitten”

MP Çelik asked the education minister when research results on the causes, efficiency and effectiveness of grade retention, and the first monitor on school advice and CITO scores, would be available. The minister expects the research results and any policy measures in the first half of 2013, and the monitor results around November 2012.
I expect to be able to send the Chamber the results of this research and any policy measures based on its outcomes in the first half of 2013.
Ik verwacht de Kamer de resultaten van dit onderzoek en de eventuele beleidsmaatregelen op basis van de uitkomsten daarvan te kunnen toesturen in de eerste helft van 2013.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over haringpromotiecampagnes op basisscholen

MP Ouwehand asks the education and economic affairs ministers whether the commercial Dutch Fisheries Bureau's 'haringsmaaklessen' campaign in primary schools, which promotes herring to children, is acceptable given overfishing and marine harm, and whether the government subsidised it. The minister replies that schools are free to use such materials, that the campaign is not an official government product, that the Fisheries Bureau received two EU fisheries fund subsidies of 7 million each for sustainability promotion, and that herring stocks are within safe limits, while declining to commit to new measures.
Schools are completely free to use the 'haringsmaaklessen'.
Scholen zijn volledig vrij om gebruik te maken van de «haringsmaaklessen».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pia Dijkstra inzake “de vertraging van verplichte voorlichting over (homo- en trans)seksualiteit op scholen

An MP asked the minister why the Council of State requested an Onderwijsraad advice on the mandatory sex and sexual diversity education decree, and whether the 1 August 2012 start date can still be met. The minister confirmed the advice request, explained that the decree can now only take effect on 1 August 2013 due to procedural steps, and pointed to voluntary initiatives in the meantime.
I therefore aim for the amendment of the core objectives to take effect on 1 August 2013.
Ik streef er daarom naar de wijziging van de kerndoelen per 1 augustus 2013 in werking te laten treden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Çelik over bevindingen van NWO-onderzoekers in relatie tot onderadvisering

An MP asks the education minister whether findings from an NWO-funded study showing teachers attribute migrant pupils' results to effort and native pupils' results to psychological factors matter for the motion on under-placement and how they will be used in an advice to schools. The minister says she has noted the findings, that implementation of the motion depends on a pending study, and that the findings will be taken into account when drafting the advice.
How I will implement the motion on under-placement depends on the outcomes of the study into the relationship between under-placement, upward and downward movement, and pupils' ethnicity.

Op welke wijze ik uitvoering ga geven aan de motie inzake onderadvisering hangt af van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek naar de relatie tussen onderadvisering, opstroom en afstroom en etniciteit van leerlingen.
Antwoord vragen Çelik over de inzet van onbevoegde docenten voor het vak maatschappijleer

An MP asked the state secretary about the use of unqualified teachers for civics (maatschappijleer) and how this relates to weakened citizenship education flagged by the inspectorate. The answer says about 60 percent of civics lessons in 2009 were taught by qualified teachers, that no link to the inspectorate's findings is known, and that a 2011 amendment limits long-term use of unqualified substitute teachers.

Research I commissioned on the number of lessons given by qualified teachers shows that on average about 60 percent of the civics lessons given in 2009 were taught by teachers qualified for the subject.

Uit onderzoek dat ik heb laten uitvoeren naar het aantal bevoegd gegeven lessen blijkt dat gemiddeld ongeveer 60 procent van de in 2009 gegeven lessen maatschappijleer/maatschappijwetenschappen gegeven is door voor het vak benoembare docenten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de evaluatie van het NICAM over de naleving van artikel 240a van het Wetboek van Strafrecht

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Education about the NICAM evaluation of compliance with article 240a of the Criminal Code on age limits for films and games. The state secretary reports that compliance rose from 14% to 49% since 2008, that the government will continue the convenant approach without declaring the Kijkwijzer code generally binding, and that further proposals on internet sales will be sent to parliament by June 2012.
As promised during the committee debate on alcohol policy of 9 February 2012, your House will be informed by letter by June 2012 at the latest.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het AO alcoholbeleid van 9 februari 2012 zal uw Kamer uiterlijk juni 2012 hierover bij brief geïnformeerd worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Çelik inzake de financiële verliezen die het Wellant College voor zijn rekening neemt voor het IPC Groene Ruimte B.V.

An MP asked the ministers whether the Wellant College's 2010 losses at its subsidiary IPC Groene Ruimte B.V. were acceptable, and whether the sector's disclosure rules allow such losses to remain hidden. The minister said the Inspectorate's basic arrangement gives no cause for further investigation, that the 2011 figures are not yet due, that the rules on timing and public-private separation were followed, and that the 0.6 million loss was charged to a private reserve.
A negative deviation from the projected result, as occurred at IPC Groene Ruimte B.V., is in itself no reason for me to conduct further investigation.
Een afwijking in negatieve zin van het geprosnosticeerd resultaat zoals bij IPC Groene Ruimte B.V. het geval was, is op zich geen aanleiding voor mij om hier nader onderzoek te verrichten.
Antwoord vragen Çelik over segregatie in het onderwijs en mooie ouderinitiatieven

An MP asked the education minister about a parent initiative to desegregate a school, the claim that such initiatives have only marginal success, and whether government should support them and investigate how. The minister replied that parents are free to choose schools, that the pilots showed only a very limited effect, that she will not impose measures from above, and that she sees no point in investigating government support.
I therefore do not consider it meaningful to investigate how the parent initiatives can be supported by the government.
Ik vind het daarom niet zinvol om te onderzoeken op welke wijze de ouderinitiatieven door de overheid ondersteund kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen Van der Ham over het bericht ‘Overheid verplicht Uitzending Gemist tot tijdslot’

An MP asked whether the 22:00 time-slot rule for 16+ programmes on the public broadcaster's online service is effective given YouTube and commercial platforms lack such a rule, and whether it unduly restricts adults. The minister defends the measure as a child-protection step within the Mediawet, applied only to public broadcasting, and says a better age-verification system would be preferred but is not yet available.
I realise that this does not produce a watertight system.
Ik realiseer me dat dit geen waterdicht systeem oplevert.
Antwoord vragen Biskop inzake het bericht “Twee miljoen voor ondernemende scholieren”

An MP asks the education minister about a subsidy for entrepreneurship projects in schools, questioning the choice of subsidy over classroom role models and whether effects can be measured. The minister defends the ONO 2012 scheme as funding proven best-practice projects being rolled out to other schools, with monitoring by AgentschapNL.

These are therefore successful projects, so-called best practices, in entrepreneurship education in primary and secondary education and senior vocational education, which are being rolled out and further developed at other schools or educational institutions.

Het gaat hier dus om succesvolle projecten, zgn. best practices, op het gebied van ondernemerschapsonderwijs in het funderend onderwijs en middelbaar beroepsonderwijs die worden uitgerold en doorontwikkeld naar andere scholen c.q. onderwijsinstellingen.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over het reddingsplan van de scholen van het Amarantis schoolbestuur

An MP asked the Education Minister about the rescue plan for the Amarantis school board, including whether the full plan would be shared, job losses, a 10 million euro continuity guarantee funded from her ministry, delayed intervention, and an independent inquiry. The minister declined to share the plan as it does not yet exist, promised an independent inquiry and information within two weeks, and gave partial answers on the other points.
I will not share the full 'rescue plan' of the Amarantis Group with the House of Representatives, because it does not yet exist.
Het volledig «reddingsplan» van de Amarantis Groep deel ik niet met de Tweede Kamer, want het is er nog niet.

Vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem (PvdA) en Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de bezuinigingen op het passend onderwijs en effecten daarvan op het onderwijzend personeel (ingezonden

MPs Dijsselbloem and Dijkgraaf asked the education minister whether cuts to special-needs education (passend onderwijs) had been dropped for 2013 and later, how the funds would be covered, and what the consequences were for staff and schools. The minister confirmed the cuts were withdrawn, said the budget would be set out in the 2013 budget, committed to talks with unions and employers on staff consequences, and proposed a one-year delay in implementation.
The coverage will be included in the 2013 national budget, of which the multi-year budget is also part.
De dekking zal worden opgenomen in de Rijksbegroting 2013, waar ook de meerjarenbegroting onderdeel van uitmaakt.
Antwoord vragen Çelik over de cijfers met betrekking tot het aantal thuiszittende kinderen dat geen onderwijs krijgt.

The MP Çelik asks whether the official figures on truant and home-sitting children are correct under a broader definition that could reach about 14,000 children in 2010/2011, and what the financial and policy consequences are. The minister confirms the figures, explains that exemptions are excluded, rejects claims of budget underspending, and notes that statistics need improvement while regional approaches and passend onderwijs are meant to reduce truancy.
I do not paint an overly rosy picture.
Ik schets niet een te rooskleurig beeld.
Antwoord vragen Çelik over het bericht “Nederlandse scholieren blijven vaker zitten”

An MP asks the education minister about reports that Dutch pupils repeat grades more often than the OECD average, and about schools where large shares of pupils fall behind, along with the reasons and possible policy responses. The minister answers that the 22% figure is self-reported and that the comparison ignores the Dutch system's integrated kindergarten-primary structure, that she will commission research into causes and effectiveness of grade repetition, that the inspectorate will hold schools to account, and that policy focuses on results-oriented teaching.
To gain more insight into the causes of grade repetition, I will have further research carried out.
Om meer zicht te krijgen op de oorzaken van zittenblijven, zal ik hier nader onderzoek naar laten doen.
Antwoord vragen Çelik over leerlingen die apart gezet worden bij het overblijven in geval van een betalingsachterstand van de ouders

An MP asked the education minister about a school that separated a pupil at lunchtime supervision because parents had not paid, and whether schools may use children to force payment. The minister called the measure premature, said schools and parents should agree alternatives in which the child notices nothing, and committed to no new action.
In such a situation the school, in my view, has sufficient other options to urge parents to pay without the children noticing anything.
In een dergelijke situatie heeft de school mijns inziens voldoende andere mogelijkheden om ouders aan te sporen om te betalen zonder dat de kinderen daar iets van merken.
Antwoord vragen Çelik en Marcouch over bestuursperikelen bij de Amsterdamse Islamitische Basisschool As-Siddieq

MPs Çelik and Marcouch asked the Minister of Education about governance turmoil and possible financial mismanagement at the Amsterdam Islamic primary school As-Siddieq, including suspended board chair and salary risks. The minister replied that no financial mismanagement or unpaid salaries were established, that the inspectorate is tightening supervision because of a dual role of the board chair, and that teaching continues without lesson loss.
The inspectorate ensures that this governance arrangement is terminated.
De inspectie ziet erop toe dat deze bestuurlijke constructie wordt beëindigd.
Antwoord vragen Ferrier en Biskop over de brief van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs aan VCO Heerenveen

MPs Ferrier and Biskop asked the Minister of Education why school margedagen (extra free days) at VCO Heerenveen conflict with the Leerplichtwet while the hours norm is met, and why they differ from the planned flexible-schedule experiment. The minister replied that the school abolished the margedagen after consulting the Inspectorate, so no sanctions are needed, that she is bound by existing law and will not make exceptions before the experimentation law takes effect.
Once a law has been adopted, I am bound to comply with it.
Op het moment dat een wet is aangenomen, ben ik gehouden aan de naleving ervan.
Antwoord vragen Van der Ham over het bericht dat scholengroep Amarantis in acute financiële nood zit door het kopen van renteverzekeringen

An MP asked the education minister about reports that school group Amarantis was in acute financial distress partly due to interest-rate derivatives, whether such purchases are policy, and whether other institutions hold derivatives. The minister replied that the distress stems from operating deficits and a lender's threatened call of financing, that derivatives hedging interest risk are permitted under the 2010 investment regulation, and that the Inspectorate will conduct a critical risk analysis of publicly funded vocational education finances, with results after the summer.
The use of derivatives does not necessarily have to be reported in detail in the annual reports.
Het gebruik van derivaten hoeft namelijk niet in detail in de jaarverslagen vermeld te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over de overeenkomst tussen de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep en de Nederlandse Postduivenhouders Organisatie

Member Bosma (PVV) asked whether a 100,000 euro payment by the public broadcaster NPO to the pigeon-breeders' organisation, and its new npo.nl domain, fit with the goal of reducing public broadcaster websites and with budget cuts. The minister answered that the NPO is independent, that the domain purchase will not increase the number of websites, and that the NPO is accountable through its financial reports under Commissariaat voor de Media supervision.
The NPO is an independent, autonomous organisation that is itself responsible for how it carries out its statutory public broadcasting mandate.
De NPO is een onafhankelijke, zelfstandige organisatie die zelf verantwoordelijk is voor de wijze waarop hij uitvoering geeft aan zijn Mediawettelijke taakopdracht
Antwoord vragen Heijnen en Çelik over de Rapportage onderzoek uittreksel GBA 2012

MPs Heijnen and Çelik asked why about 81,000 pupils still risk buying an unnecessary GBA extract for secondary school enrolment, as half of municipalities still require one. The minister says the study's conclusion is premature since municipalities inform applicants the extract is not needed, that DUO and municipal bodies were informed, and that DUO will again be asked to inform school administrators.
Therefore I will again ask DUO to inform school administrators that a GBA extract is not necessary when pupils enrol in secondary education.
Daarom zal ik DUO opnieuw verzoeken schooladministrateurs op de hoogte te brengen van het feit dat bij inschrijving van leerlingen in het voortgezet onderwijs een GBA-uittreksel niet nodig is.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen en Jasper van Dijk, Peters over een volgende aanslag op het rijksmonument Sankt Ludwig in Vlodrop

Three MPs (Jansen, Van Dijk and Peters) asked whether the foundation Meru had again applied for demolition of the national monument Sankt Ludwig in Vlodrop, whether the municipality of Roerdalen had enforced repair, and whether the instruments were adequate. The state secretary confirmed the new permit application and said the municipality has used enforcement (an order under penalty, upheld by the Raad van State, with a deadline of 21 September 2012), that the minister has no power to force repair, and that no change in procedures is needed.
I have no legal means to enforce restoration.
Ik heb geen wettelijke mogelijkheden om herstel af te dwingen.
Antwoord vragen Kortenoeven, Bosma en Wilders over de Turkse reactie op het in het Rijksmuseum exposeren van een ‘anti-Turkse spotprent’

PVV MPs asked the government about Turkish media criticism of a 1683 anti-Turkish caricature exhibited at the Rijksmuseum, whether Turkish authorities had contacted the Dutch government, and whether the museum's explanatory text was a form of capitulation. The minister answered that the Turkish embassy raised concern via the foreign ministry, that the museum is responsible for its own captions, and that the government does not share the characterization of the museum's conduct.
As for any Turkish contacts with the Rijksmuseum, I refer you to the director of the Rijksmuseum.
Voor wat betreft eventuele Turkse contacten met het Rijksmuseum, verwijs ik u naar de directeur van het Rijksmuseum.
Antwoord vragen Elias over stakingen in het onderwijs

An MP asks the education minister about school closures and teacher strikes in March 2012, including whether schools must provide care for parents, whether strikers' salaries are paid, and whether lost teaching hours must be made up. The minister answers that striking is a worker's right, schools must communicate with parents and arrange alternative care, and the Inspectorate will monitor instructional time, while declining to investigate salary payments.
Antwoord op vragen Jasper van Dijk over "de school als vastgoedmagnaat", i.v.m. nieuwbouw door scholen

An SP MP asks the education minister whether a 100 million euro new-build project by Arcus College in Heerlen, amid vacancy in the city, is justified and how it can be prevented in future. The minister answers that the plans were made when the local property market was sound, that boards and the Inspectorate provide sufficient checks, and that the college's housing spending is below the sector benchmark, though the Inspectorate will examine staffing and temporary-staff arrangements.
Antwoord vragen Jasper Van Dijk over problemen in het middelbaar beroepsonderwijs

An SP MP asks the education minister about problems in vocational education (mbo), including low student satisfaction with learning, assessment quality, unpaid optional fees, timetable gaps and placement-related dismissals. The minister acknowledges shortcomings, points to the inspectorate's monitoring, planned intensification and an action plan, and rejects the survey as unrepresentative.
The bill "Efficient learning routes/modernisation of funding", submitted to the House of Representatives, contains the measures that answer the bottlenecks revealed in the SP survey.

Het wetsvoorstel «Doelmatige leerwegen/modernisering bekostiging», aangeboden aan de Tweede Kamer, bevat de maatregelen die een antwoord vormen op de knelpunten die in het SP-onderzoek naar voren komen.
Antwoord vragen Van Dekken en Çelik over het verlies van werkgelegenheid in het primair onderwijs als gevolg van daling van leerlingaantallen in het hele land.

MPs Van Dekken and Çelik asked the education minister about job losses in primary education caused by falling pupil numbers, including a union estimate of up to 4,500 dismissals and the effects of cuts to inclusive education. The minister answered that natural teacher outflow largely offsets the decline, that cuts to passend onderwijs will remove about 4,987 fte, and that measures such as longer bekostiging periods and experiments are planned for shrinking regions.
Due to a declining number of pupils, fewer teachers are needed.
Door een dalend aantal leerlingen zijn er minder leraren nodig.
Antwoord vragen Çelik over een voorwaarde die de ABN/Amro verbindt aan sponsoring

An MP asked the education minister whether it is acceptable that ABN AMRO would sponsor only the vmbo graduation day of a school unless it could also sponsor havo/vwo students, and whether this signals growing school dependence on sponsoring. The minister replied that the newspaper report rested on a misunderstanding that has since been corrected, and that sponsoring is a matter between school and sponsor governed by a 2009 convenant on conduct rules.
The article 'Vmbo students are not second-class citizens' from Dagblad de Limburger of 15 March 2012, referred to, is based on a misunderstanding.
Het artikel «Vmbo-leerlingen zijn geen tweederangsburgers» uit het Dagblad de Limburger van 15 maart 2012, waaraan wordt gerefereerd, berust op een misverstand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Biskop en Joldersma over een tekort aan stageplekken in het mbo

MPs Biskop and Joldersma asked the ministers about a reported shortage of internship places in vocational education (mbo), particularly in care and welfare, and how the government would stimulate more places. The minister answered that enrolment and placements have risen, cited the Stagefonds funding, and said existing instruments are considered sufficient, without committing to new measures.
At present, according to SBB, the existing instruments of the knowledge centres are sufficient to keep the national supply of internship places and apprenticeships at the desired level.
Op dit moment volstaat volgens de SBB het bestaande instrumentarium van de kenniscentra om het landelijke aanbod van stageplaatsen en leerbanen op peil te houden.
Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het tekort aan stageplaatsen in het mbo (ingezonden 9 maart 2012).

An MP asked the education minister about reported shortages of internship places in vocational education (mbo) and whether these threaten a structural labour market problem. The minister answered that no major shortage yet exists, pointed to recent sector data and existing instruments, and declined to add extra measures for now but asked the SBB to monitor the situation.
However, I have asked the SBB to keep a close eye on the situation and to inform me when the existing instruments are no longer sufficient to maintain the supply.
Wel heb ik de SBB gevraagd de vinger aan de pols te houden en mij te informeren op het moment dat het bestaande instrumentarium niet meer toereikend is om het aanbod op peil te houden.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed en Klaver over het gebrek aan open standaarden in het voortgezet onderwijs

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the education minister about the lack of open standards in secondary education, including use of NL-LOM and e-portfolio standards, Magister software access problems and whether accreditation covers digital accessibility. The minister answered that schools bear responsibility under a 'high trust' pas-toe-of-leg-uit principle, cited NOiV activities and Kennisnet/EduStandaard support, and declined further dedicated studies, while promising a round-table discussion on Magister.
National government policy on open standards is based on a 'high trust' principle.
Het rijksbrede beleid ten aanzien van open standaarden is gebaseerd op een «high trust»-principe.
Antwoord vragen Van der Ham over het terugtrekken van een satirisch tv-item

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why a satirical item about God and Allah on the AVRO programme Neonletters was withdrawn, and whether fear of public uproar is a valid reason not to broadcast such material. The minister replied that broadcasters have programmatic autonomy and that it is not for her to judge editorial choices, and that the AVRO stated uproar was not the reason for dropping the item.
Broadcasters in the Netherlands have programmatic autonomy.
Omroepen in Nederland hebben programmatische autonomie.
Antwoord vragen Çelik inzake een constructie waarbij een roc diverse extra studiekosten op de schouders van leerlingen legt

An MP asked the education minister whether a vocational college forcing students to buy a basic package and extra fees from a private company, with a 10% administrative surcharge, is acceptable. The minister answered that schools may not force purchases from a specific supplier, that surcharges are only allowed if transparent and optional, and that a guideline for vocational colleges will be issued and the inspectorate has contacted the institution to correct its website.
The institution concerned will also make it clearer on its website that there is no question of forced purchasing.
Ook zal de betreffende instelling op de website duidelijker maken dat van gedwongen winkelnering geen sprake is.
Antwoord vragen Dijsselbloem over voedingszorg voor kinderen met een chronische aandoening

An MP asked the health and education ministers about a report showing high malnutrition risk among chronically ill children at LZK schools, a cost-benefit analysis of nutritional care, and a proposed expertise centre. The minister said the report's conclusions are not sufficiently researched and refused to fund or formally support the expertise centre, which is not a government responsibility.
I am therefore not willing to support this initiative financially or administratively.
Ik ben dan ook niet bereid om dit initiatief financieel of bestuurlijk te ondersteunen.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over Pink Pearls

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a conflict between the organisation Pink Pearls and subsidised organisations, including a alleged defamation campaign, market exclusion, and whether the minister would mediate. The minister acknowledged the conflict, declined to intervene because the ministry is not a party and a court has already ruled, and said market exclusion is for the judge to assess.
The Ministry of Education, Culture and Science is not a party to this conflict, on which the District Court in Utrecht has already ruled.
Het ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap is geen partij bij dit conflict, waarover de Rechtbank in Utrecht al een uitspraak heeft gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra over De uitspraak van de Minister-president dat het voor homoseksuele mannen mogelijk wordt bloed te doneren.

An MP asked whether the Prime Minister's statement that gay men would be allowed to donate blood is accurate, and whether the government had already decided its position without waiting for Council of Europe recommendations. The minister answered that the policy is under review in consultation with the education minister, that current rules exclude men who have sex with men, and that a decision depends on a forthcoming Council of Europe resolution expected in May 2012, with a letter to parliament promised before the summer recess.
I expect to inform your House about this before the summer recess.
Naar verwachting zal ik uw Kamer hier voor het zomerreces over informeren.
Antwoord vragen Dijkgraaf over de programmatische onafhankelijkheid van omroepen

An MP asked whether broadcasters' programmatic independence should be limited for content such as eating human flesh, whether the public broadcaster should be held morally accountable, and what criminal-law criteria apply. The minister answered that programmatic independence is not restricted in advance, that eating human flesh as such is not punishable though obtaining it may be, and that it is not for the government to set standards of decency.
No, as minister I do not decide on the moral choices a broadcaster makes.
Nee, als minister ga ik niet over de morele keuzes die een omroep maakt.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk over bouwfraude bij Rotterdamse scholen

An SP MP asked the education minister about alleged construction fraud at Rotterdam schools run by foundation BOOR, including whether the board can investigate itself, who can intervene in mismanagement, and whether the board should be suspended and the foundation scaled down. The minister awaits the prosecutor's findings, notes an independent external investigation has been commissioned, explains the board and municipal council intervention powers, and says she will return to the matter once the investigation concludes.
I am awaiting the conclusions of the ongoing investigation by the Public Prosecution Service.
Ik wacht de conclusies van het nog lopende onderzoek door het Openbaar Ministerie af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Çelik over financiële problemen bij een groot schoolbestuur over € 192 miljoen die schoolbesturen in het voortgezet onderwijs zouden oppotten

An MP asks the minister why school boards in secondary education held a reserve of EUR 192 million above what was needed, and whether steps should be taken now. The minister says the figure is not recognised, the reserves are falling in a controlled way, and she will await the Inspectorate's additional research before acting.
I see no reason to take further steps now, but first await the report on the Inspectorate's additional research.
Ik zie geen reden om nu verdere stappen te zetten, maar wacht eerst het rapport over het extra onderzoek van de Inspectie af.
Antwoord vragen Çelik over het toelatingsbeleid van het St.Nicolaaslyceum te Amsterdam.

An MP asks the Education Minister whether it is acceptable that Amsterdam's St. Nicolaaslyceum refuses pupils with a havo recommendation, and whether such refusals breach the voluntary Amsterdam admissions agreement. The minister says she finds such a development undesirable but does not expect it, notes schools must assess suitability, denies the school signed the agreement, and says she will consult the sectors if it spreads.
I find it, as mentioned earlier, an undesirable development. Should the situation you describe arise – though I do not expect it – I will consult with the primary and secondary education sectors.

Ik vind het zoals eerder vermeld geen wenselijke ontwikkeling. Wanneer de situatie die u schetst zich gaat voordoen – al verwacht ik dat niet – dan zal ik in overleg treden met de PO- en de VO-sector.
Antwoord vragen Van der Ham over de medezeggenschap aan het Stedelijk Lyceum te Enschede.

An MP asked whether works council members can enforce a Geschillencommissie ruling against a school board, and whether the Ondernemingskamer procedure and a lack of legal remedy create a gap in protection. The minister confirmed the Ondernemingskamer handles compliance disputes but a works council lacks legal personality, so individual members must go to the voorzieningenrechter, declined a funding sanction, and saw no gap as she considers the existing route adequate.
Therefore in this case one or more members of the works council, as natural persons, will have to go to the interim relief judge to enforce compliance with the ruling.
Daarom zal in dit geval een of meerdere leden van het medezeggenschapsorgaan als natuurlijk persoon naar de voorzieningenrechter dienen te gaan om naleving van de uitspraak af te dwingen.
Antwoord vragen Van Dam over de signaalsterkte van de radio in Noord-Holland (min ELI)

An MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Education, Culture and Science why radio reception in northern Noord-Holland remains poor and when it will improve, and whether other regions have similar problems. The minister said higher transmitter power is being coordinated, with Radio 1-3 ready but Radio 4 still under negotiation with Belgium, and that full restoration depends on rebuilding the Hoogersmilde mast and repairing Lopik by around summer 2012.
Since 2008, Agentschap Telecom, together with the Dutch Public Broadcasting organisation (NPO), has worked on improving reception of national public broadcasters in the area mentioned.
Er is sinds 2008 door Agentschap Telecom, samen met de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep (NPO), gewerkt aan verbetering van de ontvangst van landelijk publieke omroepen in het genoemde gebied.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk en Gesthuizen over ontslagen bij uitgeverij Wegener

Two SP MPs asked ministers whether they condone the planned loss of 300 to 350 jobs at publisher Wegener, whether regional news provision is important, and how they would support regional news. The ministers said job cuts are a private company decision, acknowledged the importance of news provision, and pointed to regional media centre cooperation and the Stimuleringsfonds voor de Pers as measures.
Although I regret the loss of employment, it is primarily up to Wegener to decide on this.
Hoewel ik het verlies aan werkgelegenheid betreur, is het primair aan Wegener om hierover een besluit te nemen.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers, Recourt en Van Dam over het Haarlems Dagblad

MPs Dikkers, Recourt and Van Dam asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the Haarlems Dagblad and Gooi- en Eemlander might disappear under Telegraaf Media Groep plans, and whether legal means exist to prevent it. The minister replied that TMG and HDC Media had stated no plan exists to close titles, that the press sector is primarily responsible for its own market problems, and that the government sees no reason to intervene.
The government therefore pursues a very restrained policy towards the press sector.
De overheid voert dan ook een zeer terughoudend beleid ten aanzien van de perssector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Çelik over financiële problemen bij een groot schoolbestuur

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Çelik asked the education minister about reported multi-million euro deficits, weak schools, dropout and board turmoil at Amarantis, a large Amsterdam school board with over 30,000 pupils. The minister answered that the situation is being examined by the board and supervised by the Inspectorate, gave dropout and weak-programme figures, stated that large boards do not inherently harm quality, and declined to pre-empt measures pending the board's plans.
I do not wish to anticipate any measures that may be taken.
Op eventueel te nemen maatregelen wil ik dan ook niet vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Biskop over groot tekort bij Amarantis

An MP asked the education minister about a large deficit at Amarantis, a school group, including its size in 2009, whether it grew under intensified supervision, why it was not reduced, and what instruments the Inspectorate has. The minister replied that Amarantis had a surplus in 2009 and 2010 but its finances worsened in 2011, that the Inspectorate tightened supervision in January 2012 after the board failed to act, and listed the Inspectorate's and minister's intervention powers.
Antwoord vragen Beertema over een artikel waarin gesteld wordt dat geweld binnen scholen door schooldirecties nog niet altijd voldoende wordt aangepakt

An MP asks the education minister whether school boards bear final responsibility for safety, whether they sometimes avoid reporting violence to protect their school's reputation, and whether reporting should be mandatory. The minister confirms board responsibility, lists existing measures such as higher penalties and reporting guidance, but declines to make reporting mandatory for schools and promises a review of reporting willingness with other ministries.
Because there are signals that various factors influence willingness to report, it is currently being examined how willingness to report at schools can be improved.
Omdat er signalen zijn dat verschillende factoren de aangiftebereidheid beïnvloeden wordt momenteel in kaart gebracht hoe de aangiftebereidheid op scholen kan worden verbeterd.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold, Hachchi, Schouw en Dijkstra over Kamervragen Oeganda anti-homoseksualiteitswet

D66 MPs asked the foreign minister whether the government would protest to Uganda over a renewed anti-homosexuality bill that proposes the death penalty, and what concrete steps would follow if it passed. The minister said the bill is unacceptable, that Nederland and the EU have raised objections with Uganda, that the Ugandan premier distanced himself from it, and that further steps are premature.
I do not consider the proposed private member's bill acceptable.
Ik acht het voorliggende initiatiefwetsvoorstel niet acceptabel.
Antwoord vragen Çelik over het verlies van vertrouwen van het onderwijsveld in bewindspersoon

An MP asked the education minister how she views survey results showing 78% of primary school teachers and principals and 94% of secondary school staff have no confidence in her, and whether she will reconsider measures teachers see as setbacks. The minister acknowledged the findings, said some measures are hard for the field given finances, and said she remains in dialogue with the sector without committing to specific changes.
I have taken note of the findings of the research.
Ik heb kennisgenomen van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Van der Ham over de lange termijn voor het terugstorten van de borg op gratis schoolboeken

MP Van der Ham asked the Education Minister whether a legal deadline exists for refunding the deposit on free school textbooks, how long refunds take, and how much money is involved. The minister answered that no statutory deadline exists, deposits are arranged between schools and parents, and agreed conditions apply; she referred to the evaluation for the deposit amounts, noting about three quarters of schools with external book funds charged a deposit, typically 75 euros.
No deadline for refunding the deposit is included in the education legislation.
Er is in de onderwijswetgeving geen termijn opgenomen voor terugstorting van de borg.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman en Jasper Van Dijk over het bericht dat er fors bezuinigd wordt op het schoolmaatschappelijk werk

Two SP MPs asked whether reported large cuts to school social work, which reduce oversight of children with problems at home, would be reversed and whether municipalities cutting prevention conflicts with passend onderwijs and youth care reform. The state secretary answered that school social work is important but that municipalities and schools must decide themselves, that the government does not track cut amounts and will not investigate, and that prevention is a goal of the youth care reform.
I am not aware of how many municipalities are cutting back on school social work.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel gemeenten bezuinigen op het schoolmaatschappelijk werk.

Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het artikel «BNN-presentatoren plegen kannibalisme (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

An MP asked ministers whether BNN presenters who had flesh cut from their bodies and eaten on TV amounted to cannibalism, and whether the broadcast should be penalised or the presenters made to pay fines personally. The ministers answered that the broadcaster is responsible for its content, that no criminal offence was apparent, that the regulators lack competence over such content, and that they would examine whether fines should come from association funds rather than public money.
The Public Prosecution Service sees no reason in the broadcast to proceed with prosecution.
Het Openbaar Ministerie ziet in de uitzending geen aanleiding om tot vervolging over te gaan.
Antwoord vragen Jasper van Dijk en Smits over de steeds lager opgeleide mbo-docenten

MPs Van Dijk and Smits asked about reports that mbo teachers are increasingly under-qualified and whether the government will act on the rising share lacking teaching qualifications. The state secretary replied that the mbo teaching workforce is mixed, that 11% of teachers lack a qualification (mostly career changers given two years to qualify), and that no separate budget exists for qualifying unqualified teachers beyond general professionalisation funds.
The Cabinet therefore aims for all teachers working in mbo to be appointable and to obtain their qualification within two years, if not already obtained.
Het Kabinet streeft er daarom naar dat alle in het mbo werkzame leraren benoembaar zijn en binnen twee jaren hun bevoegdheid behalen, indien nog niet behaald.

Vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Smits (beiden SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over scholen die vooruitlopen op mogelijke wetgeving rondom het zogenaamde «passend onderwijs» (ingezonden 22

MPs Van Dijk and Smits asked the Minister of Education whether schools cutting jobs and raising class sizes ahead of approved 'passend onderwijs' legislation was acceptable, and questioned the cuts. The Minister replied that no financial necessity exists to cut jobs now, that the cuts follow standard legislative procedures, that schools are responsible for their own staffing, and that she will not postpone the measures.
There is currently, however, no financial need to cut jobs now as a result of the proposed measures.
Er is op dit moment echter geen financiële noodzaak om als gevolg van de voorgenomen maatregelen nu al banen te schrappen.

An MP asked the education minister about a broadcast on children with Down syndrome being refused by schools and the number of truants (thuiszitters), and whether schools are refusing pupils strategically ahead of the Passend Onderwijs law. The minister denied seeing signals confirming the picture, estimated about 2,500 truants, and pointed to regional approaches and a Gedragswerk project, while promising new truancy data by 15 March 2012.
There are now good structures for a regional approach to truant pupils.
Er zijn nu goede structuren voor een regionale aanpak van thuiszittende leerlingen.

Vragen van de leden Van Gent en Klaver (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over voorlichting homoseksualiteit op scholen waarin de homoseksuele praktijk veroordeeld wordt (ingezonden

Two GreenLeft MPs asked the education minister about the EenVandaag broadcast on the 'Wonderlijk gemaakt' lesson method, which condemns homosexual practice, and whether schools can offer a safe climate for gay pupils. The minister replied that schools have freedom in curriculum design within core goals, that they must still ensure a safe climate and respect, that the Inspectorate monitors this, and that the ministry is in talks with the reformed school association and will add sexual diversity to the core goals.
This means that all pupils and teachers should feel safe at their school, regardless of the school's direction or denomination. The Inspectorate monitors this.
Het staat hiermee voorop dat alle leerlingen en leraren zich op hun school veilig zouden moeten voelen, ongeacht de richting of grondslag van de school. De Inspectie ziet hierop toe.

Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een scholengemeenschap die het onderwijs meent te verbeteren door voortaan leerlingen met een havo-advies af te wijzen (ingezonden

An MP asked the education minister how she assesses a Amsterdam school's decision to stop admitting pupils with a havo advice, whether it breaches the Amsterdam transition convention, and how the inspectorate will treat this 'cherry-picking' in its ratings. The minister answered that admission decisions are the competent authority's responsibility, that she cannot judge the convention question, and that the inspectorate measures results against the primary school advice, while she will monitor the po-vo transition.
It is not for me to judge admission decisions of schools.
Het is dus niet aan mij om over toelatingsbeslissingen van scholen te oordelen.
Antwoord vragen Voortman en Van Gent over het bericht dat homotherapie vergoed wordt

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether health insurers must reimburse 'homotherapy' aimed at curing homosexuality, which medical bodies call unsound and dangerous. Minister Schippers answered that such therapy is not covered by the Zvw, that the IGZ inspection found Different offers no treatment aimed at curing homosexuality, and that the IGZ will act on any new complaints.
Following the newspaper report, the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) paid an inspection visit to care organisation Different in Amsterdam.
Naar aanleiding van bedoeld krantenbericht, heeft de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) een inspectiebezoek gebracht aan zorgorganisatie Different te Amsterdam.
Antwoord vragen Çelik over examinering op de Antillen en de positie van het Vespucci College in het bijzonder

An MP asked whether mandatory state examinations on Bonaire threaten the Vespucci College on Curaçao, and whether examinations should be allowed on Curaçao. The minister replied that the school is privately funded, that exams on Bonaire are an accessible option, and that a Council of State advice indicates only a national law could allow exams on Curaçao, which it considers a heavy route for a small group.
Using the option to sit the state examination on Bonaire is then the most practical solution.
Gebruik maken van de mogelijkheid staatsexamen te doen op Bonaire is dan de meest praktische oplossing.
Antwoord vragen Van der Ham inzake medezeggenschap Stedelijk Lyceum Enschede

An MP asked the education minister how the government responds to a school board ignoring binding rulings of the national school dispute commission and the Enterprise Chamber on participation rights at Stedelijk Lyceum Enschede, and whether the WMS should give councils stronger enforcement tools, including cost reimbursement and an enquiry right. The minister said parties must comply with rulings, that councils can seek enforcement at the Enterprise Chamber and funding can be withdrawn, that the WMS is under evaluation with proposals to be considered in a policy response, and that no enquiry right is planned for primary and secondary education.
At present I am having the WMS evaluated, examining the effectiveness and effects of the law in practice.
Op dit moment laat ik de WMS evalueren, waarbij gekeken wordt naar de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van de wet in de praktijk.

Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de consequenties van de feitelijke fusie van ROC Flevoland en het ROC van Amsterdam (ingezonden 7 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether the de facto merger of ROC Flevoland and ROC van Amsterdam, which lifted all four ROC Flevoland board members into the top ten of best-paid ROC heads, changes her earlier stance, and whether the extra work justifies such pay. The Minister says she found no formal merger after an Inspectorate study, rejects the pay rise, has asked the Inspectorate for further research, and notes the WNT pay-norming bill; she reports no complaints received.
I have also asked the Inspectorate of Education to now carry out additional research into the cooperation construction used by the ROC van Amsterdam and ROC Flevoland.
Tevens heb ik de Inspectie van het Onderwijs gevraagd om nu aanvullend onderzoek te doen naar de door het ROC van Amsterdam en het ROC Flevoland toegepaste constructie van samenwerking.

Vragen van het lid Biskop (CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de aanvraag van de Stichting Voortgezet Onderwijs Kerkrade voor stichting van het College Nova Rolduc te Kerkrade (ingezonden 23 d

An MP asks the education minister why a request by the Stichting Voortgezet Onderwijs Kerkrade to found a new school, College Nova Rolduc, was rejected despite strong local interest, and whether a school could instead be transferred from another foundation. The minister confirms the rejection under the statutory formula, which counts existing schools and projected enrolment rather than expressed interest, and says a transfer is legally possible only if the initiating school board takes the step.
Expressed "interest" is not a scientifically tested method for establishing the pupil potential of a new school.
Getoonde «belangstelling» is geen wetenschappelijk beproefde methode om het leerlingenpotentieel voor een nieuwe school vast te stellen.

Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de aanvraag die de Stichting Voortgezet Onderwijs Kerkrade bij de minister heeft ingediend om toestemming te krijgen om in Kerkrad

An MP asked the education minister whether she had considered the application to found College Nova Rolduc in Kerkrade, why a Parkstad school closed, and whether citizen initiatives and school-choice motives related to quality could be weighed in new school applications. The minister answered that the application was rejected, that closing a branch is the board's decision and the minister will talk with the board, that new schools are bound by law, and that existing law already allows funding to be stopped for very poor-performing schools.
Soon, at my request, a meeting will take place with SVO|PL in which they will among other things explain the motives for their decision.
Binnenkort vindt er op mijn verzoek een gesprek met SVO|PL plaats waarin zij onder meer de motieven voor hun beslissing komen toelichten.
Vragen van het lid Elias (VVD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het door scholen betalen van vervoer naar een LAKS-demonstratie (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

An MP asked the education minister whether a school had paid for buses to a LAKS student demonstration and whether such funds should be recovered. The minister answered that the report was incorrect: the student council organised and paid for the buses through ticket sales, and the school's management was not involved, so no recovery was needed.
Inquiry with the chair of the Executive Board of OSG Sevenwolden revealed that the report that this school had used education funds for transport to the student demonstration was incorrect

Navraag bij de voorzitter van het College van Bestuur van OSG Sevenwolden leerde dat het bericht dat deze school onderwijsgeld zou hebben ingezet voor vervoer naar de scholierendemonstratie onjuist was

Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het artikel «BNN-presentatoren plegen kannibalisme (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

MP Haverkamp (CDA) asked the ministers of Education and of Justice whether BNN presenters Dennis Storm and Valerio Zeno cut flesh from their bodies and ate it on television, whether this counts as cannibalism, whether it is punishable, and whether the presenters or BNN should bear any fine. The government replied only with a procedural notice that the answers would be delayed by interdepartmental consultation and promised them within three weeks.
the answering of the parliamentary questions from MP Haverkamp (CDA) about the article 'BNN presenters commit cannibalism' cannot take place within the set deadline

de beantwoording van de Kamervragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) van uw Kamer over het artikel «BNN-presentatoren plegen kannibalisme» (ingezonden 23 december 2011) niet binnen de gestelde termijn kan plaatsvinden
Antwoord vragen Van Miltenburg over de tegenspraak tussen de uitspraken van AVRO-directeur Maas en de minister over de bezuiniging bij de Publieke Omroep

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science to explain the contradiction between her claim that cuts to the public broadcaster will not affect programming and the AVRO director's statement that they will, and asks whether efficiency savings can be enforced and a financial breakdown of closing a public TV channel provided. The minister replies that the director was misunderstood, refuses to produce a further cost calculation, points to independent research showing savings are possible without loss of quality, and says the board has been instructed to implement and monitor the cuts.
I will not make a further calculation.
Ik zal geen nadere berekening maken.
Vragen van het lid Elias (VVD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over fraude bij de Stichting Islamitische Scholen (SIS) te Almere (ingezonden 4 november 2011).

The MP asks when the court ruling on OCW's clawback from the Almere Islamic schools foundation (SIS, now Stichting Noor) is expected, and whether government should refrain from hiring the person allegedly involved until the court rules. The minister answers that the court already ruled on 7 November 2011 and declared the foundation's appeal unfounded, and that the case concerns a clawback against the school board, not a criminal case against the individual, whose unauthorised payroll placement led to reclaimed funding.
The Zwolle-Lelystad district court ruled on 7 November 2011 and declared the appeal of Stichting Noor (the new name of SIS) unfounded.
De rechtbank Zwolle-Lelystad heeft op 7 november 2011 uitspraak gedaan en het beroep van Stichting Noor (de nieuwe naam van SIS) ongegrond verklaard.

Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat de 170 leerlingen van de failliete basisschool «De Regenboog» in Maarssen door de curator zonder pardon op straa

An MP asks the education minister whether the curator of the bankrupt Maarssen school may sell the municipally owned building while 170 pupils still attend, and what safeguards exist for staff, parents and pupils. The minister says she disagrees with the curator's view, is in talks with the municipality and curator, and has offered temporary financial support so pupils can continue in the same building after Christmas.
I do not share that view. I am in discussion about this with the municipality of Maarssen and with the curator.
Ik deel die mening niet. Ik ben hierover in gesprek met de gemeente Maarssen en met de curator.

Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de aangenomen resolutie van de VO-raad die uitspreekt dat de Wet onderwijstijd niet uitgevoerd zal worden, ook niet als de Eerst

An MP asks the minister whether she is aware of a VO-raad resolution declaring that the Wet onderwijstijd will not be implemented even if the Eerste Kamer adopts it, and whether a sector council acting this way should be dissolved. The minister answers that she takes note of the resolution, expects the VO-raad to respect democratically enacted laws, and does not see reason to reconsider its status as government interlocutor.
Naturally, a sector council such as the VO-raad must also respect democratically enacted laws.
Uiteraard moet ook een Sectorraad als de VO-raad democratisch tot stand gekomen wetten eerbiedigen.

Vragen van de leden Dijkstra (D66) en Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een vergoeding van secundaire geslachtskenmerken voor transgenderoperaties (ingezonden 18 november

Two MPs asked the minister about a Transgender Remembrance Day and whether secondary sex characteristics should be covered by insurance for gender-affirming treatment, citing an adopted motion. The government acknowledged the importance of these characteristics for transgender people but said it sees no room in the Health Insurance Act to extend coverage or provide funding.
However, the cabinet currently sees no room to extend the entitlements under the Health Insurance Act on this point or otherwise make funding available for this.
Het kabinet ziet op dit moment echter geen ruimte om de aanspraken ingevolge de Zorgverzekeringswet op dit punt uit te breiden of anderszins hiervoor financiering ter beschikking te stellen.
Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de Toelatingscode vmbo-t / havo van de VO-Raad (ingezonden 8 december 2011).

MP Çelik asks the minister whether the VO-Raad's admission code for vmbo-t to havo transfer, with a 6.8 average exam grade cap and an interview, honours the Chamber's motion, and why the code takes effect only on 1 August 2012. The minister replies that the code combines grades with an interview and school advice, that a klachtenloket and an Inspectie study in 2012 will monitor compliance, and that schools will already apply the code in spring 2012.
To support this, I have agreed with the VO-Raad that a complaints desk will be operational, where parents and pupils can report if schools do not comply with the code.
Ter ondersteuning hiervan heb ik met de VO-raad afgesproken dat er dan ook een klachtenloket operationeel is, waar ouders en leerlingen het kunnen melden als scholen zich niet aan de code houden.

Vragen van het lid Smits (SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat basisscholen er fors op achteruit gaan door de bezuinigingen op «passend onderwijs» (ingezonden 7 oktober 2011).

An SP MP asks the education minister about reports that regular primary schools lose substantial funding under the 'passend onderwijs' (inclusive education) cuts, including the case of a school in Dronten whose special-needs budget falls from EUR 114,000 to about EUR 30,000. The minister denies that regular schools lose much, explains the budget reallocation to the cooperation bodies, and rejects claims that regular schools are not being spared.
I have taken note of the broadcast, but I do not recognise the picture that regular schools lose a lot of money when passend onderwijs is introduced.
Ik heb kennis genomen van de betreffende uitzending, maar herken me niet in het beeld dat reguliere scholen veel geld kwijtraken bij de invoering van passend onderwijs.

Vragen van het lid Dijsselbloem (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat de vakbonden het overleg hebben gestaakt vanwege haar weigering om het budget voor prestatiebeloning in te

Ms. Dijsselbloem (PvdA) asked the Minister of Education whether unions broke off talks because she refused to reconsider cuts to inclusive education and why she would not use performance-pay funds to soften them. The minister replied that the cuts were only temporised, part of the performance-pay funds were used to cover this, and the remaining funds go to experiments, while she offered measures to preserve expertise and limit forced dismissals.

In this consultation the state secretary and I indicated that we are willing, within the budgetary framework, to take measures aimed at preserving expertise and preventing forced dismissals as far as possible.

In dit overleg hebben de staatssecretaris en ik aangegeven bereid te zijn binnen het budgettaire kader maatregelen te treffen gericht op het behoud van expertise en het zo veel mogelijk voorkomen van gedwongen ontslagen.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over boetes en schadevergoedingen bij de publieke omroep (ingezonden 4 november 2011).

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether broadcasters should pay fines and damages for unlawful programme conduct, citing TROS, BNN and a Supreme Court TNT ruling, and whether employees or producers should bear the costs. The Minister answers that liability lies with the broadcaster under the Mediawet, that recovery from employees or producers depends on civil law and contracts, and that the matter of individual guilt is for the courts.

It is not for me to judge whether the two BNN presenters and the programme makers of the VOC programme violated the law and, if so, whether that was done intentionally. That is a matter for the judge.

Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te hebben over de vraag of de twee BNN-presentatoren en de programmamakers van het programma VOC de wet hebben overtreden en zo ja, of dat opzettelijk is gebeurd. Dat is een zaak van de rechter.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over grensoverschrijdend leerlingenvervoer (ingezonden 15 november 2011).

An MP asks the Education minister about a deaf boy from Maastricht who must travel 120 km or board to reach deaf education, while a nearer school in Hasselt, Belgium exists, and whether cross-border school transport should be enabled. The minister replies that school transport is decentralised to municipalities, which may decide case by case, that no similar cases are known, and that no law change is needed.
The implementation of pupil transport has been decentralised to the municipality.
De uitvoering van het leerlingenvervoer is gedecentraliseerd naar de gemeente.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over borg en handel rond schoolboeken (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

An MP asked the education minister whether the government knew of Van Dijk Educatie's book-exchange and deposit actions, whether it is acceptable that commercial parties earn interest on deposits and convert part of them into shop credit, and whether similar actions by other suppliers exist. The minister replied that the deposit is a matter between schools, parents and the supplier, that the government sees no reason to intervene in these commercial arrangements, that it will not regulate the deposit amount, and that other such actions are not known to her, while urging all parties to follow agreed deposit principles.

As long as initiatives do not conflict with this purpose, there is no compulsory shop purchasing, and the interests of the school, pupil or parent are not jeopardised, I see no reason to interfere in this kind of commercial action.

Zolang initiatieven niet strijdig zijn met dit doel, er geen sprake is van gedwongen winkelnering en de belangen van de school, leerling of ouder niet in het gedrang komen, zie ik geen reden mij te mengen in dit soort commerciële acties.

Vragen van het lid Dijsselbloem (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het vrijwillige mobiliteitsplan voor leerkrachten in krimpgebieden «in beweging» (ingezonden 4 november 2011).

Dijsselbloem (PvdA) asked the education minister whether she would support the 'In beweging' voluntary mobility project for primary teachers in shrinking Eastern Netherlands and whether the Participatiefonds should finance it. The minister welcomed the project, explained that the Participatiefonds and school boards decide on funding, and listed statutory measures giving declining schools more time.
It is up to the board of the Participatiefonds to decide on support for projects such as the 'In beweging' project.
Het is aan het bestuur van het Participatiefonds om een beslissing te nemen over ondersteuning van projecten zoals het project «In beweging».
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat duizenden leerlingen onterecht thuis zitten (ingezonden 7 november 2011).

MP Van der Ham (D66) asked the education minister about reports that thousands of pupils are wrongly kept at home (thuiszitters), whether research into their numbers will be done, how their right to education and legal protection are guaranteed, and how school pupil files and their privacy are handled. The minister answered that a 2010 Ingrado study exists, that new figures come in early 2012, that legal remedies (objection, appeal, civil court, complaints committees) exist, and that policy on passend onderwijs and pupil-file rules will be reviewed.
I see no reason to carry out further supplementary research on this theme.
Ik zie geen reden om op dit thema verder aanvullend onderzoek te doen.

Vragen van de leden Çelik en Kuiken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over tussentijdse verzwaring van opleidingen voor MBO-deeltijdleerlingen (ingezonden 9 november 2011).

MPs Çelik and Kuiken asked the education minister whether MBO part-time courses were being made harder mid-course by adding mandatory subjects like mathematics ahead of centrally set exams. The minister called such mid-course additions undesirable, denied that the change stems from the 2013–2014 central exams, and pointed students to the institution's complaints procedure and the Ombudslijn mbo.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de bezuinigingen op de 2.42-omroepen (ingezonden 11 november 2011).

An MP from ChristenUnie asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why cuts to the religious broadcasters (2.42 omroepen) are justified by claims that a quarter of their programming is not religious, and whether the budget cut should be revised given doubts about the viewing data. The Minister replies that the 2010 classification and the 2009 visitation committee support the finding of a broad interpretation of the religious mandate, that the cut is partly based on it and will not be revised, and that the NPO and Commissariaat will implement the reductions gradually.
I see no reason to go back on that.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om daar op terug te komen.
Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over gediplomeerde overblijfkrachten in de tussenschoolse opvang (ingezonden 17 november 2011).

An MP asked the education minister about the 11 citizen letters received on school lunch supervision, whether the statutory requirement that half of lunch supervisors be trained still stands, and how that squares with ending the training subsidy from the new year. The minister confirmed the statutory requirement, said the subsidy was explicitly temporary and that schools are now responsible, and declined to take new action.
I have no indications that schools are being placed in an impossible task and will not take any new action.
Ik heb geen indicaties dat scholen voor een onmogelijke opgave worden geplaatst en ga geen nieuwe acties ondernemen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over thuiszittende leerlingen (ingezonden 22 november 2011).

An MP asked the minister of Education to address the case of a nearly 13-year-old pupil in Den Bosch who has been staying at home from school after illness and bullying. The minister replied that the case has her attention, that it is not a hopeless home-schooling situation, and that school, truancy officer, parents and support services are seeking a solution with other schools willing to take the pupil.
The talks with the parents will continue and I have every confidence that a solution will be found in the short term.
De gesprekken met de ouders worden voortgezet en ik heb er alle vertrouwen in dat op korte termijn een oplossing wordt gevonden.
Vragen van het lid Elias (VVD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over kosten van afscheidsfeest bij ROC Aventus (ingezonden 5 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the education minister whether she knows about the costly farewell reception at ROC Aventus, whether the cost (reportedly 35,000 euro) is publicly clarified, and whether she will consult the supervisory board on disputed facts. The minister confirmed awareness, said the actual cost was 24,710 euro, called it too high, and said she informed the supervisory board and urged sober spending in future.
I have informed the Supervisory Board of my view on this matter and urged it to be frugal with public funding in future situations.
Ik heb de Raad van Toezicht geïnformeerd over mijn zienswijze in deze kwestie en erop aangedrongen om in toekomstige situaties sober om te gaan met publieke bekostiging.
Vragen van het lid Van Miltenburg (VVD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de kinderprogrammering bij de publieke omroep, in het bijzonder de TROS (ingezonden 11 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about merchandising rules for children's programming at public broadcasters, prompted by the TROS dropping children's shows and fines for the Sprookjesboomfeest. The minister explains the non-commercial rules, says merchandise is allowed but must not serve third-party commercial interests, and commits to asking the Commissariaat for more clarity.
I will ask the Commissariaat to keep working to create as much clarity as possible for the broadcasters.
