Vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem (PvdA) en Smits (SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, cultuur en Wetenschap over een integratieklas in de regio Rotterdam (ingezonden 25 maart 2011).

Two MPs asked the education minister about the failure of schools in the Rotterdam region to set up an integration class for a pupil with an intellectual disability, and what steps had been taken. The minister answered that no school has yet agreed, that neither the partnership nor the minister can compel a school, and that the ministry has encouraged both parties and will keep following developments.
Neither the partnership nor I myself can oblige a school to set up an integration class.
Noch het samenwerkingsverband, noch ikzelf kunnen een school verplichten om een integratieklas op te zetten.

Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en Veiligheid en Justitie over grievende uitspraken over homo’s door leraren te Kampen (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

MP Marcouch asked ministers whether teachers at a Kampen school holding that homosexuality is a psychiatric disorder was acceptable, whether the government would investigate, and whether teachers could be sanctioned or prosecuted. The minister replied that the Inspectorate found the statement was a debate proposition in class, not a teacher's or school's view, so no further investigation, sanctions or criminal proceedings were deemed warranted, while pointing to existing school anti-bullying and homo-emancipation measures.

From information from the Inspectorate of Education, it has become clear that at Ichtus College in Kampen a debate took place in 6 vwo based on various propositions, including the proposition that homosexuality is a psychological disorder.

Uit informatie van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs, is mij gebleken dat bij het Ichtus College in Kampen in 6 vwo een debat heeft plaatsgevonden aan de hand van diverse stellingen, waaronder de stelling dat homoseksualiteit een psychische aandoening betreft.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over subsidie religieus vormingsonderwijs op openbare scholen (ingezonden 23 maart 2011).

The MP asks the Minister of Education about the state of religious and worldview education in public schools, its numbers and costs, whether schools must buy it from the Dienstencentrum GVO/HVO, and why it is subsidised since 2009 given separation of church and state. The Minister answers that about 70,000 pupils receive it at EUR 10 million per year, that the organisations employing the teachers are responsible for content and schools buy it from them, and that subsidy followed parliamentary pressure, with the Onderwijsraad seeing no constitutional bar.
Yes, G/HVO has been subsidised since 1 August 2009, after a long debate between successive cabinets and the House and at the House's urging.
Ja het G/HVO wordt na een langdurig debat tussen opeenvolgende kabinetten en de Kamer en op aandrang van de Kamer vanaf 1 augustus 2009 gesubsidieerd.
Vragen van het lid Elias (VVD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over basisschool As Siddieq (ingezonden 4 april 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether Article 8(3) of the Primary Education Act gives enough grip to sanction schools that obstruct integration, following a Council of State ruling on the As Siddieq school's funding. The Minister answers that the law suffices, since schools that do nothing or actively obstruct integration can be sanctioned, and that the As Siddieq school was sanctioned only for insufficient citizenship education, not for obstruction.
In summary, I am therefore of the opinion that the current citizenship provision, also in view of the Division's ruling, offers sufficient grip to act against schools that obstruct integration.
Resumerend ben ik daarom van mening dat de huidige burgerschapsbepaling, mede gezien de uitspraak van de Afdeling, voldoende houvast biedt om scholen aan te kunnen pakken die integratie belemmeren.
Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Strijd tegen de bezuinigingen» (ingezonden 10 maart 2011).

An MP from the PVV asks the education minister whether the PO-Raad, an education employers' body funded indirectly by OCW, is obstructing government policy by lobbying opposition parties to deny the coalition a Senate majority, and whether it should be called to account. The minister answers that the PO-Raad is entitled to invite party representatives to schools, that this is not obstruction, but that she would call it to account if it obstructed adopted policy.
Should there be a situation in which the PO-Raad obstructs the implementation of adopted policy, I will certainly call the PO-Raad to account.
Mocht er sprake zijn van een situatie waarom de PO-Raad obstructie pleegt ten aanzien van de uitvoering van vastgesteld beleid, dan zal ik de PO-Raad zeker ter verantwoording roepen.
Vragen van de leden Van den Berge en Van Gent (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de inzet van schoolbussen als antwoord op krimp (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about school buses as a response to population decline, including how many schools use them, who bears the costs, and the expected role in shrinking regions. The minister answered that pupil transport is the responsibility of municipalities and school boards or parents, that the ministry has no overview of demand or costs, and that longer transport distances will likely play a larger role after school closures.
Pupil transport is the responsibility of the municipality.
Het leerlingvervoer is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente.
Vragen van de leden Beertema en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over islamitische scholen die slechter scoren (ingezonden 28 maart 2011).

PVV MPs Beertema and Wilders asked the education minister about Islamic schools scoring worse on inspection ratings, arguing they reject Western values and should be closed. The minister answered that low-quality schools of any denomination are a concern, noted improvement in Islamic primary schools, rejected the view that Islamic education does not fit the Netherlands, and said funding would not be withdrawn merely because a school is Islamic, though chronically weak schools face closure.
I have no intention of withdrawing funding from schools because they are Islamic.
Ik heb geen voornemens om de bekostiging van scholen in te trekken, omdat ze islamitisch zijn.
Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over gratis Schoolboeken (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

Rep. Klaver asked the education minister whether the NMa's 2011 schoolbook scan showed that free schoolbooks had neither improved quality nor lowered costs, whether the scheme should be abolished, whether funds should be redirected to special education cuts, and what measures would improve the schoolbook market. The minister replied that the evaluation of the Free Schoolbooks Act is ongoing, so she will not respond on substance or commit to changes until its results are known.
As long as the evaluation of the WGS is not completed, I will not respond substantively to the NMa's recommendations or to any measures that may be taken.
Zolang de evaluatie van de WGS niet is afgerond, ga ik inhoudelijk niet reageren op aanbevelingen van de NMa of eventueel te nemen maatregelen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over gratis schoolboeken (ingezonden 10 maart 2011).

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Education whether she would respond to the competition authority's finding that competition and prices in school book provision had not improved under the free school books law, and asked about the small number of publishers and whether she would reconsider the scheme. The Minister replied that the findings will be considered within the broader evaluation of the Free School Books Act, overseen by an expert committee, and that she will send the evaluation report to parliament once available.
When the results of the evaluation of the WGS are known, I will send the evaluation report with my response to your House.
Wanneer de resultaten van de evaluatie van de WGS bekend zijn, stuur ik het evaluatierapport met mijn reactie naar uw Kamer.

Vragen van de leden Çelik en Jadnanansing (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de afkeuring door de rechter van de lagere plaatsing van een studente door de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs

MPs Çelik and Jadnanansing asked the education minister about a court ruling that rejected DUO's lower placement of a student in a lottery class due to varied mbo diploma formats. The minister answered that the problem was known, that DUO applies the lottery rules without assessing programme value, and that the RAS regulation and a future diploma and transcript model will clarify procedures.
The above-mentioned regulation will be amended in parts.
Bovengenoemde regeling wordt op onderdelen gewijzigd.

Vragen van het lid Marcouch (PvdA) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en Veiligheid en Justitie over grievende uitspraken over homo’s door leraren te Kampen (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

An MP asks two ministers about reported remarks by teachers at a Kampen school calling homosexuality a psychiatric disorder, and what powers exist to act, including whether discrimination charges were filed. The minister of Education responds only with a postponement notice, saying answers need coordination with the Justice ministry and will follow as soon as possible.
I hereby request a postponement of the answers.
Hierbij verzoek ik u om uitstel voor de beantwoording.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de islamisering van de omgangsvormen op de Hogeschool

PVV MPs asked whether the Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences board's tolerance of a lecturer refusing to shake women's hands amounts to unacceptable sex discrimination and whether 'Islamisation' of education must be stopped. The ministers answered that the board is responsible and has decided to terminate the lecturer's contract, that gender equality and religious freedom are both fundamental, and that the school should discuss a policy, while declining to call it Islamisation and finding question 4 unclear.
The Executive Board is responsible for the running of the university and is therefore competent to take a decision in this matter.
Het College van Bestuur is verantwoordelijk voor de gang van zaken op de Hogeschool en is mitsdien bevoegd in deze een beslissing te nemen.

Vragen van het lid Elias (VVD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over politiek gekleurde informatie verspreid onder ouders van leerlingen op de Christelijke Basisschool Het Klinket te Arnhem (ingezonde

An MP asks the Education Minister whether a letter from the board of a Christian school foundation urging parents to act against the cabinet's special-needs education plans gives a one-sided, politically coloured account, and whether the template letter circulated by an umbrella body is acceptable. The minister refers to earlier answers and says she does not know how the letter was further distributed by schools.
How this letter was further distributed by schools is not known to me.
Hoe deze brief verder door scholen is verspreid, is mij niet bekend.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Beertema en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de wens van bijna 100 ouders na de zomer over te gaan op islamitisch thuisonderwijs in Amsterdam

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education whether she considers Islamic home schooling undesirable and what measures she will take to prevent it across the Netherlands, after nearly 100 Amsterdam parents wanted to switch to home education. The minister answered that home schooling is not a way to fulfil compulsory education but is permitted for exempted parents under the Leerplichtwet, that a religious objection exemption is available and judged by the courts where disputed, and that she will reconsider the exemption ground and report back in autumn.
I will therefore consider the desirability of this exemption ground and will inform you of the outcome this autumn.
Ik ga mij dan ook beraden op de opportuniteit van deze vrijstellingsgrond en zal u dit najaar over de uitkomst informeren.

Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat thuisonderwijs een grote vlucht dreigt te nemen door kledingvoorschriften in het reguliere onderwijs (ingezonden 1

An MP asked the education minister about reports that nearly 100 Amsterdam pupils from the Islamic College may be homeschooled after closure and strict dress rules at nearby schools, and about the legal basis, numbers, and oversight of homeschooling. The minister answered that homeschooling is not a legal right, only a possible consequence of a leerplicht exemption under article 5, that oversight of its quality is not required, that she will reconsider the exemption grounds, and that municipal authorities are responsible for enforcement.
I will therefore consider the desirability of this exemption ground and will inform you of the outcome this autumn.
Ik ga mij dan ook beraden op de opportuniteit van deze vrijstellingsgrond en zal u dit najaar over de uitkomst informeren.
Vragen van het lid Biskop (CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over thuisonderwijs (ingezonden 14 februari 2011).

An MP asked the education minister about home schooling after a Muslim school closure in Amsterdam, including tensions between the Compulsory Education Act's exemption for religious objections and the constitution, and oversight of quality. The minister said there is no tension, that quality supervision is not required, and that she is reconsidering the religious exemption ground and will report in autumn.
I have serious doubts about whether this exemption ground is in the interest of all those involved and of society as a whole.
Ik heb serieuze twijfel in hoeverre deze uitzonderingsgrond in het belang van alle betrokkenen en de samenleving als geheel is.

Vragen van het lid Elias (VVD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over politiek gekleurde informatie verspreid onder ouders van leerlingen op de Christelijke Basisschool Het Klinket te Arnhem (ingezonde

An MP asked the education minister about a letter from a Christian primary school head urging parents to protest education budget cuts, which the school argued was one-sided and politically coloured, and about a left-wing alderman's school visits. The minister rejected the claim that the letter's assumptions were correct, said the school head's role does not include political opinions while expressing views is a free right, and said she would inform schools through letters and web information.
To prevent and remove these kinds of misunderstandings, I have decided to inform all schools in various ways about my plans.
Om dit soort misverstanden te voorkomen en weg te nemen heb ik besloten alle scholen op verschillende manieren te informeren over mijn plannen.
Vragen van het lid Dijsselbloem (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over signalen dat scholen zorgleerlingen weigeren (ingezonden 10 maart 2011).

Dijsselbloem (PvdA) asked the education minister about reports that mainstream schools are already refusing pupils needing special support for 2011-2012, and whether this reflects planned budget cuts to Passend onderwijs. The minister said the reports stem from CG-raad signals (twelve complaints), that current funding rules give no reason to refuse such pupils, and promised information letters to schools and a helpdesk for parents.
I will send a letter to all primary and secondary schools to provide factual information.
Aan alle scholen voor basis- en voortgezet onderwijs zal ik een brief sturen om feitelijke informatie te geven.
Vragen van het lid Smits (SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat jongens niet profiteren van vernieuwd onderwijs (ingezonden 2 maart 2011).

An MP asked the education minister how she responds to reports that boys benefit less than girls from the reformed secondary education (studiehuis) and what she will do about the widening gap in school performance. The minister answered that the differences are not growing on tests, that she sees it as the schools' task to tackle boys' underachievement, and that she is working to remove barriers to school transfer.
The precise meaning and origin of the percentages 53% and 48% in the Trouw report are not known to me.
De precieze betekenis en herkomst van de percentages 53% en 48% in het bericht in Trouw is mij niet bekend.

Vragen van de leden Beertema en De Jong (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretarissen van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat tweeduizend medewerkers van de Dienst Uitv

PVV MPs asked whether it is a government task to offer therapy for fear of heights to around 2,000 DUO employees in Groningen, and why an exception is made for them. The government answered that such voluntary over-statutory measures are the employer's responsibility, that the course is needed for work at heights in the new building, and that only about ten employees are affected.
Offering therapy for fear of heights is not a government task in the sense that it is an obligation arising directly from the Working Conditions Act.
Antwoord 2 Het aanbieden van een therapie voor hoogtevrees is geen overheidstaak in de zindat het een verplichting is die direct voortvloeit uit de Arbowet.
Vragen van de leden Biskop en Koopmans (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het project «Schoolwacht» (ingezonden 14 februari 2011).

MPs Biskop and Koopmans asked the education minister about the 'Schoolwacht' project at a Weert school, in which pupils enforce school rules and which the school had linked to the mandatory social internship, including claims of ministry approval. The minister answered that the school has dropped the plan, that schools bear final responsibility for internships without national criteria or ministry approval, and that the municipality can act as intermediary.
OCW does not grant approval for individual social internships.
OCW verleent geen goedkeuring voor individuele maatschappelijke stages.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi en Klijnsma (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het rapport Hoekstra (ingezonden 24 febr

Two MPs asked why the Hoekstra commission report on Frisian language had not been made public and when it would be released. The minister answered that the report was handed over on 3 March 2011, sent to Parliament and published on 9 March, and that the government response would follow before summer.
The report was sent to your House on 9 March and made public.
Het rapport is uw Kamer op 9 maart toegestuurd en openbaar gemaakt.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over problemen met kabelexploitanten (ingezonden 25 februari 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Ziggo reducing its analogue channel package and whether foreign public broadcasters will remain available, and about the role of local programme councils and channel-selection rules. The Minister answers that pricing is not government's concern, cites OPTA and NMa powers and the Mediawet's advisory and dispute procedures, and promises a letter before summer on reforming the programme councils.
Before the summer I will inform the House what follow-up this cabinet gives to the proposed amendment to replace the programme council system with a modern form of consumer influence.

Voor de zomer zal ik de Kamer informeren welk vervolg dit kabinet geeft aan de voorgenomen wetswijziging om het systeem van programmaraden te vervangen door een eigentijdse variant van consumenteninvloed.
Vragen van de leden Çelik en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs Cultuur en Wetenschap over de kaalslag op de scholen in Noord Nederland (ingezonden 3 februari 2011).

MPs Çelik and Van Dekken asked the education minister about the consequences of school shrinkage in northern Netherlands, including projected job losses, higher costs of small schools, funding, teacher workload and inspection assessment. The minister answered that shrinkage requires timely regional measures, that job losses are expected but not necessarily forced dismissals, that small schools are compensated through funding instruments, and that the inspectorate judges schools only on quality.
The research will be concluded shortly.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Van den Besselaar (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat problemen met de gezondheid Turkse en

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers of Education and Social Affairs about press reports that poor health hampers Turkish and Moroccan women's employment, and whether the government will act on it and investigate links with social support. The minister replied that the government relies on generic emancipation and participation policy rather than group-specific measures, reports rising female employment in these groups, and promises a forthcoming letter on women's participation.
In the Emancipation Policy Outline letter, expected to go to the House in April 2011, the cabinet will go into more detail on promoting social participation.
In de Hoofdlijnenbrief Emancipatie, die naar verwachting in april 2011 naar de Kamer gaat, zal het kabinet nader ingaan op het bevorderen van de maatschappelijke participatie
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het vastleggen van de evolutietheorie in de nieuwe leerlijn biologie (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the education minister whether a biology learning line that fixes evolution theory as the dominant view limits schools' freedom to teach from their own foundation, and whether schools can still balance their teaching and lesson materials. The minister replies that only the exam programme is set by government, schools keep the same room as before to present other views, and teaching materials and their selection remain free under the freedom of education.
From the government side, only the examination programme is established.
Vanuit de overheid wordt uitsluitend het examenprogramma vastgesteld.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham en Verhoeven (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het gebrek aan talent, kennis en kunde als grootste act

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers of Education and Economic Affairs how they respond to business concerns that budget cuts to education threaten Dutch attractiveness for talent and growth, and how German business confidence relates to German knowledge investment. The minister answered that the cuts match intensifications, that Dutch attractiveness rests on multiple factors, that the top-sector policy will help, and that German confidence reflects export performance rather than knowledge investment.
The cabinet faces the task of restoring public finances to order.
Het kabinet staat voor de opgave om de overheidsfinanciën weer op orde te brengen.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de islamisering van de omgangsvormen op de Hogeschool

Two PVV MPs asked two ministers whether they knew of an article on handshake-avoidance at the Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences, whether they agreed the college of governors had gone too far in accepting gender discrimination, whether Islamization of manners in education should be halted, and when the board would be held to account. The minister of Education, Culture and Science replied only that the answers would be delayed by interdepartmental consultation and sent as soon as possible.

The written questions from MPs Van Klaveren and Beertema (both PVV) on the Islamization of manners at the Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.

Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen van de Kamerleden Van Klaveren en Beertema (beiden PVV) over de islamisering van de omgangsvormen op de Hogeschool van Amsterdam ( 2011Z01964 ) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het mengen van zwarte en witte scholen in Rotterdam (ingezonden 3 februari 2011).

An MP asks the education minister whether she supports Rotterdam's alderman dropping active promotion of mixed black and white schools in favour of raising quality, and whether she has discussed this with him. The minister answers yes to supporting the alderman's view, states that there is no clear evidence mixing schools improves results, and says quality improvements (more learning time, good teachers, involved parents) are the priority.
There is no unambiguous evidence that mixing schools leads to better results.
Er is geen eenduidig bewijs voor dat het mengen van scholen leidt tot betere resultaten.
Vragen van het lid Elias (VVD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het ontbreken van vrije schoolkeuze voor ouders in stadsdeel Amsterdam-West (ingezonden 10 februari 2011).

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Education whether the zoning of pupils by postcode in Amsterdam-West, which he sees as contrary to free school choice, and the concentration of pupils from disadvantaged backgrounds in some schools, is acceptable, and what powers the Minister has to intervene. The Minister answers that school boards cooperate voluntarily under the freedom of education, that parents can request reconsideration or go to court, and that he has no power to intervene in local admission policy.
I have no power to intervene in the admission policy of school boards.
Ik heb geen bevoegdheid om in te grijpen in het toelatingsbeleid van schoolbesturen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over spreidingsbeleid (ingezonden 10 februari 2011).

An MP from D66 asks the Minister of Education whether her policy has shifted from black schools to weak schools, and how she would deal with local governments still pursuing postal-code based placement, and whether such forced dispersal limits free school choice. The Minister answers that she values freedom of education and does not oppose local initiatives within the bounds of the law that bring pupils of different backgrounds together.
I attach value to freedom of education.
Ik hecht aan de vrijheid van onderwijs.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister voor Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een quotum voor «allochtone deskundigen» op de publieke omroep (ingezonden 10 februari 2011).

MP Van der Ham asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the public broadcaster NPO counting non-Western immigrants on screen by appearance and whether this quota-like practice harms people judged on merit. The Minister said the NPO disputed the reported method, that broadcasters bear responsibility for programming under the statutory mandate and performance agreement, and that she would discuss representativeness with the broadcasters in periodic consultation.
How the public broadcaster gives shape to its statutory mandate and programmes in the performance agreement is up to the public broadcaster.
Hoe de publieke omroep in de programma's vorm geeft aan zijn wettelijke taakopdracht en de programma's in de prestatieovereenkomst, is aan de publieke omroep.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het initiatief MEDIA & COO (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

Dutch MP Dijkgraaf asked the minister of Education, Culture and Science about the OUDERS & COO report criticising Kijkwijzer media classification for lax application and weak oversight, and about foreign comparison, parent representation, hufterig gedrag criteria and the cinema parental guidance exemption. The minister rejected the criticism, cited Commissariaat voor de Media oversight and international comparisons, said NICAM would examine the hufterig gedrag criteria, and announced talks with the cinema sector to phase out parental guidance for 16-rated content.
I have asked NICAM to again examine whether hufterig gedrag is weighed sufficiently heavily in the classification.
Ik heb het NICAM gevraagd om nog eens na te gaan of hufterig gedrag in de codering voldoende zwaar wordt meegewogen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat scholen nog steeds formeel homoseksuele leraren weigeren (ingezonden 19 januari 2011).

An MP asked the education minister how she views the VGS reformed school federation's new identity profile on hiring gay teachers, after reports that schools still refuse them. The minister replied that the profile replaces earlier controversial declarations, that VGS consulted the Commissie Gelijke Behandeling and clarified the legal limits on discrimination based on homosexuality, and that VGS will remind member schools of these limits.
VGS considers it very important that the reformed schools remain within the limits of the law when applying the new identity profile.
VGS acht het van groot belang dat de reformatorische scholen bij het hanteren van het nieuwe identiteitsprofiel binnen de grenzen van de wet blijven.

Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de doorgifte van de programmering van BVN (Beste van Vlaanderen en Nederland) in Zuid-Afrika (ingezonden 31 januari 2011).

An MP asked the minister of Education, Culture and Science why public broadcaster BVN ended its distribution via MultiChoice in southern Africa, whether tendering was required, and why the extension and notice came so late. The minister replied that BVN was legally obliged to tender the satellite distribution, that MultiChoice did not bid, that the signal was extended to 1 May 2011, and that she cannot promise continued MultiChoice access.
BVN is a contracting authority within the meaning of Directive 2004/18/EC and the Dutch public procurement rules (Bao) implementing it.
BVN is een aanbestedende dienst in de zin van de Richtlijn 2004/18/EG en het Besluit aanbestedingsregels voor overheidsopdrachten (Bao)

Vragen van de leden Dibi (GroenLinks) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over commerciële zenders die FunX weren uit het radioluisteronderzoek (ingezonden 17 februari 2011).

MPs Dibi and Voordewind asked the minister whether commercial radio broadcasters were sabotaging improvements to the Continuous Listening Survey (CLO), which excludes urban youth and minorities such as FunX's audience, and what could be done. The minister denied sabotage, said the survey is the responsibility of the broadcasters through the RAB, pointed to a tender for a new 2012 survey with attention to representativeness, and said talks were underway about earlier improvements.
The listening survey is a responsibility of the radio broadcasters themselves. I have no direct influence on it.
Het luisteronderzoek is een verantwoordelijkheid van de radiozenders zelf. Ik heb daar geen directe invloed op.
Vragen van het lid Biskop (CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het niveau van beginnende mbo'ers (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

An MP asked the education minister about reports that incoming mbo students score low on language and arithmetic diagnostic tests, and what this means for the 2014 central exams. The minister said the diagnostic test results are a signal for schools to invest more in language and maths teaching, that the exam timeline stays in place, and that appropriate measures will follow if pilot results remain too low.
I closely monitor the implementation through interim evaluations involving the Examination Board and the mbo sector.
Ik volg de implementatie nauwgezet aan de hand van tussentijdse evaluaties waarbij ik het College voor Examens en het mbo-veld betrek.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het aan kinderen opdringen van een eenzijdige klimaattheor

PVV MPs asked the education minister whether schools are being pressed to teach a one-sided climate theory to children, citing the 'Warme Truiendag' campaign and a Youth News broadcast, and asked about related subsidies. The minister said schools choose their own teaching materials, declined to give a substantive view on indoctrination, and stated that the 'Warme Truiendag' campaign received no 2011 state subsidy while a related European youth project is partly funded by the Foreign Ministry.
It is up to the schools themselves which teaching materials they use.
Het is aan scholen zelf van welke leermiddelen zij gebruik maken.

Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat scholieren nog steeds zonder les of begeleiding worden opgehokt in studielokalen om het verplicht aantal lesuren

An MP asks the education minister about reports that secondary pupils are still confined to study rooms without teaching to meet mandatory lesson hours, and whether schools and the inspectorate should act more and whether 'lesson' should be defined more strictly. The minister says schools must take responsibility, points to the pending Wetsvoorstel onderwijstijd VO giving pupils and parents voice, rejects a harder lesson definition, and says the inspectorate will enforce against schools missing the hours norm.
Schools that do not meet the hours norm will of course be subject to enforcement action by the inspectorate.
Bij scholen die niet aan de urennorm voldoen zal de inspectie vanzelfsprekend handhavend optreden.

Vragen van het lid Smits (SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat de ophokuren voor scholieren in het voortgezet onderwijs nog steeds bestaan (ingezonden 14 februari 2011).

An SP MP asked the education minister about reports that secondary school pupils still face unsupervised 'ophokuren' (study hall hours) counted toward the instruction-time norm, and why the inspectorate did not act sooner. The minister answered that idle hours add nothing to quality, that the inspectorate defines qualifying time and intervenes when schools fall short, but declined to change the definition of an instruction hour.
If a school does not achieve sufficient instruction time, the Inspectorate intervenes.
Indien een school onvoldoende onderwijstijd realiseert grijpt de Inspectie in.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham en Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over onderzoek dat uitwijst dat de uitgangspunten voor het beleid om scholen geen geld te geven voor het wegwerken van

MPs Van der Ham and Schouw (D66) asked the education minister whether a study showing ethnic origin still matters for early school disadvantage undermines the policy of not using ethnicity in the school weighting scheme. The minister replied that the findings were not new, that ethnicity was deliberately not used in favour of parental education, income and benefit dependency via the impulse regime, and that no further research was needed.
At the time it was decided, with very broad support from the House, that apart from parental education level, ethnicity would not be used as a second criterion, but another criterion instead.
Destijds is besloten met zeer brede steun van de Kamer dat naast opleidingsniveau van de ouders niet de etniciteit als tweede criterium gebruikt zou worden, maar een ander criterium.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de maatschappelijke stage (ingezonden 13 januari 2011).

An MP asked the education minister about criticism that many schools do not properly implement the mandatory social internship (maatschappelijke stage) and underspend the per-pupil funding on supervision. The minister rejects the criticism, defends school autonomy and the mandatory internship, and declines to set an hourly supervision rate.
I stand behind the national obligation.
Ik sta achter de landelijke verplichting.
Vragen van het lid Smits (SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de zorgwekkende financiële situatie bij onderwijsstichting SKOZOK (ingezonden 12 januari 2011).

An SP MP asked the education minister about SKOZOK's financial difficulties, causes, budget cuts, dismissals and accountability for mismanagement. The minister answered that the board is free to shape its finances and accounts horizontally, that overspending on staff was the cause, and that the Inspectorate oversees lawful spending.
The SKOZOK school board is free in how it shapes the cut and accounts for it horizontally.
Het schoolbestuur SKOZOK is vrij in de wijze waarop zij de bezuiniging vormgeeft en legt daar horizontaal verantwoording over af.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over afrekenbare en

MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how the cabinet measures Dutch knowledge-economy position, what the baseline and interim targets are for reaching the global top 5, and how it will be held accountable. The minister answered that the position is based on the Global Competitiveness Index, that sub-targets with concrete benchmarks will follow in the 2012 budget, and that annual reporting will occur through the departmental annual report.
The chosen sub-targets for education, science and innovation will be further elaborated in the 2012 budget, with concrete target values.
De gekozen subdoelstellingen voor onderwijs, wetenschap en innovatie zullen in de begroting 2012 nader worden uitgewerkt, met concrete streefwaarden.
Vragen van de leden Wilders, Bosma en Beertema (allen PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een partijpolitieke email van een schooldirecteur (ingezonden 17 januari 2011).

MPs Wilders, Bosma and Beertema asked the education minister about an internal email in which a primary school director expressed a party-political opinion, and whether he should be dismissed. The minister answered that expressing political views is outside the director's duties, but that the employer decides on any consequences under labour law and the constitutional freedom of education, so she declined to intervene.
This concerns a fundamental right laid down in Article 7 of the Constitution.
Het betreft hier een grondrecht dat is vastgelegd in artikel 7 van de Grondwet.

Vragen van de leden Wilders, Bosma, Van Klaveren, en Beertema (allen PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «WOII moet weer centrale plek krijgen» (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether Holocaust lessons are being adapted for Muslim pupils and to what extent. The minister said there is no national overview, that lesson design is teachers' professional responsibility, and that a survey indicated one in five history teachers in big cities had sometimes found it hard to raise the Holocaust, without this implying structural problems.
In essence this is the professional responsibility of teachers, in which the government has no involvement.
In essentie is dit de professionele verantwoordelijkheid van leraren waar de overheid geen bemoeienis mee heeft.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het rapport «De kwaliteit van het onderwijs in cluster1» (ingezonden 20 januari 2011).

MP Ferrier asked the minister about the Inspectorate's finding that individual handling and support plans for pupils in cluster 1 special education are weak and largely formal, and what consequences follow. The minister acknowledged the problem, said the plans will be replaced by a developmental perspective instrument in a forthcoming bill and in regular education, and said the classroom teaching itself is rated adequate.

Precisely because the handling plan is insufficiently effective, it will be replaced by the developmental perspective in the bill on quality of (v)so, expected to be sent to the House before the summer recess.

Juist omdat het handelingsplan onvoldoende effectief is wordt het handelingsplan in het wetsvoorstel kwaliteit (v)so, dat naar verwachting voor het zomerreces aan uw Kamer zal worden gezonden, vervangen door het ontwikkelingsperspectief.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister en de staatsecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een lijst met «ongewenste» kinderboeken (ingezonden 31 januari 2011).

An MP asks the minister and state secretary of Education, Culture and Science how they view publishers using a list of 'sensitive' topics for Protestant-Christian schools, and whether government does business with such publishers. The minister says she has taken note of the matter and that the government does not do business with educational publishers, since schools choose their own methods to meet the core objectives.
No. The government does not do business with educational publishers.
Neen. De overheid doet geen zaken met educatieve uitgevers.
Vragen van het lid Biskop (CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het melden van spijbelen (ingezonden 6 december 2010).

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Education whether school truancy reporting is adequate, notably in Amsterdam, and whether Rotterdam's plan to impose administrative fines on parents of truants is acceptable. The Minister finds reporting insufficient, prefers the criminal-law approach over fines on parents, and says she does not intend a nationwide administrative fine for parents, while pointing to her bill to fine schools.
The use of administrative fines aimed at parents is not something I consider desirable.
Het gebruik van de bestuurlijke boete gericht op ouders acht ik niet wenselijk.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de ontwikkeling van passend onderwijs en de betrokkenheid van ouders daarbij (ingezonden 22 december 2010).

An MP asks the minister how and when parent organisations are involved in drafting the bill to legally anchor inclusive education, and what actions have been taken to strengthen parents' position since February 2010. The minister lists consultations with parent and sector organisations, notes that sector bodies and unions stopped talks, describes a separate meeting with parent groups in January 2011, and says the reference framework work has resumed with parent involvement.
To keep involving the parent organisations in preparing the bill, a separate meeting with the parent organisations was held on 6 January.
Om de ouderorganisaties bij de voorbereiding van het wetsvoorstel te blijven betrekken, is er op 6 januari jl. een apart overleg met de ouderorganisaties geweest.

Vragen van het lid Elias (VVD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over bezuinigingen Leonardo-onderwijs Stichting Primair Openbaar Onderwijs De Liemers (ingezonden 13 december 2010).

An MP asked the education minister whether schools offering Leonardo education for gifted pupils face funding shortfalls forcing high parental contributions, and whether a bridging budget from the EUR 30 million earmarked for gifted pupils should be provided. The minister answered that parents choose this paid concept voluntarily, that schools know the costs in advance, that the government will not step in, and that plans will be presented in a forthcoming action plan.
I have considered your request, but I have not adopted it.
Ik heb uw verzoek overwogen, maar niet overgenomen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over afrekenbare en

MPs asked the education minister whether the cabinet's target of cutting early school leavers to at most 25,000 covers all leavers, what interim targets and instruments exist, and how progress will be reported. The minister confirmed the 25,000 target for 2014/2015, set 35,000 for 2010/2011, promised a letter by March 2011 and a shift to a percentage norm, and pointed to budgeted funds and annual reporting to parliament.

By March 2011 at the latest I will send a letter to the House of Representatives with the results for school year 2009/2010, in relation to the current early school leaving covenants with municipalities, schools and institutions.
Uiterlijk maart 2011 stuur ik een brief naar de Tweede Kamer met het resultaat van het schooljaar 2009/2010, in relatie tot de huidige vsv-convenanten met gemeenten, scholen en instellingen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over afrekenbare en controleerbare kabinet

MPs asked the education minister which performance targets, indicators, baselines and milestones the cabinet will use to meet its promise that education performance will rise, and how it will act and report. The minister answered that targets and indicators will be specified in the 2012 budget, that a baseline is the September 2010 value, and that progress will be reported through the departmental annual report and OCW monitoring publications.
The sub-objectives and associated effect and performance indicators will be further elaborated in the 2012 budget, with concrete target values.
De subdoelstellingen en bijbehorende effect- en prestatie indicatoren zullen in de begroting 2012 nader worden uitgewerkt, met concrete streefwaarden.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over afrekenbare en

MPs asked the Minister of Education whether the cabinet aims to reach more children through early childhood education (vve), what the baseline is, and how targets, selection, instruments and annual accountability will be set. The minister confirmed the aim, cited about 28,000 children in preschool and 25,000 in early primary education, and deferred detailed targets, measures and planning to a letter in spring 2011, while stating annual accountability via the departmental annual report.
In that letter I will make the objectives of the vve policy more concrete and add a planning of the actions I undertake.
In die brief maak ik de doelstellingen van het vve-beleid concreter en voeg daar een planning bij van de acties die ik onderneem.

Vragen van het lid Elias (VVD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over bezuinigingen Leonardo-onderwijs van de Stichting Primair Openbaar Onderwijs De Liemers (ingezonden 15 december 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether gifted pupils with an IQ above 130 should be classed as pupils needing extra care and funded like weak pupils in regular primary education. The Minister replies that a high IQ is not always a cause for concern, that schools can already offer tailored arrangements within existing funds, and that IQ alone will not be grounds for classing pupils as needing extra care or for extra funding.
In short, I see no reason to classify pupils as needing extra care and grant additional funding on the basis of IQ alone.
Kortom, ik zie er niets in om alleen op basis van het IQ leerlingen tot zorgleerlingen te bestempelen en aanvullende bekostiging toe te kennen.
Vragen van het lid Elias (VVD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over vertrekkende leerlingen van openbare basisschool De Spelelier in Boxtel (ingezonden 16 december 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether the Inspectorate should intervene at openbare basisschool De Spelelier in Boxtel after 35 pupils left and a complaints commission upheld parents' complaints. The Minister answers that the Inspectorate has no role in individual complaints, which are the responsibility of the competent authority, but it has monitored improvement actions and granted the school basic supervision.
The inspectorate has no role in handling complaints from individual parents/guardians or pupils.
De inspectie heeft geen rol in het behandelen van klachten van individuele ouders/verzorgers of leerlingen.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de documentaire «Help! Een homo in de klas» (ingezonden 17 december 2010).

An MP asked the education minister how many Dutch schools give lessons on homosexuality, whether schools refusing such lessons should be pressed, and about a proposal to include sexual diversity in core curriculum targets. The minister said the number of schools is unknown but declined to research it for administrative-burden reasons, promised a broader policy letter, and said the SLO proposal has been received with a letter to follow.
It is not known how many schools in the Netherlands provide information on homosexuality.
Het is niet bekend op hoeveel scholen in Nederland voorlichting over homoseksualiteit wordt gegeven.

Vragen van het lid Smits aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de moeilijkheden die ouders ondervinden bij het opzetten van een integratieklas in Rotterdam (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

An MP asks the education minister about parents' difficulties setting up an integration class in Rotterdam, modelled on the 'De blauwe bloem' class in Eindhoven, and whether the ministry will intervene when schools refuse. The minister states that the experiment was extended, that setting up such a class is a school board's own choice, that parents cannot force schools, and that the ministry asked the regional partnership to help find a school.
It is the own responsibility of the school and board to decide whether or not to submit a request for an experimental integration class.
Het is de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van school en bestuur om al dan niet een aanvraag voor een experimentele integratieklas in te dienen.
Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de groeiende afstand tussen de schoolbesturen en de werkvloer in het onderwijs (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

MP Çelik asked the Minister of Education about reports that mandatory central school-board levies vary widely and sometimes reach 30% of funding, about board-level lawyers, about boards filtering staff concerns through cluster managers, and about a gag-like culture discouraging contact with MPs. The Minister answered that boards are responsible for their own spending, that no data on levy rates is held and collecting it would add burden, that existing oversight by the Inspectorate, works councils and supervisory boards is adequate, and that she sees no need for further regulation.
Primary and secondary education have no rules requiring boards to record which part of their funding is used for central (board-level) activities.
Het primair en voortgezet onderwijs kennen geen voorschriften voor besturen om te (laten) registreren welk deel van de bekostiging wordt aangewend voor bovenschoolse activiteiten.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over Early bird scholen (ingezonden 21 december 2010).

An MP asked the education minister how the government will ensure Early bird schools operate within the law after a Rotterdam court ruling, whether English-medium instruction up to 15% can be guaranteed, and how many experiments with a foreign language as medium of instruction are running. The minister answered that the court has not yet ruled on the substance (a hearing is set for February), that 14 primary schools are running the 15% English-language pilot, and that the Inspectorate has found no schools using English for part of the curriculum outside an experiment.
No substantive ruling has yet been made on whether EarlyBird schools comply with education legislation.
Er is nog geen inhoudelijke uitspraak gedaan over of EarlyBird-scholen zich aan de onderwijswetgeving houden.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Cohen (PvdA), Roemer (SP), Halsema (Groenlinks), Rouvoet (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over afrekenbare en

Vragen van de leden Çelik en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over dreigende sluiting van school voor voortgezet onderwijs in de Haagse Schilderswijk (ingezonden 9 december 2010)

MPs Çelik and Heijnen asked whether closing a havo/vwo school in The Hague's Schilderswijk, part of the Johan de Wittcollege, would harm opportunities in a disadvantaged neighbourhood, and whether the ministry would intervene. The minister replied that the school board is only relocating the vwo branch elsewhere in The Hague due to new building, that the decision belongs to the school board and the works council, and declined to request a municipal report or to investigate keeping the programme.
Whether or not to close (branch) locations are decisions taken primarily by the school board, which is entitled to make them.
Het al dan niet sluiten van (neven)vestigingen zijn beslissingen die primair door het schoolbestuur worden genomen, het schoolbestuur is hiertoe gerechtigd.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof dat de financiering van de Nederlandse publieke omroep deels staatssteun betreft (ingezonde

MP Van der Ham asks the Education, Culture and Science minister how she responds to the EU General Court ruling that part of Dutch public broadcasting funding is state aid requiring repayment of 76 million euro from the NOS, and what financing is involved and what consequences follow. The minister answers that repayment (86.5 million euro including interest) was already made in 2006 since the appeal had no suspensive effect, that she is still considering a further appeal, and that because the amount is repaid the ruling has no consequences for broadcasting policy or programming.
The amount of 86.5 million euro (repayment amount plus interest) has therefore already been repaid by the public broadcaster to the State.
Het bedrag van € 86,5 miljoen (terugvorderingsbedrag + rente) is dus al door de publieke omroep aan de Staat terugbetaald.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat het verbod op zittenblijven op de havo voor doorstromers uit het vmbo funest is (ingezonden 25 november 2010)

Van der Ham (D66) asks the Education Minister to react to reports that the ban on repeating years for vmbo transfers into havo is harmful, and to say how unequal school standards for vmbo and other students will be remedied. The minister calls differing standards within one class objectionable, says school rules on repeating must be transparent and equal, orders an Inspectorate study of havo admission and repeating policy by late 2011, and reports ongoing VO-raad consultations with possible tightening of rules if warranted.
At my request, the Inspectorate of Education will in the course of 2011 investigate the transparency of the admission policy that havo schools apply.
De Onderwijsinspectie doet op mijn verzoek in de loop van 2011 onderzoek naar de transparantie van het toelatingsbeleid dat havo-scholen hanteren.

Vragen van de leden Ferrier en Biskop (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het rapport «Van vmbo naar havo: tweestrijd over tweesprong?» (ingezonden 26 november 2010).

CDA MPs asked the education minister about an ECBO report finding that vmbo students moving up to havo do worse partly because havo schools bar them from repeating year four, and whether schools' rules and the transition policy should change. The minister said schools set their own repeat and transition rules, called inconsistent treatment of former vmbo pupils objectionable, and declined to change the transition policy, which is left to schools.
The transition policy is entirely up to the school and I am leaving it that way.
Het overgangsbeleid is volledig aan de school en dat laat ik zo.

Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over scholen die op havo doorstromers van vmbo verbieden om in de vierde klas te doubleren (ingezonden 26 november 2010).

An MP asked the education minister whether it is acceptable that many havo schools forbid vmbo transfer students from repeating year four, cutting off their chance to finish havo, and what will be done under a parliamentary motion. The minister called differing admission criteria for vmbo and havo pupils objectionable, said the Inspectorate will examine repeat policy and admission rules in 2011, and said the rules will be tightened if the findings warrant it.
To underline that I take this matter very seriously, I have asked the Inspectorate of Education to investigate this in the second quarter of 2011 and report to me.

Om te onderstrepen dat ik deze kwestie bijzonder serieus neem, heb ik de Inspectie van het Onderwijs gevraagd om in het tweede kwartaal van 2011 hiernaar onderzoek te doen en mij hierover te rapporteren.
Vragen van het lid Smits (SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de hoge schooluitval in het middelbaar beroepsonderwijs (mbo) (ingezonden 26 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the education minister about the high dropout rate in vocational education (mbo), its causes, the VM2 pilot, and whether over-30s can still obtain qualifications. The minister acknowledges the dropout rate is still too high, notes declining figures, attributes dropout mainly to wrong course choices and organisation, and points to employer and worker training schemes for those over 30.
But I still consider the dropout rate to be far too high.
Maar de uitval vind ik nog steeds té hoog.
Vragen van het lid Smits (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over Regionale Opleidingscentra (ROC’s) die in financiële nood zitten (ingezonden 27 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about vocational colleges (ROCs) in financial distress, including whether the sector's finances are as serious as the MBO Raad claims, which schools may close, and the cost breakdowns of specific colleges. The minister answered that institutions are responsible for their own finances, that the Inspectorate of Education monitors them and will intensify supervision if thresholds are breached, and that the sector's problems stem from planning shortcomings, falling enrolment and the credit crisis, while correcting benchmark figures for one college.
Of course, the Inspectorate of Education closely monitors the financial situation of institutions.
Uiteraard volgt de Inspectie van het Onderwijs de financiële situatie van instellingen kritisch.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het aanvragen van een verklaring omtrent het gedrag voor invalleerkrachten (ingezonden 25 november 2010).

An MP asked the education minister which rules apply to requesting a certificate of good conduct (VOG) for substitute teachers, whether repeated requests over years are unnecessarily bureaucratic, and whether rules could be relaxed for teachers staying with the same school board. The minister confirmed the VOG requirement protects children, a VOG older than six months must be renewed on new appointment, and declined to relax the rule while suggesting alternative contract arrangements.
I am not inclined to increase this risk again by relaxing the rules.
Ik voel er niet voor om door een versoepeling dit risico weer te vergroten.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham en Hachchi (beiden D66) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat door fouten bij Dienst Uitvoering Onderw

Two MPs asked the ministers about a reported DUO web-portal fault that exposed students' personal and study data to other users. The minister acknowledged the incident, explained it was a capacity-overload bug in the 'Mijn DUO' application, reported it was fixed and an external audit ordered, and denied DigiD was the cause.
An external audit of the technical causes has now been commissioned.
Er is inmiddels opdracht gegeven om een externe audit uit te voeren naar de technische oorzaken.

Vragen van het lid Elias (VVD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het onderzoek van de gemeente Zeewolde over de haalbaarheid van bijzonder voortgezet onderwijs in Zeewolde (ingezonden 26 november

An MP asked the education minister whether a municipality may commission a feasibility study into specialised Christian secondary education, whether this conflicts with constitutional article 23, and what the minister can do to stop it. The minister answered that such a study is not a statutory municipal task but is not prohibited, that article 23 does not bar it, and that the minister has no means to stop it, noting that only a special-education board can establish such a school.
I have no means to oppose such a study, since the law does not prohibit it.
Ik heb geen mogelijkheden om een dergelijk onderzoek tegen te gaan, nu de wet zich hier immers niet tegen verzet.

Vragen van de leden Çelik en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over leerlingen die worden gedwongen te stoppen met hun opleiding vanwege een tekort aan leer-werkplekken (ingezo

Two MPs asked the education minister about roughly 350 vocational students in the north and Overijssel who risked being forced to quit their courses for lack of workplace-training places, and whether such students would be pushed into school-based tracks with little practical time. The minister replied that regional partners had found places for nearly all affected students, that schools keep students structured, and that the existing approach is effective.

From my answer to question 2 it appears to me that the current approach to shortages of workplace-training places – the Stage and Apprenticeship Offensive of the knowledge centres and the regional approach – is effective.
Uit mijn antwoord op vraag 2 blijkt mijns inziens dat de huidige aanpak van tekorten aan bpv-plaatsen – het Stage- en Leerbanenoffensief van de kenniscentra en de regionale aanpak – effectief is.
Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Onderwijs Cultuur en Wetenschap over de erkenning van freelancers door het Vervangingsfonds (ingezonden 1 december 2010).

An MP asks whether freelancers are excluded from reimbursement by the Vervangingsfonds for teacher replacement and whether this deters freelancers from education, and asks what steps will be taken. The minister confirms that freelancers cannot be reimbursed for replacing teachers (though they can for support staff), has no data on numbers, sees no broad need, and refers the matter to the Fund's board, which wants CAO regulation of freelancers first.
For teachers, however, the Vervangingsfonds does not provide for funded replacement through hiring freelancers.
Voor leerkrachten geldt echter dat het Vervangingsfonds niet voorziet in bekostigde vervanging door middel van het inhuren van freelancers.
Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over islamitische feestdagen op scholen (ingezonden 17 november 2010).

An MP asked whether schools using study days to create de facto holidays for Islamic feast days undermines the official holiday tradition, and whether teachers take leave on those days and how that is compensated. The minister answered that schools have autonomy within the hour norm and works council rules, that leave is a matter between employer and employee, and that no Islamic feast day is being given official holiday status.
The possibilities and impossibilities regarding taking leave, or compensating for it, are a matter between employer and employee, whether or not collectively regulated.
De (on)mogelijkheden met betrekking tot het opnemen van verlof, dan wel het compenseren daarvan, is een zaak tussen de werkgever en werknemer onderling, al dan niet collectief geregeld.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de financiering van de Lokale Omroep (ingezonden 30 november 2010).

An MP asks the education and culture minister about the funding of local broadcasting after a report found 42% of municipalities do not pay the basic amount, and asks whether they can be held to account and given a year to correct this. The minister says the report offers municipalities enough guidance to evaluate and tighten their policy, and states there is no legal minimum municipal funding, only an indicative amount of 1.30 euro per dwelling.
However, there is no statutory minimum for funding by municipalities.
Er geldt echter geen wettelijke minimum voor financiering door gemeenten.
Vragen van het lid Elias (VVD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de regeling verbetering binnenklimaat primair onderwijs 2009 (ingezonden 3 december 2010).

An MP asked the education minister whether municipalities still wanted to apply after the 31 December 2009 deadline, whether the 2009 indoor climate scheme budget was fully spent on school projects, and whether the scheme should reopen. The minister answered that the budget was allocated per municipality, 394 of 431 applied with all applications up to 125% honoured, the works run until 4 September 2011 with evaluation afterwards, and the budget was increased from about 100 to about 150 million euro so no reopening was planned.
All applications from municipalities up to 125% have been honoured.
Alle aanvragen van gemeenten tot en met 125% zijn gehonoreerd.

Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap, voor Asiel en Immigratie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over kinderen die hier illegaal verblijven en geen mbo-stage kunnen

An MP asked three ministers whether children staying illegally in the Netherlands, who have a right to education under the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child, can complete mbo vocational training when they cannot do internships, and whether treating internships as education rather than labour would solve this. The Minister of Education replied only that interdepartmental consultation is needed, so the answers are delayed and not yet given.
Because this issue requires consultation between the departments concerned, I am unable to answer you within the usual time limit.
Daar over deze problematiek overleg tussen de betrokken departementen nodig is, ben ik niet in staat u binnen de gebruikelijke termijn te antwoorden.

Vragen van de leden Klijnsma en Jadnanansing (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de weigering om een bul aan te passen na geslachtsverandering (ingezonden 8 oktober 2010).

MPs Klijnsma and Jadnanansing asked the state secretary about the University of Amsterdam refusing to issue an amended diploma after a gender change, and whether the law prevents it. The minister said the refusal was based on an overly strict reading of the WHW, which does not prevent issuing an amended certificate, so no law change is needed, and the relevant institutions will be informed.
On closer inspection it appears this interpretation of the law was too strict.
Bij nader inzien blijkt dat deze interpretatie van de wet te strikt is geweest.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Çelik (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over besparingen op bedrijfsvoering bij onderwijsinstellingen (ingezonden 19 oktober 2010).

MPs Jadnanansing and Çelik asked the education minister about a report claiming that education institutions could save about 300 million euros through better back-office management, and whether the government would verify these figures and discuss them with sector bodies. The minister agreed efficiency gains are possible, but said the 300 million figure rests on debatable assumptions and cannot be verified, declined a new study in favour of existing research, and committed to raising the issue with sector umbrella organisations.
Because I cannot verify the amount, I do not think it is right to use it in the debate on this subject without this qualification.
Omdat ik het bedrag niet kan verifiëren, vind ik het niet juist dit zonder deze nuancering in het debat over dit onderwerp te hanteren.

Vragen van het lid Van Dam (PvdA) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Justitie over de rechterlijke uitspraak over de uitzending van flitsen van beeldmateriaal van eredivisiewedstrijden door regi

MP Van Dam asks ministers about a May 2010 Utrecht court ruling that regional broadcasters may request Eredivisie match footage under the Mediawet but may not broadcast it under copyright limits, and what follow-up is planned, including whether the law or the EU directive causes risks for news gathering. The ministers answer that the ruling is a summary-proceedings judgment with the main case still pending, so they will not intervene before the final judgment and will inform parliament later if needed.
It is not appropriate to intervene in a dispute that is before the court.
Het gaat niet aan te treden in een geschil dat onder de rechter is.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de taalverwerving van kinderen tot ongeveer zes jaar (ingezonden 27 oktober 2010).

Deputy Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked the Minister of Education about early language acquisition in young children, citing a dissertation on language problems, and questioned how VVE early-education policy, diagnosis, target-group selection, school readiness and teacher training should respond. The minister answered that language development varies, that language disorders require medical or speech therapy while exposure deficits justify VVE, that municipalities define target groups, and that the government will raise specialisation topics for young children in teacher training, without committing to structural change.
It is not automatic in schools to start a language-stimulation track or not based on a particular score.
Het is op scholen geen automatisme om bij een bepaalde score al dan niet een traject van taalstimulering in te zetten.

Vragen van de leden Çelik en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat Regionale Opleiding Centra (ROC’s) wel leerlingen opvoeren voor de financiering, maar na de te

MPs Çelik and Marcouch asked the education minister about reports that ROCs enrol students for funding but refuse them after the 1 October count date, often on grounds of age, and asked for a response on the practice. The minister said she had no knowledge of dozens or hundreds of youths being excluded, referred age-discrimination complaints to the Commissie Gelijke Behandeling, argued enrolment creates binding obligations, and said she no longer receives such reports.
I am not aware that dozens and perhaps hundreds of young people are staying at home because they are not readmitted to school after the count date.
Mij is niet bekend dat tientallen en misschien honderden jongeren thuiszitten omdat ze na de teldatum niet weer worden toegelaten op school.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap aangaande kinderen die noodgedwongen thuis zitten vanwege volle scholen (ingezonden 19 oktober 2010).

An MP from D66 asked the education minister how she would respond to reports that children with psychological and behavioural problems cannot find places in special schools, whether schools will have to refuse pupils over the Christmas period, and her reaction to criticism of an upcoming 300 million euro budget cut. The minister replied that pupils with an indication retain a legal right to enrolment under current law, that there is no question of refusing pupils, and that regional expertise centres and partnerships can agree on who really needs special education while passend onderwijs and teacher training are pursued.
As long as the current legislation is in force, an indication gives the right to enrolment at a (v)so school.
Zolang de huidige wetgeving van kracht is, geeft een indicatie recht op inschrijving bij een (v)so-school.
Vragen van het lid Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het «gay-alert» in Utrecht‬ (ingezonden 25 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Utrecht's 'gay alert' and whether it treats only symptoms, and whether rising anti-gay threats link to SCP findings on non-Western attitudes toward homosexuality. The minister rejects the symptom-treatment view, welcomes the alert as an early-warning step, and says official data show no direct link to suspects' backgrounds.
I do not share this view.

Vragen van de leden van Dekken en Çelik (beiden PvdA) aan ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat tientallen scholen in Groningen dreigen te ve

PvdA MPs asked ministers of Education and Interior whether they were aware of reports that dozens of primary schools in Groningen might close, what the consequences would be, and what the Rijk would do. The minister replied that under statutory closure norms no dozens of schools will close in the short term, that on average two schools per year close in Groningen, that boards bear responsibility for school decisions, and that the Rijk will assist via pilots and the Krimpen met Kwaliteit action plan, with a progress report promised for spring 2011.
In spring 2011 the House of Representatives will be informed about the progress of the mentioned action plan.
In het voorjaar van 2011 zal de Tweede Kamer geïnformeerd worden over de voortgang van het genoemde actieplan
Vragen van het lid Smits (SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat scholen voor speciaal onderwijs in het noorden overvol zijn (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An MP from the SP asks the education minister how she views the overcrowding of special education schools in the north of the Netherlands, whether pupils are forced to travel further, whether budget cuts to the rugzak and ambulatory support caused the growth, and whether schools will be forced to stop admissions and pupils will stay at home. The minister answers that the growth is a longer-term trend since 2003 rather than a sudden effect of cuts, that no forced admission stop is needed because an indication guarantees a place, and that passend onderwijs will not cause more truancy.
In my view there can be no question of a forced admissions stop.
Er kan naar mijn idee geen sprake zijn van een noodgedwongen leerlingenstop.

Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over salarissen boven de balkenendenorm bij de publieke omroep (ingezonden 24 september 2010).

The MP asks why public broadcasters still pay presenter salaries far above the Balkenende norm after a motion, how the NPO will close management-BV workarounds, and why the excess is not paid from membership funds. The minister acknowledges legacy contracts above the cap, commits to pressing the NPO to bring management BVs under the BPPO and to ensure excess is paid from membership funds, and accepts the point as one for improvement.
I will urge the NPO executive board to include this unambiguously in the BPPO and to supervise compliance with it.
Ik zal er bij de raad van bestuur van de NPO op aandringen dit eenduidig in het BPPO op te nemen en daarop toezicht te houden.
Vragen van het lid Smits (SP) aan staatssecretaris Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de kosten voor de promotiecampagne «6-daagse beroepsonderwijs» (ingezonden 7 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary about the total cost and funding of the 6-daagse beroepsonderwijs vocational education promotion campaign and whether such a large campaign is a good use of money compared with better teaching. The minister replies that the MBO Raad contributed about 538,000 euro, the ministry gave a one-off 150,000 euro, and the campaign aims to raise the visibility and image of vocational education, with promised benefits for students and internships.
OCW made a one-off contribution of 150,000 euro to stimulate and improve the accessibility of vocational education for broad target groups and the image of vocational education.
OCW heeft een eenmalige bijdrage geleverd van € 150 000,- voor het stimuleren en verbeteren van de toegankelijkheid van beroepsonderwijs voor brede doelgroepen en voor het imago van het mbo.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het weigeren van vmbo-t-gediplomeerden bij de HAVO (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Education why some schools refuse vmbo-t graduates entry to havo and whether this breaches the law, and asks what the government will do. The minister answers that the diploma gives no entitlement to admission, that schools may set their own admission criteria and are not supervised on this by the inspectorate, estimates about 1,100 refusals per year, and promises to ask the Inspectorate to check whether schools publish their admission policies.
Admission policy for the higher year groups is therefore not part of the inspectorate's supervisory framework.
Het toelatingsbeleid tot de hogere leerjaren vormt dan ook geen onderdeel van het toezichtskader van de onderwijsinspectie.
Vragen van het lid Smits (SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over financiële problemen op basisscholen door bezuinigingen vanuit het rijk (ingezonden 18 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the education minister about a reported 2.5 million euro shortfall at a primary school board (Lucas) attributed to national cuts to management and the growth regulation, and whether these cuts harm teaching quality. The minister answers that the shortfall is only partly due to the cuts, that the board must solve it without harming quality, and that the cut stands because no funding was found to reverse it.
It is up to the board to solve the problem without harming the quality of education.
Het is aan het bestuur om het probleem op te lossen zonder de kwaliteit van het onderwijs te schaden.
