Vragen van de leden Çelik en Marcouch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de uitspraken van de Ombudsman over afgestudeerde vmbo-ers die worden geweigerd door havo-opleidingen (ingezon

MPs Çelik and Marcouch asked the education minister about Ombudsman findings that vmbo graduates are refused entry to havo programmes through selection criteria such as minimum grades. The minister answered that schools may set admission requirements for later-year entry, that this does not affect funding, and that she recognises pupils' right to know entry criteria while stressing stapelen and doorstroom are mainly the responsibility of schools, pupils and parents.
I am of the view that pupils and their parents have the right to know what admission requirements a secondary school applies.
Ik ben van mening dat leerlingen en hun ouders het recht hebben om te weten wat de toelatingseisen zijn die een school voor voortgezet onderwijs hanteert.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het weigeren van vmbo-t-gediplomeerden bij de havo (ingezonden 20 oktober 2010).

MP Ferrier asks the education minister why vmbo-t graduates are being refused entry into havo despite the vmbo-t preparing pupils for havo, and whether parents should have a say in such decisions. The minister agrees pupils and parents should know admission criteria, says schools set their own criteria without a duty to publish them, and points to complaint committees and works councils as the remedies for parents and pupils.
Secondary schools have the room to set their own admission requirements for pupils entering higher year groups than the first year, but are not obliged to publish those requirements.
Vo-scholen hebben de ruimte om zelf toelatingseisen te stellen aan leerlingen die instromen in hogere leerjaren dan het eerste jaar, maar zijn niet verplicht om die eisen bekend te maken.
Vragen van het lid Smits (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het onderzoek van Omroep Gelderland onder basisschooldirecteuren (ingezonden 14 september 2010).

An SP MP asks the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science about a regional survey of Gelderland primary school principals on teacher salaries, support staff, training budgets, inclusive education, school cleanliness and representativeness. The minister responds that the salary measures and support-staff investments are underway, that budget cuts cannot be reversed for lack of funding, and that the survey cannot be judged representative nationally, without committing to new measures.
I cannot assess whether the results are representative of the whole of the Netherlands.
Ik kan niet beoordelen of de resultaten representatief zijn voor heel Nederland.
Vragen van het lid Smits (SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de onwerkbare bureaucratie in het onderwijs (ingezonden 4 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asks the education minister about bureaucracy and red tape in schools, citing an Actal report that estimates EUR 130 million in staff hours spent on administrative burdens and criticises the many accountability demands on schools. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to reduction measures and commitments to consolidate subsidies and data collection, but rejects the claim of 'organised distrust' and disputes the characterisation of school autonomy.
I am happy to assure you that I will contact my colleague at BZK and examine with him how we can consult the decentralised governments on this.
Ik zeg u graag toe dat ik hierover contact opneem met mijn collega van BZK en met hem onderzoek hoe we hierover in overleg kunnen treden met de decentrale overheden.
Vragen van het lid Smits (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over commerciële huiswerkbegeleiding vanwege slecht onderwijs (ingezonden 8 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asks the state secretary of education how to interpret a newspaper report that poor schooling drives families to commercial private tutoring, and whether low-income children will be disadvantaged. The minister replies that parents are broadly satisfied with primary education quality, that only a small group of parents buying private tuition is less satisfied, and that cost is not a major barrier for less well-off parents, so no new onderlaag is expected.
I note that the individual findings of the people in the newspaper article do not apply to the majority of parents with children in primary education.
Ik stel vast dat de individuele bevindingen van de personen uit het krantenartikel niet gelden voor het merendeel van de ouders met kinderen in het basisonderwijs.

Vragen van het lid Harbers (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het terugsluizen van geld door de publieke omroep via een eigen muziekuitgeverij (ingezonden 20 mei 2010).

MP Harbers asked the state secretary whether the public broadcaster NPO channels 3 to 4 million euros yearly to its own music publisher Crossmex by forcing composers to assign rights, and whether this is an abuse of its position and whether sanctions will follow. The minister acknowledged the practice of rights assignment and mandatory placement with Crossmex, found it undesirable and proposed to address it in the forthcoming copyright contract law bill, but said no Mediawet provisions are breached so no sanctions have a legal basis, and that abuse of market power is for the competition authority to judge.
I consider this practice undesirable, because it can disadvantage the position of individual creators.
Ik acht deze praktijk onwenselijk, omdat het de positie van de individuele makers kan benadelen.

Vragen van het lid Smits (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het verdwijnen van de enige school voor voortgezet onderwijs uit Zandvoort aan Zee (ingezonden 14 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the education state secretary whether the only secondary school in Zandvoort aan Zee, the Wim Gertenbach College, could be kept open, and questioned whether a board can close it against the wishes of parents, staff and the municipality. The minister replied that closing a branch is primarily the school board's decision, subject to works council rights, and that no general criteria apply to closing a branch, so she declined to intervene or meet the parties.
Whether to close (branch) locations is a decision taken primarily by the school board, which is entitled to make it.
Het al dan niet sluiten van (neven)vestigingen zijn beslissingen die primair door het schoolbestuur worden genomen, het schoolbestuur is hiertoe gerechtigd.

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Scholen gewaarschuwd voor dierenactivisme» (ingezonden 16 september 2010).

Two PVV MPs asked the education minister whether she knew of reports that schools were warned about animal activism, what measures were taken after an AIVD warning, whether schools should refrain from animal-activist lessons, and whether public donations to such activists should be banned. The minister confirmed awareness, said the ministry informed school boards based on AIVD information, left the choice of speakers to school boards, and stated schools' public funding is not meant for donations to third parties.
The choice of whether or not to admit an organisation for an information session, and the conditions under which, is for the boards of educational institutions to decide.
De keuze van het wel of niet toelaten van een organisatie voor een voorlichtingsbijeenkomst en de voorwaarden waaronder, is ter beoordeling aan de besturen van onderwijsinstellingen.
Vragen van de leden De Mos en Bosma (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de uitzending «Zet het klimaat op 1» (ingezonden 11 oktober 2010).

PVV MPs De Mos and Bosma asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a public broadcaster programme on climate change and a graphic 10:10 climate campaign video, and whether public broadcasting should cooperate with the campaign. The minister called the video distasteful, said nobody may be forced to take part, and stated that broadcasters are responsible for their own programming, with the VARA having excluded the video from the broadcast.
Furthermore, it is up to the public broadcasters themselves to decide whether they want to take part in this campaign.
Verder is het aan de publieke omroepen zelf om te beslissen of ze aan deze campagne willen meedoen.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over bezuinigingen op het volwassenenonderwijs (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary for Education about reports that schools may refuse adult secondary education (vavo) students and that budget cuts reduce teachers and funding for adult education. The government answered that it knows of no waiting lists, pointed to municipalities' options to spend participation-budget funds on education, and said the current framework offers enough pathways for most pupils.
I am not aware of any waiting lists for vavo.
Over wachtlijsten voor vavo is mij niets bekend.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat door bezuinigingen minder leerlingen een kans maken alsnog een diploma te halen (ingezonden 16 september 2010

An MP asks the education minister about cuts reducing the chance for pupils to obtain a diploma later, including how many municipalities and places in adult secondary education (VAVO) are affected and whether regional differences are acceptable. The state secretary answers that municipal education budgets were cut and redirected, that VAVO funding for school pupils is unchanged, that municipalities have discretion leading to regional differences, and that the new cabinet will decide on any unwanted effects.
It is up to the new cabinet to decide how any unwanted effects will be dealt with.
Het is aan het nieuwe kabinet om te bepalen hoe zal worden omgegaan met eventuele ongewenste effecten.

Vragen van het lid Smits (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over problemen op het volwassenenonderwijs (VAVO) veroorzaakt door bezuinigingen (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about problems in adult secondary education (VAVO) caused by budget cuts, including municipal caps, enrolment refusals, and dismissals. The state secretary replied that the funding of VAVO as a second route was unchanged, that municipalities and schools decide locally, and declined to investigate or centralise funding, pointing to employers and the new cabinet.
Municipalities themselves decide on the funding of VAVO for adults from public funds.
Over de bekostiging van vavo voor volwassenen uit publieke middelen besluiten gemeenten zelf.
Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Wetenschappen en Cultuur over de bezuinigingen in het volwassenenonderwijs (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

Ms Çelik (PvdA) asks the minister about cuts to adult education, including halved municipal budgets, the origin of education funding, numbers of students seeking diplomas, and whether gemeenten's selective policies are acceptable. The state secretary answers that she refers to earlier answers on most questions, gives participation-budget and enrolment figures, and does not commit to new action.
I refer you to my answer to question 7 from Mr Van der Ham (D66).
Ik verwijs u naar mijn antwoord op vraag 7 van het lid Van der Ham (D66).
Vragen van het lid Bosma (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Baklava, dranghekken en muziek, iedereen viert suikerfeest» (ingezonden 28 september 2010).

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether the public broadcaster's costly 'Suikerfeest' broadcast, with a large Arab-style dinner and a rented concert hall, was justified given only 81,000 viewers. The state secretary replied that programme content is up to the broadcasters, gave the cost as EUR 125,000, and defended the programme under the Media Act's pluriformity mandate.
As state secretary of OCW, I do not decide on the content of the programmes.
Als staatssecretaris van OCW ga ik niet over de inhoud van de programma’s.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de hoogte van de collegegelden voor tweede studies na wijziging van de Wet op het hoger onderwijs en wetenschappelijk

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about how tuition fees for second bachelor's and master's programmes have developed since the WHW amendment, including fee differences, enrolment effects, the five-times-statutory-fee loan ceiling and the three-year compensation scheme. The state secretary said institutions set their own fees with works-council advice, OCW does not have full insight, monitoring and evaluation are planned for 2013, and the loan ceiling will be studied.
OCW has no role in this matter and does not have comprehensive insight into the development of institutional tuition fees.
OCW heeft in dezen geen rol en beschikt niet over een omvattend inzicht in de ontwikkeling van het instellingscollegegeld.

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Scholen gewaarschuwd voor dierenactivisme» (ingezonden 16 september 2010).

Two PVV MPs asked the State Secretary for Education about reports that schools were warned about animal activism, what measures were taken, whether schools should avoid animal-activist lessons, and whether public funds to animal activists should be banned. The State Secretary's reply only requests an extension, promising answers by 28 October 2010 due to investigation and interdepartmental coordination.
I hereby wish to inform you that, due to investigation and interdepartmental coordination, answering these questions requires more time.
Hierbij wil ik u laten weten dat, wegens onderzoek en interdepartementale afstemming, de beantwoording van deze vragen meer tijd vraagt.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het verdwijnen van kleinkunst en cabaret op Radio 2 (ingezonden 9 september 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary for Culture whether the move of kleinkunst and cabaret programmes from Radio 2 to Radio 5 Nostalgia was acceptable, and whether politics should intervene in broadcast scheduling. The state secretary replied that programming is the responsibility of the NPO and the broadcasters, that the programmes are moved rather than removed, and that the government will not intervene in programme decisions.
Cultural programming on the public broadcasters is a matter for the NPO.
De culturele programmering op de publieke zenders is een aangelegenheid van de NPO.

Vragen van het lid Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat universiteiten mogelijk meer armslag krijgen om studenten met ernstige dyslexie te weigeren (ingezo

MP Slob asked the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science whether selecting students with severe dyslexia at university entry conflicts with the ban on disability discrimination, and whether institutions may force alternative tracks. The state secretary answered that selection on disability is not allowed, that the equal treatment act requires reasonable accommodations, that complaints can go to the equal treatment procedure and Commissie gelijke behandeling, and that binding referral to a specialisation may not rest on disability.
Selecting on the basis of disability (direct or indirect) is therefore not permitted.
Selecteren op grond van handicap (direct of indirect) mag dus niet.
Vragen van het lid Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het zoveelste homofobe geweldsincident in Amsterdam (ingezonden 27 augustus 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary of Education, Culture and Science about a homophobic violent incident in Amsterdam, the cultural background of the suspects, and figures on homophobic incidents in 2008–2010 with the perpetrators' backgrounds. The state secretary replies only with a holding notice stating that the answers cannot be given within the usual period because information from the Justice and Interior ministries is still awaited, and promises answers as soon as possible.
since not all the necessary information has yet been received from the relevant Justice and Interior ministries
aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie van de betrokken departementen van Justitie en Binnenlandse Zaken is ontvangen
Vragen van het lid Harbers (VVD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat de TU Delft «andere dingen» doet met rijksgeld voor nieuwbouw (ingezonden 22 januari 2010).

MP Harbers asked the minister why TU Delft reportedly kept its architecture faculty in an old building and spent part of the 25 million euro earmarked for new construction on other things, and what agreements applied. The state secretary said the 25 million was earmarked for a new architectural icon, that the university is autonomous in choosing its housing, and that she will withdraw the contribution and redirect it to her department's budget problem.
I have informed TU Delft of my decision.
Ik heb de TU Delft over mijn besluit geïnformeerd.
Vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over spellingvaardigheden (ingezonden 7 september 2010).

MP Dijkgraaf asks the education minister about news reports that spelling skills decline after primary school and that lowered spelling standards in primary education do not help, and whether the reference levels for language and arithmetic weaken requirements. The state secretary rejects the claim that the reference levels lower standards, says the examinations will be aligned with the reference levels, adds a arithmetic exam and a larger role for writing skills, and promises pilots and monitoring.
I will ensure that these tests align with the principle of realistic ambition
Ik zal er op toezien dat deze toetsen aansluiten bij het beginsel van een realistische ambitie
Vragen van de leden Van Dam (PvdA) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Onderwijs Cultuur Wetenschappen over het overdag afsluiten van uitzendinggemist.nl (ingezonden 9 september 2010).

Two MPs asked the Minister why uitzendinggemist.nl would be made unavailable during daytime hours for programmes rated 12+, asking whether the Commissariaat voor de Media's position and the law support this, whether it is circumventable, and whether the law should be changed. The state secretary answered that the Mediawet 2008 obliges the public broadcaster to protect minors on all platforms, that time-slot protection under Kijkwijzer is the default, that no legislative change is desired, and that consultation on technical alternatives such as a family lock is underway.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het topsalaris van de collegevoorzitter van de TU-Delft (ingezonden 2 september 2010).

An SP MP asks the state secretary about the reported 200,000 euro salary (excluding pension) of the TU Delft board chair, whether it breaches the Balkenende norm promised earlier, the status of a maximum-salary law, bonuses, and other higher-education salaries above the norm. The government only sends a holding notice saying the questions cannot yet be answered within the usual period because not all information has been received.
I aim to answer these questions as soon as possible.
Ik streef ernaar deze vragen zo spoedig mogelijk te beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Smits (SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over kosten voor schoolboeken die onterecht aan ouders worden doorberekend (ingezonden 8 juli 2010).

An MP asked the education minister how to stop schoolbook suppliers from making parents pay shipping and administration costs for free textbooks, and whether schools allowing such online ordering constructions would be held to account. The state secretary answered that such charges are not allowed, that the inspectorate enforces this, and that deposits are permitted, but she declined to ban the ordering procedure unless it makes free books conditional on voluntary contributions or shipping costs.
If the inspectorate, in its investigation into parental contributions, encounters violations such as charging shipping and administration costs for 'free schoolbooks', this is not accepted.

Als de inspectie in haar onderzoek naar de ouderbijdrage overtredingen tegenkomt, zoals het in rekening brengen van verzend- en administratiekosten voor «gratis schoolboeken», wordt dat niet geaccepteerd.
Vragen van het lid Çelik (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de borg die scholen vragen voor gratis schoolboeken (ingezonden 20 augustus 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary how she views reports that secondary schools widely ignore agreements on deposits for free textbooks, what she will do about a blacklist from the VOO, and whether deposits of around 75 to 200 euro fit the law. The state secretary answers that deposits are permitted if the parent council agrees and schools arrange alternatives, that the inspectorate will examine the complaints and act if needed, and that she does not adopt the VOO advice to refuse payment.
At my request, the inspectorate will investigate the VOO's reports.
Op mijn verzoek zal de inspectie de meldingen van de VOO onderzoeken.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over berichten over middelbare scholen die sjoemelen met cijfers (ingezonden 26 juli 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether secondary schools are inflating grades under pressure from boards, citing a press report and AOb claims. The state secretary answered that no concrete cases are known to the union or the inspectorate, cited the 0.5-point SE-CE gap norm, and saw no reason for an investigation.
Neither Mr Dresscher of the AOb nor the Inspectorate of Education is aware of concrete examples of grade manipulation in secondary education.
Er zijn bij de heer Dresscher van de AOb en bij de Inspectie van het Onderwijs geen concrete voorbeelden bekend van gesjoemel met cijfers in het voortgezet onderwijs.
Vragen van de leden Smits en Jasper van Dijk (beiden SP) aan staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over gesjoemel met de kwaliteit in het VO en het HBO (ingezonden 27 juli 2010).

Two MPs asked the state secretary about reports that secondary schools inflate exam grades and pressure teachers over pass rates, and that higher vocational schools hand out diplomas too easily. The state secretary answered that no concrete cases or signals were known, pointed to inspection safeguards and a planned inspection investigation into higher vocational diplomas, and gave an overall reply on the matter.

Vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Gerkens (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Justitie over het programma «Op zoek naar Mary Poppins» (ingezonden 27 januari 2010).

MPs Van Dijk and Gerkens asked ministers whether the AVRO's SMS voting campaign for the programme 'Op zoek naar Mary Poppins' was permissible, how much profit it made, whether the programme and its musical promotion complied with media rules, and whether public broadcasters should promote commercial productions. The state secretary reported a net SMS result of EUR 137,770.90, said the AVRO will use cost-oriented tariffs in future under the public broadcasting code, and that the board decided not to act further because the broadcaster committed to the code.
The AVRO has informed CIPO that in future it will apply a cost-oriented tariff for SMS actions, as Guideline 5 of the public broadcasting code requires.
De AVRO heeft CIPO laten weten in het vervolg bij sms-acties een kostengeoriënteerd tarief te zullen hanteren, zoals Richtlijn 5 van de «Gedragscode publieke omroep» bepaalt.

Vragen van het lid Beertema (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het artikel in de Volkskrant van zaterdag 10 juli 2010 over diplomafraude op hogeschool InHolland (ingezonden 13 juli 20

An MP asks the state secretary whether the award of diplomas to about 250 InHolland students who had not met the exam norm, via the so-called 'Theo-route', constitutes fraud, and whether the Inspectorate should investigate, diplomas be revoked, and consequences attached for staff. The state secretary responds only with a request for postponement, stating an Inspectorate investigation is ongoing and substantive answers will follow after its results, expected in November.
I informed you in my letter that the investigation is ongoing and that I cannot yet respond concretely to the questions above, as answering them depends on the outcome of this investigation.

Ik heb u in mijn brief gemeld dat het onderzoek loopt en dat ik nog niet concreet kan ingaan op de hierboven genoemde Kamervragen, aangezien de beantwoording van de vragen afhankelijk is van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over pilot met diploma’s bij InHolland (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary for Education how InHolland issued diplomas to about 250 students through a special track, whether the Inspectorate intervened, whether the 'pilot' label is acceptable, and whether measures are needed. The state secretary replies only by requesting postponement pending the Inspectorate's ongoing investigation, with conclusions expected in November.
I informed you in my letter that the investigation is ongoing and that I cannot yet respond concretely to the questions above, since answering them depends on the outcome of this investigation.

Ik heb u in mijn brief gemeld dat het onderzoek loopt en dat ik nog niet concreet kan ingaan op de hierboven genoemde Kamervragen, aangezien de beantwoording van de vragen afhankelijk is van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het ongeoorloofd verstrekken van diploma’s media-opleiding door hogeschool InHolland te Haarlem (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

An MP asked the education minister about reports that InHolland in Haarlem issued diplomas unlawfully to about 250 media-management students, and whether the government would investigate similar practices elsewhere. The state secretary requested an extension, stating that answers depend on an ongoing Inspectorate of Education investigation with conclusions expected in November.
I informed you in my letter that the investigation is ongoing and that I cannot yet respond concretely to the above questions, as answering them depends on the outcome of this investigation.

Ik heb u in mijn brief gemeld dat het onderzoek loopt en dat ik nog niet concreet kan ingaan op de hierboven genoemde Kamervragen, aangezien de beantwoording van de vragen afhankelijk is van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over mogelijke trucs bij diplomaverstrekking op de Hanzehogeschool (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

An MP from D66 asks the State Secretary for Education whether alternative graduation routes for 'staartstudenten' (oral exams, out-of-school competences) at the Hanze University are of sufficient quality, whether this resembles InHolland's diploma irregularities, what the Inspectorate's role was, and whether these methods are used elsewhere. The State Secretary requests postponement, stating an Inspectorate investigation is ongoing and answers depend on its outcome, with conclusions expected in November.
I informed you in my letter that the investigation is ongoing and that I cannot yet respond concretely to the above questions, as answering them depends on the outcomes of this investigation.

Ik heb u in mijn brief gemeld dat het onderzoek loopt en dat ik nog niet concreet kan ingaan op de hierboven genoemde Kamervragen, aangezien de beantwoording van de vragen afhankelijk is van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de kwaliteit van de diploma’s in het hoger onderwijs (ingezonden 23 juli 2010).

An MP asks the minister for reactions to a broadcast on diploma quality in higher education, including pressure on lecturers to inflate grades, whether the Inspectorate will check that colleges have adequate guidance to meet requirements, and whether requirements will be in order before the next academic year. The state secretary replies with a request for extension, stating that an Inspectorate investigation is ongoing and that answers depend on its outcome, with conclusions expected in November.
I informed you in my letter that the investigation is ongoing and that I cannot yet address the above questions concretely, since answering them depends on the outcome of this investigation.

Ik heb u in mijn brief gemeld dat het onderzoek loopt en dat ik nog niet concreet kan ingaan op de hierboven genoemde Kamervragen, aangezien de beantwoording van de vragen afhankelijk is van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over studenten van InHolland die via een truc een diploma kregen (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

An SP MP asks the state secretary for Education about reports that InHolland gave students diplomas through an alternative graduation route and pressured staff to keep quiet, and whether the Inspectorate should have intervened earlier. The state secretary responds only with a postponement, stating an Inspectorate investigation is ongoing and substantive answers will follow once its results are available, expected around November.
I informed you in my letter that the investigation is ongoing and that I cannot yet respond concretely to the questions above, as answering them depends on the outcomes of this investigation.

Ik heb u in mijn brief gemeld dat het onderzoek loopt en dat ik nog niet concreet kan ingaan op de hierboven genoemde Kamervragen, aangezien de beantwoording van de vragen afhankelijk is van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Vragen van de leden Smits en Jasper van Dijk (beiden SP) aan staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over gesjoemel met de kwaliteit in het VO en het HBO (ingezonden 27 juli 2010).

MPs Smits and Van Dijk (SP) asked the state secretary about schools inflating final grades and capping the share of pupils who may repeat a year, teachers pressured by management, and diploma bonuses in higher vocational education, asking whether the Inspectorate will investigate and whether a national HBO end-level could help. The state secretary replied only with a postponement notice, stating that an Inspectorate investigation is ongoing, that the answers depend on its results, that an interim report is expected in October and that she expects to inform the House in November.
I informed you in my letter that the investigation is ongoing and that I cannot yet respond concretely to the above questions, since answering them depends on the outcome of this investigation.

Ik heb u in mijn brief gemeld dat het onderzoek loopt en dat ik nog niet concreet kan ingaan op de hierboven genoemde Kamervragen, aangezien de beantwoording van de vragen afhankelijk is van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.

Vragen van de leden De Krom en Harbers (beiden VVD) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over subsidie voor het aantrekken en begeleiden van niet-westerse allochtone s

MPs De Krom and Harbers asked whether the Ministry of Education allocates EUR 3 million to Randstad universities specifically to attract and support non-Western allochtone students, and why such support is not extended to autochthonous students. The state secretary confirmed the EUR 3 million per year from 2011 to 2014, framed as part of broader study-success policy for all students, with performance agreements and a 2013 review pending.
At the end of 2013, based on the results and the inspectorate's evaluation, a decision will be taken on whether the arrangement continues and, if so, in what form.
Eind 2013 vindt, op basis van de resultaten en de evaluatie van de inspectie, besluitvorming plaats over de vraag of het arrangement wordt voortgezet en zo ja, in welke vorm.

Vragen van het lid Smits (SP) aan staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het weigeren van toekomstige studenten door mbo-instellingen vanwege hun leeftijd (ingezonden 29 juli 2010).

MP Smits asked the state secretary whether vocational colleges (mbo) refusing prospective students for being too old breaches equal treatment law, and how this relates to lifelong learning policy and funding incentives. The state secretary answered that age-based refusal would violate the Equal Treatment Act on grounds of age, said no sanctions are for the minister to impose, and pointed students to the Commission for Equal Treatment and courts.
I will explicitly point the institutions to this obligation again in my next administrative consultation with the MBO Council.
Ik zal de instellingen nog eens uitdrukkelijk op deze verplichting wijzen in mijn eerstvolgende bestuurlijk overleg met de MBO Raad.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de toekomst van AT5 (ingezonden 16 juli 2010).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about AT5's financial trouble, the collapsed merger with RTV Noord-Holland, funding levels and whether provinces or cities should finance it. The state secretary said the matter is for the province and municipality, that the Mediawet 2008 framework is adequate, and declined to take a view or act.
This is a matter between the public regional and local broadcasters concerned (RTV-NH and AT5 respectively) and the provincial and municipal governments concerned.
Dit is een aangelegenheid tussen de betrokken publieke regionale en lokale omroepen (respectievelijk RTV-NH en AT5) en de betrokken provinciale en gemeentelijke overheden
Vragen van het lid Smits (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de vele havisten die afstromen naar het vmbo (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

An SP MP asks the state secretary for Education about a report that many havo pupils are being moved down to vmbo, and whether schools avoid doubling a year out of fear of a poor Inspectorate rating. The secretary says no hard figures exist, the estimated flow is about 2% and stable, the Inspectorate treats doubling and downward moves equally negatively, and the Inspectorate is already examining the unintended effects of its assessment method.
I have agreed with the Inspectorate that it will examine the options for taking downward moves and doubling into account differently in the assessment of outcomes.
Ik heb met de Inspectie afgesproken dat de Inspectie nagaat wat de mogelijkheden zijn om afstromen en doubleren anders te betrekken bij de opbrengstbeoordeling

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de gebrekkige informatievoorziening door onderwijsinstellingen over het collegegeld bij een tweede studie (ingezonden 20 ju

An MP asked the education minister about inaccurate and incomplete information from higher education institutions on tuition fees for a second degree, following an ISO study, and whether the government would act before the new academic year. The state secretary acknowledged gaps and confusion, pointed to information campaigns already run in May 2010, and said institutions are responsible for providing correct information in time.
It is the responsibility of umbrella organisations and institutional boards to have their information in order on time.
Het is de verantwoorde-lijkheid van koepels en instellingsbesturen om hun voorlichting tijdig op orde te hebben.
Vragen van het lid Peters (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de beperkte uitleenmogelijkheid van e-books door bibliotheken (ingezonden 28 april 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary whether the one-loan-at-a-time restriction on e-books in public libraries is illogical and whether the law should provide lending remuneration for e-books as it does for print books. The government answers that publishers apply the print model by licence, that Dutch copyright law and EU directive rules require rightholder consent for online lending, and that the market and sector must agree arrangements rather than the state legislating.
This means that for lending e-books via online making available, the consent of rightholders is always required.
Dit betekent dat voor de uitleen van e-books via online terbeschikkingstelling dus steeds toestemming van rechthebbenden is vereist.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de deelname van de staatssecretaris aan de Gay Pride (ingezonden 18 mei 2010).

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science whether her participation in the Gay Pride boat is hypocritical given government support for schools being able to refuse gay teachers, and whether it signals a change of position. She answered that there is no tension with the balance in the equal treatment act between anti-discrimination and freedom of education, that joining the parade underlines active policy for social acceptance of homosexuality, and that she invited volunteers from various organisations to show the progress made.
There is no tension between joining the Gay Pride parade and accepting the balance set out in the General Equal Treatment Act between the prohibition of discrimination and freedom of education.

Er is geen spanning tussen het meevaren op de Gay Pride en het aanvaarden van de in de Algemene wet gelijke behandeling vastgelegde balans tussen het verbod op discriminatie en de vrijheid van onderwijs.

Vragen van de leden Cramer en Anker (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Verkeer en Waterstaat over vervanging van een (bijna) defecte OV-chipkaart (ingezonden 8 juni 2010).

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked why replacing a damaged or defective student OV-chipkaart requires a paper form and surrender of the old card, leaving students without travel rights for up to three weeks, and whether replacement at reasonable cost, or deactivation of the old card, can be arranged. The state secretary answered that card responsibility lies with transport operators, that verification and anti-misuse rules require the defective card to be returned, that temporary cards are issued when delays threaten, and that service levels are being agreed with operators.
I am making agreements with the OV companies about the service levels.
Ik maak afspraken met de OV-bedrijven over de niveaus van dienstverlening.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over fraude bij Hogeschool Windesheim (ingezonden 23 juni 2010).

Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the state secretary for Education how the fraud of over 800,000 euro at Windesheim University of Applied Sciences happened, whether it relates to lumpsum funding, whether the supervisory board supervised finances adequately, and what measures will prevent such fraud and whether further cases are known. The state secretary said the fraud cannot yet be explained, awaits a forensic investigation commissioned by the board, refers to accountant controls and inspectorate procedures, and reported nine signals of fraud in 2009.
The Executive Board of Windesheim University of Applied Sciences immediately after the FIOD report commissioned an external firm to carry out a forensic investigation into the fraud in question.

Het College van Bestuur van Hogeschool Windesheim heeft direct na de melding van de FIOD aan een extern bureau de opdracht verstrekt om een forensisch onderzoek naar de onderhavige fraude te laten uitvoeren.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een hoger collegegeld voor een tweede studie (ingezonden 29 juni 2010).

An SP MP asks the state secretary of Education whether higher tuition for a second degree, especially for teachers, is undesirable and inconsistent with teacher retraining and shortage policy, and asks about transparency and transition for current students. The state secretary defends the statutory and institutional tuition system, the teacher and healthcare exemption, and existing scholarships, and declines to change the policy.
No, I refer you for this to the debate on the bill strengthening governance.
Neen, ik verwijs u hiervoor naar de behandeling van het wetsvoorstel versterking besturing.
Vragen van het lid Atsma (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over bezuinigingen op Omroep Gelderland (ingezonden 30 juni 2010).

MP Atsma asked the state secretary whether he knew of Gelderland's planned cuts to regional broadcaster funding from the Provinciefonds, whether such cuts are lawful under the Mediawet, and what measures would prevent similar cuts elsewhere. The state secretary confirmed awareness, stated provinces must meet the minimum funding in article 2.170 of the Mediawet 2008, sent a letter to Gelderland on 30 June, reported Noord-Brabant also plans cuts, and explained the Commissariaat voor de Media's supervisory role and the minister's power under the Provinciewet to force provincial spending.
Provinces must comply with the statutory obligations laid down in article 2.170 of the Mediawet 2008 for funding the regional broadcaster.
Provincies moeten zich houden aan de wettelijke verplichtingen die in artikel 2.170 van de Mediawet 2008 zijn opgenomen voor de bekostiging van de regionale omroep.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatsecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over tv-evenementen (ingezonden 6 juli 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science to react to a press critique that the TROS broadcaster now organises the Dutch Eurovision entry and whether this is consistent with the Eurovision Song Contest being a national matter under the media decree. The state secretary answered that programming decisions belong to the public broadcaster under the Mediawet, and that the event, listed as Category A, was broadcast fully and live as required.
This concerns a programming matter and I can and will not interfere with it.
Dit betreft een programmatische aangelegenheid en daarmee kan en wil ik mij niet bemoeien.

Vragen van de leden Knops en Biskop (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Defensie en aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het aansmeren van verzekeringspolissen aan scholieren (ingezonden 20 mei

Two CDA MPs asked whether insurance policies were being pushed on pupils during lessons at vocational colleges (ROCs), whether companies may collect pupil data for commercial approaches, and whether this fits the Veiligheid & Vakmanschap curriculum. The state secretary answered that no signs were found of insurance sales during lessons, that commercial activity at ROCs is not acceptable, and that data collection for commercial purposes does not fit the curriculum.
The Ministry of Defence also sent a letter to all ROCs with a defence training programme asking them to ensure the programmes are not used for commercial purposes.

Voorts heeft het ministerie van Defensie naar alle roc's met een defensieopleiding een brief gestuurd met daarin het verzoek erop toe te zien dat de opleidingen niet gebruikt worden voor commerciële doeleinden.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het beperken van de instroom van studenten op succesvolle opleidingen van de TU Delft (ingezonden 8 juni 2010).

An MP asked the education minister whether it is acceptable that TU Delft, for financial reasons, introduces a numerus fixus on popular bachelor programmes despite national science-promotion goals, and how this relates to earlier funding corrections. The state secretary answered that the institution has autonomous authority over intake, that funding is a given framework, that the earlier compensation issue is unrelated, that bèta intake overall has grown, and that the government cannot make statements on future funding due to its caretaker status.
An institutional board has its own authority to set annually the number of students who may at most be enrolled for the first time in a given programme.
Een instellingsbestuur heeft een eigen bevoegdheid jaarlijks het aantal studenten vast te stellen dat ten hoogste voor de eerste keer kan worden ingeschreven voor een bepaalde opleiding.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold (D66), Dijsselbloem (PvdA), Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink (VVD) en Smits (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat de Isaac Beeckman Academie wordt ge

MPs from D66, PvdA, VVD and SP asked the state secretary whether the Isaac Beeckman Academy was forced to close after a late placement decision and a demand to repay start-up funding, and why communication was delayed. The state secretary answered that the school received funding without providing education, that repayment was deferred to 2010, that the delay was an omission, and declined to discuss details of the individual case.
Vragen van het lid Harbers (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de reclame voor de Publieke Omroep op de Publieke omroep (ingezonden 18 juni 2010).

MP Harbers asks the state secretary about publicly funded self-promotion spots by the Publieke Omroep, their cost, the basis of the statistics they cite, and whether public money should fund campaigns for the broadcaster's support. The state secretary says self-promotion is part of the broadcaster's public task funded from its marketing budget, that the statistics come from NPO-commissioned research, and declines to reconsider.
Self-promotion, like programme promotion, is a suitable means for this.
Zelfpromotie is daar – net als programmapromotie – een geschikt middel voor.

Vragen van het lid Harbers (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het terugsluizen van geld door de publieke omroep via een eigen muziekuitgeverij (ingezonden 20 mei 2010).

MP Harbers asks the state secretary whether the public broadcaster NPO routes millions of euros back to itself through its own music publishing firm Crossmex by forcing composers to place their works there, and whether sanctions are warranted. The state secretary replies only that answering the questions needs more time and will follow during the summer recess.
I hereby inform you that coordinating and answering these questions requires more time.
Hierbij laat ik weten dat de afstemming en beantwoording van deze vragen meer tijd vraagt.

Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de minister van Justitie over onduidelijkheid rondom regels voor machtiging tot voorlopig verblijf (MVV) voor Surinaamse st

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary and the Justice minister why the 10,000 euro guarantee required of non-EU students, including Surinamese students, was still unclear and inconsistently applied across institutions, and whether it is an IND requirement. The government answered that proof of sufficient means is required but a guarantee is only one of several options, that it is not an IND requirement, and promised a letter to institutions in June after a delayed reply.
I will inform the institutions further by letter.
Ik zal de instellingen nader per brief informeren.
Vragen van het lid Van der Vlies (SGP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Schoolstage: pornofilms bewerken» (ingezonden 20 mei 2010).

MP Van der Vlies asked the minister whether a vocational student's internship involved editing pornographic films, how the internship was ended, whether similar cases are known, and whether the school should have sought another assignment at the same firm. The state secretary confirmed the report, explained that the training firm was asked about the incident and that the student was given a replacement placement, noted that no similar cases are known, and said the recognition body is reviewing the firm.

The knowledge centre has meanwhile contacted the vocational institution and the training firm to assess whether this was a one-off incident or whether there are grounds to withdraw the firm's recognition.

Het kenniscentrum heeft inmiddels over deze kwestie contact opgenomen met de mbo-instelling en het leerbedrijf om te bezien of dit een eenmalig incident was of dat er redenen is om het leerbedrijf de erkenning te ontnemen.

Vragen van de leden Smits en Jasper van Dijk (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretarisvan Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over oud-studenten die moeten betalen voor de naamsverandering van de IB-groep naar DUO (ingezonden 22

MPs Smits and Jasper van Dijk asked the state secretary whether former students paying off study debts via bailiffs should be charged 74.54 euro because the IB-groep was renamed DUO, and whether they would act to stop this and inform debtors. The state secretary answered that debtors should not have to pay this charge, that bailiffs rarely pass on such costs under the formal procedure, and that debtors can file a complaint with DUO to be reimbursed.
It is not intended that debtors should have to pay the 74.54 euro that results from a service of process.
Het is niet de bedoeling dat debiteuren 74,54 euro moeten betalen, die van een betekening het gevolg is.

Vragen van de leden Biskop en De Rouwe (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over mbo’ers die bevreesd zijn voor hun toekomst op de arbeidsmarkt (ingezonden 23 april 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary for Education about a newspaper report on vocational students fearing for their labour-market future, including criticism of their training and links to youth unemployment in Friesland. The secretary answered that the crisis effects are temporary, that the individual student criticism cannot be generalised, and that the government is taking quality-supervision and governance measures.
Since the cited article does not make clear which course(s) or which vocational institution are involved, I cannot make general statements about this.
Aangezien uit het genoemde artikel niet duidelijk wordt om welke opleiding(en) en/of welke mbo-instelling het gaat, kan ik hierover geen (algemene) uitspraken doen.
Vragen van het lid Bosma (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het Zembla-programma «Wilders, profeet van de angst» (ingezonden 6 mei 2010).

PVV MP Bosma asked the state secretary about a Zembla broadcast on Geert Wilders, questioning whether public broadcasting should label an elected politician a Nazi and whether balanced programming rules were being followed. The state secretary rejected Bosma's interpretation, noted the broadcaster is independent with oversight by the Commissariaat voor de Media and courts, and declined to act on the other questions, including one about a VARA founder's wartime history.
Supervision of the performance of the task is arranged independently through the Commissariaat voor de Media.
Het toezicht op de uitvoering van de taak is onafhankelijk geregeld via het Commissariaat voor de Media.

Vragen van het lid Van Leeuwen (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het voornemen van de Provincie Noord-Brabant om de subsidie aan Cubiss, de provinciale service organisatie, stop te ze

An SP MP asks the state secretary about Noord-Brabant's plan to end provincial subsidy to the library service organisation Cubiss, and whether this undermines the shared library network and the Wet op het specifiek cultuurbeleid. The secretary says ending all provincial tasks would conflict with the law and the Bibliotheekcharter, notes the province has since amended the cut to 15%, and says a library law amendment is being prepared for 2013.
Ending the provincial tasks entirely I consider, however, to conflict with the purpose of the articles of the law mentioned earlier and with the content of recent agreements between the governments.
Het geheel beëindigen van de provinciale taken acht ik echter strijdig met de strekking van de eerder genoemde artikelen van de wet en strijdig met inhoud van recente afspraken tussen de overheden
Vragen van het lid Biskop (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over bezuinigingen op het volwassenenonderwijs (ingezonden 31 mei 2010).

An MP from the CDA asks the state secretary whether cuts to adult education, and municipal budget choices, undermine second-chance education and lifelong learning, and whether care pupils are left out in the cold. The state secretary replies that municipalities must spend the full education share of the participation budget on education, that care pupils are not disadvantaged, and that consultation with the VNG and MBO Raad is ongoing.
Municipalities are obliged to spend the full amount they receive within the participation budget for education on education at a roc.
Gemeenten zijn verplicht het volledige bedrag dat zij binnen het participatiebudget voor educatie ontvangen bij een roc aan educatie te besteden.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatsecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de minister van Justitie over de bedreigingen in de richting van een Deense cartoonist en het debat over de vrijheid van

An MP asked the state secretary and justice minister how they view the Danish cartoonist Kurt Westergaard's decision to stop working after threats, and what they will do to promote free expression and protect opinion-makers. The government says it regards any threat against the cartoonist as serious and points to its human rights strategy, UN resolutions and Dutch-funded media and journalist safety projects abroad.
Ik maak mij sterk voor de vrijheid van meningsuiting.
Vragen van het lid Bosma (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over verkiezingsbeïnvloeding door de Katholieke Radio-omroep (ingezonden 27 mei 2010).

An MP asked whether the KRO broadcasting association could lawfully send members a letter urging them to support it electorally, its cost, and whether its subsidy should be withdrawn. The state secretary answered that the letter is a permitted member-communication activity not publicly funded, that it gave no voting advice, and that the law gives no basis to withdraw the subsidy.
No. The law gives me no competence and basis for that.
Nee. De wet geeft mij daarvoor geen bevoegdheid en grondslag.
Vragen van het lid Bosma (PVV) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het lidmaatschap van de VVD van KRO-voorzitter Koen Becking (ingezonden 2 juni 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether KRO chairman Koen Becking, who is a VVD member, favored his own party in a member letter and whether publicly funded means were used against a VVD competitor just before the elections. The state secretary answered that the letter contained no voting advice, that the content is Becking's responsibility, and that the campaign was financed from association income, not public funds.
I point out again that this activity was not funded with public money, but from association income.
Ik wijs er nogmaals op dat deze activiteit niet met publieke middelen is bekostigd, maar uit verenigingsinkomsten

Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over verborgen orthodoxie op scholen (ingezonden 15 april 2010).

Karabulut (SP) asked whether ouders receive full information about school grondslag, why Cosmicus Montessori Lyceum does not disclose alleged close ties to the Fethullah Gulen movement, and which other schools have such ties. The state secretary answered that schools must state their grondslag publicly and the Inspectie monitors this, that the inspectorate has received no signals of close ties at Cosmicus or other schools, and that the separate WWI-led study covers internaten and huiswerkbegeleiding rather than OCW-funded schools.
The study focuses primarily on boarding schools and homework support institutions linked to the Fethullah Gulen movement and aims to gain insight into the pedagogical-didactic climate there.

Het onderzoek richt zich primair op internaten en huiswerkbegeleidingsinstellingen verbonden aan (het gedachtegoed van) Fethullah Gulen en heeft tot doel om inzicht te verkrijgen in het pedagogisch-didactische klimaat.
Vragen van het lid Verdonk (Verdonk) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over problemen bij het aanvragen van meeneembare studiefinanciering (ingezonden 11 mei 2010).

An MP asks the Education minister about delays in obtaining portable student finance for foreign study, including structural overruns of the eight-week deadline and whether a maximum decision term or damages should apply. The state secretary replies that the legal eight-week deadline already applies, delays come from foreign institutions and quality checks, and burghers can now claim a penalty payment for late decisions under the amended AWB.
As I indicated on 12 March, the General Administrative Law Act (AWB) already sets a maximum term, which DUO must also observe.
Zoals ik op 12 maart heb aangegeven geeft de Algemene Wet Bestuursrecht (AWB) al een maximumtermijn aan, waaraan ook DUO zich te houden heeft.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de staatsecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de minister van Justitie over de bedreigingen in de richting van een Deense cartoonist en het debat over de vrijheid van

An MP from D66 asks the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science and the Minister of Justice how the government views reports that Danish cartoonist Kurt Westergaard may stop working due to threats, and what it will do to promote debate on freedom of expression and to protect opinion-makers nationally and internationally. The minister only sends an interim notice that the answers will take longer because several departments are involved, promising answers by 4 June.
Because various other departments also wish to be involved, answering will take somewhat more time.
Omdat ook diverse andere departementen betrokken willen zijn, zal beantwoording wat meer tijd vragen.
Vragen van de leden Biskop en Jan de Vries (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de beveiliging van computernetwerken op middelbare scholen (ingezonden 1 april 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked the education minister about students hacking school networks to alter grades, absences and timetables, and what schools should do about it. The state secretary answered that schools are primarily responsible for data security, that no system can be fully secure, and that DUO will remind schools of the importance of data protection, with better separation of learning and administrative environments and clear agreements with staff and students.

The reply stated that educational institutions are primarily responsible for securing pupil data, but committed to reminding school administrators of the importance of data protection through DUO's regular communications.

In de antwoordbrief is aangegeven dat de onderwijsinstellingen primair verantwoordelijk zijn voor de beveiliging van leerlinggegevens, maar is wel de toezegging gedaan om via DUO in de reguliere communicatie richting administrateurs van de onderwijsinstellingen nog eens te wijzen op het belang van gegevensbeveiliging.

Vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk (SP) en Besselink (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het advies van de VO-raad over de borg bij de gratis schoolboeken (ingezonden 27 april 2010).

Two MPs asked the state secretary whether she still stands by her statement that parents need not sign school cost agreements, and how she views required deposits for school books in distributors' terms and the VO-raad advice on them. The state secretary answered that schools, not distributors, are responsible for the deposit procedure, that supply must not depend on paying a deposit, and that the inspectorate will act on non-compliance, but mostly placed responsibility on parents and school participation councils.
However, the delivery of the school books may not be made dependent on paying a deposit.
De levering van de schoolboeken mag echter niet afhankelijk worden gesteld van het betalen van een borg.

Vragen van de leden Van Vroonhoven-Kok en Atsma (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de Wet op de archeologische monumente

MPs Van Vroonhoven-Kok and Atsma asked about nursery growers' complaints under the Archaeological Heritage Act, the scope of the 100 m2 exemption, whether municipalities can refine archaeological maps, and whether an exemption for digging to 50 cm should be introduced. The state secretary said the exemption does not cover large nursery projects, municipalities may commission detailed maps, cost-efficiency is a principle of the law, and a generic 50 cm exemption is undesirable though plans can be adjusted once deeper archaeology is confirmed.
No, I consider a generic exemption up to 50 cm below ground level undesirable, because a great many archaeological values are located in that layer.
Nee, een generieke vrijstelling tot 50 cm beneden maaiveld acht ik ongewenst, omdat heel veel archeologische waarden zich in die laag bevinden.
Vragen van het lid Harbers (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de nieuwe collegegeldtarieven van de Universiteit van Tilburg (ingezonden 13 april 2010).

The MP asks the state secretary about Tilburg University's new 2010-2011 tuition rates, which charge students who did not enrol in 2009-2010 full institutional tuition for a second master or bachelor, and whether this conflicts with the covenant accompanying the Versterking Besturing bill. The state secretary answers that institutions set their own tuition policy, that the covenant concerns students completing a parallel second study at statutory tuition, that the university appears to implement the covenant, and that funding decisions belong to the spring memorandum.
It is up to each institution to determine, with reasons, what institutional tuition it charges students.
Het is aan elke instelling om gemotiveerd te bepalen welk instellingscollegegeld zij studenten in rekening brengt.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een verschillende collegegeld voor dezelfde studie (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary whether Tilburg University may charge students who did not study there a higher institutional tuition fee than its own students for a second degree, and whether such differences are justified given accessibility concerns. The state secretary answers that the law allows institutions to differentiate institutional tuition, subject to equal-treatment law and reasoned decisions, and refers to the parliamentary debate on the governance reform for the rest.
Equal cases must be treated equally and unequal cases may be treated unequally.
Gelijke gevallen moeten gelijk en ongelijke gevallen kunnen ongelijk worden behandeld.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een miljoenenstrop bij de Hogeschool van Amsterdam (ingezonden 8 april 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Hogeschool van Amsterdam's EUR 300 million Amstelcampus real-estate project, including shops, housing and a car park, is an unacceptable use of teaching budget, and whether it is delayed, loses money, pays a EUR 17 million claim, and should be unwound through a merger with the University of Amsterdam. The state secretary answered that the institution's own board decides construction, that the project is on schedule with permits in place, that the institution is not a property developer, that no financial or educational problems have been established, and that no inspection or change to housing responsibilities is planned.
So far it has not become apparent to me that there are financial problems at the HvA or deficient education.
Vooralsnog is mij niet gebleken dat sprake is van financiële problemen bij de HvA of van tekortschietend onderwijs.
Vragen van het lid Gerkens (SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over Politiek24 op internet (ingezonden 25 maart 2010).

An MP asks why the public broadcaster's Politiek24 video is only viewable via Microsoft Silverlight and Windows Media rather than open standards, and whether debates paid with public money should be freely accessible and reusable. The minister replies that the NPO chose these players for broad compatibility, that no open video standard yet suffices for large-scale distribution, that DRM is needed for rights management, and that work toward open source continues, with a TNO follow-up study in 2010.

In a follow-up process in 2010, TNO will further examine, among other things, the organisational and technical aspects and come with proposals for further implementation of open source software and standards.

TNO zal in een vervolgtraject in 2010 onder andere de organisatorische en technische aspecten verder onderzoeken en komen met voorstellen voor verdere implementatie van open source software en standaarden.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschappen en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het gebrek aan aandacht voor homoseksuele ouderen in zorginstellingen. (ingezond

Dutch MPs asked the ministers of Education and Health how they would respond to research showing staff in care homes rarely pay attention to gay residents, and what is being done about it. The state secretary said the government funds the 'Roze Ouderen' projects and the Roze Loper initiative, granted subsidies to the Roze 50+ project and the Gay & Straight Ouderenalliantie, and promised a fuller progress letter before the summer recess.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap, Van Bijsterveldt-Vliegenthart, over sponsoring door ROC's (ingezonden 19 februari 2010).

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Education about regional vocational colleges (ROCs) sponsoring football clubs and holding business-club seats, paid from public education funds, and whether this is acceptable. The secretary said she opposes publicly funded sponsorship in principle, will regulate the lawful and efficient use of public funds via an AMvB in the upcoming bill covering sports sponsorship, and will raise business seats with the MBO-raad, but declined to compile a total overview of ROC sponsorship spending.
Because I want sharp insight into the lawful and efficient use of government funds, I will also have this AMvB cover sports sponsorship.
Omdat ik scherp inzicht wil hebben in de rechtmatige en doelmatige besteding van overheidsmiddelen zal ik deze AMvB ook betrekking laten hebben op sportsponsoring.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over problemen met studieschulden (ingezonden 1 april 2010).

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Education about students' poor understanding of study loans, the DUO's information efforts, loan write-off practice and possible new safeguards. The State Secretary says information has been intensified, DUO cooperates with Nibud, and most proposed measures (signature requirement, periodic emails, targeted start-of-study advice) are judged impractical or unnecessary, while pointing to a separate report for the question on abolishing the basic grant.
Despite all of DUO's efforts to improve information, it proves particularly difficult to make all young adults aware of the long-term effects of borrowing money.
Ondanks alle inspanningen van de DUO om de voorlichting te verbeteren, blijkt het bijzonder lastig om alle jongvolwassenen bewust te maken van de langetermijneffecten van het lenen van geld.

Vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Poppe (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretarissen van Defensie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap, mw. Van Bijsterveldt-Vliegenthart, over scholieren die verzekeringspolissen krijge

MPs asked whether vocational students were pressured during school hours to buy insurance policies from a commercial insurer, and whether this breached rules on independence and sponsorship, and questioned Defence's role in the vocational programme. The government condemned the sales practice, said the insurer no longer gives presentations at the school, and maintained that the sponsorship rules do not apply to vocational education and that Defence's teaching role is appropriate.
I disapprove of the course of events as described in the Telegraaf report.
Ik keur de gang van zaken zoals beschreven in het bericht van de Telegraaf af.

Vragen van de leden Knops en Biskop (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Defensie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap, mw. Van Bijsterveldt-Vliegenthart, over het aansmeren van verzekeringspolissen aan scholie

CDA MPs asked whether insurance firm DFD sold policies to minors during school lessons at a vocational college, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary said no policies were sold during lessons, only follow-up calls after school, that the curriculum is supervised by the Inspectorate, and that action will follow if concrete evidence of commercial practices in lessons emerges.
If concrete indications of commercial practices during lessons at a vocational college reach me, I will certainly take action against them.
Indien concrete aanwijzingen van commerciële praktijken tijdens de lessen op een roc mij bereiken zal ik daartegen zeker optreden.
Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het waarborgen van de kwaliteit van geneeskundeonderwijs (ingezonden 12 maart 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary whether universities can guarantee quality if the numerus fixus for medicine is lifted, and about funding, internship places and cuts to basic care. The state secretary answered that universities are ready to take 250 extra students from September 2011, that the decision on lifting the numerus fixus is left to the next cabinet, and that faculties have the responsibility and funds for internship planning.
On 29 January 2010 the Council for Public Health and Health Care (RVZ) presented advice to ministers Klink and Plasterk.
Op 29 januari 2010 bood de Raad voor de Volksgezondheid en Zorg (RVZ) de ministers Klink en Plasterk een advies aan
Vragen van het lid Biskop (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over competentiegericht onderwijs in het mbo (ingezonden 12 maart 2010).

MP Biskop asks the state secretary about criticism that competency-based vocational education (CGO) has upset the balance between subject knowledge and attitude, produces tick-box behaviour through thick qualification files, and needs more talks with business. The state secretary answers that paritary committees safeguard the balance, that the files are shorter than alleged, and that schools and the MBO Raad are already closely involved.
I would point out that the development of the qualification files is shaped by paritary committees.
Ik wil erop wijzen dat de ontwikkeling van de kwalificatiedossiers wordt vormgegeven door paritaire commissies.
Vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de Stewardess Academy (ingezonden 10 maart 2010)

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Education why the Stewardess Academy kept its diploma recognition and remained open despite inspection shortcomings, and what sanctions and oversight changes would follow. The State Secretary answered that the inspectorate found education quality sufficient, that sanctions such as ending diploma recognition are possible after warnings but financial sanctions are not, and promised to report back on the recognition system before the summer recess.
I am in discussion with DUO and the inspectorate about this and will report back to you before the summer recess.
Ik ben hierover met DUO en de inspectie in gesprek en kom daar voor het zomerreces bij u op terug.
Vragen van het lid Atsma (CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de zendtijd 2.42-omroepen (ingezonden 17 februari 2010).

An MP asks the minister about reallocating broadcast time among religious and philosophical 2.42 broadcasters, including how the membership base of each is measured and whether the Humanist broadcaster's gain is justified. The state secretary confirms the cuts and gains, explains the closed allocation system, the 75% proportional rule and the Commissariaat's verification method, and defends the Humanist membership estimate.
The Commissariaat then has the burden of proof independently verified by experts in demography, religious studies and sociology.
Het Commissariaat laat de bewijslast vervolgens onafhankelijk toetsen door deskundigen op het terrein van demografie, godsdienstwetenschappen en sociologie.

Vragen van de leden Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink en Schippers (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap, mw. Van Bijsterveldt-Vliegenthart, en de minister voor Ontwikkelingssamenwerking over

Two VVD MPs asked whether a West Brabant vocational college (ROC) may use public funds and staff for structural development work in Haiti and whether this fits its core task. The state secretary answered that no public WEB funds flow to Haiti, that staff plans a voluntary monthly contribution on their own initiative and cost, and that schools may invest lumpsum funds in private activities if transparent and linked to education goals.
In principle the lump sum for schools is intended for providing good education, and anything that serves that aim is permitted.
In beginsel is de lumpsum voor de scholen bedoeld voor het leveren van goed onderwijs en alles dat daartoe strekt is toegestaan.
Vragen van het lid Verdonk (Verdonk) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het feit dat steeds meer Nederlandse studenten over de grens gaan studeren (igezonden 12 maart 2010).

MPs Verdonk asked the minister whether she knows that more Dutch students study abroad, that DUO decisions on portable study grants take months, and that this causes talented students to drop out, and whether maximum decision times will be imposed. The state secretary acknowledges the trend, explains the Nuffic quality-check process and says the 8-week AWB deadline applies, with average handling just under 6 weeks in 2009, but denies knowledge of students dropping out and offers no new commitment.
The General Administrative Law Act (AWB) already sets a maximum term, which DUO must also observe.
De Algemene Wet Bestuursrecht (AWB) geeft al een maximumtermijn aan, waaraan ook DUO zich te houden heeft.
Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over leerplichtigen die worden geweigerd op school (ingezonden 2 maart 2010).

Pechtold (D66) asked the state secretary for Education about apprentices in the vocational (bbl) track losing workplace places during the crisis, refusals of compulsory-schooling pupils from vocational (bol) courses, the lack of records on refusals, and the transparency of admission decisions. The secretary replied that leerbedrijven remain sufficient overall, that sector and regional measures and extra funding are in place, that schools are not required to record refusals, and that admission rules are set by law and can be challenged in court.
Because mbo institutions are not obliged to keep a record of the number of refusals and the reasons underlying them, I cannot inform you about the causes of refusals.

Doordat mbo-instellingen niet verplicht zijn om een registratie bij te houden omtrent het aantal weigeringen en de daaraan ten grondslag liggende onderbouwingen, kan ik u niet informeren over voorkomende oorzaken van weigeringen.

Vragen van de leden De Krom en Harbers (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over discriminatie bij de Universiteit Utrecht (ingezonden 3 februari 2010).

MPs De Krom and Harbers asked whether a Utrecht University programme offering research assistant places exclusively to ethnic-minority students breaches equal treatment law and the Constitution, and whether the minister will require it to be opened to all. The state secretary replied that the programme aims to counter under-representation, that preferential policy is permitted under strict conditions of the General Equal Treatment Act, and that it is for universities, courts or the Equal Treatment Commission to judge concrete cases, so no general appraisal or instruction to Utrecht was given.
It is for the university to assess to what extent it is desirable, within the framework of the law, to pursue preferential policy for, for example, ethnic-minority students.
Het is aan de universiteit om een inschatting te maken in hoeverre het wenselijk is om binnen de kaders van de wet voorkeursbeleid te voeren voor bijvoorbeeld allochtone studenten.

Vragen van het lid Verdonk (Verdonk) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de speciale bevoegdheid van een schooldirecteur met betrekking tot de leerplichtwet (ingezonden 17 februari 2010).

An MP asked the education minister whether a school director may grant extra leave to Princess Amalia for the Winter Olympics, and whether this conflicts with the compulsory education law. The state secretary said the leave was an individual decision by the school director under the Leerplichtwet, that the parents comply with the law, and that the municipal call against early holidays is fully supported.
I am aware that Princess Amalia is attending the Winter Olympics this year and that she therefore misses four days of school.
Ik ben ervan op de hoogte dat Prinses Amalia dit jaar aanwezig is bij de Olympische Winterspelen en dat zij daardoor vier dagen school mist.
Vragen van het lid Harbers (VVD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat Iraanse studenten voortaan wel nucleaire studies mogen volgen (ingezonden 4 februari 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether a court ruling declaring the Dutch sanctions rule barring Iranian students from nuclear programmes and sites unlawful means they may now take such studies, and how the court could reach that verdict given earlier assurances.
