The state secretary replies that the ruling binds only the three plaintiffs, the rule still applies otherwise, the cabinet is considering next steps, and the Netherlands is obliged to implement UN resolution 1737.
Vragen van het lid Besselink (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over onbevoegde docenten voor de klas (ingezonden 5 maart 2010).

MP Besselink asked the education minister how she assesses reports that the share of unqualified teachers in secondary schools has risen, its causes, whether unqualified teaching can only be a temporary emergency measure, and how new teachers are supported. The state secretary answered that 82% of lessons are taught by qualified teachers, that the rise of one percentage point is not a clear trend, that unqualified deployment must not become structural with intensified inspection, and described subsidies for career changers and reduced teaching loads for new teachers.
The inspectorate will intensify its supervision on this point.
De inspectie gaat het toezicht op dit punt intensiveren.
Vragen van het lid Van Vroonhoven-Kok (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Wethouder wist al jaar van uitstel Stedelijk» (ingezonden 3 maart 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science about press reports that the reopening of the Stedelijk Museum in Amsterdam was delayed again, whether Amsterdam can lead large building projects, and who should direct major cultural construction projects. The state secretary said the matter is for the Amsterdam municipality and the museum to manage, and that a postponement does not imply a lack of direction.
It is up to the directly responsible administrators to organise the direction of major renovations or building projects.
Het is aan de direct verantwoordelijke bestuurders om de regie te organiseren bij grote verbouwingen of bouwprojecten.
Vragen van het lid Depla (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het beleggingsverlies van onderwijsinstellingen in 2008 (ingezonden 19 februari 2010).

An MP asked the education minister how the large 2008 investment losses of education institutions, which conflict with the rule that only capital-guaranteed investments are allowed, should be assessed, whether speculation with public money is acceptable, and how schools will be held to account. The government answered that the losses were book losses largely recovered, that the rules were tightened from 2010, that the Inspectorate will examine compliance and act where needed, and that accountants and monitoring will continue.
The Inspectorate of Education had included in its 2009 annual work plan an investigation into the institutions' investment and borrowing policy.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs had in het jaarwerkplan 2009 onderzoek naar het beleggings- en beleningsbeleid van de instellingen opgenomen.

Vragen van het lid Leerdam (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het instorten van het plafond van de bidkapel van de Broederenkerk in Deventer (ingezonden 19 februari 2010).

An MP asked the education, culture and science minister about the collapse of part of the ceiling of the Broederenkerk chapel in Deventer, whether large-scale deferred maintenance caused it, and whether rules or new measures are needed to prevent such risks. The state secretary confirmed the collapse and deferred maintenance, said it is incidental rather than structural, and saw no need to tighten the subsidy rules or take new measures, citing owners' responsibility.
I therefore see no reason to take new measures.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om nieuwe maatregelen te treffen.
Vragen van het lid Harbers (VVD) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het «prijzenpakket» om studenten warm te krijgen voor de OV-chipkaart (ingezonden 11 februari 2010).

An MP asks the education minister about a prize lottery (iPad, winter holiday) used to encourage students to activate their OV-chipkaart, and whether public transport operators should spend money on it rather than fixing technical problems. The state secretary replies that the operators run the campaign with their own budget, the procedure is not complicated, and a new deadline of 16 March 2010 has been set.
The lottery of prizes among students who activated their 2010 travel right is part of this campaign by the OV companies.
Het verloten van prijzen onder studerenden die het reisrecht 2010 hebben geactiveerd, maakt onderdeel uit van deze campagne van de OV-bedrijven.

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk asked whether board member B. has links to the Muslim Brotherhood, whether he is an official government interlocutor, and whether investigation and a postponement of broadcasting time for the Stichting Moslim Omroep are planned. The government answered that Bouyafa is no longer an interlocutor, that FION is linked to the European federation FIOE, that it will not say whether investigations occur, and that the broadcasting body did not designate SMO.
Publicly, however, I cannot address whether investigations are being carried out into organisations or persons.
In het openbaar kan ik echter niet ingaan op de vraag of onderzoek wordt gedaan naar organisaties of personen.

Vragen van de leden Wilders , Brinkman en Agema (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat FION, één van de initiatiefnemende o

MPs Wilders, Brinkman and Agema asked whether FION, an initiator of the new Muslim broadcaster SMO, is linked to the Muslim Brotherhood and whether the AIVD monitors it, and called for SMO's exclusion from public broadcasting. The state secretary answered that SMO was not designated by the Commissariaat voor de Media, declined to comment on AIVD investigations in public, and gave no commitment to a broad new investigation.
Publicly I cannot address whether the AIVD conducts investigations into organisations or persons.
In het openbaar kan ik niet ingaan op de vraag of de AIVD onderzoek doet naar organisaties of personen.

MP Remkes asked the minister whether the NPO plans a new 2011 radio channel (Radio 7) with religious-philosophical programming, how it would be distributed, how it would be financed, and why existing programming on Radio 5 is not placed with another channel. The state secretary confirmed the plan (part of the 2010-2015 concession policy plan), said distribution would be via AM, that financial consequences are still being worked out within existing budgets, and that the NPO is responsible for channel content under the Mediawet 2008, citing segmentation and unclear profile of Radio 5.
Within the framework of the Mediawet 2008, the public broadcaster is itself responsible for the form and content of its channels.
De publieke omroep is binnen het kader van de Mediawet 2008 zelf verantwoordelijk voor de vorm en inhoud van zijn zenders.

An MP asked the minister of Education, Culture and Science whether a Leiden rector magnificus's remark about a politician speaking of a 'tsunami of Muslims' was appropriate, and related questions on scientific respect for facts and on rehabilitating a professor. The minister confirmed awareness of the remarks, declined to judge the speaker's intentions, and had no opinion on the other points.
I do not express a view on the intentions behind a remark made by a person.
Ik spreek mij niet uit over de bedoelingen van een opmerking van een persoon.

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Gerkens asked whether the AVRO's Mary Poppins talent show, which charged 60 cents per SMS vote, complied with media law, the promotional gaming code and the non-commercial principle of public broadcasting. The government answered that CIPO is still investigating the tariffs, that the Commissariaat found no breach of the advertising and cooperation rules so far, and that a definitive assessment will follow later.
I will inform the House of the findings of CIPO.
Ik zal de Kamer informeren over de bevindingen van CIPO.

An SP MP asked the education state secretary whether a popular concierge at a municipal Dordrecht school was being dismissed because of budget cuts, how many schools face similar cuts, and whether rules could be changed or the job saved. The state secretary replied that dismissal policy is the school board's responsibility, that the leerplusarrangement changes are not directly linked to the dismissal, that 74 more schools now receive funds while 75 receive less, and that priorities are for the school to set.
Dismissal policy in secondary education is the responsibility of the school board.
Het ontslagbeleid in het voortgezet onderwijs is de verantwoordelijkheid van het schoolbestuur.

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary for Education whether a secondary school charging parents 245 euro for a laptop lease and licences, on top of the voluntary contribution, conflicts with free schoolbooks and segregates schools by parental wealth. The state secretary said laptops are not free schoolbooks, but schools may charge for them only under strict conditions: parents' council consent, a written voluntary agreement, and a reduction scheme, with the Inspectorate examining parental contributions and laptop handling in 2009-2010.
I will ask the Inspectorate to pay attention to the way schools handle the laptop.
Ik zal de Inspectie vragen hierbij aandacht te schenken aan de manier waarop scholen omgaan met de laptop.

MP Biskop asks the state secretary of Education whether new language and arithmetic reference levels will push many vmbo pupils out of obtaining a diploma and whether their introduction is well-founded. The state secretary answers that introduction will be phased and evidence-based, that no decisions on stricter exam rules will be taken until shown feasible, and that the reference levels are seen as achievable and supported by a broader quality package.
As I have already indicated, I will first gain experience with the reference levels and trial central examinations in vmbo and mbo before definitive decisions are taken.
Zoals ik reeds aangegeven heb, zal ik in het vmbo en in het mbo eerst ervaring opdoen met de referentieniveaus en proef-centrale examens alvorens definitieve beslissingen worden genomen.
Vragen van de leden Biskop (CDA) en Depla (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap, mw. Van Bijsterveld-Vliegenthart, over de mbo-keuzegids (ingezonden 21 december 2009).

MPs Biskop and Depla ask the state secretary about a dispute between the MBO Raad and the publisher of the MBO Keuzegids over publishing institution-level performance data, and whether binding agreements on transparency will be made. The secretary answers that transparency measures have been agreed with the sector and that she is not responsible for how third parties use ODIN survey results.
I regret that the presentation of the MBO Keuzegids 2010 led to disagreement between the MBO Raad and the publisher of the MBO Keuzegids.
Ik vind het jammer dat de presentatie van de Keuzegids MBO 2010 tot onenigheid tussen de MBO Raad en de uitgever van de Keuzegids MBO heeft geleid.

An MP asked the state secretary of education about truancy in Amsterdam, including the reporting practices of the Bureau Leerplicht Plus, under-registration in vocational colleges, rising luxury truancy, and a targeted plan for non-western pupils. The state secretary answered that municipalities hold primary responsibility for enforcement, that national figures are being collected, that registration is improving through measures such as a digital reporting portal, and that no group-specific policy is pursued at national level.
I will inform you about the state of affairs in spring 2010.
Ik informeer u over de stand van zaken in het voorjaar 2010.

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk asked whether ROC Albeda and Zadkine lost out in the Rotterdam civic integration tender, whether mass dismissals would follow, whether market competition should be reversed, and whether municipalities may award contracts without tender. The state secretary confirmed the loss of most of the tender volume, said job losses are inherent to market competition with no new measures planned, rejected reversing market reform, and pointed municipalities to existing non-tender options.
This is inherent to market competition and is the responsibility of the purchaser and provider.
Dit is inherent aan de marktwerking en is de verantwoordelijkheid van de vrager en aanbieder.

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary and minister about the loss of the Rotterdam integration (inburgering) tender by two regional vocational colleges (ROC Zadkine and Albeda), including job losses, finances, compliance with the WEB funding obligation, teacher and quality requirements, and the follow-up to a motion on quality safeguards. The government answered that the municipality of Rotterdam awarded the bulk of the work to other providers, estimated job losses of roughly 70 to 80 fte in 2010 across both colleges partly offset by interim MBO language contracts, and said quality weighed 60% in the tender with teacher qualification requirements applying to all providers, while flanking quality policy would be clarified no earlier than autumn 2010.
Perhaps the municipality of Rotterdam can help the ROCs limit the consequences as much as possible.
Wellicht kan de gemeente Rotterdam de ROC’s helpen om de gevolgen zo veel mogelijk te beperken.

MPs Depla and Vermeij asked whether vocational students aged 16 and 17 face a shortage of internship places and risk falling between stools, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary answered that internship places are still sufficient overall, that the affected group is small, and listed measures such as monitoring by Colo and extra funding for vocational schools.
I have asked Colo to closely monitor the availability of internship places for 16- and 17-year-old vocational students.
Ik heb Colo verzocht de beschikbaarheid van bpv-plaatsen aan 16- en 17-jarige mbo-studenten nauwlettend in de gaten te houden.

MPs Depla and Kraneveldt-van der Veen asked the education state secretaries whether a Den Helder primary school foundation's sponsorship of a basketball club, with its name on team shirts and €8,000 paid from the state grant, is permissible. The government said the arrangement is sponsorship, that using state funds for advertising breaches the funding rules, and that it will ask the Inspectorate to act and request the foundation to end the arrangement.
I will ask the Inspectorate of Education to take this signal under consideration and inform the Meerwerf Basisscholen foundation by letter of my request to end this sponsorship.

Ik zal de Inspectie van het Onderwijs verzoeken om dit signaal in behandeling te nemen en de Stichting Meerwerf Basisscholen per brief in kennis te stellen van mijn verzoek om deze sponsoring te beëindigen.

qa: Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Sneller en Ephraim over de beantwoording van schriftelijke vragen over de benoeming van een nieuw Nederlands lid van de Europese Rekenkamer

MPs Sneller and Ephraim asked whether the government would delay launching the recruitment procedure for a new Dutch member of the European Court of Auditors until parliament could discuss it, and whether the process had adequate checks and balances and peer-based selection. The minister replied that the open procedure through Bureau Algemene Bestuursdienst is already underway, that an independent selection committee will advise ministers before nomination by the Council of the EU after consulting the European Parliament, and that the process is independent with adequate checks.
After the procedure has concluded, the cabinet will consult the relevant parties to consider whether the procedure needs further shaping in the future.
Het kabinet zal na afloop van de procedure in overleg met de relevante spelers bezien of de procedure in de toekomst nog verdere vormgeving behoeft.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het onderzoek inzake de (van betrokkenheid bij terreur verdachte) organisatie UAWC

An MP asked whether the government will promptly send five attachments to an assignment for an external investigation into possible links between UAWC and the PFLP. The minister replies that the documents are two publications wrongly not published directly, containing all details of the commission and an additional assignment, and that they will be published soon.
I am happy to share the documents relating to the assignment granted to Proximities Risk Consultancy.
Ik ben graag bereid de documenten te delen met betrekking tot de aan Proximities Risk Consultancy verleende opdracht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het bericht dat de VN de Taliban 6 miljoen dollar willen betalen voor beveiliging

An MP asked whether the UN paying about 6 million dollars to Taliban-linked security personnel in Afghanistan is acceptable, given sanctions and aid restrictions, and whether the Netherlands will suspend contributions. The government answered that UN payments are made directly to security personnel rather than to the de facto authorities, that Taliban-linked individuals cannot be excluded, that it raises the issue in the UN budget process, and that Dutch aid carries strict conditions.

During the discussion of the UNAMA budget in the Fifth Committee, in which the Netherlands participates, the Netherlands will stress that it is not desirable for the Taliban to be provided with financial resources by or through the UN.

Tijdens de behandeling van het UNAMA budget in de Vijfde Commissie, waar Nederland aan deelneemt, zal Nederland onderstrepen dat het niet wenselijk is dat de Taliban door of via de VN van financiële middelen worden voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over technologieoverdracht aan China

MP Van der Lee asked the government about Dutch companies investing in China, possible circumvention of US sanctions, IMVO and export controls for technology transfer. The minister replied that outward investment monitoring is not planned, existing export controls and IMVO expectations apply, and the issues are raised within the EU.
A mechanism for monitoring outward investments to increase transparency is not something we currently have in the Netherlands or Europe.
Een mechanisme waarbij uitgaande investeringen worden gemonitord om de transparantie te vergroten, kennen we op dit moment niet in Nederland of Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het Rapport 'de evacuatie uit Afghanistan' d.d. 12 december 2021 door Crisisplan

An MP asks the ministers of Defence, Foreign Affairs and Justice about the Crisisplan report on the Afghanistan evacuation, covering implementation of recommendations, the decision-making structure, the reduction of the evacuee list from 60 to 3, the role of the IND and the expanded definition of family members. The government answers that ministries have started implementing recommendations, that the reduction to 3 was an indicative order of magnitude, that all 58 extended family members were ultimately evacuated, and that it will report on implementation before summer.
Before the coming summer, the House will be informed about the implementation of the recommendations.
Voor de aankomende zomer zal de Kamer worden geïnformeerd over de implementatie van de aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de uitspraken van de premier van Canada over Canadese burgers die niet tegen COVID-19 gevaccineerd zijn

An MP asked the foreign minister whether he shares Canadian Prime Minister Trudeau's remarks calling unvaccinated people racist and misogynist, and whether he would raise them with Canada. The minister answered that these are Trudeau's statements, that the Dutch government does not comment on democratically elected politicians of partner countries, and that it will not contact Canadian authorities, while describing Canada's provincially run COVID-19 vaccination policy.

These statements are the responsibility of Prime Minister Trudeau. The Dutch government does not comment on statements by democratically elected politicians of (partner) countries on the internal political affairs of their country.

Deze uitspraken zijn voor rekening van premier Trudeau. De Nederlandse regering laat zich niet uit over uitspraken door democratisch gekozen politici van (partner)landen over de interne politieke aangelegenheden in hun land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Laan over het bericht dat de Poolse Izabela is overleden omdat zij geen abortus mocht ondergaan

Two D66 MPs asked the foreign minister how the government views reports that a Polish woman died after being denied an abortion, and what the Netherlands is doing about Polish abortion law, civil society funding and support for women. The minister said the government is concerned about regressive pressure on women's rights, stated it has raised concerns with Poland, and said the Human Rights Fund cannot finance individuals or abortion services, while noting Dutch healthcare is a member-state competence.
In this specific case it is unclear whether the tragic death was a direct consequence of the abortion legislation or the result of a medical error.
In deze specifieke zaak is het onduidelijk of het tragische overlijden het rechtstreekse gevolg is van de abortuswetgeving of het gevolg was van een medische fout.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over de interactie tussen organisaties inzake de situatie Afghanistan en het asiel- en migratiebeleid

MPs Dassen and Koekkoek asked how the IND was involved in deciding who could be evacuated or relocated from Afghanistan before and after 15 August 2021, and asked for internal advice, criteria and working instructions. The government answered that the IND was involved through questionnaires, document checks, social media checks and visa approval, that the IND's internal advice will be included in the pending Wob requests without a fixed date, and that the criteria were set via the existing tolkenregeling and later adjusted under the Belhaj motion amid extreme time pressure.
In handling the Wob requests, all relevant documents will be considered, including those of IND/DSUA.
Bij de behandeling van de WOB-verzoeken zullen alle relevante stukken worden betrokken, dus ook die van IND/DSUA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Nederlandse investeringen in Qatar

An SP MP asked the government about ING's links via QNB to human rights abuses in Qatar, the government's oversight of Dutch firms and pension funds investing there, and the World Cup. Minister Schreinemacher answered that companies bear responsibility under the OECD guidelines, the government does not supervise compliance, and an official delegation decision will return later in 2022.
No, the cabinet currently does not supervise compliance with the OECD guidelines by Dutch companies.
Nee, het kabinet houdt momenteel geen toezicht op de naleving van de OESO-richtlijnen door Nederlandse bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de recente uitspraken van de Franse president, Emmanuel Macron, over Franse burgers die niet tegen COVID-19 gevaccineerd zijn

An MP asked the Foreign Minister to react to French President Macron's remarks that unvaccinated citizens are not real citizens and that he enjoys provoking them, and whether the EU's shared values are compatible with this. The minister answered that COVID measures are a national matter for France, that the remarks are a matter for the French parliament and courts, and that the Commission monitors rule-of-law issues through the annual cycle, without condemning Macron personally.
The cabinet trusts that any legal objections to the law can be raised within the French legal process.
Het kabinet vertrouwt er daarbij op dat eventuele juridische bezwaren tegen de wet in de Franse rechtsgang aan de orde kunnen worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de veroordeling tot vijf jaar van activist Alaa Abdel Fattah door Egypte

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the five-year sentence of activist Alaa Abdel Fattah in Egypt, his detention conditions, and possible EU sanctions. The minister confirmed the sentence, said Dutch concerns were conveyed privately and publicly, and declined to consider sanctions as not opportune.
However, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not have verifiable information about his detention conditions.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken beschikt echter niet over verifieerbare informatie over zijn detentieomstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Nederland kon bewijzen dat journalist Omar Radi geen spion was, waarom deed het dat niet?'

An MP asks the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands did not attend or actively pursue the trial of journalist Omar Radi in Morocco, despite earlier claims that the case was observed, and whether it contacted Radi's family or lawyer. The minister answers that the embassy attended other hearings but not the first-instance trial, that Morocco must ensure a fair process, and that the Netherlands rejected spying allegations and sent letters but does not interfere in the proceedings.
It is up to Morocco to guarantee a careful process. The Netherlands does not interfere in the course of justice.
Het is aan Marokko om een zorgvuldig proces te garanderen. Nederland mengt zich niet in de rechtsgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het artikel 'In 2021 vonden er bijna 12.000 pushbacks plaats aan Europese buitengrens'

Mr Simons (BIJ1) asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about reports of around 12,000 pushbacks at EU external borders in 2021, including abuse of migrants in the Balkans, and what the government would do about it. The Minister acknowledges the reports and concern, says member states bear primary responsibility for border control, states Dutch concern is raised with the Commission and at the European Council and bilaterally, and says the government will keep raising the issue without committing to a concrete new step.
The cabinet will continue to emphasise the importance of respecting fundamental rights at the border.
Het kabinet zal het belang van het respecteren van fundamentele rechten aan de grens blijven benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over bericht ‘3 jaar cel voor WK-medewerker na steun aan arbeidsmigranten’

An SP MP asks the Foreign Minister about a World Cup worker sentenced to three years in Qatar after supporting migrant workers, questioning the fairness of the trial, lack of embassy presence, and whether an official delegation should attend the World Cup. The minister says the embassy monitors the case with other actors, that the man has access to a lawyer, that consular aid is not possible since he is not Dutch, and that the World Cup delegation question will be revisited later in 2022.
The Dutch embassy in Doha cannot provide consular assistance in the Ibhais case because he is not a Dutch citizen.
De Nederlandse ambassade in Doha kan in de zaak-Ibhais geen consulaire bijstand verlenen omdat het hierbij niet gaat om een Nederlandse burger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister, in written questions, about the coalition agreement, covering EU budget and enlargement, ODA targets, asylum spending, migration partnerships, Middle East resolutions, and transparency. The ministers answered most questions in substance, pointing to existing reports and promising further studies and letters, with few concrete commitments.
The cabinet will inform your House about this in more detail with a BNC fiche.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer hierover met een BNC-fiche nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over mogelijke scenario’s voor een evacuatie uit Oekraïne

An MP from BBB asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about possible evacuation scenarios for Dutch citizens in Ukraine amid Russian troop build-up, including escalation risks, travel advice, consular registration, and EU/NATO coordination. The minister answered that evacuation is only considered in exceptional circumstances, there is currently no reason to organise one, travel advice will be updated when developments warrant, and some questions were answered jointly.
At this moment there is no question of an imminent threat to Dutch nationals.
Op dit moment is er geen sprake van een dreigende situatie voor Nederlanders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Werf over de zorgelijke toestand van INTERPOL

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van der Werf asked ministers about the election of UAE general Al-Raisi as Interpol president, alleged human rights abuse, misuse of red notices and possible measures against Interpol and its members. The ministers answered that Interpol's rules prevent undue country influence, that the election followed the formal procedure, that reforms and corrective measures against misuse are ongoing, and that suspending funds or reconsidering membership is not currently warranted.
I condemn any attempt to misuse Interpol instruments.
Ik keur elke poging tot misbruik van Interpol-instrumenten af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een oproep van maatschappelijke organisaties om straffeloosheid in Jemen te bestrijden

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would pursue new UN investigation into war crimes in Yemen, challenge Saudi Arabia's role in ending the Group of Eminent Experts inquiry, and use Security Council or EU sanctions against those responsible for starvation tactics. The minister said the government keeps accountability high on the agenda through diplomacy and support for local initiatives, declined to pre-judge options under discussion with like-minded states, regretted the inquiry's end, and pointed to raising starvation at EU and UN meetings while describing sanctions as non-punitive tools.
The cabinet does not consider it opportune to anticipate the outcome of these discussions.
Het kabinet acht het niet opportuun om vooruit te lopen op de uitkomst van deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over landonteigening zonder compensatie in Zuid-Afrika

An FVD MP asked the Foreign Minister about South African land expropriation without compensation, the ANC's shift to amending the Expropriation Act after the constitutional change failed, and the risks to Dutch property owners. The minister answered that land reform is a South African national matter, that the Netherlands opposes expropriation without reasonable compensation, that the issue has been raised repeatedly bilaterally and in the EU and OECD, and that Dutch options are limited given South Africa's democratic process and strong courts.
The government will continue to follow this issue and keep sharing the concerns in the Netherlands with South African counterparts for as long as necessary.
De regering zal dit onderwerp blijven volgen en de zorgen die er bestaan in Nederland blijven delen met de Zuid-Afrikaanse gesprekspartners zo lang dat nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het strafproces tegen een Nederlander voor zijn hulp aan vluchtelingen op Lesbos

Two GroenLinks MPs asked about the Greek criminal prosecution of a 73-year-old Dutch volunteer for rescuing and aiding refugees on Lesbos, including whether Nationally consular help was given and whether EU law forbids criminalising such aid. The State Secretary declined to judge the individual case, said the Netherlands will not interfere in Greek proceedings, outlined consular assistance, and argued that the Commission's guidance is not binding and that the government disagrees with its reading on NGO sea rescue.
The Netherlands cannot and will not interfere in the legal proceedings of another country, just as the Netherlands expects other countries not to do so in our legal proceedings.
Nederland kan en wil zich niet in de rechtsgang van een ander land mengen, net zoals Nederland verwacht dat andere landen dat niet doen in onze rechtsgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het bericht 'Nederland gebruikte martelkampen op Bali tijdens de onafhankelijkheidsoorlog'

An MP asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers why the government declined to respond to reports of Dutch torture camps on Bali during the independence war, and whether it would take the findings into account. The government said it welcomes publications that shed light on the period, that it awaits the results of the independent NIOD/KITLV/NIMH study due in February 2022, and will then take an integral position.
The Cabinet awaits the outcomes of the NIOD, KITLV and NIMH research and will on that basis determine an integral position on the use of violence in Indonesia in 1945–1949.
Het Kabinet wacht de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van NIOD, KITLV en NIMH af en zal op basis daarvan een integraal standpunt bepalen over het geweldsgebruik in de jaren 1945–1949 in Indonesië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Gijs van Dijk over het besluit van Israël om zes Palestijnse mensenrechtenorganisaties als terroristisch aan te merken

MPs Piri and Gijs van Dijk asked the Dutch government about Israel's designation of six Palestinian human rights NGOs as terrorist organisations, including whether the government shares concerns that this aims to intimidate donors and whether it has evidence for the allegations. The government said it shares serious concern, has requested the underlying information from Israel without yet judging its reliability, and that the Dutch-Israeli defence cooperation will not be reviewed.
The Netherlands has, in bilateral contacts and through the EU, called for this information to be shared, including with the NGOs concerned.
Nederland heeft in bilaterale contacten en via de EU opgeroepen deze informatie te delen, ook met de betrokken ngo's.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de gesprekken die de Nederlandse gezant voor Afghanistan voert met de top van het Taliban regime in Afghanistan over financiering van zorg- en onderwijssalarissen

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Development Cooperation and Finance about talks the Dutch envoy held with Taliban leaders on financing health and education salaries, including mandate, sanctioned persons, budget articles and sanctions compliance. The government answered all 14 questions in substance, confirming contacts with sanctioned Taliban figures under a no-direct-funding approach while noting salary payments might be channelled via NGOs and international organisations.
The cabinet does not provide financial support to the Taliban, as also requested in the De Roon motion.
Het kabinet verleent geen financiële steun aan de Taliban, zoals tevens is verzocht in de motie-De Roon.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu, Teunissen, Simons, Van der Plas en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Buitenlandse Zaken weigert Afghaanse bewakers ambassade Kabul te evacueren’

MPs asked why Dutch embassy security guards employed via a subcontractor in Kabul were not evacuated while Hungarian guards were, and whether a new direct-employment criterion was introduced without informing parliament. The government answered that the criteria for evacuation (Belhaj motion) were unchanged, that embassy guards fall under host-state responsibility and their employer is responsible, and gave figures on remaining interpreters and Afghans awaiting transfer.
There is no question of a new criterion.
Er is geen sprake van een nieuw criterium.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude, Kamminga en Becker over het bericht 'French government protests EU Commissioner meeting with 'Islamist' NGO'

MPs Van der Woude, Kamminga and Becker asked ministers about an EU Commissioner's meeting with the FEMYSO network, reported as Islamist, and about whether Dutch student associations linked to FEMYSO received university funding. The government declined to endorse the French criticism, said it supports broad civil-society consultation, reported limited funding details from universities, and said the Taskforce on problematic behaviour and undesirable foreign financing would act only if concrete problematic conduct arose.
The cabinet has confidence that our higher education institutions are well able to critically assess applications for financial support for student organisations
Het kabinet heeft er vertrouwen in dat onze instellingen voor hoger onderwijs uitstekend in staat zijn om aanvragen voor financiële ondersteuning voor studentenorganisaties kritisch te beoordelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Belhaj over het rapport 'No Forgiveness for People Like You. Executions and Enforced Disappearances in Afghanistan under the Taliban'

MPs Sjoerdsma and Belhaj asked the Foreign Minister about the Human Rights Watch report on Taliban executions and enforced disappearances of former Afghan government personnel, the broken amnesty, and related policy options. The minister condemned the reported abuses, described diplomatic pressure on the Taliban, and stated that aid is on hold and that UNAMA should keep full access and reporting powers.
The cabinet was aware through the media and other sources of rumours that, although there did not appear to be systematic reprisals, disappearances and executions did occur.
Het kabinet was via de media en andere bronnen op de hoogte van geruchten dat, hoewel er geen sprake leek van systematische vergeldingsacties, verdwijningen en executies wel degelijk voorvielen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Klink over het persbericht van het Duitse Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken inzake gesprekken in Afghanistan

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a German Foreign Ministry press release on talks in Afghanistan, including whether Dutch funding of teacher and health-worker salaries via international organisations amounts to disguised budget support to the Taliban and whether humanitarian aid carries hard conditions. The ministers answered that funding of basic services is only considered under strict conditions (no Taliban involvement, equal access for women and girls, delivery via multilateral bodies or NGOs), that humanitarian aid is subject to softer conditions monitored by the UN and EU, and that the EU has earmarked funds for basic services.

Support must only be provided via multilateral organisations or NGOs, not (directly or indirectly) via the Taliban; there may be no substantive interference by the Taliban regarding policy, implementation and management

Zo dient steun alleen via multilaterale organisaties of ngo’s te worden verstrekt, niet (direct of indirect) via de Taliban; mag er geen inhoudelijke bemoeienis van de Taliban plaatsvinden m.b.t. beleid, uitvoering en management
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het bericht dat Nederland opnieuw niet tegen een VN-resolutie heeft gestemd die enkel de islamitische naam voor de Tempelberg gebruikt

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked why the Netherlands abstained rather than opposed a UN resolution that uses only the Arabic name Haram al-Sharif for the Temple Mount, and questioned the government's voting position and negotiations. Minister Knapen answered that the Netherlands pushed to add the name Temple Mount and remove the Arabic-only reference, that the resolution's content on settlements and evictions is supported, and that the final vote reflected a broad interest assessment.

The Netherlands works at the UN to not exclusively use the term Haram al-Sharif, but to always also use the designation Temple Mount, to reflect the historical, religious and cultural connection of this holy site to the various religions.
Nederland zet zich bij de VN in om niet uitsluitend de term «Haram-al-Sharif» te gebruiken, maar daarbij ook altijd de benaming «Tempelberg» te gebruiken
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Bisschop over rechtsbescherming na Brexit

MPs Van der Staaij and Bisschop asked how legal protection in cross-border contract disputes with a British party has changed after Brexit, including the enforcement gap left by the Brussels I-bis and Rome I regimes, the 1967 bilateral treaty, and whether the UK should join the Lugano Convention. The minister replied that Dutch courts still apply Rome I, that enforcement now falls back on national rules and the 2019 Hague Judgments Convention (not yet in force for the UK), that the Commission opposes UK accession to Lugano, and that the government will push the Hague Convention and await an advisory report on article 431 Rv.
Finally, the Netherlands is working to reach a decision in the EU as quickly as possible to become a party to the 2019 Hague Conference Judgments Convention.
Ten slotte zet Nederland zich in om in de EU zo snel mogelijk tot een besluit te komen om partij te worden bij het Executieverdrag van de Haagse Conferentie van 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Van de Nederlandse rechter trekt de ambassade zich weinig aan’

MPs Piri and Gijs van Dijk asked the Foreign Minister about reports that foreign embassies in the Netherlands, including those of Egypt, Morocco, Saudi Arabia and Kuwait, ignore Dutch court rulings on the treatment of their local staff, and what the government will do about it. The minister said embassies must respect Dutch law, that the ministry reminded the ambassadors of this, and that it can mediate in labour disputes only with both parties' consent, while international immunity limits enforcement against foreign states.
All foreign diplomatic and consular missions established in the Netherlands must respect Dutch law, including the mandatory provisions of Dutch labour law.

Alle in Nederland gevestigde buitenlandse diplomatieke en consulaire vertegenwoordigingen dienen de Nederlandse wet, inclusief de dwingende bepalingen van het Nederlandse arbeidsrecht, te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Simons en Kuzu over de administratieve detentie van Palestijnen

MPs Simons and Kuzu asked the Foreign Minister about over 500 Palestinians held in administrative detention by Israel without charge or trial, including a hunger strike by six detainees, and whether the government would condemn it, press for release, and reconsider the EU-Israel Association Agreement. The minister acknowledged the concern, said five of six hunger strikers had ended their strike via agreements, and said the Netherlands and EU press for strict compliance with safeguards and support NGOs, while declining to commit to sanctions or suspension of the Association Agreement, instead favouring resuming the Association Council.

The Netherlands and the EU consider the specific situation, and more broadly the frequent use of administrative detention, worrying, and regularly stress to the Israeli authorities the importance of a fair legal process.

Nederland en de EU achten de specifieke situatie, en in bredere zin het veelvuldig gebruik van administratieve detentie, zorgelijk en onderstrepen in gesprekken met de Israëlische autoriteiten met regelmaat het belang van een eerlijke rechtsgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het gedrag van de voorzitter van de Europese Commissie

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Commission President's use of a private jet for a short trip is hypocritical given her climate stance, and whether the government would voice this to her. The minister replied that the trip was part of a multi-country visit tied to recovery plans, that charters are used only when no commercial alternative fits, and that Commissioners are accountable under their own code of conduct, so the cabinet will not judge the case.
Eurocommissioners account for their conduct within the codes of conduct drawn up for them.
Eurocommissarissen leggen verantwoording af in het kader van de daarvoor opgestelde gedragscodes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over marteling en seksueel misbruik in Russische gevangenissen aan

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about leaked footage of torture and sexual abuse in Russian prisons, the Kremlin's response, and whether the government would press Russia bilaterally and multilaterally for an independent investigation, including by the CPT. The minister condemned the abuses, said Russia is expected to investigate and punish perpetrators, committed to raising the issue bilaterally and in multilateral fora, and noted the CPT report would be shared with Russia in spring 2022 but published only with Russian consent.
The report will only be made public after Russia's consent.
Het rapport wordt pas openbaar na instemming van Rusland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de intimidatie van MH-17-advocaten

An MP asked the government about reports that lawyers representing MH17 victims' relatives were intimidated, likely by Russia, and about security measures, diplomatic responses, spying offences, a foreign agents register, and countering disinformation and cyberattacks. The government condemned all interference, said it monitors the security situation closely and takes measures where needed, but declined to discuss individual cases and said no diplomatic action is currently warranted, while noting a planned bill to extend espionage offences.
For security reasons I cannot address individual cases or comment on whether investigations are ongoing.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen kan ik niet ingaan op individuele casuïstiek en kan ik geen uitspraken doen over al dan niet lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Wijngaarden over het RTL4 nieuwsitem inzake de intimidatie van de advocaten van de nabestaanden van de MH17-zaak

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that lawyers for MH17 victims' relatives were intimidated, possibly by Russia, including being followed to their homes. Minister Grapperhaus declined to discuss individual cases or investigations for security reasons, described general counter-interference cooperation, and said the NCTV protects those involved while noting no information currently warrants diplomatic action.
For security reasons, I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Ik kan vanuit veiligheidsoverwegingen geen uitspraken doen over individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en van Nispen over het RTL4 nieuwsitem inzake de intimidatie van de advocaten van de nabestaanden van de MH17-zaak

MPs Palland and Van Nispen asked whether lawyers for MH17 victims' relatives were intimidated, likely by Russia, and what the government would do about it. Minister Grapperhaus declined to confirm individual cases or attribution for security reasons, citing close cooperation with intelligence services and general awareness measures, and offered a confidential technical briefing to the House.
For security reasons, I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Vanuit veiligheidsoverwegingen kan ik geen uitspraken doen over individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht 'Vrede in Bosnië onder druk: leider Serviërs morrelt aan voortbestaan staat'

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Foreign Minister about Milorad Dodik's provocations in Bosnia and Herzegovina, possible Bonn Powers use, EU/US sanctions, electoral law changes, and Commissioner Várhelyi's handling of rule-of-law and LGBTI concerns in Serbia's enlargement report. The minister acknowledges rising tensions and supports PIC statements and EU diplomacy, rejects no sanctions outright but says instruments must be weighed carefully, and takes a cautiously critical line on Serbia's progress, opposing opening two clusters as too optimistic.
The cabinet is in discussion with EU partners on de-escalating the situation.
Het kabinet is in gesprek met EU-partners over de-escalatie van de situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het bericht dat een 'Internationale gezant Bosnië waarschuwt voor hervatting oorlog'

An MP from JA21 asked the Foreign Minister about threats by Milorad Dodik to secede Republika Srpska and withdraw from national institutions in Bosnia and Herzegovina, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister answered that such unilateral moves are unconstitutional and unacceptable, supported EU and PIC condemnation and backing for the High Representative, and said the Netherlands would push for targeted EU sanctions.
The cabinet is of the view that such unilateral decisions are extremely undesirable and moreover unconstitutional.
Het kabinet is van mening dat dergelijke eenzijdige besluiten buitengewoon onwenselijk en bovendien ongrondwettelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over interactie asiel- en migratiebeleid en evacuaties Afghanistan

Volt MPs asked the government about the Afghanistan evacuations, including whether correspondence between ministries and the IND would be shared, the IND's role in evacuation lists, and how asylum policy relates to crisis situations. The state secretary answered that correspondence will be released via pending FOI requests with no firm timeline, that the IND had a limited support role without staff in Kabul, and that the asylum policy framework accommodates crisis situations.
Your House will therefore receive an overview of the information disclosed in this context at or immediately after its publication.
Uw Kamer zal dan ook een overzicht van de in dit kader geopenbaarde informatie ontvangen bij of onmiddellijk na de openbaarmaking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Brekelmans en Rajkowski over het bericht Hoe China met de Nederlandse politie meekijkt

MPs Michon-Derkzen, Brekelmans and Rajkowski asked whether the Dutch police use Chinese DJI drones, whether this was preceded by a security and privacy risk analysis, and whether the government will act given Chinese cyber and data-access risks. The Minister answers that the police use DJI drones only for routine tasks and not for confidential operations, that a security check and data protection impact assessment were done, that mitigating measures are in place, and that no further investigation is planned.
Given the steps the police have already taken, I see no reason to order an investigation.
Ik zie, gezien de stappen die de politie al heeft gezet, geen aanleiding om een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over Israël die zes verschillende Palestijnse ngo’s heeft bestempeld als terroristisch

An MP asked the government whether it would press Israel to explain its designation of six Palestinian NGOs as terrorist, whether it would condemn the move with EU partners, and whether Dutch funding to these organisations can continue. The government replied that it has requested the underlying information from Israel, has raised the issue bilaterally and in the EU, and is monitoring the consequences, without yet announcing a change in funding.
The Netherlands has asked Israel, both bilaterally and within the EU, to provide access to the underlying information on which the listing decision is based.
Nederland heeft zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband Israël verzocht om inzage te geven in de onderliggende informatie die ten grondslag ligt aan het besluit tot listing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over verbod van zes Palestijnse niet-gouvernementele organisatiesd

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would object to Israel's designation of six Palestinian NGOs as terrorist organisations, whether it shares concerns about suppression of rights defenders, and whether Dutch-funded organisations would keep their funding. The minister answered that Israel has not yet shared the underlying evidence, that the Netherlands has requested it and is monitoring closely, and that funding to one organisation was suspended in 2020 pending an external review while indirect funding to two others continues.
The information underlying the six listings is not public.
De informatie die ten grondslag ligt aan de zes listings is niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat Israël zes Palestijnse mensenrechtenorganisaties als terroristisch heeft bestempeld

An MP asked the foreign minister about Israel's designation of six Palestinian human rights organisations as terrorist, and about the broader record of Israeli rights violations and the Dutch response. The government said it had requested the underlying evidence from Israel without receiving it yet, that it raises the issue bilaterally and in the EU, and that it continues to press Israel on international law and accountability.
The information underlying the six listings is not public.
De informatie die ten grondslag ligt aan de zes listings is niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Beertema over het bericht dat Nederland met China DNA-onderzoek doet

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether the government knew about Dutch labs developing sensitive DNA techniques with Chinese scientists, and what it would do about it. The answer, given by Minister Slob, mostly addresses truancy (thuiszitters) in the Holland Rijnland region, does not address the DNA or China questions, and only says the government will continue its integrated truancy approach.
Following the report in the Leidsch Dagblad and the questions from MP De Hoop (PvdA), I had contact made with the Regional Truancy Bureau Holland Rijnland.
Naar aanleiding van het bericht in het Leidsch Dagblad en de vragen van het lid De Hoop (PvdA) heb ik contact laten opnemen met het Regionaal Bureau Leerplicht Holland Rijnland
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de internationale onderhandelingen over het gebruik van explosieve wapens in dichtbevolkte gebieden

The MP asked the Foreign Minister about the timing of the next negotiation round on a political declaration on explosive weapons in populated areas, and whether the Dutch position would be shared in advance. The minister answered that Ireland is considering late January or early February, that the Dutch position remains as previously explained, and that the Chamber will be informed of the outcome.
Once the international negotiations have concluded, the cabinet will inform your Chamber of the outcome and provide further explanation of the Dutch position.
Op het moment dat de internationale onderhandelingen afgerond zijn, zal het kabinet uw Kamer op de hoogte brengen van de uitkomst en verdere toelichting geven op de Nederlandse inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over ‘Turkije dat een onderzoek naar de Nederlandse terroristensteun in Syrië hindert’

An MP asks whether Turkey demanded access to the Dutch inquiry into Dutch support for Syrian rebels, whether this blocked fieldwork, what conditions Turkey set, and whether the government will publicly condemn Turkey. The minister replies that the independent Cammaert commission works autonomously, the report is expected next autumn, Turkey is an important NATO ally, and the deadline for answers was met.
The cabinet cannot speak on behalf of or about the work of the Commission of inquiry, which conducts its investigation independently and according to its own judgment.
Het kabinet kan niet namens of over de werkzaamheden van de Commissie van onderzoek spreken, die haar onderzoek onafhankelijk en naar eigen inzicht doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Juntaleider Myanmar reageert na uitsluiting voor deelname aan regionale top’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the Myanmar junta leader's exclusion from a regional summit, reports of thousands of political prisoners still held and mistreated, the EU's diplomatic pressure and sanctions options, humanitarian aid, and the relocation of Rohingya refugees to Bhasan Char. The minister answered in detail, acknowledging the grave situation, describing EU sanctions efforts and aid, and stating that Rohingya relocation must be voluntary.
The cabinet continues to call for the immediate and unconditional release of all these prisoners.
Het kabinet blijft oproepen tot onmiddellijke en onvoorwaardelijke vrijlating van al deze gevangenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar, Brekelmans en El Yassini over het bericht 'FBI raids ZPMC delivery vessel'

MPs Valstar, Brekelmans and El Yassini (VVD) asked about reports of FBI raids on ZPMC (a Chinese state-owned shipbuilder) over suspected espionage, whether Dutch authorities had contact with US and Chinese authorities, how work-residence permits via recognised sponsor status are vetted for firms from China, Russia and Iran, and whether that status should be reconsidered. The State Secretary declined to comment on intelligence knowledge or diplomatic contacts, said fewer than five work permits were issued to ZPMC Netherlands staff since 2015 with none revoked, described the IND's sponsor vetting and the limited role of intelligence services, and said the government is critically reviewing the sponsor scheme with a later update promised.
No public statements are made about the knowledge level of the intelligence and security services.
Over het kennisniveau van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten worden in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over veiligheid van Nederlanders in Ethiopië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew Saudi Arabia urged its citizens to leave Ethiopia, how to avoid a repeat of the Afghanistan evacuation chaos, what agreements exist with allies on evacuations, and how many Dutch nationals are in Ethiopia and what they are advised to do. The minister confirmed the Saudi advice, pointed to outreach to register unregistered Dutch nationals, referred to EU cooperation arrangements without detail, and said about 200 registered Dutch nationals were advised to assess whether they must stay and to prepare papers for departure.
In Ethiopia, arrangements on cooperation between different countries have been made within the EU.
In Ethiopië zijn binnen de EU afspraken gemaakt over samenwerking tussen verschillende landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Omtzigt over de escalatie van het conflict in Ethiopië

MPs Sjoerdsma and Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister about the escalation of the Ethiopia conflict, including travel advice, consular preparedness and the security of the Dutch embassy. The minister answered that the travel advice was raised to red (except Addis Ababa, orange), Dutch nationals were urged to leave via commercial flights, and the situation is continuously monitored.

The Foreign Affairs travel advice was adjusted on 4 November in connection with the security situation and has since had a red classification, except for the capital Addis Ababa, which has an orange classification.

Het reisadvies van Buitenlandse Zaken is op 4 november jl. in verband met de veiligheidssituatie aangepast en heeft sindsdien een rode classificatie, behalve voor de hoofdstad Addis Abeba, dat een oranje classificatie heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over het rapport van Reclaim Finance met de titel ‘Banks fuelling expansion of oil-and-gas Arctic extraction’

MPs Van der Lee and Snels asked the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Finance about a Reclaim Finance report showing Dutch banks and investors still fund oil and gas firms active in the Arctic, and whether the government would act on it. Minister Knapen answered that the government opposes Arctic oil and gas exploitation, expects financial institutions to follow OECD and UNGP standards, and will raise the issue in EU and Arctic Council channels, but could not provide an overview of investments or policies and deferred several points.
The cabinet does not have such an overview.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over een dergelijk overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse president van plan is de gevechtsmissie in Irak voor het einde van het jaar te beëindigen

Boswijk (CDA) asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that the US would end its combat mission in Iraq by year end, including its concrete plans, notification of allies, implications for troop presence and Dutch safety, and the effect of al-Sadr's election win. The government answered that US combat troops will withdraw by 1 January 2022, that allies were informed via the anti-ISIS coalition, that the remaining 2500 troops will focus on advisory and capacity building, and that ISIS remains a threat with ongoing attacks.
On the security risks and mitigating measures for the Dutch deployment, the House will be informed separately in the article 100 letter.
Over de veiligheidsrisico's en mitigerende maatregelen voor de Nederlandse inzet wordt de Kamer separaat in de artikel 100-brief geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Agnes Mulder over het bericht 'Hof Polen: Pools recht weegt zwaarder dan Europees Recht'

MPs Kamminga and Agnes Mulder asked the government how it assesses the Polish Constitutional Tribunal's ruling that Polish law prevails over EU law, its consequences for the rule of law, EU instruments (infringement, Article 7, RRF, budget conditionality) and Dutch citizens and firms. The minister answered that the ruling threatens the primacy of EU law, that the Commission has the tools and is to act, that Netherlands supports strong steps and conditioning Polish RRF approval on judicial independence, and that the Prime Minister will raise it at the European Council.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht ‘Polen ligt met volle kracht op ramkoers met Europa’

MP Piri asks the Foreign Minister about the Polish Constitutional Tribunal ruling challenging EU law primacy, and what the Netherlands will do via Article 7 procedures, bilateral pressure, Commission action, the RRF and the rule-of-law conditionality mechanism. The minister answers that the ruling has far-reaching EU implications, that the Netherlands backs Commission action and will push for infringement proceedings and rule-of-law measures, but acknowledges a four-fifths majority for Article 7 steps is unrealistic.
The Netherlands will keep calling on the Commission to start infringement proceedings against Poland.
Nederland zal de Commissie blijven oproepen om een inbreukprocedure tegen Polen te starten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Segers over partijdigheid van de UNHRC-onderzoekscommissie naar eventuele oorlogsmisdaden door Israël en de Palestijnen

MPs Van der Staaij and Segers asked whether the UNHRC commission of inquiry on Israel and the Palestinians is biased, given members' past public criticism of Israel, and whether its open-ended mandate should be changed. The Minister answered that members are appointed by the UNHRC President who must ensure impartiality, that the Netherlands abstained partly over the mandate's breadth, and that the government will scrutinise future reports for one-sided positions.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht dat de Australische staat Victoria ongevaccineerde parlementsleden niet meer toelaat in het parlementsgebouw

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemns Victoria's ban on unvaccinated MPs entering parliament as an attack on democracy. The minister answered that Victoria's rule was adopted democratically, that no comparable mandate exists in the Netherlands, and that he would not object to Australian domestic legislation.
However, in my view it is not appropriate to reject Australian domestic legislation, which was democratically enacted.
Het is echter wat mij betreft niet aan de orde om Australische binnenlandse wetgeving, die democratisch tot stand is gekomen, af te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Kops over de gastekorten en het bericht dat het Russische Gazprom minder gas levert

PVV MPs De Roon and Kops asked the government about gas shortages, reduced Gazprom deliveries, nuclear energy and mandatory gas storage reserves. The State Secretary answered that Dutch-specific gas imports cannot be isolated, that high prices reflect supply and demand factors, that nuclear energy is not excluded, and that storage obligations are not currently necessary.
It is only possible to measure European gas imports from Russia.
Het is enkel mogelijk om de Europese gasimport vanuit Rusland te meten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Amhaouch over ontwikkelingen omtrent de Brexit met specifiek het Noord-Ierland protocol

MPs Kamminga and Amhaouch asked the Foreign Minister about Brexit and the Northern Ireland Protocol, including the Commission's proposed simplifications, risks of fraud, and the possible use of Article 16. The minister answered that the Protocol is still being negotiated with the UK, that full implementation remains the goal, and that the consequences of Article 16 cannot yet be assessed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over de situatie van Jezidische slachtoffers

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked the Dutch government about the precarious situation of Yazidi victims of IS, including women with children from IS rapists, and whether the Netherlands should create an asylum programme like Germany, France and Canada. The government acknowledged likely genocide and described support programmes, explained that resettlement is UNHCR-led and that the Netherlands has no humanitarian admission programme, and outlined revised asylum assessment practice for Yazidis; it did not answer the final question on timing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het verzoek van de ambassade in Kabul om militaire bijstand

An SP MP asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers why they rejected the Kabul embassy's request for military assistance, why it was omitted from the factual account, and why the request came only on 16 August. The ministers replied that no refusal occurred, that the embassy recommended a special forces protection team on 16 August which deployed on 17 August, and that the Taliban's rapid takeover surprised everyone.
There has been no question of rejecting a request for military assistance.
Van afwijzing van een verzoek tot militaire bijstand is geen sprake geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de situatie in Tigray (Ethiopië) en de humanitaire crisis die daar plaatsvindt

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the humanitarian crisis in Tigray, Ethiopia, including blockade of aid, telecommunications and banking cutoffs, and what Dutch diplomacy and sanctions could do. The minister answered that the situation is very serious, that Dutch funding of over EUR 15 million continues, that no dialogue between the parties currently exists, and that the Netherlands will push for sanctions at the next Foreign Affairs Council.
The Netherlands will therefore again advocate for sanctions at the upcoming FAC of 18 October.
Nederland zal dan ook wederom pleiten voor sancties tijdens de aankomende RBZ van 18 oktober.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Omtzigt over het aantal evacuaties vanuit de ambassade in Kaboel

MPs Van Dijk and Omtzigt asked whether the 'three' figure for evacuation exceptions from Kabul was used in government deliberations, and why the minutes of the inter-ministerial meetings are withheld. The minister says the figure was only an order-of-magnitude illustration relayed by phone, that cabinet minutes are confidential to protect the unity of cabinet policy, and that questions cannot be answered within 72 hours.

For this reason, information about the views within the cabinet is not made public, such as minutes of the (Council of) Ministers and preparation for sub-councils, other consultations of ministers and preliminary official deliberations.

Om deze reden wordt informatie over de opvattingen binnen het kabinet niet openbaar, zoals bijvoorbeeld verslagen van de (Rijks)ministerraad en voorbereiding voor onderraden, andere overleggen van bewindslieden en ambtelijke voorportalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het bericht dat 58 Afghanen via Pakistan naar Nederland worden gehaald

An MP asked whether 58 Afghans who crossed into Pakistan would be brought to the Netherlands, whether the government assisted their overland crossing despite advising against it, and whether moving them from Pakistan shows the aim is relocation to the Netherlands rather than regional protection. The minister confirmed the transfers, said travel decisions are personal responsibility, and stated that the government will keep pursuing evacuation of eligible people while preferring regional protection for others.
The cabinet wants to make a special effort for interpreters and persons who had already been called up for evacuation under the Belhaj et al. motion.
Het kabinet wil een bijzondere inspanning leveren voor tolken en de personen die reeds opgeroepen waren voor evacuatie in het kader van de motie-Belhaj c.s.
